headline: Joe Cole Oo Daaha Ka Rogay Hal Arrin Oo Palmer Ku Qasbi Karta Inuu Chelsea Ka Tago
body:
Xiddigii hore ee kooxda Chelsea, Joe Cole, ayaa ka digay in mustaqbalka Cole Palmer uu ku xirnaan doono haddii kooxdu ay u soo baxdo tartanka Champions League xilli-ciyaareedka soo socda.
Joe Cole ayaa aaminsan in in kasta oo Palmer uu yahay ciyaaryahan muhiim u ah Chelsea, haddana hammigiisa shaqsiga ah uu yahay inuu ka ciyaaro tartamada ugu waaweyn Yurub. “Haddii aadan koox ahaan u diyaarin madal uu Cole Palmer ku ciyaaro Champions League, ugu yaraan maskaxdiisu waxay bilaabi doontaa inay ka fikirto meel kale,” ayuu yiri Cole.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray in heshiisyada dhaadheer ee ciyaartoyda lala galo aysan dammaanad buuxda u ahayn inay sii joogaan haddii ay ku qanacsanaan waayaan heerka tartanka kooxda. Palmer oo bandhig heer sare ah ka sameeyay Stamford Bridge tan iyo markii uu ku soo biiray, ayaa loo arkaa xiddig u qalma inuu ka dhex muuqdo fagaarayaasha ugu sarreeya kubadda cagta.
Hadalka Joe Cole ayaa imaanaya xilli Chelsea ay ku jirto halgan adag oo ay ugu jirto boosaska loogu soo boxo Champions League, iyadoo suuqa xagaaga ee soo socda la filayo inuu noqdo mid go’aamin doona mustaqbalka qaar ka mid ah xiddigaha ugu muhiimsan kooxda. Taageerayaasha Blues ayaa rajaynaya in kooxdu ay gaarto hadafkeeda si ay u sii haysato xiddigan hibada leh.

headline: Clarence Seedorf Oo Magacaabay Kooxda Ugu Cadcad Ku Guuleysiga Champions League Sannad Kaan; Ma Ahan PSG
body:
Halyeeyga reer Holland iyo kooxda AC Milan, Clarence Seedorf, ayaa magacaabay kooxda uu u arko inay ku guuleysan karto koobka Champions League sannadkan, isagoo iska indha-tiray kooxaha PSG iyo Bayern Munich.
Seedorf oo hadlayay ka dib markii ay PSG 5-4 ku garaacday Bayern Munich kulan xiiso badnaa oo dhacay habeenkii Talaadada, ayaa sheegay inuu aad ula yaabay difaac xumada ay soo bandhigeen labada kooxood. Wuxuu aaminsan yahay in difaac adag uu yahay furaha guusha tartankan, taasna ay hadda haysato kooxda Arsenal.
“Waxaan aragnay kooxo ay ka mid tahay Arsenal oo shabaqeeda aad u ilaashata, taasna ay isbeddel samaynayso,” ayuu yiri Seedorf oo ka hadlayay barnaamijka Amazon Prime. Wuxuu intaas ku daray, “Haddii ay jirto koox guriga keeni karta koobka, waxay noqon kartaa iyaga (Arsenal).”
Arsenal ayaa caawa u safreysa dalka Spain si ay ula ciyaarto Atletico Madrid kulanka lugta hore ee wareegga semi-finalka. Seedorf ayaa aaminsan in degenaanshaha dhanka difaaca ee kooxda Mikel Arteta ay siineyso fursad ka wanaagsan kooxaha kale ee xamaasadda badan ee PSG iyo Bayern, kuwaas oo muujiyay inay nugul yihiin marka la weeraro.

headline: Luis Enrique Oo Shaaciyay Kulankii Ugu Adkaa Ee Uu Koox Leyliyo, Iyo Goolasha Ay Kooxdiisu Dhalin Doonto Ciyaarta Lugta Labaad Ee Munich
body:
Tababaraha kooxda Paris Saint-Germain, Luis Enrique, ayaa ku sifeeyay guushii waalida ahayd ee 5-4 ay kaga adkaadeen Bayern Munich “ciyaartii ugu fiicnayd ee uu waligiis koox layliyo,” isagoo dhanka kale shaaca ka qaaday hammigiisa gool-dhalineed ee kulanka lugta labaad.
Enrique, oo aad ula dhacsanaa qaab ciyaareedka weerarka iyo xamaasadda ciyaarta, ayaa sheegay in inkasta oo ay haystaan hal gool oo ay ku hoggaaminayaan, haddana ay Munich u dagaallami doonaan sidii inay 0-0 tahay ciyaarta. Wuxuu xusay in kooxdiisu ay u baahan doonto inay dhaliso “ugu yaraan saddex gool” oo dheeri ah marka la tago garoonka Allianz Arena si ay u hubiyaan inay u soo baxaan finalka, maaddaama uu aaminsan yahay in Bayern ay aad u khatar badnaan doonto marka ay gurigooda joogaan.
“Bayern waxay ku ciyaari doonaan garoonkooda iyagoo taageerayaashoodu ka dambeeyaan, laakiin waxaan doonaynaa inaan ku ciyaarno isla maskaxdii weerarka ahayd. Waxaan rabnaa inaan badino ciyaarta, taasna waxay u baahan tahay inaan dhalino goolal,” ayuu yiri Enrique oo la hadlayay saxaafadda ka dib ciyaarta.
Ciyaartan oo noqotay tii ugu goolasha badnayd ee semi-finalka Champions League abid, ayaa muujisay awoodda weerar ee labada kooxood, iyadoo Enrique uu qiray inay mudnaayeen inay badshaan, barbaro galaan, ama xitaa laga badiyo marka loo eego fursadihii badnaa ee labada dhinac isweydaarsadeen.
Go’aanka tababaraha ee ah inuu sii wado weerarka xitaa isagoo marti ah ayaa muujinaya kalsoonida uu ku qabo xiddigaha PSG si ay u difaacdaan koobka ay xilli-ciyaareedkii hore ku guuleysteen.

headline: Mikel Arteta Oo Xaqiijiyay Xiddigihiisa Diyaarka U Ah Kulanka Atletico Iyo Kuwa Seegaya
body:
Tababaraha Arsenal, Mikel Arteta, ayaa xaqiijiyay liiska ciyaartoyda u diyaarka ah iyo kuwa ka maqnaan doona kulanka adag ee lugta hore ee semi-finalka Champions League ee ay caawa wajahayaan kooxda Atletico Madrid.
Arteta oo ka hadlayay shirka jaraa’id ee ka hor ciyaarta ayaa caddeeyay in xiddigaha muhiimka ah ee kala ah Eberechi Eze, Bukayo Saka, iyo Ricardo Calafiori ay dhamaantood diyaar yihiin oo ay qayb ka yihiin safka u safray dalka Spain.
Calafiori ayaa dib u soo laabashadiisu tahay mid muhiim u ah daafaca, halka Eze iyo Saka ay diyaar u yihiin inay hogaamiyaan weerarka Gunners kulanka ka dhici doona garoonka Metropolitano.
Dhanka kale, Arteta ayaa xaqiijiyay in weeraryahanka reer Germany, Kai Havertz, uu seegi doono kulankan dhaawac aawgiis. “Eze, Calafiori, iyo Saka dhamaantood waa diyaar… Kai isagu wuu seegayaa kulanka,” ayuu yiri Arteta.
Ciyaartan oo bilaaban doonta 10-ka habeenimo ee xilliga Geeska Afrika ayaa loo arkaa mid go’aamin karta rajada Arsenal ee ah inay markii ugu horreysay taariikhda u soo baxaan finalka Champions League, iyadoo maqnaanshaha Havertz ay tahay dhabar-jab yar balse soo laabashada xiddigaha kale ay kalsooni siinayso kooxda.

headline: Rio Ferdinand Oo Magacaabay Xiddiga Ku Hoggaamin Kara Arsenal Ku Guuleysiga Horyaalka Xilli Ciyaareed Kaan
body:
Difaacii hore ee Manchester United, Rio Ferdinand, ayaa magacaabay xiddiga uu aaminsan yahay inuu Arsenal ka caawin karo ku guuleysiga horyaalka Premier League xilli-ciyaareedkan, isagoo tilmaamay in Eberechi Eze uu yahay furaha guusha.
Ferdinand oo ka hadlayay barnaamijkiisa YouTube-ka ayaa sheegay in Eze uu yahay ciyaaryahan leh tayo gaar ah oo uu ugu hoggaamin karo Gunners hanashada koobka haddii fursad xor ah la siiyo. Eze ayaa dhaliyay goolkiisii 10-aad ee xilli-ciyaareedka kulankii ay Arsenal 1-0 kaga badisay Newcastle Sabtidii lasoo dhaafay, taas oo ka caawisay kooxda inay saddex dhibcood ku qabato hoggaanka horyaalka.
“Waa inaad Eze xorriyad siisaan. Isaga ayaa idinku hoggaamin kara horyaalka,” ayuu yiri Ferdinand. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in ninkan uu awood u leeyahay inuu kooxda dhan dhabarka saarto ilaa laga gaarayo xariiqda guusha.
Sida ay qortay Daily Mail, hadalka Ferdinand ayaa imaanaya xilli tartanka horyaalka ee u dhexeeya Arsenal iyo Manchester City uu marayo meel aad u kulul, iyadoo khubarada ciyaaruhu ay isha ku hayaan saameynta ay xiddigaha isbeddelka sameeya sida Eze ku yeelan karaan natiijooyinka u dambeeya ee xilli-ciyaareedka.

headline: Casemiro Oo Iska Diiday Dalab Weyn Oo Uga Yimid Sacuudiga, Oggolaadayna Inuu Ku Biiro Koox Ka Dhisan Horyaalka Mareykanka
body:
Xiddiga khadka dhexe ee Manchester United, Casemiro, ayaa la sheegay inuu iska diiday dalabyo lacag badan oo uga yimid kooxaha ka dhisan dalka Sacuudi Carabiya, isagoo doorbidaya inuu u dhaqaaqo horyaalka Mareykanka ee MLS, gaar ahaan kooxda Inter Miami.
Sida ay qortay jariidadda Mirror, kooxaha Al-Hilal iyo Al-Nassr ayaa miiska u saaray xiddiga reer Brazil dalabyo dhaqaale oo aad u sarreeya, balse Casemiro ayaa ka caga-jiidaya inuu qoyskiisa u raro gobolkaas. Taa beddelkeeda, wuxuu aad u danaynayaa nolosha magaalada Miami iyo mashruuca kooxda uu leeyahay David Beckham.
Inter Miami ayaa la sheegay inay wadahadallo kula jirto ciyaaryahanka, iyadoo u bandhigtay heshiis socon kara ilaa sannadka 2028-ka, oo ay weheliso ikhtiyaar hal sano oo dheeri ah. Casemiro oo la filayo inuu ka tago Old Trafford dhammaadka xilli-ciyaareedkan ka dib markii lagu heshiin waayay qandaraas cusub, ayaa u arka horyaalka MLS fursad uu ugu raaxaysan karo kubadda cagta iyo nolosha qoyskiisaba.
Haddii uu heshiiskan hirgalo, Casemiro wuxuu ku biiri doonaa liiska xiddigaha caanka ah ee ku sugan Miami, taas oo kor u qaadi doonta tayada iyo sumcadda kooxda ee tartamada caalamiga ah. Taageerayaasha Manchester United ayaa iyaguna isha ku haya halka uu ku dambayn doono mid ka mid ah xiddigaha ugu khibradda badan khadkooda dhexe.

headline: Florentino Pérez Oo Doortay Tababaraha Beddelaya Alvaro Arbeloa
body:
Wararka ugu dambeeya ee laga helayo kooxda Real Madrid ayaa sheegaya in madaxweyne Florentino Pérez uu doortay Jose Mourinho inuu noqdo tababaraha xiga ee kooxda, isagoo doonaya inuu dib u soo nooleeyo mashruuca kooxda ee lumay labadii sano ee la soo dhaafay.
Sida ay qortay Footyleaks, Álvaro Arbeloa oo kooxda la wareegay bartamihii xilli-ciyaareedkan ayaa la filayaa inuu iska casilo xilka xagaaga soo socda, ka dib markii kooxdu ay ku fashilantay inay ku guuleysato wax koobab muhiim ah. Suxufiga caanka ah ee David Ornstein ayaa xaqiijiyay in Mourinho uu yahay musharaxa koowaad ee uu Pérez doonayo inuu keeno garoonka Santiago Bernabéu.
Soo laabashada macquulka ah ee Mourinho ayaa dhalisay dareen kala duwan; qaar ayaa u arka inuu yahay ninka kaliya ee dib u habayn kara kooxda, halka qaar kale ay ka walaacsan yihiin xiisadihii iyo khilaafaadkii uu horay uga dhex abuuray naadiga. Mourinho ayaa horay u soo layliyay Real Madrid intii u dhaxaysay 2010 ilaa 2013, isagoo markaas kooxda u horseeday guulo horyaalka ah.
Go’aankan ayaa loo arkaa mid istiraatiiji ah oo khatar badan leh, maaddaama madaxweyne Pérez uu kaligii rabo inuu go’aamiyo qofka hoggaamin doona kooxda xilli-ciyaareedka dambe. Taageerayaasha Madrid ayaa si weyn u sugaya in la xaqiijiyo haddii “Special One” uu markii labaad dib ugu soo laaban doono caasimadda Spain si uu kooxda ugu soo celiyo dhabbihii guusha.

headline: Manuel Ugarte Oo Go’aan Ka Gaartay Mustaqbalka Manuel Ugarte
body:
Manchester United ayaa qorshaynaysa inay iska iibiso xiddiga reer Uruguay ee Manuel Ugarte inta lagu guda jiro suuqa kala iibsiga ee xagaaga soo socda, kadib markii uu ku fashilmay inuu kooxda ku soo kordhiyo wixii laga filayay.
Sida uu shaaca ka qaaday suxufiga caanka ah ee Fabrizio Romano, maamulka kooxda ayaa go’aansaday inay fasaxaan Ugarte si ay dib u habayn ugu sameeyaan khadka dhexe. Ugarte ayaa kooxda kaga soo biiray Paris Saint-Germain xagaagii 2024 lacag dhan 50 milyan oo euro, balse waxa uu ku dhibtooday inuu la qabsado horyaalka Premier League iyo nidaamka kooxda.
Manchester United ayaa hiigsanaysa inay lasoo saxiixato ugu yaraan laba ciyaaryahan oo cusub oo khadka dhexe ah, iyadoo dhanka kale xoogga saaraysa cusboonaysiinta heshiiska Kobbie Mainoo, kaas oo wacdaro ka dhigaya kooxda.
Qorshahan ayaa qayb ka ah isbeddellada ballaaran ee ay kooxdu doonayso inay samayso si ay ugu tartanto koobabka xilli-ciyaareedka dambe, iyadoo Ugarte loo arko mid ka mid ah ciyaartoyda banneyn doona booska si loo helo saxiixyo cusub oo tayo leh.

headline: Sergio Aguero Oo Magacaabay Kooxda Ugu Cadcad Ku Guuleysiga Champions League Ka Hor Kulamada Semi-final-ka Tartanka
body:
Halyeeyga kooxda Manchester City, Sergio Aguero, ayaa shaaca ka qaaday kooxda uu u arko inay ugu cad-cadahay ku guuleysiga tartanka UEFA Champions League xilli-ciyaareedkan, isagoo ku sifeeyay inay yihiin kuwo “halis ah.”
Aguero ayaa aaminsan in kooxda difaacaneysa horyaalnimada ee Paris Saint-Germain ay tahay tan ugu dhow inay mar kale kor u qaaddo koobka. PSG ayaa caawa wajahaysa Bayern Munich kulanka lugta hore ee wareegga semi-finalka ee ka dhacaya magaalada Paris.
“Waxaan u malaynayaa in PSG ay aad u wanaagsan tahay,” ayuu Aguero u sheegay Stake. “Ma fududa in laba sano oo isku xigta lagu guuleysto, laakiin maanta Bayern iyo Paris labaduba aad ayay u xooggan yihiin. Waxaan qabaa in PSG ay fursado badan leeyihiin. Waxay u ciyaaraan si isku mid ah, waxayna heystaan ciyaartoy ay adag tahay in la joojiyo.”
Aguero ayaa intaas ku daray in maamulka Luis Enrique uu kooxda siiyay weji cad iyo qaab ciyaareed qeexan, taasina ay ka dhigayso koox dhammaystiran oo halis ku ah qof kasta oo ka hor yimaada. Inkasta oo uu qiray awoodda Bayern Munich, haddana wuxuu dareensan yahay in dunida inteeda badan ay hadda u arkaan PSG kooxda ugu fursadda wanaagsan ee hanan karta koobka qaaradda Yurub.

headline: Arsenal Oo War Farxad Leh Ka Heshay Xaaladda Eze iyo Calafiori Ka Hor Kulanka Atletico
body:
Kooxda Arsenal ayaa heshay war dhiirigelin leh ka hor kulanka lugta hore ee semi-finalka Champions League ee ay la ciyaarayaan Atletico Madrid, ka dib markii laba xiddig oo muhiim ah lagu arkay tababarka.
Eberechi Eze, oo ku dhaawacmay kulankii Newcastle ee toddobaadkii hore, ayaa dib ugu soo laabtay tababarka buuxa ee kooxda maalintii Talaadada. Waxaa sidoo kale garoonka tababarka lagu arkay daafaca Riccardo Calafiori, kaas oo kooxda ka maqnaa tan iyo horraantii bishii April, taas oo kor u qaadaysa dookhyada daafaca ee Mikel Arteta.
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxaa weli shaki ku jiraa Kai Havertz, kaas oo la rumeysan yahay inuusan diyaar u noqon doonin kulanka bartamaha toddobaadka in kasta oo dhaawiciisa lagu tilmaamay mid fudud. Sidoo kale, Jurrien Timber ayaa weli ka maqan liiska tababarka kooxda.
Arsenal ayaa u safri doonta dalka Spain si ay u wajahdo kooxda Diego Simeone, iyadoo Eze iyo Calafiori ay qayb ka noqon karaan safarkaas, taas oo xoojinaysa hammiga kooxda ee ah inay natiijo wanaagsan kala soo laabtaan garoonka Metropolitano.

headline: Guti Oo Real Madrid Kaga Digay Inay Tababareheeda Cusub U Magacowdo Mourinho; Sabab?
body:
Halyeeyga kooxda Real Madrid, Guti, ayaa kula taliyay maamulka kooxda inaysan dib u soo celin Jose Mourinho si uu u beddelo Alvaro Arbeloa dhammaadka xilli-ciyaareedkan.
Arbeloa ayaa la filayaa inuu banneeyo kursiga maaddaama Real Madrid ay qarka u saarantahay inay xilli-ciyaareedkan ku dhammaysato koob la’aan, waxaana soo baxayay warar sheegaya in Mourinho loo arko dookh macquul ah.
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Guti ayaa aaminsan in xilligii dahabiga ahaa ee Mourinho uu dhammaaday, isla markaana ay jiraan tababarayaal kale oo hadda ka firfircoon oo kooxdu ay la soo saxiixan karto.
“Mourinho waa tababare weyn, laakiin uma malaynayo in xilligiisii ugu sarreeyay uu hadda joogo,” ayuu yiri Guti. Wuxuu tusaale u soo qaatay in tababaruhu uu ka soo laabtay kooxda Fenerbahce uuna soo maray Benfica xilli adag, isagoo ku dooday in Madrid ay u baahan tahay dhiig cusub iyo tababarayaal ku jira xaalad ka wanaagsan tan halyeeyga Portuguese-ka.
Jose Mourinho ayaa horay u soo layliyay Real Madrid intii u dhaxaysay 2010 ilaa 2013, isagoo kula guuleystay horyaalka La Liga, balse ku fashilmay inuu kooxda u horseedo hanashada tartanka Champions League intii uu joogay garoonka Santiago Bernabeu.

headline: Sesko: “Aad Ayaan Uga Soo Hor Jeedaa Inuu Isaga Innaga Tago”
body:
Weeraryahanka Manchester United, Benjamin Sesko, ayaa muujiyay sida uu uga xun yahay bixitaanka Casemiro ee dhammaadka xilli-ciyaareedkan, isagoo ku sifeeyay xiddiga reer Brazil inuu yahay mashiin shaqo.
Sesko, oo gool dhaliyay kulankii ay 2-1 kaga badiyeen Brentford oo uu Casemiro isna gool ka dhaliyay, ayaa ammaanay dedaalka iyo saameynta uu khadka dhexe ee rug-caddaaga ah ku leeyahay garoonka dhexdiisa. “Waxa uu garoonka kusoo bandhigayo waa wax aan la rumeysan karin. Waxaad u baahan tahay qof isaga oo kale ah,” ayuu yiri Sesko.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray in ciyaaryahan kasta oo doonaya inuu horumaro ay tahay inuu cashar ka barto hab-shaqeedka Casemiro. In kasta oo taageerayaashu ay ku luuqeeyeen “hal sano oo kale nala joog” intii ay ciyaartu socotay, tababare Michael Carrick ayaa xaqiijiyay in go’aanka kama dambaysta ah ee labada dhinac ay ku kala tegayaan uu yahay mid horay loo qaatay.
Sesko ayaa sheegay in kooxdu ay ka faa’iidaysan doonto khibradda Casemiro ilaa daqiiqadda ugu dambaysa ee uu xiran yahay maaliyadda cas, isagoo carrabka ku adkeeyay in joogitaankiisu uu kalsooni iyo xoog weyn u ahaa kooxda intii uu ku sugnaa Old Trafford.

headline: Paul Pogba Iyo Jesse Lingard Oo Si Wadajir Ah U Tilmaamay Xiddig United U Ciyaara Oo Mudan Abaalmarinta Ballon d’Or Ee Sannad Kaan
body:
Xiddigihii hore ee Manchester United, Paul Pogba iyo Jesse Lingard, ayaa aaminsan in kabtanka Manchester United, Bruno Fernandes, uu u qalmo in loo tixgeliyo abaalmarinta Ballon d’Or ee sannadkan 2026-ka.
Lingard iyo Pogba ayaa labaduba amaanay saameynta weyn ee uu Fernandes ku leeyahay kooxda, isagoo xilli-ciyaareedkan dhaliyay 8 gool, halka uu sameeyay 19 caawin 32 kulan oo uu saftay. Lingard ayaa u sheegay BBC Sport in qaab ciyaareedka Fernandes uu ahaa mid “aan caadi ahayn” xilli-ciyaareedkan, ayna khasab tahay inuu ku jiro liiska musharaxiinta ugu sarreeya.
Paul Pogba ayaa isna dhankiisa ku dooday in haddii Fernandes uu u ciyaari lahaa kooxda Manchester City, inuu hubaal ku jiri lahaa saddexda ciyaaryahan ee ugu dhow inay ku guuleystaan Ballon d’Or. “Ma u malaynaysaa haddii Bruno uu koox kale ku jiri lahaa inuusan noqdeen ciyaaryahan Ballon d’Or u qalma? Haddii City uu joogi lahaa, wuxuu ku jiri lahaa liiska Ballon d’Or,” ayuu yiri Pogba oo la hadlayay Rio Ferdinand.
Inkasta oo Fernandes uu soo bandhigay xilli-ciyaareed shaqsi ah oo aad u sarreeya, warbixintu waxay xustay inay adag tahay inuu ku guuleysto abaalmarintan, maaddaama xiddigo kale oo ay ka mid yihiin Harry Kane, Lamine Yamal, iyo Kylian Mbappe ay kaga horreeyaan qiimeynta tartamada ay ku guuleysteen ama ku jiraan awgeed.
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Pogba wuxuu aaminsan yahay in Fernandes uu yahay ciyaaryahan dhammaystiran oo leh deganaansho, caqli ciyaareed, iyo karti gool-dhalin oo heersare ah.

headline: Obi Mikel Oo Shaaciyay Cidda Chelsea Ka Saari Karta Xaaladda Xun Ay Ku Sugan Tahay Waqti Xaadir Kaan
body:
Xiddigii hore ee Chelsea, John Obi Mikel, ayaa ugu baaqay milkiilayaasha kooxda inay John Terry siiyaan door tababarenimo oo kooxda koowaad ah, xitaa haddii ay ahaan lahayd macallin kumeel gaar ah, si uu dib u soo celiyo awoodda qolka labiska.
Mikel, oo ka hadlayay barnaamijkiisa The Obi One Podcast, ayaa ku sifeeyay Terry inuu yahay “Mr. Chelsea,” isagoo xusay inuu yahay qofka kaliya ee dhiiggiisu yahay buluug isla markaana awood u leh inuu mideeyo kooxda xilli ay ku jirto xaalad cakiran. “Muxuu JT u noqon waayay tababaraha ku meel gaarka ah ilaa dhammaadka xilli-ciyaareedka? Waa qofka dhiiggiisu yahay buluug,” ayuu yiri Mikel.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray in Terry uusan ahayn qof laga dhex hadlo, balse uu yahay hoggaamiye dabiici ah oo garanaya dhaqanka iyo mabaadi’da kooxda Chelsea. Sidaas darteed, Mikel wuxuu aaminsan yahay in Terry uu yahay ninka kaliya ee dhiirigelin kara ciyaartoyda iyo taageerayaashaba xilligan adag.
Si kasta ha ahaatee, wararka ayaa sheegaya in maamulka sare ee Chelsea aysan qorshaynayn inay Terry u magacaabaan door kooxda koowaad ah, balse ay ku qanacsan yihiin inuu sii wado doorkiisa ee uu ka hayo akadeemiyada kooxda. Arrintan ayaa dhalisay dood u dhexaysa taageerayaasha, kuwaas oo qaarkood u arka in Terry uu yahay xalka ay Chelsea u baahan tahay hadda.

headline: Maguire Oo Weerar Afka Ah Kabaha Kula Dul-maray Ruben Amorim
body:
Daafaca Manchester United, Harry Maguire, ayaa dhaleeceyn u jeediyay qaabkii ay kooxdu u ciyaari jirtay xilligii uu tababare Ruben Amorim joogay, isagoo ku dooday in kooxdu ay hadda aad uga wanaagsan tahay sidii hore tan iyo markii uu la wareegay Michael Carrick.
Maguire oo hadlayay ka dib guushii 2-1 ahayd ee ay ka gaareen Brentford, ayaa sheegay in markii uu Amorim joogay ay ciyaaruhu inta badan ahaan jireen kuwo labada dhinac isku dhow (50/50), balse ay mar kasta ku dambeyn jireen guuldarro. “Markii uu Ruben Amorim halkan joogay, ciyaaruhu waxay ahaayeen 50/50… laakiin mar kasta waxay noogu dhammaan jirtay guuldarro,” ayuu yiri Maguire.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray in Manchester United ay hadda aad uga horumartay dhanka difaaca iyo weerarkaba, iyagoo si fiican u difaacda goolkooda, dhanka kalena ka faa’iideysta fursadaha ay helaan. Isbeddelkaas ayuu ku tilmaamay sababta ay natiijooyinka wanaagsan u helayaan hadda, iyagoo dhowaan ka soo adkaaday kooxaha Chelsea iyo Brentford.
Manchester United ayaa hadda fadhida booska saddexaad ee horyaalka iyadoo leh 51 dhibcood, waxayna saddex dhibcood ka sarreeyaan Liverpool oo ay wajihi doonaan toddobaadkan. Maguire ayaa aaminsan in degenaanshaha iyo hufnaanta uu keenay Carrick ay tahay midda dib u soo celisay kalsoonidii ciyaartoyda.

headline: WAR WEYN! Julián Álvarez Oo Oggolaaday Inuu Ku Biiro Barcelona
body:
Wararka ka soo baxaya dalka Spain ayaa sheegaya in weeraryahanka Atlético Madrid, Julián Álvarez, uu go’aan ka gaaray mustaqbalkiisa, isagoo muujiyay rabitaanka uu ugu biirayo kooxda Barcelona inta lagu guda jiro suuqa kala iibsiga ee xagaaga soo socda.
Sida ay qortay jariidadda Sport, xiddiga reer Argentine ayaa ku wargeliyay maamulka kooxdiisa inuu doonayo u dhaqaaqista garoonka Camp Nou. Barcelona ayaa u aragta Álvarez beddelka ugu habboon ee Robert Lewandowski, kaas oo laga yaabo inuu ka tago kooxda dhammaadka xilli-ciyaareedkan.
Inkasta oo Atlético Madrid ay ka cagajiidayso inay fasaxdo mid ka mid ah xiddigaheeda ugu muhiimsan, haddana waxaa la sheegay in maamulka Barcelona ay durbadiiba bilaabeen xiriirka wakiillada ciyaaryahanka.
Álvarez oo hadlay ka hor kulanka semi-finalka Champions League ee ay wajahayaan Arsenal, ayaan beenin xanta ku saabsan mustaqbalkiisa, isagoo yiri: “Ma beenin karo, mana xaqiijin karo wax walba oo warbaahinta lagu wareejinayo.”
Arrimaha xaaladda adkeynaya waxaa ka mid ah:
Qandaraaska: Álvarez wuxuu heshiis kula jiraa Atlético ilaa sannadka 2030, waxaana lagu burburin karaa qandaraaskiisa lacag dhan 500 oo milyan oo euro.
Dhaqaalaha Barcelona: Kooxda reer Catalonia ayaa weli la tacaalaysa xeerarka anshaxa dhaqaalaha (Financial Fair Play), taas oo caqabad ku noqon karta saxiixa xiddig qaali ah.
Champions League: Natiijada Atlético ka keento tartanka Yurub ayaa go’aamin doonta xawaaraha wadahadallada, iyadoo bisha June ay tahay xilliga wax walba la kala ogaan doono.
Xiddigan 26-jirka ah ayaa soo qaatay xilli-ciyaareed cajiib ah, isagoo 47 ciyaarood oo uu saftay dhaliyay 19 gool, halka uu caawiyay 9 kale, taas oo ka dhigaysa mid ka mid ah weeraryahannada ugu tayada sarreeya qaaradda Yurub xilligan.

headline: Gary Neville Oo Shaaciyay Kulanka Go’aaminaya Mustaqbalka Arne Slot Ee Liverpool
body:
Gary Neville ayaa aaminsan in kulanka soo socda ee u dhexeeya Manchester United iyo Liverpool uu miisaan weyn u leeyahay labada tababare ee Michael Carrick iyo Arne Slot, in kasta oo uusan kulanku go’aaminayn hanashada horyaalka.
Neville, oo ka hadlayay Sky Sports, ayaa xusay in ciyaartu ay tahay mid muujinaysa halka ay koox walba taagan tahay iyo fariinta ay  dirayaan xilli-ciyaareedka dambe. “Haddii Arne Slot uu yimaado halkan oo uu guuleysto, waxay u noqon doontaa wax weyn. Sidoo kale, haddii Michael Carrick uu ka adkaado Slot, waxay u noqon doontaa guul aad u weyn,” ayuu yiri Neville.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray in bilahii u dambeeyay ay Liverpool soo martay xaalado kala duwan, taas oo ka dhigaysa guusha kulankan mid muhiim u ah kalsoonida Slot. Dhanka kale, Carrick ayaa isna raadinaya inuu sii xoojiyo booskiisa kadib markii uu natiijooyin wanaagsan u keenay Manchester United.
Inkasta oo Neville uu ka xun yahay in ciyaartu aysan ahayn mid go’aamineysa horyaalka, haddana wuxuu qabaa in xamaasadda xifaltanka labada kooxood iyo muhiimadda ay u leedahay macallimiinta ay ka dhigayso kulan aad loo wada sugayo. Taageerayaasha labada dhinac ayaa isha ku haya sida ay labadan xeel-dheere u maareeyaan mid ka mid ah kulammada ugu waaweyn kubadda cagta Ingiriiska.

headline: Gerrard Oo Farta Ku Fiiqay Xiddiga Uu U Arko Kan Ugu Muhiimsan Chelsea Xilli Ciyaareed Kaan
body:
Halyeeyga kubadda cagta England, Steven Gerrard, ayaa ammaan ballaaran u jeediyay weeraryahanka Chelsea, Joao Pedro, isagoo ku sifeeyay inuu yahay xiddiga isbeddelka dhab ah kusoo kordhiyay kooxda xilli-ciyaareedkan.
Gerrard ayaa xusay in Chelsea ay u muuqato koox gabi ahaanba ka duwan sida caadiga ah marka uu Joao Pedro garoonka ku jiro. Wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay in tayada ciyaaryahanka, gaar ahaan awooddiisa uu ku abuuro fursadaha iyo sida uu u hoggaamiyo weerarka, ay tahay mid muhiim u ah qaab ciyaareedka Blues.
“Chelsea waxay u muuqataa koox ka duwan sida caadiga ah marka uu isagu joogo,” ayuu yiri Gerrard, isagoo muujiyay in saameynta Joao Pedro ay dhaafsiisan tahay kaliya dhalinta goolasha, balse uu yahay mashiinka dhaqaajiya weerarka kooxda.
Joao Pedro ayaa xilli-ciyaareedkan noqday mid ka mid ah saxiixyada ugu guulaha badnaa ee ay samaysay Chelsea, isagoo si joogto ah u muujinayay bandhig heer sare ah oo soo jiitay indhaha khubarada ciyaaraha iyo taageerayaashaba.
Gerrard ayaa aaminsan in sii joogitaanka iyo badqabka xiddigan ay fure u tahay hammiga kooxda ee xilli-ciyaareedyada soo socda.

headline: Supercomputer-ka Opta Oo Saadaaliyay 5-ta Koox Ee Premier League Ee Usoo Bixi Doona Champions League Xilli Ciyaareedka Dambe
body:
“Supercomputer-ka” Opta ayaa soo saaray saadaal cusub oo ku saabsan shanta kooxood ee xilli-ciyaareedkan horyaalka Premier League ka soo aadi doona tartanka Champions League, maaddaama dalka Ingiriisku uu heli doono shan boos sannadkan.
Sida ay qortay Daily Post, Arsenal iyo Manchester City ayaa mar hore xaqiijiyay boosaskooda tartanka Yurub ee heerka koowaad. Hadda, saadaashu waxay tilmaamaysaa in saddexda boos ee soo haray ay si weyn ugu dhow yihiin kooxaha Manchester United, Liverpool, iyo Aston Villa.
Saddexdan kooxood ayaa la siiyay fursad dhan 97% inay ku dhammaystaan shanta boos ee ugu sarreeya, iyadoo dhibco yar ay u dhexeyso mid walba. Aston Villa iyo Liverpool ayaa hadda fadhiya boosaska afaraad iyo shanaad, iyagoo siddeed dhibcood ka sarreeya kooxda Brighton oo ku jirta booska lixaad.
Dhinaca kale, isla supercomputer-ka ayaa saadaaliyay in Arsenal ay tahay kooxda ugu cad-cad ee ku guuleysan karta tartanka Champions League ee sannadkan, iyadoo la siiyay fursad dhan 37%, halka Bayern Munich ay ku xigto oo leh 36%. Arsenal ayaa habeenka berri ah la ciyaari doonta Atletico Madrid wareegga semi-finalka, halka PSG iyo Bayern Munich ay iyaguna iska hor imaan doonaan caawa.

headline: Taageerayaasha Manchester United Oo Codsi Lama Filaan Ah U Diray Casemiro Kadib Kulankii Brentford
body:
Taageerayaasha Manchester United ayaa habeennimadii Isniinta ka codsaday Casemiro inuusan ka tegin kooxda xagaagan, iyagoo ka dalbaday inuu sii joogo ugu yaraan hal sano oo dheeri ah.
Intii ay socotay ciyaartii ay United 2-1 kaga badisay Brentford, taageerayaashii ku sugnaa garoonka Old Trafford ayaa ku heesayay “One more year, Casemiro” (Hal sano oo kale, Casemiro), ka dib markii uu xiddigan reer Brazil dhaliyay gool, isla markaana uu tilmaamay calaamadda kooxda ee ku taal maaliyadiisa. Arrintan ayaa dhalisay dareen weyn, waxaana muuqaallada dhacdadaas ay si ballaaran ugu faafeen baraha bulshada.
Casemiro, oo hadda ah 34 jir, ayaa horay u shaaciyay inuu ka tegi doono kooxda dhammaadka xilli-ciyaareedkan si uu u raadsado caqabad cusub, iyadoo qandaraaskiisu uu ku egyahay June 2026. Xataa saaxiibkiis Matheus Cunha ayaa bartiisa Instagram-ka soo dhigay qoraal uu ku codsanayo in Casemiro uu sii joogo hal sano oo kale.
Codsigan ka yimid taageerayaasha ayaa muujinaya sida loogu qanacsan yahay saameynta iyo khibradda uu Casemiro weli ku leeyahay khadka dhexe ee Manchester United, inkasta oo uu qorshaynayay inuu macasalaameeyo garoonka Old Trafford marka uu xilli-ciyaareedku dhammaado.

headline: Bruno Fernandes Oo Barbareeyay Rikoodh Muhiim Ah Oo Uu Dhigay Cristiano Ronaldo
body:
Kabtanka Manchester United, Bruno Fernandes, ayaa xalay barbareeyay rikoor muhiim ah oo uu dhigay Cristiano Ronaldo, ka dib markii uu gool caawiyay guushii 2-1 ahayd ee ay kooxdiisu ka gaartay Brentford.
Fernandes ayaa caawiyay goolkii uu dhaliyay Benjamin Sesko, taas oo ka dhigan inuu hadda ku lug yeeshay 140 gool oo Premier League ah (70 gool iyo 70 caawin) intii uu joogay Manchester United. Tiradan ayaa la mid ah inta gool ee uu Ronaldo ka qayb qaatay horyaalka isagoo u ciyaaraya United (103 gool iyo 37 caawin).
Sida ay sheegtay OptaJoe, Fernandes ayaa rikoorkan ku gaaray 226 kulan, isagoo ka dhakhsiyo badan Ronaldo oo isla tiradaas ku gaaray 237 kulan (11 kulan ayuu ka horreeyaa).
Xiddigan 31-jirka ah, oo kooxda kaga soo biiray Sporting CP sannadkii 2020, ayaa hadda u muuqda mid qarka u saaran inuu dhowaan dhaafo saaxiibkiisa ay xulka Portugal ka wada tirsan yihiin si uu u noqdo midka ugu saameynta badan dhanka gool dhalinta iyo caawinta.

headline: Supercomputer-ka Opta Oo Saadaaliyay Kooxda Ugu Cad-cad Ku Guuleysiga Champions League Ka Hor Kulamada Semi-final-ka
body:
Supercomputer-ka Opta ayaa saadaaliyay in Arsenal ay tahay kooxda ugu dhow ee ku guuleysan karta tartanka Champions League ee xilli-ciyaareedkan, ka hor inta aan la ciyaarin lugta hore ee wareegga semi-finalka.
Sida ay qortay Daily Post, kooxda Mikel Arteta ayaa la siiyay fursad dhan 37% inay markii ugu horreysay taariikhdooda kor u qaadi karaan koobkan. Arsenal ayaa habeenka Arbacada wajahaysa Atletico Madrid ciyaarta lugta hore ee semi-finalka.
Bayern Munich, oo durba loo xaqiijiyay inay ku guuleysteen horyaalka Jarmalka (Bundesliga), ayaa ah kooxda labaad ee ugu cad-cad iyadoo haysata 36%. Bayern ayaa caawa u safraysa kooxda Paris Saint-Germain oo iyaduna haysata fursad dhan 19%, halka Atletico Madrid ay tahay kooxda ugu fursadda yar iyadoo la siiyay 8% oo qura.
Saadaashan ayaa muujinaysa in tartanka sanadkan uu aad u adag yahay, iyadoo Gunners loo arko inay yihiin kuwa ugu xooggan ee hanan kara koobka ugu xiisaha badan qaaradda Yurub.

headline: Jamie Carragher Oo Shaaciyay Caqabadda Ugu Weyn Ee Arsenal Ka Hor Istaagi Karta Ku Guuleysiga Horyaalka Xilli Ciyaareed Kaan
body:
Jamie Carragher ayaa uga digay kooxda Arsenal in kooxda Fulham ay noqon karto caqabadda ugu weyn ee ka hor istaagi karta hanashada horyaalka Premier League xilli-ciyaareedkan.
Carragher, oo falanqeynayay kulammadii u dambeeyay ee barnaamijka Monday Night Football, ayaa sheegay in tartanka horyaalka ee u dhexeeya Arsenal iyo Manchester City uu marayo meel aad u xasaasi ah, halkaas oo hal dhibic oo la lumiyo ay la macno tahay in koobka la waayn karo. Arsenal ayaa hadda saddex dhibcood ka sarreysa Manchester City, waxaana u dhiman kulan ay Fulham kula ciyaari doonaan garoonka Emirates toddobaadkan.
“Waxaan u malaynayaa in Fulham ay tahay koox aad u fiican, waxaana jirta fursad ay ku noqon karaan caqabadda rasmiga ah ee Arsenal,” ayuu yiri Carragher. Wuxuu xusay in haddii Arsenal ay garaacdo Fulham ay hoggaanka ku qaban doonaan lix dhibcood oo nadiif ah, balse Fulham ay tahay koox awood u leh inay dhibco ka reebto kooxaha waaweyn.
Digniintan ayaa timid xilli khubarada kale ee ciyaaraha ay iyaguna isha ku hayaan kulammada u dhiman labada kooxood ee u tartamaya horyaalka, iyadoo la dareemayo in cadaadiska uu sii kordhayo xilli kasta oo ay ciyaartu dhammaadka u dhowdahay.

headline: Michael Carrick Oo Amaan Ugu Qubeeyay Mainoo Kadib Guushii Brentford
body:
Tababaraha Manchester United, Michael Carrick, ayaa amaan aan wax loogu reeban u jeediyay xiddiga da’da yar ee Kobbie Mainoo ka dib qaab ciyaareedkii cajiibka ahaa ee uu soo bandhigay kulankii ay garaaceen kooxda Brentford.
Carrick ayaa ku sifeeyay Mainoo inuu yahay ciyaaryahan leh deganaansho iyo aragti ka fog da’diisa, isagoo xusay inuu door muhiim ah ka qaatay xakamaynta khadka dhexe intii ay ciyaartu socotay. “Kobbie wuxuu leeyahay karti dabiici ah, laakiin waxa iga yaabiyay waa sida uu u akhriyo ciyaarta isagoo aad u yar,” ayuu yiri Carrick.
Xiddigan heerka caalami ee dalka England ayaa ka mid ahaa xiddigihii ugu fiicnaa garoonka Old Trafford, isagoo muujiyay karti uu ku jebiyo weerarada kooxda kale. Khubarada ciyaaraha ayaa aaminsan in Mainoo uu xilligan yahay mid ka mid ah tiirarka mustaqbalka ee khadka dhexe ee kooxda Manchester United.
Amaanta Carrick ayaa timid xilli Mainoo uu si joogto ah ugu soo bilaabanayo safka hore, isagoo ka sare maray xiddigo badan oo ka khibrad weyn. Taageerayaasha kooxda ayaa iyaguna baraha bulshada ku hadal hayay qaab ciyaareedkiisa, iyagoo u arka inuu yahay “wadnaha” cusub ee khadka dhexe ee kooxda.

headline: Gary Lineker Oo Shaaciyay Kulanka Kaliya Ee Arsenal Ka Hor Istaagi Kara Ku Guuleysiga Horyaalka Xilli Ciyaareed Kaan
body:
Halyeeyga xulka qaranka England, Gary Lineker, ayaa tilmaamay hal kulan oo uu rumeysan yahay inuu caqabad weyn ku noqon karo hamiga Arsenal ee hanashada horyaalka Premier League xilli-ciyaareedkan.
Arsenal ayaa hadda fadhida hoggaanka horyaalka ka dib markii ay 1-0 ku garaaceen Newcastle United maalintii Sabtida. Lineker, oo ka hadlayay barnaamijka The Rest is Football podcast, ayaa xusay in inkasta oo Arsenal ay u muuqato mid haysata kulamo la guuleysan karo, haddana safarka ay ku aadi doonaan bariga London uu yahay midka go’aamin kara masiirkooda.
“Arsenal waxay lix dhibcood ka sarreyn kartaa Man City ka hor inta aysan City ciyaarin, afarta kulan ee u dhiman Arsenal-na waa kuwo la guuleysan karo,” ayuu yiri Lineker. “Waxay Fulham ku martigelin doonaan gurigooda, ka dibna West Ham ayay u safri doonaan, taas ayaana noqon doonta ciyaar dhib badan. West Ham waxay u dagaallamayaan noloshooda (ka badbaadista heerka labaad), si fiican ayayna u ciyaarayaan hadda.”
Lineker ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay in West Ham ay muujisay qaab ciyaareed aad u sarreeya tan iyo bilowgii sanadkan, taasina ay ka dhigayso kulanka 10-ka May ee ka dhacaya garoonka London Stadium midka ugu adag ee horyaalka ay ku lumin karto kooxda Mikel Arteta.

headline: Paul Merson Oo Magacaabay Tababaraha Ay Tahay In Loo Dhiibo Shaqada Chelsea Xilli Ciyaareedka Dambe
body:
Halyeeyga kooxda Arsenal, Paul Merson, ayaa kula taliyay kooxda Chelsea inay tababaraha Newcastle United, Eddie Howe, u magacaabaan beddelka joogtada ah ee Liam Rosenior dhammaadka xilli-ciyaareedkan.
Chelsea ayaa todobaadkii hore shaqada ka cayrisay Rosenior, iyadoo Calum McFarlane u magacawday tababare kumeel gaar ah inta ka dhiman xilli-ciyaareedka.
Merson ayaa aaminsan in Howe uu yahay qofka ku habboon Stamford Bridge si uu Blues ugu hoggaamiyo guulo xilli-ciyaareedka soo socda.
“Aad ayaan u taageeraa Eddie Howe. Haddii uu ka tago Newcastle, kooxo badan ayaa saf u gali doona isaga. Waa tababare heersare ah,” ayuu Merson u sheegay Sky Sports.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray in Chelsea ay diyaar u tahay inay qaadato Howe wakhti kasta, isagoo ku sifeeyay inuu yahay tababaraha mustaqbalka ee xulka qaranka England. Merson ayaa uga digay Newcastle inay ka fogaadaan luminta Howe, maadaama uu u arko inuu yahay mid ka mid ah khubarada ugu fiican horyaalka Premier League xilligan.

headline: Jamie Carragher Oo Farta Ku Fiiqay Cidda Uu Aaminsan Yahay Inay Noqoneyso Tababaraha Joogtada Ah Ee Manchester United Xilli Ciyaareedka Dambe
body:
Halyeeyga kooxda Liverpool ahna khabiirka Sky Sports, Jamie Carragher, ayaa aaminsan in Michael Carrick uu qaban doono xilka tababanenimo ee joogtada ah ee Manchester United xilli-ciyaareedka soo socda, isagoo xusay inuusan jirin wax shaki ah oo arrintaas ku saabsan.
Carragher ayaa ku dooday in natiijooyinka uu Carrick keenay tan iyo markii uu la wareegay kooxda ay yihiin kuwo u dhigma koox horyaal u tartamaysa. “Wuxuu noqon doonaa tababaraha Manchester United xilli-ciyaareedka dambe, shaki kuma jiro. Ma dhihi kartid uma qalmo,” ayuu Carragher u sheegay Sky Sports.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray in inkasta oo qaab ciyaareedka kooxdu uusan mar kasta ahayn mid heersare ah, haddana Carrick uu ku guuleystay inuu natiijooyin waaweyn ka soo saaro koox aan xilligan ku jirin xaaladdeedii ugu fiicnayd. Carragher ayaa sidoo kale isbarbardhig ku sameeyay Carrick iyo tababarihii hore ee Ruben Amorim, isagoo sheegay in Carrick uu muujiyay awood uu kula qabsan karo xaaladaha kala duwan ee ciyaarta.
Michael Carrick ayaa dhankiisa qirtay inay kooxdu mar hore bilowday wadahadallada ku saabsan magacaabista tababare cusub, balse ilaa hadda ma uusan xaqiijin in isaga loogu dhiibayo xilkaas si joogto ah.
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, guushii ugu dambeysay ee ay ka gaareen Brentford ayaa sii xoojisay rajada uu Carrick u leeyahay inuu sii hayo hoggaanka kooxda ka dib markii uu helay dhibco muhiim u ah u soo bixitaanka Champions League.

headline: Chelsea Oo Ku Dhawaaqday Waqtiga Ay Magacaabeyso Tababare Rasmi Ah
body:
Wararka ka soo baxaya kooxda Chelsea ayaa sheegaya in maamulka kooxdu ay qorshaynayaan inay ku dhawaaqaan tababaraha rasmiga ah ee beddeli doona Liam Rosenior isla marka uu dhamaado xilli-ciyaareedkan.
Sida ay sheegayaan warbixinnadii ugu dambeeyay, kooxda Blues ayaa doonaysa inay si degdeg ah u magacawdo hoggaanka cusub si ay u bilaabaan diyaarinta xilli-ciyaareedka dambe iyo dib-u-dhiska kooxda. Go’aankan ayaa yimid ka dib markii shaqada laga cayriyay Rosenior oo muddo kooban laylinayay kooxda, waxaana hadda si ku-meel-gaar ah xilka u haya Calum McFarlane.
Chelsea ayaa isha ku haysa tababarayaal dhowr ah oo ay ka mid yihiin Andoni Iraola, Marco Silva, iyo Xabi Alonso, kuwaas oo loo arko inay yihiin dookhyada ugu horreeya ee maamulka kooxdu rabo. Maaddaama kooxdu ay ku jirto booska sideedaad ee horyaalka, ujeedka ugu weyn waa in la helo tababare khibrad leh oo dib u soo celin kara tartankii looga bartay Chelsea.
Maamulka sare ee kooxda ayaa lagu soo warramayaa inay mar hore bilaabeen wadahadallada lala leeyahay wakiillada tababarayaashan, iyadoo ujeedku yahay in heshiiska la dhammaystiro ka hor inta uusan furmin suuqa kala iibsiga ee xagaaga. Taageerayaasha kooxda ayaa si weyn u sugaya cidda noqon doonta hoggaamiyaha cusub ee Stamford Bridge ka dib xilli-ciyaareed ay ka muuqato degenaansho la’aan oo dhanka maamulka ah.

headline: Muxuu Carrick Ka Yiri Guushii Kooxdiisa Ay Ka Gaartay Brentford?
body:
Tababaraha ku meel gaarka ah ee Manchester United, Michael Carrick, ayaa faahfaahin ka bixiyay guushii muhiimka ahayd ee ay kooxdiisu ka gaartay Brentford, isagoo sharraxay isbeddelladii dhanka taatikada ahaa ee uu sameeyay si loo xaqiijiyo saddexda dhibcood.
Carrick ayaa sheegay in marxaladdan xilli-ciyaareedka ay muhiimadda koowaad tahay helitaanka dhibco macquul ah si kooxdu u xaqiijisato booska Champions League. “Waxaan u baahnayn inaan dhibco qaadanno,” ayuu yiri Carrick isagoo sharraxayay culayskii saarnaa kooxda ka hor ciyaarta.
Intii ay socotay ciyaarta, Carrick ayaa sameeyay isbeddell taatiko ah oo saameyn weyn yeeshay, isagoo xoogga saaray sidii loo xakamayn lahaa weerarka Brentford loona abuuri lahaa fursado weerar celis ah. Isbeddelkaas ayaa keenay in kooxdu ay hesho goolka labaad ee guusha, kaas oo uu saxiixay Benjamin Sesko ka dib caawin ka timid Bruno Fernandes.
Sidoo kale, Carrick ayaa ammaanay ciyaartoyda kooxda sida ay u dhabar-adaygeen ilaa dhamaadkii ciyaarta, gaar ahaan ka dib markii Brentford ay keentay gool ka naxsaday daqiiqadihii ugu dambeeyay. Guushan ayaa United ka caawisay inay sii xoojiyaan fadhigooda booska saddexaad ee horyaalka Premier League.

headline: Manchester United Oo Guul Muhiim Ah Ka Gaartay Brentford
body:
Manchester United ayaa guul muhiim ah ka gaartay kooxda Brentford kulankii ka dhacay garoonka Old Trafford, iyadoo ciyaartu ay ku dhammaatay 2-1 oo ay guushu ku raacday wiilasha Michael Carrick.
Goolasha Manchester United waxaa u kala dhaliyay Casemiro daqiiqadii 11-aad iyo Benjamin Sesko daqiiqadii 43-aad, halka goolka qura ee Brentford uu dhaliyay Mathias Jensen dhammaadkii ciyaarta (daqiiqadii 87-aad). Bruno Fernandes ayaa qayb weyn ka qaatay guushan isagoo caawiyay goolka labaad, taas oo ka dhigan inuu hadda leeyahay 19 caawin horyaalka Premier League xilli-ciyaareedkan.
Guushan ayaa Manchester United u dhowaynaysa inay xaqiijisato ka qaybgalka tartanka Champions League ee xilli-ciyaareedka dambe, maadaama ay hadda fadhiyaan booska saddexaad.
Tababare Carrick ayaa ciyaarta dhexdeeda isbeddel dhanka taatikada ah sameeyay, taas oo ka caawisay kooxda inay difaacato natiijada ilaa dhamaadkii ciyaarta.
Natiijadan ayaa sidoo kale soo afjartay rikoor fiican oo ay Brentford ka haysatay United, iyadoo markii dambe la kulmay guuldarro ka dib shan kulan oo ay bar-baro soo galeen. Manchester United ayaa hadda u baahan dhibco yar si ay si rasmi ah ugu soo baxdo tartanka Yurub ee heerka koowaad.

headline: Bruno Fernandes Oo Qarka U Saaran Inuu Jebiyo Rikoodh Uu Ku Faano Kevin De Bruyne
body:
Kabtanka kooxda Manchester United, Bruno Fernandes, ayaa ku dhow inuu taariikh cusub ka dhigo horyaalka Premier League, ka dib markii uu caawa diiwaangeliyay caawintii 19-aad ee xilli-ciyaareedkan.
Fernandes ayaa caawiyay goolkii uu Benjamin Sesko ka dhaliyay kooxda Brentford, taas oo ka dhigtay inuu hal caawin oo qura ka dambeeyo rikoorka horyaalka oo ah 20 caawin, kaas oo ay hadda si wadajir ah u hayaan halyeeyada Thierry Henry iyo Kevin De Bruyne.
Markii uu gaaray 19 caawin, xiddiga reer Portugal ayaa dhaafay rikoorkii Mesut Ozil oo hal xilli-ciyaareed ku sameeyay 18 caawin. Maaddaama ay u dhiman yihiin dhowr kulan oo horyaalka ah, Fernandes ayaa haysta fursad dahabi ah oo uu ku jabin karo rikoorka guud ee hal xilli-ciyaareed oo horyaalka ah.
Tababare Michael Carrick ayaa ammaanay saameynta weyn ee Bruno Fernandes uu ku leeyahay kooxda, isagoo ku sifeeyay ciyaaryahan beddeli kara natiijada kulan kasta. Taageerayaasha Manchester United ayaa rajeynaya in kabtankoodu uu sii wado qaab ciyaareedkan cajiibka ah si uu u galo buugga taariikhda horyaalka Ingiriiska.

headline: Xavi Hernández Oo Magacaabay 5-ta Xul Ee Ugu Cad-cad Ku Guuleysiga Koobka Adduunka 2026
body:
Tababarihii hore ee Barcelona, Xavi Hernández, ayaa magacaabay shan xul oo uu u arko inay ugu cad-cad yihiin ku guuleysiga koobka adduunka ee sanadkan 2026-ka.
Isagoo ka hadlayay kanaalka YouTube-ka ee halyeeyga Romario, Xavi ayaa liiska musharaxiinta koowaad ka dhigay xulalka Brazil, Spain, France, Portugal, iyo Argentina oo hadda koobka difaacanaysa.
Xavi ayaa si gaar ah u iftiimiyay fursadda xulka Brazil, isagoo yiri: “Brazil waxay noqon karaan horyaal. Marka hore, sababtoo ah Ancelotti ayaa tababare u ah, kaas oo soo saara tayada ugu fiican ee ciyaartoyda, marka labaadna, Brazil mar walba waxay awood ku leeyihiin koobka adduunka. Waxay leeyihiin ciyaartoy tayo leh, Ancelotti-na mar walba waa mid tartama.”
Dhinaca kale, wuxuu xusay in xulalka Spain, Argentina, France, iyo Portugal ay yihiin kuwo aad u xooggan xilligan. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Xavi ayaa sheegay inuu u arko xulka Jarmalka kuwo ka fursad yar musharaxiintaas, halka uu xusay in England ay iyaguna meel fog gaari karaan.
Koobka Adduunka ee 2026-ka ayaa bilaaban doona xagaagan, waxaana lagu qaban doonaa waddamada Mareykanka, Kanada, iyo Meksiko.

headline: Saddexda Tababare Ay Chelsea U Calaamadsatay Beddelka Liam Rosenior Oo La Ogaaday
body:
Wararka ka soo baxaya gudaha dalka Ingiriiska ayaa sheegaya inay kooxda Chelsea calaamadsatay saddex tababare oo ay u aragto inay yihiin dookhyada ugu sarreeya ee hoggaamin kara kooxda, ka dib markii shaqada laga cayriyay Liam Rosenior.
Sida uu sheegay wariyaha lagu kalsoon yahay ee Matt Law, liiska saddexda tababare ee ay Chelsea doonayso waxaa ugu horreeya Andoni Iraola oo hadda jooga Bournemouth, Marco Silva oo Fulham hoggaamiya, iyo Xabi Alonso oo bilaa koox ah tan iyo markii laga baaciyay Real Madrid bishii Janaayo.
Go’aankan ayaa yimid ka dib markii Chelsea ay guuldarro xanuun badan oo 3-0 ah kala kulantay Brighton, taas oo soo afjartay rajadii ay ka lahaayeen inay u soo baxaan tartanka Champions League xilli-ciyaareedka dambe. Liam Rosenior ayaa shaqada laga eryay ka dib afar bilood oo qura oo uu xafiiska joogay.
Chelsea ayaa hadda baadi-goob ugu jirta tababare khibrad u leh Premier League oo dib u dhis ku sameeya kooxda. In kasta oo magacyo ay ka mid yihiin Cesc Fabregas iyo Filipe Luis lala xiriiriyay kooxda, haddana kuma jiraan liiska ugu dambeeya ee ay maamulka kooxdu doonayaan.
Xilligan, Calum McFarlane ayaa si ku-meel-gaar ah u haya xilka tababaraha, iyadoo madaxda Blues ay ka fiirsanayaan go’aankooda xiga si aysan mar kale ugu dhicin qalad dhanka maamulka ah.
Isku dayga ay Chelsea ku doonayso Xabi Alonso ayaa sidoo kale loolan adag kala kulmi kara kooxo kale oo waaweyn oo Yurub ah oo isha ku haya xiddigii hore ee khadka dhexe.

headline: Wayne Rooney Oo Shaaciyay Cidda Uu Aaminsan Yahay Inay Chelsea Kusoo Celin Karto Dhabbada Guulaha
body:
Wayne Rooney ayaa kula taliyay kooxda Chelsea inay dib usoo celiyaan halyeeyga kooxda ee Claude Makélélé si uu gacan uga geysto dhisidda hoggaanka kooxda xilli ay ku jiraan xaalad adag oo dhanka maamulka ah.
Rooney, oo ka hadlayay barnaamijkiisa podcast-ka ee BBC-da, ayaa sheegay in qof leh maskaxda iyo fikirka Makélélé uu wax weyn ka beddeli karo jawiga kooxda. Talo soo jeedintan ayaa timid ka dib markii Chelsea ay shaqada ka cayrisay tababare Liam Rosenior, kaas oo kooxda laylinayay muddo 106 maalmood ah, balse ay ragaadiyeen natiijooyin xun iyo shan guuldarro oo xiriir ah oo horyaalka ah.
Rooney ayaa xusay in ciyaartoyda Chelsea ay u muuqdeen kuwo “neef ka soo baxday” ka dib cayrintii Rosenior, isagoo ku eedeeyay qaar ka mid ah ciyaartoyda inay gabi ahaanba is dhiibeen.
Wuxuu isbarbardhig ku sameeyay jiilkii hore ee Chelsea oo ay ku jireen Lampard, Terry, Cech, iyo Makélélé, kuwaas oo ahaa hoggaamiyeyaal garoonka dhexdiisa ka go’aamin jiray wax walba xataa haddii tababaraha la beddelo.
“Waxaan u malaynayay waqtigaas, qof leh maskaxdiisa iyo aragtidiisa, inuu joogo hareeraha kooxda waxay u noqon lahayd Chelsea wax weyn,” ayuu yiri Rooney isagoo ka hadlayay Makélélé.
Chelsea ayaa hadda fadhida booska sideedaad, iyadoo 10 dhibcood ka dambaysa boosaska loogu soo boxo Champions League. Waxay hadda isku diyaarinayaan kulammada Nottingham Forest iyo Liverpool, ka hor inta aysan wajahin Manchester City finalka FA Cup-ka. Rooney ayaa rumeysan in soo celinta Makélélé ay dib u soo noolayn karto ruuxda guusha iyo hoggaaminta ee ka maqan garoonka Stamford Bridge.

headline: DEG-DEG: Xiddig Muhiim U Ah Manchester United Oo Seegaya Kulanka Brentford
body:
Wararka ka soo baxaya kooxda Manchester United ayaa sheegaya in Matheus Cunha uu seegi doono kulanka muhiimka ah ee ay caawa la ciyaarayaan kooxda Brentford, ka dib markii uu dhaawac soo gaaray.
Maqnaanshaha Cunha ayaa dhabar-jab ku ah qorshaha tababare Michael Carrick, maadaama xiddigan reer Brazil uu ka mid ahaa xubnaha ugu muhiimsan weerarka kooxda xilli-ciyaareedkan.
Sida ay sheegayaan warbixinnada hordhaca ah, Cunha ayaa dareemay xanuun dhanka muruqa ah, taas oo keentay in laga saaro liiska ciyaartoyda ee kulanka caawa ka dhacaya garoonka Old Trafford.
In kasta oo shaxda hordhaca ah lagu daray magaciisa, dhaawacan cusub ayaa ku khasbi doona Carrick inuu isbeddel degdeg ah ku sameeyo safkiisa hore. Manchester United ayaa raadinaysa guul ay ku sii xajisato booska saddexaad ee horyaalka, balse la’aanta Cunha waxay daciifin kartaa awoodda weerar ee kooxda marka ay wajahayaan Brentford.
Maqnaanshaha xiddigan ayaa fursad u furi karta ciyaartoyda kale ee weerarka ka ciyaara si ay u buuxiyaan booskiisa, iyadoo kooxdu ay ku dhibtoonayso sidii ay u joogteyn lahayd dhibcaha ay helayso toddobaadyadan u dambeeya.

headline: Gary Neville: Arsenal Way Ku Guuleysan Kartaa Premier League-ga, Laakiin…..
body:
Gary Neville ayaa rumeysan in fursadda ay Arsenal ugu guuleysan karto horyaalka Premier League ay ka weyn tahay midda ay u heysato hanashada Champions League xilli-ciyaareedkan.
Gunners ayaa hadda saddex dhibcood ka sarreeya Manchester City oo hal kulan oo baaqi ah haysata, iyadoo loolanka horyaalku uu marayo meel aad u xasaasi ah. Dhanka kale, Arsenal ayaan weli wax guuldarro ah la kulmin tartanka Champions League, waxayna isku diyaarinayaan wareegga semi-finalka oo ay la ciyaari doonaan Atletico Madrid.
Neville, oo ka hadlayay barnaamijkiisa The Gary Neville Podcast, ayaa ku dooday in ciyaartoyda Arsenal aysan khibrad u lahayn ku guuleysiga Champions League, balse ay aad ugu dhowaadeen hanashada horyaalka Ingiriiska, taasna ay ku keenayso hami waalli ah.
“Waxaan u malaynayaa inay jiraan kooxo ka fiican iyaga oo ku jira Champions League, waana tartan adag. Waxaa u dhiman saddex kulan oo qura, halka horyaalkana ay afar kulan u dhiman yihiin, markaas waxaa la dhihi karaa labadaba waa u fududahay, laakiin anigu uma arko inay ka gudbi karaan Atlético Madrid iyo kooxaha kale ee semi-finalka jooga. Balse waxaan u arkaa inay fursad fiican u leeyihiin horyaalka,” ayuu yiri Neville.
In kasta oo uu kula taliyay Mikel Arteta inuu u dagaallamo kulan kasta oo uusan kala dooran labada tartan, haddana Neville wuxuu qabaa in Premier League uu yahay midka ay hadda gacanta ku dhigi karaan marka loo eego tayada kooxaha kale ee Yurub isugu soo haray.

headline: Paul Merson Oo Saadaaliyay Kulanka Weyn Ee Arsenal Ay Ku Wajahayso Atletico Lugta Koowaad Ee Semi-finalka Champions League-ga
body:
Halyeeyga kooxda Arsenal, Paul Merson, ayaa saadaal ka bixiyay kulanka adag ee ay kooxdiisii hore ugu safri doonto dalka Spain si ay u wajahdo Atletico Madrid, lugta hore ee semi-finalka Champions League maalinta Arbacada.
Merson ayaa ka digay in Gunners ay wejihi doonto “ciyaar aad u adag” marka ay gaaraan magaalada Madrid, isagoo xusay in cadaadiska saaran Arsenal uu noqon doono mid weyn. Sidaas darteed, wuxuu kula taliyay tababare Mikel Arteta inuu ciyaarta kusoo bilaabo weeraryahanka Viktor Gyokeres.
“Aniga ahaan, Gyokeres waa inuu ciyaaraa habeenka Arbacada ee tartanka Yurub, sababtoo ah waa ciyaaryahan kubadda haysan kara waqti badan” ayuu Merson u sheegay Sky Sports.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray in marka ay Arsenal cadaadis la kulanto, ay u baahan doonaan awoodda Gyokeres si uu kooxda u siiyo neefta ay u baahan tahay iyo inuu kubadda ka fogeeyo aagga halista ah.
Arsenal ayaa usoo gudubtay wareegga afar-dhamaadka ka dib markii ay 1-0 cel-celis ahaan ku reebtay kooxda Sporting CP, halka Atletico Madrid ay tartanka ka saartay kooxda Barcelona. Talo soo jeedintan Merson ayaa imaaneysa xilli laga sugayo Arteta shaxda uu kaga hor tegi doono kooxda difaacashada adag ee uu hoggaamiyo Diego Simeone.

headline: Scholes Oo Shaaciyay Saddex Sababood Oo Ay City Ugu Guuleysan Karto Horyaalka Xilli Ciyaareed Kaan
body:
Halyeeyga khadka dhexe ee Manchester United, Paul Scholes, ayaa ku adkeystay in Manchester City ay weli haysato fursadda ugu wanaagsan ee ay ugu guuleysan karto horyaalka Premier League, inkasta oo ay Arsenal muujisay dadaal weyn.
Arsenal ayaa guul muhiim ah oo 1-0 ah ka gaartay Newcastle maalintii Axadda, taas oo ka dhigtay inay saddex dhibcood oo qura ka dambeeyaan City, inkasta oo kooxda Pep Guardiola ay hal kulan oo baaqi ah gacanta ku hayso. Scholes ayaa aaminsan in waayo-aragnimada iyo maskaxda guusha ee City ay fure u noqon doonto tartankan.
Scholes ayaa taxay saddex sababood oo uu u arko inay City horyaalka ugu guuleysan doonto:
1.Waayo-aragnimada Tartanka:
Wuxuu tilmaamay in Manchester City ay marar badan soo martay marxaladdan oo kale, ayna yaqaannaan sida loo maareeyo culayska toddobaadyada u dambeeya.
2. Maskaxda Guusha:
Scholes ayaa aaminsan in ciyaartoyda City ay leeyihiin deganaansho iyo maskax adag oo ay kaga gudbi karaan daqiiqadaha go’aaminaya tartanka.
3. Pep Guardiola:
Wuxuu ku sifeeyay Guardiola tababare ku takhasusay hanashada horyaallada, kaas oo si sax ah u garanaya sida loo soo xiro loolanka marka uu tartanku gaaro heerka gabagabada ah.
Dhanka kale, Scholes ayaa shaki geliyay in Arsenal ay leedahay awood dhalineed oo ku filan iyo “ad-adeyg” oo ay ku go’aamin karaan natiijooyinka marka ay xaaladdu adag tahay. “Taasi waa waxa kala saara kooxaha tartamaya iyo kuwa horyaalka qaadaya,” ayuu raaciyay Scholes, isagoo xusay in su’aalaha ugu waaweyn ay weli dul taagan yihiin kooxda Mikel Arteta.

headline: Wayne Rooney Oo Bannaanka Keenay Hal Arrin Oo Arsenal Ka Caawineysa Ku Guuleysiga Premier League Xilli Ciyaareed Kaan
body:
Halyeeyga Manchester United, Wayne Rooney, ayaa sheegay in soo laabashada Bukayo Saka ay tahay dhiirigelin weyn oo ay heshay kooxda Arsenal xilli ay la daalaa dhaceyso tartanka adag ee hanashada horyaalka Premier League.
Saka ayaa garoomada dib ugu soo laabtay kulankii ay Arsenal 1-0 kaga badisay Newcastle United maalintii Sabtida, isagoo beddel ku soo galay ka dib markii uu ku dhowaad bil dhaawac ku maqnaa.
Inkasta oo xiddigan uu dhaliyay labo gool oo qura tan iyo bishii December, uuna dhowr jeer xilli-ciyaareedkan dhaawacmay, haddana Rooney wuxuu rumeysan yahay in joogitaankiisa garoonka uu muhiimad weyn u leeyahay kooxda.
“Bukayo Saka wuxuu Arsenal u ahaa ciyaaryahan aad u fiican dhowrkii sano ee la soo dhaafay,” ayuu Rooney ku sheegay barnaamijkiisa podcast-ka ee BBC-da. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in inkasta oo uusan Saka gaarin heerkii looga bartay xilli-ciyaareedkan, haddana uu weli yahay xiddig muhiim u ah qaabka ay kooxdu u ciyaarto.
Rooney ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay in Saka uu ka mid yahay hoggaamiyeyaasha kooxda, sidaas darteedna soo laabashadiisa xilligan lagu jiro gabagabada xilli-ciyaareedka ay tahay  dhiirigelin xooggan oo gacan ka geysan karta in Arsenal ay hanato horyaalka oo ay saddex dhibcood hadda ku hayso hoggaankiisa.

headline: Chelsea Mise City? – Alan Pardew Oo Saadaaliyay Kooxda Ku Guuleysaneysa Koobka FA Cup-ka Sannad Kaan
body:
Tababarihii hore ee kooxda Newcastle United, Alan Pardew, ayaa saadaaliyay in Manchester City ay garaaci doonto Chelsea marka ay labada kooxood isku wajahaan finalka FA Cup-ka bisha dambe.
Chelsea iyo Man City ayaa xaqiijiyay boosaskooda finalka ka dib markii ay semi-finalkii dhacay toddobaadkan ka kala badiyeen kooxaha Leeds United iyo Southampton. Markii la weydiiyay haddii Chelsea ay awoodi karto inay ka badiso kooxda Pep Guardiola, Pardew wuxuu u sheegay talkSPORT inuusan rumeysnayn inay taasi dhacayso.
“Uma malaynayo, maya,” ayuu yiri Pardew. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in qaab ciyaareedka Manchester City ee kulankii Southampton uu ahaa mid aad u sarreeya, iyadoo xiddigaha weerarka ee kooxdaas ay ku jiraan xaalad fiican, sidoo kale Pep Guardiola uu haysto ciyaartoy tayo leh oo kursiga kaydka uga soo kici kara.
Finalka tartanka FA Cup-ka ayaa ka dhici doona garoonka Wembley Stadium taariikhdu marka ay ku beegantahay 16-ka May, halkaas oo lagu kala bixi doono koobka labaad ee ugu muhiimsan dalka Ingiriiska.

headline: Fabrizio Romano Oo Shaaciyay Go’aanka Liverpool Ee Mustaqbalka Tababare Slot
body:
Suxufiga Fabrizio Romano ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in kooxda Liverpool aysan hadda qorshaynayn inay Arne Slot ku beddesho Xabi Alonso xagaagan, isagoo xusay in maamulka kooxdu ay weli kalsooni ku qabaan macalinkooda hadda.
In kasta oo wararka ka soo baxaya dalka Jarmalka ay sheegayeen in Alonso loola dhaqmayo sidii beddelka suurtagalka ah ee Slot, Romano ayaa beeniyay warkaas, isagoo caddeeyay inuusan jirin wax xiriir ah oo dhex maray labada dhinac. Liverpool ayaa hadda ku jirta booska afaraad ee horyaalka Premier League, waxaana soo wajahay xilli-ciyaareed ku dhow inuu si niyad-jab ah ku dhammaado.
Haddii kooxdu ay weydo booska tartanka Champions League, cadaadiska saaran Slot ayaa laga yaabaa inuu sii kordho, taas oo horseedi karta in su’aalo badan laga keeno mustaqbalkiisa, inkasta oo uu haysto hal sano oo qandaraaskiisa ka dhiman.
Dhanka kale, Xabi Alonso ayaa hadda bilaa koox ah ka dib markii uu bishii Janaayo ka tagay Real Madrid, halkaas oo uu joogay muddo sideed bilood ah oo qura. In kasta oo taariikhda uu Alonso la leeyahay Liverpool ay ka dhigtay mid lala xiriiriyo xilkan, haddana kooxda ayaa xoogga saaraysa sidii ay u garab istaagi lahayd Arne Slot halkii ay ka fikiri lahayd isbeddel dhanka maamulka ah.

headline: Joe Cole Oo Farta Ku Fiiqay Ciyaartoydii Chelsea U Suurtagelisay Inay Gaarto Final-ka FA Cup-ka
body:
Halyeeyga kooxda Chelsea, Joe Cole, ayaa ammaan ballaaran u jeediyay xiddiga khadka dhexe ee Enzo Fernandez kadib markii uu soo bandhigay ciyaar heer sare ah kulankii semi-finalka FA Cup-ka ee ay ka badiyeen Leeds United.
Enzo ayaa dhaliyay goolka qura ee guusha u horseeday Chelsea, isagoo markaas kooxdiisa geeyay finalka tartanka, isla markaana iska yareeyay dhaleeceyn weyn oo muddooyinkii u dambeeyay kaga imaanaysay qaab ciyaareedkiisa.
Joe Cole oo ka hadlayay jawiga garoonka Wembley kadib ciyaarta ayaa yiri: “Ninkaas waxaan u maleeyay inuu ahaa mid heersare ah. Waxaa jiray su’aalo badan oo la iska weydiinayay hadalladii uu horay u yiri, balse marka uu garoonka soo galo waa dagaalyahan dhab ah.”
Sidoo kale, Cole ayaa ammaanay difaaca kooxda iyo goolhaye Robert Sanchez oo muujiyay dhabar-adayg weyn. Wuxuu si gaar ah u xusay Trevor Chalobah iyo Tosin Adarabioyo oo uu sheegay inay si adag u xakameeyeen weeraryahanka Dominic Calvert-Lewin.“Taas waa waxa ay taageerayaashu rabaan inay arkaan; inay arkaan dagaal iyo hami dhab ah oo kooxda ka dhex muuqda,” ayuu raaciyay Cole, isagoo ku faraxsan in kooxdu ay u soo gudubtay finalka FA Cup-ka halkaas oo ay ku wajahayso Manchester City.

headline: Marcus Rashford Oo Go’aan Ka Soo Saaray Mustaqbalkiisa Barcelona
body:
Marcus Rashford ayaa si buuxda diiradda u saaraya sidii uu u sii joogi lahaa kooxda Barcelona, isagoo meesha ka saaray inuu dib ugu laabto Manchester United xilli-ciyaareedka soo socda. Weeraryahankan reer England, oo gool dhaliyay guushii ay kooxdu ka gaartay Getafe, ayaa rumeysan inuu qabtay shaqo ku filan oo uu ku qancin karo maamulka kooxda si ay u kordhiyaan joogitaankiisa.
Inkasta oo uu Rashford qandaraas kula jiro Manchester United ilaa sanadka 2028, haddana kuma talajiro inuu dib ugu laabto Old Trafford marxaladdan. Hadafkiisa koowaad waa inuu sii joogo Barcelona, maadaama uu dareensan yahay in qaab ciyaareedka kooxdaas uu aad ugu habboon yahay tayadiisa ciyaareed.
Xiddigan 28-jirka ah ayaa tusaale u soo qaatay xogtiisa xilli-ciyaareedkan oo ah 13 gool iyo 11 caawin, isagoo doonaya inuu ku qanciyo tababare Hansi Flick oo aan weli go’aan kama dambays ah ka gaarin mustaqbalkiisa.
Wararka ayaa intaas ku daraya inay jirto fursad Barcelona ay ku iibsan karto Rashford oo lagu qiyaasay €30 milyan, iyadoo uu jiro heshiis horudhac ah oo ku saabsan in ciyaaryahanku aqbalo mushahar dhimis. Rashford ayaa la sheegay inuu diyaar u yahay tanaasul dheeraad ah oo dhanka maaliyadda ah si uu u xaqiijiyo inuu mustaqbal fog ku yeesho garoonka Camp Nou.

Rashford ayaa la sheegay inuu diyaar u yahay tanaasul dheeraad ah oo dhanka maaliyadda ah si uu u xaqiijiyo inuu mustaqbal fog ku yeesho garoonka Camp Nou.

headline: Eberechi Eze Oo Calaacal Afka Furtay, Sheegayna Dhibaatada Ugu Weyn Ay Arsenal Wajaheyso Waqti Xaadir Kaan.
body:
Xiddiga weerarka uga ciyaara kooxda Arsenal, Eberechi Eze, ayaa qiray in cadaadiska saaran kooxda uu yahay mid aad u weyn, balse wuxuu ku sifeeyay mid lagama maarmaan u ah hanashada horyaalka Premier League.
Eze, oo ahaa geesigii dhaliyay goolka qura ee ay Arsenal kaga badisay Newcastle United maalintii Sabtida, ayaa sheegay in ciyaartoydu aysan dhegeysan qeylada uga timaada khubarada kubadda cagta ama dadka dibadda ka hadla. Sida uu sheegay xiddigan reer England, cadaadiska ay ciyaartoydu isku saaraan gudaha ayaa ka culus midka dibadda uga imaanaya.
“Ma dhegeysto khubarada! Cadaadiska aan annagu is saarayno ayaa aad uga badan midka dibadda naga soo gaaraya,” ayuu yiri Eze isagoo la hadlayay Fabrizio Romano.
In kasta oo uu cadaadis jiro, Eze wuxuu aaminsan yahay inuu yahay mid u wacan iyaga. “Waa cadaadis waxa lagama maarmaanka u ah guusha, ma ahan mid taban, ee waa mid qurux badan,” ayuu raaciyay, isagoo muujiyay in tartanka loogu jiro horyaalka uu u baahan yahay dhabar-adayg iyo maskax adag.
Guushan ayaa ka caawisay Arsenal inay dib ugu laabato hoggaanka horyaalka, iyadoo saddex dhibcood ka sarreysa Manchester City, inkasta oo City ay haysato hal kulan oo baaqi ah maaddaama ay ku seegtay todobaadkii hore tartanka FA Cup-ka.

headline: Gary Neville Oo Shaaciyay Hal Waddo Oo Ay Arsenal Ugu Guuleysan Karto Champions League Iyo Premier League Sannad Kaan
body:
Halyeeyga Manchester United, Gary Neville, ayaa fariin talo ah u diray kooxda Arsenal iyo tababare Mikel Arteta, isagoo tilmaamay isbeddelka ay tahay inay sameeyaan haddii ay rabaan inay ku guuleystaan horyaalka Premier League iyo Champions League xilli-ciyaareedkan.
Neville, oo falanqayn ka sameynayay Sky Sports ka dib guushii 1-0 ee Arsenal ay ka gaartay Newcastle, ayaa sheegay in Gunners ay u baahan tahay inay “si xor ah u weerarto” haddii ay doonayaan inay hantiyaan koobab waaweyn. Guushaas ayaa Arsenal ka dhigtay inay saddex dhibcood ku hoggaamiso horyaalka ka hor inta aysan wajahin Atletico Madrid ciyaarta lugta hore ee semi-finalka Champions League maalinta Arbacada.
“Waxay u baahan yihiin inay si xor ah u ciyaaraan marka ay weerarka ku jiraan,” ayuu yiri Neville. Wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay in kooxdu ay hadda u muuqato mid aad diiradda u saaraysa hanashada horyaalka Premier League, balse aysan maskaxda ku hayn inay u tartami karaan hanashada Champions League.
Neville ayaa rumeysan in haddii Arsenal ay kordhiso tayada iyo xawaaraha weerarkeeda, ay awood u yeelan karto inay taariikh cusub dhigto oo ay labada koobba ku guuleysato, balse xilligan ay u muuqdaan kuwo ku ciyaaraya taxaddar badan.

headline: Paul Merson Oo Shaaciyay Kulanka Go’aamin Doona Premier League
body:
Halyeeyga khadka dhexe ee xulka England, Paul Merson, ayaa sheegay in kulanka soo socda ee ay Arsenal la ciyaari doonto Fulham uu yahay midka go’aamin doona cidda ku guuleysaneysa horyaalka Premier League.
Arsenal ayaa Sabtidii 1-0 ku garaacday Newcastle, taas oo ka dhigtay inay saddex dhibcood ka sarreeyaan Manchester City. Ka hor guushan, wiilasha Mikel Arteta ayaa la kulmay laba guuldarro oo xiriir ah oo ay kala kulmeen kooxaha Bournemouth iyo Man City, balse hadda waxay dib u heleen kalsoonidooda iyadoo ay u dhiman yihiin afar kulan oo qura.
Afarta kulan ee ugu dambeeya ee Arsenal ayaa kala ah Fulham, West Ham, Crystal Palace, iyo Burnley. Merson oo ka hadlayay Sky Sports ayaa yiri: “Haddii Arsenal ay toddobaadka dambe ka badiso Fulham iyadoo gurigeeda joogta, Arsenal ayaa ku guuleysan doonta horyaalka.”
Wuxuu intaas ku daray in haddii Gunners ay lix dhibcood ku fogaato hoggaanka, ay culays weyn saari doonto Manchester City oo markaas u safri doonta Everton, isagoo aaminsan in ciyaartaas Goodison Park ay ku adkaan doonto kooxda Pep Guardiola haddii ay dhibco badan ka dambeeyaan.

headline: Wakhtiga Ay Arsenal Ku Guulaysan Karto Horyaalka Oo La Saadaaliyay
body:
Paul Merson ayaa aaminsan in tartanka horyaalka Premier League uu soo dhammaan karo toddobaadka soo socda, isagoo xusay in guul ay Arsenal ka gaarto Fulham ay fure u noqon doonto hanashada koobka.
Merson, oo la hadlayay Sky Sports, ayaa sheegay in haddii Gunners ay lix dhibcood ku fogaato hoggaanka ka hor inta aysan Manchester City u safrin kooxda Everton, in culayska saaran City uu noqon doono mid aad u weyn. Wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay in booqashada ay City ku tagayso Merseyside ay tahay imtixaan adag, gaar ahaan xilli ay dhibco ka dambeeyaan Arsenal.
“Haddii Arsenal ay guuleysato toddobaadka soo socda, horyaalka iyagaa iska leh,” ayuu yiri Merson. Wuxuu tilmaamay in xaaladda hadda taagan ay u baahan tahay dhiirigelin iyo in laga faa’iideysto fursad kasta oo lagu dheereysan karo hoggaanka.
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, halyeeygan hore ee Arsenal ayaa qiray in qaabka ay hadda kooxdu u ciyaareyso uusan ahayn mid indhaha u roon, isagoo ku sifeeyay mid “walwal badan” oo ay ku adag tahay taageerayaasha inay ku raaxaystaan. Wuxuu sheegay in walwalka tartanka adag uu saameyn ku yeeshay jawiga garoonka iyo qaab ciyaareedka ciyaartoyda, balse waxa ugu muhiimsan ay tahay helitaanka saddexda dhibcood marxaladdan xasaasiga ah.
Arsenal ayaa hadda saddex dhibcood ka sarreysa Manchester City ka dib guushii 1-0 ee ay ka gaareen Newcastle, inkasta oo City ay haysato hal kulan oo baaqi ah. Guul ay ka gaaraan Fulham waxay culays weyn saari doontaa kooxda Pep Guardiola ka hor kulankooda Goodison Park.

headline: Shaxda Ay Manchester United Kaga Hor Tagi Karto Brentford
body:
Manchester United ayaa caawa garoonka Old Trafford ku martigelin doonta kooxda Brentford saacadda 10:00 habeenimo (xilliga Geeska Afrika), iyagoo raadinaya inay sii xoojiyaan booskooda shanta sare ee horyaalka Premier League.
Kooxda “Red Devils” ayaa hadda fadhida booska saddexaad, iyagoo sideed dhibcood ka sarreeya kooxda lixaad ee Brighton, iyagoo heysta hal kulan oo baaqi ahna haystaan. In kasta oo uu tababare Michael Carrick isbeddel weyn ku sameeyay kooxda tan iyo markii uu la wareegay, haddana Man Utd ayaan ku jirin xaaladdeedii ugu fiicnayd dhowrkii kulan ee u dambeeyay, iyadoo laga badiyay labo ka mid ah shantii kulan ee u dambeeyay horyaalka.
Taariikhda dhawaanahan ee labada kooxood ayaa dhiirigelin siinaysa Brentford, maadaama ay garaaceen Man Utd labadii kulan ee ugu dambeeyay horyaalka oo ay iska hor yimaadeen.
Shaxda macquulka ah ee Man Utd (4-2-3-1):
Lammens; Mazraoui, Heaven, Maguire, Shaw; Casemiro, Mainoo; Mbeumo, Fernandes, Cunha; Sesko.
Guul ay caawa gaarto Manchester United waxay dhabaha u xaari doontaa inay si rasmi ah u xaqiijisato ka qaybgalka tartanka Champions League ee xilli-ciyaareedka dambe.

headline: Jamie Carragher Oo Shaaciyay Xiddig Ay Liverpool Ka Qoomameyn Doonto Saxiixiisa
body:
Halyeeyga Liverpool, Jamie Carragher, ayaa muujiyay walaac ku aaddan in Alexander Isak uusan marnaba caddeyn karin lacagtii badneyd ee laga bixiyay, isagoo xusay in xilli-ciyaareedka koowaad ee Liverpool uu badanaa tilmaam u yahay waxa uu ciyaaryahanku qaban doono mustaqbalka.
“Kharash-gareyntii badneyd ee xagaaga ma shaqeyn,” ayuu Carragher u sheegay wargeyska Liverpool Echo. Carragher ayaa ku dooday in in kasta oo aan la xukumi karin saxiix kasta sanadkiisa koowaad, haddana waayo-aragnimadiisii ciyaaryahannimo ay bartay inay dhif tahay in ciyaaryahan aan xilli-ciyaareedkiisa koowaad waxba qaban uu mar dambe noqdo mid wacdaro dhiga.
“Isak weli ma uusan bilaabin inuu si fiican u ciyaaro. Dabcan dhaawac ayaa ku dhacay, laakiin xitaa bilowgii hore umuu muuqan mid aad u wanaagsan,” ayuu raaciyay Carragher.
Alexander Isak ayaa dhowr bilood garoomada uga maqnaa dhaawac halis ah oo kasoo gaaray lugta, wuxuuna hadda dhaliyay goolkiisii saddexaad ee xilli-ciyaareedka intii ay socotay ciyaartii ay Liverpool 3-1 kaga badisay Crystal Palace. In kasta oo uu goolkaas dhaliyay, haddana Carragher wuxuu weli qabaa shaki ah in weeraryahanka reer Sweden uu buuxin karo filashada weyn ee laga qabo.

headline: Xavi Hernandez Oo Ugu Dambeyntii Shaaciyay Cidda Ka Hor Istaagtay Inuu Messi Barcelona Dib Ugu Soo Celiyo
body:
Tababarihii hore ee kooxda Barcelona, Xavi Hernandez, ayaa shaaca ka qaaday sababta rasmiga ah ee uu ugu fashilmay isku daygii uu Lionel Messi dib ugu soo celin lahaa garoonka Camp Nou, isagoo eedda dusha kaga tuuray hal qof.
Xavi oo wareysi siiyay kanaalka YouTube-ka ee halyeeyga Romario, ayaa sheegay inuu dadaal badan u galay sidii uu kooxda dib ugu soo celin lahaa xiddigo hore u soo maray kooxda oo ay ku jiraan Neymar, Pedro, iyo Messi. In kasta oo Neymar iyo Pedro ay u soo laaban waayeen duruufo dhaqaale dartood, haddana arrinta Messi ayay sheekadu ka duwanayd.
“Anigoo ah tababaraha Barcelona, waxaan dib u soo celiyay Dani Alves, waxaana isku dayay inaan dib u soo celiyo Neymar, Pedro, iyo Messi. Pedro iyo Neymar lama saxiixan karin xaalado dhaqaale awgood. Laakiin marka ay timaado Messi, madaxweynaha (Joan Laporta) ayaan diiday inuu soo laabto,” ayuu yiri Xavi.
Xavi ayaa intaas ku daray inay Messi la hadlayeen muddo shan bilood ah sanadkii 2023, wax kastaana ay diyaar ahaayeen, balse ugu dambayntii uu Laporta diiday in heshiiska la dhammaystiro.
Sidoo kale, Xavi ayaa isagoo dhoola-caddeynaya dib u xusuustay waqtigii ay wada ciyaari jireen Messi, isagoo yiri: “Mararka qaar Messi wuu igu xanaaqi jiray haddii aan kubadda u baasno ciyaartoy kale… wuxuu igu oran jiray ‘Haye, haye! Maxaad samaynaysaa? Kubadda aniga ii baas!'”
In kasta oo isku daygaas uu fashilmay, Xavi wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay in xiriirka ka dhexeeya isaga iyo Messi uu weli yahay mid aad u xooggan oo ku dhisay kalsooni muddo dheer soo jirtay. Barcelona ayaa markii dambe ka tagtay Xavi, waxayna magacawday Hansi Flick oo hadda kooxda hoggaamiya.

headline: Michael Carrick Oo Markii Ugu Horreysay Si Toos Ah U Tilmaamay Xiddiga Laf-dhabarta U Ah Manchester United
body:
Michael Carrick ayaa amaan ugu qubeeyay kabtanka Manchester United, Bruno Fernandes, isagoo ku sifeeyay mid ka mid ah musharaxiinta ugu cad-cad ee abaalmarinta xiddiga ugu fiican xilli-ciyaareedka (Player of the Year), ka dib saameynta weyn ee uu ku yeeshay kooxda.
“Bruno muddo dheer ayaan aqaanay, shaqo ayaana naga dhexaysay markii uu kooxda yimid, markaas waxa uu hadda samaynayo iguma noqon wax layaab leh,” ayuu yiri Carrick. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in xiddiga reer Portugal uu muujiyay korniinka dhanka khibradda ah, isagoo hadda ku jira xaalad ciyaareed oo aad u sarreysa.
Carrick ayaa sharraxay in habka ugu wanaagsan ee Bruno looga soo saari karo tayadiisa ay tahay in la siiyo fursad iyo xorriyad uu ku abuuro fursadaha weerarka, isagoo yiri: “Waxaan jecelahay inaan arko Bruno oo ku jira boosaska weerarka isagoo haysta xorriyad yar. Wuxuu u ciyaaraa kooxda, mas’uuliyad weyn ayaana ka saaran dhismaha ciyaarta.”
Carrick ayaa si gaar ah u xusay dadaalkii difaacasho ee uu Bruno muujiyay kulankii ay 1-0 kaga badiyeen Chelsea, isagoo sheegay in kabtanku uusan ku fiicnayn oo qura kubad heysashada, balse uu qabtay shaqo aad u adag marka ay kooxdu kubadda weydo.
“Aad ayaan ugu faraxsannahay saameynta iyo qaab ciyaareedka uu hadda soo bandhigayo,” ayuu hadalkiisa ku soo xiray Carrick, isagoo tilmaamay in qaab-dhismeedka kooxda loo dhisay si looga faa’iideysto tayada ciyaartoyda oo dhan, gaar ahaan xiddigaha farqiga sameeya sida Bruno.

headline: Barcelona Oo Rashford U Dirtay Farriin Culus Oo Mustaqbalkiisa Ku Aadan
body:
Sida uu qoray suxufiga Guillem Balague ee ka tirsan BBC-da, kooxda Barcelona ayaa fariin u dirtay Marcus Rashford iyadoo ka codsatay inuu dulqaad muujiyo inta ay socdaan wadahadalada qandaraaskiisa. Kooxda ayaa u xaqiijisay Rashford in dib-u-dhaca uu ka dhashay xannibaadaha dhaqaale ee horyaalka ee aysan la xiriirin wax shaki ah oo laga qabo tayadiisa ama dadaalkiisa.
Rashford ayaa muujiyay korniin dhanka maskaxda ah isagoo aqbalay inuu mararka qaar kursiga kaydka fariisto isagoon wax cabasho ah muujin, wuxuuna wacdaro ka dhigay kulankii Champions League ee ay la ciyaareen Atlético Madrid. In kasta oo tababare Hansi Flick uu aad u jecel yahay ciyaarta Rashford, haddana kooxda ayaa mudnaanta siinaysa saxiixa Julián Alvarez oo loo arko dhaxal sugaha Lewandowski, iyo xiddigaha garabka ee sida Lamine Yamal iyo Raphinha.
Xogta ayaa muujinaysa in Rashford uu heli lahaa mushahar ka badan kan Barcelona haddii uu ku laaban lahaa Manchester United, balse wuxuu doorbidi lahaa inuu sii joogo Camp Nou maadaama uu ku faraxsan yahay xorriyadda uu ka helay kooxda. Wakiillada ciyaaryahanka ayaa ku sifeeyay wararka sheegaya inuu baxayo kuwo looga gol-leeyahay wadahadalada, iyagoo kalsooni ku qaba in xal la heli doono.
“Si buuxda ayuu ula dhacsan yahay mashruuca kooxda,” ayay xaqiijiyeen ilo ku dhow ciyaaryahanka. Rashford ayaa xilli-ciyaareedkan gacan ka geystay 26 gool, taas oo ka dhigan in la-qabsashadiisa xilli-ciyaareedkii ugu horreeyay ee Barcelona ay ka wanaagsan tahay xiddigo waaweyn oo soo maray kooxda sida Thierry Henry, Zlatan Ibrahimovic, Neymar, Ousmane Dembele, iyo Robert Lewandowski.
Luis Suarez ayaa ah xiddiga qura ee ka horreeya dhanka xogta la-qabsashada ee xilli-ciyaareedka koowaad.

Wakiillada ciyaaryahanka ayaa ku sifeeyay wararka sheegaya inuu baxayo kuwo looga gol-leeyahay wadahadalada, iyagoo kalsooni ku qaba in xal la heli doono.

Luis Suarez ayaa ah xiddiga qura ee ka horreeya dhanka xogta la-qabsashada ee xilli-ciyaareedka koowaad.

headline: Jamie Carragher Oo Ka Dhawaajiyay Saxiixyada Liverpool Ay Ku Qasban Tahay Inay Sameyso Suuqa Xagaaga
body:
Halyeeygii hore ee daafaca Liverpool, Jamie Carragher, ayaa ku dooday in kooxdu ay u baahan tahay inay lasoo saxiixato ugu yaraan saddex ciyaaryahan oo si toos ah ugu soo bilaaban kara safka hore xagaagan, isagoo dhanka kale uga digay inay ku celiyaan kharash gareyntii waallida ahayd ee xagaagii hore oo ay suuqa geliyeen £446 milyan.
“Markay timaado waxa ay tahay inay Liverpool samayso xilli-ciyaareedka dambe, dabcan waxaa cad inay u baahan yihiin inay helaan beddelka Mohamed Salah,” ayuu Carragher u sheegay wargeyska Liverpool Echo.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray inuu aaminsan yahay in saddex ciyaaryahan ay lagama maarmaan u yihiin inay si toos ah ugu soo biiraan kooxda koowaad. “Ma socon karto inaad hal mar soo iibsato shan ciyaaryahan oo kooxda galaya. Liverpool waxay ciyaartoy badan soo iibsatay xagaagii hore, markaas uma malaynayo inay kuwo aad u badan soo iibsan doonaan xagaagan.”
Carragher ayaa rumeysan in halkii tiro badan oo ciyaartoy ah la keeni lahaa, ay ka muhiimsan tahay in xoogga lagu saaro tayo gaar ah oo dabooli karta kaalinta xiddigaha baxaya, gaar ahaan mishiinkii goolasha ee Salah oo horey u xaqiijiyay inuu ka tagayo Anfield.

headline: SuperComputer-ka Opta Oo Soo Sasray Saadaal Cusub Oo Ku Aadan Kooxda Ku Guuleysaneysa Premier League
body:
Opta SuperComputer ayaa soo saaray xog cusub oo ku saabsan tartanka horyaalka Premier League, ka dib guushii ay Arsenal 1-0 kaga adkaatay kooxda Newcastle United maalintii Sabtida.
Sida ay muujinayso xogtii u dambaysay, fursadda ay Arsenal ugu guuleysan karto horyaalka ayaa kor ugu kacday 70.85%. Guushan, oo uu goolka qura u saxiixay Eberechi Eze ka dib kooner si xirfad leh loo soo laaday, ayaa Gunners ka caawisay inay saddex dhibcood ka sarreeyaan Manchester City, iyagoo dib u hantay hoggaanka horyaalka.
Dhanka kale, kooxda Manchester City oo haysata hal kulan oo baaqi ah, ayaa fursadeeda lagu qiyaasay 29.15%. In kasta oo City ay weli tartanka ku jirto, haddana culayska ayaa ku sii kordhaya ka dib markii Arsenal ay muujisay joogteyn iyo dhabar-adayg.
Arsenal ayaa kulankeeda xiga garoonkeeda ku qaabili doonta kooxda Fulham, waana fursad ay lix dhibcood ku fogaan karaan ka hor inta aysan Manchester City u safrin kooxda Everton. Toddobaadyada soo socda ayaa go’aamin doona haddii saadaashan Opta ay dhabowdo iyo haddii City ay markale loolanka dhinac u rogto.

headline: Van Dijk: “Isak Waxay Kooxda Uga Baaahan Tahay Goolal Badan, Sababtoo Ah….”
body:
Kabtanka kooxda Liverpool, Virgil van Dijk, ayaa sheegay inuu filayo in goolal tiro beel ah ka yimaadaan Alexander Isak, ka dib markii uu xiddiga reer Sweden soo maray xilli-ciyaareed adag oo dhaawacyo ragaadiyeen.
“Waa muhiim in Alex uu goolal dhaliyo maadaama uu yahay weeraryahanka kooxda, goolkii uu dhaliyayna wuxuu ahaa mid aad u qurux badan,” ayuu yiri Van Dijk ka dib guushii 3-1 ee ay Liverpool ka gaartay kooxda Crystal Palace. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in ciyaartoyda ay isku kooxda yihiin ay si buuxda u garanayaan tayada weyn ee uu leeyahay Isak.
Van Dijk ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay inaysan jirin wax walaac ah oo uu ka qabo weeraryahanka, isagoo xusay in waxa uu u baahan yahay oo qura ay tahay kalsooni iyo inuu helo kulamo badan oo uu ciyaaro. “Waxaan ka rabnaa wax ka badan goolal, waana waxa uu keeni karo. Waa inuu sii wadaa shaqada, ahaadaa mid taam ah, isla markaana muhiim u ahaado kooxda,” ayuu raaciyay difaaca reer Holland.
Xilli-ciyaareedkan ayaa ahaa mid aad ugu adag weeraryahanka, maadaama uu muddo bilooyin ah garoomada kaga maqnaa dhaawac dartiis. Isak ayaa goolkiisii saddexaad ee xilli-ciyaareedka dhaliyay kulankii u dambeeyay, ka dib markii uu ku dhibtooday inuu si joogto ah u ciyaaro.
Ugu dambeyntii, Van Dijk ayaa rajo wanaagsan ka muujiyay in Isak uu hadda taam yahay, uuna diyaar u yahay inuu garoonka ku soo bandhigo tayadiisa dhabta ah ee lagu arkay xilliyadii uu tababarka la qaadanayay kooxda.

headline: Barcelona Oo Shuruudo Cusub Ku Xirtay Inay Heshiiska U Kordhiso Lewandowski
body:
Suxufiga caanka ah ee Fabrizio Romano ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in kooxda Barcelona ay diyaar u tahay inay sii haysato weeraryahanka reer Poland ee Robert Lewandowski xilli-ciyaareed kale, balse taasi ay ku xirnaan doonto shuruudo cusub.
Shuruudahan ayaa la sheegay inay qayb ka yihiin qandaraas wakhti gaaban ah iyo in ciyaaryahanku uu ogolaado mushahar dhimis weyn marka loo eego heshiiskiisa hadda.
Dhanka kale, Lewandowski iyo wakiilkiisa ayaan weli gaarin go’aan rasmi ah, waxayna hadda miisaamayaan fursadaha horyaalla. Sida lagu waramay, wakiilka ciyaaryahanka ayaa qorshaynaya inuu toddobaadyada soo socda booqashooyin ku maro dhowr dal oo uu ku jiro dalka Talyaaniga, si uu u soo qiimeeyo xiisaha iyo dalabaadka ay u qabaan kooxaha kale ka hor inta uusan u bandhigin xiddigan rug-caddaaga ah.
Go’aanka kama dambaysta ah ayaa gacanta ugu jira Robert Lewandowski laftiisa. Haddii uu doorto inuu sii joogo Camp Nou ama inuu tijaabiyo loolan cusub, waxay saameyn toos ah ku yeelan doontaa qorshaha weerarka ee kooxda Barcelona ee xilli-ciyaareedka soo socda.
Maaddaama uu Lewandowski yahay mid ka mid ah xiddigaha ugu saameynta badan kooxda, maamulka Barcelona ayaa doonaya inay si taxaddar leh u maareeyaan mustaqbalkiisa si ay u dheellitiraan baahida farsamo ee garoonka iyo xaaladda dhaqaale ee kooxda.

headline: FIFA Oo Kordhineysa Lacagaha Abaalmarinta Iyo Gunnooyinka Ka Qeyb-galka Koobka Adduunka 2026
body:
Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Adduunka ee FIFA ayaa si horudhac ah isugu raacay in kor loo qaado lacagaha abaalmarinta iyo gunnooyinka ka qaybgalka ee Koobka Adduunka 2026. Go’aankan ayaa yimid ka dib markii xiriirada qaar ka mid ah waddamada ay muujiyeen walaac ku aaddan kharashka badan ee ku bixi doona ka qaybgalka tartankaas.
Xiriirada ayaa ka digay in kharashka safarka, hoyga, iyo canshuuraha, gaar ahaan gudaha dalka Mareykanka ay horseedi karaan in xulalka qaar ay la kulmaan khasaare maaliyadeed, xataa haddii ay natiijooyin wanaagsan ka gaaraan tartanka.
FIFA ayaa markii hore qorshaysay lacag dhan $727 milyan oo loogu talagalay abaalmarinnada, balse tiradaas ayaa hadda la filayaa inay sii korodho.
Sidoo kale, qorshahan waxaa qayb ka ah in la kordhiyo taageerada horumarineed ee la siiyo 211-ka xiriir ee xubnaha ka ah FIFA, taas oo markii hore lagu qiyaasay $2.7 bilyan muddada wareeggan hadda socda. FIFA ayaa xustay inay ku jirto xaaladdii maaliyadeed ee ugu adkayd taariikhdeeda, iyadoo rajeynaysa dakhli gaaraya ilaa $13 bilyan muddada wareegga Koobka Adduunka ee hadda socda.
Ansixinta kama dambaysta ah ee faahfaahinta lacagahan ayaa la filayaa inay dhowaan dhacdo inta lagu guda jiro kulanka Golaha FIFA ee ka dhacaya magaalada Vancouver ee dalka Canada. Tallaabadan ayaa ujeeddadeedu tahay in lagu hubiyo in daqliga laga helayo kubadda cagta adduunka ay gaaraan heer sare oo caalami ah.

headline: Chelsea Oo Iska Xaadirisay Final-ka FA Cup-ka
body:
Kooxda Chelsea ayaa xaqiijisatay guul qaali ah ka dib markii ay 1-0 ku garaacday kooxda Leeds United kulankii semi-finalka FA Cup-ka ee ka dhacay garoonka Wembley.
Guushan ayaa ka dhigan in Chelsea ay si rasmi ah ugu soo gudubtay finalka tartanka FA Cup-ka. Goolka qura ee ciyaarta ayay dhalisay daqiiqadii 23-aad, waxaana saxiixay Enzo Fernandez ka dib markii uu madax ku dhammaystiray karoos qurux badan oo uu dhanka midig uga soo tuuray Pedro Neto.
Chelsea ayaa finalka ay foodda isku dari doonaan kooxda Manchester City, taas oo iyaduna shalay soo gudubtay kadib markii ay 2-1 kaga badisay Southampton.
Kulanka weyn ee finalka ayaa la qorsheeyay inuu dhaco maalinta Sabtida ah ee 16-ka May, waxaana lagu ciyaari doonaa isla garoonka Wembley Stadium.
