headline: Gary Neville Oo Furka Ku Tuuray Martin Zubimendi Kadib Bandhig Liita Oo Uu Sameeyay Kulankii Newcastle
body:
Gary Neville ayaa dhaleeceyn u soo jeediyay qaab ciyaareedka Martin Zubimendi ee bilihii ugu dambeeyay, isagoo qiray inuu ka niyad-jabay xiddiga khadka dhexe ee Arsenal xilli-ciyaareedkan.
In kasta oo Gunners ay dib ugu soo laabatay hoggaanka horyaalka kadib guushii 1-0 ee ay ka gaartay Newcastle, Neville ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay hoos u dhaca ku yimid Zubimendi. Wuxuu xusay in saxiixan ku fadhiya £60-ka milyan uu dhibtoonayay dhowrkii bilood ee u dambeeyay, inkastoo uu ku bilowday qaab ciyaareed aad u xooggan.
“Bilowgii xilli-ciyaareedka waxaan moodayay in Zubimendi uu ahaa saxiix weyn,” ayuu Neville ka yiri barnaamijkiisa The Gary Neville Podcast. “Wuxuu ahaa ciyaaryahan u wanaagsan Arsenal, laakiin hadda waxaan filayay inuu noqon doono xiddigii farqiga samayn lahaa.”
Neville ayaa is barbar dhig ku sameeyay Zubimendi iyo xiddigaha sida Pirlo, Scholes, Rodri ama Bernardo Silva, isagoo sheegay inuu ka sugayay inuu maamulo ciyaarta oo uu Arsenal siiyo awood dhanka khadka dhexe ah, balse uusan taas soo bandhigin toddobaadyadii la soo dhaafay. Sidoo kale, wuxuu xusay in Viktor Gyokeres looga baahnaa inuu goolal u beddelo fursadihii uu helay si ciyaartu ay u noqoto 2-0.
“Waxaan dareemay in Zubimendi, Rice iyo Odegaard looga adkaaday khadka dhexe kulankii Newcastle,” ayuu raaciyay Neville. Wuxuu tilmaamay in Newcastle ay haysatay  kubadda boqolkiiba 55, halka Arsenal ay haysatay boqolkiiba 45, taas oo uu ku sifeeyay mid layaab leh maaddaama khadka dhexe ee Newcastle uu ka ciyaar fiicnaa kan Arsenal.
Ugu dambeyntii, Neville ayaa soo jeediyay in Mikel Arteta uu dib uga fikiro sida uu u habayn karo khadkiisa dhexe si ay u muujiyaan awood iyo xakameyn inta ay socdaan kulamada muhiimka ah.

headline: Xavi Oo Magacaabay Xiddiga Ugu Muhiimsan Barcelona Waqti Xaadir Kaan
body:
Tababarihii hore ee kooxda Barcelona, Xavi Hernandez, ayaa ammaan aan loo kala harin u jeediyay xiddiga da’da yar ee Lamine Yamal, isagoo ku sifeeyay hibadiisa mid mar dhif iyo naadir ah dunida ku soo biirta, isla markaana durba ka mid ah kuwa ugu fiican caalamka.
Xavi, oo ahaa tababarihii fursaddii ugu horreysay ee kooxda koowaad siiyay Yamal, ayaa bixiyay qiimeyn sare oo ku aaddan awoodda iyo mustaqbalka wiilkan yar.
“Lamine Yamal waa ciyaaryahan la doortay. Waa garaad dhanka kubadda cagta ah, hadda wuxuu ka mid yahay ciyaartoyda ugu fiican ama waa kan ugu fiican adduunka,” ayuu yiri Xavi. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in guulaha uu gaari karo ay hadda ku xiran yihiin maskaxdiisa, tamarta uu la yimaado, iyo hamiga uu u leeyahay inuu taariikh dhigo.
Yamal ayaa taariikhda galay isagoo uu hoggaaminayo Xavi 29-kii Abriil, 2023, markaas oo uu saftay kulankiisii ugu horreeyay ee La Liga isagoo ka hor yimid Real Betis. Wuxuu xilligaas jiray 15 sano, 9 bilood, iyo 16 maalmood, isagoo noqday ciyaaryahankii ugu yaraa ee abid u safta Barcelona horyaalka Spain.
Xiddigan garabka ka ciyaara ayaa ciyaarta soo galay daqiiqadii 83-aad, isagoo beddelay Gavi xilli kooxdu ay ku badinaysay 4-0. Maalintaas waxay calaamad u noqotay bilowga mid ka mid ah waayihii ciyaareed ee loogu dabagalka badnaa guud ahaan qaaradda Yurub.

headline: Bruno Fernandes Oo Shaaciyay Halka Sabab Ee Uu U Doonayo In Portugal Ugu Guulaysato Koobka Adduunka.
body:
Kabtanka kooxda Manchester United iyo xiddiga khadka dhexe ee xulka Portugal, Bruno Fernandes, ayaa si qiiro leh uga hadlay hamigooda ku aaddan Koobka Adduunka 2026, isagoo sheegay inay doonayaan inay koobka u qaadaan Cristiano Ronaldo.
Ronaldo, oo hadda 41 jir ah kuna sugan kooxda Al-Nassr, ayaa la filayaa inuu tartankan xagaaga ka dhici doona qaaradda Waqooyiga Ameerika ku sagootiyo waayihiisa ciyaareed ee caalamiga ah. In kasta oo uu Ronaldo ku guuleystay koobab fara badan oo uu ku jiro Euro 2016, haddana waxaa weli ka maqan Koobka Adduunka oo ah kan ugu qiimaha badan.
Portugal ayaa lagu daray Group K, halkaas oo ay kula tartami doonaan xulalka DR Congo, Uzbekistan, iyo Colombia. Taageerayaasha kubadda cagta ayaa isha ku haya sida uu xulkan u mari doono wareegyada hore.
Fernandes oo wareysi siiyay BBC ayaa yiri: “Inuu waayihiisa kusoo af-jaro ku guuleysiga Koobkan Adduunka waxay noqon lahayd wax cajiib ah. Runtii waxaan rajeynayaa inaan taas ka dhigi karno mid dhacda… kaliya ma ahan Portugal darteed, balse wax kasta oo Cristiano uu siiyay kubadda cagta iyo dunidaba.”
Hadalkan ayaa imaanaya xilli ciyaartoyda Portugal ay u muuqdaan kuwo midaysan oo doonaya inay maamuus weyn ku sagootiyaan mid ka mid ah ciyaartoyda ugu fiican taariikhda kubadda cagta.

headline: Liverpool Oo War Xun Ka Heshay Dhaawaca Salah
body:
Warka ku saabsan dhaawaca Mohamed Salah ayaa noqday mid naxdin leh, iyadoo la xaqiijiyay inuu seegi doono inta ka dhiman xilli-ciyaareedka ka dib markii uu muruqa dillaacay intii ay socotay ciyaartii Liverpool 3-1 uga badisay Crystal Palace. Xiddigan garabka ka ciyaara ayaa garoonka ka baxay daqiiqadii 60-aad isagoo u sacabinaya taageerayaasha.
Ibrahim Hassan oo ah agaasimaha xulka qaranka Masar ayaa xaqiijiyay in Salah uu garoomada ka maqnaan doono muddo afar toddobaad ah. Maaddaama uu Salah hore u shaaciyay inuu ka tegayo kooxda dhammaadka xilli-ciyaareedkan, tani waxay ka dhigan tahay inuusan mar dambe xiran doonin maaliyadda Liverpool kulan rasmi ah.
In kasta oo Liverpool aysan weli soo saarin bayaan rasmi ah, macasalaamaynta Salah ee Anfield waxay dhici doontaa kulanka u dambeeya ee Brentford 24-ka May, balse wuxuu kaga qayb geli doonaa hadal ee ma noqon doonto ciyaar.
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Hassan ayaa xaqiijiyay in Salah uu taam u noqon doono koobka adduunka (World Cup 2026), halkaas oo xulka Masar ay ku jiraan Group G iyagoo la ciyaari doona Belgium, New Zealand, iyo Iran. Tartanka ayaa bilaaban doona 11-ka June, waxaana lagu qaban doonaa Mareykanka, Mexico, iyo Canada.
Salah ayaa soo afjaraya xilligiisii Liverpool isagoo ah ciyaaryahanka saddexaad ee ugu goolasha badan taariikhda kooxda, isagoo xilli-ciyaareedkan oo qura gacan ka geystay 12 gool iyo 9 caawin dhammaan tartammada.

headline: Ronald Araujo Oo Go’aan Lama Filaan Ah Ka Soo Saaray Mustaqbalkiisa Barcelona
body:
Kabtanka kooxda Barcelona, Ronald Araujo, ayaan wax niyad ah u hayn inuu ka tago kooxda xagaagan, in kasta oo uu jiro hubanti la’aan dhanka booskiisa ah iyo tartanka adag ee ka dhex jira kooxda uu hoggaamiyo tababare Hansi Flick.
Xilli ay Barcelona ku dhow dahay inay xaqiijisato horyaalka La Liga, haddana waxaa durba bilaabatay qorshaynta xilli-ciyaareedka dambe ka dib markii ay kooxdu ku fashilantay tartammada Copa del Rey iyo Champions League.
Sida ay werisay jariidada SPORT, Araujo ayaa wali si buuxda ay ugu go’an tahay inuu kasii mid ahaado mashruuca kooxda, isagoo aaminsan inuu dib u soo ceshan karo booskiisii muhiimka ahaa ee safka hore.
Difaaca u dhashay dalka Uruguay ayaa xilli-ciyaareedkan kursiga kaydka uga jira ciyaartoyda kala ah Eric García iyo Gerard Martín, balse wuxuu u arkaa Koobka Adduunka ee soo socda fursad weyn oo uu dib ugu soo celin karo kalsoonidiisa heer caalami iyo heer kooxeedba.
Xilli-ciyaareedkan, 27-jirkan ayaa ku soo bilowday 10 kulan oo qura horyaalka, isagoo dhaliyay saddex gool. In kasta oo ay yaraatay daqiiqadaha uu ciyaarayo, haddana maskaxda Araujo waxay diiradda ku haysaa sidii uu u soo kabsan lahaa intii uu ka fikiri lahaa bixitaan, iyadoo mustaqbalkiisa fog la filayo in dib loo qiimeeyo ka dib xilliga Koobka Adduunka.

headline: Steven Gerrard Oo Magacaabay Xiddiga Uu Jecel Yahay In Dib Loogu Soo Celiyo Liverpool
body:
Steven Gerrard ayaa si furan uga hadlay xiddigii hore ee garabka uga ciyaari jiray Liverpool, Luis Diaz, isagoo muujiyay sida uu u jecel yahay inuu arko isagoo dib u xiran maaliyadda kooxda.
Gerrard oo la hadlayay TNT Sports ayaa sharraxay dhibaatada ay wajahaan daafacyada marka ay ka hor imaadaan Diaz, isagoo yiri: “Markaad tahay daafaca garabka ee aad ka hor tagayso ciyaaryahan garabka ka ciyaara, caadiyan waxay leeyihiin dhinac daciif ah, laakiin dhibaatada isaga haysata waxay tahay inuu labada dhinacba u ordi karo, lugtiisa midig iyo tan bidixna ay isku mid yihiin.”
Wuxuu intaas ku daray in Diaz uu yahay khatar weyn haddii looga hor imaado xaalad fool-ka-fool ah, maaddaama uu leeyahay farsamooyin iyo caawin heer sare ah.
Markii la weydiiyay haddii ay macquul tahay in Michael Olise uu yimaado Liverpool, Gerrard ayaa ku jawaabay inay taasi tahay mid uu aad u soo dhoweynayo, balse wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay inay adag tahay inuu ka soo tago kooxda Bayern Munich oo hadda aad u xooggan.
“Wuxuu u muuqdaa wiil aad u faraxsan oo deggan, uma malaynayo inuu meel u socdo. Laakiin, haa, aad ayaan u jeclaan lahaa inuu yimaado Liverpool. Sidoo kale, wax dhib ah uma arko inuu Luis Diaz dib u soo laabto. Aad ayaan ugu xiisay isaga,” ayuu hadalkiisa ku soo xiray halyeeyga Liverpool.

headline: Mikel Arteta Oo Magacaabay Maskaxda Ka Dambeysa Guushii Kooxdiisa Ay Ka Gaartay Newcastle
body:
Mikel Arteta ayaa kadib guushii ay Arsenal ka gaartay Newcastle, amaan ballaaran u jeediyay shaqaalihiisa tababarka, gaar ahaan tababaraha ku takhasusay kubadaha istaagga (set-piece coach) Nico Jover, isagoo ku bogaadiyay diyaarinta ciyaartoyda iyo sida ay ciyaartoydu qorshaha u fuliyaan.
Arteta ayaa rajo weyn ka qaba in qaab ciyaareedkan oo kale ay sii wadi doonaan marka ay Arsenal wajahdo Atletico Madrid maalinta Talaadada ah, xilli ay socdaan kulammada go’aaminaya xilli-ciyaareedka.
“Tani waa dadaalka Nico iyo shaqaalaha oo bixiyay dedaal, dardar iyo xirfad badan. Ciyaartoydu waxay rumeysan yihiin inaan wax kasta ku beddeli karno fursadahaas, tayadii aan soo bandhignayna waxay ahayd mid aad u wanaagsan,” ayuu yiri Arteta.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray: “Waxaan ku faraxsanahay inaan safar qurux badan ku tagno Madrid si aan u ciyaarno semi-finalka Champions League. Tani mar walba ma dhacdo, markaas waa inaan soo kabsannaa, waxaana bilaabaynaa inaan hadda diiradda saarno kulanka Atletico si aan guul u raadinno.”

headline: Jamie Redknapp Oo Sharaxay Caqabadda Kaliya Ee Arsenal Ka Hor Taagan Inay Ku Guuleysato Horyaalka Waqti Hore Kadib Guushii Newcastle
body:
Xiddigii hore ee khadka dhexe ee kooxda Liverpool, Jamie Redknapp, ayaa ka hadlay culayska ay wajahayso kooxda Arsenal ee tartanka loogu jiro horyaalka Premier League.
“Waxaad naftaada u sheegi kartaa intaad doonto in cadaadisku yahay fursad qaali ah, balse xaqiiqadu waxay tahay marka aad garoonka ku jirto, mararka qaar cabsidu way ku merjin kartaa. Waxay kugu noqon kartaa mid ku hareeraysa, wax kasta oo fudud oo aad samaynaysay tan iyo markii aad 10 ama 11 sano jirka ahayd ayaana si lama filaan ah u noqda kuwo aad u adag. Taasina waa waxa hadda ku dhacaya Arsenal,” ayuu yiri Redknapp.
Redknapp ayaa tilmaamay in khaladaadka shaqsiga ah iyo luminta baasaska muhiimka ah ay yihiin calaamadaha muujinaya sida cadaadisku u saameeyay ciyaartoyda. Waxa uu intaas ku daray in xaaladaha noocaas ah looga baxo oo qura xirfad gaar ah: “Taas ayaa ka dhigtay daqiiqadihii cajiibka ahaa kuwo aad muhiim u ah. Tayada dhabta ah ee uu muujiyay Eze (oo dhaliyay goolka qura ee ciyaartii Newcastle), ayaa noqotay midda go’aamisay natiijada, waxayna ahayd xilli dhab ahaan cajiib ah.”
In kasta oo ay Arsenal guul gaartay, Redknapp waxa uu aaminsan yahay in dareenka cabsida iyo cadaadiska uu weli yahay caqabad weyn oo hor taagan hammigooda horyaalka.

headline: Man City Mise Arsenal? Alan Shearer Oo Saadaaliyay Kooxda Ku Guuleysaneysa Premier League Xilli Ciyaareed Kaan
body:
Xiddigii hore ee kooxda Newcastle United, Alan Shearer, ayaa weli aaminsan in Arsenal ay ku guuleysan doonto horyaalka Premier League, ka dib markii ay 1-0 kaga badiyeen kooxdiisii hore maalintii Sabtida.
Goolka qura ee Eberechi Eze uu dhaliyay qaybtii hore ee ciyaarta ayaa ka caawiyay Gunners inay saddex dhibcood ka sare maraan Manchester City, inkastoo City ay u dhiman tahay hal kulan oo baaqi ah. Shearer ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay in loolanka horyaalka uusan weli dhammaan.
“Waxaan idiin sheegayaa, weli waxaan rumeysanahay in Arsenal ay ku guuleysan karto horyaalka Premier League,” ayuu Shearer u sheegay barnaamijka Match of the Day. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in qof kasta oo u malaynaya in tartanku dhammaaday ka dib wixii ka dhacay garoonka Etihad (guuldarradii Arsenal ee City) uu qalad weyn sameynayo.
Shearer ayaa si gaar ah u ammaanay dabeecadda iyo maskaxda ciyaartoyda Arsenal: “Waxa sida ugu weyn ii cajabiyay waa Arsenal lafteeda. Dadka qaar ayaa su’aal ka keenay maskaxdooda, iyagoo leh cadaadiska ayaa saameeyay, laakiin waxay u jawaabeen sida ay u jawaabaan kooxaha u tartamaya horyaalka. Tamarta, xoogga iyo gaajada ay u qabaan guusha, dhammaan halkaasay yaalleen.”
Sida uu qabo Shearer, qaab ciyaareedkii ay Arsenal ku muujisay Emirates Stadium wuxuu caddeyn u yahay inay maskax ahaan u diyaarsan yihiin inay horyaalka hantiyaan ilaa daqiiqadda ugu dambeysa.

headline: Arsenal Oo Dhigtay Labo Rikoodh Oo Cusub Kulankii Newcastle
body:
Kooxda Arsenal ayaa dhigtay laba rikoor oo cusub kadib guushii 1-0 ahayd ee ay ka gaartay Newcastle United kulankii Premier League-ga ee ka dhacay Emirates Stadium.
Goolka qura ee ciyaarta oo uu saxiixay Eberechi Eze ayaa ka caawiyay kooxda Mikel Arteta inay la wareegto hoggaanka horyaalka, iyagoo hadda 3 dhibcood ka sarreeya Manchester City, inkastoo City ay u dhiman tahay hal kulan oo baaqi ah.
Kooxda Pep Guardiola ayaan ciyaarin Premier League toddobaadkan maaddaama ay ku mashquulsanaayeen semi-finalka FA Cup-ka oo ay kaga adkaadeen Southampton.
Sida ay werisay shabakadda xogta ee OptaJoe, goolkii Eze ayaa ka dhigay in Arsenal ay hadda haysato laba rikoor oo dhanka kubadaha geesaha hal xilli-ciyaareed gudihii;
Goolasha ugu badan ee laga dhaliyo kubadaha geesaha: Waxay xilli-ciyaareedkan kubadaha istaagga(set pieces) ku dhaliyeen 17 gool.
Goolasha ka imaada kubadaha istaagga ee looga hormaro kooxaha kale (1-0): Waxay kubadaha noicaad ku dhaliyeen goolka koowaad ee ciyaarta 10 jeer.
Arsenal ayaa hadda diiradda u wareejin doonta tartanka Champions League, halkaas oo ay habeenka Arbacada ah wajihi doonaan kooxda Atletico Madrid wareegga semi-finalka ee tartanka.

headline: Miyuu Nicolas Jackson Dib Ugu Soo Laabanayaa Chelsea Kadib Dhammaadka Heshiiskiisa Bayern?
body:
Suxufiga caanka ah ee Fabrizio Romano ayaa xaqiijiyay in weeraryahanka Chelsea ee amaahda ku maqan, Nicolas Jackson, uu dib ugu soo laaban doono kooxda xagaagan ka dib markii uu soo dhammaaystay amaahdii uu ku joogay Bayern Munich.
“Nicolas Jackson wuxuu dib ugu soo laaban doonaa Chelsea bisha June maadaama Bayern aysan isticmaali doonin qodobka dhigaya inay ku iibsan karaan €65 milyan,” ayuu Romano ku qoray bartiisa Twitter-ka.
Agaasimaha kooxda Bayern Munich, Max Eberl, ayaa u xaqiijiyay go’aankan telefishinka ZDF, isagoo xusay in qorshahoodu uu sidaas ahaa tan iyo bishii Janaayo.
Maamulka Chelsea iyo wakiillada ciyaaryahanka ayaa hadda u fariisan doona sidii ay uga tashan lahaayeen mustaqbalka Jackson, iyadoo ay macquul tahay in xagaaga soo socda uu markale koox kale u wareego.

headline: Gary Neville Oo Farta Ku Fiiqay Hal Wax Oo Ay Arsenal Kaga Liidato Manchester City Kadib Kulankii Newcastle
body:
Difaacii hore ee kooxda Manchester United, Gary Neville, ayaa aaminsan in Manchester City ay weli haysato fursad ka wanaagsan tan Arsenal ee ku guuleysiga horyaalka Premier League, isagoo sabab uga dhigay tayada weerarka ee kooxda Pep Guardiola.
“Kubadaha istaagga (set pieces) waa qayb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah ciyaarta Arsenal, waana sidii ay guusha ku gaareen kulankii Newcastle. Arsenal waxay taqaan sida looga badbaado goolal, laakiin City ayaa kaga horreysa dhanka weerarka iyo qaabka ay goolasha u dhaliyaan,” ayuu yiri Neville.
Neville ayaa intaas ku daray in Arsenal looga baahan yahay inay guuleysato kulan kasta oo u dhiman haddii ay rabaan horyaalka: “Difaacoodu waa mid cajiib ah, laakiin waxaad sidoo kale u baahan tahay goolal badan.”
Kadib 34 kulan oo ay ciyaartay, Arsenal ayaa hoggaaminaysa horyaalka iyadoo 3 dhibcood ka sarreysa Manchester City, inkastoo City ay heysato hal kulan oo baaqi ah.

headline: Ruud Gullit Oo Shaaciyay Labada Xul Ee Ugu Cadcad Ku Guuleysiga Koobka Adduunka Sanad Kaan
body:
Xiddigii hore ee kooxaha Chelsea iyo AC Milan, Ruud Gullit, ayaa magacaabay labada xul ee uu u arko inay ugu cadcad yihiin ku guuleysiga koobka adduunka ee FIFA World Cup 2026.
Tartanka sannadkan ayaa markii ugu horreysay ka dhici doona saddex waddan oo kala ah Mareykanka, Mexico, iyo Canada, waxaana ku tartami doona 48 xul oo u dagaallami doona koobka ugu qabsan kubadda cagta inta lagu jiro xagaaga.
Isagoo la hadlayay majaladda Diario AS, Gullit ayaa tilmaamay in xulalka Spain iyo France ay yihiin kuwa ugu xooggan tartanka, inkastoo uu rajo ka muujiyay in dalkiisa hooyo ee Netherlands uu ku guuleysto tartanka.
“Spain iyo France ayaan u arkaa kuwa ugu awoodda badan,” ayuu yiri Gullit. “Waxaan dabcan rajeynayaa inay Netherlands ku guuleysato.”
Xulka Argentina ayaa hadda ah xulka difaacanaya koobka, ka dib markii ay afar sano ka hor ku guuleysteen tartankii ka dhacay dalka Qatar.

headline: Pep Guardiola Oo Farta Ku Fiiqay Labada Xiddig Ee Kooxdiisa U Suurtageliyay Inay Gaarto Finalka FA Cup-ka
body:
Macallinka kooxda Manchester City, Pep Guardiola, ayaa farta ku fiiqay laba ciyaaryahan oo qayb ka qaatay guushii ay kooxdiisu ka gaartay Southampton kulankii semi-finalka FA Cup-ka ee dhacay maalintii Sabtida.
Guardiola ayaa daawaday kooxdiisa oo guul 2-1 ah ku gaareysa garoonka Wembley, ka dib markii qaybtii dambe ee ciyaarta ay goolal u dhaliyeen Jeremy Doku iyo Nico Gonzalez.
Isagoo hadlay wareysiga ciyaarta ka dib, Guardiola ayaa ammaan u jeediyay Jeremy Doku iyo Savinho, isagoo sheegay inay kooxda siiyeen “tamar” cusub oo ka caawisay inay ka guuleystaan Southampton qaybtii dambe ee tartanka.
“Waxay ahaayeen 19 kulan oo aan laga badin, markaas marnaba uma malaynayn inay fududaan doonto,” ayuu yiri Guardiola.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray: “Tamartii aan ka helnay Jeremy iyo Savinho qaybtii dambe [ayaa na caawisay], laakiin haddii ay ciyaarta ku bilaaban lahaayeen markii hore, ma ayan heli laheen tamartan oo kale.”
Manchester City ayaa hadda u gudubtay finalka FA Cup-ka, halkaas oo ay ku sugayso kooxda soo baxda kulanka dhexmaraya Chelsea iyo Leeds United.

headline: Wayne Rooney Oo Magacaabay Xiddiga Uu Aaminsan Yahay Inuu Ku Guuleysanayo Abaalmarinta Xiddiga Sanadka Ee Premier League-ga
body:
Wayne Rooney ayaa dood ka dhaliyay barnaamijkiisa BBC-da ee “The Wayne Rooney Show”, isagoo sheegay in kabtanka Manchester United, Bruno Fernandes, uu mudan yahay in la guddoonsiiyo abaalmarinta xiddiga ugu fiican horyaalka Premier League ee xilli-ciyaareedkan (Player of the Year).
“Waxaan qabaa in sanadkan aad adigu ku guuleysan doonto. Waxa aad kooxda ku soo kordhiso, gaar ahaan marka ay kooxdu ku jirto xilli adag, mar walba halkaas ayaad joogtaa, si joogto ah ayaadna u hoggaamisaa kooxda” ayuu Rooney u sheegay Bruno. Rooney ayaa intaas ku daray in Bruno uu yahay tusaalaha ugu habboon ee ay saaxiibbadiis raaci karaan.
Bruno Fernandes ayaa xilli-ciyaareedkan horyaalka Premier League ka sameeyay 18 caawin (assists). Waxaa hadda u dhiman shan kulan oo qura, isagoo hiigsanaya inuu jebiyo rikoorka caawinta ee horyaalka oo ah 20, kaas oo ay hore u dhigeen Thierry Henry iyo Kevin De Bruyne.
Haddii uu Bruno sii wado qaab ciyaareedkan, wuxuu fursad u haystaa inuu taariikh cusub ka dhigo horyaalka Ingiriiska, isagoo dhanka kale horseed u ah dadaalka ay United ugu jirto inay xaqiijisato booskeeda Champions League.

headline: Manchester City Oo Sameysay Taariikh Kadib Guushii Southampton
body:
Kooxda Manchester City ayaa dhigtay taariikh cusub ka dib markii ay guul 2-1 ah ka gaartay kooxda Southampton kulankii semi-finalka FA Cup-ka ee ka dhacay garoonka Wembley.
Qaybtii hore ee ciyaarta ayaa ku dhammaatay gool la’aan, balse Southampton ayaa markii hore hoggaanka ku qabatay gool uu dhaliyay Finn Azaz daqiiqadii 79-aad. Manchester City ayaa si degdeg ah uga soo kabsatay, iyadoo goolal ay u dhaliyeen Jeremy Doku iyo Nicolas Gonzalez ay xaqiijiyeen guusha wiilasha Pep Guardiola.
Sida ay werisay shabakadda xogta ururisa ee OptaJoe, guushan ayaa ka dhigan in Manchester City ay noqotay kooxdii ugu horreysay ee taariikhda tartankan gaarta afar final oo FA Cup ah oo isku xiga.
Manchester City ayaa hadda sugaysa kooxda ay isku wajihi doonaan finalka, taas oo ka soo bixi doonta kulanka dhexmaraya Chelsea iyo Leeds United oo maanta oo Axad ah dhacaya.

headline: Muxuu Arteta Ka Yiri Guushii Dirqiga Ahayd Ay Kooxdiisa Ka Gaartay Newcastle?
body:
Mikel Arteta ayaa Sky Sports la wadaagay dareenkiisa ka dib guushii ay Arsenal 1-0 kaga gaartay Newcastle, isagoo carrabka ku adkeeyay in kooxda martida u ahayd ay isbeddelo badan samaysay si ay cadaadiska ugu sii hayso.
“Newcastle waxay sameeyeen shan beddel, laakiin waxay u muuqdeen inay toban beddel sameeyeen! Mar walba ciyaartoy cusub ayay soo gelinayeen,” ayuu yiri Arteta. Isagoo hadalkiisa sii wata, wuxuu xusay in kooxdiisu ay u baahnayd guushan, inkastoo farqiga dhibcaha iyo natiijada uu ahaa mid aad u yar.
Tababaraha Arsenal ayaa ammaanay dhabar-adayga iyo hab-difaaca ciyaartoydiisa, balse wuxuu qiray inay jiraan waxyaabo ay tahay inay horumariyaan, gaar ahaan marka ay kubadda haystaan iyo sida ay u soo afjarayaan weerarada qeybta dambe ee garoonka.
“Waxaa jira caadooyin ay tahay inaynu si fiican u qabano haddii aynu rabno inaynu ciyaarta si buuxda u maamusho. Meelo badan, gaar ahaan sida aynu u dhammaystiri weyno ficillada marka aynu gaarno boosaska muhiimka ah, waa inaan wax ka beddelnaa,” ayuu raaciyay Arteta.
Guushan ayaa u oggolaatay Arsenal inay dib ugu soo laabato hoggaanka horyaalka Premier League, xilli kooxda ay loolanka kula jiraan ee Manchester City ay toddobaadkan ku mashquulsanayd tartanka FA Cup-ka.

headline: Arsenal Oo Garaacday Newcastle, Dibna Ula Wareegtay Hoggaanka Horyaalka
body:
Kooxda Arsenal ayaa dib u la wareegtay hoggaanka horyaalka Premier League ka dib guul ay si adag uga gaartay Newcastle United, taas oo qayb ka ahayd wareegga 34-aad ee horyaalka, iyadoo ciyaartu ka dhacday garoonka Emirates Stadium.
Goolka qura ee ciyaarta lagu kala baxay waxaa dhaliyay xiddiga Eberechi Eze, ka dib markii la soo laaday kooner dhulka ah oo uu helay Kai Havertz, kaas oo markaas kubadda u gudbiyay Eze. Eze ayaa darbo aad u qurux badan ka soo tuuray geeska xerada ganaaxa, isagoo kubadda dhex dhigay shabaqa Newcastle.
Guushan muhiimka ah ka dib, Arsenal waxay dhibcaheeda kor ugu qaadday 73 dhibcood, iyadoo fadhida booska koowaad ee Premier League. Dhanka kale, Newcastle United ayaa wali ku jirta kaalinta 14-aad iyadoo leh 42 dhibcood.
Manchester City ayaa hadda u dhacday kaalinta labaad iyadoo leh 70 dhibcood, balse waxaa xusid mudan inay u dhiman tahay hal kulan oo baaqi u ah oo ay la ciyaari doonaan kooxda Crystal Palace.

headline: Manchester United Oo Atletico Madrid Ka Af-duubaneysa Xiddig Ay Horay Heshiis Ula Gaartay
body:
Kooxda Manchester United ayaa ku soo biirtay tartanka loogu jiro saxiixa xiddiga khadka dhexe ee kooxda Atalanta, Ederson, in kasta oo xiddiga reer Brazil uu horay heshiis shaqsi ah ula gaaray kooxda Atletico Madrid.
Sida uu sheegay suxufiga weyn Nicolo Schira, Ederson ayaa Atletico la galay heshiis soconaya ilaa sanadka 2031-ka, kaas oo uu sanadkii ku qaadanayo mushahar dhan €4.5 milyan. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Atletico Madrid ayaan wali heshiis rasmi ah la gaarin kooxda Atalanta, taas oo ka dhigan in suuqu uu wali furan yahay.
Manchester United ayaa si dhow u la socota xaaladda wiilkan, waxayna qorsheynaysaa inay ka faa’iideysato dib-u-dhaca ku yimid heshiiska labada kooxood si ay ugu dhaqaaqdo saxiixa xiddigan lagu qiimeeyo khadka dhexe xagaaga soo socda.

headline: Sababta Rasmiga Ah Ee Uu Rayan Cherki Isaga Diiday Inuu Ku Biiro Chelsea Oo Bannaanka Loo Soo Saaray
body:
Xiddigii hore ee akadeemiyada Chelsea, haddana u ciyaara kooxda Charlton Athletic, Miles Leaburn, ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in Rayan Cherki oo xagaagan ku biiray Manchester City uu horay u diiday inuu ku biiro Chelsea.
Cherki oo 22 jir ah, ayaa qabsaday indhaha taageerayaasha iyo falanqeeyayaasha tan iyo markii uu ka soo tagay kooxdiisii carruurnimada ee Olympique Lyonnais, isagoo ugu biiray City heshiis gaaraya £34 milyan. Xiddigan ayaa xilli-ciyaareedkan soo bandhigay wacdaro isagoo dhaliyay 11 gool, halka uu sameeyay 14 caawin 49 kulan oo uu saftay, wuxuuna kooxdiisa la qaaday koobka EFL Cup.
Sida uu sheegay Leaburn, Cherki ayaa iska diiday fursad uu ugu biiri lahaa akadeemiyada Chelsea isagoo 12 jir ah sanadkii 2015. Leaburn oo xasuusanaya waqtigii uu Cherki kula qaatay tababarka Cobham ayaa u sheegay joornaalka The Sun:
“Wuxuu ka yimid Faransiiska, tababarkana wuxuu ku samaynayay xirfado layaab leh. Waxaan is lahaa, ‘Ilaahow, kani waa wax aan la rumeysan karin’. Wuxuu si dhab ah u diiday fursadda uu ugu ciyaari lahaa Chelsea sababtoo ah waxay u muuqatay mid isaga aan u qalmin. Qof kasta wuu ka sarreeyay… xirfadiisu waxay ahayd mid dhammaystiran.”
Cherki oo kulankiisii ugu horreeyay ee weyn u saftay Lyon isagoo 16 jir ah bishii October 2019, ayaa sidoo kale waxaa eryanaysay kooxda Manchester United sida ay werisay talkSPORT. Isaga ayaa se iska diiday dalabkii Red Devils horraantii 2019, maadaama uu doonayay inuu waayihiisa ciyaareed ka bilaabo kooxda Lyon.
Xiddigan hibada leh ee ku ciyaara labada lugood ayaa la filayaa inuu markale u safto Manchester City kulanka semi-finalka FA Cup ee ay maanta la leeyihiin kooxda Southampton.

headline: Saadaasha Khabiirka BBC Ee Kulamada FA Cup Ee Todobaadkan
body:
Xiddigii hore ee kooxda Chelsea, Chris Sutton, ayaa bixiyay saadaashiisa ku aadan kulammada semi-finalka ee tartanka FA Cup-ka ee ka dhacaya garoonka Wembley.
Manchester City ayaa galabta wajahaysa kooxda Southampton, halka Chelsea ay maalinta Axadda ah la ciyaari doonto kooxda Leeds United, si loogu tartamo boosaska finalka tartankan.
Sutton ayaa aaminsan in Manchester City ay si fudud ku dhaafi doonto Southampton, haddii ay ka faa’iideystaan fursadaha ay helaan. Wuxuu saadaaliyay inay wiilasha Pep Guardiola ku guuleysan doonaan “3-0”, isagoo xusay inuusan filaynin wax natiijo ah oo ka baxsan guusha City.
Dhanka kale, Sutton ayaa saadaal lama filaan ah ka bixiyay kulanka dhexmaraya Chelsea iyo Leeds United. Wuxuu taageero u muujiyay kooxda Daniel Farke in ay garaacdo Chelsea, isagoo u sheegay BBC Sport: “Waxaan qabaa in Leeds United ay Chelsea ku garaaci doonto Wembley. Chelsea 1-2 Leeds United.”

headline: Real Madrid Oo Gacanta Ku Dhigtay Tababaraha Beddelaya Alvaro Arbeloa
body:
Wararka ka imaanaya gudaha kooxda Real Madrid ayaa muujinaya in maamulka kooxdu ay indhaha ku hayaan tababare khibrad weyn u leh fagaarayaasha Yurub, iyadoo mar kale uu soo cusboonaaday xiisaha loo qabo macallin aad looga qadariyo garoonka Santiago Bernabéu.
Real Madrid ayaa muujinaysa xiiso xooggan oo ay ku doonayso saxiixa tababaraha kooxda AC Milan, Massimiliano Allegri. Sida uu baahiyay suxufi Ramon Alvarez oo ka tirsan Radio Marca, madaxweyne Florentino Perez ayaa aad ula dhacsan tayada farsamo iyo shaqsiyadda uu leeyahay macallinka reer Talyaani.
Perez ayaa aaminsan in Allegri uu yahay tababare aan caadi ahayn, kaas oo leh saameyn xooggan oo uu ku maamuli karo qolka labiska iyo xiddigaha waaweyn ee kooxda, isagoo u arka qofka ugu habboon ee xamili kara cadaadiska saaran kooxda boqortooyada.
Wararka ayaa tilmaamaya inay tani noqon karto isku daygii saddexaad oo ay Real Madrid ku doonayso Allegri, ka dib markii ay labo jeer oo hore (2019 iyo 2021) ku dhowaadeen inay heshiis la galaan. In kasta oo magacyo kale sida Jürgen Klopp, Mauricio Pochettino, iyo Didier Deschamps ay miiska saaran yihiin, haddana khibradda Allegri ayaa u muuqata mid Perez uu aad u soo dhoweynayo si uu u hoggaamiyo mashruuca fog ee kooxda.
Dhanka kale, qandaraaska Allegri ee kooxda Milan ayaa ku eg June 2027, waxaana la sheegay inuu ku faraxsan yahay nolosha magaalada Milano iyo jawiga kooxdiisa hadda, taas oo caqabad ku noqon karta damaca Madrid.
Xaaladda Real Madrid ayaa hadda ah mid kacsan ka dib markii Bayern Munich ay kaga soo reebtay tartanka Champions League wareegga siddeed dhammaadka (6-4 dhibic dhibic), halka horyaalka La Liga ay ku jiraan kaalinta labaad iyagoo leh 74 dhibcood, xilli kooxda ay hadda u muuqato mid u baahan isbeddel dhanka hoggaanka farsamada ah.

headline: Saadaasha Khabiirka BBC Ee Kulamada Premier League Ee Todobaadkan
body:
Xiddigii hore ee kooxda Chelsea, Chris Sutton, ayaa bixiyay saadaashiisa ku aadan kulammada toddobaadka 34-aad ee horyaalka Premier League, isagoo si gaar ah diiradda u saaray kulanka xamaasadda leh ee dhexmaraya Arsenal iyo Newcastle United.
Sutton ayaa aaminsan in Gunners ay guul muhiim ah ka gaari doonto Newcastle, taas oo ka caawin karta inay dib ugu soo laabtaan hoggaanka horyaalka. Sidoo kale, wuxuu saadaaliyay in Liverpool ay Anfield guul kaga gaari doonto Crystal Palace, halka uu qabo in Manchester United ay barbaro la geli doonto kooxda Brentford kulanka Isniinta.
Halkan kaga bogo saadaasha Chris Sutton ee uu siiyay BBC Sport:
Liverpool 2-1 Crystal Palace
West Ham 1-1 Everton
Wolves 0-1 Tottenham
Arsenal 2-0 Newcastle United
Man United 1-1 Brentford
Haddii Arsenal ay caawa ka badiso Newcastle, waxay si ku-meel-gaar ah ula wareegi doonaan hoggaanka horyaalka Premier League, iyagoo dhaafi doona Manchester City oo hadda booska koowaad ku haysa goolal badan oo ay dhalisay.

headline: Arsenal Oo Fursad Dahabi Ah Haysata – Miyay Ku Soo Laaban Doontaa Hoggaanka Horyaalka?
body:
Saaxadda ayaa hadda diyaar u ah kulanka ugu weyn horyaalka Premier League, marka ay kooxda Arsenal garoonkeeda Emirates Stadium ku soo dhoweyneyso Newcastle United fiidnimada Sabtida.
Labada kooxoodba waxay kulankan soo gelayaan iyagoo dhibco soo lumiyay kulammadoodii ugu dambeeyay ee horyaalka; Arsenal ayaa 2-1 guuldarro ah kala soo kulantay Manchester City, halka Newcastle ay isla natiijadaas 2-1 ah oo guuldarro ah kagala kulantay kooxda Bournemouth. Markii ugu dambeysay ee ay labadan kooxood ku kulmeen garoonka St. James’ Park bishii September, Gunners ayaa ku soo badisay 2-1.
Arsenal ayaa hadda ku jirta kaalinta labaad ee kala sarreynta horyaalka, waxayna fursad u haysataa inay hoggaanka ka la wareegto Man City haddii ay ka badiso Newcastle, oo iyadu ku jirta kaalinta 14-aad.
Macallinka Arsenal, Mikel Arteta, ayaa xaqiijiyay in Bukayo Saka uu ku soo laaban doono kooxda ka dib markii uu ka soo kabsaday dhaawac dhanka canqowga ah oo uu ku maqnaa shan kulan, halka Riccardo Calafiori isna la filayo inuu taam u noqdo ciyaartan.
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Gunners waxaa ka maqnaan doona Jurrien Timber oo weli ka kabsanaya dhaawac gumaarka ah iyo Mikel Merino oo muddo dheer ku maqnaa dhaawac cagta ah.
Dhinaca kale, macallinka Newcastle, Eddie Howe, ayaa wajahaya dhibaatooyin dhaawac oo dhanka xiddigaha muhiimka ah; Anthony Gordon ayaa ku maqnaan doona dhaawac sinta ah, halka Tino Livramento laga cabsi qabo inuu xilli-ciyaareedku u dhammaaday ka dib dhaawac muruqa ah oo soo gaaray toddobaadkii hore.
Joelinton ayaa isna ganaax ku maqan ka dib markii uu qaatay kaarkii 10-aad ee digniinta ah, halka Fabian Schar iyo Emil Krafth ay weli ku maqan yihiin dhaawacyo jilibka ah oo muddo dheer ah. Warka wanaagsan ee Newcastle ayaa ah in kabtanka kooxda, Bruno Guimaraes, uu si buuxda u tababartay toddobaadkan, uuna diyaar u yahay inuu hoggaamiyo khadka dhexe.

headline: Bruno Fernandes Oo Ugu Dambeyn Caddeeyay Hadafkiisa Ugu Weyn Ee Manchester United
body:
Kabtanka kooxda Manchester United, Bruno Fernandes, ayaa muujiyay inuusan wali ku qanacsanayn waxyaabihii uu ilaa hadda la gaaray kooxda, isagoo ku hammiyaya inuu ku guuleysto koobabka ugu waaweyn ee kubadda cagta.
“Waxaan rabaa inaan ku guuleysto Premier League,” ayuu kabtanku u sheegay barnaamijka The Wayne Rooney Show ee ka baxa BBC-da. “Waxaan rabaa inaan ku guuleysto Champions League. Marnaba taas kama dhuunto.”
Muddo lix sano iyo bar ah oo uu joogay garoonka Old Trafford, Bruno wuxuu ilaa hadda ku guuleystay oo qura koobabka FA Cup iyo Carabao Cup.
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxaa loo malaynayaa inuu heli doono fursad uu markale kaga soo muuqdo tartanka Champions League xilli-ciyaareedka dambe, ka dib markii uu tartankaas ka maqnaa dhowr sano intii uu u ciyaarayay kooxda, maadaama Manchester United ay hadda u dhowdahay inay xaqiijisato booskeeda tartankaas.

headline: Arne Slot Oo U Hanjabay Crystal Palace Ka Hor Kulanka Maanta
body:
Kooxda Crystal Palace ayaa qarka u saaran inay taariikh cusub dhigto haddii ay garaacaan Liverpool, iyagoo noqon kara kooxdii ugu horreysay ee afar jeer xilli-ciyaareed qura ka badisa Reds, ka dib markii ay hore ugu soo adkaadeen tartammada Community Shield, League Cup iyo kulankoodii horyaalka ee ka dhacay Selhurst Park.
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Arne Slot ayaa aaminsan in guushii xamaasadda lahayd ee ay toddobaadkii hore ka gaareen kooxda Everton ay firfirconi cusub geliyeen xididdada Liverpool.
“Waxaan dareennay niyad-wanaag ku xeeran kooxda toddobaadkan. Ma dhihi karo waa markii ugu horreysay xilli-ciyaareedkan, laakiin uma aysan dhicin marar badan sidii aan rajeynaynay,” ayuu yiri Slot.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray inay muhiim tahay in dardartaas loo wareejiyo kulanka Crystal Palace, isagoo yiri: “Waa inaad keentaa niyad-wanaag ciyaarta, laakiin taas kaliya kuguma guuleysiinayso. Waa inaad wax badan sifiican u sameysaa marka aad wajahayso Crystal Palace, sababtoo ah waa mid ka mid ah kooxaha ugu adag ee lala ciyaaro.”
Dhinaca kale, Slot ayaa xaqiijisay in goolhaye Giorgi Mamardashvili uu ku seegayo kulankan dhaawac, taas oo dhib ku ah kooxda xilli ay ku jiraan xaalad dhiirran.

headline: Wesley Fofana: “Chelsea Waxaan U Imid Inaan Koobab Kula Guuleysto”
body:
Wesley Fofana ayaa muujiyay hamigiisa ku aadan inuu ku guuleysto koobka FA Cup-ka markii labaad ee xirfadiisa, isagoo hore ugu soo guuleystay koobkan markii uu Leicester City u ciyaarayay, xilligaas oo ay final-kii ka badisay Chelsea.
“Aniga ahaan, waa arrin aad u weyn inaan isku dayo ku guuleysiga FA Cup. Horay ayaan hal mar ugu guuleystay, waxaana rabaa inaan hadda la qaado Chelsea, dabcan, sababtoo ah halkan waxaan u imid inaan koobab kula guuleysto,” ayuu yiri daafaca reer France.
Fofana ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay in xaaladda kooxdu aysan ahayn mid fudud dhowaanahan, isagoo yiri: “Dabcan, xilligan ma ahan mid fudud, xoogaa waa mid adag, kulamo ayaana naga soo hoos baxay, laakiin waa inaan midowno. Waa inaan diiradda saarnaa sababtoo ah waxyaabo waaweyn ayaa noo dhiman.”
Tartanka FA Cup-ka ayaa ah fursadda kaliya ee ay Chelsea xilli-ciyaareedkan koob ku qaadi karto, iyagoo hal kulan oo qura u jira final-ka. Maalinta Axadda ah, waxay semi-finalka tartankan ku wajahayaan kooxda Leeds United garoonka weyn ee Wembley.

headline: Saddex Kulan Oo Laga Filan Karo Natiijooyin Layaab Leh Horyaalka Premier League Todobaad Kaan
body:
Xilli-ciyaareedka Premier League ayaa maraya heer gebagebo ah, iyadoo toddobaadkan la filayo kulamo xiiso leh oo saameyn weyn ku yeelan kara kala sarreynta horyaalka.
Maaddaama kooxaha Chelsea iyo Manchester City ay ku mashquulsan yihiin semi-finalka FA Cup, halkaas oo ay ku wajahayaan Leeds United iyo Southampton, indhaha waxaa lagu hayn doonaa kulammada kale ee horyaalka.
Halkan ka eeg saddex kulan oo laga yaabo inay ka dhashaan natiijooyin lama filaan ah:
1. Wolves vs Spurs
Bilowgii toddobaadkan, Wolves ayaa si rasmi ah u noqotay kooxdii ugu horreysay ee u laabata heerka labaad. Si kasta ha ahaatee, kooxda martida u ah ee Tottenham ayaa lafteeda halis ugu jirta inay raacdo, iyadoo tartanka ka harista horyaalka uu u dhaxeeyo Spurs iyo West Ham. Maaddaama Wolves aysan wax cadaadis ah ku qabin tartanka badbaadada, Spurs-na aysan wax guul ah gaarin tan iyo bilowgii sanadkan 2026, ciyaartan wax kasta ayaa laga filan karaa.
2. Liverpool vs Crystal Palace
Ka dib markii ay Chelsea hoos u dhacday, Liverpool ayaa hadda ku jirta booska ugu habboon ee ay ku dambeyn karto oo ah kaalinta shanaad. Laakiin si ay u sii xajistaan booskaas, waxay u baahan yihiin inay urursadaan dhibco kasta oo suurtagal ah. Crystal Palace ayaa Anfield imaanaysa iyadoo ku jirta qaab ciyaareed wanaagsan, waxayna raadinayaan natiijooyin ay kaga mid noqdaan qeybta sare ee jadwalka horyaalka.
3. Man Utd vs Brentford
Xaalad layaab leh ayaa dhalatay toddobaadyadii u dambeeyay, iyadoo kooxda Brentford ay hadda u tartamayso booska Champions League, xilli ay u dhiman yihiin kaliya shan kulan. “The Bees” waxay u safrayaan garoonka Old Trafford si ay ula ciyaaraan Manchester United, koox ku dhowaad hubsatay inay u soo baxdo Champions League. Brentford waxay u baahan tahay dhibco ay ku sii wadato riyadeeda, waxaana macquul ah inay la soo laabato natiijada ay u baahan tahay.

headline: Arsenal Oo Dooneysa Saxiixa Xiddig Real Madrid Muhiim U Ah
body:
Wararka ka imaanaya warbaahinta Spanish ka ayaa daaha ka qaaday in kooxda Arsenal ay xiriiro cusub la samaysay wakiillada Arda Güler, iyadoo isku dayaysa inay sahamiso fursadda ay kula saxiixan karto xiddigan xagaaga soo socda, maadaama kooxda ka dhisan London ay aad u doonayso dhammaystirka heshiiskan.
Inkasta oo uu jiro xiisahan xooggan, xiddiga reer Turkiga ayaa si cad u qeexay mowqifkiisa, isagoo sheegay inuusan doonayn inuu ka tago Real Madrid xilligan. Wuxuu door biday inuu sii joogo kooxda oo uu qayb ka ahaado dhismaha mustaqbalka ee naadiga.
Güler ayaa loo arkaa mid ka mid ah xubnaha muhiimka ah ee safka Real Madrid xilli-ciyaareedkan, isagoo saameyn weyn ku yeeshay kooxda intii ay hoggaaminayeen tababarihii hore Xabi Alonso iyo macallinka hadda ee Álvaro Arbeloa.
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Guler ayaa dhowaan la kulmay dhaawac dhanka muruqa ah kaas oo ka dhigi doona inuu garoomada ka maqnaado ilaa dhammaadka xilli-ciyaareedka hadda socda. Arrintan ayaa dharbaaxo ku ah kooxda Real Madrid xilli lagu jiro marxaladda ugu xasaasisan ee xilli-ciyaareedka.

headline: Shaxda Ay Liverpool Kaga Hor Tagi Karto Crystal Palace
body:
Kooxda Liverpool ayaa raadinaysa inay sii xoojiso booskeeda shanta sare ee horyaalka Premier League marka ay galabta garoonka Anfield ku soo dhoweeyneyso kooxda Crystal Palace saacadda 5:00 galabnimo (waqtiga bariga Afrika).
Reds ayaa guuleystay labadii kulan ee u dambeeyay ee horyaalka, taas oo keentay inay shan dhibcood ka sarreeyaan kooxda lixaad, iyadoo weliba uu u dhiman yahay kulan baaqi ah marka loo eego kooxaha ka hooseeya.
Shaxda macquulka ah ee Liverpool(4-2-3-1):
Woodman; Jones, Konate, Van Dijk, Kerkez; Gravenberch, Szoboszlai; Salah, Wirtz, Gakpo; Isak.
Wiilasha Arne Slot ayaa hadda ku jira xaalad wanaagsan oo ay ugu soo laaban karaan tartanka Champions League ka dib xilli-ciyaareed dhibaatooyin badnaa. Waxay guuleysteen lix ka mid ah tobankii kulan ee ugu dambeeyay horyaalka, halka markii hore ay guuleysteen shan kulan oo qura 18-kii kulan ee ka horreeyay ee horyaalka.

headline: Shaxda Ay Arsenal Kaga Hor Tagi Karto Newcastle
body:
Kooxda Arsenal ayaa raadinaysa inay dib ugu soo laabato hoggaanka horyaalka Premier League marka ay galabta garoonka Emirates ku soo dhoweeyaan kooxda Newcastle United, saacadda marka ay tahay 7:30 fiidnimo (waqtiga bariga Afrika).
Gunners ayaa lumisay booska koowaad markii ugu horreysay muddo 200 maalmood ka dib markii ay la kulmeen laba guuldarro oo isku xiga. Waxaa ka mid ahaa guuldarradii todobaadkii hore ka soo gaartay Manchester City, kuwaas oo ka sare maray Arsenal ka dib markii ay guuleysteen kulankii bartamaha toddobaadka, iyagoo haatan ku hoggaaminaya goolal badan oo ay dhaliyeen.
Shaxda macquulka ah ee Arsenal(4-3-3):
Raya; Mosquera, Saliba, Gabriel, Hincapie; Odegaard, Zubimendi, Rice; Madueke, Havertz, Eze.
Kooxda Mikel Arteta ayaa hadda loo arkaa tartamaha labaad ee ku guuleysan kara horyaalka marka loo eego saadaasha sharadleyda. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, xogta Opta ayaa weli Arsenal siinaysa fursad dhan 65.36% inay ku guuleysato horyaalka, halka Manchester City ay haysato 34.64%.
Guul ay ka gaaraan Newcastle, oo ay ku soo afjaraan natiijooyinkii xumaa ee dhowaanahan, waxay farriin xooggan u noqon doontaa tartanka Arsenal ee horyaalka.

headline: Joe Cole Oo Farta Ku Fiiqay Tababaraha Kaliya Uu Aaminsan Yahay Inuu Chelsea Ku Hoggaamin Karo Guulo Haddii La Magacaabo
body:
Xiddigii hore ee kooxda Chelsea, Joe Cole, ayaa u magacaabay tababarihii hore ee Real Madrid iyo Bayer Leverkusen, Xabi Alonso, inuu yahay qofka ugu habboon ee hoggaamin kara kooxda Blues.
Isagoo la hadlayay Paddy Power, Cole ayaa ku sifeeyay Alonso mid ah guuleyste, inkastoo uu hadda bilaa shaqo yahay ka dib markii Real Madrid ay ceyrisay horraantii sanadkan. Tallaabadan ayaa timid dhowr maalmood ka dib markii Chelsea ay shaqada ka dirtay tababaraheeda Liam Rosenior.
“Waxaan jeclaan lahaa inaan Xabi Alonso ku arko kooxda. Aad ayaan u jeclaa daawashada kooxdiisii Leverkusen,” ayuu yiri Cole.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray, “Waxaan u malaynayaa in si xaqdarro ah loola dhaqmay markii uu joogay Real Madrid. Isagu wuu fahmayaa kooxaha waaweyn, waana qof guusha jecel. Waxaase ayaan darro ah, uma malaynayo in Xabi Alonso uu xitaa ka fiirsan doono imaatinka Chelsea.”

headline: Muxuu Cesc Fabregas Ka Yiri Wararka La Xiriirinaya Shaqada Chelsea?
body:
Macallinka kooxda Como, Cesc Fabregas, ayaa iska fogeeyay wararka la xiriirinaya booska bannaan ee tababarenimo ee kooxda Chelsea, isagoo ku adkeystay in diiraddiisu ay saaran tahay mustaqbalka kooxdiisa Talyaaniga ah.
Chelsea ayaa hadda baadi-goob ugu jirta tababarihii beddeli lahaa Liam Rosenior oo shaqada laga ceyriyay. In kasta oo kooxdu ay si ku-meel-gaar ah xilka ugu dhiibtay Calum McFarlane ilaa dhammaadka xilli-ciyaareedka, haddana Fabregas oo horay khadka dhexe uga soo ciyaaray Blues ayaa ka mid ahaa magacyada loo malaynayo in si rasmi ah loogu magacaabo xilkaas.
Madaxweynaha kooxda Como, Mirwan Suwarso, ayaa horraantii Jimcihii u sheegay City AM in uusan hor istaagi doonin Fabregas haddii uu doonayo inuu la wareego hoggaanka Stamford Bridge.
Si kasta ha ahaatee, Fabregas oo ka hadlayay xaaladdan ka hor kulanka ay kooxdiisu la leedahay Genoa ee horyaalka Serie A, ayaa yiri: “Ma jiraan wax aan ka leeyahay arrintaas, waxay noqon lahayd doqonnimo inaan hadda ka fikiro taas; diiraddaydu waxay saaran tahay kulanka xiga ee Genoa. Xitaa ma aanan arkin wax hadal ah oo ka soo baxay madaxweynahayaga.”
Wuxuu intaas ku daray: “Waxaan aaminsanahay inaan sii wadi doono cutubkayga tababarenimo ee Como. Waxaan xoogga saarayaa kulammada soo socda.”

headline: Arne Slot Oo War Weyn Ka Soo Saaray Mustaqbalka Alisson Becker
body:
Tababaraha kooxda Liverpool, Arne Slot, ayaa qirtay in kooxdu ay tahay inay go’aan ka gaarto mustaqbalka goolhaye Alisson Becker, kaas oo bartilmaameed u ah kooxda Juventus suuqa xagaaga.
“Waxaan u malaynayaa in kooxda loo maamulo si gaar ah, waxaana qaadanaa go’aanno ay kooxdu u aragto inay danteedu ku jirto,” ayuu yiri Slot. “Taas waxay noqon kartaa sababta aan u sameyno ficillada aan sameyno. Taariikhda dhammaan suuqa kala iibsiga waxay muujinaysaa in wax kasta loo sameeyo ujeedo ama iyadoo laga fekeray.”
Wuxuu intaas ku daray in dadka go’aannada gaaraya ay xisaabta ku darsadaan wax kasta si ay u gaaraan go’aanka ugu fiican ee danta kooxda u adeegaya. Inkastoo uu xusay in khibradda Alisson ay tahay sabab muhiim ah oo lagu sii haysan karo, haddana wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay inay jiraan doodo kale, isagoo xasuusiyay in goolhayuhu uu weli qandaraaskiisa ka dhiman yahay hal sano.
Liverpool ayaa horay u xaqiijisay inay ka tagayaan xiddigaha Mohamed Salah iyo Andy Robertson. Haddii uu Alisson baxo, waxay ka dhigan tahay in kooxda hoggaankeedu uu sii yaraan doono, xilli Reds ay sii waddo ka fogaanshaha safkii caanka ahaa ee uu dhisay Jurgen Klopp.

headline: Benjamin Sesko Oo Shaaciyay Abaalmarinta Uu Jecel Yahay In Bruno Ku Guuleysto Xilli Ciyaareed Kaan Kadib Bandhig Heer Sare Ah
body:
Weeraryahanka kooxda Manchester United, Benjamin Sesko, ayaa taageero buuxda u muujiyay saaxiibkiisa Bruno Fernandes si uu ugu guuleysto abaalmarinta xiddiga ugu fiican horyaalka Premier League, isagoo ku ammaanay qaab ciyaareedkiisa cajiibka ah iyo saameynta uu leeyahay xilli-ciyaareedkan.
Bruno Fernandes ayaa xilli-ciyaareedkan soo bandhigay qaab ciyaareed aad u sarreeya, isagoo ilaa hadda horyaalka Premier League ka sameeyay 18 caawin. Wuxuu hadda laba caawin oo qura u jiraa inuu barbareeyo rikoodhka abid ee caawinta ugu badan ee hal xilli-ciyaareed dhexdiisa, kaas oo ay hadda wada hayaan halyeeyada Thierry Henry iyo Kevin De Bruyne.
Sesko, oo dhaliyay afar ka mid ah sagaalkiisa gool ee horyaalka xilli-ciyaareedkan isagoo caawin ka helaya Fernandes, ayaa sheegay inuusan arkin ciyaaryahan kale oo ka wanaagsan Fernandes. Isagoo la hadlayay Sky Sports, wuxuu yiri:
“Tababar kasta, tababarka ka dib, mararka qaarkoodna tababarka ka hor [isaga ayaan u tagaa]. Wax kasta oo uu kuu sheego, kaliya samee, ha ka fekerin laba jeer. Taasna waa waxa aan sheegay. Aad ayaan ugu mahadcelinayaa inaan fursad u helo inaan agtiisa ahaado.”
Wuxuu intaas raaciyay: “Isagu waa mid weyn. Waa saaxiibkayga kooxda. Dabcan, mar walba waan u istaagayaa saaxiibbadayda kooxda, haa, isaga ayaa mudan inuu ku guuleysto abaalmarinnada xilli ciyaareedka.”

headline: Bruno Fernandes Oo Ugu Dambeyntii Sharaxay Sababta Ku Qasabtay Inuu Sii Joogo Man United Kadib Dalab Waalli Ah Oo Uu Ka Helay Horyaalka Sacuudiga
body:
Bruno Fernandes ayaa daaha ka qaaday sababtii uu u go’aansaday inuu u sii joogo Manchester United xagaagii hore, xilli uu wadahadalo dhab ah kula jiray kooxda Al Hilal ee ka ciyaarta horyaalka Sacuudiga.
“Waxaan u sii joogay sababtoo ah waxaan dareemay inay weli jiraan wax aan dib ugu celin karo kooxda,” ayuu Fernandes u sheegay Wayne Rooney oo uu marti u ahaa barnaamijkiisa podcast-ka ee BBC-da.
Isagoo ka hadlayay dalabkii uga yimid Sacuudiga, wuxuu yiri: “Dabcan xaaladda Sacuudiga iyo lacagta… waxay ahayd mid aad u badan. Laakiin waxa wanaagsan ee qoyskayga ku saabsan ayaa ah in xaaskeygu ay tahay qof dabeecad dhow sida qaybtayda oo kale. Waxaan aad uga warqabnaa inaanan doonayn inaan noqono dadka ugu taajirsan adduunka; kaliya waxaan rabnaa inaan noqono kuwa gaaray riyooyinkoodii, nolol wanaagsanna la qaata carruurtooda.”
Fernandes ayaa xusay in hadalkii xaaskiisa uu isbeddel weyn ku sameeyay: “Xaaskeygu waxay igu tiri, ‘ma gaartay riyooyinkaagii? ma gaartay wax kasta oo aad rabtay?’ Hadalkaas yar ee ay tiri wuxuu iga dhigay inaan fahmo hadaf keyga guud. Markaas ayaan go’aansaday inaan sii dadaalo oo aan arko meesha ay tani i gaarsiiso.”
Go’aanka Fernandes ayaa u muuqda mid guuleystay, gaar ahaan marka loo eego bandhigiisa shaqsiyadeed ee xilli-ciyaareedkan, isagoo horyaalka Premier League ka dhaliyay 8 gool, halka uu sameeyay 18 caawin, taas oo ka dhigtay inuu noqdo mid ka mid ah tartamayaasha ugu weyn ee abaalmarinnada shaqsiga ah ee dhammaadka xilli-ciyaareedka.

body:
Natiijadii ka soo baxday kulankii dhexmaray Real Madrid iyo Betis, oo ku dhammaaday barbaro 1-1 ah, ayaa ka dhigan in kooxda Barcelona ay hadda u baahan tahay oo qura toddobo dhibcood lixda kulan ee u dhiman si ay ugu guuleysato horyaalka La Liga.
Real Madrid waxay leedahay 74 dhibcood ka dib 33 kulan, taas oo ka dhigan inay gaari karaan ugu badnaan 89 dhibcood haddii ay guuleystaan dhammaan shanta kulan ee u hartay.
Dhanka kale, haddii Barcelona ay toddobo dhibcood ku darsato 82-da dhibcood ee ay hadda haysato, waxay gaari doontaa 89 dhibcood. Heerkaas waa mid aysan Real Madrid ka gudbi karin marka loo eego in Barcelona ay aad ugu sarreyso xisaabta goolal-tirka, xitaa haddii Barca laga badiyo kulammada kale ee u haray.
Sidaas darteed, waxaa si kalsooni leh loo dhihi karaa tartankii horyaalka La Liga ee xilli-ciyaareedka 2025/26 waa mid dhammaad ah. Barcelona ayaa hadda loo arkaa kooxda difaacanaysa horyaalkii ay sidoo kale ku guuleysatay xilli-ciyaareedkii hore, iyagoo qarka u saaran dabaaldegooda rasmiga ah.

headline: Liverpool Oo Qorsheyneysa Saxiixa Labo Garab Oo Miisaanka Culus Suuqa Xagaaga
body:
Sida ay werisay talkSPORT, kooxda Liverpool ayaa u muuqata inay diyaar u tahay xoojinta safkeeda weerarka iyadoo qorshaynaysa inay lasoo saxiixato laba garab xagaagan.
Tagitaanka rasmiga ah ee Mohamed Salah ayaa ka dhigtay mid iska cad in Liverpool ay u baahan tahay inay la wareegto weeraryahan cusub oo ka ciyaara dhanka midig.
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, kooxdu waxay doonaysaa inay ciyaaryahan cusub ku darto dhanka kale ee garabka bidix, maadaama aan weli si habboon loo beddelin Luis Diaz tan iyo markii uu u wareegay kooxda Bayern Munich sanadkii hore.
Xiddiga kooxda RB Leipzig, Yan Diomande, oo ka ciyaari kara labada garabba, ayaa loo arkaa inuu yahay baddalka koowaad ee Diaz. Taas waxay ka dhigan tahay in Reds ay weli u baahan tahay inay raadiso qofkii buuxin lahaa booska uu banneeyay Salah.

headline: Mbappé Oo Halis Ugu Jira In La Ganaaxo Ka Hor Kulanka Espanyol
body:
Weeraryahanka kooxda Real Madrid, Kylian Mbappé, ayaa halis ugu jira in la ganaaxo ka hor kulanka habeen dambe ee LaLiga ay la leeyihiin Real Betis.
Mbappé ayaa qarka u saaran inuu safto kulankiisii 100-aad ee uu u ciyaaro kooxda Los Blancos, balse xiddiga reer France ayaa u baahan inuu ka fogaado qaadashada kaarka digniinta ah. Haddii kaar la siiyo, wuxuu seegi doonaa kulanka Espanyol ee dhacaya 3-da bisha May.
Tan iyo markii uu ku soo biiray kooxda bishii Juun 2024, Mbappé wuxuu muujiyay wacdaro layaab leh isagoo dhaliyay 85 gool, halka uu caawiyay 23 kale. Sidoo kale, wuxuu hadda hoggaaminayaa gooldhalinta horyaalka LaLiga isagoo leh 24 gool, wuxuuna saddex gool ka horreeyaa weeraryahanka Mallorca, Vedat Muriqi, isagoo hiigsanaya inuu laba sano oo xiriir ah ku guuleysto abaalmarinta gooldhalinta ee horyaalka.

headline: Mikel Arteta Oo Ka Hadlay Fursadaha Kooxdiisa Ee Ku Guuleysiga Horyaalka Premier League
body:
Tababaraha kooxda Arsenal, Mikel Arteta, ayaa uga digay ciyaartoydiisa inay muhiim tahay in la helo “dheelitirnaan” inta ay ku howlan yihiin tartanka adag ee ay kula jiraan Manchester City ee hanashada horyaalka Premier League.
Gunners ayaa hoggaanka horyaalka haysay muddo 200 oo maalmood ah, ilaa laga soo gaaray guuldarrooyinkii is xigay ee ka soo gaaray kooxaha Bournemouth iyo Manchester City. Arsenal ayaa hadda fadhida booska labaad, iyagoo dhibcaha iyo goolal-tirka ay kala siman yihiin kooxda Pep Guardiola.
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Manchester City ayaa wali ku jirta kaalinta koowaad maadaama ay dhalisay goolal ka badan kuwa Arsenal.
Arteta oo la hadlayay warbaahinta maalintii Jimcaha ayaa yiri: “Goolasha naloo dhaliyay iyo kuwa aan dhalinay, waxay noqon doontaa mid dheelitiran sidii ay ahyd xilli-ciyaareedka oo dhan. Taas ayaa keentay in farqiga goolal-tirka ee u dhaxeeya labada kooxood ee u tartamaya horyaalka uu u noqdo mid aad u yar.”
Wuxuu intaas ku daray: “Marka hore, aad ayay u cadahay waxa nala gudboon si aan ugu guuleysano kulanka, inaan kasbano xuquuqda aan ku tartamayno, inta kalena gadaal ayay ka iman doontaa.”

headline: Rasmi: UEFA Oo Ganaax Culus Dul-dhigtay Xiddigii Vinicius Jr Daanyeerka Ku Tilmaamay Kulankii Real Iyo Benfica
body:
Ururka Kubadda Cagta Yurub (UEFA) ayaa ku dhawaaqay go’aankii ugu dambeeyay ee laga qaatay ciyaaryahanka kooxda Benfica, Gianluca Prestianni, kaas oo lagu riday ganaax dhan 6 kulan, kuwaas oo saddex ka mid ah ay yihiin dib-u-dhac, ka dib markii lagu helay dhaqan cunsuriyad ah oo uu kula kacay xiddiga Real Madrid, Vinicius Junior.
Dhacdadan ayaa waxey dib noogu celineysaa xilli ay labada kooxood ku tartamayeen isreeb-reebka wareegga 16-ka ee tartanka UEFA Champions League. Ciyaaryahanka reer Argentine ayaa lagu eedeeyay inuu aflagaado cunsuriyad iyo mid takoor ku saleysan u adeegsaday Vinicius ka dib markii xiddiga reer Brazil uu gool dhaliyay, taas oo keentay in UEFA ay furto baaritaan rasmi ah.
Bayaanka ka soo baxay UEFA ayaa lagu caddeeyay in baaritaan dheer ka dib la xaqiijiyay dambiga ciyaaryahanka, waxaana lagu ganaaxay 6 kulan oo isugu jira tartammada kooxaha Yurub iyo kuwa xulalka qaranka. Saddex ka mid ah kulammadaas ayaa laga dhigay muddo tijaabo ah oo laba sano ah, haddii uusan dambigaas ku celin.
Ganaaxan ayaa sidoo kale lagu daray kulankii uu ciyaaryahanku horey ugu seegay si ku-meel-gaar ah intii ay socotay ciyaartii lugta labaad, ka dib markii la diiday racfaankii uu ciyaaryahanku ka qaatay go’aankaas.
Arrin kale oo sii adkeynaysa xaaladda Prestianni ayaa ah in UEFA ay ka codsatay xiriirka kubadda cagta adduunka ee FIFA inay ganaaxan ka dhigto mid caalami ah. Haddii codsigaas la oggolaado, waxay halis weyn gelinaysaa ka qaybgalka ciyaaryahanka ee tartanka Koobka Adduunka.

headline: Saadaasha Alan Shearer Ee Kulamada Premier League Ee Todobaadkan
body:
Halyeyga kooxda Newcastle United, Alan Shearer, ayaa soo bandhigay saadaashiisa ku aadan qaar ka mid ah kulammada horyaalka Premier League ee la ciyaarayo dhammaadka toddobaadkan.
Maadaama kooxaha Manchester City iyo Chelsea ay ku jiraan tartanka semi-finalka ee koobka FA Cup, waxaa la ciyaari doonaa kulammo ka yar sidii looga bartay horyaalka.
Arsenal ayaa martigelin doonta kooxda Newcastle, iyadoo raadinaysa inay dib ugu laabato hoggaanka horyaalka. Sidoo kale, Manchester United ayaa garoonka Old Trafford ku soo dhoweyn doonta Brentford, iyadoo doonaysa inay sare u qaaddo fursaddeeda ay ugu soo bixi karto tartanka Champions League.

Manchester United vs Brentford – Man Utd ayaa guuleysanaysa (Man Utd Win).

headline: Arteta Oo Lagula Taliyay Inuu Keydka Dhigo Mid Kamid Ah Xiidigihiisa Kulamada Ka Harsan Horyaalka
body:
Xiddigii hore ee kooxda Arsenal, Perry Groves, ayaa kula taliyay Mikel Arteta inuu kursiga kaydka dhigo Viktor Gyokeres kulammada soo socda, isagoo door biday in Kai Havertz uu sii ahaado weeraryahanka koowaad ee kooxda.
Groves ayaa wareysi uu siiyay Metro ku sheegay in inkasta oo Gyokeres uu leeyahay rikoodh gooldhalin oo wanaagsan, haddana taasi aysan u dammaanad qaadayn inuu kusoo bilaawdo shaxda, maadaama Havertz uu muujiyay isfaham iyo wada-shaqayn ka wanaagsan tan saaxiibbadiis.
Wuxuu tusaale u soo qaatay kulankii dhowaan dhexmaray Arsenal iyo Manchester City, isagoo tilmaamay farqiga u dhexeeya labada weeraryahan:
“Waxaan taageere u ahay Gyokeres, xilli-ciyaareedkana waan difaacayay sababtoo ah waan jecelahay dabeecaddiisa iyo qaabkiisa ciyaareed. Wuxuu ku guuleystay inuu dhaliyo 18 gool,” ayuu yiri Groves.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray: “Wuxuu la qabsanayaa nidaamkayaga, annaguna waan la qabsanaynaa isaga, laakiin waxaan ku riyaaqay kulankii Man City inaan awoodnay inaan u ciyaarno qaab cadaadis ah iyo inaan kubadaha dhaadheer si degdeg ah u gaarsiino weerarka. David Raya wuxuu kubad dheer oo qalan u tuuray Havertz, taas oo u ogolaatay Havertz inuu kubadda xajisto ama uu madaxa ugu sii baaso saaxiibbadiis. Havertz wuxuu bixiyaa koontarool ka wanaagsan kan Gyokeres, taas oo ka dhigan in Gyokeres laga yaabo inuu sugo waqtigiisa.”
Kai Havertz ayaa gool dhaliyay ciyaartii Manchester City ka dib markii uu cadaadis saaray goolhaye Gigi Donnarumma, isagoo ka faa’iideystay qalad uu galay goolhayahaas.

headline: Patrick Vieira Oo Digniin Culus U Diray Ciyaartoyda Arsenal Ka Hor Kulamada Ka Harsan Horyaalka
body:
Halyeyga kooxda Arsenal, Patrick Vieira, ayaa ku boorriyay ciyaartoyda Gunners inay dib u eegaan guulihii ay gaareen xilli-ciyaareedkan, inkastoo ay wajaheen caqabado dhowaanahan.
Hadalkiisa ayaa dhashay ka dib markii Manchester City ay Arsenal kala wareegtay hoggaanka horyaalka Premier League 22-kii Abriil, markii ay 1-0 ku garaacday kooxda Burnley. Arsenal ayaa hoggaaminaysay horyaalka muddo ka badan 200 oo maalmood, waxayna sidoo kale joogaan semi-finalka Champions League, taas oo siinaysa fursad ay ku hantiyi karaan laba koob oo waaweyn.
Si kasta ha ahaatee, Gunners ayaa wajahday toddobaadyo adag, iyagoo laga badiyay afar ka mid ah lixdii kulan ee ugu dambeeyay ee tartammada oo dhan. Waxaa ka mid ahaa laba guuldarro oo ay kala kulmeen Manchester City, mid ka mid ahna ay ahayd final-ka koobka EFL Cup, iyo inay ka hareen koobka FA Cup ka dib markii ay ka badisay Southampton.
Vieira oo la hadlayay mareegta rasmiga ah ee kooxda ayaa yiri: “Waxaan rabaa inay xasuustaan meesha ay joogaan iyo sababta ay halkaas u joogaan. Waxay fadhiyaan hoggaanka horyaalka, waxayna joogaan semi-finalka Champions League; heerkaasna lama gaari karo haddii aysan jirin tayo, ruux kooxeed, iyo wadajir.”
Wuxuu intaas ku daray: “Waa arrin ku saabsan ku guuleysiga kulammada haray, wayna yaqaannaan sida loo sameeyo waayo waxay samaynayeen toddobadii ilaa siddeeddii bilood ee la soo dhaafay. Marka la joogo orodka u dambeeya, waxaa muhiim ah inaysan iloobin tayadii keentay halka ay maanta joogaan, sababtoo ah taasi ayaa ka caawin doonta inay guuleystaan.”
Arsenal ayaa hadda fadhida booska labaad iyadoo leh 70 dhibcood ka dib 33 kulan, waxayna dhibcaha iyo goolal-tirka (+37) iskaga mid yihiin Manchester City, inkastoo City ay hadda hoggaanka ku hayso goolal badan oo ay dhalisay. Gunners ayaa ku taamayaysa inay ku guuleysato horyaalkeedii ugu horreeyay ee Premier League muddo 22 sano ah.

headline: Tababaraha Ugu Cad-cad Shaqada Chelsea Kadib Ceyrintii Liam Rosenior Oo La Ogaaday
body:
Kooxda Chelsea ayaa dib u bilowday raadinta tababare cusub kadib markii ay shaqada ka ceyrisay Liam Rosenior, kaas oo kooxda joogay 106 maalmood oo qura inkastoo uu saxiixay qandaraas lix sano ah.
Go’aankan ayaa yimid ka dib markii kooxda ay wajahday shan guuldarro oo xiriir ah oo horyaalka Premier League iyadoon wax gool ah dhalin, taas oo ka dhigtay inay fariistaan booska siddeedaad, iyagoo todobo dhibcood u jira boosaska loogu soo baxo Champions League.
Difaacii hore ee Chelsea, Filipe Luis, ayaa ku soo baxay musharaxa ugu cadcad ee loo malaynayo inuu buuxiyo booskaas. Xiddigan reer Brazil oo ka mid ahaa kooxdii Chelsea ee ku guuleysatay horyaalka 2014/15, ayaa magaciisu sare u kacay ka dib guulo isdaba joog ah oo uu u soo hooyay kooxda Flamengo, halkaas oo uu dhawaan kula guuleystay koobabka Copa Libertadores iyo Campeonato Carioca.
Inkasta oo Calum McFarlane uu markii labaad xilli-ciyaareedkan si ku-meel-gaar ah xilka u hayo, maamulka kooxda ayaa tixgelinaya magacyo dhowr ah oo caan ah. Tababaraha Bournemouth, Andoni Iraola, iyo macallinka kooxda Como, Cesc Fabregas, ayaa ka mid ah xubnaha la hadal hayo, balse Filipe Luis ayaa loo arkaa qofka ugu dhow ee hoggaamin doona dhismaha cusub ee kooxda.
Chelsea ayaa hadda si quus ah u raadinaysa xasilooni, maadaama ay soo mareen 11 tababare muddo sideed sano gudahood ah.

headline: Ian Wright Oo Magacaabay Xiddiga U Qalma Ku Guuleysiga Abaalmarinta Ballon d’Or Xilli Ciyaareed Kaan
body:
Halyeyga kooxda Arsenal, Ian Wright, ayaa u magacaabay xiddiga khadka dhexe ee Declan Rice inuu yahay ciyaaryahanka mudan inuu ku guuleysto abaalmarinta Ballon d’Or xilli-ciyaareedkan.
Wright ayaa aaminsan haddii Arsenal ay ku guuleysato horyaalka Premier League iyo tartanka UEFA Champions League, in Rice uu heli doono fursadda ugu weyn ee uu ku hantiyo abaalmarinta shaqsiga ah ee ugu qiimaha badan dunida. Isagoo ka hadlayay barnaamijka Stick to Football ka hor kulanka Arsenal ay la leedahay Newcastle United, wuxuu yiri:
“Haddii Arsenal ay ku guuleysato Premier League, Declan Rice waa inuu noqdaa xiddiga sanadka ee horyaalka (POTY). Haddii ay sidoo kale ku guuleystaan Champions League, Rice waa inuu ku guuleystaa Ballon d’Or.”
Declan Rice ayaa Arsenal kaga soo biiray kooxda West Ham United sanadkii 2023, isagoo markaas ku yimid lacag rikoodh u ahayd horyaalka Premier League oo gaaraysay £105 milyan.
Xiddigan oo hadda 27-jir ah ayaa u saftay kooxda ka dhisan waqooyiga London in ka badan 150 kulan, isagoo u dhaliyay 21 gool, halka uu caawiyay 31 gool oo kale.

headline: Jamie Carragher Oo Daboolka Ka Rogay Hal Isbeddel Oo Ay Chelsea U Baahan Tahay Ka Hor Xilli Ciyaareedka Cusub
body:
Difaacii hore ee kooxda Liverpool, Jamie Carragher, ayaa si adag uga hadlay xaaladda cakiran ee kooxda Chelsea ka dib markii shaqada laga ceyriyay tababare Liam Rosenior.
Carragher ayaa aaminsan in dhibaatada Chelsea aysan ku koobnayn tababaraha, balse ay salka ku heyso hoggaanka kooxda, isagoo yiri: “In la ceyriyo tababarihii shanaad muddo afar sano gudahood ah waxay muujinaysaa in Chelsea ay u baahan tahay milkiile cusub si la mid ah sida ay ugu baahan tahay tababare cusub.”
Wuxuu ku tilmaamay xilligii ay BlueCo la wareegtay kooxda mid fashilmay oo lagu lumiyay lacag ka badan £1.5 bilyan, isagoo xusay in magacaabistii Liam Rosenior iyo fashilkii ku yimid ay markhaati u tahay maamul-xumada jirta. “Waxay kooxdii koobabka ku guuleysan jirtay u beddeleen tijaabo kubbadda cagta ah oo qaali ah balse fashilantay,” ayuu raaciyay Carragher.
Carragher ayaa sidoo kale dhaleeceeyay dhaqanka madaxda sare ee kooxda, isagoo sheegay inay u dhaqmayaan sidii inay ka caqli badan yihiin qof kasta oo abid koox kubbadda cagta ah soo maamulay. Wuxuu xusay inay u muuqato in madaxda fadhida qolka shirarka ay rabaan inay iyagu isku muujiyaan inay yihiin kuwa ka dambeeya guusha, halkii ay fursad siin lahaayeen dadka garoonka jooga.
“Xukunkooda liita waa digniin ku socota dadka kale,” ayuu yiri Carragher. “Guushu waxay ku timaadaa wadajir, laakiin isla marka ay awooddu u wareegto agaasimayaasha halkii ay ahaan lahayd kuwa maalin walba garoonka tababarka jooga, fowdo ayaa dhalata. Waxaa dhuma xiriirkii ka dhexeeyay taageerayaasha, ciyaartoyda, tababarayaasha iyo madaxda.”
Ugu dambeyntii, Carragher wuxuu sheegay in milkiileyaasha hadda ay rabeen inay wax u maamulaan si ka duwan Roman Abramovich, balse ay ku guuleysteen oo kaliya inay Chelsea ka dhigaan koox ka guulo yar, ka haybad yar, kana ixtiraam yar sidii ay ahaan jirtay.

headline: Patrick Vieira Oo Shaaciyay Xiddiga Kaliya Ee Arsenal Ka Caawin Kara Inay Ku Guuleysato Horyaalka Xilli Ciyaareed Kaan
body:
Halyeyga kooxda Arsenal, Patrick Vieira, ayaa aaminsan in weeraryahanka Viktor Gyokeres uu door muhiim ah ka ciyaari doono guulaha Arsenal ee bisha ugu dambaysa ee xilli-ciyaareedka.
Gyokeres, oo xagaagii hore kaga soo biiray Arsenal kooxda Sporting, ayaa horay u dhaliyay 18 gool xilli-ciyaareedkan 2025/26, isagoo si degdeg ah u noqday gooldhaliyaha ugu sarreeya kooxda.
“Waxaan arkay isagoo si adag u shaqaynaya marka aysan kooxdu kubadda haysan, had iyo jeerna wuxuu muujiyaa dadaal dheeri ah oo kooxda dhexdeeda,” ayuu yiri Vieira.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray: “Waxaan arkay isagoo samaynaya orod uu boos ku abuurayo, inkastoo sababo jira awgood aysan kubaddu gaarin. Laakiin waxaan u arkaa inuu yahay qof wax badan bixin kara marka loo eego intii aan aragnay, waxaana aad u jecelahay tamarta iyo ruuxda uu garoonka la soo galo. Waa ciyaaryahan u ciyaara kooxda, goolalna wuu dhalin doonaa, shaki nagama galayo taas.”
Vieira ayaa aaminsan in tayada iyo dadaalka Gyokeres ay Arsenal ka caawin doonto guusha horyaalka inta lagu jiro kulamada go’aaminaya tartanka horyaalka.

headline: Michael Carrick Oo Ugu Dambeyntii Tilmaamay Xiddiga Doorka Ugu Weyn Ka Ciyaaray Inuu United Guulo Wax Ku Ool Ah La Gaaro
body:
Michael Carrick ayaa aad ugu ammaanay Bruno Fernandes qaab ciyaareedkiisa iyo doorka uu ku leeyahay Manchester United, isagoo carrabka ku adkeeyay inay muhiim tahay in xiddigan khadka dhexe la siiyo xornimo uu ku soo bandhigo hibadiisa, iyadoo lala dhowrayo nidaamka kooxda.
Carrick ayaa sheegay inay ka shaqeynayaan dhisidda qaab-dhismeed kooxeed oo soo saari kara tayada ciyaaryahan kasta, isagoo yiri: “Waxa aan isku dayeynaa inaan dhisno qaab-dhismeed keenaya in qof walba uu soo bandhigo waxa ugu fiican ee uu karo. Waxaa jira xaddidaado maadaama qof kasta laga rabo inuu wax u huro danta kooxda, laakiin anigu waxaan jeclahay inaan arko Bruno oo ku jira boosaska weerarka isagoo haysta xornimo yar.”
Wuxuu intaas ku daray inuu ku kalsoon yahay Fernandes, isagoo tilmaamay inuu yahay ciyaaryahan hal-abuur leh oo leh maskax aad u wanaagsan. “Waa ciyaaryahan aad u fiican, wax buu arkaa, hal-abuur ayuu leeyahay, wuxuuna saameyn weyn ku leeyahay kooxda. Inta badan waa kalsooni iyo inaan isku dayno inaan dhigno booska aan isleenahay isbeddelka ugu weyn ayuu ka samayn karaa.”
Carrick oo ka hadlayay mas’uuliyadda Fernandes dusha ka saaran ayaa yiri: “Bruno muddo dheer ayaan aqaanay, waana la soo shaqeeyay markii uu kooxda ku soo biiray, markaas ma aysan igu noqon wax lala yaabo waxa uu soo kordhiyay. Waxaad arki kartaa inuu u koray si aad u wanaagsan, saameyn weyna uu ku leeyahay kooxda, aad ayaana ugu faraxsanahay qaabka uu hadda u ciyaarayo.”

headline: Liverpool Oo War Farxad Leh Ka Heshay Xaaladda Alisson, Endo Iyo Gomez Ka Hor Kulanka Palace
body:
Kooxda Liverpool ayaa heshay dhiirigelin weyn ka dib markii ay tababarka buuxa dib ugu soo laabteen xiddigaha Alisson Becker, Joe Gomez, iyo Wataru Endo toddobaadkan. Reds ayaa garoonka Anfield ku martigelin doonta Crystal Palace maalinta Sabtida, iyagoo hiigsanaya inay sii adkeystaan booskooda loogu soo baxo tartanka Champions League.
Kooxda uu hoggaamiyo Arne Slot ayaa hadda shan dhibcood ka sarreysa kooxda Brighton, iyadoo xogta Opta ay muujinayso inay haysato 91% fursad ay ugu soo bixi karto UCL.
Soo laabashada Alisson ayaa si gaar ah muhiim u ah, ka dib markii goolhayaha reer Brazil uu baraha bulshada ku caddeeyay xaaladdiisa, isagoo yiri: “Waxaan ku jiraa wejigii daaweynta, qorshuhuna waa inaan ahaado mid diyaar u ah ciyaarista dhammaadka Abriil!”
Liverpool ayaa raadinaysa dhibco macquul ah si ay u soo afjarto xilli-ciyaareedkan oo ay aad ugu dhibtootay. Reds ayaa xilli-ciyaareedkan aad ugu xooggan garoonkeeda, waxaana soo laabashada xiddigaha qibradda leh sida Gomez iyo kabtan Endo ay kooxda siinaysaa awood dheeri ah oo ay ku wajahaan tartammada u dhiman.

headline: Jadon Sancho Oo Shaaciyay Kooxda Uu Ku Biirayo Kadib Dhammaadka Qandaraaskiisa United
body:
Xiddiga heerka caalami ee dalka England, Jadon Sancho, ayaa ku wargeliyay kooxda Borussia Dortmund inuu diyaar u yahay inuu dib ugu laabto horyaalka Bundesliga marka uu si xor ah uga tago Manchester United xagaagan.
Sancho ayaa kaga soo biiray Dortmund kooxda Red Devils sanadkii 2021 lacag dhan £73 milyan, balse kuma uusan guuleysan inuu bandhig faneed sare ka sameeyo garoonka Old Trafford. Xiddigan 26-jirka ah ayaa xilli-ciyaareedkan amaah ku joogay kooxda Aston Villa, Manchester United ayaana horay u go’aansatay inay u ogolaato inuu si bilaash ah uga tago kooxda marka uu qandaraaskiisu dhamaado xagaagan.
Manchester United ayaa aad u danaynaysa inay iska yareyso culayska mushaharkiisa oo gaaraya £300,000 toddobaadkii, mana doonayaan inay isticmaalaan qodobka u ogolaanaya inay hal sano oo dheeri ah ku kordhiyaan qandaraaskiisa si ay lacag iib ah uga helaan.
Sida ay werisay Sky Germany, Sancho ayaa horay wada-hadallo ula yeeshay Dortmund, wuxuuna si cad u sheegay inuu jecel yahay dib ugu laabashada Jarmalka. Inkasta oo uu dalabyo badan ka helayo kooxaha kale ee caalamka, hadda go’aanku wuxuu u yaallaa Dortmund inay go’aansato inay dib u soo celinayso iyo in kale.
Tababaraha Borussia Dortmund, Niko Kovac, ayaa la sheegay inuu horay u bixiyay ogolaanshaha si Sancho dib loogu soo celiyo kooxda xagaagan.

headline: Manchester United Oo Ugu Dambeyntii Gacanta Ku Dhigtay Tababaraha Beddelaya Michael Carrick
body:
Xaaladda maamulka ee kooxda Manchester United ayaa weli ah mid aan fadhiyin, iyadoo ay socdaan doodaha ku saabsan cidda si rasmi ah ula wareegi doonta hoggaanka kooxda.
Michael Carrick ayaa hadda loo arkaa musharaxa ugu horreeya ee booskaas, ka dib markii uu soo bandhigay qaab ciyaareed cajiib ah tan iyo markii uu xilka la wareegay bishii Janaayo. Degganaantiisa iyo natiijooyinkii hore ee uu keenay ayaa ka caawiyay inuu helo taageerada qaar ka mid ah madaxda kooxda oo doorbidaya in isaga la sii haysto.
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxaa jira walaac laga qabo in Carrick uusan lahayn khibrad ku filan oo uu ku dhisi karo koox u tartami karta horyaalka muddo dheer, laguna kalsoonaan karo hannaankeeda ciyaareed.
Marka laga soo tago Carrick, Julian Nagelsmann ayaa la sheegay in si weyn looga qaddariyo gudaha kooxda, waxaana lala sameeyay xiriir si loo ogaado inuu diyaar yahay. Sida uu weriyay Sully Talkz, caqabadda ugu weyn ayaa ah tartanka Koobka Adduunka, maadaama macallinka Jarmalku uu u furan yahay inuu ku soo biiro United, balse helitaankiisu ay ku xiran tahay ballanqaadkiisa xulka qaranka iyo waqtiga uu tartanku dhamaanayo.
Madaxda sare ee kooxda, oo ay ka mid yihiin Jason Wilcox iyo Omar Berrada, ayaa la sheegay inay qaadanayaan go’aan aad looga fiirsaday, iyagoo dareensan in magacaabista soo socota ay go’aamin doonto jihada kooxda ee sanadaha soo socda, ka dib xasilooni darro dhanka tababareyaasha ah oo soo martay kooxda.

headline: Micah Richards Oo Difaacay Arsenal Kadib Guushii City Ee Burnley
body:
Manchester City ayaa si layaab leh ula wareegtay hoggaanka horyaalka Premier League ka dib markii ay 1-0 ku garaaceen kooxda Burnley, taas oo keentay in Arsenal mar kale lagu eedeeyo inay “fashilantay” xilli muhiim ah.
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Micah Richards oo falanqeeya ka ah Sky Sports ayaa difaacay kooxda Arsenal, isagoo ku adkeystay in tartanka horyaalku uusan weli dhammaan inkastoo ay City hadda gacanta sare leedahay.
“Markaan ka hadlayno inay Arsenal fashilantay, ma aysan fashilmin,” ayuu Richards ka yiri Sky Sports. “Kaliya waxay albaabka u fureen Manchester City. Way sameyn karaan [inay dib u soo laabtaan].”
Manchester City ayaa hadda hoggaanka horyaalka ku haysa tirada goolashii ay dhalisay, iyadoo labada kooxoodba ay leeyihiin 70 dhibcood iyo +37 goolal-tir ah, iyadoo ay u dhiman yihiin shan kulan oo kaliya.
Inkasta oo qaab ciyaareedka dhowaanahan ee City uu ahaa mid aad u xooggan, Arsenal ayaa weli si adag ugu jirta loolanka loogu jiro hanashada horyaalka xilli-ciyaareedkan.

headline: Patrick Vieira Oo Bannaanka Keenay Hal Sir Oo Ay Arsenal Kaga Guuleysan Karto City Ka Hor Dhammaadka Horyaalka
body:
Loolanka loogu jiro horyaalka Premier League ayaa laga yaabaa in lagu kala baxo goolal-tirka haddii Arsenal iyo Manchester City ay wada guuleystaan dhammaan kulamadooda u haray. Manchester City ayaa hadda wax yar horreysa maadaama ay dhalisay goolal ka badan kuwa Arsenal (66 marka loo eego 63), inkastoo labada kooxood ay ka siman yihiin dhibcaha iyo goolal-tirka (GD).
Halyeyga Arsenal, Patrick Vieira, oo door muhiim ah ka ciyaaray hanashada horyaallada 1998, 2002, iyo 2004, ayaa ku boorriyay kooxdiisii hore inay xajistaan degganaanshaha xilli horyaalku marayo marxaladdii lagu kala bixi lahaa.
“Waxaan rabaa inay xasuustaan meesha ay joogaan iyo sababta ay halkaas u joogaan. Waxay fadhiyaan hoggaanka horyaalka, waxayna joogaan semi-finalka Champions League; heerkaasna lama gaari karo haddii aysan jirin tayo, ruux kooxeed, iyo wadajir,” ayuu yiri Vieira.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray inay muhiim tahay inaan la baddalin qaabkii kooxdu u soo ciyaaraysay siddeedii bilood ee la soo dhaafay: “Marka la joogo orodka u dambeeya, waxaa muhiim ah inaan la iloobin tayadii keentay halka ay maanta joogaan, sababtoo ah taasi ayaa ka caawin doonta inay guuleystaan. Waa inaan la baddalin caadooyinka, ee la sii wado wixii la samayn jiray, laguna raaxaysto waqtiga lala qaadanayo qoyska.”
Vieira ayaa aaminsan in kalsoonida iyo joogteynta ay tahay furaha ay Arsenal kaga guuleysan karto Manchester City xilli-ciyaareedkan aadka u adag.

headline: Barcelona Oo Ku Dhow Inay Buriso Heshiiska Rashford
body:
Waqtiga Marcus Rashford ee kooxda Barcelona ayaa u muuqda mid sii dhammaanaya ka dib markii tababare Hansi Flick uu kursiga kaydka dhigay intii ay socotay ciyaartii Celta Vigo, isagoo ka door biday Gavi inkastoo uu maqnaa Raphinha, sida ay werisay Diario Sport.
Qeybtii labaad ee ciyaarta, Flick ayaa doortay inuu garabka bidix ka ciyaarsiiyo Fermín López, halka xiddiga reer England uu helay daqiiqado aad u kooban isagoo ka ciyaarayay booska “false nine”. Tani waxay calaamad u tahay in booskii uu ku lahaa kooxda uu aad u yaraaday xilli lagu jiro marxaladda ugu muhiimsan ee xilli-ciyaareedka.
Barcelona ayaa markii hore qorsheynaysay inay bixiso 30 milyan oo Yuuro si ay Rashford si rasmi ah ugula wareegto ka dib bandhig wanaagsan oo uu sameeyay bilowgii amaahda.
Laakiin laga soo bilaabo bishii Febraayo, qaab ciyaareedkiisa oo aan fadhiyin iyo kharashka ku bixi lahaa oo isugu jira lacagta iibka iyo mushaharkiisa sare ayaa baddalay fikirka maamulka; midkoodna Flick ama agaasimaha ciyaaraha Deco ma doonayaan inay bixiyaan mushahar sare iyadoo uusan ciyaaryahanku ahayn mid boos joogto ah haysta.
Rashford, oo qandaraas kula jira Manchester United ilaa 2028, ayaa wali doonaya inuu sii joogo Barca, inkastoo ay jirto xiiso ka imaanaya kooxda Newcastle oo u aragta baddalka Anthony Gordon. Dhankeeda, Barcelona ayaa hadda bilowday inay suuqa ka raadiso xiddigo garabka bidix ka ciyaara oo qiimo jaban.

Dhankeeda, Barcelona ayaa hadda bilowday inay suuqa ka raadiso xiddigo garabka bidix ka ciyaara oo qiimo jaban.

headline: Liverpool Oo Ogaatay Waqtiga Uu Garoomada Dib Ugu Soo Laabanayo Hugo Ekitike
body:

Sida ay werisay jariidadda L’Equipe, xiddigan u dhashay dalka Faransiiska ayaa qalliinka loogu sameeyay magaalada London shan maalmood ka dib markii uu dhaawacu soo gaaray, taas oo ku beegneyd 18-ka Abriil. headline: “Isaga Ayaa Koobab U Qaadi Kara” – William Gallas Oo Magacaabay Tababaraha Ku Habboon In Loo Magacaabo Shaqada Chelsea
body:
Xiddigii hore ee kooxda Chelsea, William Gallas, ayaa u soo jeediyay maamulka kooxda inay magacaabaan Diego Simeone, isagoo u arka inuu yahay dookha ugu habboon ee xalka degdeg u noqon kara booska tababarenimo ee kooxda.
Gallas ayaa ku adkeystay in tababaraha Atletico Madrid uu leeyahay maskax guuleed oo uu koobab ugu horseedi karo Blues muddo gaaban gudahood. Isagoo la hadlayay Boyle Sport ka dib markii dhawaan shaqada laga ceyriyay Liam Rosenior, Gallas wuxuu sharraxay aragtidiisa ku aadan qorshaha fog iyo kan dhow ee kooxda:
“Haddii laga fakarayo qorshaha fog, Chelsea waxay keeni kartaa Cesc Fabregas sababtoo ah shaqo fiican ayuu hadda ka hayaa kooxdiisa (Como),” ayuu yiri Gallas.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray: “Haddii aad ka fakarayso muddada dhow, waxay u baahan yihiin madax khibrad leh oo haga sida Diego Simeone. Marka la eego shakhsiyaddiisa, wuxuu wax ku guuleysan karaa waqti dhow isagoo jooga Chelsea. Waxaa laga yaabaa inay ciyaartoyda Chelsea u baahan yihiin isaga, sababtoo ah waxaan u baahannahay inaynu kooxda ku dhex aragno dagaalyahanno iyo askar ka dib wixii ay na tuseen.”

headline: Manchester City Oo Wadahadallo Hordhac Ah La Furtay Tababaraha Beddelaya Pep Guardiola
body:
Maamulka kooxda Manchester City ayaa wada-hadallo wax ku ool ah la yeeshay tababarihii hore ee Chelsea, Enzo Maresca, si uu u baddelo Pep Guardiola.
Mustaqbalka Guardiola ee garoonka Etihad ayaa weli ah mawduuc si weyn loo hadal hayo, iyadoo macallinka reer Spain uu hadda marayo bilooyinkii ugu dambeeyay ee qandaraaskiisa hadda ee City.
Hoggaanka kooxda ayaa hadda diyaarinaya qorshe ay ku raadinayaan cidda xilka kala wareegi lahayd, taas oo keeni karta in weji horey loo yaqaannay uu dib ugu soo laabto Etihad Stadium. Sida ay werisay jariidadda The Guardian, Maresca ayaa u soo baxay musharaxa ugu horreeya ee loo qorsheeyay inuu hoggaanka qabto.
Tallaabadan ayaa timid xilli ay jiraan warar xan ah oo sheegaya in Guardiola uu isaga tegi doono kooxda xagaagan. In kasta oo City ay weli rajo ka qabto in Guardiola uu sii joogi doono ilaa sanadka 2027, haddana ma rabaan inay wax fursad ah iska lumiyaan oo ay weeyaan qof diyaar ah.

headline: Saadaasha Khabiirka Skysports Ee Kulamada Premier League Ee Usbuucaan
body:
Xiddigii hore ee kooxda Arsenal, Paul Merson, ayaa shaaciyay saadaashiisa kulammada toddobaadka 34-aad ee horyaalka Premier League.
Ciyaaraha horyaalka ayaa bilaabanaya habeennimada Jimcaha, iyadoo Sunderland ay garoonka Stadium of Light ku soo dhoweynayso kooxda Nottingham Forest.
Maalinta Sabtida, Fulham ayaa wajihi doonta Aston Villa, Liverpool waxay Anfield ku martigelin doontaa Crystal Palace, halka Arsenal iyo Newcastle United ay ku loolami doonaan garoonka Emirates. Toddobaadka 34-aad waxaa lagu soo xiri doonaa habeennimada Isniinta, marka ay Manchester United garoonka Old Trafford ku qaabisho Brentford.
Saadaasha Merson ee kulammadaas, sida uu u qoray Sportskeeda, waa sidatan:
Sunderland 1-0 Nottingham Forest
Fulham 1-1 Aston Villa
West Ham United 1-2 Everton
Wolves 1-2 Tottenham Hotspur
Liverpool 3-0 Crystal Palace
Arsenal 2-0 Newcastle United
Manchester United 1-1 Brentford

headline: Real Madrid Oo Ku Dhow Inay Qandaraaska U Kordhiso Vinicius Junior
body:
Kooxda Real Madrid ayaa heshiis hordhac ah oo ay qandaraaska ugu kordhinayso la gaartay xiddiga reer Brazil ee Vinicius Junior, sida uu weriyay wariyaha Sky Sports Germany ee Florian Plettenberg.
Inkasta oo wali la dhammaystirin faahfaahinta u dambaysa ee heshiiska, waxaa la xaqiijiyay hal qodob oo muhiim ah: In Kylian Mbappé uu wali sii ahaan doona xiddiga ugu mushaharka badan kooxda.
Vinicius oo qandaraaskiisa hadda uu ku egyahay sanadka 2027, laguna burburin karo lacag dhan hal bilyan oo Yuuro, ayaa door muhiim ah ka ciyaaray guulaha Real Madrid, isagoo ka caawiyay hanashada horyaallada La Liga iyo koobkii Champions League ee 2022.
Wada-hadalladan oo socday tan iyo bilowgii sanadkii 2025, ayaa markii hore wajahay caqabado la xiriira mushaharka oo la sheegay inay gaarayeen 30 milyan oo Yuuro sanadkii, balse horumarka laga gaaray heshiiskan ayaa muujinaya sida uu xiddigani ugu heellan yahay sii joogista kooxda xilli ay xiiso u muujiyeen kooxaha ka dhisan Sucuudiga.
Heshiiskan cusub ayaa xaqiijinaya in Vinicius oo 25 jir ah uu sii joogi doono garoonka Santiago Bernabéu ugu yaraan ilaa sanadka 2030, taas oo xoojinaysa weerarka Madrid ka dib qaab ciyaareedkii cajiibka ahaa ee uu soo bandhigay xilli-ciyaareedkan 2025-26.
Mas’uuliyiinta kooxda ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay inay diyaar u yihiin in loogu darayo gunnooyin dheeraad ah si loo waafajiyo qaab-dhismeedka mushaharka ee kooxda iyada oo aan wax carqalad ah lagu sameynin miisaaniyadda.

headline: Federico Chiesa Oo Go’aan Ka Gaaray Mustaqbalkiisa Liverpool
body:
Federico Chiesa ayaa la filayaa inuu isaga tago kooxda Liverpool, iyadoo dhowr kooxood oo ka ciyaara dalka Talyaaniga ay si dhow u la socdaan xaaladdiisa, sida ay werisay jariidadda Daily Mail.
Kooxaha Atalanta, Roma, AC Milan iyo Juventus ayaa dhammaantood isha ku haya garabkan ka fiirsanaya inuu dib ugu laabto horyaalka Serie A.
Chiesa ayaa Liverpool kaga soo biiray Juventus bishii Ogosto 2024 isagoo ku yimid lacag dhan £12.5 milyan, waxaana loola soo wareegay inuu tayo ku soo kordhiyo kooxda, balse wuxuu ku dhibtoonayay inuu boos joogto ah ka helo shaxda tababare Arne Slot.
Waqtigiisa Anfield waxaa saameeyay dhaawacyo iyo daqiiqado kooban oo uu garoonka ku jiray, iyadoo inta badan kulamadiisa uu beddel ku soo gelayay.
Xilli-ciyaareedkan ayaa isna u muuqda mid raacay dhabbihii hore, iyadoo Chiesa uu saftay 33 kulan tartammada oo dhan balse uu ciyaaray wadar ahaan 686 daqiiqo oo kaliya, isagoo dhaliyay saddex gool, saddex kalena caawiyay.

Khvicha Kvaratskhelia(Georgia): Xiddiga Paris Saint-Germain oo ka mid ah garbaha ugu fiican adduunka ayaa ka maqnaan doona tartanka maadaama Georgia aysan soo bixin.
