headline: “Waa Koox Qasan, Ha Isku Tagin” – Emmanuel Petit Oo Fabregas Uga Digay Inuu Shaqada Chelsea Qabto
body:
Emmanuel Petit oo horay ugu soo ciyaaray kooxda Chelsea ayaa u soo jeediyay tababaraha kooxda Como, Cesc Fabregas, inuu iska diido dalab kasta oo uga yimaada kooxda reer London, isagoo kula taliyay inuu doorto Barcelona haddii ay fursaddu u timaado.
Fabregas ayaa lala xiriirinayay inuu la wareego hoggaanka Chelsea dhamaadka xilli-ciyaareedkan, ka dib markii shalay shaqada laga ceyriyay Liam Rosenior. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Petit ayaa aaminsan in Stamford Bridge ay hadda tahay meel qasan oo u eg “riyo xun” oo ay adag tahay in tababare kasta uu ku guuleysto.
“Cesc Fabregas miyuu aadayaa Chelsea? Maya, maya, maya. Haddii aad kala dooranayso Chelsea iyo Barcelona, waxaad dooranaysaa Barcelona,” ayuu Petit u sheegay Andy’s Bet Club.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray: “Chelsea waa meel qasan. Waa riyo xun oo ku habsatay tababarayaasha, xitaa ciyaartoyda laftooda ayay hadda u tahay riyo xun. Waxaad heli doontaa deganaansho badan xitaa haddii aad cadaadis weyn kala kulanto Barcelona marka loo eego xaaladda hadda ka jirta Chelsea.”

headline: Ander Herrera Oo Shaaciyay Hal Wax Oo Ay Yamal Iyo Messi Ku Kala Duwan Yihiin
body:
Xiddiga khadka dhexe ee kooxda Boca Juniors, Ander Herrera, ayaa isbarbardhig ku sameeyay garabka kooxda Barcelona Lamine Yamal iyo kabtanka Inter Miami Lionel Messi.
Sida uu qabo xiddigii hore ee Paris Saint-Germain, ma jiri doono ciyaaryahan la mid ah Messi oo mar kale soo baxa, isagoo intaas ku daray in Yamal uu kaga duwan yahay dhanka hannaanka ciyaarta.
Herrera oo la hadlayay TNT Sports ayaa yiri, “Runtii, aniga ahaan, ciyaaryahan la mid ah Lionel Messi marnaba dib uma soo laaban doono. Lamine Yamal malaha waa ciyaaryahanka ugu dhow isaga ee aan arkay ilaa hadda.”
Wuxuu sii raaciyay: “Messi wuxuu mar walba ka shaqeeyaa ciyaarta wadajirka ah iyo abuurista fursadaha, halka Lamine uu u muuqdo mid aad diiradda u saara xaaladaha fool-ka-foolka ah iyo iska horimaadyada shaqsiga ah si uu u jebiyo difaacyada.”

headline: Manchester United Oo Ogaatay Waqtiga Uu Garoomada Dib Ugu Soo Laabanayo Patrick Dorgu
body:
Patrick Dorgu ayaa hiigsanaya inuu dib ugu soo laabto garoomada kulanka weyn ee Manchester United ay horyaalka kula ballansan tahay kooxda Liverpool maalinta Axadda ee 3-da May, sida uu weriyay SullyTalkz.
Xiddigan 21-jirka ah ayaa sidoo kale la filayaa inuu dhowaan dib ugu soo laabto tababarka kooxda, isagoo sii kordhinaya dadaalkiisa uu kaga soo kabanayo dhaawac dhanka muruqa ah oo muddo uu la dhibtoonayay.
Dorgu ayaa saameyn degdeg ah ku yeeshay kooxda markii uu xilka kumeel-gaarka ah la wareegay Michael Carrick, isagoo goolal ka dhaliyay kooxaha Manchester City iyo Arsenal labadiisii kulan ee ugu horreysay.
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, horumarkii uu sameynayay ayaa ku istaagay garoonka Emirates Stadium, halkaas oo uu dhaawac muruqa ahi kasoo gaaray isagoo eryanayay kubad dheer. Taas waxay keentay in garoomada laga saaro ugu yaraan 10 usbuuc, isagoo seegay dhammaan kulamadii ay kooxdu ciyaartay wixii markaas ka dambeeyay.

headline: Ciyaartoyda Chelsea Oo Maamulka Kooxda Ka Codsaday Tababare Khibrad Leh
body:
Sida ay werisay jariidadda The Guardian, ciyaartoyda Chelsea ayaa doonaya tababare khibrad leh oo leh haybad hoggaamineed ka dib markii shaqada laga ceyriyay Liam Rosenior.

Dhibaatooyinka kooxda ayaa sii kordhay ka dib markii shaqada laga joojiyay Enzo Fernandez, taas oo dhalisay xiisad kooxda dhexdeeda. Sidoo kale, qaar ka mid ah ciyaartoyda, oo uu ku jiro Marc Cucurella, ayaa la sheegay inay tabayaan tababarihii hore ee Enzo Maresca.

headline: Pep Guardiola Oo Si Qiiro Leh Uga Falceliyay Shaqo Ka Ceyrintii Chelsea Ee Liam Rosenior
body:
Tababaraha Manchester City, Pep Guardiola, ayaa ka falceliyay ceyrintii Liam Rosenior, kaasoo laga xayuubiyay xilka tababaranimo ee Chelsea, isagoo muujiyay dareen ka xun go’aankaas.
Rosenior ayaa xilka laga qaaday maalintii Arbacada ka dib markii kooxda Chelsea ay guuldarro 3-0 ah kala kulantay Brighton maalintii Axadda. Isagoo ka jawaabayay su’aashaas intii uu socday shirkii jaraa’id ee ka dambeeyay guushii ay City 1-0 kaga adkaatay Burnley, Guardiola wuxuu yiri: “Aad baan uga xumahay.”
Macallinka reer Spain ayaa ammaan u jeediyay tababaraha 41-jirka ah ee reer England, isagoo tilmaamay inuu yahay mid leh heerka looga baahan yahay hoggaaminta kooxaha waaweyn. “Waxaa hubaal ah inuu yahay tababare heerkaas gaarsiisan” ayuu raaciyay Guardiola.
Ugu dambeyntii, Guardiola ayaa xusay nasiibka uu u leeyahay inuu joogo koox deggan, isagoo yiri: “Mar kasta oo ay tani dhacdo, waxaan had iyo jeer ka fikiraa sida aan nasiib u leeyahay mar kale inaan joogo kooxda aan hadda joogo.”

headline: SIR CULUS! Sababta Ugu Weyn Ee Shaqada Looga Ceyriyay Liam Rosenior Oo La Ogaaday
body:
Tijaabadii fashilantay ee kooxda Chelsea ee Liam Rosenior ayaa soo afjarantay habeenkii Arbacada, iyadoo ay soo baxayaan warar sheegaya in qolka lebiska ee kooxda uu qarka u saarnaa “gadood” ka hor intaan shaqada laga ceyrin.
Tababarahan 41-jirka ah ayaa la sheegay inuu lumiyay gebi ahaanba xushmaddii iyo awooddii uu ku lahaa ciyaartoyda, kuwaas oo ku jees-jeesi jiray muuqaalkiisa iyo qaabka uu u sharraxo xeeladaha ciyaarta oo ay u arkayeen mid la mid ah luuqadda lagu isticmaalo barta LinkedIn.
Sida ay werisay jariidadda The Independent, xiddigaha qaar ayaa xitaa ku maadsaday go’aankii uu Rosenior ku joojiyay xirashada muraayadaha indhaha (ookiyaalaha) marka uu joogo garoonka tababarka, iyagoo ku tilmaamay isku day uu rabay inuu “ugu muuqdo mid adag.”
Xiriirka labada dhinac ayaa gebi ahaanba burburay ka dib wareysigii ugu dambeeyay ee Rosenior ee ka dambeeyay guuldarradii 3-0 ee ka soo gaartay Brighton, halkaas oo uu dadaalka ciyaartoyda ku tilmaamay mid “aan la aqbali karin.” Ciyaartoyda ayaa si caro leh uga fal-celiyay hadalkaas, iyagoo billaabay inay gadoodaan, taas oo ku qasabtay maamulka kooxda inay qaataan go’aanka eryidda.
Maamulka Chelsea ayaa hadda wajahaya wareegga afar-dhamaadka ee tartanka FA Cup iyadoo uu kooxda si kumeel-gaar ah u hor kacayo Calum McFarlane, xilli ay raadinayaan tababare awood u leh inuu xalliyo dhibaatooyinka ka dhex jira safkan qaaliga ah ee kala firdhaday.

headline: Pep Guardiola Oo Shaaciyay Dariiqa Kaliya Ay Kooxdiisa Ugu Guuleysan Karto Horyaalka Xilli Ciyaareed Kaan
body:
Tababaraha Manchester City, Pep Guardiola, ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in dariiqa kaliya ee ay kooxdiisu ugu guulaysan karto horyaalka Premier League ay tahay inay badiyaan dhamaan kulamada u haray xilli-ciyaareedka.
Guardiola ayaa ku hoggaamiyay Man City guul 1-0 ah oo ay habeenkii Arbacada ka gaareen Burnley, taas oo dib ugu soo celisay hoggaanka horyaalka markii ugu horreysay tan iyo bishii Ogosto. Manchester City iyo Arsenal ayaa hadda wada leh 70 dhibcood, balse kooxda Guardiola ayaa hoggaanka ku haysa 66 gool oo ay dhaliyeen, halka Gunners ay leeyihiin 63 gool.
Isagoo la hadlayay suxufiyiinta ciyaarta ka dib, Guardiola wuxuu yiri: “Hadda waxaan u weecanaynaa tartanka FA Cup-ka, ka dibna waxaa noo dhiman shan kulan oo horyaalka ah. Fursadda kaliya ee aan ku hantiyi karno horyaalka waa inaan badino dhammaan kulamadaas.”
Markii ugu dambaysay ee ay Manchester City ku guulaysato horyaalka Premier League waxay ahayd sanadkii 2023-kii iyadoo uu hoggaaminayo isla Guardiola. Tan iyo markaas, waxay si adag ugu tartamayeen sidii ay dib ugu soo ceshan lahaayeen calanka horyaalka Ingiriiska.

headline: Paul Merson Oo Shaaciyay Hal Xeelad Oo Ay Arsenal Ku Niyad-jebin Karto City Si Ay Ugu Guuleysato Horyaalka
body:
Xiddigii hore ee xulka qaranka England iyo kooxda Arsenal, Paul Merson, ayaa sheegay in Arsenal ay weli fursad u haysato inay lix dhibcood ka sare marto Manchester City inta lagu jiro loolanka adag ee loogu jiro horyaalka Premier League.
Manchester City ayaa hadda fadhida hoggaanka horyaalka ka dib guushii 1-0 ahayd ee ay Arbacadii ka gaareen Burnley. Labada kooxood ayaa leh dhibco iyo goolal isku mid ah, balse wiilasha Pep Guardiola ayaa ku gacan sarreeya dhanka goolal dhalinta.
Mikel Arteta iyo kooxdiisa ayaa dib ugu soo laaban kara hoggaanka marka ay toddobaadkan garoonkooda ku qaabilaan Newcastle. Sidoo kale, Arsenal ayaa ciyaari doonta kulan kale oo ay wajahayaan Fulham ka hor inta aysan City u safrin kooxda Everton.
Merson oo hadlayay ayaa yiri: “Meel aysan cidna ka fileynin ayay Manchester City hoggaanka horyaalka kula wareegtay. Waa wax laga naxo. Laakiin Arsenal waxay ciyaaraysaa laba kulan ka hor inta aysan City ciyaarin, waxayna mar kale ku hoggaamin karaan lix dhibcood, waana inay taas ka faa’iideystaan. Waa inay guuleystaan labadaas kulan ee Newcastle iyo Fulham si ay cadaadiska ugu soo celiyaan City. Taas waa mid qasab ah.”

headline: Ian Wright Oo Saadaal Cusub Ka Bixiyay Kooxda Ku Guuleysaneysa Horyaalka Kadib Guushii City Ee Burnley
body:
Weeraryahankii hore ee xulka qaranka England, Ian Wright, ayaa Arsenal ku taageeray ku guuleysiga horyaalka Premier League, inkastoo ay hadda u dhaceen kaalinta labaad.
Wright ayaa aaminsan in Gunners ay heli doonto awood ay ku hantiso horyaalka, xitaa haddii ay ku guuleysanayaan dhibco aad u ciriiri ah. Wiilasha Mikel Arteta ayaa toddobaadkan galaya iyagoo ka dambeeya Manchester City, oo Arbacadii 1-0 ku garaacday Burnley, balse City ayaa ku hoggaaminaysa kaliya tirada goolasha ay dhalisay madaama dhibcaha iyo goolal-tirka  ay siman yihiin.
“Waxaan dhihi lahaa: horyaalka waan ku guuleysanaynaa,” ayuu Wright ka yiri barnaamijka Stick to Football markii la weydiiyay saadaashiisa.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray: “Fursadihii aan ka abuurnay kulankii City, waxaan qabaa inaynu ku celin karno kulamada soo socda. Dabcan, waa inaan noqonaa kuwo aad u naxariis daran oo fursadaha ka faa’iideysta. Ka hor kulankaas, ma aanan arkayn inaan abuureyno fursado nagu filan, waxaana u muuqannay kuwo ku dhacaya sidii looga bartay Arsenal marxaladdan xilli-ciyaareedka.”
Wright ayaa aaminsan in haddii Arsenal ay dib u soo ceshato difaacii adkaa ee lagu yaqaanay bilowgii xilli-ciyaareedka, isla markaana ay fursadaha goolal u beddesho, ay hantiyidda horyaalka suurtagal tahay. “Ciyaartii City waxaan sameynay wax nagu filan. Haddii aan u ciyaarno qaabkaas, xitaa haddii aan dhibco yaryar ku soo dugaalno, malaha waan sameyn karnaa.”

headline: Ciyaartoyda Chelsea Oo Naaneys Layaab Leh U Bixiyay Tababarihii Shaqada Laga Ceyriyay Rosenior
body:
Kooxda Chelsea ayaa wajaheysa xaalad adag ka dib markii ay soo baxeen warar sheegaya in jawiga qolka lebiska uu ahaa mid aad u xun ka hor intaan shaqada laga ceyrin tababare Liam Rosenior maalintii Arbacada.
Inkasta oo taageerayaasha iyo khubarada ciyaaruhu ay inta badan ku eedaynayeen fashilka kooxda qaabka ay wax u maamulayaan milkiilayaasha, hadda waxaa soo baxaya in dabeecadda ciyaartoyda ay tahay halka dhibaatadu ka bilaabatay.
Sida ay werisay warbaahinta BBC, ixtiraam darrada ka dhex jirtay kooxda ayaa gaartay heerkii ugu sarreeyay, iyadoo la sheegay in ugu yaraan mid ka mid ah ciyaartoyda kooxda koowaad uu Rosenior ugu yeeray magaca “Macallinka kumeel-gaarka ah ee dugsiyada”. Tani waxay muujinaysaa in awooddii tababaruhu ay gebi ahaanba duntay ka hor intaan xilka laga qaadin, xilli kooxdu ay ku dhibtoonayso kaalinta toddobaad ee horyaalka.
Muuqaalkan ayaa su’aal geliyay qaangaarnimada ciyaartoyda kooxda, waxaana taageerayaal badan ay dalbanayaan in isbeddel weyn lagu sameeyo safka ciyaartoyda iyo maamulkaba. Tababaraha cusub ee imaan doona Stamford Bridge ayaa wajahaya shaqo adag oo ah inuu gabi ahaanba beddelo dhaqanka iyo asluubta ka dhex jirta qolka lebiska ee Chelsea.

headline: Pep Guardiola Oo Ka Warbixiyay Dhaawaca Rodri Kadib Kulankii Burnley
body:
Xiddiga khadka dhexe ee dalka Spain, Rodri, ayaa seegay safarkii ay Manchester City habeenkii Arbacada ugu tagtay kooxda Burnley, ka dib markii uu dhaawac dhanka gumaarka ah soo gaaray kulankii ay 2-1 kaga guuleysteen Arsenal.
Tababare Pep Guardiola ayaa bixiyay warbixin aan faahfaahin badan lahayn ciyaarta ka dib, isagoo shaki geliyay inuu Rodri diyaar u noqon doono kulanka soo socda ee wareegga afar-dhamaadka FA Cup-ka oo ay Wembley kula ciyaari doonaan kooxda Southampton.
“Weli ma garanayo. Maalinba maalinta ka dambaysa ayaan eegi doonnaa xaaladdiisa,” ayuu yiri macallinka City.
Dhaawaca Rodri ayaa yimid daqiiqaddii 88-aad ee ciyaartii xamaasadda lahayd ee Axaddii dhex martay kooxaha ugu sarreeya horyaalka. Maadaama uu Rodri yahay udub-dhexaadka khadka dhexe ee City, maqnaanshihiisa ayaa walwal weyn ku haysa taageerayaasha xilli lagu jiro qaybtii ugu dambaysay ee xilli-ciyaareedka oo ay kooxdu ugu tartamayso koobab dhawr ah.

headline: Pogba Oo Farriin Cad U Diray Mainoo Ka Hor Inta Uusan Man United Heshiis Cusub Qalinka Ugu Duugin.
body:
Manchester United ayaa hadda ku jirta wada-hadallo heshiis kordhin ah oo ay la leedahay Kobbie Mainoo, balse xiddigii hore ee Red Devils, Paul Pogba, ayaa uga digay laacibkan da’da yar inuu kaliya mudnaanta siiyo waqti ciyaareedka uu helayo.
Xiddigan 21-jirka ah ee khadka dhexe ayaa wejahay bilow adag xilli-ciyaareedkan, isagoo kursiga kaydka ku qaatay waqtigii Ruben Amorim, balse wuxuu hadda noqday udub-dhexaadka kooxda tan iyo markii uu xilka la wareegay Michael Carrick.
Pogba, oo laba jeer ka tegay Old Trafford isagoo raadinaya fursado ka fiican, ayaa tilmaamay in xiisaha kooxaha kale ee xiddigan uu sare u kici doono. “Waxay ku xiran tahay sida uu dareemayo, haddii uu xiriir wanaagsan la leeyahay tababaraha, iyo haddii tababaruhu runtii ku kalsoon yahay, sababtoo ah wuxuu heli doonaa kooxo badan oo saf u soo geli doona” ayuu yiri Pogba.
Xaaladda Mainoo ayaa isbeddeshay tan iyo bishii Janaayo. Ka dib markii laga horjoogsaday inuu amaah ku baxo xagaagii hore, isagoo helay dalabyo uga imaanayay kooxda Napoli. Xiddigan ka soo baxay akadeemiyada ayaa ciyaaray kulan kasta oo uu Carrick hoggaaminayay, isagoo xilli-ciyaareedkan sameeyay 2 caawin 23 kulan oo uu saftay.
Xiddigan u ciyaara xulka qaranka England ayaa hadda u dagaallamaya sidii uu boos uga heli lahaa liiska Thomas Tuchel ee Koobka Adduunka. Inkasta oo wada-hadallada heshiis kordhinta ay u socdaan si wanaagsan, qandaraaskiisa hadda ayaa farsamo ahaan gelaya sanadkii ugu dambeeyay xagaagan, taas oo ka dhigaysa in United ay aad u doonayso inay xaqiijiso mustaqbalkiisa fog.

headline: Musiibo: Lamine Yamal Oo Dhaawac Ku Seegaya Xilli Ciyaareedka Inta Ka Harsan
body:
Wararka ka soo baxaya warbaahinta gobolka Catalonia ayaa sheegaya in baaritaanadii horudhaca ahaa ee lagu sameeyay xiddiga da’da yar ee kooxda Barcelona, Lamine Yamal, ay muujinayaan inuu qabo dhaawac dhanka muruqa ah ka dib ciyaartii Celta Vigo.
Wararku waxay xaqiijinayaan in dhaawacan uu garoomada ka fogayn doono laacibkan muddo lagu qiyaasay qiyaastii shan usbuuc, taas oo la micno ah inuu seegayo dhammaan xilli-ciyaareedka inta ka hartay.
Waxaa la rajeynayaa in ciyaaryahanku uu soo kabsado ka hor inta aysan bilaaban u diyaargarowga Koobka Adduunka, si uu diyaar ugu noqdo tartankaas weyn ee caalamiga ah.
Yamal ayaa soo bandhigay qaab-ciyaareed aad u wanaagsan intii ay socotay ciyaartii Celta Vigo ee wareeggii 33-aad ee horyaalka La Liga, isagoo daqiiqaddii 40-aad ku guuleystay gool ku laad uu isagu si guul leh u dhaliyay, kaas oo Barcelona siiyay hoggaanka ciyaarta.
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, farxadda ciyaaryahanka ayaan sii waarin, maadaama uu codsaday in la beddelo isla markii uu u dabbaal-degayay goolkaas, taas oo ku qasabtay tababare Hans Flick inuu garoonka ka saaro daqiiqaddii 43-aad, isagoo beddelkiisana soo geliyay Roni Bardagji.

headline: Pep Guardiola Oo Daaha Ka Rogay Sababta Kooxdiisa Ay Ugu Fashilantay Inay Goolal Badan Dhaliso Kulankii Burnley
body:
Tababaraha Manchester City, Pep Guardiola, ayaa sheegay in ciyaartoydiisu aysan si buuxda uga soo kaban ciyaartii ay 2-1 kaga guuleysteen Arsenal maalintii Axadda, taasina ay sabab u ahayd inay goolal badan dhalin waayaan kulankii Burnley ee habeenkii Arbacada.
Wiilasha Guardiola ayaa 1-0 ku badiyay ciyaartii ka dhacday garoonka Turf Moor, waxaana goolka qura u saxiixay Erling Haaland bilowgii ciyaarta. In kasta oo City ay ku fashilantay inay goolal kale dhaliso wixii ka dambeeyay daqiiqaddii lixaad, haddana waxay ku guuleysteen inay la wareegaan hoggaanka horyaalka Premier League.
Manchester City ayaa hadda Arsenal kaga sarreysa oo kaliya dhanka goolasha.
Guardiola ayaa u sheegay Sky Sports: “Wax kasta ayaan sameynay ka dib ciyaar aad u adkeyd oo aan ciyaarnay saddex maalmood ka hor. Sidaas darteed, ciyaartu waxay ahayd mid u baahan dadaal badan, mana sahlaneyn. Waxaan halkaan ku luminay goolal dhowr ah.”
Wuxuu intaas ku daray isagoo meesha ka saaraya inuu ka caraysan yahay natiijada: “Ma jirto wax calool xumo ah. Maxaan u calool xumaanayaa? Hadda waxaan joognaa hoggaanka horyaalka. Calool xumo ma jirto. Dabcan, si ka fiican ayaan u sameyn karnaa oo goolal ayaan dhalin karnaa, laakiin ciyaartoydu wax kasta ayay bixiyeen, kaliya ma aynaan dhalin goolal intaas ka badan. Ma jirin wax aan dhayalsanay, si aad u wanaagsan ayaan u ciyaarnay.”

headline: Gary Neville Oo Shaaciyay In Guushii City Ay Ka Gaartay Burnley Ay Faa’iido U Tahay Arsenal; Sidee?
body:
Difaacii hore ee kooxda Manchester United, Gary Neville, ayaa sheegay in guushii 1-0 ahayd ee Manchester City ay ka gaartay Burnley habeenkii Arbacada ay tahay natiijadii ugu fiicnayd ee ay Arsenal rajayn kartay.
Erling Haaland ayaa dhaliyay goolka qura ee ciyaarta daqiiqadii lixaad, taas oo ka dhigtay in City ay la wareegto hoggaanka horyaalka Premier League. Wiilasha Pep Guardiola ayaa hadda Arsenal kaga sarreeya oo kaliya tirada goolasha ay dhaliyeen.
“Waa guul u soo hoyatay Manchester City. Laakiin waa guushii ugu fiicnayd ee ay Arsenal rajayn kartay. Waa hal iyo waxba (1-0),” ayuu Neville ka yiri Sky Sports.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray: “Loolanku weli waa mid furan. Arsenal waxay maalinta Sabtida garoonkeeda ku qaabili doontaa Newcastle, halkaas oo ay dib ugu soo ceshan karaan hoggaankooda saddexda dhibcood. Manchester City wax weyn uma hirgelin. Waa inay u ciyaaraan si ka fiican sidii caawa, haddii kale dhibco ayay lumin doonaan.”
Neville ayaa hadalkiisa kusoo xiray: “Balse Pep Guardiola wuxuu ogaa inay tahay inuu la yimaado saddex dhibcood, taasna wuu ku guuleystay.”

headline: Virgil van Dijk Oo Farriin Culus U Diray Ciyaartoyda Liverpool Ka Hor Bixitaanka Salah Iyo Robertson
body:
Virgil van Dijk ayaa ugu baaqay ciyaartoy badan oo Liverpool ah inay mas’uuliyad is saaraan oo ay buuxiyaan kaalinta hoggaamineed ee bannaanan doonta marka ay Mohamed Salah iyo Andrew Robertson ka tagaan kooxda xagaaga.
Daafaca reer Holland ayaa sidoo kale tilmaamay inuu maskaxda ku hayo qofka noqon doona ku-xigeenka kabtanka (iyo qofka la filayo inuu isaga kala wareego xilka kabtanimada dambe), balse ma uusan magacaabin weli.
“Ciyaartoydu waa inay soo baxaan,” ayuu yiri Van Dijk. “Waa door aad ku dhex korto ama aad horay ugu dhex lahayd, taasina waa wax ay tahay inay ciyaartoydu xilli-ciyaareedka dambe muujiyaan xitaa si ka badan. Koobka Adduunka ka dib, marka la gaaro diyaarinta xilli-ciyaareedka (pre-season), waxay noqon doontaa horumar xiiso leh marka la eego sida uu tababaraha (Arne Slot) u arko, ka dibna waa inaan xilli-ciyaareedka u wajahnaa sida ugu wanaagsan, si uusan noogu soo laaban xilli-ciyaareed la mid ah kan aan hadda ku jirno.”
Wuxuu intaas ku daray isagoo ka hadlayay ku-xigeenka kabtanka: “Ma rabo inaan magacaabo, laakiin xaqiiqdii ra’yi baan ka leeyahay qofka noqonayo, mar walbana waan dhiibtaa ra’yigayga. Diiradda hadda waxay saaran tahay inaan xilli-ciyaareedkan si wanaagsan ku dhammaysanno, inkastoo uu yahay xilli-ciyaareed liita.”
Van Dijk ayaa hadalkiisa kusoo gaba-gabeeyay: “Waxaan haysanaa shan kulan oo kale, waxaana ku xiga Koobka Adduunka, ka dibna fasax wanaagsan, waayo taas waa loo baahan yahay, ka dibna diyaarinta xilli-ciyaareedka cusub si aan kan dambe ugu guuleysanno.”

headline: Paul Pogba Oo Tilmaamay Xiddig Real Madrid U Ciyaara Oo Ku Guuleysan Doona Ballon d’Or
body:
Weeraryahanka Real Madrid, Kylian Mbappe, ayaa ammaan ballaaran ka helay saaxiibkiis Paul Pogba, kaas oo aaminsan in ku guuleysiga abaalmarinta Ballon d’Or ay u tahay mid aan laga baaqsan karin.
Pogba oo ka hadlayay barnaamijka Rio Ferdinand (Podcast) ayaa hoosta ka xariiqay bilowga cajiibka ah ee Mbappe uu ka sameeyay dalka Spain. “Wuxuu dhaliyay goolal ka badan kuwii ay Cristiano Ronaldo iyo Ronaldo Nazario dhaliyeen xilli-ciyaareedkoodii ugu horreeyay ee Real Madrid. Wax intaas ka badan ayaa u dhiman, lalamana yaabayo,” ayuu yiri Pogba.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray: “Ku guuleysiga Ballon d’Or waa uun arrin waqti ah. Aniga ahaan, isaga ayaa ahaa ciyaaryahanka ugu fiican xilli-ciyaareedka oo dhan.”
Pogba ayaa sidoo kale dib u xasuustay isfahamkii ka dhexeeyay markii ay u ciyaarayeen qaranka Faransiiska, isagoo ammaanay xawaaraha iyo dareenka gool-dhallineed ee Mbappe. “Aad ayaan isu fahmi jirnay… waan garanayaa orodka uu sameeyo iyo halka uu u socdo,” ayuu yiri.
Mbappe ayaa weli udub-dhexaad u ah xilli-ciyaareedka Madrid inkastoo ay kooxdu natiijooyin kala duwan wajahday, iyadoo laga qabo rajo weyn saameynta uu yeelan doono mustaqbalka fog. Weeraryahanka Faransiiska ayaa xilli-ciyaareedkan Real Madrid u dhaliyay 41 gool.

headline: Manchester United Oo Shaacisay Boosaska Ugu Muhiimsan Ay Dooneyso Inay Iska Xoojiso Suuqa Xagaaga
body:
Sida ay werisay idaacadda talkSPORT, Manchester United ayaa weli qorshaynaysa inay la soo wareegto laba xiddig oo khadka dhexe ah xagaagan, maadaama xoojinta aaggaas ay tahay baahida ugu weyn ee kooxda.
Hadafka koowaad ee kooxda ayaa ah inay helaan xiddig cusub oo lambarka 6-aad ah kaas oo beddeli doona Casemiro. Aurelien Tchouameni ayaa ku soo baxay mid ka mid ah bartilmaameedyada ugu muhiimsan, xilli uu jiro shaki ku saabsan mustaqbalkiisa kooxda Real Madrid.
Ciyaaryahanka labaad ee khadka dhexe ee ay kooxdu doonayso ayaa ah mid ka ciyaari kara dhowr boos, inkastoo weli ay jiraan doodo gudaha kooxda ah oo ku saabsan inay u baahan yihiin ciyaaryahan haga khadka dhexe  iyo in kale.
Elliot Anderson ayaa weli ah dookha koowaad ee ay United u calaamadsatay doorkaas, balse waxay tartan adag kala kulmi doonaan kooxda ay isku magaalada yihiin ee Manchester City.
Manchester United ayaa isha ku haysa inay si weyn u beddesho wejiga khadkeeda dhexe ka hor inta uusan bilaaban xilli-ciyaareedka dambe, si ay u soo yareeyaan farqiga u dhexeeya kooxaha hoggaanka haya.

headline: Micah Richards Oo Ka Dhawaajiyay Hal Meel Oo Ay Man City Kaga Awood Badan Tahay Arsenal Kadib Kulankii Burnley
body:
Difaacii hore ee kooxda Manchester City, Micah Richards, ayaa aaminsan in kooxdiisii hore ay ku hoggaamineyso Arsenal dhanka loolanka maskaxeed ee loogu jiro horyaalka Premier League.
Richards ayaa hadalkan ka dhawaajiyay ka dib markii ay Man City 1-0 ku garaacday Burnley, taas oo ka dhigtay inay la wareegaan hoggaanka horyaalka. “Qof kasta wuxuu leeyahay: kulamada Arsenal waa ay ka yara fudud yihiin. Laakiin cidna ma tixgelinayso dagaalka dhanka maskaxda ah ee qaybta ka ah tartanka,” ayuu yiri Richards.
Wuxuu xasuustay xilligii uu ciyaari jiray isagoo yiri: “Habeenkii ma seexan jirin. Marka la galo lixda kulan ee ugu dambeeya xilli-ciyaareedka, waa dareen maskaxeed oo ka duwan kii hore. Markaad haysato ciyaartoy la mid ah Sergio Aguero, David Silva ama Vincent Kompany, waxay ahaayeen kuwo u dhashay guusha.”
Richards ayaa tilmaamay in khibradda guulaha ee Man City ay tahay hubka ay ku dhaafi karaan Arsenal: “Haddii Man City ay dhibcaha la sinnato Arsenal, waxaan aaminsanahay inay guuleysan doonaan sababtoo ah waxay aad ugu dheereeyaan dagaalka maskaxda. Waxay heystaan hoggaamiyeyaal iyo khibrad. Markaan eego Arsenal, waxay heystaan ciyaartoy iyo hibo weyn, laakiin yay u jeesanayaan marka ay xaaladdu ku adkaato? Yaa u soo bixi doona?”
Wuxuu hadalkiisa kusoo gaba-gabeeyay in kulamadii waaweynaa ee dhowaan dhacay ay Arsenal heshay fursado qaali ah balse aysan ka faa’iideysan, taasna ay tahay farqiga u dhexeeya labada kooxood: “Marka ay fursadaha waaweyn yimaadaan, waxaad u baahan tahay ciyaartoyda waaweyn inay soo baxaan. Taasina waa waxa ay Man City u muuqato inay sameyso inta badan.”

headline: Gary Neville Oo Magacaabay 2 Ciyaaryahan Ee Ka Dambeeya In Shaqada Laga Ceyriyo Liam Rosenior
body:
Difaacii hore ee kooxda Manchester United, Gary Neville, ayaa ku eedeeyay Enzo Fernandez iyo Marc Cucurella inay “god u qodeen” tababare Liam Rosenior ka hor inta aan shaqada laga ceyrin.
Kooxda Chelsea ayaa si rasmi ah u fasaxday Rosenior ka dib natiijooyin xun oo isdaba joog ah. Neville oo arrintan ka hadlayay isagoo wareysi siinayay Sky Sports ayaa yiri: “Tababaraha ayaa mar walba dusha u rita mas’uuliyadda, waana qayb ka mid ah shaqada. Way ka fududahay in hal tababare la ceyriyo intii laga fasaxi lahaa shan iyo labaatan ciyaaryahan.”
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Neville ayaa farta ku fiiqay labada xiddig ee ka dambeeya in la ceyriyo macallin Rosenior isagoo yiri: “Aynu runta ka hadalno… Cucurella iyo Fernandez, oo laga yaabo inay yihiin labada ciyaaryahan ee kaliya ee khibradda leh ee Chelsea, waxay toddobaadyo “dhagrayeen” Rosenior iyagoo si furan u sheegayay inta ay jecel yihiin Enzo Maresca.”
Neville ayaa hadalkiisa kusoo xiray: “Hagaag, si fiican uma aysan ciyaaraynin intii uu Rosenior joogay. Waxaan qabaa in Maresca uu isna yahay tababare fiican.”
Hadalkan ayaa muujinaya in jawiga qolka lebiska ee Chelsea uu ahaa mid kacsan ka hor inta aan go’aanka rasmiga ah la gaarin mustaqbalka tababaraha.

headline: 2 Koox Oo La Xaqiijiyay U Laabashada Heerka Labaad Ee Horyaalka Ingiriiska
body:
Kooxda Burnley ayaa noqotay naadigii labaad ee xilli-ciyaareedkan si rasmi ah ugu dhacda heerka labaad (Championship) ee horyaalka Ingiriiska.
Arrintan ayaa timid ka dib markii 1-0 looga adkaaday ciyaartii ay xalay oo Arbaco ahayd la yeesheen kooxda Manchester City. Erling Haaland ayaa dhaliyay goolka qura ee ciyaarta daqiiqadii lixaad ee bilowgii kulanka ka dhacay garoonka Turf Moor. Inkasta oo City ay ku guuldarraysatay inay goolal kale ku darto, haddana saddexdaas dhibcood ayaa ku filnaaday inay Arsenal kala wareegaan hoggaanka horyaalka Premier League.
Wiilasha uu hoggaamiyo Scott Parker ayaa markii ay hal xilli-ciyaareed qura joogeen heerka sare, waxay hadda dib ugu laabanayaan horyaalka Championship-ka.
Kooxda Wolves ayaa horay u noqotay naadigii ugu horreeyay ee xaqiijiyay inay heerka labaad u dhaceen, ka dib markii ay Crystal Palace iyo West Ham galeen barbaro 0-0 ah habeenkii Isniinta.

headline: Tababaraha Ugu Cad-cad Shaqada Chelsea Kadib Ceydhintii Liam Rosenior Oo La Ogaaday
body:
Sida uu sheegay suxufiga Ben Jacobs, tababaraha kooxda Bournemouth, Andoni Iraola, ayaa la filayaa inuu noqdo musharaxa ugu weyn ee qaban doona xilka tababarenimo ee rasmiga ah ee Chelsea xagaagan.
Macallinkan u dhashay dalka Spain ayaa horay u shaaciyay inuu ka tegayo kooxdiisa hadda, isagoo sidoo kale iska diiday dalabyo uga yimid kooxda Crystal Palace oo doonaysay inuu beddelo Oliver Glasner.
Inkasta oo Chelsea aysan weli si rasmi ah u bilaabin wada-hadallada ama aysan weli soo saarin liiska gaaban ee musharaxiinta, haddana waxaa jira macallimiin dhowr ah oo ay mas’uuliyiinta kooxdu aad u qaddariyaan kuwaas oo qayb ka noqon kara hannaanka xulashada. Magacyadaas waxaa ka mid ah Eddie Howe oo jooga Newcastle, Francesco Farioli oo Porto u jooga, Filipe Luís, iyo Edin Terzic.
Mudada lagu jiro raadinta tababaraha cusub, Calum McFarlane ayaa sii ahaan doona tababaraha kumeel-gaarka ah ilaa dhammaadka xilli-ciyaareedka, ka dib markii shaqada laga ceyriyay Liam Rosenior.

headline: Rasmi: Chelsea Oo Xaqiijisay Ceydhinta Liam Rosenior
body:
Kooxda Chelsea ayaa si rasmi ah u xaqiijisay inay shaqada ka cayrisay tababarihii kooxda Liam Rosenior.
War-saxaafadeed ka soo baxay kooxda ayaa lagu yiri: “Kooxda kubbadda cagta ee Chelsea waxay maanta kala tageen madaxii tababarka Liam Rosenior. Magaca qof kasta oo ka tirsan Chelsea, waxaan jecelnahay inaan halkaan ku shaacinno u mahadcelinteena Liam iyo shaqaalihiisa dadaalkii ay muujiyeen muddadii ay kooxda joogeen.”
Kooxda ayaa xustay in Rosenior uu mar walba muujiyay xirfad-kasnimo iyo hufnaan sare tan iyo markii loo magacaabay xilka bartamihii xilli-ciyaareedkan. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxay tilmaameen in go’aankan uusan ahayn mid fudud, balse natiijooyinkii u dambeeyay iyo qaab-ciyaareedka kooxda ay ka hoos mareen heerkii loo baahnaa, iyadoo weli ay jiraan wax badan oo loo tartamayo xilli-ciyaareedkan.
Chelsea ayaa sidoo kale ku dhawaaqday in Calum McFarlane uu noqon doono tababaraha kumeel-gaarka ah ee kooxda ilaa dhammaadka xilli-ciyaareedka, isagoo kaashanaya shaqaalaha kale ee farsamada. Hadafka kooxda ayaa lagu sheegay inay tahay in la xaqiijiyo boos looga qaybgalo tartammada Yurub iyo in horumar laga sameeyo tartanka FA Cup-ka.
Ugu dambayn, kooxdu waxay sheegtay inay bilaabayso hannaanka raadinta tababare rasmi ah oo muddo dheer hoggaamin doona kooxda, si loo soo celiyo xasilloonidii Stamford Bridge.

headline: DEG-DEG: Chelsea Oo Ceyrisay Liam Rosenior
body:

Wuxuu intaas ku daray in muddadii afarta bilood ahayd ee uu tababaruhu joogay ay soo dhammaatay, ka dib markii kooxdu ay la kulantay shan guuldarro oo xiriir ah oo horyaalka Premier League iyado aan wax gool ah dhalin mudadaas.

headline: Manchester United Oo Dooneysa Saxiixa Xiddig Muhiim U Ah Real Madrid
body:
Manchester United ayaa la soo warinayaa inay bartilmaameedsanayaan Aurelien Tchouameni si ay u xoojiyaan khadka dhexe xagaagan.
Kooxda uu hogaamiyo Michael Carrick ayaa dooneysa ciyaaryahan khibrad sare leh, gaar ahaan iyadoo la filayo inay dib ugu laabtaan UEFA Champions League.
Inkasta oo Real Madrid ay rabto inay kordhiso qandaraaska Tchouaméni, wararka ayaa sheegaya in xilli ciyaareedkan oo aan koob lagu guuleysan uu ku qasbi karo inay dhageystaan dalabyo waaweyn si ay u sameeyaan dib-u-dhis.
United ayaa sidoo kale eegtay xulashooyin kale sida Adam Wharton iyo Elliot Anderson, balse Tchouaméni ayaa ah bartilmaameedka ugu weyn.
Bixitaanka ciyaartoy mushahar sare qaata sida Casemiro ayaa siinaya United dabacsanaan dhaqaale oo ay ku fuliyaan heshiis weyn.
Manchester United waxay doonaysaa saxiix culus oo khadka dhexe ah, iyadoo Tchouaméni loo arko xiddig ku habboon mashruuca cusub, laakiin heshiiska wuxuu ku xirnaan doonaa go’aanka Real Madrid iyo qiimaha la dul dhigo.

headline: Jamie Carragher Oo Farta Ku Fiiqay Boosaska Ay Liverpool Ku Qasban Tahay Inay Iska Xoojiso Suuqa Xagaaga
body:
Jamie Carragher ayaa si adag ugu digay Liverpool, isagoo sheegay in kooxda ay u baahan tahay ugu yaraan saddex ciyaaryahan oo si toos ah ugu soo bilaaban kara safka hore xagaagan si loo saxo khaladaadkii suuqa kala iibsiga.
Carragher wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay laba baahi oo degdeg ah:
– Beddelka Mohamed Salah
– Dambeed midig oo dabiici ah oo la isku halleyn karo
Wuxuu sidoo kale dhaliilay ciyaartoyda cusub sida Alexander Isak iyo Florian Wirtz, isagoo sheegay inay tahay inay wax badan muujiyaan kadib xilli ciyaareedyo dhaawacyo iyo qaab ciyaareed liita ay soo bandhigeen.
Dhanka kale, Jeremie Frimpong ayuu ku tilmaamay inuu ka fiican yahay weerarka balse uusan ahayn xalka joogtada ah ee difaaca.
Carragher wuxuu sidoo kale tilmaamay in dhaawacyada joogtada ah ee Conor Bradley ay sii kordhiyeen baahida loo qabo daafac midig oo heer sare ah.
Liverpool waxay wajahaysaa suuq xagaaga oo aad u muhiim ah, haddii aysan keenin ciyaartoy si degdeg ah saameyn u yeesha, waxay halis ugu jiraan inay ka sii fogaadaan kooxaha ugu sareeya.

headline: Barcelona Oo Iska Direysa Xiddig Muhiim Ah Suuqa Xagaaga
body:
Barcelona ayaa la soo warinayaa inay qorsheyneyso isbeddel weyn oo xagaaga ah, iyadoo diyaar u ah inay iska iibiso dhowr ciyaaryahan oo caan ah.
Magaca ugu weyn ee liiska ku jira waa Frenkie de Jong, inkastoo uu muddo dheer ahaa laf-dhabarta khadka dhexe ee Barça. Dhaawacyo soo noqnoqday ayaa sare u qaaday shakiga mustaqbalkiisa, gaar ahaan iyadoo uu ka mid yahay ciyaartoyda ugu mushaharka badan kooxda.
Ciyaartoyda kale ee la filayo inay baxaan waxaa ka mid ah:
Robert Lewandowski
Marcus Rashford
Andreas Christensen

headline: Liverpool Oo Xiddig Wayn U Calaamadsatay Beddelka Salah
body:
Liverpool ayaa la soo warinayaa inay xiiseynayaan saxiixa Randal Kolo Muani, iyadoo loo arko beddel macquul ah oo buuxin kara booska Mohamed Salah.
Weeraryahanka Faransiiska ah, oo hadda amaah ku jooga Tottenham Hotspur, ayaa muujiyay tayo gaar ah kulamadii UEFA Champions League, inkastoo uu hal gool oo kaliya ka dhaliyay Premier League xilli ciyaareedkan.
Xiisaha Liverpool ayaa si toos ah u dhaqaajiyay Juventus, kuwaasoo dadaal xooggan ugu jira inay helaan saxiixiisa kahor tartamayaasha kale.
Wararka ayaa sidoo kale tilmaamaya in Paris Saint-Germain ay door ku yeelan karto heshiiska, iyadoo agaasimaha ciyaaraha Luis Campos uu xiiseynayo Jonathan David, taasoo keeni karta is-weydaarsi ciyaartoy ah haddii Muani u wareego Juventus.
Kolo Muani wuxuu noqday bartilmaameed muhiim ah suuqa xagaaga, iyadoo Liverpool iyo Juventus ay si adag ugu tartamayaan saxiixiisa, halka PSG ay sidoo kale door qarsoon ka ciyaari karto heshiiska.

headline: Curtis Jones Oo Go’aan Ka Soo Saaray Mustaqbalkiisa Liverpool
body:
Curtis Jones ayaa wajahaya mustaqbal aan la hubin, iyadoo wararku sheegayaan inuu ka fiirsanayo inuu ka tago kooxda Anfield xagaagan.
Ciyaaryahanka kasoo baxay akadeemiyada Liverpool ayaa noqday mid aan joogto u ciyaarin xilli ciyaareedkan, gaar ahaan tan iyo markii Arne Slot uu la wareegay kooxda. Jones marar badan waxaa laga ciyaarsiiyay boos aan ahayn kan uu jecel yahay ee khadka dhexe, taasoo saameysay qaab ciyaareedkiisa.
Qandaraaskiisa oo galay 12-ka bilood ee ugu dambeeya ayaa xaaladda sii adkeeyay. Dhanka kale, imaanshaha xiddigaha cusub sida Florian Wirtz ayaa sii yareeyay fursadaha uu heli karo.

headline: Liam Rosenior Oo Tilmaamay Cidda Iska Leh Mas’uuliyadda Guuldarradii Kooxdiisa Ka Soo Gaartay Kulankii Brighton
body:
Tababaraha kooxda Chelsea, Liam Rosenior, ayaa si furan u qirtay in afar ka mid ah ciyaartoydiisa aysan soo bandhigin qaab-ciyaareed ku filan, ka dib guuldarradii bahdilaadda ahayd ee 3-0 ee ka soo gaartay Brighton habeenkii Talaadada.
Rosenior ayaa bixiyay raalligelin toos ah oo ku socota taageerayaasha Blues ee u safray inay kooxda soo daawadaan. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, wuxuu qirtay in afar xubnood oo qura oo ka tirsan kooxdiisa ay bixiyeen dadaal buuxa intii ay socotay ciyaarta.
Goolasha Brighton waxaa u kala dhaliyay Danny Welbeck, Jack Hinshelwood, iyo Ferdi Kadioglu, taas oo ka dhigtay in Blues ay fariisato kaalinta toddobaad ee kala horreynta horyaalka.
“Runtii, taageerayaasha, waan ka raalligelinayaa wixii dhacay, ma ahayn wax la aqbali karo,” ayuu yiri Rosenior. “Waan difaaci doonaa ciyaartoydayda marka ay u qalmaan. Saddex ama afar ka mid ah ayaa bixiyay wax kasta. Ma rabo inaan magacaabo, laakiin saddex ama afar qof-na waxay ahaayeen kuwo liita.”
Rosenior ayaa hadda isku dayi doona inuu dib u soo celiyo niyadda kooxdiisa si ay jawaab degdeg ah uga bixiyaan marka ay toddobaadkan dhammaadkiisa wajahayaan kooxda Leeds United wareegga nus-dhammaadka ee tartanka FA Cup-ka.

headline: Premier League: Tim Sherwood Oo Farta Ku Fiiqay Tababaraha Ugu Cad-cad In La Ceyriyo Ka Hor Dhammaadka Xilli Ciyaareedka
body:
Ciyaaryahankii iyo tababarihii hore ee Premier League, Tim Sherwood, ayaa tilmaamay in tababaraha Chelsea, Liam Rosenior, uu noqon doono macallinka xiga ee shaqada laga cayrin doono ka hor dhammaadka xilli ciyaareed ka.
Sherwood ayaa aaminsan in maamulka Chelsea ay soo afjari doonaan qandaraaska Rosenior ka dib guuldarradii 3-0 ahayd ee ka soo gaartay Brighton fiidnimadii Talaadada. Ciyaartaas oo ka dhacday garoonka Amex, Brighton ayaa guul u qalanta ku gaartay goolal ay dhaliyeen Ferdi Kadioglu, Jack Hinshelwood, iyo Danny Welbeck.
Guuldarradan ayaa ka dhigan in Chelsea ay markii ugu horreysay tan iyo sanadkii 1912 la kulantay shan guuldarro oo xiriir ah oo horyaalka ah iyado aan hal gool dhalin. Intii ay ciyaartu socotay, taageerayaasha Chelsea ayaa muujiyay cadhadooda iyagoo dalbanayay in Rosenior la cayriyo, sidoo kalena ka horyimid milkiilayaasha kooxda ee BlueCo.
Inkastoo kooxdu ay sheegtay inaysan hadda qorshaynayn inay ceyriyaan Rosenior, Sherwood ayaa qaba in 41-jirkan uusan sii joogi doonin Stamford Bridge. Isagoo la hadlayay Sky Sports, Sherwood wuxuu yiri: “Waxay ahayd koox tartamaysa oo ka hor intaysan xaaladdu sidan isu beddelin. Waxaan arkayay ciyaartoyda iyagoo dhammaadkii u tegaya taageerayaasha, iyadoo badhkood ay garoonka ka baxeen 20 daqiiqo ka hor.”
Sherwood ayaa dhaleeceeyay xeeladaha tababaraha isagoo yiri: “Wuxuu adeegsaday shan daafac qaybtii hore, waxayna ahayd wax laga xishoodo inta boos ee ay Brighton heshay. Rosenior wuxuu nasiib lahaa in qaybtii hore hal gool oo qura lagu hoggaaminayay.”
Wuxuu hadalkiisa kusoo gaba-gabeeyay: “Ma jecli inaan tan sheego, laakiin waxaa jira mudaaharaadyo iyo calamo ka dhan ah BlueCo; uma malaynayo inuu u barordiiqi doono, Liam Rosenior uma adkaysan doono tan, waxay u tahay nasiib darro. Waa shaqo aad u adag in tababare kasta uu beddelo jawiga sababtoo ah taageerayaasha Chelsea waxay ku soo koreen ku guulaysiga koobab waaweyn.”
Chelsea ayaa usbuucii hore sidoo kale 1-0 guuldarro ah kala kulantay Manchester United, taas oo shaki weyn gelisay inay u soo baxaan Champions League xilli-ciyaareedka dambe.

headline: Pep Guardiola Oo Markii Ugu Horreysay Ka Hadlay Fursadaha Ay Arsenal Ugu Guuleysan Karto Horyaalka Xilli Ciyaareed Kaan
body:
Tababaraha Manchester City, Pep Guardiola, ayaa mar kale amaan ugu qubeeyay kooxda Arsenal ka hor safarka ay caawa oo Arbaco ah ugu baxayaan kooxda Burnley.
Manchester City ayaa haysata fursad ay ku dhaafaan Gunners oo ay kula wareegi karaan hoggaanka horyaalka Premier League haddii ay guul gaaraan. In kasta oo kooxda Guardiola ay 2-1 ku garaacday Arsenal maalintii Axadda, haddana Pep ayaa aaminsan in kooxda ay tartanka kula jiraan ay ka mid tahay kooxaha ugu fiican xitaa guud ahaan qaaradda Yurub.
“Marka aan joogo dhinaca garoonka oo aan arko Arsenal, waxaan ku farxaa inaan kula loollamo horyaalka,” ayuu yiri Guardiola. “Waa koox heer sare ah, oo u taagan inay ku guuleysato Champions League, waana hoggaamiyeyaasha horyaalka.”
Wuxuu intaas ku daray isagoo qeexaya dhibka ay leedahay ka hortaggooda: “Waa inaad dhididdaa, dhididdaa, oo aad si adag u dagaallantaa si aad u garaacdo; wax kasta ayay haystaan! Aad iyo aad ayay u tartamaan, xagga maskaxda iyo waxyaabo badan oo kale ayay si fiican u qabtaan.”
Pep ayaa sidoo kale tilmaamay in Arsenal ay tahay koox dhinac kasta ka dhisan: “Markay baaska gaaban ciyaarayaan, si fiican ayay u ciyaaraan. Laadadka xorta ah iyo koonayaashuna markey kugu helaan waagaa kugu baryaya. Taas ayaa ah sababta u amaanayo. Ciyaartoydaydu way ogyihiin taas, wayna dareensan yihiin.”

headline: Chelsea Oo Boodhka Ka Jafatay Rikoodh Xun Oo Ay Dhigtay 114 Sano Ka Hor
body:
Kooxda Chelsea ayaa gaartay meeshii ugu hoosaysay xilli-ciyaareedkan ka dib markii 3-0 lagu garaacay ciyaartii ay la lahaayeen Brighton habeenkii Talaadada.
Kaliya ma ahan inay guuldarraysteen shan kulan oo Premier League ah oo xiriir ah, balse waxay sidoo kale ku guuldarraysteen inay dhaliyaan hal gool mudadaas. Tani waa markii ugu horreysay ee ay kooxdu la kulanto rikoor xun oo caynkan ah tan iyo bishii Noofambar 1912—oo hadda laga joogo 114 sano. Xilligaas fog, Chelsea waxay ku dhamaysatay kaalinta 18-aad, iyadoo si dirqi ah kaga badbaadday inay u laabato heerka labaad.
Inkastoo kooxdan hadda jirta ay fadhido kaalinta toddobaad ee kala horreynta horyaalka, haddana waxaa jirta cabsi xooggan oo ah inay hoos ugu dhici karaan qaybta dambe ee miiska haddii natiijooyinka kooxaha kale ay sare u kacaan.
Guuldarradan taariikhiga ah ayaa culays hor leh ku kordhinaysa hoggaanka kooxda iyo taageerayaasha oo markii horeba ka walwalsanaa habka ay wax u socdaan.

headline: Jamie Carragher Oo Digniin Culus U Diray Arsenal Ka Hor Kulanka Atletico Madrid
body:
Jamie Carragher ayaa digniin culus u diray kooxda Arsenal inkasta oo ay haystaan kulamo u muuqda kuwo ka fudud kuwa kooxaha kale, haddana ka qaybgalkooda tartanka Champions League-ga uu caqabad ku noqon karo loolanka horyaalka Premier League ee ay kula jiraan Man City.
“Uma malaynayo in Arsenal ay filanayso inay guulaysato dhamaan kulamadeeda, laakiin shaki kuma jiro inay haystaan kulamada ugu fudud,” ayuu yiri Carragher.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray: “Waxaan u malaynayaa in kulamada ay la leeyihiin Atletico Madrid ay wax badan ka qaadi doonaan dhanka jismiga iyo dhanka maskaxdaba. Taasina waa wax weyn marka aad eegto Arsenal hadda; ma ahan oo kaliya tayada ciyaartoyda, balse waa dhanka jismiga iyo sida ay dareemayaan. Ma noqon doonto wax fudud.”
Arsenal ayaa u safri doonta magaalada Madrid usbuuca soo socda ka hor inta aysan lix casho ka dib martigelin Atletico ciyaarta nus-dhammaadka ee Champions League. Labadaas kulan inta ay u dhaxeeysa, waxay garoonkooda kula ciyaari doonaan kooxda Fulham kulan ka tirsan horyaalka Premier League.

headline: Petr Cech Oo Shaaciyay Dhibaatada Ugu Weyn Ee Heysata Chelsea Xilli Ciyaareed Kaan
body:
Goolhayihii hore ee halyeyga u ahaa kooxda Chelsea, Petr Cech, ayaa ku doodaya in kooxda hadda joogta Stamford Bridge aysan u tartami karin horyaalka Premier League iyada oo aysan jirin khibrad ku filan safka kooxda.
“Waxaan u malaynayaa marka aad eegto kooxda iyo isbedbedelka dhanka qaab-ciyaareedka ah ee ay la kulmeen xilli-ciyaareedkan, iyo waliba isbeddelada dhanka tababarayaasha iyo ciyaartoyda ah, waxaa jira isbeddelo aad u badan,” ayuu Cech u sheegay Canal Plus.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray: “Taas waxay la macno tahay in weli aysan jirin xasilloonidii iyo dardartii kooxda. Waxaan aaminsanahay in taasi ay u baahan tahay waqti. Uma arko kooxdan inay yihiin kuwo macquul ah oo la tartami kara Manchester City ama Arsenal, ama kooxaha kale.
Chelsea waxaa ka maqan khibrad, iyo sidoo kale ciyaartoy horay ugu soo guulaystay koobab oo saftay kulamo waaweyn.”
Cech ayaa hadalkiisa kusoo gaba-gabeeyay: “Waqtigan xaadirka ah, waxaa jira hibo badan, balse waxaa jirta khibrad la’aan sababtay in la lumiyo dhibco badan.”
Hadalkan ayaa imanaya xilli Chelsea ay la tacaalayso sidii ay u heli lahayd qaab-ciyaareed joogto ah, iyadoo xiddigo badan oo da’ yar ay qayb ka yihiin dhismaha cusub ee kooxda.

headline: Liam Rosenior: “Waxba Igama Galin Buuqa Iyo Af-lagaaddada Taageerayaasha”
body:
Intii ay socotay ciyaartii Chelsea 3-0 looga adkaaday ee ay la lahayd Brighton, taageerayaasha kooxda ayaa si isdaba joog ah ugu heesayay ereyo ka dhan ah tababare Liam Rosenior, iyagoo dalbanayay inuu kooxda ka tago.
“Waan fahmi karaa caradooda, waana shaqadayda maadaama aan ahay madaxa tababarka iyo maamulaha kooxda. Mas’uuliyaddu aniga ayaa leh,” ayuu tababaraha Chelsea u sheegay Sky Sports markii wax laga weydiiyay heesahaas.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray: “Maqaarkaygu waa adag yahay (samir baan leeyahay), waana fahmayaa sababta ay taageerayaashu u niyad-jabsan yihiin. Aniguba waan ka niyad-jabsanahay qaab-ciyaareedka aan soo bandhigayno. Waa inaan sii wadaa inaan si adag ula shaqeeyo shaqaalaha iyo ciyaartoyda, laakiin waxa aan u baahanahay inaan sameeyo waa inaan si dhab ah u eego sida aan u galno ciyaaraha iyo ciyaartoyda aan aamini karo xilliyada adag, sababtoo ah ciyaartoy badan ma aysan muujin taas maanta.”
Rosenior oo hadalkiisa sii wata ayaa yiri: “Waxaan ahay qof dareen leh. Wixii maanta dhacay waa wax aan la aqbali karin. Ereyga saxda ah waa ‘aan la aqbali karin’. Waxaan weynay boqolkiiba 80 ee loolankii fool-ka-foolka ahaa. Madax kuma aynaan guulaysan.
Laba ka mid ah goolasha waxay dhasheen annagoo awoodna inaan kubbadda madax ku bixino, taas oo ah aasaaska kubbadda cagta. Heer kasta oo aad joogto, haddii aad samayso khaladaadkaas oo kale, guul gaari maysid.”

headline: Malouda: “Estevao Hala Barbar-dhigina Hazard”
body:
Xiddigii hore ee kooxda Chelsea, Florent Malouda, ayaa uga digay taageerayaasha kooxda inay xiddiga da’da yar ee Estevao la barbar dhigaan halyeyga kooxdaas ee Eden Hazard.
Sida uu qabo xiddigan reer Faransa, barbar-dhigga noocan ahi ma caawin doonto 18-jirka reer Brazil, wuxuuna yiri: “Waa in aynaan Estevao la barbar dhigin Hazard. Taas ma caawin doonto isaga. Hazard waa ciyaaryahan halyey ah oo ku guuleystay koobab badan, isbeddel weyna sameeyay. Laakiin xaaladuhu aad bay u kala duwan yihiin.”
Estevao ayaa xagaagii hore kaga soo biiray Chelsea kooxda Palmeiras, isagoo wata rajo weyn ka dib bandhiggii cajiibka ahaa ee uu ka sameeyay dalkiisa Brazil. Xiddigan ayaa qandaraas kula jira kooxda ka dhisan London ilaa bisha June ee sanadka 2033-ka.

headline: Tartanka Gooldhalinta Horyaallada Europe Oo Meel Xiiso Leh Maraya; Kumaa Hoggaaminaya?
body:
Xiddiga weerarka uga ciyaara kooxda Bayern Munich, Harry Kane, ayaa hadda hoggaaminaya liiska gool-dhalinta qaaradda Yurub ee xilli-ciyaareedkan, ka dib markii la soo gaba-gabeeyay kulammadii horyaallada ee usbuucii hore.
Kabtanka xulka England ayaa hoggaanka ku haya 32 gool oo uu u dhaliyay Bayern Munich 27 kulan oo uu saftay, isagoo gool ka dhaliyay ciyaartii ay 4-2 kaga guuleysteen kooxda VfB Stuttgart maalintii Axadda.
Kaalinta labaad waxaa ku jira Luis Suarez oo u ciyaara kooxda Benfica, kaas oo leh 24 gool, halka Kylian Mbappe uu kaalinta saddexaad ku jiro isagoo 23 gool u dhaliyay kooxda Real Madrid.
Sidoo kale, Ayase Ueda oo u ciyaara Feyenoord ayaa isna leh 23 gool, waxaana ku xiga Erling Haaland oo Manchester City u saxiixay 23 gool ka dib goolkii guusha ee uu ka dhaliyay Arsenal, taas oo ka dhigtay inuu u soo gurguurto kaalinta shanaad.
Liiska tobanka ugu sarreeya waxaa dhammaystiraya ciyaartoyda kala ah: Paul Onuachu (Trabzonspor) oo leh 22 gool, Vangelis Pavlidis (Benfica), Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) iyo Igor Thiago (Brentford) oo min 21 gool leh, halka Yanis Begraoui oo u ciyaara Estoril Praia uu ku jiro kaalinta tobnaad isagoo leh 19 gool.
Tartanka loogu jiro kabta dahabka ah ee Yurub ayaa la filayaa inuu sii kululaado toddobaadyada soo socda marka ay horyaalladu marayaan meel xasaasi ah.

headline: Paul Scholes Oo Farta Ku Fiiqay Xiddigaha Ay United U Baahan Tahay Si Ay Ugu Geeleysato koobab
body:
Halyeyga Manchester United, Paul Scholes, ayaa magacaabay saddex xiddig oo uu u arko “bartilmaameedyo macquul ah” oo ay tahay inay kooxdu u dhaqaaqdo, isagoo dhanka kalena beddelay aragtidiisii hore ee ku aaddanayd Declan Rice oo uu hadda ku tilmaamay saxiixa uu ku riyoonayo.
“Waxaan u malaynayaa inaan dooran lahaa Declan Rice. Waan ogahay inaan mar hore wax yar naqdiyay, laakiin waxaan u malaynayaa inay Manchester United u baahan tahay qof isaga oo kale ah. Waxay u baahan yihiin xiddig khadka dhexe ah oo dhab ah,” ayuu yiri Scholes.
Scholes ayaa ka horyimid fikradda ah in kooxda ay ku adkaato soo xero-gelinta xiddigo waaweyn, isagoo yiri: “Ma aaminsani inay jiraan ciyaartoy ama tababarayaal aysan United Keeni karin. Waxaan qabaa in qof kasta uu imaan karo United.”
Marka laga soo tago Rice, Scholes ayaa farta ku fiiqay saddex magac oo kale oo uu aaminsan yahay inay xoojin karaan khadka dhexe ee kooxda: “Kuwa hadda laga hadlayo waa Elliot Anderson, Adam Wharton, iyo Sandro Tonali, kaasina waa booska ay United u baahan tahay inay xoojiso.”
Hadalladan ayaa imaanaya xilli Manchester United ay isha ku hayso dib-u-dhiska kooxda marka uu furmo suuqa kala iibsiga ee xagaaga, si ay mar kale ugu tartamaan koobabka waaweyn.

headline: Pep Guardiola Oo Xaqiijiyay Dhaawaca Xiddig Muhiim U Ah Kooxdiisa
body:
Tababaraha kooxda Manchester City, Pep Guardiola, ayaa xaqiijiyay in xiddigiisa khadka dhexe ee Rodri uu seegi doono kulanka Premier League ee ay habeenka Arbacada la ciyaarayaan kooxda Burnley.
Rodri ayaa dhaawac dhanka gumaarka ah uu ka soo gaaray intii ay socotay ciyaartii ay 2-1 kaga badisay Arsenal maalintii Axadda. Xiddiga reer Spain ayaan weli ka soo kaban dhaawacaas, taas oo ka dhigan in uusan diyaar u ahayn safarka ay ku tegayaan garoonka Turf Moor.
Waxa kale oo jira walaac weyn oo ku aaddan in Rodri uu sidoo kale seegi karo ciyaarta nus-dhammaadka ee tartanka FA Cup-ka oo ay dhammaadka usbuucan la ciyaari doonaan kooxda Southampton.
“Waxaan u malaynayaa inuusan diyaar u noqon doonin kulanka berrito,” ayuu yiri Guardiola xilli uu la hadlayay saxaafadda ka hor kulanka Burnley. “Waan eegi doonnaa kulamada soo socda, ha noqoto nus-dhammaadka FA Cup-ka ee aan la ciyaarayno Southampton ama ciyaarta Premier League ee aan 12 maalmood ka dib la leenahay Everton.”
Maqnaanshaha Rodri ayaa dhabar-jab weyn ku ah Manchester City, iyadoo kooxdu ay ku jirto marxalad xasaasi ah oo ay u tartamayso hanashada saddex koob, kuwaa oo kala ah Premier League, FA Cup, iyo Champions League.

headline: DEG-DEG: Barcelona Oo Heshiis Hordhac Ah La Gaartay Alessandro Bastoni
body:
Sida ay werisay jariidada La Gazzetta dello Sport, kooxda Barcelona ayaa heshiis hordhac ah la gaartay daafaca kooxda Inter Milan, Alessandro Bastoni, si uu ugu biiro xagaaga soo socda, isagoo saxiixi doona qandaraas shan sano ah oo ku eg ilaa 2031.
Daafaca dhexe ee reer Talyaani ayaa ogolaaday inuu u wareego garoonka Camp Nou, isagoo dareensan inuu diyaar u yahay cutub cusub oo ka mid ah waayihiisa ciyaareed. Barcelona ayaa qorshaynaysa inay wadahadallo rasmi ah la furto Inter si heshiiskan loo soo afjaro ka hor inta aanu bilaaban koobka Adduunka ee 2026.
Hadda waxaa dhiman wadahadallada qaybta ugu adag, maadaama kooxda reer Catalan ay caqabad kala kulmayso lacagta ay Inter ku qiimaysay xiddigan oo gaaraysa 70 milyan oo Yuuro. Bastoni ayaa dhankiisa diyaar u ah inuu la xaajoodo maamulka Inter si hoos loogu dhigo lacagta lagu iibsanayo.
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, xiddigan reer Talyaani ayaa go’aansaday inuu sii joogo kooxdiisa Inter haddii ay dhacdo in labada kooxood ay ku heshiin waayaan heshiiska.

headline: Paul Scholes Oo Ka Soo Horjeestay In Carrick Loo Magacaabo Tababaraha Joogtada Ee United
body:
Kooxda Manchester United ayaa u dhowaatay inay boos ka hesho tartanka Champions League-ga ka dib guushii ay ka gaartay Chelsea, waxaana hadda ka xiga inay xaqiijistaan booskooda kaliya lix dhibcood.
Michael Carrick ayaa kooxda geliyay xaalad adag oo dhanka tartanka ah, balse halyeyga kooxdaas ee Paul Scholes ayaa ku baaqay in laga digtoonaado in Carrick si joogto ah loogu magacaabo xilka tababarenimo, isagoo uga digay maamulka inay qaataan go’aan degdeg ah oo ku dhisan dareen kaliya, inkastoo ay muuqato horumar dhanka qaab-ciyaareedka ah.
“Waxaan u malaynayaa inay muhiim tahay inuusan dareen na qaadin oo aynaan ku dhex milmin shucuurta. Kulankii Leeds ee toddobaadkii hore, ma u malaynayseen inay arrintu dhammaatay,” ayuu yiri Scholes.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray isagoo ka hadlayay walaaciisa: “Waxaan eegayay Michael, waxaana u cabsanayay isaga. Leeds ayaa ku sarraysay ciyaarta, waxaana naftayda ku lahaa ‘wax uun sameey’.”
Scholes ayaa aaminsan in inkastoo guulaha dhowaan la gaaray ay yihiin kuwo dhiirigelin leh, haddana loo baahan yahay in si degan loo qiimeeyo mustaqbalka tababarenimo ee kooxda ka hor inta aan go’aan rasmi ah la gaarin.

Savinho ayaa qarka u saarnaa inuu xagaagii hore ku biiro kooxda Tottenham, balse kooxda reer London ayaa diidday heshiiskaas xilligaas. headline: 9 Xiddig Oo Ka Tagaya Liverpool Dhammaadka Xilli Ciyaareedka
body:
Kooxda Liverpool ayaa qorshaynaysa inay isbeddel ballaaran ku samayso safkeeda marka uu furmo suuqa kala iibsiga ee xagaaga, iyadoo la filayo inay kooxda ka baxaan ilaa 9 ciyaaryahan. Tallaabadan ayaa qayb ka ah qorshaha tababare Arne Slot uu ku doonayo inay kooxdu waji cusub ku yeelato ka hor xilli-ciyaareedka soo socda.
Sida ay sheegayaan wararka laga helayo saxaafadda, bixitaanka xiddiga reer Masar ee Mohamed Salah ayaa horay loo xaqiijiyay, ka dib markii uu bishii Maarso ee la soo dhaafay shaaciyay inuu ka tegayo kooxda.
Salah ayaa soo afjaraya mid ka mid ah waayihii ugu guulaha badnaa ee taariikhda Liverpool, waxaana bixitaankiisu uu dhib weyn ku noqon doonaa dhismaha weerarka kooxda.
Difaaca bidix ee Andy Robertson ayaa isna la filayaa inuu macasalaameeyo kooxda ka dib markii uu hoos u dhacay ka qayb galkiisa xilli-ciyaareedkan, iyadoo kooxda Tottenham ay xiisaynayso saxiixiisa. Sidoo kale, liiska xiddigaha baxaya waxaa ku jira Alexis Mac Allister; go’aankan oo dad badan ka yaabiyay ayaa yimid ka dib markii uu soo bandhigay qaab-ciyaareed aan fadhiyin qaybtii dambe ee xilli-ciyaareedka.
Waxaa sidoo kale shaki weyn uu ku jiraa mustaqbalka xiddigaha kala ah Curtis Jones, Federico Chiesa, iyo Joe Gomez, kuwaas oo saameyntoodii kooxdu ay yaraatay. Dhanka kale, Harvey Elliott, Calvin Ramsay, iyo Rhys Williams ayaa iyagana la filayaa inay qayb ka noqdaan qorshaha dib-u-dhiska ee kooxda bixi doonta.
Tallaabooyinkan la filayo ayaa muujinaya isbeddelka weyn ee ka dhici doona gudaha Liverpool, xilli kooxdu ay u diyaar garoobayso cutub cusub oo taariikhdeeda ka mid ah, iyadoo xagaagan loo arko mid ka mid ah kuwii ugu muhiimsanaa ee soo mara kooxda sanadihii u dambeeyay.

headline: Lamine Yamal: “Waxaan Doonayaa Inaan Mar Kale Koobka Adduunka Ka Dejiyo Spain”
body:
Xiddiga garabka uga ciyaara kooxda Barcelona iyo xulka Spain, Lamine Yamal, ayaa warbaahinta la wadaagay dareenkiisa ku aaddan koobka Adduunka ee 2026-ka, xilli uu ka hadlayay xafladda abaalmarinta Laureus.
“Aad baan u faraxsanahay. Tan iyo markii aan yaraa, waxaan ku riyoon jiray inaan ka qayb galo koobka Adduunka, inaan hooyaday ku arko tarabuunka, iyo inaan matalo xulka qarankayga… labadan bilood ee soo socda waxay iila muuqdaan kuwo aad u gaaban, dabcan waxaan rajaynayaa inaan noqono horyaalka,” ayuu yiri xiddigan hibada gaarka ah leh.
Yamal ayaa door muhiim ah ka qaatay guushii xulka Spain ee koobka Euro 2024, wuxuuna hadda higsanayaa inuu saameyn la mid ah ku yeesho koobka Adduunka ee foodda nagu soo hayo.
Xiddigan ayaa ku jira qaab-ciyaareedkiisii ugu fiicnaa xilli-ciyaareedkan, isagoo dhaliyay 23 gool, caawiyayna 18 kale tartammada oo dhan, taas oo war farxad leh u ah taageerayaasha xulka La Roja.

headline: Jamie Carragher: Mikel Arteta Lama Ceyrinayo Xitaa Haddii……..
body:
Jamie Carragher ayaa aaminsan in Mikel Arteta uusan wajihi doonin shaqo ka eryis xataa haddii Arsenal ay horyaalka Premier League-ga ku dhamaysato kaalinta labaad markii afraad oo xiriir ah.
Arsenal ayaa haysatay fursad ay 12 dhibcood ku qabato hoggaanka horaantii bishan, balse guuldarro lama filaan ah oo gurigooda ay kaga soo gaartay Bournemouth ayaa hakisay dardartii ay lahaayeen. Farqiga dhibcaha ayaa hadda hoos ugu dhacay saddex dhibcood oo qura, iyadoo Manchester City uu baaqi u yahay hal kulan.
Kooxda Pep Guardiola ayaa sii xoojisay rajadeeda horyaalka ka dib markii ay 2-1 ku garaacday Arsenal garoonka Etihad. City ayaa hadda u safraysa kooxda Burnley, halkaas oo haddii ay guul gaaraan ay markii ugu horreysay tan iyo bishii Oktoobar ku fariisan doonaan hoggaanka horyaalka, halka Arsenal ay isu diyaarinayso inay martigeliso Newcastle kulan muhiim ah oo go’aamin kara rajadooda koobka.
In kasta oo uu jiro culays weyn oo ku aaddan tartanka Arsenal, Carragher ayaa yiri: “Uma malaynayo inuu Mikel Arteta ku weynayo shaqadiisa hadii mar kale uu fashilmo, wax saas ah ma jiraan. Laakiin tani waxay u muuqataa mid ka duwan xilli-ciyaareedyadii hore, sababtoo ah marna ma dareemin inay yihiin kooxda ugu fiican horyaalka.”
Wuxuu intaas ku daray: “Waxaan u malaynayaa in inta badan xilli-ciyaareedkan dadka badankiisu ay dareemayeen in Arsenal ay haysato safka iyo kooxda ugu fiican, haddana nasiib-darro waxay wax walba isbeddelayaan xilliga gabaabsiga.
Horay waxaan had iyo jeer u dareemi jirnay in Liverpool ama City ay ka sarreeyeen Arsenal, balse xilli-ciyaareedkan saas ma dareemayn, waxaana jirtay xilli ay sagaal dhibcood ku hoggaaminayeen horyaalka.”

headline: Liverpool Oo Go’aan Ka Gaartay Ciyaaryahanka Ay Ku Beddeleyso Mo Salah
body:
Kooxda Liverpool ayaa u calaamadsatay garabka kooxda RB Leipzig, Yan Diomande, bartilmaameedkooda koowaad ee ay ku beddelayaan Mohamed Salah, sida uu sheegay suxufiga caanka ah ee Florian Plettenberg.
Maamulka sare ee Liverpool ayaa la fahamsan yahay inay si buuxda u ansixiyeen saxiixa xiddigan, iyadoo kooxdu ay kordhisay dadaalkeeda ka hor inta uusan furmin suuqa kala iibsiga ee xagaaga. Inkastoo wadahadallo ay hadda uga socdaan wakiilladiisa shirkadda Roc Nation Sports, haddana weli ma jirto wax heshiis ah oo laga gaaray dhanka rasmiga ah, loomana gudbin gorgortanka u dhexeeya labada kooxood.
Kooxda RB Leipzig ayaa dhankeeda doonaysa inay xajisato xiddigan, iyadoo qorshaynaysa inay u kordhiso mushaharka iyo muddada qandaraaskiisa. balse, loolanka loogu jiro Diomande ayaa sii kululaanaya, maadaama kooxda Paris Saint-Germain ay iyaduna tartanka ku jirto, horayna ay wadahadallo ula yeelatay wakiilladiisa.
Yan Diomande ayaa soo qaatay xilli-ciyaareed aad u wanaagsan, isagoo RB Leipzig u saftay 32 kulan tartammada oo dhan, waxaana uu u dhaliyay 13 gool, halka uu caawiyay 7 kale. Bandhiggan cajiibka ah ayaa ka dhigay mid ka mid ah xiddigaha loogu doonista badan yahay qaaradda Yurub si uu u buuxiyo booska bannaan ee laga yaabo inuu ka tago Mohamed Salah.

headline: Manchester United Oo War Farxad Leh Ka Heshay Xaaladda Cunha Iyo Yoro Ka Hor Kulanka Brentford
body:
Cunha iyo Yoro ayaa la filayaa inay taam u noqdaan kulanka Manchester United ay la ciyaari doonto kooxda Brentford 27-ka Abriil, ka dib markii ay soo baxeen warar sheegaya inay ka soo kabanayaan dhaawacyo fudud.
Cunha ayaa laga saaray garoonka daqiiqaddii 81-aad ee kulankii Chelsea ka dib markii uu dareemay xanuun dhanka gumaarka ah, halka Yoro uu dhaawac yar ku soo gaaray tababarkii ka horreeyay ciyaartii Stamford Bridge.
Sida ay sheegtay shabakadda ESPN, maamulka United ayaa rajo weyn ka qaba inay labadan ciyaaryahan soo laabtaan, maadaama uu jiro nasasho sagaal casho ah oo u dhaxaysa labada kulan, taas oo muhiim u ah soo kabsashadooda.
Soo laabashada labadan xiddig ayaa muhiimad weyn u leh kooxda; Cunha ayaa xilli-ciyaareedkan ahaa dookh muhiim ah oo dhanka weerarka ah, halka Yoro uu xoojin doono daafaca xilli ay ganaax ku maqan yihiin Harry Maguire iyo Lisandro Martinez.
Ka qayb galka labadan xiddig ee kulanka Brentford ayaa fure u noqon doona dadaalka United ee ku aaddan hagaajinta booskooda horyaalka dhamaadka xilli-ciyaareedka.

headline: Liam Rosenior Oo Ka Jawaabay Hadallo Lid Ku Ah Kooxdiisa Oo Uu Jeediyay Palmer
body:
Ka hor kulankii Chelsea iyo Manchester United, Cole Palmer ayaa sheegay: “Waxaan rajaynayaa inaan aniga iyo ciyaartoyda hadda wax badan kula guulaysanno Chelsea.
“Haddii aanaan u soo bixin Champions League, wax kasta waa ay isbeddelayaan. Waxaan u baahannahay inaan ku dhamaysanno boosaska loogu soo baxo Champions League.”
Kadib guuldarradii niyad-jabka lahayd ee ka soo gaartay shayaadiinta cas-cas (United), tababare Liam Rosenior ayaa ka hadlay hadallada Palmer iyo micnaha ay xambaarsan yihiin.
“Waxa aanan doonayn waa inaan halkan fariisto oo aan ka hadlo annaga oo aan u soo bixin Champions League, waayo weli waan u dagaallamaynaa,” ayuu yiri Rosenior.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray: “Ma wax kasta ayaa isbeddelaya? Maya. Dhamaanteen isku hadaf ayaan nahay, iyada oo ay yar tahay inaan Champions League u soo baxno iyo in kale, marka loo eego waxa ay kooxdan u baahan tahay mustaqbalka fog si ay u guulaysato.”

headline: Arsene Wenger Oo Saadaaliyay Kooxda Ku Guuleysaneysa Premier League Kadib Guuldarradii Arsenal Ee City
body:
Tababarihii hore ee kooxda Arsenal, Arsene Wenger, ayaa aaminsan in kooxdu ay weli ku guuleysan karto horyaalka Premier League-ga, inkastoo ay lumiyeen lix dhibcood oo muhiim ah labadii kulan ee u dambeeyay.
Gunners ayaa guuldarro 2-1 ah garoonkooda kagala kulmay kooxda Bournemouth, waxaana isla natiijadaas lagu garaacay kulankii ay Axaddii martida u ahaayeen Manchester City. Manchester City ayaa hadda fursad u haysata inay hoggaanka horyaalka kala wareegto Arsenal habeenka Arbacada haddii ay ka guuleystaan kooxda Burnley.
Wenger oo ka hadlayay barnaamijka Twinning Project ayaa ku adkaystay in Arsenal ay noqon doonto horyaalka Ingiriiska ka dib 22 sano oo ay sugayeen: “Waxaan aaminsanahay inay Arsenal ku guuleysan doonto horyaalka. Si dhab ah ayaan u aaminsanahay. Waxay iila muuqataa mid caqli-gal ah.”
Wuxuu sidoo kale ammaanay ciyaartoyda weerarka ee Arsenal isagoo yiri: “Waan ka helay qaabka ay wax u weerarayeen Eze, Odegaard, Havertz iyo Madueke (kulankii Etihad).”
Wenger ayaa hadalkiisa kusoo xiray inuusan fileyn in Manchester City ay guuleysato dhamaan kulamada u haray: “Manchester City ma sameyn doonto guulo xiriir ah oo aan joogsi lahayn ilaa dhamaadka.”

headline: Lamine Yamal Oo Magacaabay Ciyaaryahankii Ugu Fiicnaa Ee Abid Soo Mara Taariikhda Kubadda Cagta
body:
Xiddiga garabka uga ciyaara kooxda Barcelona, Lamine Yamal, ayaa u magacaabay kabtanka kooxda Inter Miami, Lionel Messi,  xiddigii ugu fiicnaa abid ee soo mara taariikhda kubbadda cagta.
Yamal oo u ciyaara xulka qaranka Spain ayaa sheegay in qof kastaa uu ixtiraam u hayo Messi marka loo eego waxyaabihii layaabka lahaa ee uu ka gaaray ciyaaraha.
Hadalkan ayaa yimid ka dib markii Yamal loo aqoonsaday xiddiga ku guuleystay abaalmarinta “Best Young Athlete” ee xafladdii Laureus Awards 2026 oo habeenkii Isniinta lagu qabtay magaalada Madrid.
“Leo Messi waa ciyaaryahankii ugu fiicnaa ee abid soo mara kubbadda cagta. Haddii uusan ahayn ciyaaryahankii ugu fiicnaa abid ee dhamaan ciyaaraha (athlete), hubaal wuxuu ka mid yahay kuwa ugu horreeya,” ayuu yiri Yamal sida ay soo xigatay Barça Universal. Wuxuu kaloo raaciyay: “Qof kastaa wuxuu ku ixtiraamaa waxyaabihii uu gaaray, waxaana rajaynayaa inaan raaco raadkiisa.”
Lionel Messi ayaa ah ciyaaryahanka ugu koobabka badan taariikhda, isagoo ku guuleystay in ka badan 45 koob intii uu ku jiray garoomada, oo uu ku jiro koobka Adduunka.
Messi oo hadda jira 38 sano, ayaa maraya dhammaadka waayihiisa ciyaareed, waxaana la filayaa inuu xulka Argentina u ciyaaro tartankii ugu dambeeyay ee koobka Adduunka xagaagan soo socda.

headline: Ruud Gullit Oo Daboolka Ka Rogay Dhibaatada Ugu Weyn Ee Heysata Chelsea Xilli Ciyaareed Kaan
body:
Xiddigii hore ee kooxda Chelsea, Ruud Gullit, ayaa daaha ka rogay dhibaatada weyn ee haysata kooxda Blues ka hor kulanka ay caawa oo Talaado ah la ciyaarayaan kooxda Brighton horyaalka Premier League.
Chelsea ayaa hadda fadhida kaalinta 6-aad ee kala sarreynta horyaalka ka dib markii ay guuldarro 1-0 ahi ka soo gaartay Manchester United dhammaadkii usbuucii la soo dhaafay. Kooxda ayaa wajahaysa khatar ah inay weyso booska loogu soo baxo tartanka Champions League-ga haddii aysan guuleysan shanta kulan ee ka haray xilli-ciyaareedka.
Gullit oo la hadlayay Daily Mail Sport ayaa sheegay in dhibaatada ugu weyn ee haysata kooxda Liam Rosenior ay tahay inay ka kooban tahay ciyaartoy dhalinyaro ah oo kaliya, kuwaas oo aad u degdeg badan.
Halyeyga reer Holland ayaa ku adkaystay in Chelsea ay u baahan tahay ciyaartoy khibrad leh oo rug-caddaa ah si ay wax u baraan dhalinyarada: “Waan fahamsanahay inay Chelsea rabto inay guuleysato, laakiin waxay haystaan ciyaartoy dhalinyaro ah oo kaliya. Waxaad u baahan tahay ruug-caddaa ciyaartoyda dhalinyarada ah ku bara tababarka waxa ay tahay inay sameeyaan. Waxay markasta ku celceliyaan khaladaad isku mid ah.”
Wuxuu tusaale u soo qaatay xiddigaha khadka dhexe ee Luka Modric iyo Toni Kroos, isagoo yiri: “Aad bay u degan yihiin, wax walba way fahamsan yihiin. Waxaad u baahan tahay inaad beddesho xawaarahaaga iyo wax walba. Ciyaartoyda sida Modric iyo Kroos oo kale waxay ku barayaan sida loo maareeyo ciyaarta, Chelsea-na taas ma haysato.”

Xiddigii hore ee Manchester United, Patrice Evra, ayaa ku adkaystay in kooxda Arsenal aysan ku guuleysan doonin horyaalka Premier League xilli-ciyaareedkan, isagoo saadaaliyay inay mar kale “fashilmi doonaan” xilli uu tartanku marayo meel xasaasi ah.
Evra oo ka soo muuqday barnaamijka Rio Ferdinand Presents podcast, ayaa sheegay in guuldarradii 2-1 ahayd ee ka soo gaartay Manchester City maalintii Axadda ay tahay calaamad muujinaysa in Gunners aysan weli haysan awood maskaxeed oo ay ku xamilaan cadaadiska weyn ee tartanka horyaalka.
“Taas ayaa ah sababta aan u leeyahay ma arko Arsenal… saddexda kulan ee ugu dambeeya, way isku furi doonaan,” ayuu yiri Evra. Wuxuu intaas ku daray: “Ma arko wax shaqsiyad ah oo kooxdan oo maareyn karta cadaadiskaas. Taas waa aragtidayda. Sida aan sheegay, waan khaldanaan karaa; dadku waxay dhihi karaan wuxuu neceb yahay Arsenal, laakiin City waxay sii wadi doontaa horay u socodka.”
Arsenal ayaa xilli-ciyaareedkan hoggaanka horyaalka haysay muddo 207 maalmood ah, balse guuldarradii Axadda ayaa ka dhigtay in dhibcaha ay ku hoggaaminayaan ay hoos ugu dhacaan saddex dhibcood oo kaliya, iyadoo Manchester City uu baaqi u yahay kulan ay la ciyaari doonaan Burnley.
Haddii Arsenal ay ku fashilanto inay koobka qaaddo sanadkan, waxay u noqon doontaa sannadkii afraad oo xiriir ah oo ay u dhowaadaan hanashada horyaalka balse ay ku fashilmaan marxaladaha ugu dambeeya, iyadoo ay hadda ka soo wareegtay 22 sano tan iyo markii ugu dambaysay ee ay horyaalka ku guuleystaan.

headline: Gary Lineker Oo Shaaciyay Hal Wax Oo Go’aamin Kara Tartanka Premier League Xilli Ciyaareed Kaan
body:
Halyeyga xulka qaranka England, Gary Lineker, ayaa muujiyay sida uu u taageersan yahay in Arsenal ay ku guuleysato horyaalkeedii ugu horreeyay ee Premier League muddo 22 sano ah, in kasta oo ay dhowaan guuldarro 2-1 ahi ka soo gaartay Manchester City.
Maalintii Axadda, Gunners waxay la kulmeen guuldarradii afraad ee soo gaarta lixdii kulan ee ugu dambeeyay tartammada oo dhan, ka dib markii lagu garaacay garoonka Etihad Stadium. Goolal ay dhaliyeen Rayan Cherki iyo Erling Haaland ayaa guusha siiyay City, halka goolka qura ee Arsenal uu u saxiixay Kai Havertz.
Guuldarradaas ka dib, Arsenal waxay weli fadhidaa hoggaanka horyaalka iyadoo leh 70 dhibcood ka dib 33 kulan, halka Manchester City ay kaalinta labaad ku jirto iyadoo leh 67 dhibcood balse uu baaqi u yahay hal kulan. City ayaa fursad u haysata inay hoggaanka qabato haddii ay ka guuleystaan kooxda Burnley habeenka Arbacada (22-ka Abriil).
Isagoo ka hadlayay barnaamijka The Rest Is Football podcast, Lineker ayaa sheegay in tartanka loogu jiro koobka uu go’aamin karo farqiga goolasha: “Ma ahan wax aan macquul ahayn in lagu kala bixi waayo farqiga goolasha, waayo tartanku aad buu isugu dhow yahay. Waa arrin xiiso u leh taageerayaasha dhexdhexaadka ah sababtoo ah qof walba wuxuu rabaa tartan adag ilaa dhammaadka.”
Lineker ayaa difaacay kooxda uu hoggaamiyo Mikel Arteta isagoo yiri: “Wax yar ayaan u naxayaa Arsenal; waxay wajahayaan caqabado, laakiin weli waxay ku jiraan nus-dhammaadka Champions League-ga, welina waxay u tartami karaan horyaalka Premier League-ga.
Dad badan ayaa dhihi doona ‘Arsenal way khalkhashay’, laakiin xilli-ciyaareedkan weli wuxuu u noqon karaa mid taariikhi ah. Anigu kama mid noqonayo dadka leh fursaddii ay koob ku qaadi lahaayeen bay khasaariyeen; weli waa xilli hore in go’aan saas ah la gaaro.”
Wuxuu hadalkiisa kusoo xiray in Arsenal ay muujisay adkeysi inkastoo natiijadu aysan u hiillin. Kooxda Arsenal ayaa hadda isku diyaarinaysa kulan adag oo ay Newcastle United la ciyaari doonaan Sabtida, ka hor inta aysan wajahin Atletico Madrid tartanka Champions League-ga 29-ka bishan Abriil.

headline: 10-ka Goolhaye Ee Ugu Mushaharka Badan Horyaallada Europe Ugu Waaweyn
body:

Goolhayaha ruug-caddaaga ah ee Manuel Neuer oo u ciyaara kooxda Bayern Munich ayaa hoggaaminaya liiska, isagoo sannadkii qaata 11.1 milyan oo Yuuro. Neuer ayaa ka sarreeya goolhayaha kooxda Fenerbahce, Ederson, iyo Jan Oblak oo ka tirsan Atletico Madrid.
Halkan kaga bogo 10-ka goolhaye ee ugu mushaharka badan Yurub iyo lacagta ay sannadkii helaan:

headline: Paul Scholes Oo Tilmaamay Khaladaadkii Arteta Uu Ku Dhacay Kulankii City
body:
Halyeyga Manchester United, Paul Scholes, ayaa farta ku fiiqay khaladaad uu aaminsan yahay in tababaraha Arsenal, Mikel Arteta, uu galay intii ay socotay ciyaartii ay 2-1 guuldarrada kala kulmeen Manchester City maalintii Axadda.
Isagoo ka hadlayay barnaamijka The Good, The Bad & The Football podcast, Scholes ayaa sheegay in Arteta uu beddelay xeeladdiisii ciyaareed, isagoo markan soo qaatay saf aad u weerar badan, taas oo uu u arkay mid khatar horseedday.
“Waxaan u malaynayaa in Arteta uu wax yar beddelay; ma ahan wax sahlan in la beddelo qaab aad muddo ku socotay. Si lama filaan ah ayuu ugu ciyaaray koox aad u weerar badan,” ayuu yiri Scholes. Wuxuu raaciyay in haddii uu tababaruhu rabay inuu dhab ahaan gool raadiyo, ay ahayd inuu garoonka ka saaro mid ka mid ah khadka dhexe ee daafaca sida Declan Rice ama Martin Zubimendi si uu weerarka u sii xoojiyo.
Khaladka labaad ee uu Scholes tilmaamay ayaa ahaa beddelkii Eberechi Eze, kaas oo uu u arkayay inuu saameyn weyn ku lahaa ciyaarta. “Markaad ciyaarta eegayso, waxaad arkaysaa in Eze uu si fiican u ciyaarayo, saameyn weynna uu ku leeyahay. Waxaan u malaynayaa in ciyaartoyda kale ay la yaabeen go’aankii garoonka looga saaray,” ayuu hadalkiisa ku soo xiray Scholes.
Guuldarradan ayaa Arsenal ka dhigtay inay lumin karaan hoggaanka horyaalka haddii Manchester City ay guul ka gaarto kulanka baaqiga u ah ee ay la ciyaarayaan Burnley bartamaha usbuucan.

body:
Kadib guuldarradii 2-1 ahayd ee Arsenal ka soo gaartay Manchester City maalintii Axadda, halyeyga kooxda Watford, Troy Deeney, ayaa si adag u naqdiyay bandhigga lix ciyaaryahan oo ka tirsan Gunners-ka, isagoo sheegay inay ku fashilmeen inay muujiyaan tayadooda kulankii ka dhacay Etihad Stadium.
Manchester City ayaa guusha ku hantiday goolal ay kala dhaliyeen Ryan Cherki iyo Erling Haaland, halka goolka qura ee Arsenal uu u saxiixay Kai Havertz, kaas oo u muuqday mid aan waxba ka beddelin natiijada ciyaarta.
Deeney oo ka soo muuqday barnaamijka CBS Sports ayaa yiri: “Qof kastaa wuxuu ka hadlaa sida ay City u wanaagsan tahay, laakiin aan xaqiiqada wajahno—Noni Madueke uma soo muuqan (sidii laga filayay), Martin Zubimendi uma soo muuqan, Martin Odegaard uma soo muuqan, Cristhian Mosquera uma soo muuqan, Piero Hincapie-na uma soo muuqan.”
Wuxuu sidoo kale si gaar ah farta ugu fiiqay saaxiibkiis Declan Rice isagoo yiri: “Waxaan kaloo weli shaki gelin karaa waxqabadka Rice, isagoo weliba saaxiibkay ah, isaga xitaa bandhig fiican muusan sameyn.”
Naqdigan ayaa imaanaya xilli Arsenal ay lumisay dhibco muhiim u ahaa horyaalka, iyadoo ciyaartoyda magaca weyn leh ee kooxda lagu eedeeyay inay khalkhaleen xilligii loogu baahida badnaa.

headline: Manchester City Oo Xaqiijisay Tagista Labo Xiddig Oo Muhiim Ah
body:
Laba ka mid ah xiddigaha ugu muhiimsan kooxda Manchester City ayaa la xaqiijiyay inay isaga tegi doonaan kooxda garoonka Etihad xagaagan, ka dib markii uu warkaas shaaciyay khabiirka suuqa kala iibsiga ee Fabrizio Romano.
Difaaca reer England, John Stones, ayaa la xaqiijiyay inuu kooxda ka tagi doono marka uu dhamaado xilli-ciyaareedkan. Stones ayaa noqonaya ciyaaryahankii labaad ee weyn ee bixitaankiisa la xaqiijiyo, ka dib markii kabtanka kooxda, Bernardo Silva, uu isna horay u shaaciyay inuu soo afjarayo sagaal sano oo uu la joogay kooxda Sky Blues.
Fabrizio Romano ayaa bartiisa Twitter-ka ku qoray: “John Stones waxaa la filayaa inuu ka tago Manchester City xagaaga isagoo ah ciyaaryahan xor ah. Difaacan 31-jirka ah wuxuu rabaa inuu kooxda caawiyo ilaa dhamaadka xilli-ciyaareedka, ka dibna la filayaa inuu baxo kadib markii uu taariikh weyn ka dhigay kooxda.”
Wuxuu intaas ku daray: “Bernardo iyo Stones, labaduba waxay baxayaan bisha Juun.”
Bixitaanka labadan ruug-caddaa ayaa calaamad u ah dhammaadka waa dahabi ah oo ay soo martay Manchester City, iyadoo tababare Pep Guardiola uu hadda wajahayo hawl adag oo uu ku beddelayo laba ka mid ah tiirarkii ugu waaweynaa ee kooxda ka caawiyay hanashada koobab badan.

headline: Xiddigaha Goolasha Ugu Badan Ku Lug Yeeshay Premier League Xilli Ciyaareed Kaan
body:
Xiddiga weerarka uga ciyaara kooxda Manchester City, Erling Haaland, ayaa hadda hoggaaminaya liiska ciyaartoyda goolasha ugu badan ka qayb qaatay (goolal iyo caawin) horyaalka Premier League xilli-ciyaareedkan 2025/26.
Sida ay muujinayso xogta u dambaysay ee Squawka Football, xiddiga xulka qaranka Norway ayaa ku lug yeeshay 30 gool (23 uu dhaliyay iyo 7 uu caawiyay) ilaa hadda. Haaland ayaa noqday ciyaaryahankii ugu horreeyay ee gaara tiradan ka dib goolkii uu ka dhaliyay Arsenal kulankii Axaddii ay City ku guuleysatay 2-1.
Halkan kaga bogo 10-ka ciyaaryahan ee ugu goolal iyo caawinta badan Premier League-ga xilli-ciyaareedkan:
1. Erling Haaland (Man City) – 30
2. Bruno Fernandes (Man Utd) – 26
3. Igor Thiago (Brentford) – 22
4. Joao Pedro (Brighton) – 19
5. Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) – 19
6. Harry Wilson (Fulham) – 16
7. Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) – 16
8. Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool) – 15
9. Rayan Cherki (Man City) – 14
10. Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottm Forest) – 14

headline: Tim Sherwood Oo Magacaabay Xiddig Man City Ah Oo Arsenal Ka Caawiyay Inay Kusii Jirto Tartanka Horyaalka
body:
Tababarihii hore ee kooxda Aston Villa, Tim Sherwood, ayaa sheegay in weeraryahanka Manchester City, Erling Haaland, uu yahay ninka badbaadiyay rajada Arsenal ee hanashada horyaalka, ka dib markii uu diiday inuu dhulka isku tuuro markii ay isku dhaceen daafaca Gabriel Magalhaes maalintii Axadda.
Haaland ayaa dhaliyay goolka guusha ee ay City 2-1 ugu garaacday Gunners, taas oo ka dhigtay in City ay hadda saddex dhibcood oo qura u jirsato hoggaanka. Ciyaarta oo dhan, labada ciyaaryahan ayaa ku jiray loolan adag oo dhanka xoogga ah.
Dhacdo aad u hadal hayn badan ayaa timid daqiiqaddii 84-aad, markii ay labada ciyaaryahan is-hor istaageen kadib loolan dhex maray, waxaana la arkayay Gabriel oo madaxiisa ku riixaya wejiga Haaland. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, garsoore Anthony Taylor ayaa labada ciyaaryahanba ku ciqaabay calaamadda huruudda ah oo kaliya.
Haddii Gabriel la siin lahaa calaamadda guduudka ah, wuxuu muteysan lahaa ganaax saddex kulan ah, taas oo ka dhigan inay Arsenal weyn lahayd kulamada muhiimka ah ee ay la ciyaarayaan Newcastle, Fulham, iyo West Ham.
Sherwood ayaa yiri: “Waxaan u malaynayaa in Erling Haaland uu Arsenal kusoo celiyay tartanka horyaalka markii uu diiday inuu dhulka isku tuuro. Haddii uu dhici lahaa, boqolkiiba boqol casaan ayaa la siin lahaa Gabriel.”
Wuxuu raaciyay: “Gabriel wuxuu ahaa mid aad u wanaagsan xilli-ciyaareedkan, isaga iyo Declan Rice ayaa ahaa xiddigaha ugu muhiimsan Arsenal. Haddii ay weyn lahaayeen saddex kulan xilli lagu jiro dhamaadka horyaalka, taas waxay calaamad u noqon lahayd dhamaadka rajadooda horyaalka.”

headline: Gary Lineker Oo Saadaal Cusub Ka Bixiyay Kooxda Ku Guuleysaneysa Premier League Kadib Guuldarradii Arsenal Ee City
body:
Halyeyga xulka qaranka England, Gary Lineker, ayaa bixiyay saadaal cusub oo ku aaddan tartanka horyaalka Premier League ee u dhexeeya kooxaha Arsenal iyo Manchester City, ka dib markii uu isbeddel ku yimid hoggaanka horyaalka.
Isagoo ka hadlayay barnaamijka The Rest Is Football podcast, Lineker ayaa xusay in tartanka xilli-ciyaareedkan uu noqon karo mid lagu kala baxo farqiga goolasha, maadaama labada kooxood ay aad isugu dhow yihiin.
“Horyaalku wuxuu ku xirnaan karaa farqiga goolasha, waana mid aad iyo aad isugu dhow,” ayuu yiri Lineker.
Wuxuu sidoo kale u naxariistay kooxda Arsenal oo dhowaanahan dhibco muhiim ah lumineysay, isagoo yiri: “Wax yar ayaan u damqanayaa Arsenal, laakiin weli waxay ku jiraan nus-dhammaadka Champions League-ga, welina waxay ku guuleysan karaan horyaalka Premier League-ga.”
Lineker ayaa diiday inuu ku raaco dadka leh Arsenal way khalkhashay ama tartanka ayay iska dhiibtay, isagoo yiri: “Dad badan ayaa dhihi doona ‘Arsenal way isku dhex yaacday’, laakiin anigu kama mid noqonayo dadka raaca fikirka ah inay fursadda iska khasaariyeen, waayo weli waa xilli hore in go’aan saas ah la gaaro.”
Dagaalka loogu jiro koobka ayaa hadda maraya meel xasaasi ah, iyadoo Manchester City ay fursad u haysato inay hoggaanka la wareegto haddii ay guul ka gaarto kulanka  baaqiga u ah.

Lineker ayaa diiday inuu ku raaco dadka leh Arsenal way khalkhashay ama tartanka ayay iska dhiibtay, isagoo yiri: "Dad badan ayaa dhihi doona 'Arsenal way isku dhex yaacday', laakiin anigu kama mid noqonayo dadka raaca fikirka ah inay fursadda iska khasaariyeen, waayo weli waa xilli hore in go'aan saas ah la gaaro."
Dagaalka loogu jiro koobka ayaa hadda maraya meel xasaasi ah, iyadoo Manchester City ay fursad u haysato inay hoggaanka la wareegto haddii ay guul ka gaarto kulanka baaqiga u ah.

headline: Barcelona Oo Shuruudo Adag Dul-dhigtay Qandaraas Kordhinta Lewandowski
body:
Kooxda Barcelona ayaa shuruudo adag ku xirtay cusboonaysiinta qandaraaska weeraryahankeeda Robert Lewandowski, xilli heshiiskiisa haatan uu ku dhow yahay inuu dhamaado dhamaadka xilli-ciyaareedkan.
Sida ay qortay jariiradda ‘Marca’ ee ka soo baxda dalka Spain, maamulka Barcelona ayaa wakiilka ciyaaryahanka, Pini Zahavi, la wadaagay qorshaha ay ku doonayaan inay ku sii haystaan weeraryahankan rug-caddaaga ah.
Wararka ayaa sheegaya in kooxdu ay shuruud ka dhigtay in Lewandowski uu aqbalo in mushaharkiisa hadda loo dhimo kala bar (50%), iyo sidoo kale inuu aqbalo inuu door muhiim ah balse dhinaca keydka ah ka ciyaaro. Tani waxay ka dambaysay iyadoo kooxdu qorshaynayso inay la soo saxiixato weeraryahan cusub suuqa xagaaga ee soo socda si loo cusboonaysiiyo safka weerarka.
Go’aankan ayaa loo arkaa mid ay Barcelona ku dhimayso culeyska dhanka dhaqaalaha ah ee haysta, iyadoo dhanka kale doonaysa inay sii haysato khibradda Lewandowski ee qolka labiska si uu u caawiyo ciyaartoyda dhalinyarada ah.
Ilaa hadda, weeraryahanka u dhashay dalka Poland ma uusan gaarin go’aan rasmi ah oo ku saabsan mustaqbalkiisa, xilli ay jiraan kooxo dhowr ah oo danaynaya saxiixiisa kuwaas oo ka ciyaara qaaradaha Yurub, Ameerika, iyo sidoo kale horyaalka dalka Sacuudiga.

headline: Chelsea Oo Go’aan Kama Dambays Ah Kasoo Saartay Mustaqbalka Alejandro Garnacho
body:
Kooxda Chelsea ayaa diyaar u ah inay iska iibiso Alejandro Garnacho sannad uun ka dib markii uu £40m kaga soo biiray Manchester United, iyadoo kooxdu ay qirsan tahay in saxiixa xiddigan uusan u noqon sidii la filayay, sida ay werisay shabakadda talkSPORT.
Xiddigan 21-jirka ah ayaa ku dhibtooday inuu muujiyo qiimihii laga soo bixiyay, isagoo soo bandhigay qaab-ciyaareed hooseeya, iyadoo inta badan goolashii uu dhaliyay ay ahaayeen kuwo uu ka dhaliyay kooxaha heerarka hoose ka ciyaara.
Xaaladda adag ee uu ku jiro ayaa sii socotay kulankii dhowaan ay guuldarradu ka soo gaartay kooxdiisii hore ee United, halkaas oo uu ku guuldarraystay inuu wax saameyn ah ku yeesho ciyaarta.
Garnacho ayaa sidoo kale wajahay dhaleeceyn dhanka nolosha bannaanka ah, oo ay ka mid yihiin muranno dhanka baraha bulshada ah iyo maadaysi kaga imaanayay saaxiibbadiisii hore, taas oo sii kordhisay xilli-ciyaareedka niyad-jabka ah ee uu ku jiro.
