headline: “Waa Inaan Runta Wajahnaa!” – Rosenior Oo Ka Hadlay Dhibaatada Chelsea!
body:
Tababaraha kooxda Chelsea, Liam Rosenior, ayaa qiray in kooxdiisu xaalad aad u cakiran ku sugan tahay.Wuxuu caddeeyay inay ku dhibtoonayaan tiigsiga kaalmaha sare ee horyaalka Premier League, xilli ay isku diyaarinayaan kulan muhiim ah oo ay marti u noqon doonaan kooxda Brighton.
Rosenior oo ka hadlayay dareenkiisa ka hor safarkaas ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay in Chelsea aysan awoodin inay u adkeysato wixii horay u dhacay, inkastoo cadaadis xooggani uu saaran yahay.
“Dhib aad u weyn ayaan is galinnay. Waa inaan runta isku sheegnaa oo aan xaqiiqada wajahnaa. Waxa aan samayn karin ayaa ah inaan is dhiibno; waa inaan sii dagaallannaa,” ayuu yiri Rosenior.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray inay muhiim tahay in kulanka Brighton lala tago tamar iyo dardar la mid ah tii ay muujiyeen kulankii Manchester United, balse ay markan u baahan yihiin inay ka hufnaadaan khaladaadka difaaca;
“Waa inaan hubinnaa inaan Brighton ula tagno sifooyin la mid ah kuwii aan ku arkay ciyaartii Manchester United dhanka tamarta iyo xoogga, laakiin waxaan u baahannahay inaan noqonno kuwo go’aan qaadasho leh; labada sanduuqba, madaama aanan kulankii hore shabaqa ilaashan, fursadihiina aanan ka faa’iidaysan.”
Chelsea ayaa xilligan u halgamaysa inay ku dhameysato shanta kaalmood ee ugu sarreeya, taas oo loo arko inay dammaanad u tahay ka qaybgalka Champions League ee xilli-ciyaareedka dambe.
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Rosenior ayaa diiday inay saameyn ku yeelato hadal-haynta ku aaddan waxa dhici kara haddii ay waayaan booskaas.
“Uma malaynayo inay tahay inaan hadda saas u fekernno. Xaalad kasta oo timaada xilligeeda ayaan ka hadli doonnaa. Waqtigan xaadirka ah waa hawl adag, laakiin diirradda kaliya waa inaan berri ka badino kooxda Brighton oo aad u wanaagsan. Waa inaan hubinnaa inaan si aad u wanaagsan u tababaranno, diirraddayadana aan saarno sidii aan u guuleysan lahayn kulankan,” ayuu hadalkiisa kusoo xiray Rosenior.

headline: Ryan Giggs Oo Shaaciyay Hal Wax Ay Manchester United Ka Faa’iiday Amorim Intii Uu Kooxda Joogay
body:
Halyeyga Manchester United Ryan Giggs ayaa ugu baaqay taageerayaasha inay aqoonsadaan doorkii uu Ruben Amorim ka qaatay dhismaha kooxda, isagoo sheegay inuu isagu dhigay asaaska uu hadda ku guuleysanayo Michael Carrick, inkastoo waayihii Amorim ay ku dhammaadeen natiijooyin niyad-jab leh.
Giggs oo ka hadlayay qaabka uu Amorim u maamulay kooxda ayaa yiri: “Ruben Amorim dhaleeceyn badan ayaa loogu soo jeediyay qaab-ciyaareedkiisii. Ma aanan ku raaxaysan jirin daawashadeeda, laakiin dhab ahaantii, waxaan u malaynayaa in qaar ka mid ah ciyaartoydii uu la soo saxiixday ay ahaayeen kuwo wanaagsan.”
Wuxuu intaas ku daray in saameynta Amorim ay ka qoto dheer tahay dhibcaha garoonka: “Dhaxalkiisu ma fiicna marka loo eego natiijooyinka iyo bandhigyada, laakiin muddo dheer ka dib, wuxuu kooxda kaga tagay meel aad u wanaagsan. Calaamadda lagu garto tababaraha wanaagsan waa halka uu uga tago kooxda, isagu wuxuu keenay dhaqan ka duwan oo ka wanaagsan xilliyadii hore.”
Sida uu qabo Giggs, inkastoo natiijooyinkii Amorim ay ahaayeen kuwo adag, haddana nidaamkii iyo ciyaartoydii uu keenay ayay hadda kooxdu ku naalloonaysaa, taas oo sahashay in Michael Carrick uu si degdeg ah guulo u gaaro.

headline: Arsenal Mise Man City? Roy Keane & Patrick Vieira Oo Saadaaliyay Kooxda Ku Guulaysan Doonta Premier League.
body:
Halyeeyada Premier League-ga, Roy Keane iyo Patrick Vieira, ayaa bixiyay saadaal kala duwan oo ku aaddan kooxda ku guuleysan doonta horyaalka, ka dib markii Manchester City ay 2-1 ku garaacday Arsenal maalintii Axadda.
Patrick Vieira, oo ahaa kabtankii hore ee Arsenal, ayaa markan u xaglinaya dhanka kooxda Pep Guardiola isagoo cuskanaya dardarta ay la yimaadeen. “Dardartu waxay hadda jirsatay dhanka Manchester City. Waxay noqon doontaa mid xiiso leh in la arko sida ay Arsenal uga soo kabsato guuldarradan, waayo waa niyad-jab weyn oo soo gaartay. Hadda culayska ayaa ku sii kordhi doona,” ayuu yiri Vieira. Wuxuuna hadalkiisa raaciyay: “Waxaan aaminsanahay in City ay samayn doonto (oo ay horyaalka ku guuleysan doonto).”

headline: Liverpool Oo War Farxad Leh Ka Heshay Mustaqbalka Konate
body:
Ibrahima Konate ayaa xaqiijiyay inuu ku dhow yahay inuu qalinka ku duugo heshiis cusub oo uu ku sii joogayo kooxda Liverpool.
Difaaca reer France oo ka hadlayay mustaqbalkiisa ayaa yiri: “Mustaqbalkayga? Si dhab ah haddii loo hadlo, waxyaabo badan ayaa la sheegay laakiin muddo dheer ayaan wadahadal kula jirnay kooxda, waxaana ku dhow nahay inaan gaarno heshiis.”
Wuxuu intaas ku daray: “Waxaan u malaynayaa in qof kastaa uu taas rajaynayay muddo intaas la eg, laakiin hadda waxaan ku taagan nahay dhabihii saxda ahaa. Waxaa hubaal ah inay jirto fursad weyn oo aan halkan ku joogi doono xilli-ciyaareedka soo socda. Tani waa waxa aan mar walba doonayay.”
Konate ayaa sidoo kale xusay inuu sugayo oo kaliya inta wax walba laga dhammaystirayo: “Waxaan sugayaa in heshiiska la kala saaro, laakiin marka wax walba la soo afjaro, waa inaad weydisaan Richard Hughes (agaasimaha ciyaaraha) wixii aan ku iri bilihii Sebtembar iyo Noofembar, isaga ayaana dhiibi doona hadal ka dhigi doona qof kasta mid aamusa.”

headline: Wayne Rooney Oo Digniin Culus U Diray Taageerayaasha Arsenal Kadib Guuldarradii City
body:
Weeraryahankii hore ee kooxda Manchester United, Wayne Rooney, ayaa aaminsan in taageerayaasha Arsenal looga baahan yahay inay si ka wanaagsan sidii hore u garab istaagaan kooxdooda xilligan adag.
Hadalkan ayaa imaanaya ka dib markii kooxda Mikel Arteta ay 1-2 guuldarro ah kala kulantay Manchester City 19-kii Abriil, taas oo ahayd guuldarradii labaad oo xiriir ah ka dib markii ay usbuucii hore isla natiijadaas heleen kulankii Bournemouth.
Rooney oo u warramayay Tribuna ayaa yiri: “Waxaan u malaynayaa inay taageerayaasha Arsenal u baahan yihiin inay ka fiicnaadaan sida ay hadda yihiin. Waxaan arkay iyagoo ku oorinaya kooxda kulankii Bournemouth. Arsenal waxay ahayd mid cajiib ah xilli-ciyaareedka oo dhan, laakiin hadda waxay ku jiraan xaalad hoos u dhac yar ah.”
Wuxuu intaas ku daray in taageerada jamaahiirtu ay saameyn weyn ku leedahay maskaxda ciyaartoyda: “Taageerayaashu waa inay fahmaan muhiimadda ay taageeradoodu u leedahay ciyaartoyda iyo inta ay dhab ahaan caawin karto. Ciyaartoydan waxay maalin kasta si adag ugu soo tababartaan sidii ay heerkan u gaari lahaayeen, markaa marka aad guuldarraysataan ka dibna laydinku ooryo, waxay taasi si dhab ah u saameysaa ciyaartoyda.”
Rooney ayaa tusaale u soo qaatay kooxdiisii hore isagoo yiri: “Sannadihii u dambeeyay, Manchester United waxay soo martay xaalado adag xilliyadii Erik ten Hag iyo Ruben Amorim, haddana taageerayaashu way garab istaageen tababarayaasha iyagoo ku dhiirigelinayay garoonka dhexdiisa. Mar walba way heesayeen, aad bayna u dhif ahayd in la maqlo iyagoo ku oorinaya kooxda.”
Wuxuu hadalkiisa kusoo xiray dardaaran uu u jeediyay jamaahiirta Gunners: “Arsenal waxay horyaalka hoggaaminaysay xilli-ciyaareedka oo dhan, waxayna gaareen nus-dhammaadka Champions League-ga, haddana waxay guuldarro kala kulmayaan Bournemouth markaasna waa lagu oorinayaa? Taageerayaashu waa inay si wanaagsan ula dhaqmaan ciyaartoyda, waayo ooridu boqolkiiba boqol waxay dhaawacdaa ciyaartoyda.”

headline: Szoboszlai Oo Ugu Dambeyntii Caddeeyay Yoolka Ugu Weyn Ee Liverpool Inta Ka Harsan Ee Xilli Ciyaareedka
body:
Dominik Szoboszlai ayaa ka hadlay guushii 2-1 ahayd ee ay Liverpool ka gaartay kooxda Everton iyo saamaynta ay ku leedahay xilli-ciyaareedkooda.
“Guushu mar walba waxay beddeshaa niyadda kooxda, laakiin waa inaynu dhexda u xirannaa oo aynu maalin kasta si adag u shaqaynnaa,” ayuu yiri.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray inay muhiim tahay in loo dagaallamo boosaska looga soo baxo tartanka Champions League-ga: “Waa inaan sii wadnaa dagaalka aan ugu jirno boosaska Champions League-ga, waxaana ina horyaalla kulamo adag.
Mar walba way adag tahay inaad natiijo fiican hesho marka aad la ciyaarayso kooxaha aad isku dhibco dhow dihiin sida Manchester United, Chelsea, Aston Villa, iyo Crystal Palace. Waa inaad mar walba diyaar ahaataa oo aad dagaallantaa kulamadaas.”
Szoboszlai ayaa sidoo kale taageeray hadalkii tababare Arne Slot ee ahaa in Liverpool ay leedahay mustaqbal ifaya, isagoo yiri: “Waxaan u malaynayaa in waxa uu tababaruhu sheegay ay sax yihiin. Waxaan keenay ciyaartoy cusub oo dhalinyaro ah, xirfad badanna leh. Waxaan ognahay waxa ay qaban karaan iyo inay caawin karaan kooxda, waana sababta ay halkan u joogaan. Waxaan aad u sugayaa inaan la ciyaaro shanta kulan ee noo haray iyo sidoo kale mustaqbalka.”

Sida ay baahisay shabakadda xogta ururisa ee OptaJoe, Erling Haaland ayaa noqday ciyaaryahankii labaad ee afar kulan oo xiriir ah oo Premier League ah gool ka dhaliya kooxda Arsenal ee uu hoggaamiyo Mikel Arteta. Wuxuu sidaas ku raacay raadka weeraryahankii hore ee Liverpool, Diogo Jota, oo isagu rikoorkaas dhigay intii u dhexaysay Sebtember 2020 ilaa Maarso 2022.

Labada ciyaaryahan ee Haaland iyo Cherki ayaa muujiyay bandhig cajiib ah tan iyo markii ay ku soo biireen kooxda Pep Guardiola, iyagoo ka yimid Borussia Dortmund iyo Lyon. Waxay hadda doonayaan inay City ku hoggaamiyaan guul kale marka ay la ciyaarayaan kooxda Burnley maalinta Arbacada ee soo socota.

headline: Gary Neville Iyo Micah Richards Oo Saadaal Lama Filaan Ah Ka Soo Saaray Kooxda Ku Guuleysaneysa Premier League Xilli Ciyaareed Kaan
body:
Halyeyga Manchester United Gary Neville iyo xiddigii hore ee Manchester City Micah Richards ayaa saadaal ka bixiyay kooxda ku guuleysan doonta horyaalka Premier League xilli-ciyaareedkan.
Tani waxay ka dambaysay markii Manchester City ay 2-1 ku garaacday Arsenal kulankii Axaddii ka dhacay garoonka Etihad. Isagoo ka hadlayay Sky Sports, Neville ayaa markii ugu horreysay xilli-ciyaareedkan qirtay inuu u arko Manchester City kooxda horyaalka qaadaysa.
“Uma malaynayo in labada kooxoodba (Arsenal iyo Man City) ay guuleysan doonaan kulan kasta oo u haray. Waxaan aaminsanahay in Man City ay hadda haysato fursad aad iyo aad u weyn,” ayuu yiri Neville. Wuxuu kaloo ka digay kulanka Arsenal ee Sabtida soo socota ay la ciyaari doonto Newcastle, isagoo sheegay inuu yahay kulan khatar badan, ayna tahay in Arsenal ay ka gudubto culayskaas.
Wuxuu ku soo xiray: “Markii ugu horreysay xilli-ciyaareedkan, waxaan dhihi karaa [shariqyada horyaalka] waxay noqon doonaan buluug.”
Geesta kale, Micah Richards ayaa ku raacay fikirkaas, isagoo sheegay inay markii horeba xaaladdu aysan la xiriirin natiijada kulankan. “Mar walba waxaan dhihi jiray haddii Man City ay guul gaarto ciyaartan, waxay siin doontaa dardar weyn. Waxaan u malaynayay in Arsenal ay aad u wanaagsanayd, laakiin Man City ayaa guulaysatay. Waxaan dhihi karaa Man City ayaa horyaalkan qaadeysa”
Guushaas ka dib, Manchester City waxay hadda saddex dhibcood oo qura ka dambaysaa Arsenal oo hoggaanka haysa, iyadoo weliba uu baaqi u yahay hal kulan oo dheeri ah.

headline: Emmanuel Petit Oo Farta Ku Fiiqay Labada Xiddig Ay Tahay Inay Arsenal Iska Ceyriso Suuqa Xagaaga
body:
Halyeyga kooxda Arsenal, Emmanuel Petit, ayaa magacaabay dhowr ciyaaryahan oo uu aaminsan yahay in kooxdu ay iska iibiso suuqa kala iibsiga ee soo socda si ay kor ugu qaaddo heerka kooxda.
Petit ayaa tilmaamay in booska garbaha uu yahay meesha ugu weyn ee ay tahay in kooxdu ay xoogga saarto xagaagan. Arsenal ayaan ku guuleysan koob weyn tan iyo sannadkii 2020, waxayna kaalinta labaad ku jireen saddexdii xilli-ciyaareed ee u dambeeyay horyaalka Premier League.
Xilli-ciyaareedkan, Gunners waxay u tartamayaan horyaalka iyo tartanka Champions League-ga, inkastoo ay horey guuldarro kala kulmeen Manchester City final-kii koobka EFL Cup.
Petit oo ka hadlayay baahida kooxda ee garabka weerarka ayaa yiri: “Haddii Arsenal ay rabto inay qaaddo tallaabada xigta, oo ah inay ciyaarto kubad wanaagsan xilli-ciyaareedka oo dhan, waa inay keensadaan garbo tayo leh.”
Isagoo tusaale u soo qaatay kooxaha Bayern Munich iyo PSG, wuxuu xusay inay u baahan yihiin ciyaartoy heer caalami ah. Petit ayaa yiri: “Arsenal waxay haysataa Bukayo Saka, kaasoo dhaawacyo iyo xaalado adag wajahay xilli-ciyaareedkan. Noni Madueke, sida aan qabo, waa ciyaaryahan wanaagsan, laakiin kuma jiro kuwa ugu sarreeya booskiisa.”
Wuxuu hadalkiisa kusoo xiray dhaleeceyn uu u jeediyay garabka bidix: “Sidoo kale dhanka bidix ee ay joogaan Gabriel Martinelli iyo Leandro Trossard; ma ahan kuwa ugu fiican boosaskooda marka loo eego heerka sare ee tartanka.”

headline: SuperComputer-ka Opta Oo Soo Saaray Saadaal Cusub Oo Ku Aadan Kooxda Ku Guuleysaneysa Premier League Kadib Guuldarradii Arsenal Ee City
body:
SuperComputer-ka Opta ayaa ku adkaystay in Arsenal ay weli u taagan tahay ku guuleysiga horyaalka Premier League, inkasta oo guuldarro 2-1 ahi ay ka soo gaartay Manchester City galabnimadii Axadda.
Tani waxay ahayd guuldarradii labaad ee xiriir ah oo soo gaarta hoggaanka horyaalka, ka dib markii usbuucii hore ay 2-1 guuldarro ah kala kulmeen kooxda Bournemouth. Natiijadan ayaa saamaxday in kooxda Pep Guardiola ay hoggaanka u soo jirsadaan saddex dhibcood oo kaliya.
Intaan ciyaartu bilaaban, SuperComputer-ka ayaa Arsenal siiyay fursad weyn oo dhan 85.2% si ay horyaalka ugu guuleystaan, halka City la siiyay 14.8%.
Laakiin ka dib natiijadii ka dhacday garoonka Etihad, inkasta oo City ay hoos u dhigtay farqiga dhibcaha, haddana xogta Opta ayaa muujinaysa in fursadda Arsenal ay hoos ugu dhacday 73.0%. Taas waxay ka dhigan tahay in fursadda Manchester City ay hadda tahay 27%, iyadoo la xasuusto in City ay hoggaanka la wareegi karto haddii ay ka badiso kooxda Burnley kulanka dhacaya maalinta Arbacada.

headline: Dharbaaxo: Xiddig Muhiim Ah Oo Manchester City Ka Dhaawacmay Kadib Guushii Arsenal
body:
Kooxda Manchester City ayaa la kulantay dhabar-jab weyn ka dib markii uu dhaawac kasoo gaaray laf-dhabarta khadka dhexe ee Rodri, intii ay socotay ciyaartii ay 2-1 kaga badiyeen Arsenal maalintii Axadda.
Rodri ayaa dareemay xanuun dhanka gumaarka ah, taas oo keentay in laga walwalo inta uu maqnaan doono. Tababare Pep Guardiola ayaa xaqiijiyay inuu sugayo natiijada baaritaanka caafimaadka si loo ogaado heerka uu gaarsiisan yahay dhaawaca xiddigan reer Spain.
Dhaawacan ayaa yimid xilli City ay u dabbaaldegaysay guul muhiim ah oo ay dhibcaha kala hartay Arsenal, iyadoo hadda saddex dhibcood oo qura laga horeeyo, iyadoo uu u baaqi yahay hal kulan.
Xilli-ciyaareedkan ayaa ku noqday mid adag Rodri, kaas oo horay u seegay 11 kulan oo horyaalka ah ka dib markii ay soo wajaheen dhaawacyo dhanka muruqa bowdada iyo jilibka ah. In kasta oo ay dhaawacyo harreeyeen, haddana Rodri wuxuu kooxda u saftay 31 kulan tartammada oo dhan xilli-ciyaareedkan 2025/26.

headline: Taageerayaasha Arsenal Oo Si Wadajir Ah U Dhaleeceyay Arteta Kadib Khalad Uu Sameeyay Kulankii City
body:
Taageerayaasha Arsenal ayaa dhaleeceyn kulul u soo jeediyay tababare Mikel Arteta ka dib markii kooxdiisu ay guuldarro 2-1 ah kala kulantay Manchester City kulankii horyaalka Premier League-ga ee ka dhacay garoonka Etihad.
Arteta ayaa wajahaya cadaadis xooggan oo ku aadan go’aankii uu garoonka uga saaray Eberechi Eze qaybtii dambe ee ciyaarta, xilli uu ciyaaryahanku u muuqday mid halis weyn ku hayay difaaca City. Eze ayaa birta ku dhuftay kubad xooggan, wuxuuna abuuray fursado dhowr ah ka hor inta aan lagu beddelin Leandro Trossard.
Baraha bulshada, gaar ahaan barta X (Twitter), taageerayaasha ayaa ku sifeeyay go’aankaas mid saameyn xun ku yeeshay natiijada ciyaarta. Qaar ka mid ah falcelinnada taageerayaasha waxaa ka mid ahaa:
DB ayaa yiri: “Arteta wuxuu beddelay Eze xilli ay ciyaartu furnayd, waana go’aan aad u xun.”
Jones ayaa isna qoray: “Eze oo loo beddelay Trossard; waa halkaas meesha uu Arteta ku lumiyay shaqadiisa.”
SinghAFC_19 ayaa isna si adag u dhaleeceeyay tababaraha, isagoo sheegay in Eze uu ahaa ciyaaryahanka kaliya ee dhibaato ku hayay City, halka Havertz oo wax badan qaban waayay lagu daayay garoonka. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in tababaruhu uu difaaco ciyaartoyda uu isagu jecel yahay halkii uu eegi lahaa waxa ay ciyaartu u baahan tahay.
Xitaa Piers Morgan ayaa ka horyimid go’aankaas isagoo yiri: “Eze miyaa la saaray???? Taasi waa wax lala yaabo, wuxuu ahaa ciyaaryahankayga ugu fiicnaa.”
Dhanka kale, taageerayaasha Manchester City ayaa dareemay nafis markii Eze laga saaray garoonka. Taageere lagu magacaabo MakabeTsolo ayaa yiri: “Waxaan dareemay ammaan markii Eze la saaray. Maxay ahayd waxa uu Arteta samaynayay?”
Guuldarradan ayaa Arsenal ku qasbay inay lumiso dhibco muhiim ah, taas oo ka dhigan in tartanka horyaalka ee xilli-ciyaareedka 2025/26 uu hadda noqday mid aad u kulul.

headline: Joe Cole: Xiddigo Waaweyn Oo Muhiim Ah Ayaa Chelsea Isaga Tagaya, Haddii……
body:
Dhibaatada haysata kooxda Chelsea ayaa sii xumaatay ka dib markii guuldarro 1-0 ahi ay ka soo gaartay Manchester United, taas oo sii kordhisay walwalka laga qabo fursadaha ay ugu soo bixi karaan tartanka Champions League-ga xilli-ciyaareedka dambe.
Iyadoo qaab-ciyaareedka kooxdu uu hoos u dhacayo, culayskana uu sii kordhayo, xiddigii hore ee kooxda Blues, Joe Cole, ayaa soo saaray digniin kulul oo ku aaddan waxa ka dhalan kara haddii kooxdu ay weydo booska tartanka Yurub.
“Waxaad halkan u timaadaa inaad koobab ku guuleysato, markaa haddii ay taasi dhici weydo, xaqiiqada jirta waxay tahay inay jiri doonaan ciyaartoy ku jira qolka labiska oo u sheegi doona wakiilladooda, ‘ma iga saari kartaan halkan?'” ayuu yiri Cole.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray: “Halkan ma imaan karo oo been ma sheegi karo, taasi way dhici doontaa, iyadoo ay u muuqato wax kasta oo ay hadda sheegayaan ama bayaan kasta oo ay soo saarayaan, sababtoo ah taasi waa dabeecadda ciyaartoyda kubadda cagta. Waa waayo-ciyaareed oo gaaban, waxaadna doonaysaa inaad koobab ku guuleysato.”
Natiijadan ayaa Chelsea ka dhigeysa mid u baahan dadaal aan caadi ahayn kulammada u haray si ay u xaqiijistaan kaalmaha sare, xilli halyeeyada kooxdu ay ka cabsi qabaan in xiddigaha ugu muhiimsan ay ka tagaan kooxda haddii aan la gaarin himilooyinka ciyaareed ee tartammada waaweyn.

headline: Rio Ferdinand Oo Magacaabay Labada Ciyaaryahan Ay Tahay Inay United Ka Soo Qaadato Tottenham Haddii Ay Heerka Labaad U Dhacdo
body:
Kabtankii hore ee kooxda Manchester United, Rio Ferdinand, ayaa aaminsan in kooxdu ay u dhaqaaqi karto saxiixa dhowr ciyaartoy oo ka tirsan Tottenham Hotspur, haddii ay dhacdo in kooxda reer London ay u dhacdo heerka labaad dhammaadka xilli-ciyaareedka 2025/26.
Kooxda loo yaqaanno The Lilywhites ayaa laga yaabaa inay lumiso inta badan ciyaartoydeeda muhiimka ah haddii ay u laabtaan heerka labaad, maadaama qandaraasyada qaar ay ku jiraan qodobbo u oggolaanaya ciyaartoyda inay ka tagaan kooxda haddii xaaladdaas la wajaho.
Ferdinand oo la weydiiyay haddii uu jiro ciyaaryahan Spurs ah oo uu jeclaan lahaa inay Manchester United la soo saxiixato, ayuu ku jawaabay: “Hadda ma jiro mid aan dhihi karo haa. Ma jiraan ciyaartoy aan hadda maskaxda ku hayo oo aan qaadan lahaa, gaar ahaan marka loo eego qaabka ay hadda u ciyaarayaan.”
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, wuxuu hadalkiisa raaciyay: “Waxaa laga yaabaa Van de Ven. Van de Ven iyo Djed Spence dhab ahaantii. Djed Spence.”
Djed Spence ayaa loo arkaa ciyaaryahan xoojin kara difaacyada garbaha ee Manchester United, maadaama uu yahay mid karti u leh inuu ka ciyaaro labada dhinac ee garoonka. Dhanka kale, Micky van de Ven ayaa loo arkaa mid si weyn u xoojin kara safka difaaca dhexe ee kooxda ka dhisan Old Trafford.

headline: Owen Hargreaves Oo Farta Ku Fiiqay Maskaxdii Ka Dambeysay In Manchester United Ay Garaacdo Chelsea
body:
Halyeygii hore ee kooxda Manchester United, Owen Hargreaves, ayaa ammaan ballaaran u jeediyay Bruno Fernandes ka dib bandhiggii cajiibka ahaa ee uu ka sameeyay guushii 1-0 ee ay dhowaan ka gaareen kooxda Chelsea.

headline: Pep Guardiola Oo Hal Wax Uga Digay Ciyaartoydiisa Kadib Guushii Arsenal
body:
Tababaraha kooxda Manchester City, Pep Guardiola, ayaa uga digay ciyaartoydiisa inay lumiyaan diirradda xilli ay u dabbaaldegayaan guushii muhiimka ahayd ee 2-1 ee ay ka gaareen Arsenal galabnimadii Axadda.
Guardiola ayaa doonaya in kooxdiisu ay hadda maskaxda ku hayso kulanka xiga ee ay la ciyaari doonaan kooxda Burnley habeenka Arbacada, kaas oo ka tirsan horyaalka Premier League. Isagoo ka hadlayay shirkii jaraa’id ee ka dambeeyay ciyaartii ka dhacday Etihad Stadium, ee uu goolka guusha u saxiixay Erling Haaland, wuxuu yiri:
“Waa inaan ku raaxaysanaa (guusha aan ka gaarnay Arsenal), dabbaaldegnaa, qaadanaa waxyaabaha wanaagsan, laakiin waa inaanan lumin diirradda. Diirradda hadda waxay saaran kulanka xiga, markaas oo aan u safreyno Burnley.”
Manchester City ayaa hadda saddex dhibcood oo qura ka dambaysa kooxda Arsenal ee hoggaanka horyaalka haysa, iyadoo weliba ay u baaqi tahay hal kulan oo u sahlaya inay dhibcaha bar-bareeyaan haddii ay guuleystaan.

headline: Arsenal Oo Dhigtay Rikoodh Xun Oo Aysan Taageerayaasha Ku Farxin Kulankii City
body:
Kooxda Arsenal ayaa dhigtay rikoor aysan ku farxin ka dib markii ay guuldarro 2-1 ah kala kulantay Manchester City kulankii horyaalka Premier League-ga ee galabnimadii Axadda ka dhacay garoonka Etihad.
Weeraryahanka Manchester City, Erling Haaland, ayaa dhaliyay goolka guusha qaybtii dambe ee ciyaarta, taas oo kooxda Pep Guardiola u saamaxday inay saddex dhibcood oo muhiim ah ka qaataan martidooda.
Sida ay sheegtay shabakadda xogta ururisa ee OptaJoe, natiijadan ayaa ka dhigan in Arsenal ay markii ugu horreysay guuldarraysatay afar kulan oo xiriir ah tartammada maxalliga ah (horyaalka iyo koobabka) tan iyo markii uu tababare u noqday Mikel Arteta.
Sidoo kale, waa markii ugu horreysay ee ay sidan oo kale u dhacdo guud ahaan tan iyo bishii Maarso 2018, xilligaas oo ay sidoo kale la dhibtoonayeen labo guuldarro oo ka soo gaartay Manchester City.
In kasta oo ay guuldarradan la kulmeen, Arsenal ayaa weli fadhida halka ugu sarreysa ee kala horreynta horyaalka Premier League-ga, iyagoo saddex dhibcood ka sarreeya kooxda City. Kooxda uu hoggaaminayo Arteta ayaa kulankooda xiga wajahaya kooxda Newcastle United 25-ka bishan Abriil.

headline: “Waa Dammiin Aan U Qalmin Chelsea”
body:
Goolhayihii hore ee kooxda Tottenham Hotspur, Paul Robinson, ayaa dhaleeceyn u soo jeediyay garabka kooxda Chelsea, Alejandro Garnacho, isagoo ku adkaystay in xiddigan 21-jirka ah uusan lahayn tayadii uu si joogto ah ugu soo bilaaban lahaa safka kooxda Blues.
Robinson ayaa intaas ku daray inuu aad u layaabay markii xiddiga reer Argentina uu go’aansaday inuu ka tago Manchester United sanadkii hore, isagoo u wareegay Stamford Bridge.
Tan iyo markii uu Garnacho ka soo tagay Old Trafford, wuxuu ku dhibtoonayay inuu saameyn ku yeesho kooxda uu hoggaamiyo Liam Rosenior, isagoo xilli-ciyaareedkan horyaalka Premier League dhaliyay kaliya hal gool.
Isagoo la hadlayay Stadium Astro, Robinson ayaa yiri: “Ma ahan mid ku wanaagsan inuu si joogto ah ugu soo bilaawdo Chelsea, waxaana laga yaabaa inay Manchester United samaysay ganacsi wanaagsan.”
Wuxuu sii raaciyay: “Haddii dib loo eego xilli-ciyaareedkii uu ka tagay United, aad ayaan ula yaabay inay u ogolaadeen inuu baxo. Haddii aad eegto tirokoobkiisii xilligaas, dhab ahaantii wuxuu ahaa ciyaaryahankooda ugu hal-abuurka badnaa.”

headline: Real Madrid Oo Lagu Boorriyay Inay La Soo Saxiixato Salah
body:
Halyeygii iyo kabtankii hore ee kooxda Real Madrid, Fernando Hierro, ayaa ku boorriyay kooxda in ay la soo saxiixato xiddiga reer Masar iyo kooxda Liverpool, Mohamed Salah.
Wareysi dhowaan lala yeeshay, Hierro ayaa markii la weydiiyay suurtagalnimada uu Salah ugu biiri karo Los Blancos ayuu ku jawaabay:
“Maxaa diidaya? Dabcan, waan jeclaan lahaa. Mohamed Salah waa ciyaaryahan aan caadi ahayn dhinac walba. Ma jiro qof dafiri kara saameyntiisa weyn ee Liverpool iyo guulaha uu gaaray. Waxaan jeclaan lahaa inaan ku arko Real Madrid; wax walba waa ka suurtagal kubadda cagta.”
Isagoo sii ammaanaya tayada Salah, Hierro ayaa intaas ku daray: “Salah waa nooca ciyaaryahan ee ay koox kasta oo adduunka ah doonayso inay la soo saxiixato, sababtoo ah waa mid gaar ah oo saameyn toos ah ku leh ciyaarta. Isagu ma ahan kaliya ciyaaryahan weyn; waa mucjiso dhab ah oo dhanka kubadda cagta ah, kaasoo isbeddel sameeya meel kasta oo uu joogo.”
Hierro ayaa sidoo kale xusay in u soo wareegista horyaalka La Liga ay dhiirigelin weyn u noqon karto tartanka: “Inaad ku qiyaasto isaga oo jooga La Liga, ha noqoto Real Madrid ama Barcelona, waxay tartanka siin doontaa kor u kac weyn, taasoo ay ugu wacan tahay tayadiisa, khibradiisa, iyo sida uu ula qabsan karo xaaladaha kala duwan.”
Qandaraaska Salah ee Liverpool ayaa ku eg dhammaadka xilli-ciyaareedkan, taas oo ka dhigan in uu ku bixi karo bilaash ama qiimo jaban haddii heshiiska aan la cusboonaysiin.

headline: Manchester City Oo Guul Muhiim Ah Ka Gaartay Arsenal, Dibna U Soo Nooleysay Rajadeedii Horyaalka
body:
Manchester City ayaa guul aad u qaali ah ka gaartay kooxda Arsenal, ka dib markii ay 2-1 ku garaacday kulankii xiisaha badnaa ee wareegga 33-aad ee horyaalka Premier League-ga.
Manchester City ayaa hoggaanka ciyaarta ku qabatay gool uu u dhaliyay Rayan Cherki daqiiqaddii 16-aad, ka dib markii uu baas ka helay Nunes, isagoo dhex galay xerada ganaaxa, si xirfad lehna u dhaafay difaaca Arsenal ka hor inta uusan shabaqa ku hubsan kubadda.
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Arsenal ayaa bar-baraha heshay labo daqiiqo ka dib markii qalad uu ka dhacay goolhaye Donnarumma; baas dib loogu soo celiyay ayuu isku dayay inuu iska saaro, balse waxay ku dhacday Kai Havertz, iyadoo si tartiib ah ugu dhalatay shabaqa oo marnaa.
Manchester City ayaa la timid goolka guusha daqiiqaddii 65-aad, ka dib markii O’Reilly uu loog qurux badan u soo qaaday Erling Haaland, kaas oo isna si xarrago leh kubadda ugu leexiyay goolka.
Natiijadan ayaa ka dhigan in Arsenal ay weli hoggaanka ku hayso 70 dhibcood, halka Manchester City ay dhibcaheeda ka dhigtay 67 dhibcood, iyadoo weliba uu u baaqi yahay hal kulan oo ay la ciyaari doonto kooxda Crystal Palace.

headline: Mohamed Salah Oo Barbarreeyay Rikoodh Uu Ku Faani Jiray Steven Gerrard
body:
Xiddiga reer Masar ee Mohamed Salah ayaa sii wada sameynta taariikho cusub, ka dib markii uu noqday gooldhaliyaha ugu sarreeya abid ee kulanka Merseyside derby ee horyaalka Premier League-ga.
Salah ayaa gaaray goolkiisii 9-aad ee uu ka dhaliyo kooxda Everton, isagoo sidaas ku bar-bareeyay rikoorkii uu horey u haystay halyeyga Liverpool ee Steven Gerrard.
Guushan ayaa ka dhigan saameynta weyn ee uu Salah ku leeyahay kulammada waaweyn, gaar ahaan mid ka mid ah kulammada ugu caansan ee dalka Ingiriiska.
Xiddigan ayaa sii xoojiyay booskiisa halyeeyada ugu caansan taariikhda Liverpool, isagoo muujiyay qaab-ciyaareed joogto ah in muddo ah iyo tirokoobyo wax ku ool ah oo go’aamiya natiijada ciyaarta.

headline: Liverpool Oo Guul Muhiim Ah Ka Gaartay Everton Waqtiga Dhimashada
body:
Liverpool ayaa guul dirqi ah oo 2-1 ah ka gaartay kooxda ay xafiiltamaan ee Everton kulan ka tirsan Merseyside derby, iyadoo goolka guusha uu dhashay dhammaadkii ciyaarta.
Mohamed Salah ayaa goolka hore u saxiixay Liverpool qaybtii hore ee ciyaarta, isagoo si dhib yar u dhammaystiray fursad uu helay, taas oo Reds siisay hoggaan ay ku nasato. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Everton ayaa soo laabatay qaybtii dambe, waxayna ciyaarta ka dhigtay bar-baro 1-1 ah ka dib gool uu u dhaliyay weeraryahanka Beto, taas oo keentay in ciyaartu ay aad u kululaato.
Xilli ay u muuqatay in kulanku ku dhammaanayo bar-baro, kabtanka Liverpool Virgil van Dijk ayaa daqiiqadihii ugu dambeeyay madax ku dhaliyay goolkii go’aamiyay kulanka, isagoo qalbi jabiyay taageerayaasha Everton, halka uu Liverpool u xaqiijiyay saddex dhibcood oo qaali ah.
Natiijadan ayaa kusii kordhinaysa rikoorka wanaagsan ee Liverpool ay ku leedahay Merseyside derby, waxayna si weyn u xoojinaysaa booskooda kala horreynta horyaalka, halka Everton ay garoonka ka hoyatay iyadoo niyad-jabsan ka dib bandhig adag oo ay muujiyeen.

headline: Maxaa Sababay In Barcelona Ay Ku Fashilanto Saxiixa Rashford?
body:
Waxaa sii yaraanaya fursadda ay kooxda Barcelona ku ceshan karto Marcus Rashford, iyadoo mushaharkiisa sare iyo qiimaha lagu iibsanayo ay caqabad weyn ku noqdeen heshiis rasmi ah.
Rashford ayaa la sheegay inuu ku qanacsan yahay nolosha magaalada Barcelona, balse wuxuu ogyahay inay hoos u dhacday fursadda uu ku sii joogi karo ka dib dhaawacyo soo gaaray iyo qaab-ciyaareedkiisa oo aan fadhin. Go’aanka ugu dambeeya ayaa la filayaa in la gaaro ka dib wadahadallo uu la yeesho tababare Hansi Flick.
Ciyaaryahanka ayaa leh qodob lagu burburin karo heshiiskiisa oo gaaraya €30m (£26m), inkastoo qiimihiisa suuqa lagu qiyaaso ku dhowaad €40m. Manchester United ayaan laga filayn inay hoos u dhigto lacagta ay dalbanayso, mana doonayaan inay markale amaah ku bixiyaan.
Caqabadda ugu weyn ayaa ah mushaharka Rashford. Maadaama la filayo in Manchester United ay ku soo laabato tartanka Champions League, mushaharkiisa ayaa dib ugu kici doona qiyaastii £325,000 toddobaadkii, taas oo sanadkii noqonaysa qiyaastii £17m (€20m). Barcelona ayaan u muuqan koox bixin karta lacagtaas baaxadda leh.
Dhaqdhaqaaqa wanaagsan ee United, oo ay ku jirto guushii ugu dambeysay ee ay ka gaareen Chelsea, ayaa xoojisay booska kooxda Ingiriiska ah, halka xubnaha kooxda sida Michael Carrick ay tilmaameen in Rashford dib loogu soo celin karo safka kooxda.
Barcelona ayaa durbaba bilowday inay raadiso beddelka Rashford. Agaasimaha ciyaaraha ee Deco ayaa isha ku haya ciyaartoy da’ yar oo uu ka mid yahay Eduardo Conceiçao, inkastoo garabkaas uusan u soo wareegi karin Yurub ilaa sanadka 2028.
Sidoo kale, kooxda reer Catalonia ayaa horey u tixgelisay saxiixyada Luis Díaz iyo Nico Williams si ay uga ciyaaraan garabka bidix, waxaana laga yaabaa inay dib ugu laabtaan suuqa haddii uu Rashford baxo.
In kasta oo uu mararka qaar muujiyay tayo sare, Rashford ayaa ku dhibtoonayay inuu si joogto ah u soo bandhigo heerka sare ee laga filayay, taas oo sii murjisay go’aanka Barcelona ee ku aadan in heshiiskiisa laga dhigo mid rasmi ah.

headline: Cole Palmer: Haddii Chelsea Ay U Soo Bixi Weyso Champions League Xilli Ciyaareedka Dambe, Waxaa…..
body:
Xiddiga kooxda Chelsea, Cole Palmer, ayaa qirtay kadib guuldarradii ka soo gaartay Manchester United  in “wax walba ay isbeddelayaan” haddii kooxdiisu ay weydo booska Champions League-ga.
“Waxaan rajeynayaa [inaan Chelsea ku gaaro hamigayga]. Waxaan aaminsanahay kooxda, si furan ayayna noola hadleen annaga oo ciyaartoyda ah,” ayuu yiri Palmer.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray: “Waxaan rajeynayaa inaan aniga iyo ciyaartoyda kale ba wax badan kula guuleysano Chelsea. Laakiin haddii aysan noo suurtagelin inaan u soo baxno Champions League, wax walba way isbeddelayaan. Waxaan u baahannahay inaan ku dhammaysanno booska loogu soo baxo Champions League.”
Guuldarradaas ka dib, Chelsea waxay hadda 10 dhibcood ka dambeysaa Manchester United, waxayna toddobo dhibcood ka dambayn doontaa Liverpool haddii ay maanta ka guuleysato kooxda Everton.
Tani waxay ka dhigeysaa tartanka loogu jiro afarta boos ee ugu sarreeysa mid uu loollan adag ka jiro.

headline: Jurgen Klopp Oo Shuruud Adag Ku Xiray Inuu Qabto Shaqada Real Madrid
body:
Tababaraha reer Jarmal, Jurgen Klopp, ayaa laga yaabaa inuu noqdo tababaraha xiga ee kooxda Real Madrid, sida ay baahisay warbaahinta El Nacional.
Sida ay sheegayaan ilo-wareedyo ku dhow kooxda reer Spain. Real ayaa muddo xiriir la lahayd tababarahan 58-jirka ah, isna wuxuu diyaar u yahay inuu dib ugu soo laabto shaqada tababarenimo. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Klopp ayaa hal shuruud hordhigay hoggaanka Real Madrid ka hor inta uusan la wareegin kooxda.
Tababaraha Jarmalka ayaa doonaya in loo saxiixo goolhayaha kooxda Freiburg, Noah Atubolu, kaasoo xilli-ciyaareed aad u xooggan qaadanaya. Klopp ayaa u arka saaxiibkiisa ay isku dalka yihiin inuu yahay goolhayaha awooda inuu beddelo goolhayaha koowaad ee Real Madrid, Thibaut Courtois.
Isla mar ahaantaana, waxaa xusid mudan in goolhayaha reer Ukraine, Andriy Lunin, uu qarka u saaran yahay inuu ka tago Real Madrid xagaagan. Tani waa mid ka mid ah dalabaadka Klopp, maadaama uusan ciyaaryahanku ku jirin qorshaha uu ka damacsan yahay kooxda garoonka Santiago Bernabeu.

headline: Liam Rosenior Oo Ka Hadlay Fursadaha Ay Kooxdiisa Ugu Soo Bixi Karto Champions League Xilli Ciyaareedka Dambe
body:
Tababaraha kooxda Chelsea, Liam Rosenior, ayaa qirtay in kooxdiisu ay hadda wajahayso hawl aad u adag oo ku aaddan u soo bixitaanka tartanka UEFA Champions League ee xilli-ciyaareedka dambe.
Rosenior ayaa hadalkan jeediyay intii uu ku jiray wareysigii ka dambeeyay ciyaartii ay guuldarradu 1-0 ka soo gaartay Manchester United habeennimadii Sabtida, taas oo ka dhacday garoonka Stamford Bridge. Natiijadan ayaa ka dhigan in kooxda Blues ay fadhido booska 6-aad ee kala horreynta horyaalka Premier League, iyagoo leh 48 dhibcood ka dib 33 kulan oo ay ciyaareen.
Kooxda uu hoggaamiyo Rosenior ayaa ka dambaysa kooxaha Liverpool, Aston Villa, Manchester United, Manchester City, iyo Arsenal.
Isagoo ka hadlayay fursadda ay kooxdiisu ugu soo bixi karto Champions League-ga, Rosenior ayaa yiri: “Natiijadani waxay na hordhigtay hawl aad u adag oo lamid ah buur dheer oo la korayo. Waa inaan tagno ciyaarta Brighton ee dhacaysa maalinta Talaadada annagoo og inaan u baahannahay kaliya guul.”

headline: Shaxda Ay Arsenal Kaga Hor Tagi Karto Manchester City
body:
Kooxda Arsenal ayaa galabta u safreysa garoonka Etihad Stadium si ay u wajahdo Manchester City, waana kulan aad loo wada sugayo oo ka tirsan horyaalka Premier League.
Ciyaartan oo bilaabanaysa 18:30 galabnimo (waqtiga geeska Afrika), waxaa si toos ah looga daawan karaa kanaallada Sky Sports Main Event iyo Sky Sports Premier League.
Arsenal ayaa kulankan soo galaysa iyadoo guuldarro ka sidata Bournemouth oo 2-1 ku garaacday, taas oo sii kordhisay dhibaatada ay kooxdu wajahdo marka la gaaro bisha Abriil. Inkastoo Gunners ay weli lix dhibcood ku hoggaaminayaan horyaalka, haddana hoggaankooda ayaa soo yaraaday xilli loolanka uu sii kululaanayo.
Shaxda Arsenal ee la saadaalinayo (4-2-3-1):
David Raya; Ben White, William Saliba, Gabriel Magalhaes, Piero Hincapie; Martin Zubimendi, Declan Rice; Gabriel Martinelli, Eberechi Eze, Leandro Trossard; Viktor Gyokeres.

headline: Shaxda Ay Manchester City Kaga Hor Tagi Karto Arsenal
body:
Kooxda Manchester City ayaa galabta doonaysa inay sare u qaaddo fursaddeeda difaashada horyaalka Premier League-ga, marka ay garoonkeeda Etihad Stadium ku soo dhoweyso kooxda ay xafiiltamaan ee Arsenal.
Ciyaartan oo bilaabanaysa 18:30 galabnimo (waqtiga Bariga Afrika), waxaa si toos ah looga daawan karaa kanaallada Sky Sports Main Event iyo Sky Sports Premier League.
Manchester City ayaa todobaadkii hore ka faa’iideysatay guuldarradii 2-1 ahayd ee Arsenal ka soo gaartay Bournemouth, taas oo u saamaxday inay farqiga dhibcaha ee hoggaanka u soo yareeyaan lix dhibcood. Marka la gaaro xilligan oo kale ee xilli-ciyaareedka, City waxay caan ku tahay inay muujiso adkeysi maskaxeed oo ay guulo xiriir ah ku gaarto, iyadoo hadda u muuqata inay gashay xaaladdii looga bartay ee ay kooxuhu u joojin waayeen.
Shaxda Manchester City ee la saadaalinayo(4-2-3-1):
Gianluigi Donnarumma; Matheus Nunes, Abdukodir Khusanov, Marc Guehi, Nico O’Reilly; Bernardo Silva, Rodri; Antoine Semenyo, Rayan Cherki, Jeremy Doku; Erling Haaland.

headline: Liam Rosenior Oo Caddeeyay Sababta Uusan Enzo Ugu Magacaabin Kabtanka Rasmiga Ah Ee Chelsea Kulankii Man United
body:
Tababaraha kooxda Chelsea, Liam Rosenior, ayaa caddeeyay sababta uusan Enzo Fernandez ugu magacaabin kabtanka rasmiga ah ee kooxda inta uu maqan yahay Reece James, inkastoo xiddiga reer Argentina uu xirtay calaamadda kabtanimada kulankii guuldarrada 1-0 ay kala kulmeen Manchester United.
Reece James ayaa hadda garoomada kaga maqan dhaawac dhanka muruqa ah oo soo gaaray bishii March 2026, isagoo inta badan xilli-ciyaareedkan u jiifay dhaawacyo kala duwan. Enzo Fernandez, oo markaas uun ka soo laabtay ganaax labo kulan ah, ayaa si ku-meel-gaar ah u xirtay calaamadda kabtanka.
Rosenior ayaa sheegay in kooxdu ay horey u lahayd koox ciyaartoy ah oo loo qoondeeyay hoggaanka: “Go’aanku waa inaan leenahay koox hoggaamineed. Waxaan rumeysanahay in xirashada calaamadda kabtanimada ay tahay sharaf weyn oo kooxdan weynideeda ka tarjumeysa.”
Wuxuu amaanay bandhigga Enzo isagoo yiri: “Enzo wuxuu u ciyaaray sidii kabtan oo kale. Waxaan u maleeynayaa inuu ahaa mid aad u fiican; wuxuu bixiyay wax walba, wuxuuna nasiib u waayay inuu gool dhaliyo dhowr jeer. Tani waxay muujineysaa sida uu ugu heellan yahay kooxda, aad ayaanuna ugu qanacsan nahay bandhigiisa.”
Dhanka kale, Rosenior ayaa xaqiijiyay in xiddiga reer Brazil ee Willian Estevao uu ooyay intii lagu jiray nasashada ciyaarta ka dib markii uu dareemay dhaawac kale oo dhanka muruqa ah. Estevao ayaa garoonka looga saaray baahi caafimaad, waxaana lagu beddelay Alejandro Garnacho.
“Aad ayuu u qalbi jabay; wuxuu ooyayay xilligii nasashada,” ayuu yiri Rosenior. “Aad ayaan uga xumahay isaga; waxay u muuqataa dhibaato muruqa ah. Waxay dhacday xilli uu goolka u ordayay oo uu markaas muruqa wax ka dareemay.”
Estevao oo 18 jir ah ayaa horay u seegay lix kulan xilli-ciyaareedkan isla dhaawacan dartiis, waxaana laga cabsi qabaa inuu mar kale muddo dheer garoomada ka maqnaado.

headline: Kylian Mbappe Oo Diiday In Real Loo Dhiibo Klopp, Magacaabayna Macallinka Saxda Ah Ee Uu Aaminsan Yahay Inuu Guulo Ku Hoggaamin Karo
body:
Kylian Mbappe, weeraryahanka kooxda Real Madrid, ayaa la sheegay inuu kasoo horjeedo fikradda ah in kooxdu ay magacawdo tababarihii hore ee Liverpool, Jurgen Klopp, si uu u noqdo macallinka xiga ee kooxda.
Taa beddelkeeda, kabtanka xulka Faransiiska ayaa ku cadaadinaya maamulka kooxda inay mar saddexaad dib u soo celiyaan halyeyga ay isku dalka yihiin ee Zinedine Zidane. Real Madrid ayaa bishii Janaayo cayrisay Xabi Alonso, waxayna xilka si ku-meel-gaar ah ugu dhiibtay Alvaro Arbeloa.
Maadaama kooxdu ay qarka u saaran tahay inay xilli-ciyaareedkan ku dhammaysato koob la’aan, waxaa la filayaa in Arbeloa uu ka tago xilka xagaagan. headline: Craig Burley Oo Saadaaliyay Kulanka Weyn Ee City Iyo Arsenal
body:
Halyeygii hore ee kooxda Chelsea, Craig Burley, ayaa dhiibtay saadaashiisa ku aadan kulanka aadka loo sugayo ee dhex mari doona kooxaha Manchester City iyo Arsenal ee ka dhacaya garoonka Etihad.
Arsenal ayaa hadda lix dhibcood ku haysa hoggaanka horyaalka, halka City ay haysato hal kulan oo baaqi ah. Guul-darro soo gaarta Gunners maanta waxay la macno tahay in hoggaankoodu uu aad u yaraanayo toddobaadka dambe, maadaama City ay kulan kale ciyaari doonto bartamaha toddobaadka.
Craig Burley, oo la hadlayay ESPN FC, ayaa aaminsan in Manchester City ay hanan doonto horyaalka Premier League-ga haddii ay guuleysato kulanka maanta. Wuxuu sheegay in ciyaartoyda Arsenal ay dareemayaan baqdin weyn isagoo yiri:
“Kaliya hal qol labis ayaa laga dareemayaa cabsi, waana kan Arsenal. City way fahansan tahay muhiimadda kulankaan, shaki la’aan. Waxay ku jiraan xaalad aad u sarreysa, tababaruhuna waxay u badan tahay inuu baxo xagaaga, halka Bernardo Silva uu mar hore shaaciyay inuu baxayo. Waxay ku jiraan boos adag, koob kan na mar hore ayaa ugu dambeysay”
Burley ayaa isbarbar-dhigay xaaladda labada kooxood, isagoo xusay in City ay u soo baxday semi-finalka FA Cup, halka Arsenal ay tartankaas ka reebtay kooxda Southampton.
“Hadda, dhammaan tamarta wanaagsan waxay la jirtaa City. Haddii ay kulankan guuleystaan, waxaan aaminsanahay inay horyaalka ku guuleysan doonaan. Waxaan dareemayaa walaac aad u weyn oo ka dhex jira qolka labiska Arsenal, City-na taas way dareemi kartaa. Ciyaartoyda Arsenal waxay ogyihiin haddii kulankani ku xumaado oo laga badiyo, inay jirto fursad weyn oo ay ku khasaarin karaan fursadda ay horyaalka ugu guuleysan lahaayeen.”
Arsenal ayaa qaab-ciyaareed liita ku jirtay dhowaanahan, iyadoo guuleysatay hal kulan oo kaliya shantii ciyaarood ee ugu dambeeyay ee tartammada oo dhan, iyadoo la kulantay saddex guul-darro iyo hal bar-baro.

headline: Glenn Hoddle: “Chelsea Waxay Ceyrineysaa Liam Rosenior, Kaliya Haddii……”
body:
Halyeygii hore ee ciyaartoyda iyo tababarayaasha Premier League, Glenn Hoddle, ayaa qaba aragtida ah in Chelsea ay sii haysan doonto Liam Rosenior xilli-ciyaareedka soo socda, halkii ay xilka ka qaadi lahayd.
Habeennimadii Sabtida, Chelsea waxay la kulantay guuldarradii afraad oo xiriir ah oo horyaalka Premier League ah, ka dib markii Manchester United ay 1-0 ku garaacday. Natiijadan ayaa Chelsea dhigtay booska lixaad, waxayna toddobo dhibcood ka dambayn doonaan kooxda Liverpool haddii ay Liverpool maanta ka adkaato Everton.
Rosenior ayaa xilka kala wareegay Enzo Maresca bishii Janaayo, balse tababarahan 41-jirka ah ayaa hadda wajahaya cadaadis kaga imaanaya qaar ka mid ah taageerayaasha kooxda oo dalbanaya in la cayriyo.
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Hoddle wuxuu rumeysan yahay in kooxdiisii hore ay kalsooni siin doonto Rosenior inta lagu jiro xagaaga, isagoo ka digay in isbeddel dhici karo kaliya haddii xilli-ciyaareedka dambe uu ku bilowdo si liidata.
“Waxay ku jiraan xaalad aad u adag,” ayuu Hoddle u sheegay Premier League Productions. “Aragtidayda, si Liam uu u sii haysto shaqadiisa ilaa dhamaadka xilli-ciyaareedka, waxaan aaminsanahay inay fursaddaas siin doonaan, laakiin waa inuu xilli-ciyaareedka ku dhammeeystaa si wanaagsan oo uu guulo gaaraa.”
Wuxuu intaas ku daray in ujeeddada loo magacaabay ay tahay inuu yahay tababare da’ yar oo qayb ka ah mashruuca fog ee kooxda: “Xitaa haddii aysan u soo bixin Champions League, waxay weli joogaan semi-finalka FA Cup, taas oo macnaheedu yahay inay heli karaan fursad ay koob ugu guuleystaan. Waxaan filayaa inay sii haysan doonaan, oo ay siin doonaan fursad uu kooxda ku diyaariyo xagaaga (pre-season), laakiin waa inuu ku billaabaa xilli ciyaareedka si xooggan; haddii kale, wuxuu geli doonaa xaalad halis ah.”

headline: Cole Palmer Oo Difaacay Tababare Rosenior Kadib Guuldarradii Manchester United
body:
Xiddiga kooxda Chelsea, Cole Palmer, ayaa difaacay tababaraha kooxda Liam Rosenior, isagoo ka hadlay xaaladda adag ee ay kooxdu ku jirto xilli ay u dhiman yihiin lixda kulan ee ugu dambeeya horyaalka Premier League.
Rosenior ayaa bishii Janaayo xilka kala wareegay Enzo Maresca, tan iyo markaasna kooxdu waxay wajahday caqabado dhowr ah. Blues ayaa laga reebay tartanka Champions League-ga ka dib markii ay garaacday kooxda PSG, sidoo kale waxay hadda fadhidaa booska lixaad ee horyaalka iyadoo leh 48 dhibcood.
Wareysi uu siiyay The Guardian, Palmer ayaa ku dooday in Rosenior uu u baahan yahay waqti iyo diyaar garow xagaaga ah si uu isbeddel dhab ah u keeno:
“In tababare la keeno bartamaha xilli-ciyaareedka waxay la macno tahay inuusan helin wax diyaar garow xagaaga ah, waqtiga tababarkuna uu aad u yaraado maadaama diirradda la saarayo kaliya kulammada is xiga,” ayuu yiri Palmer.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray: “Tababaruhu waa mid aqoon leh, marka uu helo pre-season sax ah si uu fikradihiisa iyo qaab-ciyaareedka uu doonayo u gudbiyo, waa tababare heer sare ah. Haddii aan annagu ciyaartoy ahaan muujinno kartideena, lana keeno ciyaartoyda saxda ah, waxaan gaari karnaa horumar weyn.”
Cole Palmer ayaa isna dhankiisa wajahay dhaleeceyn xilli-ciyaareedkan ka dib markii uu la tacaalayay dhaawacyo isdaba joog ah, isagoo dhaliyay 10 gool, saddex kalena caawiyay 27 kulan oo uu saftay.
Hadda, Chelsea waxay xoogga saaraysaa semi-finalka FA Cup-ka oo dhacaya 26-ka Abriil, waxayna hiigsanaysaa inay xilli-ciyaareedka ku dhammaystaan shanta boos ee ugu sarreeya horyaalka.

headline: Joe Cole Oo Magacaabay Labo Saxiix Ay Chelsea Ku Qasban Tahay Inay Sameyso Suuqa Xagaaga
body:
Halyeygii hore ee kooxda Chelsea, Joe Cole, ayaa ku taliyay in kooxdiisii hore ay u dhaqaaqdo saxiixyada Robert Lewandowski oo u ciyaara Barcelona iyo John Stones oo ka tirsan Manchester City.
Cole ayaa ku dooday in labadan ciyaaryahan ee khibradda leh ay si weyn u xoojin lahaayeen kooxda uu hoggaamiyo Liam Rosenior, gaar ahaan dhanka caawinta iyo hagidda ciyaartoyda da’da yar ee ku badan safka Chelsea.
Wareysi uu siiyay Metro, ayuu ku sharraxay in Lewandowski oo xor noqon kara marka uu dhamaado qandaraaskiisa Barcelona uu noqon karo macallin iyo tusaale fiican oo ay wax ka bartaan weeraryahannada da’da yar ee Liam Delap iyo João Pedro.
“Waxaan u baahannahay khibrad; qof cusub oo garab istaaga ciyaartoyda da’da yar. Waxaan eegi lahaa Lewandowski. Waa magac weyn, waxaana u malaynayaa inuu si dhab ah u caawin karo João Pedro iyo Liam Delap,” ayuu yiri Cole.
Sidoo kale, wuxuu soo bandhigay fikirka ah in lala soo saxiixdo John Stones haddii Manchester City ay u oggolaato in qandaraaskiisu dhammaado.
“Waa mid kale oo miisaan weyn ku yeelan kara qolka labiska, isagoo caawinaya isla markaana kor u qaadaya daafacyada dhexe ee da’da yar ee cajiibka ah ee aan ku haysanno Chelsea.”

headline: Frank Leboeuf Oo Saadaal Lama Filaan Ah Ka Bixiyay Kulanka City Iyo Arsenal
body:
Daaficii hore ee kooxda Chelsea, Frank Leboeuf, ayaa dhiibtay saadaashiisa ku aadan kulanka weyn ee maanta dhex mari doona kooxaha Manchester City iyo Arsenal ee ka tirsan horyaalka Premier League-ga.
Leboeuf oo la hadlayay ESPN FC, ayaa tilmaamay isbeddelada ka dhacay labada kooxood tan iyo finalkii Carabao Cup bishii March, kaas oo ay kooxda Pep Guardiola ku guuleysatay 2-0.
“Waxaan u malaynayaa in joogitaanka Saliba iyo Gabriel ay daafaca Arsenal ka dhigayso mid ka duwan sidii hore,” ayuu yiri Leboeuf.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray: “Sidaas darteed, waxaan u malaynayaa inay Manchester City ku adkaan doonto inay garaacdo Arsenal. Waxaanse saadaalinayaa inay City ku badin doonto 2-1.”
Xilligan la joogo, kooxda uu hoggaaminayo Mikel Arteta ayaa horyaalka ku hoggaaminaysa lix dhibcood oo ay ka horreyso City, taas oo ka dhigaysa kulanka maanta mid go’aamin kara jihada uu aadayo horyaalka xilli-ciyaareedkan.

headline: Michael Carrick Oo Farta Ku Fiiqay Ciyaaryahanka U Suurtageliyay Inay Garaacaan Chelsea
body:
Macallinka Manchester United, Michael Carrick, ayaa ammaan gaar ah u xushay xiddiga da’da yar ee Kobbie Mainoo ka dib bandhiggii cajiibka ahaa ee uu ka sameeyay guushii 1-0 ahayd ee ay United ka gaartay Chelsea.
“Waxaan u malaynayaa inay ahayd ciyaartii ugu fiicnayd ee uu Kobbie dheelo, hubaal tan iyo markii aan halkan ku soo laabtay. Inuu horay u soo tillaabsado oo uu dhinacyo badan oo ciyaartiisa ah soo bandhigo caawa waa wax weyn,” ayuu yiri Carrick.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray in deganaanshaha Mainoo uu ahaa mid soo jiidasho leh: “Waxaan u arkayay mid aad u deggen, oo leh joogitaan dhab ah, si fiicanna u difaacday. Ma fududa marka ay kugu xeeran yihiin ciyaartoy tayo leh, waxayna ahayd dagaal wanaagsan oo dhex maray isaga iyo Cole Palmer.”
Carrick ayaa sidoo kale shaaca ka qaaday in Mainoo uusan si buuxda u tababaran ka hor ciyaarta: “Kobbie si badan uma tababaran. Wuxuu qabtay xoogaa yar maalintii Khamiista iyo in yar oo dheeri ah shalay, markaa ammaan ayay u tahay inuu ciyaar caynkan oo kale ah soo bandhigo isagoo aan tababar buuxa helin. Wuxuu na tusay waxa uu awoodo.”

body:
Bruno Fernandes ayaa galay diiwaanka taariikhda kooxda Manchester United, isagoo noqday ciyaaryahankii ugu horreeyay ee taariikhda kooxda ee xilli-ciyaareed kaliya gudahiisa ka sameeya 18 caawin iyo wax ka badan horyaalka Premier League.

Guushan 1-0 ahayd ee ay ku soo gaareen garoonka Stamford Bridge ayaa timid xilli muhiim ah, taageerayaasha kooxda ayaana uga mahadcelinaya Bruno iyo Cunha oo iska kaashaday goolkaas.

headline: Muxuu Liam Rosenior Ka Yiri Guuldarradii Chelsea Ka Soo Gaartay Manchester United?
body:
Tababaraha kooxda Chelsea, Liam Rosenior, ayaa ku dooday in kooxdiisu ay ahayd midda fiicnayd kulankii habeennimadii Sabtida, inkastoo ay guuldarro 1-0 ahi ka soo gaartay Manchester United.
“Ilaa iyo inta laga gaarayo xerada ganaaxa, aad ayaan u fiicnayn. Waxaan sheegayaa wixii dhacay, waxaana u malaynayaa inaan ahayn kooxda garoonka maamulaysay laga soo bilaabo daqiiqaddii koowaad ilaa dhamaadkii ciyaarta,” ayuu Rosenior u sheegay TNT Sports.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray inay aad kuu niyad-jabineyso in ciyaarta lagaaga badiyo qaabkaas: “Inaan ciyaartan ku weyno qaabkaas waa wax aad looga xumaado, sababtoo ah waxaan helnay fursado badan oo aan ku guuleysan karno.”
Isagoo ka hadlayay goolka kaliya ee United ay ku badisay, wuxuu yiri: “Aad bay u dhib badan tahay. Waxaan filayaa inuu ahaa laadkii kaliya ee ay ku laadeen dhanka goolka, waxaana markaas garoonka nooga maqnaa hal ciyaaryahan [Wesley Fofana oo daawayn loo saaray], balse waa inaan si ka fiican u difaacannaa.”
Rosenior ayaa hadalkiisa kusoo xiray digniin ku aadan heerka ciyaarta: “Heerkan oo kale, ma damin kartid dareenkaaga daqiiqad kasta, si kasta oo aad ciyaarta u maamusho. Waxay u muuqataa in qalad kasta oo yar uu ku dhamaanayo shabaqeena, waana inay taasi isbeddeshaa.”

headline: Manchester United Oo Garaacday Chelsea, God Mugdi Ahna Ku Riday Rajadii Chelsea Ee Champions League Xilli Ciyaareedka Dambe
body:
Manchester United ayaa guul qaali ah oo 1-0 ah ka gaartay kooxda Chelsea kulan ka tirsanaa wareegga 33-aad ee horyaalka Premier League-ga, kaas oo ka dhacay garoonka Stamford Bridge.
Qaybtii hore ee ciyaarta ayaa inta badan ahayd mid dheellitiran, iyadoo aanay jirin fursado badan oo goolal lagu dhalin karay, inkastoo Chelsea ay waxyar kaga sarreysay United dhanka haysashada kubbadda iyo maamulka khadka dhexe.
Markii ay ciyaartu socotay, qaab-ciyaareedka Manchester United ayaa tartiib-tartiib u soo wanaagsanaaday, waxayna ku guuleysteen inay hoggaanka qabtaan daqiiqaddii 43-aad ee ciyaarta. Goolkaas waxaa u saxiixay Matheus Cunha, ka dib markii uu helay karoos sax ah oo uu ka soo shaqeeyay Bruno Fernandes, iyadoo Cunha uu si qurux badan kubbadda ugu hubsaday shabaqa.
Qaybtii labaad ee tartanka, Manchester United waxay aad ugu tiirsanayd weerarada rogaal-celiska ah ee degdegga ah, iyagoo dhowr jeer uu halis galiyay goolka kooxda ka soo horjeeda. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, xoogaa deganaan la’aan ah oo ka muuqatay taabashada ugu dambaysa iyo go’aanno aan sax ahayn oo ay ku sameeyeen goolka hortiisa ayaa u diiday United inay sii kordhiso hoggaankeeda.
Dhanka kale, Chelsea ayaa kordhisay dadaalkeeda daqiiqadihii ugu dambeeyay si ay u hesho goolka bar-baraha, iyadoo samaysay darbooyin iyo isku-dayo shakhsi ah oo ay ka tuurayeen bannaanka aagga ganaaxa. Balse, dhammaan isku-dayadaas midna gool uma istaagin, ciyaartuna waxay ku dhammaatay guul ay gaartay kooxda Manchester United.

headline: Gabriel Magalhaes Oo Farriin Culus U Diray Pep Guardiola Ka Hor Kulanka Axadda
body:
Dagaalka dhanka maskaxda ee u dhexeeya labada kooxood ee ugu sarreeya horyaalka Premier League ayaa gaaray heerkii ugu sarreeyay ka hor kulanka weyn ee Axadda ka dhici doona garoonka Etihad.
Iyadoo Manchester City ay si aad ah u cayrsanayso Arsenal, daafaca reer Brazil ee Gabriel Magalhaes ayaa jawaab adag ka bixiyay cadaadiska sii kordhaya ee kooxdiisa lagu hayo iyo hadallada ka soo yeeraya dhanka magaalada Manchester.
Gabriel ayaan ka gaban tartankan adag, isagoo yiri: “Dhabtii! Waxaan rabaa inaan ka hor yimaado ciyaartoy waaweyn, waxayna noqon doontaa dagaal weyn. Taas ayaan u joogaa halkan; inaan la ciyaaro xiddigaha heerka sare ah. Waxaan jeclahay inaan ahaado mid ad-adeyg iyo awood isku darsaday. Waxaan u baahannahay inaan ku raaxaysanno daqiiqad kasta. Waxay noqon doontaa maalin weyn Kulanka axadda.”
Isagoo ka hadlayay hadallada ka soo yeeray Pep Guardiola, wuxuu raaciyay: “Uma baahnin inaan dhagaysanno buuqaas. Waxay dhihi karaan wax kasta oo ay rabaan. Kaliya waa inaan diiradda saarnaa nafteena iyo ciyaarta aan rabno inaan dheelno. Waa ciyaar qurux badan oon sugeynay. Waxaan nahay kuwo u diyaar ah!”

headline: Jurgen Klopp Oo Ka Jawaabay Wararka La Xiriirinaya Liverpool Iyo Real Madrid
body:
Jurgen Klopp ayaa iska diiday fursad uu dib ugu laaban lahaa kooxda Liverpool iyo xiiso uu ka helay Real Madrid, isagoo diiradda saaraya qorshe fog oo uu ku doonayo inuu ku qabto xulka qaranka Jarmalka.
Sida uu sheegay wargeyska Diario AS, tababarihii hore ee Liverpool oo hadda ah agaasimaha isboortiga ee kooxaha Red Bull, ayaan ka fekerayn inuu si degdeg ah ugu soo laabto tababarennimada kooxaha. In kasta oo ay jireen warar muddo toban sano ah lala xiriirinayay Real Madrid, Klopp ma qorsheynayo inuu ku biiro kooxda reer Spain, sidoo kale kooxdu si rasmi ah uma cayrsanayso xilligan.
Sidoo kale, Klopp ma xiiseynayo inuu dib ugu laabto Liverpool marxaladdan. Wuxuu ku qanacsan yahay doorkiisa hadda iyo nolosha uu ku haysto magaalada Mallorca, wuxuuna isha ku hayaa inuu la wareego xilka tababaraha xulka Jarmalka ka dib Koobka Adduunka 2026, taas oo ku xirnaan doonta mustaqbalka Julian Nagelsmann.
Warbixintu waxay caddeysay in mustaqbalka Klopp uusan ku xirnayn Real Madrid ama Liverpool xilli-ciyaareedka soo socda, inkastoo ay jiraan mala-awaal badan oo ku saabsan shaqadiisa.

headline: Wayne Rooney Oo Daboolka Ka Rogay Sababta Ugu Weyn Ee Hoos U Dhaca Liverpool Xilli Ciyaareed Kaan
body:
Wayne Rooney ayaa aaminsan in kooxda Liverpool ay weysay sifo muhiim ah oo ka caawisay guulihii ay gaartay xilli-ciyaareedkii hore.
Rooney ayaa yiri: “Waxaan u malaynayaa qaar ka mid ah ciyaartoydii ay lumiyeen aawgeed, gaar ahaan [Diogo] Jota, inay ahayd wax uu ka xumaado qof kasta. [Luis] Diaz, xitaa [Darwin] Nunez wuxuu ahaa mid dardar badan inkastoo uu iska galab-galab ahaa. Markaad tagto Anfield, waxaad horey u arki jirtay xiddigo ay ka mid yihiin Stevie [Gerrard] iyo Dirk Kuyt oo si xooggan kuu cadaadinaya.”
Wuxuu intaas ku daray: “Waxaan u malaynayaa in taasi ay ahayd waxa ay Nunez iyo Diaz samayn jireen. Hadda taas wax yar ayay lumiyeen.”

headline: Sergio Aguero Oo Magacaabay Weeraryahanka Kaliya Ee Uu Aaminsan Yahay Inuu Barcelona Ku Hoggaamin Karo Koobab Waaweyn
body:
Weeraryahankii hore ee dalka Argentina, Sergio Aguero, ayaa rumeysan in Julian Alvarez oo u ciyaara kooxda Atletico Madrid uu noqon karo saxiix ku habboon kooxda Barcelona.
Aguero ayaa yiri: “Julian wuxuu saxiix fiican u noqon lahaa koox kasta maanta. Marka loo eego Barca, dabcan wax walba waxay ku xiran yihiin inuu dareemo raaxo. Waxay ku xiran tahay inay isfahmaan ciyaaryahanka iyo kooxda. Haddii wax walba si fiican u dhacaan, maalin uun wuxuu noqon doonaa xiddig ku guuleysta Champions League.”
“Way ku adag tahay inuu halkaas sii joogo, aad ayayna murugo ugu tahay. Laakiin haddii Barca ay isha ku hayso isagana uu bandhig fiican samaynayo, waxaa ku fiican inuu halkaas iska xaadiriyo.”
Ugu dambeyntii, Aguero ayaa ammaanay tayada gaarka ah ee Alvarez isagoo yiri: “Wuu jecel yahay kubadda cagta, wuxuuna leeyahay wax aysan lahayn weeraryahanno badan: kaas oo ah dhinaca difaaca oo uu aad ugu heellan yahay. Julian waa ciyaaryahan aad u dhammaystiran.”

headline: Paul Scholes Iyo Gary Neville Oo Saadaal Kala Duwan Ka Bixiyay Kulanka Weyn Ee City Iyo Arsenal
body:
Kulanka bari ee u dhexeeya Manchester City iyo Arsenal waa midka ugu saamaynta badan tartanka horyaalka Premier League-ga xilli-ciyaareedkan, iyadoo labada kooxoodba ay ka warqabaan in natiijada ka soo baxda ay go’aamin karto halka uu koobku ku dambayn doono.
Arsenal ayaa hadda lix dhibcood ka horreysa City, in kasta oo Manchester City uu u harsan yahay hal kulan oo baaqi ah. Guul ay gaarto City waxay dib ugu soo celinaysaa loolanka dhabta ah ee horyaalka, halka Arsenal ay ogtahay in natiijo wanaagsan oo ay kala soo laabato Etihad ay aad u xoojin doonto fursadeeda hanashada koobka.
Inkastoo Arsenal ay aaminsan tahay inay natiijo heli karto, khubarada kubadda cagta ayaan isku raacsanayn waxa dhici kara:
Gary Neville:Wuxuu saadaaliyay in ciyaartu ku dhammaan doonto bar-baro 1-1 ah. Neville wuxuu rumeysan yahay inuu xafiiltan adag dhex mari doono labada kooxood, bar-baruhuna uu Arsenal u oggolaan doono inay sii haystaan hoggaanka, inkastoo ay albaabka u furayso City kulammada haray.
Paul Scholes: Wuxuu qabaa aragti ka duwan taas, isagoo yiri: “Waxaan u malaynayaa in City ay si fudud u guuleysan doonto… Waxay ku badin doonaan labo ama saddex gool iyo waxba.” Scholes wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay in City ay tahay koox aad u xooggan marka ay joogto garoonkeeda, gaar ahaan kulammada waaweyn.
Haddiiba ay u dhacdo sida uu Neville saadaaliyay oo dhibcaha la qaybsado, ama ay u dhacdo sida Scholes uu filayo oo City ay si raaxo leh ku badiso, kulankani wuxuu hadhayn doonaa dhammaadka xilli-ciyaareedka waana midka go’aaminaya halka uu u jiheysanayo horyaalka Ingiriiska.

headline: Neymar: “Kadib Messi, Barcelona Waxay Heshay Dheeman”
body:
Xiddiga garabka uga ciyaara kooxda Santos ee dalka Brazil, Neymar Jr, ayaa ammaan ballaaran u jeediyay da’yarka wacdaha dhigaya ee kooxda Barcelona, Lamine Yamal.
“Waxaan rumeysanahay inuu yahay mid ka mid ah hibada ugu weyn ee ay kubadda cagtu waligeed aragto isagoo da’yar. Waxaa soo maray kubadda cagta Messi, aniga… laakiin waxa uu wiilkan samaynayo isagoo 18 jir ah waa wax cajiib ah,” ayuu yiri Neymar.
Neymar ayaa sidoo kale ka hadlay dareenkiisii markii Barcelona laga reebay tartanka Champions League-ga: “Aad baan uga xumaaday markii laga saaray UCL. Wax walba ayuu bixiyay, xitaa isaga ayaa horseeday soo laabashadii kooxda. Laakiin tani waa kubadda cagta, wax walba way dhici karaan.”
Wuxuu hadalkiisa kusoo xiray dhiirigelin uu u dirayo Yamal: “Waqtigiisii waa soo dhow yahay. Waxaan rajaynayaa inuu guuleysto sanadka dambe… maxayse u dhici weysay inuu xitaa ku guuleysto Ballon d’Or? Waa wiil qaali ah. Waa mid ka mid ah ciyaartoyda aan mar walba taageeri doono.”

headline: 3 Kulan Oo Natiijooyin Lama Filaan Ah Ay Ka Dhici Karaan Premier League Todobaadkan
body:
Toddobaadka 33-aad ee horyaalka Premier League-ga ayaa galinka dambe ee maanta dib u bilaaban doona, iyadoo dhowr kulan oo xiiso leh la filayo inay dhacaan, kuwaas oo qaarkood ay ka dhalan karaan natiijooyin lama filaan ah.
Waa kuwan saddexda kulan ee sida gaarka ah isha loogu hayo inay natiijooyin lama filaan ah soo saaraan:
1. Tottenham vs Brighton
Kulankan ayaa caawa ka dhici doona garoonka Tottenham Hotspur Stadium. Spurs ayaa ku jirta xaalad aad u adag iyagoo fadhiya kaalinta 18-aad ee horyaalka, halka Brighton ay ku jirto kaalinta 9-aad. Tottenham ayaa kulankoodii ugu dambeeyay 1-0 guuldarro ahi ka soo gaartay Sunderland, halka Brighton ay 2-0 ku garaacday Burnley. Inkastoo Tottenham ay xilli-ciyaareedkan dhibtooneysay, waxay isku dayi doonaan inay ka faa’iideystaan garoonkooda si ay natiijo layaab leh uga helaan Brighton, uuna uga baaqsadaan guuldarro labaad oo xiriir ah.
2. Chelsea vs Man United
Chelsea ayaa caawa Stamford Bridge ku martigelin doonta kooxda Manchester United. Labada kooxoodba waxay dhibco lumiyeen kulammadii ugu dambeeyay; Chelsea waxaa garaacday Manchester City, halka United ay guuldarro lama filaan ah kala kulantay Leeds United. Blues ayaa fadhida kaalinta 6-aad, halka Red Devils ay ku jiraan kaalinta 3-aad.
Kooxda Liam Rosenior ayaa rajeynaysa inay ka fogaato guuldarro gurigooda ah, waxayna raadinayaan inay natiijo fiican ka helaan wiilasha Michael Carrick.
3. Everton vs Liverpool
Kulanka xiisaha badan ee Merseyside Derby ayaa galinka dambe ee Axadda ka dhici doona garoonka Everton. Everton ayaa bar-baro 2-2 ah la soo gashay Brentford kulankii u dambeeyay, halka Liverpool ay 2-0 ku soo garaacday Fulham. Kooxda David Moyes ayaa fadhida kaalinta 8-aad, halka Liverpool ay ku jirto kaalinta 5-aad. Everton ayaa markasta dhib weyn ku noqota kooxda ay xafiiltamaan ee Liverpool marka ay gurigeeda joogto, waxaana laga yaabaa inay natiijo layaab leh ka hesho kooxda Arne Slot si ay u sii horumariso dhibcaheeda.

headline: Shaxda Ay Manchester United Kaga Hor Tagi Karto Chelsea
body:
Manchester United ayaa isku dayi doonta inay sii xoojiso booska ay kaga jirto shanta sare ee horyaalka Premier League-ga marka ay caawa u safraan kooxda Chelsea kulan bilaaban doona 10-ka habeennimo (8-da fiidnimo xilliga UK).
Red Devils ayaa hadda fadhida kaalinta saddexaad, iyagoo toddobo dhibcood ka sarreeya kooxda ay caawa ka hor imanayaan ee Chelsea oo ku jirta kaalinta lixaad.
In lagu dhammaysto kaalinta shanaad ayaa hadda ku filan in lagu soo baxo tartanka Champions League-ga, kadib markii horyaalka Premier League-ga uu xaqiijiyay mid ka mid ah labada boos ee dheeriga ah ee lagu daray tartanka.
Shaxda Manchester United ee la saadaalinayo(4-2-3-1):
Lammens; Mazraoui, Yoro, Heaven, Shaw; Casemiro, Ugarte; Diallo, Fernandes, Cunha; Mbeumo.
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, kooxda Michael Carrick ayaa kulankan soo gelaysa iyadoo ku jirta xaalad xoogaa cakiran. Waxay guuleysteen kaliya hal kulan saddexdii ciyaarood ee ugu dambeeyay, iyadoo ay ku jirto guuldarradii gurigooda ku qabsatay Isniintii ee ka soo gaartay kooxda Leeds United.
Tani waxay imaanaysaa ka dib markii Red Devils laga badiyay kaliya labo kulan 22-kii ciyaarood ee ka horreeyay. Hadda waxay isku dayayaan inay iska ilaaliyaan in markii ugu horreysay xilli-ciyaareedkan labo kulan oo xiriir ah horyaalka laga badiyo.

headline: Shaxda Ay Chelsea Kaga Hor Tagi Karto Manchester United
body:
Kooxda Chelsea ayaa caawa Stamford Bridge dib ugu soo dhoweynaysa xiddiga reer Argentina ee Enzo Fernandez, ka dib markii uu dhammaystay labo kulan oo ganaax ah oo ay kooxdu ku soo rogtay. Ganaaxan ayaa yimid ka dib hadallo uu dhowaan ka yiri mustaqbalkiisa, kuwaas oo tababare Liam Rosenior uu ku tilmaamay kuwo “xadka ka baxsan”.
Iyadoo kabtanka kooxda Reece James uu weli la dhibtoonayo dhaawac dhanka muruqa ah, waxaa la filayaa in kabtanimada kooxda loo dhiibo Moises Caicedo. Caicedo ayaa shalay oo Jimce ahayd saxiixay qandaraas cusub, waxaana loo arkaa inuu yahay qofka ugu habboon ee hoggaamin kara Blues kulankan muhiimka u ah rajada Champions League-ga ee xilli-ciyaareedka dambe.
Dhanka kale, Chelsea waxaa weli ka maqan ciyaartoyda kala ah Jamie Gittens iyo goolhaye Filip Jorgensen oo qaba dhaawacyo muddo dheer qaadanaya.
Shaxda Chelsea ee la saadaalinayo(4-2-3-1):
Sanchez; Gusto, Fofana, Hato, Cucurella; Santos, Caicedo; Palmer, Fernandez, Neto; Joao Pedro.

Kooxda Chelsea ayaa caawa Stamford Bridge dib ugu soo dhoweynaysa xiddiga reer Argentina ee Enzo Fernandez, ka dib markii uu dhammaystay labo kulan oo ganaax ah oo ay kooxdu ku soo rogtay. Ganaaxan ayaa yimid ka dib hadallo uu dhowaan ka yiri mustaqbalkiisa, kuwaas oo tababare Liam Rosenior uu ku tilmaamay kuwo "xadka ka baxsan".
Iyadoo kabtanka kooxda Reece James uu weli la dhibtoonayo dhaawac dhanka muruqa ah, waxaa la filayaa in kabtanimada kooxda loo dhiibo Moises Caicedo. Caicedo ayaa shalay oo Jimce ahayd saxiixay qandaraas cusub, waxaana loo arkaa inuu yahay qofka ugu habboon ee hoggaamin kara Blues kulankan muhiimka u ah rajada Champions League-ga ee xilli-ciyaareedka dambe.
Dhanka kale, Chelsea waxaa weli ka maqan ciyaartoyda kala ah Jamie Gittens iyo goolhaye Filip Jorgensen oo qaba dhaawacyo muddo dheer qaadanaya.
Shaxda Chelsea ee la saadaalinayo(4-2-3-1):
Sanchez; Gusto, Fofana, Hato, Cucurella; Santos, Caicedo; Palmer, Fernandez, Neto; Joao Pedro.

headline: “Ma Dooneyno Barbarro” – Mikel Arteta Oo U Hanjabay City Ka Hor Kulanka Axadda
body:
Macallinka kooxda Arsenal, Mikel Arteta, ayaa diray digniin xooggan ka hor kulanka ay axadda la leeyihiin Manchester City, isagoo caddeeyay in kooxdiisu ay u tagayso garoonka Etihad kaliya si ay guul u soo gaarto.
Arsenal ayaa hadda lix dhibcood ka horreysa City, balse kooxda Pep Guardiola waxaa u harsan hal kulan oo baaqi ah. Haddii City ay guul gaarto kulankan iyo ciyaarta u dhiman, waxay la sinmi karaan dhibcaha Gunners, taas oo tartanka horyaalka ka dhigaysa mid aad u kulul.
Arteta oo ka hadlayay qorshaha kooxdiisa ayaa yiri: “Waxaan rabnaa inaan guuleysano. Waxaan u tagnay halkaas si aan u guuleysano. Kama aynaan hadlin bar-baro, waxaan u baahannahay guul. Ma jiri doonto wax farqi ah oo u dhexeeya garoonkan iyo garoomada kale ee aan tagnay shantii sano ee la soo dhaafay.”
Macallin Arteta ayaa doonaya inuu baddelo qaab ciyaareedkii labo sano ka hor markii ay bar-baro 0-0 ah kula soo galeen Etihad, taas oo markii dambe keentay in Rodri uu ku eedeeyo Arsenal inay ka maqnayd “maskaxda guusha”. Markan, Arteta wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay inay doonayaan weerar si ay u ballaariyaan hoggaanka dhibcaha una gaarsiiyaan sagaal dhibcood.
“Ma soo bandhigi doonno ciyaar difaac ah sababtoo ah marna ma samayno taas,” ayuu raaciyay Arteta. “Mararka qaarkood kooxda kaa soo horjeeda ayaa kugu qasbeysa inaad gadaal u gurato, laakiin hadafkeenu waa inaan ciyaarta maamulno.”
Sidoo kale, Arteta wuxuu kalsooni weyn ka muujiyay mid ka mid ah xiddigaha da’da yar ee kooxda isagoo yiri: “Wuxuu noqon doonaa mid diyaar ah, waan hubaa. Meel kasta oo aad geliso wiilkan, waad ogtahay waxa uu soo bandhigayo, wuxuuna taas muujiyay xilli-ciyaareedkan kulan kasta oo aan u xil-saarnay.”

headline: Arne Slot: “Ma Dhici Doonto Mar Kale Musiibadii Nagu Habsatay Xilli Ciyaareed Kaan”
body:
Macallinka kooxda Liverpool, Arne Slot, ayaa ka hadlay mustaqbalka kooxda ka dib markii ay ka hareen tartanka Champions League-ga, isagoo aaminsan in xiddigihiisu ay hadda la qabsadeen xawaaraha horyaalka Premier League-ga.
“Marka aad isbarbardhigto ciyaartoyda aan la soo saxiixanannay bilowgii xilli-ciyaareedka iyo halka ay hadda joogaan, waxaan arkaa isbeddel weyn oo dhanka wanaagsan ah,” ayuu yiri Slot.
Wuxuu tusaale u soo qaatay xiddiga cusub ee Florian, isagoo yiri: “Haddii aad aragtay wixii uu Florian awooday inuu sameeyo ciyaartiisii saddexaad muddo toddoba casho gudahood ah (kulankii PSG), markaad barbar dhigto bilowgii xilli-ciyaareedka, waxaan arkaa farqi aad u weyn.”
Slot ayaa sidoo kale xusay inuusan u malaynayn inay mar kale la kulmi doonaan xilli-ciyaareedkan oo kale oo ay nasiib-xumo badan haraysay. “Miyuu jiri doonaa xilli-ciyaareed kale oo nalaga dhaliyo goolal badan waqtiga dheeriga ah? Uma malaynayo inay taasi suurtagal tahay. Haddii tan aysan dhici lahayn, waxaan heysan lahayn dhibco lix, toddoba ama siddeed oo kale.”
Wuxuu hadalkiisa raaciyay in dhaawacyada badan ee kooxda soo gaaray ay qayb ka ahaayeen nasiib-xumadaas: “Miyaan mar kale yeelan doonnaa xilli-ciyaareed dhaawacyo intaan la eg leh? Ma rumeysni inay macquul tahay in mar kale nalagu celiyo nasiib-xumo intaas la eg. Waxa ugu muhiimsan waa sida aan ula tartannay Paris Saint-Germain annagoo nasiyo helnay labo maalmood kaliya, halka ay iyagu haysteen toddobaad nasasho ah.”
Ugu dambeyntii, Slot ayaa rajo ka muujiyay xilli-ciyaareedka dambe: “Marka aad eegto inaan samayn doonno saxiixyo sax ah xagaaga, haddii aanan la kulmin nasiib-xumadii na qabsatay xilli-ciyaareedkan, waxaan yeelan doonnaa xilli-ciyaareed aad u wanaagsan.”

headline: Nicky Butt Oo Farta Ku Fiiqay Xiddiga Ay Tahay Inay United Iska Iibiso Suuqa Xagaaga
body:
Halyeygii hore ee khadka dhexe ee Manchester United, Nicky Butt, ayaa sheegay inuu taageero weyn u yahay Mason Mount, balse uu rumeysan yahay in kooxdu ay tahay inay iska iibiso xiddigan suuqa xagaaga.
Butt oo ka hadlayay xaaladda ciyaaryahanka ayaa yiri: “Waa ciyaaryahan cajiib ah, aad ayaan u taageeraa marka uu caafimaad qabo. Marka uu joogo maalintiisa ugu wanaagsan, waa ciyaaryahan heer sare ah oo ku habboon hab-ciyaareedka Manchester United.”
Wuxuu xasuusiyay taageerayaasha bandhiggii Mount ee kooxdiisii hore: “Aad baan u jeclaa markii uu bandhigga fiican samaynayay, wuxuuna ahaa mid aad u wanaagsan markii uu u ciyaarayay Chelsea. Laakiin dhibaatadu waxay tahay inuusan caafimaad qabin.”
Butt ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay in muddadii saddexda sano ahayd ee uu Mount joogay Old Trafford aysan midho-dhal noqon dhaawacyo dartood: “Wuxuu halkaas joogay ku dhowaad saddex sano. Way igu adag tahay inaan dhaleeceeyo dadka dhaawacan, laakiin marka aad eegto inta lacag ee lagu soo iibiyay (£55 milyan) iyo waxa uu soo celiyay, gaar ahaan marka la joogo xilliga qandaraas kordhinta, ma sii haysan kartid qof noocaa”
Ugu dambeyntii, Nicky Butt wuxuu ku taliyay in kooxdu ay horey u socoto: “Waa inaad iska iibisaa uun. Waa wax laga xumaado laakiin waa inay sameeyaan. United waxay u baahan tahay ciyaartoy ay isku halleyn karaan, gaar ahaan xilligan lagu jiro.”

headline: Carlo Ancelotti Oo Magacaabay Kooxda Uu Aaminsan Yahay Inay Ku Guuleysan Doonto Tartanka Champions League-ga
body:
Tababaraha xulka qaranka Brazil, Carlo Ancelotti, ayaa u saadaaliyay kooxda Paris Saint-Germain inay ku guuleysan doonto tartanka Champions League-ga xilli-ciyaareedkan.
Markii labaad oo xiriir ah, kooxda ka dhisan dalka Faransiiska ayaa tartanka ka saartay Liverpool, iyadoo markan ku reebtay wadar ahaan goolal gaaraya 4-0 wareeggii siddeed-dhammaadka. PSG ayaa hadda semi-finalka ku wajihi doonta kooxda Bayern Munich. Dhanka kale, kooxaha Arsenal iyo Atletico Madrid ayaa sidoo kale isku arki doona semi-finalka tartanka.
Ancelotti ayaa taageero u muujiyay PSG, kuwaas oo ah kooxda difaacanaysa tartanka, isagoo sheegay inay markale ku guuleysan karaan koobkan.
Isagoo la hadlayay Il Giornale, ayuu yiri: “Waxaan arkay kulamo cajiib ah oo goolal badan ay dhasheen, sida Atletico Madrid vs Barcelona iyo Bayern Munich vs Real Madrid, kuwaas oo xiiso gaar ah u lahaa taageerayaasha.”
Wuxuu intaas ku daray: “Champions League waa tartan aan mar walba u xaglin kooxaha ugu waaweyn sida Real Madrid, Barcelona, iyo Manchester City, laakiin weli waa tartan ay kooxuhu ku horumari karaan kuna kici karaan.”

headline: Oliver Kahn Oo Magacaabay Labada Tababare Ee Ugu Cad-cad Shaqada Real Madrid Haddii La Eryo Arbeloa
body:
Halyeyga kooxda Bayern Munich, Oliver Kahn, ayaa magacaabay labo tababare oo xilka kala wareegi kara Alvaro Arbeloa haddii maamulka Real Madrid ay go’aansadaan inay cayriyaan tababarahaas.
Arbeloa ayaa wajahaya cadaadis xooggan ka dib markii Real Madrid lagu reebay wareegga siddeed-dhammaadka ee tartanka UEFA Champions League, iyadoo kooxda Bayern Munich ay meel fagaaro ah ku garaacday Arbacadii la soo dhaafay.
Sidoo kale, kooxda reer Madrid ayaa sagaal dhibcood ka dambaysa Barcelona oo hoggaaminaysa tartanka LaLiga, ka hor kulanka ay la leeyihiin kooxda Alaves maalinta Talaadada.
Xilligan la joogo, Real Madrid waxay u muuqataa inay xilli-ciyaareedka ku dhamaysan doonto koob la’aan, taas oo keeni karta inay beddelaan Arbeloa marka uu dhammaado xilli-ciyaareedkan.
Kahn oo ay wareysatay Sky Sport Germany ayaa xusay Jurgen Klopp oo horay u soo layliyay Liverpool iyo Didier Deschamps oo hadda ah macallinka xulka qaranka Faransiiska inay yihiin kuwa u sharraxan xilkaas.
“Waxaan u malaynayaa in nin khibrad leh sida Didier Deschamps uu heli karo fursaddan, isagoo laga yaabo inuu xilka ka dego ka dib Koobka Adduunka ka dibna la wareego Real Madrid,” ayuu yiri Kahn.
Wuxuu sidoo kale intaas ku daray: “Si fudud ayaan u qiyaasi karaa Jurgen Klopp. Waxaan u malaynayaa in Jurgen uu weli dareemayo xiisaha tababarennimo. In kasta oo uu caddeeyay inuu ku raaxaysanayo shaqadiisa hadda, haddana wax walba si degdeg ah ayay isugu beddelaan kubadda cagta. Markii Real Madrid ay kuu yeerto, inta badan ma dhihi kartid maya.”

headline: HORDHAC: Chelsea Vs Man United: Wax Walba Oo Aad Uga Baahan Halkaan Ka Ogoow
body:
Kooxda Chelsea ayaa gelaysa marxalad ay qasab ku tahay inay guul gaarto si ay u ilaaliso rajadeeda ka qaybgalka Champions League-ga xilli-ciyaareedka dambe, iyadoo habeenka Sabtida garoonka Stamford Bridge ku martigelin doonta Manchester United.
Manchester United ayaa kulankan soo galeysa kadib guuldarro layaab leh oo gurigooda ku qabsatay Isniintii, markaas oo ay kooxda Leeds United 2-1 ku garaacday. Guuldarradaas ayaa Manchester United dib ugu soo celisay loolanka loogu jiro afarta sarre, iyadoo Chelsea oo fadhida kaalinta lixaad ay toddobo dhibcood ka dambayso United, balse ay haystaan fursad ay dhibcahaas ku soo yareeyaan toddobaadkan.
Xogta Kulanka
Goobta: Stamford Bridge, London.
Taariikhda: Sabti, 18-ka Abriil.
Saacadda: 10:00 Habeenimo (Xilliga Geeska Afrika).
Garsooraha: Michael Oliver.
VAR: Tony Harrington.
Xaqiiqooyinka Kulanka:
Kulankan ayaa sidoo kale xiiso gaar ah u leh tababarayaasha labada kooxood, waana markii ugu horreysay tan iyo sanadkii 1999-kii oo labo tababare oo u dhashay dalka Ingiriiska ay iyagoo ku jira lixda sare ee horyaalka iska hor yimaadaan bisha Abriil.
Kooxda Liam Rosenior ee Chelsea ayaa doonaysa inay ka soo kabsato guuldarradii 3-0 ee ka soo gaartay Man City, halka United-da Michael Carrick ay doonayaan inay iska mayraan ceebtii Leeds United.

headline: Cole Palmer Oo Go’aan Culus Ka Soo Saaray Mustaqbalkiisa Chelsea
body:
Xiddiga khadka dhexe ee kooxda Chelsea, Cole Palmer, ayaa beeniyay wararka la isla dhexmarayo suuqa ee sheegaya inuu u dhaqaaqayo kooxda Manchester United xagaagan.
Palmer ayaa lala xiriirinayay inuu ka tagayo kooxda garoonka Stamford Bridge ka dib markii ay soo baxeen warar sheegaya inuusan ku qanacsanayn xaaladda kooxda. Xiddigan 23-jirka ah ayaa ku soo biiray Blues sanadkii 2023-kii, isagoo kaga yimid Manchester City lacag dhan £40 milyan oo Gini.
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Palmer oo la hadlayay wargeyska The Guardian ee dalka Ingiriiska, ayaa ku adkeystay inuu sii joogi doono Chelsea.
Palmer ayaa kalsooni ku qaba in kooxdu ay u tartami karto “koobab muhiim ah” xilli-ciyaareedka dambe haddii lala soo saxiixdo “ciyaartoyda saxda ah ee boosaska saxda ah” inta lagu jiro suuqa kala iibsiga ee xagaaga.
Chelsea ayaa hadda fadhida kaalinta lixaad ee horyaalka Premier League-ga, iyadoo afar dhibcood ka dambaysa kooxda Liverpool oo ku jirta kaalinta shanaad.

headline: Sergio Aguero Oo Saadaal Lama Filaan Ah Ka Bixiyay Kulanka Wayn Ee City Iyo Arsenal
body:
Halyeygii hore ee weerarka xulka Argentina iyo kooxda Manchester City, Sergio Aguero, ayaa dhiibtay saadaashiisa ku aadan kulanka xiisaha badan ee horyaalka Premier League-ga ee dhex mari doona Manchester City iyo Arsenal maalinta Axadda.
Arsenal ayaa ciyaartan soo gelaysa iyadoo lix dhibcood ka horreysa City, in kasta oo kooxda heysata horyaalka uu u harsan yahay hal kulan oo baaqi ah. Aguero ayaa sheegay inuu filayo “ciyaar layaab leh” maadaama Mikel Arteta iyo Pep Guardiola ay si fiican isku yaqaannaan.
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Aguero ayaa u saadaaliyay kooxdiisii hore inay garaaci doonto Arsenal kulankan go’aaminaya hoggaanka horyaalka.
“Waa ciyaar layaab leh. Labada tababare si fiican ayay isku yaqaannaan, waxayna ogyihiin meesha laga weeraro iyo meesha uu ka jilicsan yahay qofka ka soo horjeeda,” ayuu Aguero u sheegay Stake.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray: “Mararka qaarkood kulammadan oo kale goolal aad u yar ayaa dhasha, marna way furmaan oo waxay u noqdaan bandhig weyn taageerayaasha. Waxaan u malaynayaa in City ay ku soo bilaaban doonto si xooggan 10-ka illaa 15-ka daqiiqo ee ugu horreeya, iyagoo dardar gelinaya ciyaarta isla markaana la wareegi doona koontaroolka kubbadda.”
Aguero ayaa saadaashiisa ku soo xiray: “Ciyaartu waxay ku dhammaan kartaa 2-0 ama 2-1 oo ay ku guuleysato City. Waxaan rajeynayaa in City aysan wax badan dhibtoon, laakiin haddii ay ku hoggaaminayaan hal gool oo kaliya, waxaan u malaynayaa in daqiiqadaha ugu dambeeya ay City xoogaa dhibtoon doonto.”

headline: Michael Carrick Oo Albaabbada U Furay Soo Laabashada Marcus Rashford
body:
Tababaraha ku meel gaarka ah ee kooxda Manchester United, Michael Carrick, ayaa u muuqda mid albaabka u furay soo laabashada Marcus Rashford ka dib markii uu hal sano oo amaah ah ku qaatay kooxda Barcelona.
“Waxaan u malaynayaa in go’aanno laga gaari doono arrimo gaar ah marka la gaaro waqtiga saxda ah, hubaalna Marcus wuxuu ku jiraa xaaladdaas,” ayuu Carrick ka sheegay shirkiisa jaraa’id.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray: “Laakiin xilligan la joogo, waxba weli lama go’aamin. Waase la go’aamin doonaa sababtoo ah waa in go’aan la gaaro waqti cayiman, laakiin marxaladdan ma jirto wax laga sheego.”

headline: Maxaa Hor Taagan In Vinicius Jr Qandaraas Cusub U Saxiixo Real Madrid?
body:
Sida uu sheegay wariyaha caanka ah ee Jorge Picon, waxaa jirta suurtagalnimo xooggan oo ah in Vinicius Jr. uu si bilaash ah kaga tago kooxda Real Madrid xagaaga sanadka 2027-ka.
Tani waxay dhalatay ka dib markii Vinicius uu diiday inuu aqbalo dalabka qandaraas kordhinta ah ee ay kooxdu miiska u saartay bilo ka hor. “Waxaa miiska u saarnaa dalab qandaraas kordhin ah muddo dheer. Dhibaatadu waxay tahay: kooxda la taliyayaashiisa ah ayaa dalbanaya lacag intaas ka badan,” ayuu yiri Picon.
Dalabyada xiddiga ayaa salka ku haya in loo kordhiyo mushaharka ama la siiyo gunno qandaraas kordhin ah oo aysan kooxdu horay u bixin. Dhanka kale, Real Madrid ayaan qorshaynayn inay xitaa hal senti ku kordhiso dalabka ay u gudbiyeen, in kasta oo ay doonayaan inuu saxiixo oo uu sii joogo.
Picon ayaa intaas ku daray: “Ciyaaryahanku isna wuxuu rabaa inuu sii joogo, laakiin wuxuu aad ugu dhowaanayaa inuu noqdo ciyaaryahan xor ah (Janaayo 2027). Saadaashayda ku aadan waxa aan ogahay: arrintan, ha xumaato ama ha fiicnaato, waxay jiitami doontaa illaa ka dib Koobka Adduunka.”
Xilli-ciyaareedkan, qaab ciyaareedka Vinicius ayaa ahaa mid isbedbeddelaya (mar fiican mar xun), iyadoo inta badan culayska dhalinta goolasha ee kooxda uu dusha u ritay Kylian Mbappe.

headline: Pep Guardiola Oo Durba Cabsi Ka Muujiyay Arsenal Ka Hor Kulanka Axadda
body:
Macallinka kooxda Manchester City, Pep Guardiola, ayaa ka hadlay qaab ciyaareedka uu Mikel Arteta ku soo kordhiyay kooxda Arsenal, xilli labada dhinac ay isku diyaarinayaan kulanka go’aamin kara tartanka horyaalka Premier League-ga.
Guul ay gaarto Arsenal waxay ka dhigan tahay inay sagaal dhibcood ka sare mari doonaan kooxda Guardiola, halka guuldarro soo gaarta ay si weyn u yareyn karto fursadooda hanashada horyaalka ee xilli-ciyaareedkan. In kasta oo Arsenal lagu dhaleeceeyay qaab ciyaareedka ay qaadatay xilli-ciyaareedkan, haddana Guardiola ayaa sheegay inuu ku raaxaysto daawashada Gunners.
Isagoo la hadlayay saxaafadda ka hor kulanka weyn ee Axadda, Guardiola ayaa yiri: “Waan ku raaxaystaa daawashadooda. Waa koox awood badan oo aan la dhayalsan karin. Waxyaabo badan ayaan ka bartaa. Waa koox jecel guusha.”
Wuxuu intaas ku daray: “Waxay soo mareen 22 sano oo aysan guuleysan Premier League. Dhinacaas tartan ma nagula geli karaan. Waxay leeyihiin wax ka dhigaya kuwo gaar ah…”
Manchester City ayaa hadda lix dhibcood ka dambaysa Arsenal ka hor inta uusan bilaaban kulanka, waxayna u soo jiri karaan saddex dhibcood oo kaliya haddii ay guuleystaan. Sidoo kale, wiilasha Pep Guardiola waxaa u harsan hal kulan oo baaqi ah.

headline: Mikel Arteta Oo Xaqiijiyay Labo Xiddig Oo Muhiim Ah Oo Seegi Doona Kulanka Man City
body:
Macallinka kooxda Arsenal, Mikel Arteta, ayaa xaqiijiyay in xiddiga garabka uga ciyaara ee Bukayo Saka uusan diyaar u ahayn safarka ay maalinta Axadda ugu dhoofayaan magaalada Manchester si ay ula soo ciyaaraan Manchester City.
Saka ayaan garoomada lagu arkin tan iyo markii Gunners ay guuldarro 2-0 ahi ka soo gaartay kooxda Bournemouth tartanka Carabao Cup 22-kii bishii Maarso. Xiddigan 24-jirka ah ayaan weli ka soo kabsan dhaawac looga shakisan yahay inuu kasoo gaaray seedka ciribta, loomana dooran doono kulanka City ee dhammaadka toddobaadkan.
Sidoo kale, Mikel Merino ayaan dib ugu soo laaban doonin garoomada isagoo kasoo kabanaya jab ka soo gaaray cagta, inkastoo uu hadda iska saaray kabiinkii difaacayay lugta.
Arteta oo la hadlayay wariyaasha maalintii Jimcaha ayaa yiri: “Bukayo ma ciyaari doono, taasi waa hubaal. Marka ay timaaddo Saka, waxaan ula tacaalaynaa si aan marka hore u ilaalino ciyaaryahanka, ka dibna uu u soo bandhigo bandhigga ugu wanaagsan ee uu awoodo.”
Wuxuu intaas ku daray: “Hadda ayuu bilaabay inuu sameeyo waxyaabo yaryar, markaa aan aragno horumarka uu sameeyo iyo sida degdegga ah ee uu u soo kaban karo. Laakiin xilligan diyaar ma ahan. Bukayo ma ciyaari doono, Mikel-na sidoo kale waa maqan yahay.”
Arteta ayaa hadalkiisa kusoo xiray: “Waxaan heli doonnaa xal, wax kasta oo dhaca. Aad ayaan ula qabsannay arrimahan xilli-ciyaareedkan. Wax kasta oo dhaca, waxaan la imaan doonnaa xalka saxda ah.”
