headline: Oliver Kahn Oo Magacaabay Xiddiga Uu Aaminsan Yahay Inuu Ku Guuleysanayo Abaalmarinta Ballon d’Or 2026
body:
Halyeyga xulka Jarmalka, Oliver Kahn, ayaa u xushay garabka kooxda Bayern Munich, Michael Olise, inuu ku guuleysan doono abaalmarinta Ballon d’Or ee sanadka 2026-ka.
Kahn ayaa aaminsan in bandhigga ciyaareed ee Olise ee xilli-ciyaareedkan uu ka dhigayso tartamaha ugu mudan ee abaalmarintan ka hor xiddigaha kale.
Hadalkan ayaa imaanaya kadib markii Olise uu Bayern ku hoggaamiyay inay garaacaan Real Madrid kulankii lugta labaad ee wareegga siddeed-dhammaadka Champions League-ga ee dhacay bartamihii toddobaadkan.
“Haddii aad eegto bandhigiisii toddobaadyadii la soo dhaafay, Michael Olise wuxuu hubaal u socdaa dhanka abaalmarinta Ballon d’Or,” ayuu Kahn u sheegay Sky Germany.
Olise ayaa soo bandhigay qaab ciyaareed aad u sarreeya xilli-ciyaareedkan. Olise iyo Vinicius Jr oo Real Madrid ah ayaa ah ciyaartoyda caawinta ugu badan ka sameeyay tartanka Champions League-ga illaa hadda.

headline: Gary Neville Oo Farta Ku Fiiqay Xiddiga Looga Fadhiyo Inuu Arsenal Ku Hoggaamiyo Horyaalka Sannad Kaan
body:
Halyeeyga kooxda Manchester United, Gary Neville, ayaa aaminsan in xiddiga khadka dhexe ee xulka qaranka England, Declan Rice, uu yahay xiddiga looga fadhiyo inuu Arsenal u xaqiijiyo horyaalka Premier League-ga marka ay Axadda wajahayaan Manchester City.
Isagoo ka hadlayay barnaamijka The Overlap, Neville ayaa sidoo kale qirtay inuu aad uga xumaaday markii uu Rice ku biiray Arsenal isagoo ka yimid West Ham United.
“Markii uu Rice ugu biiray Arsenal lacag dhan £100 milyan, aad baan uga xumaaday. Waxaan u malaynayaa inuu yahay ciyaaryahan u qalma Manchester United,” ayuu yiri Neville.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray isagoo ka hadlayay kulanka soo socda: “Marka la eego ciyaarta Axadda, isagu waa ciyaaryahanka aan isha ku hayo. Tan macnaheedu ma ahan inaan cadaadis saarayo, balse waxaan ka filayaa inuu soo bandhigo wacdarihii looga bartay halyeeyadii Roy Keane iyo Steven Gerrard xilliyadii ay ciyaari jireen kulammada waaweyn.”
Manchester City ayaa ku martigelin doonta Gunners garoonka Etihad Stadium dhammaadka toddobaadkan, iyadoo hadda fadhida kaalinta labaad, iyadoo lix dhibcood ka dambaysa kooxda Mikel Arteta. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, kooxda Cityzens ayaa gacanta ku haysata hal kulan oo baaqi ah.

headline: Ferdinand: “Ma Jiro Tababare Doonaya Inuu Qabto Arsenal, Marka Loo Eego Man United”
body:
Halyeyga kooxda Manchester United, Rio Ferdinand, ayaa magacaabay saddex tababare oo kaliya kuwaas oo doorbidaya kooxda Arsenal beddelka Manchester United, isagoo isla markaana digniin culus u diray taageerayaasha Gunners ee dalbanaya in la eryo Mikel Arteta.
Ferdinand oo ka hadlayay barnaamijkiisa YouTube-ka, ayaa kula taliyay taageerayaasha Arsenal inay ka fiirsadaan waxa ay ku hamiyayaan: “Haddii aad tahay taageere Arsenal, waxaan dhihi lahaa ka fikir waxaad ku hamiyayso, haddii aad u malaynayso in eryidda Arteta ay tahay waxa ugu wanaagsan ee aad samayn kartaan.”
Wuxuu xasuusiyay halkii ay kooxdu joogtay ka hor inta uusan imaan Arteta: “Waa inaad xasuusataan halkii aad joogteen markii uu imanayay. Hadda si joogto ah ayaad ugu soo bixi kartaan Champions League, taas oo aysan jirin ka hor inta uusan isagu imaan. Inta badan waxaad ku dhameysaneysaan kaalinta labaad, waxaadna u dagaallameysaan horyaalka Premier League sanad walba.”
Isagoo ka hadlayay macallimiinta lala xiriirinayo Arsenal, Ferdinand wuxuu yiri: “Luis Enrique ma imaanayo Arsenal. Miyaad waalan tihiin! Ma waxaad filaysaan inuu ka soo tago kooxda ugu wanaagsan adduunka (PSG) oo uu yimaado Arsenal? Tababare kasta oo kale, marka laga reebo Thierry Henry, Patrick Vieira ama Cesc Fabregas, waxay dooran lahaayeen inay aadaan Man United halkii ay Arsenal aadi lahaayeen.”

headline: Erling Haaland Oo Digniin Culus U Diray Arsenal Ka Hor Kulanka Axadda
body:
Weeraryahanka kooxda Manchester City, Erling Haaland, oo la hadlayay Sky Sports ka hor kulanka weyn ee ay la leeyihiin Arsenal, ayaa qiray muhiimadda ay ciyaartani u leedahay tartanka horyaalka Premier League-ga.
“Had iyo jeer waa dagaal weyn, waana wax aad u wanaagsan in lala ciyaaro kooxaha ugu fiican, waayo taasi waa waxa aad doonayso inaad samayso,” ayuu yiri Haaland.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray: “Shaki la’aan waa ciyaar aad u weyn. Dhammaanteen waan ognahay muhiimadda uu leeyahay kulankan. Waa sida ciyaar final ah oo kale. Sida dhammaadka toddobaadkii hore aan ula ciyaarnay Chelsea, taasna waxay ahayd final. Aan runta sheegno, lixda toddobaad ee soo socota, dhammaad kasta oo toddobaad ah waxaa noo qorshaysan ciyaar final ah.”
Haaland ayaa hadalkiisa kusoo xiray: “Waa ciyaar weyn, laga yaabaa inay tahay ciyaarta ugu weyn uguna wanaagsan ee dhici karta, markaa waxaan rajeynayaa inay noqoto mid cajiib ah. Kuwani waa kulammada aad rabto inaad ciyaarto, waana xilliyada aad jeceshahay inaad ku dhex jirto.”

headline: Manchester United Oo Xaqiijisay Kulamada Uu Lisandro Martinez Seegayo
body:
Tababaraha kooxda Manchester United, Michael Carrick, ayaa xaqiijiyay in Lisandro Martinez uusan u safan doonin kooxda kulanka horyaalka Premier League-ga ee ay la ciyaarayaan Chelsea.
Tani waxay ka dhigan tahay in isku daygii kooxdu ay racfaan uga qaadanaysay kaarkii casaa ee Martinez loo taagay kulankii Leeds uu fashilmay.
“Ma aynaan waafaqsanayn go’aankaas, waana iska cadahay sidii aan dareemayay ciyaarta ka dib, welina sidii ayaan dareemayaa,” ayuu Carrick ka sheegay shirkiisa jaraa’id. “Ma rabo inaan hadda gudaha u galo arrintaas, sida ay tahay ayaan u aqbalaynaa, horey ayaana u soconaynaa.”
Martinez ayaa la siiyay kaar cas oo toos ah ka dib markii uu timaha ka jiiday Dominic Calvert-Lewin. Maadaama falkaas loo tixgeliyay ‘anshax xumo rabshad wadata’, xiddiga u dhashay dalka Argentina ayaa la kulmay ganaax toos ah oo saddex kulan ah, taas oo la macno ah inuu sidoo kale seegi doono kulammada Brentford iyo Liverpool.

headline: Pep Guardiola Oo Daaha Ka Rogay Kulanka Go’aaminaya Horyaalka Xilli Ciyaareed Kaan

“Dhab ahaantii. Haddii nalaga badiyo, wax walba way dhammaanayaan,” ayuu yiri macalinka City intii uu ku jiray shirkiisa jaraa’id ee Jimcaha. Wuxuu xusay turunturooyinkii ugu dambeeyay ee Arsenal, isagoo tilmaamay inay ku guuldarraysteen inay ka badiyaan Bournemouth, balse wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay inay weli labada dhinacba u dhiman yihiin kulamo badan.
“Inaan ogaanno in Arsenal aysan ka badin Bournemouth waa muhiim, laakiin weli ciyaaro ayaa noo dhiman. Lix kulan waa wax badan,” ayuu raaciyay.
Maadaama ay Arsenal hadda lix dhibcood ku hoggaaminayso horyaalka, City-na uu u harsan yahay hal kulan oo baaqi ah, Guardiola wuxuu garawsan yahay in guul ay ku gaaraan garoonka Etihad ay lagama maarmaan u tahay rajadooda ku aadan in ay horyaalka difaacdaan.

“Toddobaadkan, waxaynu eegaynaa ciyaar go’aaminaysa horyaalka. Arsenal iyo Manchester City labadaba dhowr kulan ayaa u haray, laakiin qof kasta oo dabaal-dega Axadda wuxuu durba sawiran doonaa isagoo kor u qaadaya koobka Premier League-ga,” ayuu yiri Carragher.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray in guul ay Arsenal ku gaarto garoonka Etihad ay ka caawin doonto inay si fudud ugu guuleystaan horyaalka, halka bar-baro ay ka dhigan tahay inay dhib ku mari doonaan jidka harsan. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, guuldarro soo gaarta Arsenal ayuu sheegay inay fursad weyn siin doonto kooxda Pep Guardiola.
Carragher ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay in cadaadiska ugu weyn uu saaran yahay Mikel Arteta: “Guushu waxay meesha ka saari doontaa dhammaan dhaleeceyntii hore. Laakiin fashilku wuxuu horseedi doonaa waqti ciqaab iyo ciil ah. Arteta wuxuu kooxdiisa geeyay meel xasaasi ah isagoo adeegsanaya xeelad difaac ku dhisan.”
Wuxuu xusay in taageerayaasha Arsenal ay toddobadii bilood ee la soo dhaafay u dulqaadanayeen guulo aan lagu qancin, isagoo tilmaamay in qaab ciyaareedka Arteta uu hadda aad ugu dhow yahay kii José Mourinho ee Chelsea beddelka qaabkii weerarka ee Guardiola.
“Hadda, Arteta waxaa ka xiga rumeynta himiladiisa hal guul oo taariikhi ah oo uu ka gaaro kooxda ay sida aadka ah u xafiiltamaan. Dhibaatadu waxay tahay in haddii laga badiyo, taageerayaasha Arsenal laga yaabo inay kooxdoodu noqoto midda loogu dhaleeceynta badan yahay taariikhda kooxaha u tartama horyaalka,” ayuu hadalkiisa kusoo xiray Carragher.

headline: Toni Kroos Oo Shaaciyay Hal Caqabad Oo Barcelona Ka Hor Istaageysa Inay Champions League Ku Guuleysato Sannadaha Soo Socda
body:
Xiddigii hore ee Real Madrid, Toni Kroos, ayaa sheegay in qaab ciyaareedka ee ay hadda ku socoto Barcelona uu ka hor istaagi doono inay ku guuleystaan tartanka Champions League-ga.
Kooxda reer Catalonia ayaa laga saaray wareegga siddeed-dhammaadka tartankaas, kadib markii lagu reebay wadar ahaan 3-4.
“Waxaan u malaynayaa in Barcelona ay ahayd koox xooggan, laakiin marka aad muddo dheer ku ciyaarayso ciyaartoy la’aan, aad bay u adag tahay Inaad meel gaarto. Atletico waxay taqaannaa sida loo difaacdo natiijooyinka kulamada noocaas, marka loo eego faa’iidadii ay heleen lugtii hore iyo kaarkii casaa ee Barca, waxay heleen dhiirigelin weyn oo ay ku gaaraan nus-dhammaadka,” ayuu yiri Kroos.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray: “Marka aad u difaacato qaabkaas oo aad firaaqeyso gadaashaada, waxyaabaha noocan oo kale ah ayaa dhacaya, oo ay ku jiraan kaararka cas ee looga hortagayo in goolhayaha la gaaro.”
Kroos oo hadalkiisa sii wata ayaa yiri: “Daafaca Barcelona waa mid aad u jilicsan. Sannadkii hore waxay dhibaatadaas ku qabsatay kulankii Inter, sannadkan na waa Atletico. Sidaan horay u sheegay, haddii aysan wax ka beddelin qaab ciyaareedkooda, kuma guuleysan doonaan Champions League-ga,” ayuu Kroos ka yiri wareysi uu siiyay barnaamijka Luppen TV ee barta YouTube-ka.

headline: Maxaa Ka Jira Wararka Sheegaya In Arsenal Ay Ku Dhow Dahay Saxiixa Khvicha Kvaratskhelia?
body:
Wariyaha aadka loogu ixtiraamo xogaha suuqa kala iibsiga ee David Ornstein ayaa dharbaaxo weyn ku dhuftay taageerayaasha kooxda Arsenal, ka dib markii uu meesha ka saaray suurtagalnimada in kooxdu ay xagaaga u dhaqaaqdo saxiixa xiddiga Paris Saint-Germain ee Khvicha Kvaratskhelia.
Isagoo ka jawaabayay su’aalaha taageerayaasha ee barta The Athletic, Ornstein ayaa yiri: “Qof kastaa wuu jecel yahay Khvicha Kvaratskhelia, balse waxaan si buuxda u filayaa inuu sii joogayo PSG. Waxay u muuqataa inuu halkaas aad ugu faraxsan yahay, iyaguna hubaal aad bay ugu qanacsan yihiin isaga. Uma malaynayo in Arsenal ama cid kale ay fursad u helayso saxiixiisa xilligan.”
Xiddigan 25-jirka ah ee u dhashay dalka Georgia ayaa soo bandhigay qaab ciyaareed cajiib ah tan iyo markii uu kaga soo biiray PSG kooxda Napoli bishii Janaayo ee sanadkii 2025 lacag dhan €80 milyan oo Yuuro, isagoo si weyn u iftiimay kulankii wareegga siddeed-dhammaadka Champions League-ga ee ay ka guuleysteen Liverpool.
In kasta oo kooxaha Arsenal, Chelsea iyo Liverpool ay dhammaantood muujiyeen inay xiiseynayaan weeraryahankan, haddana qandaraaskiisa oo dhacaya sanadka 2029-ka iyo muhiimadda uu u leeyahay qorshaha tababare Luis Enrique ayaa ka dhigaysa bixitaankiisa mid aad u adag, ilaa laga helayo dalab aad u ballaaran oo aan caadi ahayn.

headline: Miyay Liverpool U Baahan Tahay Weeraryahan Kale? Slot Oo Fariin Cad Diray!
body:
Tababaraha kooxda Liverpool, Arne Slot, ayaa ku nuux-nuux saday muhiimadda ay kooxda u lahayd inay lasoo saxiixato labo weeraryahan, ka dib markii soo laabashada Alexander Isak ay kusoo beegantay dhaawac muddo dheer ah oo soo gaaray Hugo Ekitike.
“Waa wax wanaagsan inaynu lasoo saxiixannay labo lambar sagaal. Dad badan ayaa ka doodayay sababta aan ula soo saxiixannay labo, laakiin hadda waxay u muuqataa fikrad aad u wanaagsan,” ayuu yiri Slot. “Hadda dadku waxay leeyihiin waa inaan mid kale lasoo saxiixannaa xagaaga.”
Tababaraha u dhashay dalka Holland ayaa xusay sida ay arrintani ugu dhacday si la yaab leh. “Qof ayaa igu yiri maalin ka dib markii ay arrintu dhacday, ma qori kartid sheeko ka yaab badan in markuu Isak kusoo laabanayo shaxda koowaad, kan kale uu garoonka uga baxayo dhaawac muddo dheer ah.”
Slot ayaa caddeeyay in Isak uusan weli diyaar u ahayn inuu ciyaaro 90 daqiiqo oo buuxda, balse uu yahay dookh muhiim ah. “Waa wax aad u wanaagsan inuu Alex soo laabtay, balse ma ahan markii ugu horreysay oo aan waayo qof ka ciyaara boos gaar ah, sida daafaca midig. Alex waan ognahay inuusan weli diyaar u ahayn inuu ciyaaro 90-ka daqiiqo.”

headline: Patrick Vieira Oo Saadaaliyay Booska Ay Arsenal Kaga Dhameysan Karto Champions League Sanad Kaan.
body:
Halyeygii hore ee Arsenal, Patrick Vieira, ayaa bixiyay saadaal ku saabsan tartanka loogu jiro horyaalka Premier League-ga iyo kan Champions League-ga xilli-ciyaareedkan.
Vieira ayaa saadaaliyay in Arsenal ay kaga adkaan doonto Manchester City tartanka loogu jiro horyaalka dalka Ingiriiska, isla markaana ay xaqiijisan doonto booskeeda ciyaarta kama dambaysta ah ee Champions League-ga.
Wuxuu aaminsan yahay in kalsoonida iyo dardarta kooxda Mikel Arteta ay aad u sarreyso, xilli ay isu diyaarinayaan kulanka adag ee ay Axadda la ciyaari doonaan Man City iyo loolanka nus-dhammaadka Champions League-ga ee ay la geli doonaan Atletico Madrid dabayaaqada bishan.
“Waxaan aaminsanahay inay kooxda Arsenal haysato tayo ku filan oo ay ku tagi karaan finalka Champions League-ga, xataa ay ku guuleysan karaan Premier League-ga,” ayuu Vieira u sheegay CBS Sports.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray: “Kaliya waxay u baahan yihiin ciyaartoy muhiim ah oo kooxda hoggaamiya. Waxaan u malaynayaa in Gabriel uu ka mid noqon karo ciyaartoydaas, Declan Rice-na uu yahay mid kale.”

headline: Vinicius Jr Oo Jebiyay Rikoodh Uu Messi Horay U Dhigay
body:
Xiddiga kooxda Real Madrid, Vinicius Jr, ayaa jebiyay rikoorkii Lionel Messi ee ahaa ciyaaryahanka caawinta ugu badan ka sameeyay wareegyada bug-baxa ee tartanka Champions League-ga.
Guushan uu gaaray xiddiga reer Brazil ayaa timid kadib markii kooxda Los Blancos ay wadar ahaan labadii kulan 6-4 kaga hartay tartanka wareegga siddeed-dhammaadka.
Kulankii lugta labaad ee dhex maray Bayern Munich, Vinicius Jr ayaa caawiyay goolkii uu dhaliyay Kylian Mbappe, kaas oo ahaa goolkii saddexaad ee ay kooxdu dhaliso habeenkaas. In kasta oo Madrid ciyaartaas looga adkaaday 4-3, haddana caawintaas ayaa ka dhigtay Vinicius inuu ka sarre maro halyeeyga Lionel Messi.
Sida ay werisay shabakadda HITC, Vinicius Jr ayaa hadda ah xiddiga labaad ee caawinta ugu badan ka sameeyay kulammada bug-baxa ee UEFA Champions League.
Xiddigan reer Brazil ayaa hadda leh 13 caawin isagoo saftay 41 kulan oo wareegyada bug-baxa ah, halka Messi uu leeyahay 12 caawin isagoo saftay 77 kulan oo isla wareegyadaas ah.
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Vinicius ayaa weli ka dambeeya Cristiano Ronaldo, kaas oo haysta rikoorka ugu sarreeya isagoo sameeyay 15 caawin 85 kulan oo uu ciyaaray wareegyada bug-baxa.
Vinicius Jr oo weli da’ yar ayaa loo saadaalinayaa inuu jebin karo rikoorka Ronaldo haddii uu sii wado qaab ciyaareedkiisa cajiibka ah. Vinicius ayaa horay ugu guuleystay labo koob oo Champions League ah isagoo la jooga Real Madrid, halka Lionel Messi uu haysto afar koob, Cristiano Ronaldo-na uu ku guuleystay shan koob.

headline: Liverpool Oo Qorshaheeda Ka Saartay Xabi Alonso – Maxaa Is-beddelay?
body:
Kooxda Liverpool ayaan wax xiiso ah u hayn inay Xabi Alonso u magacawdo tababaraheeda xiga, waxayna qorshaynaysaa inay sii haysato Arne Slot xilli-ciyaareedka dambe.
In kasta oo kooxdu ay la daalaa-dhaceyso xilli-ciyaareed niyad-jab leh oo ay kaga hartay tartanka Champions League-ga, isla markaana ay fadhiso kaalinta shanaad ee horyaalka Premier League, haddana wariyaha caanka ah ee David Ornstein ayaa sheegay in maamulka FSG aysan hadda wax damac ah u hayn inay eryaan tababaraha u dhashay dalka Holland.
“Kuma baraarugsani inay Alonso ugu jirto ajandaha Liverpool,” ayuu yiri Ornstein. “Dadku waxaa laga yaabaa inay u cuntami weydo warkaan, balse waxaan gudbinayaa xogta aan helay: ujeedkoodu waa inay sii wataan Slot. Xataa haddii isbeddel la samaynayo, ma hayo wax xog ah oo tilmaamaya in Alonso uu safka hore kaga jiro dadka beddelaya.”
Slot ayaa la filayaa inuu hoggaamiyo dib-u-dhiska kooxda lagu sameynayo xagaaga, iyadoo xiddigo ay ka mid yihiin Mohamed Salah iyo Andy Robertson la filayo inay ka tagaan kooxda. Liverpool ayaa hadafkeedu yahay inay lasoo saxiixato ugu yaraan afar ciyaaryahan oo cusub, marka laga soo tago Jeremy Jacquet oo horay loola xiriiriyay.

headline: Declan Rice Oo U Hanjabay Manchester City Ka Hor Kulanka Axadda
body:
Xiddiga khadka dhexe ee kooxda Arsenal, Declan Rice, ayaa qirtay in xanuunka guuldarradii ka soo gaartay Manchester City ciyaartii kama dambaysta ahayd ee Carabao Cup uu weli gubayo, wuxuuna shaaciyay inuu u isticmaalayo dhiirigelin ahaan ka hor kulanka weyn ee Axadda ka dhacaya garoonka Etihad.
“Way xanuun badan tahay in lagaa badiyo kulan kasta oo final ah. Inaan arko iyagoo koobka kor u qaadaya, runtii aad bay ii dhibtay. Waxaa calooshayda ku jira dab igu dhiirigelinaya inaan xanuunkaas tirtiro dhammaadka toddobaadkan,” ayuu yiri Rice.
Arsenal ayaa hadda lix dhibcood ku hoggaaminaysa City xilli ay fadhiso booska koowaad ee kala horreynta horyaalka, inkastoo kooxda Pep Guardiola uu baaqi u yahay hal kulan.
Xiddigan u ciyaara xulka qaranka England ayaa sidoo kale maskaxda ku haya tartanka Champions League-ga, iyadoo Arsenal ay isku diyaarinayso inay wajahdo Atletico Madrid wareegga nus-dhammaadka.
Rice ayaa intaas ku daray: “Lix kulan ayaa nooga haray Premier League, waana ognahay muhiimadda ay leeyihiin. Dhanka Champions League, waxaan ognahay inaan wajaheyno Atletico Madrid, markaa waxay noqon doontaa safar cajiib ah haddii aan gaarno finalka. Waa inaan sii wadnaa dadaalka oo aan aaminnaa waxa aan gaari karno.”

headline: “Waa Ilmo Yar Oo Quuq Badan, Waxba Kuma Dhex-jiraan Yamal”
body:
Weeraryahankii hore ee kooxda Barcelona, Christophe Dugarry, ayaa weerar afka ah ku qaaday xiddiga da’da yar ee Lamine Yamal, ka dib markii kooxda reer Catalonia ay tartanka Champions League-ga kaga hartay gacanta Atletico Madrid wareeggii siddeed-dhammaadka.
Dugarry oo u dhashay dalka Faransiiska ayaa su’aal ka keenay saameynta guud iyo maskaxda wiilkan 18-jirka ah, isagoo ku tilmaamay mid hadal badan balse aanan si joogto ah u soo bandhigin qaab ciyaareed lagu kalsoonaan karo.
Isagoo la hadlayay idaacadda RMC, Dugarry ayaa yiri: “Haddii aad rabto inaad hadal badan sameyso, hubi inay kooxdaadu awood u leedahay guul. Adduunkee ayaad ku nooshahay, wiilyahow? Adduunka dhabta ah, waxba ma aadan qaban.”
In kasta oo uu qirtay goolkii hore ee uu Yamal dhaliyay, haddana wuxuu aaminsan yahay inaysan taasi ku filnayn: “Gool ayuu dhaliyay daqiiqaddii 4-aad. Ka dibna maxaa dhacay? Wuxuu caddeeyay inuusan u tartami karin abaalmarinta Ballon d’Or. Dembele ayaa hubaal ahaan dhalin lahaa dhowr gool oo kale. Lamine-ka yar wuxuu helay daqiiqad kooban oo ammaan ah, intaas uun bayna ku dhammaatay.”
Dugarry ayaa hadalkiisa kusoo xiray: “Marnaba igama dhaadhacsaneyn in Barca ay u qalantay inay ka gudubto Atletico, marka loo eego bandhigii Lamine Yamal. Wuxuu leeyahay isla weyni aad u sarreysa.”

headline: “Waa Dammiin, Isagaa La Degay Kooxda” :- Carragher Oo Si Aan Naxariis Lahayn Furka Ugu Tuuray Florian Wirtz
body:
Hammigii kooxda Liverpool ee tartanka Champions League-ga ayaa ku soo afjarmay garoonka Anfield, ka dib markii ay xaaqday kooxda difaacanaysa tartanka ee Paris Saint-Germain. Natiijadan ayaa ka dhigan in wadar ahaan labadi kulan looga adkaaday 0-4, taas oo Liverpool ka dhigtay koox xilli-ciyaareedkan ku dhamaysanaysa koob la’aan.
Eedaymaha ugu badan ee ciyaarta ka dib ayaa lagu riday xiddigii ay kooxdu xagaagii lasoo wareegtay ee Florian Wirtz, kaas oo ku dhibtoonayay inuu soo bandhigo qaab ciyaareed go’aan qaadasho leh tan iyo markii uu kaga soo biiray Bayer Leverkusen lacag lagu sheegay €150 milyan oo Yuuro.
Difaacii hore ee Liverpool, haddana ah falanqeeye dhanka isboortiga, Jamie Carragher, ayaa si gaar ah u dhaleeceeyay bandhigga 22-jirkan markii ay ciyaartu dhammaatay.
Carragher ayaa yiri: “Haddii aad eegto Liverpool lacagtey ku bixisay, dhab ahaantii waxba kama aysan helin. Isagu weli ma uusan muujin tayadii laga filayay. Waxaad ku sifeeyn kartaa ciyaaryahan nadiif ah oo nidaamsan, balse ugu dambayntii ma lahan awoodda go’aan qaadashada ah ee lagu dhalin karo goolal.”
Carragher ayaa sidoo kale tilmaamay in isbedbedelka qaab ciyaareedka Wirtz uu ka tarjumayo dhibaatooyinka guud ee Liverpool ka haysta xilliyada muhiimka ah, isagoo xusay in kooxda ay ka maqan tahay tayo hufan marka ay xaaladdu adag tahay.
Xiddigan khadka dhexe ee u dhashay dalka Jarmalka ayaa xilli-ciyaareedkan dhaliyay afar gool oo horyaalka Premier League ah iyo hal gool oo Champions League ah, waana tiro aad uga hooseysa wixii laga filayay marka loo eego lacagta qaaliga ah ee lagasoo bixiyay iyo mushaharkiisa sannadlaha ah oo lagu qiyaasay €20 milyan oo Yuuro.

headline: Kylian Mbappe Oo Farriin Dhiirigelin Leh Hawada U Mariyay Taageerayaasha Real Madrid Kadib Markii Laga Reebay Real Madrid Champions League-ga
body:
Kylian Mbappe ayaa adeegsaday barta Instagram-ka si uu farriin dhiirigelin leh ugu diro taageerayaasha Real Madrid ee daafaha dunida, ka dib markii kooxdiisa ay tartanka Champions League-ga ka reebtay Bayern Munich.
“Waxaan isku daynay ilaa daqiiqaddii ugu dambaysay, balse intaas naguma filnaan,” ayuu Mbappe ku yiri farriintiisa uu soo dhigay baraha bulshada.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray: “Waa wax laga xumaado in laga haro tartan muhiimad intaas leeg leh, balse waa inaan horey u soconnaa. Waxaa nalaga doonayaa inaan si dhab ah ugu kuur-galno waxyaabaha naga khaldan, si aan loogu soo laaban niyad-jabkan oo kale mar kale. Marnaba isma dhiibi doonno.”
Mbappe ayaa hadalkiisa kusoo gunaanaday: “Magaalada Madrid, fashilku marnaba ma noqon doono dookh furan. Balse hal go’aan ayaan idiin ballan-qaadayaa: waxaan dib u bilaabi doonnaa guulaha dhawaan, waana dhowdahay xilligaas.”

headline: Real Madrid Oo Saddex Tababare U Calaamadsatay Beddelka Alvaro Arbeloa
body:
Sida ay werisay ABC Deportes, maamulka sare ee Real Madrid ayaa xilli-ciyaareedka hadda socda u arka mid fashil weyn ah, maadaama ay aad ugu dhowdahay in kooxdu ay labo xilli-ciyaareed oo isku xiga weydo wax koob oo muhiim ah.
Inkastoo xaaladdu adag tahay, madaxweynaha kooxda Florentino Perez ayaa go’aansaday inuusan qaadan go’aanno degdeg ah, isagoo door biday in muddo la sugo si looga fikiro tallaabooyinka xiga.
Hadda waxa ay isha ku haysaa Real ciddii beddeli lahayd Alvaro Arbeloa, waxaana liiska musharaxiinta hoggaaminaya Mauricio Pochettino, Didier Deschamps iyo Jurgen Klopp.
Dhanka ciyaartoyda, ilaa siddeed xiddig ayaa la filayaa inay ka tagaan garoonka Santiago Bernabeu xagaagan. Dani Carvajal iyo David Alaba ayaa qarka u saaran inay ku baxaan si bilaash ah marka uu qandaraaskoodu dhammaado, halka Dani Ceballos laftiisa uusan ku jirin qorshaha kooxda.
Sidoo kale, Real Madrid ayaa diyaar u ah inay iibiso Eduardo Camavinga, Raul Asencio, Gonzalo Garcia iyo Fran Garcia, halka Franco Mastantuono la qorsheeyay in amaah lagu bixiyo.
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, kooxdu ma fasaxi doonto xiddigaha ugu waaweyn ee laf-dhabarta u ah sida Jude Bellingham, Vinicius Junior iyo Kylian Mbappe.
Madrid waxay qorsheynaysaa inay xoojiso dhowr boos oo muhiim ah oo dhanka daafaca iyo khadka dhexe ah, iyadoo isu diyaarinaysa dib-u-dhis weyn oo ay sameyso xagaaga soo socda.

headline: Chelsea Oo Go’aan Lama Filaan Ah Ka Soo Saartay Mustaqbalka Garnacho
body:
Sida ay werisay jariiradda The Sun, kooxda Chelsea ayaa diyaar u ah inay iska iibiso Alejandro Garnacho, iyadoo aysan xitaa hal sano ka soo wareegin markii ay kaga soo iibsadeen Manchester United lacag dhan £40 milyan oo gini.
Xiddigan 21-jirka ah ayaa saftay 38 kulan xilli-ciyaareedkiisii ugu horreeyay ee kooxda Blues, isagoo kusoo bilowday 21 ka mid ah, wuxuuna dhaliyay siddeed gool isagoo caawiyay afar kale. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, goolashaas uu dhaliyay mid qura ayaa ah horyaalka Premier League-ga.
Ciyaaryahanka u dhashay dalka Argentina ayaan si joogto ah u ciyaarin tan iyo markii uu xilka la wareegay tababare Liam Rosenior, kaas oo la rumeysan yahay inuu shaki ka qabo qaab ciyaareedka wiilkan yar.
Sidoo kale, hadallo uu Garnacho dhowaan fagaaraha ka sheegay ayaa soo jiitay indhaha dadka, ka dib markii uu muujiyay qoomamo ku aadan qaabkii ay ahayd bilihiisii ugu dambeeyay ee kooxda Manchester United.
Ma jiraan wax calaamado ah oo muujinaya in Manchester United ay diyaar u tahay inay dib u soo celiso, inkastoo Ruben Amorim uusan hadda joogin kooxda, isla markaana helitaanka garab bidix oo cusub ay tahay mid ka mid ah waxyaabaha ay mudnaanta siinayaan suuqa xagaaga.

headline: Saadaasha Khabiirka Skysports Ee Kulamada Premier League Ee Usbuucaan
body:
Xiddigii hore ee kooxda Arsenal, Paul Merson, ayaa bixiyay saadaashiisa ku aadan kulammada horyaalka Premier League-ga ee dhacaya dhammaadka toddobaadkan.
Kooxda Brentford ayaa garoonkeeda ku martigelin doonta Fulham duhurnimada Sabtida, halka Newcastle United ay foodda is dari doonaan Bournemouth. Habeenimada Sabtida, waxaa isha lagu hayn doonaa kulanka adag ee dhex mari doona Chelsea iyo Manchester United oo ka dhici doona garoonka Stamford Bridge.
Kulanka ugu weyn ayaa galabnimada Axadda ku dhex mari doona kooxaha Manchester City iyo Arsenal garoonka Etihad Stadium.
Merson ayaa rumeysan in Brentford ay 2-0 ku garaaci doonto Fulham. Sida ay werisay shabakadda Sportskeeda, saadaasha kale ee Paul Merson waa sidatan:

Nottingham Forest 2-0 Burnley
Aston Villa 2-0 Sunderland

headline: Raphinha: “Ballon d’Or-ka Sanadkii 2024/2025 Aniga Ayaa Xaq U Lahaa”
body:
Xiddiga kooxda Barcelona, Raphinha, ayaa si adag uga hadlay doodda ku saabsan abaalmarinta Ballon d’Or, isagoo ku adkeystay inay bandhigyadiisu u qalmeen in aqoonsi sare lagu siiyo.
Ka dib xilli-ciyaareedkii cajiibka ahaa ee 2024/2025, kaasoo uu ka qeyb qaatay 59 gool (isugeyn goolal iyo caawin), xiddiga reer Brazil ayaa ku dhameystay meel ka baxsan saddexda kaalin ee ugu sarreeya, natiijo oo uu si cad uga hor yimid.
“Aragtidayda, haddii lagu salayn lahaa xilli-ciyaareedka oo dhan, aniga ayaa u qalmi lahaa,” ayuu yiri Raphinha.
Raphinha ayaa xitaa soo bandhigay sida ay isaga la tahay kala horreynta ciyaartoyda ugu sarreysa, isagoo saaxiibkiis Lamine Yamal dhigay kaalinta labaad, halka Pedri uu u doortay kaalinta saddexaad. Wuxuu yiri: “Lamine ayaan dhigi lahaa [labaad], Pedri-na [saddexaad], iyadoo Dembele uu u qalmo kaalinta afaraad.”
Bandhigiisii xilli-ciyaareedkaas oo ka koobnaa 34 gool iyo 26 caawin oo uu ka sameeyay dhammaan tartammada, ayaa ka caawiyay Barcelona inay ku guuleysato horyaalka La Liga iyo koobka Copa Del Rey, sidoo kale waxay gaareen afar-dhammaadka tartanka Champions League.

headline: Shaxda Ugu Fiican Todobaadkan Champions League Oo La Soo Saaray
body:
Waxaa la shaaciyay shaxda ugu wanaagsan toddobaadka ee tartanka Champions League-ga, iyadoo xiddiga da’da yar ee Arda Guler uu noqday ciyaaryahanka qura ee matalaya kooxda Real Madrid.
Guler ayaa booskan ku helay bandhig cajiib ah oo uu sameeyay kulankii Bayern, isagoo noqday xiddig si weyn uga dhex muuqday safka Madrid inkastoo ay kooxdiisu wajahday habeen adag oo ay kaga hartay tartanka Yurub.
Afka hore ee weerarka ayaa waxaa ku midoobay xiddigaha Ousmane Dembele (PSG), Ferran Torres (Barcelona), iyo Michael Olise (Bayern Munich).
Khadka dhexe, Guler waxaa ku weheliya Martin Zubimendi (Arsenal), Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich), iyo Marcos Llorente (Atletico Madrid).
Daafaca ayaa waxaa ka muuqda Marquinhos (PSG), Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich), iyo Geny Catamo Quaresma (Sporting CP).
Goolka waxaa lagu aaminay Juan Musso (Atletico Madrid) oo dhamaystiray shaxdan gool-dhaliyeyaasha iyo xiddigaha ugu fiican ee wareegga sideed dhammaadka laga soo xushay.

headline: Lionel Messi Oo Iibsaday Koox Ka Dhisan Dalka Spain
body:
Kabtanka xulka Argentina iyo kooxda Inter Miami, Lionel Messi, ayaa si rasmi ah u dhamaystiray heshiis uu boqolkiiba boqol (100%) ku iibsaday kooxda UE Cornellà oo ka ciyaarta heerka afaraad ee dalka Spain (Tercera RFEF).
Xiddigan ku guuleystay siddeedda Ballon d’Or ayaa hadda noqday milkiilaha rasmiga ah ee kooxdan fadhigeedu yahay gobolka Catalonia, isagoo markale dib u soo nooleeyay xiriirkii adkaa ee uu la lahaa deegaankaas uu kusoo barbaaray.
Kooxda UE Cornellà ayaa hadda ku jirta kaalinta saddexaad ee Group-ka 5-aad ee haryaalaka Tercera RFEF, iyadoo shan dhibcood ka dambeysa kooxda hoggaanka u heysa ee Manresa. Maadaama ay kooxdu horey u xaqiijisatay booska loogu soo gudbo ciyaaraha kala baxa (play-offs), hadafka Messi ayaa ah inuu kooxda kor ugu soo qaado heerarka sare ee kubbadda cagta Spain isagoo maalgelin weyn ku sameynaya akadeemiyada kooxda.
Tallaabadan uu qaaday Messi ayaa ah mid lamid ah Cristiano Ronaldo. Ronaldo ayaa bishii Febraayo ee sanadkan iibsaday boqolkiiba 25% saamiga kooxda UD Almería oo ka ciyaarta heerka labaad ee Spain, taasoo muujinaysa loolanka cusub ee labadan halyey ee dhanka maalgashiga kubbadda cagta.

headline: Declan Rice Oo Ka Hadlay Awoodda Atletico Ee Ka Hor Kulamada 4 Dhammaadka Tartanka Champions League-ga
body:
Xiddiga khadka dhexe ee kooxda Arsenal, Declan Rice, ayaa ku adkeystay inay si fiican u garanayaan waxa ay kala kulmi doonaan kooxda Atletico Madrid, marka ay isaga hor yimaadaan wareegga nus-dhammaadka ee tartanka UEFA Champions League dabayaaqada bishan.
Rice ayaa hadalkan ka dhawaajiyay isagoo bixinayay wareysi ciyaarta ka dib, markii uu Arsenal ku hoggaamiyay barbaro 0-0 ah oo ay la galeen kooxda Sporting CP kulankii lugta labaad ee wareegga siddeed-dhammaadka oo habeenkii Arbacada ka dhacay garoonka Emirates.
Waxaa xusid mudan in Arsenal ay ugu soo gudubtay wareegga afar-dhammaadka cel-celis ahaan gool iyo waxba (1-0) oo ay kaga soo adkaadeen kooxda reer Portugal.
Isagoo la hadlayay taleefishinka TNT Sports oo ka warbixinayay kulanka soo socda ee Atletico, Rice ayaa yiri: “Aad baan ugu faraxsanahay. Waxay ahayd tijaabo aad u adag oo labo kulan ah. Inaan labo xilli-ciyaareed oo isku xiga gaarno afar-dhammaadka waa guul weyn oo u soo hoyatay kooxdan, haddana waxaan rabnaa inaan tallaabo kale horey u qaadno oo aan gaarno kama dambaysta.”
Wuxuu intaas ku daray: “Hal mar ayaan la ciyaarnay Atlético sanadkan, waxayna ahayd ciyaar aad u wanaagsan; waan ognahay waxaan ka filan karno. Ha noo yimaadaan toddobaadyada ugu dambeeya ee tartanka.”
Arsenal ayaa horay u soo garaacday Atletico Madrid bilowgii xilli-ciyaareedkan markii ay labada kooxood ku kulmeen isla tartanka Champions League-ga.

Arsenal ayaa horay u soo garaacday Atletico Madrid bilowgii xilli-ciyaareedkan markii ay labada kooxood ku kulmeen isla tartanka Champions League-ga.

headline: Bernardo Silva Oo Xaqiijiyay Inuu Ka Tagayo Manchester City
body:
Kabtanka kooxda Manchester City, Bernardo Silva, ayaa xaqiijiyay inuu ka tagi doono kooxda horyaalka Premier League-ga difaacanaysa ee Manchester City marka uu dhammaado xilli-ciyaareedkan.

31-jirkan ayaa sidoo kale liiska koobabkiisa ku darsaday labo koob oo FA Cup ah, shan koob oo Carabao Cup ah, saddex koob oo Community Shield ah, iyo min hal koob oo ah Koobka Naadiyada Adduunka iyo kan Super Cup-ka Yurub.
Bishii hore ayay ahayd markii Silva isagoo ah kabtanka kooxda uu Manchester City ku hoggaamiyay hanashada koobka Carabao Cup ee 2026-ka, ka dib markii ay ka adkaadeen kooxda Arsenal.

headline: 10-ka Xiddig Ee Ugu Cad-cad Abaalmarinta Ballon d’Or 2026
body:
Weeraryahanka kooxda Bayern Munich, Harry Kane, ayaa hadda loo arkaa ninka ugu cad-cad ee ku guuleysan kara abaalmarinta Ballon d’Or ee sanadka 2026-ka.
Kane ayaa qaab ciyaareed cajiib ah soo bandhigay xilli ciyaareedkaan iyadoo  Kabtanka xulka qaranka England uu shabaqa soo taabtay kulankii Bayern ay 4-3 (wadar ahaan 6-4) ku dubatay Real Madrid, si ay u xaqiijisato booskeeda afar-dhammaadka Champions League.
Wiilasha uu hoggaamiyo tababare Vincent Kompany ayaa sidoo kale cagta saaray wadadii ay ku difaacan lahaayeen horyaalka Bundesliga. Marka loo eego bandhigyadii u dambeeyay iyo saadaasha suuqa, Kane ayaa ka horreeya xiddigo magac leh iyo kuwo hadda soo baxaya oo ka ciyaara qaaradda Yurub.
Halkan kaga bogo 10-ka ciyaaryahan ee ugu dhow ku guuleysiga abaalmarintaas:

headline: “Maxaad Dooneysaa, Afkaaga Iga Qabso” :- Vinicius Jr Oo Furka Ku Tuuray Bellingham Kulankii Bayern Munchen
body:
Xiisad ayaa dhex martay labada xiddig ee kooxda Real Madrid, Vinicius Jr iyo Jude Bellingham, xilli kooxdooda laga reebay tartanka Champions League-ga habeenkii Arbacada markii ay iska hor yimaadeen Bayern Munich.
Dhacdadan ayaa timid waxyar ka hor inta aan kaarka cas ee digniinta labaad ah la siin Eduardo Camavinga.
Daqiiqadii 83-aad ee ciyaarta, Vinicius ayaa kubadda soo jiitay isagoo si toos ah u abbaaray goolka, xilli Bellingham uu gudaha ugu jiray diilinta ganaaxa isagoo weydiisanaya Vini inuu u dhiibo kubadda. balse, Vinicius ayaa ku fashilmay isku daygiisa, iyadoo uu si degdeg ah uga dafay Dayot Upamecano, taasoo keentay inuu bixin waayo baaskii laga sugayay. Arrimahan ayaa ka careysiiyay Bellingham oo muujiyay sida uu uga xun yahay go’aanka saaxiibkiis.
Kaamirooyinka ayaa qabtay Vinicius Jr oo si caro leh ugu jawaabaya Bellingham, isagoo ku yiri: “Maxaad rabtaa? Maxaad rabtaa? Iga aamus.”
Real Madrid ayaa waqtigaas hoggaanka ku heysay 3-2, iyadoo cel-celis ahaan labada kulan ay markaas maraysay 4-4, ka hor inta aan Camavinga garoonka laga saarin markii uu dib u dhigay laad xor ah.
Kooxda reer Spain ayaa durbadiiba laga soo xiray fursaddaas, waxaana goolal ka dhaliyay Luis Diaz iyo Michael Olise, kuwaas oo Bayern Munich u xaqiijiyay inay u gudubto wareegga afar-dhammaadka halkaas oo ay isku heli doonaan Paris Saint-Germain.

headline: Xiddigaha Ugu Gool-caawinta Badan Tartanka Champions League Sanad Kaan
body:
Xiddigaha Michael Olise oo ka tirsan Bayern Munich iyo Vinicius Junior oo u ciyaara Real Madrid ayaa hoggaaminaya liiska ciyaartoyda caawinta ugu badan ka sameeyay tartanka Champions League-ga ilaa hadda xilli-ciyaareedkan.
Olise iyo Vinicius ayaa mid kastaaba leh 8 caawin, waxaana ay safka hore kaga jiraan xiddigaha fursadaha ugu badan abuuray ka hor inta aan la gudbin wareegga afar-dhammaadka.
Arrintan ayaa dhalatay ka dib markii Arbacadii la soo gabagabeeyay kulammadii lugta labaad ee wareegga siddeed-dhammaadka. Waxaa xusid mudan in Bayern Munich ay tartanka ka reebtay Real Madrid si ay ugu soo baxdo nus-dhammaadka, halka Arsenal ay iyaduna meesha ka saartay kooxda Sporting CP.
Halkan kaga bogo ciyaartoyda ugu caawinta badan Champions League-ga 2025/26 ilaa hadda:
8 caawin – Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) iyo Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid)
5 caawin – Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille), Antoine Griezmann (Atletico Madrid), Achraf Hakimi (PSG) iyo Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG).

headline: Real Madrid Oo Go’aan Culus Ka Soo Saartay Mustaqbalka Alvaro Arbeloa, Kadib Ka Haristii Champions League
body:
Waxaa la filayaa in kooxda Real Madrid ay iska fasaxdo tababare Alvaro Arbeloa ka dib markii ay ka hartay tartanka Champions League-ga, iyadoo wararku sheegayaan in bixitaankiisu uu hadda yahay mid “hubaal ah”.
Guuldarradii bartamihii toddobaadkan ayaa xaqiijisay in kooxda reer Spain ay xilli-ciyaareedkan ku dhamaysan doonto koob la’aan, maadaama sagaal dhibcood looga hayo hoggaanka horyaalka La Liga oo ay hayso Barcelona. Natiijadan ayaa culeys weyn ku keentay madaxda sare ee kooxda, kuwaas oo hadda bilaabay inay go’aanno adag gaaraan ka hor suuqa xagaaga.
Inkastoo Arbeloa uu sheegay inaysan waxba jirin marka la weydiiyay mustaqbalkiisa ciyaartii Bayern ka dib, haddana xogta laga helayo gudaha kooxda ayaa tilmaamaysa in sii joogistiisa ay ku xirnayn horumar laga sameeyo fagaarayaasha Yurub. Maadaama hadafkii laga lahaa tartankaas uu meesha ka baxay, kooxdu uma aragto mid macquul ah in qandaraaska loo kordhiyo.
Dhibaatada Real Madrid ee xilli-ciyaareedkan ayaa ku baahday dhammaan tartamada, iyadoo ka haridda Champions League iyo Copa del Rey ay sii xumeeyeen xaaladda liidata ee ay ka taagan yihiin horyaalka.
Maamulka kooxda ayaa hadda bilaabay qorshaha lagu magacaabayo tababare cusub, waxaana liiska musharaxiinta ku jira magacyo ay ka mid yihiin Jurgen Klopp, Zinedine Zidane, Didier Deschamps, iyo Mauricio Pochettino. Klopp ayaana weli loo arkaa dookha koowaad ee ay kooxdu doonayso inay ku aaminto mashruuceeda mustaqbalka fog.

headline: Nemanja Vidic Oo Magacaabay Tababaraha Ku Habboon Xilka Joogtada Ah Ee Man United.
body:
Nemanja Vidic ayaa taageero buuxda u muujiyay Michael Carrick si loogu magacaabo tababaraha rasmiga ah ee kooxda Manchester United.
Halyeygan oo ay sideed sano Carrick ka wada ciyaarayeen kooxda ayaa ku yiri website-ka rasmiga ah ee kooxda: “Carrick waa shakhsi weyn, lehna dabeecad adag balse la fahmi karo. Waa nin aqoon badan, degan, mar walbana aad isku halleyn karto.”
Vidic ayaa intaas ku daray: “Kani waa tababaraha aad rabto in kooxdaadu hoggaamiyo, waayo waa wejiga kooxda. Waxaan aaminsanahay inuu kooxda isugu habeyn karo habka ugu wanaagsan, waxaana taa u dheer inuu keenay natiijooyin.”
Carrick ayaa soo bandhigay qaab ciyaareed cajiib ah tan iyo markii uu ula wareegay xilka si kumeel gaar ah, isagoo guuleystay todobo ka mid ah 11-kii kulan ee uu hoggaamiyay kooxda, halka labo jeer uu barbaro galay, labo kalena laga badiyay.
United ayaa hadda ku jirta kaalinta saddexaad ee kala sarreynta horyaalka Premier League, waxayna heysaa wadada ay kaga qeyb galeyso tartanka Champions League xilli-ciyaareedka dambe.

headline: Mikel Arteta: “Waxaan Sameynay Wax Aan Taariikhda Arsenal Horay Uga Dhicin”
body:
Tababaraha kooxda Arsenal, Mikel Arteta, ayaa sheegay in kooxdiisu ay gaartay wax aan horay loo sameyn taariikhda naadiga.
Arteta ayaa hadalkan ka dhawaajiyay ka dib markii uu Arsenal u horseeday inay u soo gudubto wareegga nus-dhammaadka ee tartanka Champions League habeenkii Arbacada. Macallinka reer Spain ayaa daawanayay wiilashiisa Gunners oo barbaro 0-0 ah la galaya kooxda Sporting CP kulankii lugta labaad ee wareegga siddeed-dhammaadka ee ka dhacay garoonka Emirates Stadium.
Kooxda hoggaaminaysa horyaalka Premier League-ga ayaa wareegga afar-dhammaadka ku soo baxday cel-celis ahaan gool iyo waxba (1-0), iyadoo hadda isu diyaarinaysa inay dabayaaqada bishan wajahdo kooxda Atletico Madrid.
Isagoo la hadlayay warbaahinta ciyaarta ka dib, Arteta ayaa yiri: “Farriinteydu waxay ahayd mid aan ugu mahadcelinayo ciyaartoyda. Waxaan ogahay dadaalka iyo dardarta ay muujiyeen. Shaqo badan ayaa arrintan ka dambaysay, waxaana samaynay wax aan marnaba horay loogu arkin taariikhda kooxdeena. Waxaan ku qasbanayn inaan hab gaar ah u wajahno, annagoo weynay ciyaartoy badan oo muhiim ah, marka arrintaas ammaan weyn ayay mudan tahay.”

headline: Harry Kane Oo Sameeyay Taariikh Cusub Kulankii Real Madrid
body:
Weeraryahanka kooxda Bayern Munich, Harry Kane, ayaa habeenkii Arbacada dhigay taariikh cusub ka dib markii kooxdiisu ay tartanka UEFA Champions League ka reebtay Real Madrid.
Kabtanka xulka qaranka England ayaa shabaqa soo taabtay, isagoo sidoo kale caawiyay gool kale, xilli Bayern ay 4-3 ku dubatay naadiga Los Blancos kulankii lugta labaad ee wareegga siddeed-dhammaadka ee ka dhacay garoonka Allianz Arena.
Guushan ayaa ka dhigan in kooxda awoodda badan ee Bundesliga ay u gudubtay wareegga nus-dhammaadka ee Champions League, halkaas oo ay isku haleeli doonaan Paris Saint-Germain.
Sida ay sheegtay shabakadda uruurisa xogaha ciyaaraha ee OptaJoe, Kane ayaa hadda dhaliyay ugu yaraan saddex gool ama caawiyay labo gool mid kasta oo ka mid ah shan-tii kulan ee ugu dambeeyay ee uu ka hor yimid Real Madrid tartanka Champions League. Arrinkan ayaa noqonaya rikoorkii ugu dheeraa ee ciyaaryahan uu ka diiwaan geliyo kooxda reer Spain taariikhda tartankan.
Dhanka kale, kabtankii hore ee Tottenham Hotspur ayaa hadda saddex gool ka dambeeya xiddiga Real Madrid, Kylian Mbappe, oo hoggaaminaya gool-dhalinta tartanka Champions League ee xilli-ciyaareedkan.

headline: Jamie Carragher Oo Sharaxay Sababta Aysan Arsenal Ugu Guuleysan Karin Champions League Sanad Kaan
body:
Halyeyga kooxda Liverpool, Jamie Carragher, ayaa ka laabtay saadaashii uu horay uga bixiyay kooxda ku guuleysan doonta tartanka Champions League-ga xilli-ciyaareedkan.
Carragher ayaa markii hore rumeysnaa in Arsenal ay tartanka ilaa heerka ugu dambeeya gaari doonto, calankana ay hanan doonto. Inkastoo ay kooxda Gunners soo reebtay Sporting Lisbon si ay u xaqiijiso booskeeda afar-dhammaadka, haddana Carragher ma aaminsana in ay tartankaas ku guuleysan karaan.
Arsenal ayaa foodda dari doonta kooxda Atletico Madrid si ay boos uga hesho ciyaarta kama dambaysta ah, halka dhanka kale ay loollami doonaan kooxaha Paris Saint-Germain iyo Bayern Munich.
Carragher oo falanqeynayay tayada Arsenal isagoo la hadlayay CBS Sports ayaa yiri: “Ma hubno inay leeyihiin tayo ku filan oo dhanka weerarka ah. Markaad fiiriso kulankii aan daawanay iyo ciyaartoyda labada kooxood ee garoonka ku jiray, Arsenal ma lahan ciyaartoy heerkoodu gaarsiisan yahay inay ku guuleystaan tartankan”
Waxa uu hadalkiisa sii raaciyay: “Tani ma ahan dhaleeceyn, balse dhabta ayaa ah inaysan haysan ciyaartoy heer sare ah oo weerarka ka ciyaara, ilaa haddana ma aysan helin.”

headline: Tartanka Gooldhalinta Champions League Ka Hor Kulamada 4 Dhammaadka Oo Meel Xiiso Leh Maraya
body:
Weeraryahanka koixda Real madrid, Kylian Mbappe ayaa xilligan hoggaaminaya gool-dhalinta tartanka UEFA Champions League, ka hor kulammada afar-dhammaadka ee dhici doona dabayaaqada bishan.
Kabtanka xulka Faransiiska ayaa urursaday 15 gool, ka dib markii uu gool dhaliyay kulankii Real Madrid looga adkaaday lugta labaad ee wareeggii siddeed-dhammaadka ee ay la ciyaareen Bayern Munich maalintii Arbacada.
Mbappe ayaa saddex gool ka sarreeya weeraryahanka kooxda Bayern Munich, Harry Kane, oo ku jira kaalinta labaad ee liiska gool-dhalinta.
Kane ayaa haysta fursad uu ku soo qaban karo Mbappe marka ay kooxdiisa Bayern foodda is darayaan Paris Saint-Germain wareegga nus-dhammaadka ee dhammaadka bishan.
Xaaladda kala horreynta gool-dhalinta Champions League ee xilli-ciyaareedka 2025/26 ka hor kulammada afar-dhammaadka waa sidatan:

10 gool – Anthony Gordon (Newcastle)

headline: Joe Cole Oo Saadaal Cajiib Ah Ka Bixiyay Kulanka Arsenal Iyo Atletico Ee 4 Dhammaadka Tartanka Champions League
body:
Joe Cole ayaa saadaaliyay in Arsenal ay fursad weyn u leedahay inay ka gudubto Atletico Madrid kulanka semi-finalka UEFA Champions League.
Inkasta oo Arsenal uu hoos u dhac ku yimid dhowrkii kulan ee ugu dambeeyay, Cole wuxuu aaminsan yahay in taageerayaashu ay aad ugu kalsoon yihiin awoodda kooxda.
Wuxuu tilmaamay in Arsenal ay leedahay tayo badan oo ka wanaagsan Atletico, halka faa’iidada ugu weyn ee kooxda Diego Simeone ay tahay khibradda.
Cole wuxuu sidoo kale ka digay qaab ciyaareedka Atletico:
Wuxuu sheegay in kulanku noqon doono mid adag oo “qasan,” isla markaana Arsenal aysan u ciyaari karin si jilicsan.
Haddii Arsenal ay si adag u wajahdo ciyaarta oo aysan ka baqan xeeladaha adag ee Atletico, waxay leedahay fursad dhab ah oo ay ku gaarto finalka, xitaa Cole wuxuu rumeysan yahay inay hanan karto laba koob xilli ciyaareedkan.

headline: Thierry Henry Oo Digniin Culus U Diray Arsenal Ka Hor Kulanka City
body:
Thierry Henry ayaa si cad ugu digay Arsenal iyo Mikel Arteta ka hor kulanka weyn ee ay la leeyihiin Manchester City.
Henry wuxuu sheegay in qaab ciyaareedkii ay Arsenal ku soo bandhigtay kulankii Sporting CP (0-0) uusan ku filneyn kulanka City, isagoo si adag u yiri:
“Ha u ciyaarina sidaas!”
Wuxuu sidoo kale xusay in bandhigyada kale ee liitay ee ay sameeyeen xilli ciyaareedkan ay muujinayaan in kooxdu aysan wali gaarin heerkii ugu sarreeyay ee looga baahnaa kulamada waaweyn.
Henry ayaa ku booriyay Arsenal inay muujiyaan xamaasad, geesinimo iyo rabitaan cad oo guul ah.
Kulanka Etihad waa fursad dahabi ah oo Arsenal ku caddeyn karto inay dhab ahaantii diyaar u tahay hanashada horyaalka, laakiin waa inay muujiyaan “dardarta” uu Henry ka hadlay.

headline: Joshua Kimmich Oo Shaaciyay Kooxaha Uu Aaminsan Yahay Inay Yihiin Kuwa Ugu Fiican Europe Sanad Kaan
body:
Joshua Kimmich ayaa sheegay in kooxaha ugu fiican Yurub ay hadda isugu soo hareen semi-finalka UEFA Champions League.
Kimmich wuxuu hadalkan yiri kadib markii Bayern Munich ay si cajiib ah uga adkaadeen Real Madrid oo ay u gudbeen wareegga afar dhammaadka.
Bayern ayaa hadda wajihi doonta Paris Saint-Germain, halka dhinaca kale ay Arsenal la ciyaari doonto Atletico Madrid.
Inkastoo uu qiray in ciyaartoodii Madrid ay ahayd mid liidata, haddana Kimmich wuxuu ku faraxsanaa natiijada, wuxuuna aaminsan yahay in hadda la joogo heerkii ay isku arki lahaayeen kooxaha ugu xooggan Yurub.
Kimmich wuxuu u arkaa semi-finalka Champions League mid ay ku tartamayaan kooxaha ugu tayada sareeya, taasoo ka dhigaysa kulamada soo socda kuwo aad u xiiso badan.

headline: Mbappé Oo Sameeyay Taariikh Kulankii Bayern
body:
Kylian Mbappe ayaa markale sameeyay taariikh cusub oo Champions League ah.
Xiddiga Real Madrid ayaa noqday ciyaaryahankii ugu horreeyay abid ee dhaliya 10 gool oo bannaanka ah hal xilli ciyaareed Champions League gudihii.
Goolkiisii kulankii Bayern Munich ayaa xaqiijiyay rikoodhkan, isagoo sii waday qaab ciyaareedka cajiibka ah marka uu ka ciyaarayo meel ka baxsan guriga Real.
Tiradiisa goolasha uu ku dhaliyay bannaanka waxaa ka mid ah:
4 gool vs Olympiacos
3 gool vs Kairat
2 gool vs Benfica
1 gool vs Bayern
Sidoo kale, Mbappé wuxuu gaaray 70 gool guud ahaan Champions League, taasoo sii xoojineysa inuu ka mid noqdo halyeeyada ugu waaweyn tartankan.
Mbappé wuxuu sii wadaa inuu jebiyo rikoorro waaweyn, isagoo si degdeg ah ugu sii dhowaanaya heerka ciyaartoyda ugu taariikhda weyn Yurub.

headline: Real Madrid Oo Macsalaameysay Champions League Kadib Guuldarro Xilli Dambe Ah Oo Ay Kala Kulantay Bayern
body:
Real Madrid ayaa si lama filaan ah uga hartay UEFA Champions League kadib guuldarro 4-3 ah oo ay kala kulmeen Bayern Munich, iyadoo Bayern ku gudubtay 6-4 oo wadar guud.
Kulanka ayaa ku bilowday si waali ah, iyadoo Arda Guler uu gool ku dhaliyay ilbiriqsiyo gudahood kadib qalad uu sameeyay Manuel Neuer. Bayern si degdeg ah ayay uga jawaabeen, Alexander Pavlovic ayaana barbareeyay, balse Güler ayaa markale hoggaanka siiyay Madrid isagoo dhaliyay laad xor ah oo qurux badan.
Harry Kane ayaa keenay barbaro kale, ka hor inta uusan Kylian Mbappe dib ugu celin hoggaanka Madrid ka hor nasashada.
Qodobka ugu weyn ee ciyaarta beddelay ayaa yimid daqiiqaddii 86-aad markii Eduardo Camavinga la siiyay kaar cas. Bayern ayaa ka faa’iidaysatay:
•Luis Diaz ayaa barbareeyay Real daqiiqaddii 88-aad
•Michael Olise ayaa dhaliyay goolka guusha waqtigii dheeriga ahaa
Real Madrid waxay gacanta ku haysay ciyaarta, laakiin casaanka iyo burburka daqiiqadihii ugu dambeeyay ayaa sabab u noqday in Bayern Munich si mucjiso ah ugu gudubto semi-finalka.

headline: Liverpool Oo Go’aan Ka Soo Saartay Mustaqbalka Slot Kadib Kulankii PSG
body:
Liverpool ayaa qorsheynaya inay sii wadaan la shaqeynta tababare Arne Slot inkastoo kooxda laga reebay UEFA Champions League.
Sida uu sheegay David Ornstein, maamulka kooxda (FSG) waxay wali kalsooni ku qabaan Slot, xitaa haddii Liverpool aysan u soo bixin Champions League xilli ciyaareedka dambe.
Kooxda ayaa hadda ku jirta kaalinta 5-aad ee Premier League, iyagoo wali dagaal ugu jira inay galaan afarta sare, balse guuldarradii PSG ayaa ka dhigtay xilli ciyaareedkooda mid koob la’aan ku dhammaaday.
Qorshaha Liverpool
•In Slot la siiyo waqti uu ku dhiso mashruuciisa
•In la sameeyo saxiixyo cusub xagaaga
•In la xoojiyo ilaa 4–5 boos oo muhiim ah oo ka tirsan safka hore
Liverpool ma qorsheyneyso inay bedesho tababareheeda hadda, balse waxay diiradda saarayaan dib u dhis iyo horumar mustaqbalka dhow.

headline: Bellingham: ‘Way Adagtahay In Lala Ciyaaro Mbappé Iyo Vinicius!’
body:
Jude Bellingham ayaa qirtay in mararka qaar ay adkaan karto in lala ciyaaro Kylian Mbappe iyo Vinicius Junior marka la joogo Real Madrid.
Bellingham wuxuu sharaxay in dhibaatadu ka timaaddo in labadan xiddig ay jecel yihiin inay ka ciyaaraan isla dhinaca bidix, taasoo mararka qaar keenta in ciyaartu isku dhex yaacdo.
Si kastaba, wuxuu caddeeyay in kooxda ay wali heli karto isku dheelitirnaan, gaar ahaan marka la hagaajiyo boosaska, iyadoo isaga mararka qaar loo wareejiyo dhinaca kale si uu u fududeeyo dhaqdhaqaaqa.
Inkasta oo ay jiraan caqabado dhinaca isku dhafnaanta ah, Bellingham wuxuu aaminsan yahay in tayada Mbappé iyo Vinicius ay ka dhigan tahay inay wax walba hagaagsan yihiin. Real Madrid ay noqon karto mid aad u khatar badan, gaar ahaan kulanka muhiimka ah ee ay la leeyihiin Bayern Munich ee UEFA Champions League.

headline: Carragher Oo Weerar Afka Ah Ku Beegsaday Arne Slot Kadib Ka Haristii Liverpool Ee Champions League-ga
body:
Jamie Carragher ayaa si weyn ula yaabay go’aankii Arne Slot ee ahaa in uusan kusoo bilaabin Mohamed Salah kulankii ay Liverpool kaga hareen tartanka UEFA Champions League.
Carragher wuxuu sheegay in go’aankaas uusan macno sameynayn, isagoo tilmaamay in Salah uu weli yahay mid ka mid ah gooldhaliyeyaasha ugu muhiimsan Liverpool, isla markaana uu si fiican u yaqaan nidaamka kooxda.
Wuxuu sidoo kale dhaliilay in kulanka lagu soo bilaabay Alexander Isak oo aan wali si buuxda taam u noqon, isla markaana aan la qabsan kooxda.
Carragher wuxuu soo jeediyay su’aalo ku saabsan sababta ka dambeysa go’aanka, isagoo xitaa ka fikiray in laga yaabo in arrintu la xiriirto mustaqbalka Salah, laakiin ugu dambeyn wuxuu ku adkeystay in kulamada noocan ah ay tahay in lagu saleeyo “hadda iyo guusha,” halkii laga eegi lahaa qorshe mustaqbal.
Carragher wuxuu u arkaa go’aanka Slot mid khaldan oo saameyn ku yeeshay fursadaha Liverpool ee ay ugu sii jiri lahayd tartanka.

headline: Muxuu Yamal Ka Yiri Ka Haristii Barcelona Ee Tartanka Champions League-ga?
body:
Lamine Yamal ayaa muujiyay kalsooni weyn inkastoo Barcelona laga reebay UEFA Champions League kadib guuldarro ay kala kulmeen Atletico Madrid.
Xiddiga da’da yar ayaa sheegay in kooxda aysan quusan doonin, isla markaana ay mar kale u dagaalami doonaan koobka Champions League mustaqbalka dhow.
Yamal wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay in inkastoo ay bixiyeen wax walba kulankii ay la ciyaareen Atletico, haddana aysan ku filnayn inay u gudbaan wareega xiga, laakiin khaladaadkaas ay cashar ka baran doonaan.
Fariintiisa ugu weyn:
Barcelona wali waxay aaminsan tahay inay dib ugu soo laaban doonto heerka ugu sarreeya, isla markaana ay mar uun keeni doonto koobka Champions League garoonkeeda.
Hadalka Yamal wuxuu muujinayaa maskax adag iyo kalsooni sare oo laga filayo ciyaaryahan da’diisu yar tahay, taasoo taageerayaasha Barca siin karta rajo mustaqbalka.

headline: FA-ga Oo Ganaax Dheeri Ah Ku Soo Rogay Harry Maguire
body:
Harry Maguire ayaa wajahaya ganaax dheeri ah, taasoo sii xumeyneysa xaaladda difaaca ee Manchester United ka hor kulankooda Chelsea.
FA-ga ayaa qorsheynaya inay ku kordhiso hal kulan ganaaxii Maguire, kadib fal uu kula kacay garsooraha afaraad. Taas waxay ka dhigan tahay inuu seegi doono kulanka muhiimka ah ee Chelsea.
Arrintu way sii adkaaneysaa sababtoo ah Lisandro Martinez ayaa sidoo kale ganaax ku maqan, isagoo seegi doona saddex kulan kadib casaankii uu qaatay kulankii Leeds.
Xaaladdan waxay ku qasbeysaa tababare Michael Carrick inuu ku tiirsanaado da’yarta sida Leny Yoro iyo Ayden Heaven si ay u buuxiyaan boosaska difaaca dhexe.
Man United waxay wajahaysaa dhibaato weyn oo dhanka difaaca ah xilli ay wajahayaan kulan adag oo Premier League ah.

headline: Arne Slot Oo Magacaabay Kooxda Ugu Cad-cad Ku Guuleysiga Champions League Sanad Kaan
body:
Arne Slot ayaa qiray awoodda Paris Saint-Germain kadib markii ay ka reebeen Liverpool tartanka UEFA Champions League.
Slot wuxuu sheegay in PSG ay heystaan fursad weyn oo ay markale ugu guuleysan karaan Champions League, isagoo si gaar ah u amaanay tayada iyo waxtarka ay ku dhammeeystiraan fursadaha.
Wuxuu tilmaamay in Liverpool ay abuureen fursado badan, balse PSG ay muujiyeen difaac adag iyo dhammeystir heer sare ah, gaar ahaan Ousmane Dembele oo dhaliyay labada gool.
Slot ayaa sidoo kale xusay in Dembele uu muujiyay sababta uu ugu guuleystay Ballon d’Or, isla markaana PSG ay u yihiin koox si dhab ah ugu tartami karta hanashada koob mar kale.
Guuldarradan waxay ka dhigan tahay in Liverpool ay xilli ciyaareedkan ku dhamaysan doonto bilaa koob, kadib markii ay ka hareen dhammaan tartamadii waaweynaa.

headline: Alan Shearer Oo Farta Ku Fiiqay Xiddiga Iska Leh Mas’uuliyadda Guuldarradii Liverpool Ay Kala Kulantay PSG
body:
Alan Shearer ayaa dhaliilay bandhigii Alexander Isak ee kulankii UEFA Champions League ay Liverpool la ciyaartay Paris Saint-Germain.
Shearer wuxuu sheegay in Isak uu ahaa mid si aad ah uga maqnaa ciyaarta qeybtii hore, isagoo helay kaliya dhowr taabasho oo aan saameyn muuqata yeelan. Wuxuu sidoo kale xusay in uu u muuqday mid si buuxda aan taam u ahayn.
Xaaladdaas waxay la xiriirtay dhaawacii cuslaa ee Isak uu ku maqnaa muddo ka badan saddex bilood, taasoo ka dhigtay inuu kulankan noqdo kulankiisii ugu horreeyay ee uu ku soo billowdo tan iyo bishii December.
Inkasta oo la filayay inuu ciyaaro kaliya 45 daqiiqo, haddana Liverpool waxay u baahan doontaa inuu qaato door weyn kulamada soo socda, gaar ahaan kadib dhaawaca culus ee Hugo Ekitike oo xilli ciyaareedka inta ka harsan maqnaan doona.

Hadalka Mikel wuxuu muujinayaa in Chelsea wali u baahan tahay weeraryahan leh dhaqdhaqaaqiisa iyo saameyntiisa, inkastoo hore loo dhaliili jiray.

headline: Thierry Henry Oo Amaan Ugu Qubeeyay Lamine Yamal Kadib Kulankii Atletico
body:
Thierry Henry ayaa si weyn u amaanay Lamine Yamal kadib bandhig kale oo cajiib ah oo uu sameeyay kulankii Barcelona iyo Atletico.
Henry wuxuu sheegay in Yamal uu yahay “mid gaar ah oo xiiso leh in la daawado,” isagoo carrabka ku adkeeyay in kalsoonidiisa garoonka ay ka sarreyso da’diisa.
Wuxuu sidoo kale barbar dhigay qaabkiisa ciyaareed waagii Ronaldo da’yarta ahaa, isagoo tilmaamay in labaduba ay leeyihiin geesinimo iyo kalsooni ay ciyaarta ku wajahaan.
Henry wuxuu xusay in Yamal:
-uu si geesinimo leh kubadda u dalbado
-uu abuuro fursado muhiim ah
-u ciyaaro si bisayl leh inkastoo uu da’yar yahay
Ugu dambeyn, Henry wuxuu sheegay in haddii uu sii wado horumarka iyo dadaalka, uu noqon karo mid ka mid ah ciyaartoyda ugu fiican adduunka mustaqbalka.

headline: Isku Aadka La Saadaalinayo Ee Afar Dhammaadka Champions League Kadib Kulamada Caawa
body:
Waxaa harsan laba boos oo keliya oo dhammeystiraya isku aadka semi-final-ka UEFA Champions League ee xilli ciyaareedkan, waxayna u muuqataa in sawirku si tartiib ah u caddaanayo.
Habeenkii Talaadada, Paris Saint-Germain iyo Atlético Madrid ayaa horey u xaqiijiyay u soo bixitaankooda wareegga afar dhammaadka.
Caawa, Arsenal ayaa gurigooda ku qaabilaya Sporting CP, iyadoo Arsenal ay 1-0 ku soo badisay lugtii hore. Kooxda Mikel Arteta ayaa si weyn loo saadaalinayaa inay shaqada dhammeystiri doonto; haddii ay sidaas dhacdo, waxay la ciyaari doonaan Atlético semi-final-ka.
Dhanka kale, Bayern Munich ayaa heysata fursad fiican oo ay ku gudbaan kadib guushii 2-1 ay ka gaareen Real Madrid lugtii hore. Kooxda Vincent Kompany haddii ay gurigooda ku rajo tiraan Real, waxay wajihi doonaan PSG, kulan noqon kara mid aad u xiiso badan.
Haddii wax walba sida la filayo u dhacaan, semi-final-ka waxaa isku aadaya:
Atlético Madrid vs Arsenal
PSG vs Bayern Munich
Tartanku hadda wuxuu marayaa heerkii ugu kululaa.

headline: Arne Slot Oo Sharaxay Sababtii Ka Dambeysay Beddelkii Deg-dega Ee Joe Gomez Kulankii PSG
body:
Arne Slot ayaa sharaxaad ka bixiyay sababta Joe Gomez laba jeer looga saaray ciyaartii UEFA Champions League ee ay la ciyaareen Paris Saint-Germain.
Slot wuxuu sheegay in Gomez uu ahaa mid aan dhaawac dhab qabin markii hore, balse ciyaaryahanku uu isagu codsaday in la beddelo kadib markii uu dareemay inuusan si buuxda u ciyaari karin.
“Ma ahayn dhaawac. Laakiin wuxuu ii sheegay inuusan hubin inuu sii ordi karo, sidaas darteed wuxuu ii sheegay inay fiican tahay inuu baxo si aan khatar loo gelin,” ayuu yiri Slot.
Tababaraha Liverpool ayaa sidoo kale sharaxay in uu hore u dhammaystiray beddeladiisa, taasoo ka dhigtay in uu sameeyo isbeddel degdeg ah si uusan ciyaaryahanka u gelin halis dhaawac.
Ugu dambeyn, Slot wuxuu ku tilmaamay go’aanka mid taxaddar ah oo looga fogaaday in xaaladdu sii xumaato.

headline: Casemiro Oo Heshiis Hordhac Ah La Gaaray Koox Weyn
body:
Casemiro ayaa lagu soo waramayaa inuu heshiis la gaaray Inter Miami, isagoo qorsheynaya inuu ku biiro kadib koobka adduunka ee 2026.
Xiddiga Manchester United ayaa hore u sheegay inuusan cusbooneysiin doonin heshiiskiisa, taasoo ka dhigaysa xilli ciyaareedkan kii ugu dambeeyay ee uu Old Trafford ku qaato.
Wararka ayaa sheegaya in heshiiska cusub uu noqon doono mid aad u weyn, iyadoo dakhliga guud uu ka badan doono laba jibaar mushaharkiisa hadda. Waxaa sidoo kale ku jiri doona gunnooyin iyo dakhli ka yimaada xayeysiin iyo arrimaha la xiriira sumcaddiisa.
Heshiiskan ayaa la rumeysan yahay inuu horumar sameeyay kadib kulamo dhowr ah oo dhex maray labada dhinac, iyadoo Casemiro si joogto ah loogu arkay Miami bilihii la soo dhaafay.

headline: Gavi Oo Shaaciyay Cidda Iska Leh Mas’uuliyadda Guuldarradii Barcelona Looga Reebay Tartanka Champions League
body:
Gavi ayaa si ka duwan inta badan ciyaartoyda Barcelona uga hadlay sababta ka haristooda UEFA Champions League.
Isagoo ka hadlayay guuldarradii ay kala kulmeen Atlético Madrid, Gavi wuxuu diiday in uu garsoorka eedeeyo, inkastoo uu qiray inaysan u janjeerin dhanka Barcelona. Wuxuu si cad u sheegay in dhibaatadu ay ahayd in kooxda aysan ka faa’iideysan fursadihii ay abuurtay.
“Annaga ayaa nafteena reebnay,” ayuu si toos ah u yiri, taasoo muujinaysa inuu mas’uuliyadda dusha ka saaray kooxda.
Dhanka kale, Raphinha ayaa si adag uga soo horjeestay aragtidaas, isagoo ku adkaystay in garsoorku si cad uga hor yimid Barcelona. Wuxuu xitaa sheegay in kulamadii la ciyaaray aad loogu jiifay kooxda, isla markaana la “xaday” guushooda.
Hadalladan kala duwan waxay muujinayaan laba aragti oo iska soo horjeeda oo gudaha Barca ka jirta: mid aqbalaya qaladka kooxda, iyo mid eedeynaya go’aamada garsoorka.

headline: “Waa Nala Dhacay”:- Raphinha Oo Farta Ku Fiiqay Cidda Ka Dambeysa In Barcelona Laga Reebo Tartanka Champions League
body:

“Ma garanayo inta qalad ay sameeyeen, laakiin garsooruhu xitaa hal kaar jaalle ah ma bixin.”
Raphinha ayaa su’aal ka keenay sida garsoorayaashu ula dhaqmaan Barcelona, gaar ahaan iyadoo Barca la siiyay kaarar casaan ah labadii lugood ee kulanka.
Ugu dambeyn, Barcelona ayaa looga reebay tartanka 3-2 wadar ahaan, halka Atlético Madrid ay u gudubtay wareegga xiga.

headline: Muxuu Hansi Flick Ka Yiri In Barcelona Si Dirqi Ah Looga Reebo Champions League?
body:
Hansi Flick ayaa muujiyay niyad jab weyn kadib markii Barcelona looga reebay Champions League si dirqi ah, kadib guuldarro 3-2 ah oo wadar ahaan ah oo ay kala kulmeen Atlético Madrid.
Tababaraha reer Jarmal ayaa qiray in kooxdiisu si fiican u ciyaartay, xitaa markii ay hal ciyaaryahan ka yaraayeen Atletico, balse aysan ka faa’iidaysan fursadahooda.
“Aad ayaan u niyad jabnay sababtoo ah kooxda waxay ahayd mid heer sare ah, xitaa markii aan hal ciyaaryahan ka hooseynay iyaga” ayuu yiri Flick.
Wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay in Barcelona ay abuurtay fursado badan qeybtii hore, laakiin qaladaad ay sameeyeen ay keeneen in gool laga dhaliyo, taasoo beddeshay natiijada.
“Kubadda cagtu waa iska sidaas. Waa inaan wax ka hagaajinaa xilli ciyaareedka dambe,” ayuu ku daray.
Inkasta oo kooxda ay dadaal badan muujisay, Flick wuxuu qiray in aysan ku filneyn si ay u gudbaan, taasoo ka dhigaysa in Barcelona hadda diiradda saarto hagaajinta iyo dib-u-dhis xilli ciyaareedka soo socda.

headline: Muxuu Arne Slot Ka Yiri Guuldarradii Kooxdiisa Looga Reebay Tartanka Champions League?
body:
Arne Slot ayaa sheegay in Liverpool ay nasiib xuntahay kadib ka haristii UEFA Champions League. Waxay la kulantay guuldarro wadar ahaan niyad jab leh(4-0).
Liverpool ayaa looga badiyay 2-0 lugtii labaad, inkastoo ay abuureen fursado badan oo ay goolal ku dhalin kareen. Slot wuxuu qiray in kulankii hore ay nasiib lahaayeen, laakiin kulankan ay nasiib darnaayeen.
“Todobaadkii hore waxaan helnay wax ka badan wixii aan mudneyn, maanta waxaan helnay wax ka yar wixii aan mudneyn,” ayuu yiri Slot.
Wuxuu aaminsan yahay in kooxdiisu ay u qalantay inay guuleysato kulanka, balse ay ku guuldarreysteen inay ka faa’iideystaan fursadahooda, halka PSG ay muujisay tayo sare, gaar ahaan dhanka dhammeystirka.
Slot wuxuu si gaar ah u amaanay Ousmane Dembele, isagoo sheegay inuu muujiyay sababta uu ugu guuleystay Ballon d’Or.
Ugu dambeyn, Slot wuxuu tilmaamay farqiga u dhexeeya labada koox:
Liverpool → fursado badan laakiin aan la dhammeystirin
PSG → fursado yar laakiin si fiican loo dhammeystiray
Taas ayaa ugu dambeyn go’aamisay in Liverpool laga reebo tartanka.

headline: PSG Oo Si Awood Leh U Garaacday Liverpool, Una Soo Gudubtay Wareega 4 Dhammaadka Tartanka Champions League
body:
Paris Saint-Germain ayaa si awood leh ugu gudubtay semi-final-ka UEFA Champions League kadib markii ay 2-0 ku garaacday Liverpool lugtii labaad ee ka dhacday Anfield.
Kooxda Paris ayaa sidoo kale ku badisay lugtii hore 2-0, taasoo ka dhigtay natiijada guud 4-0; guul cad oo muujinaysa awoodooda tartanka.
Ciyaarta dhexdeeda, PSG ayaa ku fiicnayd dhinaca xakamaynta iyo kubad heysashada, halka Liverpool ay isku dayday inay fursado abuurto, gaar ahaan qeybtii hore, balse aysan ka faa’iidaysan.
Xiddiga ciyaarta wuxuu noqday Ousmane Dembele:
-Goolka 1aad (73’) kadib caawin uu ka helay Khvicha Kvaratskhelia
-Goolka 2aad (90+1’) oo uu ka caawiyay Bradley Barcola
Sidoo kale, ciyaarta waxaa jiray muran VAR ah markii go’aan penalty loo dhigay Liverpool, balse la kansalay kadib dib-u-eegis.
PSG waxay hadda si buuxda u muujisay inay tahay musharax dhab ah oo u tartamaya koobka, halka Liverpool ay si niyad jab leh uga hartay tartanka.

headline: Atletico Madrid Oo U Gudubtay Wareega 4 Dhamaadka Champions League, Kadib Markii Ay Garaacday Barcelona.
body:
Atlético Madrid ayaa si cajiib ah ugu gudubtay semi-final-ka UEFA Champions League inkastoo looga badiyay 2-1 lugtii labaad ee ay la ciyaareen Barcelona.
Barcelona ayaa si degdeg ah ku bilaabatay ciyaarta, iyadoo Lamine Yamal furay goolasha daqiiqaddii 4aad, halka Ferran Torres uu labaad ku daray daqiiqaddii 24aad. Xilligaas waxay u muuqatay in Barça ay dib u soo laaban karto.
Laakiin Atlético Madrid ma quusan. Ademola Lookman ayaa dhaliyay gool muhiim ah daqiiqaddii 31aad, taas oo si weyn u beddeshay jihada kulanka, maadaama ay sii haysteen faa’iidada guud.
Xaaladda ayaa sii adkaatay markii Eric Garcia laga saaray ciyaarta (red card), laakiin Atlético waxay si fiican u maareeyeen daqiiqadihii ugu dambeeyay si ay u ilaashadaan natiijada.
Ugu dambeyn, Atlético Madrid ayaa ku gudubtay 3-2 wadar ahaan, taasoo mar kale muujisay sida ay ugu adag yihiin kulamada knockout-ka.
Hadda waxay sugayaan kooxda ka soo baxda kulanka u dhexeeya Arsenal iyo Sporting CP.

Suxufiga Andy Mitten ayaa sheegay in go’aanka kooxda uu weli ku xiran yahay hal arrin oo muhiim ah; u soo bixitaanka UEFA Champions League.
“Waxba isma beddelin. Haddii uu Manchester United geeyo Champions League, shaqada wuu sii hayn doonaa,” ayuu Mitten yiri.
Wuxuu sidoo kale xusay in maamulka United ay wali qiimeynayaan tababarayaal kale, balse xaaladda hadda jirta ay u shaqeynayso Carrick:
“Dad badan hadda lama heli karo sababo kala duwan awgood, sida Koobka Adduunka iwm. Dadka badankoodna way ku qanacsan yihiin Carrick, laakiin waa inuu geeyaa kooxda Champions League.”
Manchester United ayaa hadda ku jirta kaalinta 3aad ee Premier League, iyadoo heysata dhibco la mid ah Aston Villa, halka Liverpool ay si dhow uga daba imaaneyso.
Iyadoo lix kulan oo kaliya ay harsan yihiin, tartanka loogu jiro afarta sare ayaa aad u adag, waxayna arrintaas si toos ah u go’aamin kartaa mustaqbalka Carrick ee Old Trafford.

headline: Szoboszlai Oo Farriin Culus U Diray Taageerayaasha Liverpool Ka Hor Kulanka PSG
body:
Xiddiga khadka dhexe ee Liverpool, Dominik Szoboszlai, ayaa fariin toos ah u diray taageerayaasha kooxda kahor kulanka adag ee ay la leeyihiin Paris Saint-Germain ee Champions League.
Liverpool ayaa u baahan inay kasoo kabato 2-0, balse Szoboszlai wuxuu muujiyay kalsooni iyo dagaal:
“Waxaan rajeynayaa inaan sameyn karno soo laabasho. Dhiiga ayaan shubi doonaa, i aamina. Xitaa haddii aan ciyaarnay laba maalmood kahor, waxaan nahay diyaar”
Wuxuu sidoo kale carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimada kalsoonida:
“Waxay noqon doontaa habeen gaar ah, waan dareemayaa. Waa inaan is-aaminsanaano, qof walba waa inuu is aaminsanaadaa. Haddii aadan is-aaminsanayn, gurigaaga iska joog.”
Hadalladan ayaa muujinaya sida uu Szoboszlai ugu diyaarsan yahay kulanka, isagoo doonaya inuu kiciyo taageerayaasha Anfield si ay u abuuraan jawi caawin kara soo laabasho suurtagal ah.
Si kastaba, tani waxay timid kadib muran hore oo uu galay, markii uu u muuqday inuu taageerayaasha ku dhaliilay inaysan dadaal badan muujin kadib guuldarro 4-0 ah oo ay kala kulmeen Manchester City, taasoo ku qasabtay inuu raalli-gelin bixiyo.

headline: SuperComputer-ka Opta Oo Saadaaliyay 4-ta Koox Ee U Soo Gudbi Kara Semi-finalka Tartanka Champions League
body:
SuperComputer-ka Opta ayaa saadaaliyay in afar koox ay si weyn ugu dhow yihiin inay gaaraan semi-finalka Champions League, iyadoo la tixraacayo natiijooyinka lugaha hore iyo qaab ciyaareedka kooxaha.
Kooxda Arsenal ayaa leh fursadda ugu sarreysa, iyadoo la siiyay 88% inay u gudbaan afar dhamaadka kadib guushii ay ka gaareen Sporting. Bayern Munich ayaa sidoo kale meel fiican ku jirta, iyadoo heshay 83.4% fursad kadib markii ay ka adkaatay Real Madrid.
Paris Saint-Germain ayaa iyaduna leh 85.6% fursad oo ay ku gaarto semi-finalka, kadib guushii 2-0 ay ka gaartay Liverpool, halka Atletico Madrid loo saadaaliyay 78.9% inay gudubto kadib markii ay si lama filaan ah 2-0 ugu garaacday Barcelona.
Dhanka kale, kooxaha laga adkaaday lugtii hore sida Real Madrid, Liverpool, Barcelona iyo Sporting CP waxaa la siiyay fursado aad u hooseeya, midkoodna kama badna 21.1% inay sameeyaan soo laabasho.
Saadaashan waxay muujineysaa in kooxaha horey u helay natiijooyinka wanaagsan ay hadda gacanta ku hayaan fursadda ugu weyn ee u gudbidda wareega xiga, inkastoo kubadda cagta uusan waligeed ka madhnayn yaabab.

headline: Mikel Arteta: “Wax Cabsi Ah Kama Qabo Inaan Ku Guuleysanayno Premier League Sanadkaan”
body:
Tababaraha Arsenal, Mikel Arteta, ayaa muujiyay kalsooni buuxda kahor toddobaad aad u muhiim ah oo go’aamin kara xilli ciyaareedka kooxda.
Arsenal ayaa wajahaysa labo kulan oo culus; midka hore waa lugta labaad ee Champions League oo ay la leeyihiin Sporting CP, kadib guushii 1-0 ay kusoo gaareen Portugal. Haddii ay gudbaan, waxay noqon doontaa markii ugu horreysay ee ay gaaraan semi-finalka tartanka laba xilli ciyaareed oo xiriir ah.
Kadib, kooxda ayaa u safri doonta Etihad si ay ula ciyaarto Manchester City kulan si weyn u saameyn kara tartanka Premier League.
Arteta ayaa si cad u muujiyay dareenkiisa:
“Shucuurteyda wey kacsan tahay. Wax kale ma jiraan. Waxaan u riyoonayaa si weyn.”
Wuxuu sheegay inuu soo galay dadaal badan si uu kooxda u gaarsiiyo heerkan:
“Wax badan ayaan qabtay si aan halkan u gaaro. Waxaan hadda arkaa fursad iyo wax qurux badan, waxaan rabaa inaan dhameystiro safarkan.”
Arteta ayaa sidoo kale carrabka ku adkeeyay inuusan wax cabsi ah qabin:
“Wax cabsi ah ma qabo hadda. Hore ayaan u baqayay, mar aan ku wareersanaa mustaqbalka kooxda. Hadda? Waa ujeeddo cad, xamaasad iyo jihayn.”
Hadalladan ayaa muujinaya sida uu Arteta ugu diyaar garoobay toddobaad go’aan qaadasho ah oo Arsenal u horseedi kara guulo waaweyn ama cadaadis cusub.

headline: Obi Mikel Oo Si Aan Horay Loo Arag Ugu Maadsaday Arteta Kadib Guuldarradii Bournemouth
body:
Halyeeygii hore ee Chelsea, John Obi Mikel, ayaa si kaftan iyo dhaliil leh u weeraray tababaraha Arsenal, Mikel Arteta, kadib guuldarradii ay kala kulmeen AFC Bournemouth.
Mikel ayaa ku kaftamay in Arteta uu “illaaway” inuu ciyaartoydiisa u sheego inay garoonka yimaadaan:
“Wuxuu ilaaway inuu u sheego ciyaartoyda inay yimaadaan garoonka, inay keensadaan kabahooda iyo qalabkooda, maxaa yeelay ma aysan ahayn kuwo qalbiyan u xaadir ah.”
Ciyaarta ayaa ku dhammaatay 2-1 oo ay guusha ku qaadatay Bournemouth, iyadoo goolsha ay u kala dhaliyeen Alex Scott iyo Eli Junior Kroupi.
Mikel ayaa sidoo kale si adag u dhaliilay qaab ciyaareedka Arsenal:
“Waxay ahayd ciyaar caajis ah in la daawado; ma jirin xiiso, ma jirin firfircooni. Ciyaartoyda Arsenal xitaa ma rabin kubadda. Ma jirin xorriyad ama isku xirnaan dhexdooda ah.”
Hadalladan ayaa muujinaya sida ay khubaradu uga niyad jabeen bandhigga Arsenal, xilli cadaadis uu sii kordhayo kahor kulamada waaweyn ee soo socda.

headline: Paul Scholes Oo Saadaal Cusub Ka Soo Saaray Kooxda Ku Guuleysaneysa Premier League Kadib Guushii City Ee Chelsea
body:
Halyeeygii Manchester United, Paul Scholes, ayaa saadaal cusub ka bixiyay tartanka horyaalka Premier League, isagoo sheegay in Manchester City ay hadda u muuqato kooxda ugu dhow inay ku guuleysaneyso.
Scholes ayaa aaminsan in Arsenal ay lumiyeen dardartii lagu bartay kadib guuldarradii Bournemouth iyo guushii weynayd ee City ka gaartay Chelsea.
“Aniga ahaan, Arsenal way u dhammaatay. Dardarta oo dhan wuxuu la jiraa City,” ayuu yiri Scholes.
Wuxuu sidoo kale tilmaamay dhibaato weyn oo Arsenal haysata:
“Mar uun waa inaad garaacdaa kooxaha kula tartamaya. Anigu ma arkin iyaga oo sidaas sameynaya, isma badbaadin karaan kulamada waaweyn.”
Labada koox ayaa isku wajihi doona kulan aad u muhiim ah oo ka dhici doona Etihad, kaasoo si weyn u go’aamin kara cidda qaadi doonta horyaalka.

headline: Shaxda Ay Liverpool Kaga Hor Tagi Karto PSG

Liverpool ayaa wajahaysa habeen go’aan qaadasho ah marka ay Anfield ku martigeliyaan Paris Saint-Germain lugta labaad ee Champions League.

Mamardashvili; Jeremie Frimpong, Ibrahima Konate, Virgil van Dijk, Kerkez; Ryan Gravenberch, Alexis Mac Allister; Mohamed Salah, Szoboszlai, Wirtz; Ekitike.
Slot ayaa la filayaa inuu ka laabto nidaamkii saddexda daafac ee uu isticmaalay lugtii hore, maadaama Liverpool ay u baahan tahay goolal badan si ay u soo laabato.
Kulankan ayaa noqon kara mid taariikhi ah haddii Liverpool ay ku guuleysato inay sameyso soo laabasho kale oo caan ah, iyadoo taageerayaasha Anfield mar kale la filayo inay door weyn ka ciyaaraan.

headline: Shaxda Ay Barcelona Kaga Hor Tagi Karto Atletico
body:
Barcelona ayaa wajahaysa hawl aad u adag marka ay booqdaan Atletico Madrid lugta labaad ee wareega 8-da Champions League, iyagoo u baahan inay kasoo kabsadaan 2-0.
Kulankii hore ee Camp Nou wax walba si xun ayay ugu dhaceen kooxda uu hoggaamiyo Hansi Flick. Inkastoo ay si fiican u billowdeen ciyaarta, casaankii Pau Cubarsi ayaa beddelay jihada kulanka, taasoo fursad u siisay Atletico inay laba gool dhaliso.
Hadda Barcelona waxay u baahan tahay dadaal weyn si ay u sameyso soo laabasho, gaar ahaan iyadoo lagu ciyaarayo garoonka Metropolitano oo leh jawi adag. Si kastaba, kooxda Catalan-ka ayaa weli leh rajo, maadaama ay caan ku yihiin awoodda ay u leeyihiin inay goolal badan dhaliyaan.
Haddii Barcelona laga reebo Champions League marxaladdan, waxaa loo arki doonaa guuldarro weyn, maadaama ay wali raadinayaan koobkoodii ugu horreeyay tan iyo 2015.
Go’aamada uu qaato Flick ee xulashada ciyaartoyda ayaa noqon doona kuwo aad muhiim u ah, haddii Barcelona ay rabto inay sii noolayso riyadeeda Yurub.

headline: Virgil van Dijk Oo Farriin Culus U Diray Taageerayaasha Liverpool Ka Hor Kulanka Caawa
body:
Kabtanka Liverpool, Virgil van Dijk, ayaa fariin xooggan u diray taageerayaasha ka hor kulanka adag ee Champions League ee ay la leeyihiin Paris Saint-Germain.
Van Dijk ayaa ku booriyay taageerayaasha inay abuuraan jawigii cabsida lahaa ee Anfield lagu yaqaan:
“Xaaladdu way ka duwan tahay sidii hore, laakiin Anfield waa meel aan si fiican u naqaano, waxaa na sugaya habeen weyn oo Champions League ah, koox adag iyo fursad aan si wadajir ah wax gaar ah u sameyn karno.”
Wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay in kulankan uu yahay mid ay ciyaartoydu uu aad ugu weyn yahay:
“Haddii aadan ku farxin kulamadan, waxaad ku jirtaa ciyaar qaldan.”
Van Dijk ayaa qirtay in bandhiggoodii Paris uu liitay, balse wuxuu aaminsan yahay in wax walba ay is beddeli karaan marka lagu ciyaarayo Anfield:
“Waxaan u baahannahay wax gaar ah, taas waxay ka bilaabaneysaa qaab ciyaareedkeena iyo taageerada aad na siinaysaan.”
Wuxuu sidoo kale xusay habeenno waaweyn oo hore sida kuwii Barcelona iyo Manchester City, isagoo sheegay in kooxda ay weli rumeysan tahay inay mar kale sameyn karto mucjiso.
“Gudaha Qolka labiska, qof walba wuu aaminsan yahay inaan wax gaar ah sameyn karno caawa.”
Ugu dambeyn, Van Dijk wuxuu ku baaqay midnimo iyo dagaal buuxa:
“Waa inaan muujinaa rabitaan, dadaal iyo go’aan qaadasho 90 daqiiqo ama ka badan. Aan wadajir u bixino wax walba oo aan hayno.”

headline: Obi Mikel Oo Bannaanka Keenay Hal Caqabad Oo Arsenal Ka Hor Istaagi Karta Ku Guuleysiga Premier League
body:
Arsenal ayaa wajahday dhaleeceyn culus kadib guuldarradii 2-1 ee ay kala kulmeen AFC Bournemouth, iyadoo halyeeygii hore ee Chelsea, John Obi Mikel, uu si adag u weeraray ciyaartoyda Arsenal.
Obi Mikel ayaa sheegay in ciyaartoydu aysan ku soo bixin sidii laga filayay kulankii  Emirates Stadium, isagoo xitaa ku eedeeyay inay “ka dhuunteen kubadda” markii cadaadisku ku kordhay.
Wuxuu sidoo kale ammaan u jeediyay taageerayaasha:
“Taageerayaashu way yimaadeen oo waxay bixiyeen wax walba, laakiin ciyaartoydu ma aysan muujin dadaal.”
Dhaliishan ayaa imaanaysa xilli Arsenal ay wali ku jirto tartan adag oo horyaalka ah, isla markaana ay u diyaar garoobayaan lugta labaad ee Champions League ee ay la ciyaarayaan Sporting CP, ka hor kulanka weyn ee Manchester City ee Premier League.

headline: Lisandro Martinez Oo Baal Madoow Ka Galay Taariikhda Premier League Kulankii Leeds
body:
Daafaca Manchester United, Lisandro Martinez, ayaa qaatay casaankii ugu horreeyay ee xirfaddiisa kooxda intii lagu jiray kulankii ay la yeesheen Leeds United.
Ciyaaryahanka reer Argentina ayaa laga saaray ciyaarta qeybtii labaad kadib markii uu timaha ka jiiday Dominic Calvert-Lewin, iyadoo waqtigaas Leeds ay 2-0 ku hoggaamineysay ciyaarta, taasoo xaaladda United sii adkaysay.
Tani waxay ahayd casaankii ugu horreeyay ee Martinez qaato 106 kulan oo uu u saftay Manchester United, iyo guud ahaan casaankii labaad ee xirfaddiisa kubadda cagta.
Daafacan dhexe ayaa xilli ciyaareedkan wajahaya dhibaatooyin dhaawac, iyadoo kulankan uu ahaa kaliya kii 16-aad ee uu ciyaaro.
Casaankan ayaa sii carqaladeeyay xilli ciyaareedka adag ee Martinez iyo sidoo kale kooxdiisa.

headline: Achraf Hakimi Oo Durba Cabsi Ka Muujiyay Awoodda Liverpool Ee Anfield Ka Hor Kulanka Lugta Labaad Ee Champions League
body:
Xiddiga Paris Saint-Germain, Achraf Hakimi, ayaa ka digay in kooxdiisu aysan is dhigan marka ay u safreyso Anfield si ay ula ciyaarto Liverpool lugta labaad ee Champions League.
PSG ayaa wadata hoggaan 2-0 ah kadib guushii lugtii hore, balse Hakimi wuxuu sheegay in wali wax walba ay furan yihiin:
“Waa inaan aad u feejignaannaa. Waxaan ognahay sida Liverpool khatar u tahay, gaar ahaan marka ay gurigeeda joogto. Ciyaarta hal mar ayay is beddeli karta.”
Inkasta oo tirakoobyada ay PSG siinayaan fursad sare oo ay ku gudbi karto, Hakimi si cad ayuu u diiday inay Liverpool dhayalsadaan:
“Ma dareemeyno inaan ka sarreyno cidna. Waxa ugu muhiimsan waa inaan mideysnaano, ku dagaalanno kubad kasta, oo aan ku raaxaysanno ciyaarta.”
Kulankan ayaa si gaar ah xiiso u leh, iyadoo Liverpool lagu yaqaan soo laabashooyin taariikhi ah, gaar ahaan tii ay ku sameeyeen Barcelona sanadkii 2019.
Hakimi ayaa qiray in kulanku uu noqon doono mid adag, balse wuxuu muujiyay kalsooni:
“Way adkaan doontaa, laakiin waan u diyaarsan nahay. Labada kooxoodba wax walba ayay bixin doonaan.”

headline: Jamie Carragher Oo Shaaciyay Sababta Arteta Iyo Arsenal Ugu Adkaan Doonto Inay Garaacaan City
body:
Halyeeygii hore ee Liverpool, Jamie Carragher, ayaa aaminsan in Arsenal ay si weyn ugu adkaan doonto inay garaacdo Manchester City kulanka muhiimka ah ee dhammaadka todobaadkan.
Carragher ayaa sheegay in labada koox ay si kala duwan u wajahayaan tartanka horyaalka:
“Arsenal iyo Man City waxay isugu dayayaan inay horyaalka ugu guuleystaan si kala duwan. City waxay leedahay weerar toos ah iyo tayo  sareysa marka la joogo qeybta ugu dambeysa.”
Wuxuu tusaale u soo qaatay bandhigii xoogga lahaa ee City qeybtii labaad ee kulankii Chelsea:
“Tani ma ahayn arrin taatik ah oo keliya, waxay ahayd maskax iyo dhaqdhaqaaqyo weerar oo aanan ka arkin Arsenal.”
Sidoo kale, wuxuu tilmaamay in Mikel Arteta uusan beddeli doonin qaabkiisa:
“Arteta ma beddeli doono wax badan toddobaad gudihiis. Waan ognahay sida uu Arteta u ciyaaro, wuxuu ku tiirsanaan doonaa difaaciisa iyo Declan Rice.”
Ugu dambeyn, Carragher wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay in dhibaatada ugu weyn ee Arsenal ay tahay dhanka weerarka:
“Awooddiisu ma aha weerarka. Waxaan sheegayay arrintan xilli ciyaareedkan oo dhan, ma haystaan ciyaaryahan weerar oo heer sare ah.”
Iyadoo Manchester City ay u baahan tahay inay badiso dhammaan kulamada harsan si ay horyaalka u qaaddo, kulankan Etihad ayaa noqon kara mid si weyn u go’aamiya cidda ku guuleysan doonta Premier League.

Dhanka kale, Manchester City ayaa la sheegay inay durba diyaarsatay bedelka Pep Guardiola, iyagoo doorbidaya Enzo Maresca.
Sidoo kale, Bayern Munich ayaa horey u dejisay xaaladdeeda iyadoo uu hoggaaminayo Vincent Kompany, taasoo ka dhigaysa Liverpool meesha kaliya ee u furan Alonso.
Haddii uu u wareego Anfield, Alonso wuxuu heli karaa xasillooni iyo mashruuc waqti dheer ah, wax uu waayay muddadii koobnayd ee uu joogay Madrid.

headline: Real Madrid Oo Go’aan Cad Ka Soo Saartay Mustaqbalka Endrick
body:
Kooxda Real Madrid ayaa go’aan cad ka gaartay mustaqbalka xiddiga da’da yar ee reer Brazil, Endrick.
Sida uu sheegay wariyaha lagu kalsoon yahay ee Mario Cortegana, Endrick ayaa dib ugu soo laaban doona Real Madrid marka uu dhammaado amaahdiisa uu ku joogo Olympique Lyonnais dhammaadka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Wararka ayaa sidoo kale tilmaamaya in maamulka Madrid ay si buuxda u go’aansadeen inay sii haystaan ciyaaryahanka xilli ciyaareedka dambe, isla markaana aysan diyaar u ahayn inay dhageystaan wax dalab ah oo uga yimaada kooxo kale.
Endrick waxaa loo arkaa qayb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah qorshaha mustaqbalka fog ee kooxda, mana jirto wax qorshe ah oo lagu iibinayo ama mar kale lagu amaahinayo xagaaga soo socda.
Dhanka waxqabadka, weeraryahanka ayaa si fiican ku billowday waayihiisa Lyon, inkastoo uu wax yar hoos u dhacay markii dambe. Wuxuu ciyaaray 16 kulan, isagoo dhaliyay 6 gool isla markaana bixiyay 6 caawin, taasoo muujinaysa kartidiisa sare inkastoo uu wali yahay ciyaaryahan da’yar.

headline: Bruno Fernandes Oo Shaaciyay Hal Wax Oo Sababay Inay Leeds Ka Adkaato United
body:
Kabtanka Manchester United, Bruno Fernandes, ayaa sheegay in kooxdiisu aysan kulanka ku lumin casaankii Martinez, balse ay guuldarradu timid qeybtii hore ee ciyaartii ay la yeesheen Leeds United.
United ayaa 2-1 loogu awood sheegtay iyadoo joogta gurigeeda Old Trafford, iyadoo Leeds ay 2-0 hoggaanka u qabatay qeybtii hore.
Fernandes ayaa si cad u sheegay meesha dhibku ka bilowday:
“Waxaan ciyaarta iska luminay qeybtii hore.”
Wuxuu tilmaamay in kooxdiisa ay ku fashilmatay inay si degdeg ah ula qabsadaan cadaadiska Leeds:
“Ma aanan gaarin heerka ciyaarta bilowgiiba. Waan ogayn inay si xoog leh noo cadaadin doonaan, laakiin waxaa na looga  baahnaa inaan ka fiicnaanno sidaas”
Inkasta oo ay fursad u heleen inay soo laabtaan qeybtii labaad, Fernandes wuxuu qiray in aysan u suurtagelin:
“Waxaan haysannay waqti aan ku beddeli karno ciyaarta qeybtii labaad, laakiin ma suurtoobin.”
Hadda Manchester United waxay u safri doonaan London si ay ula ciyaaraan Chelsea kulanka xiga ee Premier League.
