headline: Muxuu Carrick Ka Yiri Guuldarradii Kooxdiisa Ka Soo Gaartay Leeds?
body:
Tababaraha Manchester United, Michael Carrick, ayaa si adag u dhaliilay garsoorka kadib guuldarradii 2-1 ee ay kala kulmeen Leeds United habeenkii Isniinta.
Carrick ayaa si cad u muujiyay caro iyo niyad-jab, isagoo yiri:
“Go’aankaas waa mid ka mid ah kuwii ugu xumaa ee aan waligey arko.”
Wuxuu si gaar ah uga hadlay casaankii la siiyay Lisandro Martinez:
“Wuxuu gacantiisa ku dhuftay wejiga Licha, haddana isaga ayaa la diray, waa wax lala yaabo.”
Sidoo kale, Carrick ayaa ka cawday goolka koowaad ee Leeds, isagoo sheegay in khalad cad la iska indha tiray:
“Leny Yoro madaxa ayaa laga garaacay ka hor goolkooda, laakiin waxba lagama qaban.”
Guuldarradan ayaa joojisay formkii fiicnaa ee Carrick tan iyo markii uu noqday tababaraha ku meel gaarka ah, halka Leeds ay gaartay guul taariikhi ah oo ah markii ugu horreysay ee ay Old Trafford ku badiso muddo 45 sano ah.

headline: Virgil van Dijk Oo Farriin Xoogan U Diray Taageerayaasha Liverpool Ka Hor Kulanka PSG
body:
Kabtanka Liverpool, Virgil van Dijk, ayaa fariin xooggan u diray taageerayaasha kooxda ka hor kulanka muhiimka ah ee Champions League ee ay la leeyihiin Paris Saint-Germain.
Liverpool ayaa 2-0 looga soo adkaaday lugtii hore ee Paris, waxaana goolasha u dhaliyay Désiré Doué iyo Khvicha Kvaratskhelia, taasoo ka dhigtay in Reds ay u baahan yihiin soo laabasho weyn oo Anfield Ah.
Van Dijk ayaa sheegay in taageerayaashu ay door muhiim ah ka ciyaari doonaan:
“Taageerayaashu waxay u badan tahay inay noqdaan qodobka ugu muhiimsan, marka laga reebo bandhigga aan sameyno.”
Wuxuu xusay habeenadii hore ee Anfield oo ay taageerayaashu saameyn weyn yeesheen:
“Waxaan nasiib u yeeshay inaan la kulmo habeenno ay xiriirka u dhexeeya taageerayaasha iyo ciyaartoydu uu ahaa mid cajiib ah.”
Si kastaba, daafaca reer Holland ayaa caddeeyay in Liverpool ay u baahan tahay wax gaar ah si ay u soo baxdo:
“Waxaan u baahannahay wax aad u gaar ah, haddii kale fursad ma hayno.”
Wuxuu sidoo kale ka digay in haddii ay u ciyaaraan sidii kulankii Paris:
“Haddii aan u ciyaarno sidii Paris, markaas fursad ma haysanno aniga ahaan.”
Liverpool ayaa hadda ku qasban inay sameyso soo laabasho weyn si ay uga gudubto PSG una gaarto wareegga xiga.

headline: Paul Merson Oo Ka Hadlay Fursadaha Man United Ee Ku Guuleysiga Premier League Xilli Ciyaareedka Dambe
body:
Halyeeygii hore ee Arsenal, Paul Merson, ayaa shaki geliyay fursadaha Manchester United ee ku guuleysiga horyaalka Premier League xilli ciyaareedka soo socda.
Tan iyo markii Michael Carrick uu qabtay xilka tababarenimo bishii January, United ayaa si fiican u soo kacday, iyagoo hadda ku jira kaalinta saddexaad, kana dambeeya Arsenal iyo Manchester City.
Si kastaba, Merson ma aaminsana in kooxda ay weli diyaar u tahay inay horyaalka u tartanto.
“Uma maleynayo in Manchester United ay diyaar u tahay inay u tartanto horyaalka xilli ciyaareedka soo socda,” ayuu yiri.
Wuxuu ku talinayaa in diiradda ugu weyn ay noqoto dib ugu soo laabashada Champions League:
“Waxa ugu muhiimsan waa inay dib ugu soo laabtaan Champions League, taas ayaana ah mudnaanta koowaad.”

headline: Jeremy Doku Oo Tilmaamay Kulanka Go’aamin Kara Tartanka Premier League
body:
Xiddiga Manchester City, Jeremy Doku, ayaa sheegay in kulanka soo socda ee ay la ciyaarayaan Arsenal uu si weyn u go’aamin karo cidda qaadaysa horyaalka Premier League.
City ayaa gaartay guul weyn oo 3-0 ah kulankii Chelsea, taasoo ka dhigtay inay farqiga 6-da dhibcood usoo dhowaadaan, kadib guuldarradii lama filaanka ahayd ee Arsenal kala kulantay Bournemouth.
Labada koox ayaa hadda ku balansan kulan adag oo ka dhici doona Etihad Stadium usbuuca soo socda, iyadoo horyaalku uu meel xasaasi ah marayo.
Doku ayaa si cad u muujiyay sida uu u arko kulankan:
“Haa, aniga ahaan waa kulanka go’aaminaya horyaalka.”
Wuxuu sharaxay in kulamada haray ay aad u yar yihiin, sidaas darteed natiijada kulankan uu noqon karo mid go’aamiya tartanka:
“Haddii aad badiso, waa dharbaaxo weyn oo aad ku dhufanayso iyaga. Haddii aad guuldarraysato, markaas arrintu waxay noqonaysaa mid gacantooda ku jirta, annagana waa inaan sugnaa inay dhibco lumiyaan.”
Ugu dambeyn, Doku wuxuu sheegay inuu doonayo in wax walba ay gacanta ugu jiraan City:
“Haddii aan guuleysanno, wax walba gacanteenna ayay ku jiri doonaan, aniguna taas ayaan doorbidayaa.”

Xiddiga Manchester City, Jeremy Doku, ayaa sheegay in kulanka soo socda ee ay la ciyaarayaan Arsenal uu si weyn u go'aamin karo cidda qaadaysa horyaalka Premier League.
City ayaa gaartay guul weyn oo 3-0 ah kulankii Chelsea, taasoo ka dhigtay inay farqiga 6-da dhibcood usoo dhowaadaan, kadib guuldarradii lama filaanka ahayd ee Arsenal kala kulantay Bournemouth.
Labada koox ayaa hadda ku balansan kulan adag oo ka dhici doona Etihad Stadium usbuuca soo socda, iyadoo horyaalku uu meel xasaasi ah marayo.
Doku ayaa si cad u muujiyay sida uu u arko kulankan:
"Haa, aniga ahaan waa kulanka go'aaminaya horyaalka."
Wuxuu sharaxay in kulamada haray ay aad u yar yihiin, sidaas darteed natiijada kulankan uu noqon karo mid go'aamiya tartanka:
"Haddii aad badiso, waa dharbaaxo weyn oo aad ku dhufanayso iyaga. Haddii aad guuldarraysato, markaas arrintu waxay noqonaysaa mid gacantooda ku jirta, annagana waa inaan sugnaa inay dhibco lumiyaan."
Ugu dambeyn, Doku wuxuu sheegay inuu doonayo in wax walba ay gacanta ugu jiraan City:
"Haddii aan guuleysanno, wax walba gacanteenna ayay ku jiri doonaan, aniguna taas ayaan doorbidayaa."

headline: Gary Lineker Oo Beddelay Saadaashiisa Kooxda Ku Guuleysaneysa Premier League, Kadib Guuldarradii Arsenal Ee Bournemouth
body:
Halyeeygii hore ee England, Gary Lineker, ayaa beddelay saadaashiisa horyaalka ka hor kulanka weyn ee Manchester City iyo Arsenal.
Lineker ayaa hore si joogto ah u taageeri jiray Arsenal, isagoo mar walba ku andacoon jiray inay ku guuleysaneyso horyaalka kadib 22 sano, balse hadda wuxuu beddelay fikirkaas kadib natiijooyinkii ugu dambeeyay.
Arsenal ayaa 2-1 waxaa uga adkaatay Bournemouth, halka City ay 3-0 ku xasuuqday Chelsea, taasoo beddeshay jihada tartanka.
Isagoo ka hadlayay podcast-kiisa, wuxuu yiri:
“Waxaan dadka oo dhan u sheegayay in Arsenal ay fiicnaan doonto oo aysan fashilmi doonin.
Laakiin hadda way liicayaan, form-kooduna  hoos ayuu u dhacay, waxaana ognahay sida ay muhiim u tahay dardarta.
Hadda waxaa dardar ay ka muuqataa Man City.”
Ugu dambeyn, Lineker wuxuu qirtay in doorashada hadda ay adag tahay, balse haddii lagu qasbo inuu doorto:
“Haddii la i yiraahdo koox dooro, hadda waxaan u badinayaa saadaasheyda Man City, sababtoo ah waxaan aaminsanahay inay guuleysan doonaan usbuuca soo socda.”

headline: Lamine Yamal Oo Digniin Culus U Diray Atletico Ka Hor Kulanka Lugta Labaad Ee Champions League
body:
Xiddiga da’da yar ee Lamine Yamal ayaa caddeeyay in Barcelona ay si buuxda uga go’an tahay inay ka fogaato guuldarro kale oo xanuun leh marka ay wajahaan Atletico Madrid lugta labaad ee Champions League.
Isagoo hadlayay ka hor kulanka, Yamal wuxuu sheegay in kooxda ay si fiican u fahamsan tahay culayska saaran, gaar ahaan kadib niyad-jabkii koobabka.
Wuxuu yiri:
“Haa, waxaan rabnaa inaan ka fogaanno wixii koobka ka dhacay, laakiin kaliya sababtaas ma aha. Sanado badan Barcelona waa inay joogtaa Champions League.”
“Waxaan leenahay rabitaan weyn oo aan ugu gudubno wareegga xiga; waxaan nahay Barcelona, waxaana rabnaa inaan gudubno. Waan aaminsanahay inaan sameyn karno isbeddel, dadaal walbana waan bixin doonnaa.”
Barcelona ayaa wajahaysa caqabad adag kadib markii ay 2-0 ku lumisay lugtii hore gurigeeda, balse Yamal wuxuu diiday in arrinta loo arko mucjiso.
“Waa inaan u ciyaarnaa sida na lagu yaqaan, si xoog leh, laakiin aan lumin qaab ciyaareedkeenna. Taasi waa furaha, mana aha inaan ka fikirno inay tahay mucjiso.”
Inkasta oo ay ciyaarta ka bilaabaneyso 2-0, Yamal wuxuu ku adkeystay in kalsoonida iyo qaab ciyaareedka saxda ah ay yihiin waxa kaliya ee ay u baahan yihiin si ay u soo laabtaan.

headline: Arne Slot Oo Kashifay Qorshaha Ay Kooxdiisa Kaga Hor Tagi Doonto PSG Kulanka Lugta Labaad
body:
Tababaraha Liverpool, Arne Slot, ayaa sheegay in laga yaabo inuu wax ka beddel ku sameeyo qaab ciyaareedka kooxdiisa ka hor kulanka muhiimka ah ee ay la leeyihiin Paris Saint-Germain.
Slot ayaa tilmaamay in nidaamkii ay isticmaaleen lugtii hore (difaac shan ah) uu saameeyay sida ay u wajaheen ciyaarta:
“Haddii aad beddesho nidaamka, diiradda badanaa waxay ku dhacdaa nidaamka laftiisa halkii ay ka ahaan lahayd habka ciyaarta.”
Wuxuu caddeeyay inuusan waligiis qorsheyn inuu kooxdiisa ciyaarsiiyo difaac hoose muddo 90 daqiiqo ah:
“Anigu waligay umaan qorsheyn koox inay difaacato oo kaliya. Waxaan isku daynay inaan si sare u cadaadino, laakiin dhowr jeer ayay si toos ah goolka u gaareen.”
Tababaraha ayaa sheegay in qorshahooda uu yahay inay halis qaataan si ay kubadda uga qaadaan PSG:
“Si aad kubadda uga qaadato, waa inaad cadaadis saartaa, laakiin waxaan aragnay sida ay u adag tahay.”
Slot ayaa sidoo kale muujiyay kalsooni weyn oo ku saabsan saameynta garoonka Anfield:
“Waagii hore Anfield ayaa sameeyn jiray farqi weyn, waxaanan filayaa inuu mar kale sameyn doono.”
Inkasta oo Liverpool lagu hoggaaminayo 2-0, Slot wuxuu sheegay in dareenka kulanka uu ka duwan yahay natiijada:
“Xusuusnow natiijada? Wuxuu ahaa 2-0, laakiin ma uusan u muuqan sidaas.”
Wuxuu ku adkeystay in kooxdiisu awood u leedahay inay sameyso wax gaar ah:
“Waxaa jira rumeysnaan inaan sameyn karno wax gaar ah, laakiin waa inaan noqonaa kuwo aad u gaar ah, sababtoo ah waxaan la ciyaareynaa kooxda heysata Champions League.”
Ugu dambeyn, Slot wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda dheelitirka:
“Waa inaan helnaa dheelitirnaan fiican oo u dhexeeya weerar iyo difaac. Si aad u weerarto, waa inaad marka hore kubadda haysataa.”
Liverpool ayaa u baahan inay kasoo laabato guuldarro 2-0 ah marka ay PSG ku martigelinayaan Anfield lugta labaad.

headline: Patrice Evra Oo Ka Hadlay Fursadaha Barcelona Ay Uga Soo Bixi Karto Atletico Kulanka Lugta Labaad Ee Champions League
body:
Halyeeygii Manchester United, Patrice Evra, ayaa shaki weyn geliyay rajada Barcelona ee soo laabashada ee kulanka Champions League ee ay la leeyihiin Atletico Madrid.
Evra ayaa si toos ah ugu sheegay taageerayaasha Barcelona inay wajahaan xaqiiqda, isagoo yiri:
“Dhageysta, taageerayaasha Barcelona waa inay soo toosaan oo xaqiiqda arkaan. Waa waqtigii la is-hoosaysiin lahaa. Tani ma aha Barcelona-dii 2015, kooxdaas hadda ma jirto.”
Wuxuu tilmaamay in Barcelona ay marar badan ku fashilantay kulamada waaweyn ee Yurub sanadihii u dambeeyay.
“Waxaan aragnay inay marar badan fashilmatay marka ay timaado marxaladaha waaweyn, run ahaantii ma awoodaan inay mar kale sameeyaan soo laabasho weyn,” ayuu raaciyay.
Evra ayaa sidoo kale dhaliilay difaaca kooxda marka uu cadaadis saaran yahay:
“Champions League, waxay u badan tahay inay qaataan kaar cas kale halkii ay guul gaari lahaayeen. Taasi waxay noqotay caado.”
Ugu dambeyn, wuxuu muujiyay kalsoonida uu ku qabo Diego Simeone iyo ciyaartoydiisa:
“Waan ku kalsoonahay Simeone iyo kooxdiisa. Waa dagaalyahanno si fiican u diyaarsan, waxayna diyaar u yihiin inay joojiyaan Barcelona.”
Evra ayaa ku soo gabagabeeyay hadalkiisa isagoo sheegay in Barcelona aysan hadda ka mid ahayn kooxaha ugu sarreeya Yurub:
“Taageerayaasha Barcelona, caga dhigta oo aamusa, sababtoo ah Yurub waa sheeko kale… mana tihidin boqortooyadii hore.”

Evra ayaa sidoo kale dhaliilay difaaca kooxda marka uu cadaadis saaran yahay:
"Champions League, waxay u badan tahay inay qaataan kaar cas kale halkii ay guul gaari lahaayeen. Taasi waxay noqotay caado."
Ugu dambeyn, wuxuu muujiyay kalsoonida uu ku qabo Diego Simeone iyo ciyaartoydiisa:
"Waan ku kalsoonahay Simeone iyo kooxdiisa. Waa dagaalyahanno si fiican u diyaarsan, waxayna diyaar u yihiin inay joojiyaan Barcelona."

"Taageerayaasha Barcelona, caga dhigta oo aamusa, sababtoo ah Yurub waa sheeko kale… mana tihidin boqortooyadii hore."

headline: Carrick Oo Diiday Inuu Ka Hadlo Mustaqbalkiisa — Muxuu Qarinayaa?
body:
Tababaraha ku meel gaarka ah ee Manchester United, Michael Carrick, ayaa ka hadlay mustaqbalkiisa kooxda iyadoo wali la isku khilaafsan yahay inuu si rasmi ah xilka u sii hayn doono iyo in kale.
Carrick ayaa sameeyay natiijooyin wanaagsan tan iyo markii uu qabtay shaqada, isagoo 7 guul ka keenay 10 kulan, taasoo United u soo dhoweysay kaalinta saddexaad isla markaana xoojisay rajadooda Champions League.
Si kastaba, wuxuu sheegay in diiraddiisu aysan ku jirin heshiisyo ama mustaqbalka, balse ay ku jirto horumarinta kooxda:
“Waxaan sii wadeynaa shaqada, horumarinta. Waxaan kaloo jecel nahay inaan halkan sii joogno. Aniga ahaan, tani waa shaqada ugu weyn ee aad qaban karto.”
Wuxuu sidoo kale carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimada midnimada kooxda:
“Waxa ugu muhiimsan waa inaan dhammaanteen hal jiho u soconno. Wax kasta oo dhici doona, way dhici doonaan, laakiin muhiimadu waa inaan ahaanno kuwo wanaagsan oo guulo gaara.”
Carrick ayaa tilmaamay in wax walba la xallin doono marka xilli ciyaareedka dhamaado:
“Arrimaha ka khaldan kooxda waa la xallin doonaa si uun ama si kale. Waxaa fiican in ciyaartoydu ay dareemaan farxad oo ay ku raaxaystaan kubadda.”
Ugu dambeyn, wuxuu cadeeyay in hadafka ugu weyn uu yahay in kooxda ay gaarto meel sare:
“Ma aqbali karo inaan qeybta hoose ku dhammaysanno. Waxaan rabnaa inaan la tartanno kuwa ugu sarreeya. Champions League waa meesha aan rabno inaan joogno, sababtoo ah waxay saameyn ku leedahay wax walba; ciyaartoyda sii joogaya, kuwa imanaya, iyo dhinaca dhaqaalaha.”

headline: Shaxda Ay Manchester United Kaga Hor Tagi Karto Leeds
body:
Lisandro Martinez ayaa la filayaa inuu dib ugu soo laabto safka Manchester United marka ay caawa la ciyaarayaan Leeds United.
Daafaca reer Argentina ayaa seegay shantii kulan ee ugu dambeysay sababo la xiriira dhaawac muruqa ah, wuxuuna xilli ciyaareedkan ciyaaray kaliya 15 kulan dhammaan tartamada, kadib markii ay waqti ku qaadatay inuu ka soo kabsado qalliin jilibka ah.
Si kastaba, Martinez ayaa hadda ku soo laabtay tababarka kadib dadaallo uu sameeyay toddobaadkii hore intii lagu jiray xero tababar oo afar maalmood ah oo ka qabsoontay Ireland, halkaas oo United ay u aadeen si ay u sii joogteeyaan firfircoonidooda.
Weli lama xaqiijin inuu si toos ah ugu soo bilaaban doono kulanka Leeds, balse soo laabashadiisa ayaa ku soo beegmeysa waqti muhiim ah, maadaama Harry Maguire uu ganaax ku maqan yahay kadib casaankii uu qaatay kulankii Bournemouth.
Intii uu maqnaa Martinez, Leny Yoro ayaa la ciyaarayay Maguire, halka Matthijs de Ligt uu wali dhaawac dhabarka hoose ah ku maqnaa tan iyo November.
Haddii Martinez uusan diyaar u noqon inuu ku soo billowdo kulanka, waxaa suuragal ah in da’yarka Ayden Heaven uu la safan doono Yoro difaaca dhexe.
Dhanka kale, Patrick Dorgu ayaa wali ka soo kabanaya dhaawac bowdada ah, waxaana la filayaa inuusan diyaar u noqon kulankan.
Tababaraha ku meel gaarka ah Michael Carrick ayaa sheegay in aysan ku degdegi doonin go’aan ku saabsan Martinez, isagoo yiri:
“Ma doonayno inaan ku degdegno. Waa muhiim in ciyaartoydu si buuxda u diyaar noqdaan. Inkastoo kulanka xiga uu muhiim yahay, waxa ka muhiimsan waa sawirka guud.”
Line-up-ka la saadaaliyay ee Manchester United:
Lammens; Dalot, Yoro, Martinez, Shaw; Casemiro, Mainoo; Amad, Bruno Fernandes, Matheus Cunha; Mbeumo
Shaki: Dalot, Dorgu, Heaton
Dhaawac: De Ligt
Ganaax: Maguire

Garoonka: Old Trafford, Manchester

headline: Gary Neville Oo Farta Ku Fiiqay Koox Weyn Oo Premier League Ka Dhisan Oo Aan U Soo Bixi Doonin Champions League Xilli Ciyaareedka Dambe
body:
Gary Neville ayaa aaminsan in Chelsea ay seegi doonto u soo bixitaanka Champions League, kadib hoos u dhac weyn oo ku yimid qaab ciyaareedkooda.
Isagoo ka hadlayay The Gary Neville Podcast, halyeeyga Manchester United ayaa sheegay in Chelsea ay hadda wajahday dhammaad xilli ciyaareed adag.
“Waxaan u maleynayaa in Chelsea ay la kulmi doonto dhammaad adag, waxaana ii muuqata hadda inay seegi doonaan Champions League,” ayuu yiri Neville.
Wuxuu sidoo kale tilmaamay in dhowr toddobaad ka hor ay xaaladdu ka duwaneyd sidan, markaasoo uu u arkayay Chelsea inay si fudud ugu soo bixi karto saddexda ilaa shanta sare, iyadoo Aston Villa uu hoos u dhac ka jiray waqtigaas.
Laakiin hadda, Neville wuxuu aaminsan yahay in wax walba isbeddeleen sababo la xiriira natiijooyinkii xumaa ee dhawaanahan.
Chelsea ayaa laga adkaaday 5 ka mid ah 6-dii kulan ee ugu dambeeyay tartamada oo dhan, oo ay ku jirto guuldarradii cusleyd ee 3-0 ee Manchester City, taasoo si weyn u saameysay rajadooda ku dhameysashada top 5.
Dhanka kale, guusha Liverpool ee Fulham ayaa sii xoojisay tartanka boosaska Champions League, iyadoo dagaalka top 5 uu hadda noqday mid aad u adag oo furan.

headline: Wayne Rooney Oo Saadaal Waalli Ah Ka Bixiyay Kulanka Weyn Ee City Iyo Arsenal
body:
Halyeeyga Manchester United, Wayne Rooney, ayaa saadaaliyay natiijada kulanka weyn ee u dhexeeya Manchester City iyo Arsenal, isagoo ku tilmaamay mid go’aamin karta horyaalka.
Arsenal ayaa fursad weyn lumisay kadib guuldarradii 2-1 ee Bournemouth, taasoo ka dhigtay inay lumiyaan saddex ka mid ah afartii kulan ee ugu dambeeyay. Dhanka kale, Manchester City ayaa 3-0 ku garaacday Chelsea, taasoo farqiga ka dhigtay 6 dhibcood oo kaliya.
City waxay sidoo kale heysataa hal kulan oo dheeri ah, waxayna gurigooda ku martigelinayaan Arsenal usbuuca soo socda—taasoo ka dhigaysa tartanka mid si buuxda u furan.
Rooney ayaa sheegay in kulankan uu yahay “title decider” (kulanka go’aamin kara horyaalka), wuxuuna yiri:
“Haa, waxaan aaminsanahay inuu yahay kulanka go’aamin doona horyaalka. Haddii City guuleysato, waxaan u arkaa inay qaadi doonaan horyaalka; haddii Arsenal guuleysato, markaas iyaga ayaa qaadi doona.”
Markii la weydiiyay natiijada uu filayo, Rooney wuxuu yiri:
“Waxaan filayaa Manchester City inay ku badiso 1-0. Xitaa haddii ay sidaas dhacdo, weli ma dhammaan doono horyaalka, laakiin waxay siinaysaa City faa’iido yar.”
Rooney wuxuu sidoo kale sheegay in dhibaatada Arsenal ay tahay cadaadiska, maadaama ciyaartoy badan oo ka tirsan kooxda aysan horay ugu guuleysan horyaal, taasoo saameyn ku yeelan karta marxaladdan muhiimka ah ee xilli ciyaareedka.

headline: Michael Owen Oo Shaaciyay Saadaal Cusub Oo Ku Aadan Kooxda Ku Guuleysaneysa Premier League Xilli Ciyaareed Kaan
body:
Michael Owen ayaa soo bandhigay saadaal cusub oo ku saabsan tartanka horyaalka, wuxuuna aaminsan yahay in Arsenal wali haysato fursad fiican inkastoo cadaadis xooggan uu kaga imanayo Manchester City.
Inkasta oo Arsenal laga adkaaday kulankii Bournemouth, halka City ay si xoog leh u garaacday Chelsea, Owen wuxuu sheegay in xaaladdu aysan weli dhammaan. Farqiga dhibcaha ayaa hadda ah 6 dhibcood, iyadoo City hal kulan dheeraad u harsan yahay.
Owen wuxuu tilmaamay in jadwalka kulamada harsan uu door weyn ka ciyaari karo tartanka. Sida uu sheegay, Manchester City waxay leedahay kulamo adag sida safarro ay ku aadayaan Bournemouth iyo Everton, kuwaas oo sababi kara inay dhibco lumiso.
Wuxuu qiray in wax walba isugu aadan yihiin City; form fiican, khibrad, iyo tababare guulo badan leh, laakiin ugu dambeyn wuxuu sheegay in tartanka uu yahay mid aad u adag oo aan la saadaalin karin.
Si kastaba, Owen wuxuu ku soo gabagabeeyay aragtidiisa isagoo yiri Arsenal “way xadi kartaa” horyaalka, taasoo la micno ah inay si ciriiri ah ugu guuleysan karto inkastoo xaaladdu adag tahay.

headline: Pep Guardiola Oo Sharaxay Sababta City Ay Isu-muujiso Dhammaadka Xilli Ciyaareedka
body:
Tababaraha Manchester City, Pep Guardiola, ayaa bixiyay sababta ay kooxdiisu u sameyneyso qaab ciyaareed aad u wanaagsan dhammaadka xilli ciyaareedka.
Xilli ciyaareedka Premier League ayaa dhammaanaya bisha soo socota, iyadoo City ay gashay qaab ciyaareed aad u fiican.
Kooxda Guardiola wali maysan dhalin wax gool ah saddexdii kulan ee ugu dambeeyay tartamada oo dhan.
Waxay 2-0 ku garaaceen Arsenal final-kii Carabao Cup, 4-0 ayay ku xasuuqeen Liverpool wareegga quarter-final-ka FA Cup, sidoo kale waxay 3-0 ku garaaceen Chelsea kulankii Premier League ee Axaddii.
Cityzens waxay hadda 6 dhibcood ka dambeeyaan Arsenal, iyagoo hal kulan dheeri ah haysta.
Isagoo ka hadlayay sababta ay City u fiicnaato dhammaadka xilli ciyaareedka, Guardiola ayaa ka yiri wareysi uu bixiyay kadib kulankii Chelsea:
“City waa sida Qorraxda. Maya maya, ma kaftamayo.
Manchester marna qorrax ma leh. Haddii ay jiri lahayd qorrax bisha November, waxaan noqon lahayn horyaalka Janaayo. Waa qorraxda, runtii. Niyaddeenu aad bay u fiican tahay.”

body:
Gary Neville ayaa saadaaliyay in Arsenal ay wali ku guuleysan doonto horyaalka Premier League xilli ciyaareedkan, inkastoo cadaadis xooggan uu kaga imanayo Manchester City.
Isagoo ka hadlayay Sky Sports, Neville wuxuu sheegay in kooxda Mikel Arteta aysan si sahlan ku qaadi doonin koobka, balse ay “si dirqi ah ku dhammaysan doonaan”.

Neville wuxuu sheegay in Arsenal ay dareemayaan walwal iyo cadaadis maadaama ay u dhow yihiin horyaalkoodii ugu horreeyay muddo dheer kadib.
Wuxuu yiri:
“Arsenal si dirqi ah ayay ku gaari doonaan. Uma maleynayo inay si fudud ku dhammaysan doonaan, xitaa waxaa laga yaabaa inay guuldareystaan usbuuca soo socda, laakiin waxaan u maleynayaa inay weli haystaan faa’iido yar.
Manchester City ma aha kuwo dhammaystiran, Arsenal-na way gaari doonaan, balse waxay ku jiraan xaalad ka adag tii ay ku jireen Sabtidii markii ay bilaabayeen kulankooda Bournemouth.”

headline: Arsenal Oo Go’aan Lama Filaan Ah Ka Soo Saartay Mustaqbalka Martin Odegaard
body:
Warbixin cusub ayaa xaqiijineysa in Martin Odegaard uu weli yahay xubin aad muhiim ugu ah qorshaha Arsenal, inkastoo xilli ciyaareedkiisa ay si weyn u saameeyeen dhaawacyo.
Kabtan-ka kooxda ayaa ciyaaray kaliya 29 kulan tartamada oo dhan, halka tan iyo bishii February uu kasoo muuqday afar kulan oo keliya. Dhibaatada ugu weyn ee heysata ayaa timid kadib dhaawac canqowga ah oo soo gaaray isagoo u ciyaaraya Norway, kaasoo dib u dhigay horumarkiisa.
Isku daygiisii ugu dambeeyay ee soo laabashada ayaa sidoo kale fashilmay, kadib markii laga saaray kulankii Sporting CP, isla markaana uu seegay kulankii Bournemouth.
Si kastaba, gudaha kooxda waxaa si cad loo aaminsan yahay in saameynta Odegaard aysan ku koobnayn garoonka oo kaliya. Wuxuu weli yahay hogaamiye muhiim ah oo saameyn ku leh ciyaartoyda kale iyo jawiga qolka labiska.
Tan iyo markii uu si rasmi ah ugu soo biiray Arsenal 2021, Odegaard wuxuu noqday mid ka mid ah tiirarka ugu muhiimsan ee mashruuca Arteta, isla markaana loo magacaabay kabtanka koixda 2022.
Inkastoo dhaawacyadu carqaladeeyeen xilli ciyaareedkiisa, haddana Arsenal waxay weli u aragtaa inuu yahay ciyaaryahan muhiim u ah mustaqbalka kooxda, gaar ahaan marka loo eego dagaalka ay ugu jiraan horyaalka.

headline: “Nafta Ayaan Kusoo Celinayaa Taageerayaasha Liverpool” :- Rio Ngumoha Oo Ballanqaad U Sameeyay Taageerayaasha Ka Hor Kulanka PSG
body:
Rio Ngumoha ayaa noqday mud kamid ah da’yarta loogu hadalheynta badan yahay Premier league, kadib bandhig cajiib ah oo uu ka sameeyay Anfield, halkaas oo uu ku dhaliyay goolkiisii ugu horreeyay Anfield, kulankii ay 2-0 uga adkaadeen Fulham.
Ciyaaryahanka 17-jirka ah ayaa muujiyay kalsooni weyn, isagoo sheegay inuu dareemayo in wax badan oo ka sii wanaagsan ay ka iman doonaan mustaqbalka. Wuxuu si gaar ah u tilmaamay in horumarkiisa jireed uu door weyn ka ciyaaray waxqabadkiisa, isagoo sheegay inuu si joogto ah gym-ka uga shaqeynayay si uu ula tartamo ciyaartoyda ka waaweyn.
Ngumoha wuxuu aaminsan yahay in isku darka xawaarihiisa iyo xooggiisa cusub ay ka caawinayaan inuu heer kale gaaro. Wuxuu sidoo kale sheegay inuu doonayo inuu mar walba madadaaliyo taageerayaasha oo uu muujiyo xirfadiisa marka uu helo fursad.
Mar uu ka hadlayay goolkiisii Anfield, Rio wuxuu ku tilmaamay mid aad u gaar ah, isagoo sheegay in maqalka taageerayaasha oo magaciisa qaadaya ay ahayd waayo-aragnimo uu waligiis xasuusan doono.
Wuxuu sidoo kale amaanay Mohamed Salah iyo Andy Robertson, kuwaas oo ka caawiyay inuu la qabsado kooxda, gaar ahaan bilowgii xilli ciyaareedka.
Hadda, Ngumoha wuxuu isha ku hayaa fursad uu ku soo bilaaban karo kulanka Champions League ee PSG, isagoo kalsooni ku qaba in Liverpool ay soo laaban karto inkastoo ay 2-0 ku soo jabeen lugtii hore.

headline: Chelsea Oo Go’aan Ka Soo Saartay Mustaqbalka Liam Rosenior Kadib Guuldarradii City
body:
Fabrizio Romano ayaa xaqiijiyay in Chelsea aysan qorsheyneyn inay hadda ceyriso tababare Liam Rosenior, inkastoo ay Chelsea ku fashilmatay kulankii Manchester City.
Farriinta ka timid maamulka club-ka waa mid cad: wali waxay kalsooni ku qabaan Rosenior. Waxay tixgelinayaan in uu yimid bishii January isla markaana uusan helin waqti pre-season ah si uu u dhiso kooxdiisa.
Si kastaba, xaaladda kooxda ma fiicna; Chelsea waxay guuldarreysatay 5 ka mid ah 6-dii kulan ee ugu dambeeyay, inkastoo ay hal guul oo weyn ka gaareen Port Vale, FA Cup-kii. Taasi waxay sare u qaaday walaaca taageerayaasha, balse maamulka wali ma lumin kalsoonida.
Romano wuxuu sidoo kale sheegay in waxa muhiimka ah ay noqon doonto sida ay Chelsea u dhammeeysato xilli ciyaareedka. Taas ayaa go’aamin karta mustaqbalka Rosenior.
Dhanka kale, Rosenior laftiisa wuxuu sheegay inuu horey uga qeyb qaadanayo qorshaha suuqa kala iibsiga xagaaga, taasoo muujineysa in maamulka ay u arkaan inuu qeyb ka yahay mustaqbalka kooxda; ugu yaraan waqtigan.

headline: Jeremie Frimpong Oo Caddeeyay Cidda Fiican Xabi Alonso Iyo Arne Slot
body:
Jeremie Frimpong ayaa si weyn u amaanay Xabi Alonso, isagoo sheegay in tababarihii hore uu ka caawiyay inuu gaaro heerkiisa ugu fiican intii ay wada joogeen Bayer Leverkusen.
Frimpong wuxuu sheegay in Alonso uu si degdeg ah u fahmay awooddiisa, gaar ahaan xawaaraha iyo awoodda uu kaga gudbo daafacyada. Wuxuu tilmaamay in marka uu yimid kooxda, Alonso inuu si cad u ogaa sida loo isticmaalo si uu kooxda uga faa’iideeyo.
“Alonso wuxuu ahaa qof aad ii fahansan oo og meelaha aan ku fiicanahay, wuxuuna uga faa’iideeyay kooxdiisa”
Sidoo kale, Frimpong wuxuu xusay in tababarkii uu ka helay Alonso uu si weyn u horumariyay ciyaartiisa, gaar ahaan dhinacyada muhiimka ah sida goorta uu ordayo si uusan offside u galin iyo sida uu u sameeyo go’aanno sax ah marka uu joogo meelaha ugu halista badan ee weerarka.
Hadalka Frimpong wuxuu muujinayaa sida Alonso u yahay tababare si fiican u horumariya ciyaartoyda, taasoo sii xoojineysa sumcaddiisa, xilli lagu xirayo mustaqbalka kooxo waaweyn sida Liverpool.

headline: Muxuu Liam Rosenior Ka Yiri Guuldarradii Xanuunka Badneyd Ee Chelsea Ka Soo Gaartay Man City?
body:
Liam Rosenior ayaa si daacad ah u qirtay sababta Chelsea looga adkaaday kulankii ay la ciyaareen Manchester City.
Tababaraha Chelsea wuxuu sheegay in dhibaatada ugu weyn timid qeybtii labaad, halkaas oo kooxdiisu si buuxda hoos ugu dhacday. Wuxuu tilmaamay in qeybtii hore ay ahaayeen kuwo si fiican u abaabulan oo ay adag tahay in la jebiyo, balse wax walba ay is beddeleen kadib nasashada.
Rosenior wuxuu sidoo kale xusay dhibaato soo noqnoqotay oo kooxdiisa heysata:
– Marka hal gool laga xiro, si degdeg ah ayaa tu kale looga dhaliyaa.
Arrintan ayuu ku tilmaamay mid aan la aqbali karin haddii ay rabaan inay la tartamaan kooxaha waaweyn. Wuxuu sidoo kale ka hadlay fursad ay heleen (gool u dhow), balse nasiib darro aysan ka faa’iideysan.
Guuldarradan waxay ka dhigan tahay in Chelsea ay wali ku jirto kaalinta lixaad, taasoo cadaadis saaraysa rajadooda inay gaaraan tartamada Yurub.
Rosenior wuxuu cadeeyay in dhibaatadu aysan qabsan bilowgii ciyaarta, balse ay burbureen qeybtii labaad, taas oo ay Manchester City si buuxda uga faa’iideysatay.

headline: Arsenal Mise Man City? Supercomputer Oo Saadaaliyay Kooxda Ku Guulaysan Doonta Premier League
body:
Saadaasha “supercomputer”-ka ayaa si lama filaan ah u beddeshay jihada tartanka Premier League, iyadoo hadda la rumeysan yahay in Manchester City ay si ciriiri ah u dafi doonto horyaalka. Waxaa la sheegay inay Arsenal kaga qaadi doonto hal dhibic oo keliya.
Arsenal waxay muddo dheer heysay hoggaanka, xitaa waxay haysteen 9 dhibcood oo farqi ah, laakiin guuldarradii lama filaanka ahayd ee Bournemouth ayaa si weyn u beddeshay xaaladda. Halkii ay ka gaari lahaayeen 12 dhibcood oo farqi ah, waxay fureen albaab ay City ku soo laaban karto.
Saadaashu waxay tilmaamaysaa in dhibaatada ugu weyn ee Arsenal aysan noqon doonin in laga adkaado, balse ay noqon doonto barbarooyin badan. Waxaa la filayaa inay barbaro galaan dhowr kulan oo muhiim ah, taasoo ka dhigan inay luminayaan dhibco qaali ah xilli ciyaareedka dhammaadkiisa.
Dhanka kale, Manchester City ayaa la saadaaliyay inay si joogto ah u guuleysan doonto inta badan kulamada harsan, taasoo siinaysa fursad ay kaga gudbaan Arsenal daqiiqadaha ugu dambeeya.
Haddii tani dhacdo, waxay noqon doontaa guul kale oo weyn oo uu gaaro Pep Guardiola, iyo horyaal kale oo u kordha Manchester City sanadihii ugu dambeeyay.
Sidoo kale, saadaasha waxay muujineysaa in Manchester United ay ku dhammaysan karto kaalinta saddexaad, halka Aston Villa ay qaadan karto booska afaraad ee Champions League.
Inkasta oo Arsenal wali hoggaanka hayso, saadaasha cusub waxay muujineysaa in qalad yar ama barbarooyin ay ku filnaan karto inay lumiyaan horyaalka—hal dhibic oo keliya ayaana go’aamin karta cidda ku guuleysaneysa.

headline: Miyuu Kylian Mbappe Seegi Doonaa Kulanka Lugta Labaad Ee Bayern?
body:
Real Madrid ayaa heshay war wanaagsan oo ku saabsan Kylian Mbappe, waxaana la xaqiijiyay inuusan qabin dhaawac halis ah, inkastoo uu ka maqnaa qeyb ka mid ah tababarkii ugu dambeeyay.
Maqnaanshihiisa ayaa markii hore dhalisay walaac, gaar ahaan iyadoo ay soo socoto kulan aad u weyn oo UEFA Champions League ah oo ay la ciyaarayaan Bayern Munich. Laakiin wararku waxay xaqiijinayaan in arrintu ahayd taxaddar kaliya, ee aysan jirin wax dhaawac culus ah.
Mbappe wuxuu dareemay xanuun yar kadib kulankii Girona, wuxuuna sidoo kale qabay dhaawac yar oo dhanka sunniyaha isha. Sidaas darteed, tababarayaasha ayaa go’aansaday inay yareeyaan culayska saaran si looga hortago halis kasta.
Ilo ku dhow kooxda ayaa sheegaya in xiddiga Faransiiska uu diyaar u noqon doono safarka Munich, taasoo si weyn u xoojinaysa rajada Real Madrid ee inay soo laabtaan oo ay u gudbaan wareegga xiga.
Soo laabashada Mbappe waxay noqon doontaa dhiirigelin weyn, maadaama uu yahay ciyaaryahanka ugu saameynta badan weerarka kooxda.

headline: Bernardo Silva Oo Taariikh Sameeyay Kadib Kulankii Chelsea
body:
Bernardo Silva ayaa mar kale galay buuga rikoodhada isagoo noqday ciyaaryahanka kaliya ee Portuguèsse ah ee saftay kulamada ugu badan taariikhda Premier League.
Kabtanka Manchester City ayaa gaaray 297 kulan, isagoo dhaafay rikoodhkii uu hastyay Luis Boa Morte. Waxa uu sidoo kale ka sarre maray xiddigo waaweyn sida Cristiano Ronaldo iyo Bruno Fernandes.
Tan iyo markii uu yimid England sanadkii 2017, Silva wuxuu noqday mid ka mid ah ciyaartoyda ugu muhiimsan ee Premier League, gaar ahaan xilligii Pep Guardiola. Wuxuu caan ku yahay fahamka ciyaarta, dadaalka joogtada ah iyo xirfadiisa sare.
Rikoodhkan ma aha oo kaliya tirada kulamada, balse wuxuu ka tarjumayaa heer joogto ah oo sare. Silva wuxuu la qaaday Manchester City 19 koob oo waaweyn, oo ay ku jiraan 6 horyaal oo Premier League ah iyo Champions League.
Guushan cusub waxay sii adkeyneysaa magaca Bernardo Silva, iyadoo ay ka dhigan tahay inuu yahay khadka dhexe ee ugu saameynta badan jiilka casriga ah.

headline: Manchester City Oo Si Layaqaan U Garaacday Chelsea, Xaalkana Ku Sii Xumeysay Arsenal
body:
Manchester City ayaa si buuxda u muujisay awooddeeda kadib markii ay 3-0 ugu awood sheegatay Chelsea kulan ka dhacay Stamford Bridge.
Kadib qeyb hore oo dheellitiran, City ayaa boorka iska jaftay qeybtii labaad. Nico O’Reilly ayaa furay goolasha daqiiqadii 51aad, ka hor inta uusan Marc Guehi si degdeg ah u laba jibaarin hoggaanka lix daqiiqo kadib. Jeremy Doku ayaa ciyaarta si rasmi ah u soo xiray daqiiqadii 68aad, isagoo xaqiijiyay guul nadiif ah.
Natiijadan waxay si weyn u beddeshay xaaladda tartanka horyaalka. City waxay kor ugu kacday 64 dhibcood, iyadoo si dhow u daba joogta Arsenal, halka Chelsea ay ku hartay kaalinta lixaad iyadoo ku hakatay 48 dhibcood.
Guushan muhiimka ah waxay sidoo kale muujisay fariintii Pep Guardiola ee ahayd “waa inaan wada badinnaa inta kulan ee hartay” iyadoo City hadda si buuxda ugu jirto dagaalka horyaalka, isla markaana cadaadis weyn saaraysa Arsenal.

headline: Arsenal Oo Shuruud Adag Ku Xirtay Mustaqbalka Arteta
body:
Wararka ayaa sheegaya in Arsenal ay shuruud adag ku xirtay mustaqbalka Mikel Arteta; waa inuu keenaa koob weyn xilli ciyaareedkan, haddii kale wuxuu halis ugu jiraa in la ceyriyo.
Sida lagu sheegay warbixinta, Arteta waxaa laga yaabaa in la eryo haddii Arsenal ku guuldareysato inay ku guuleysato mid ka mid ah labada tartan ee ugu waaweyn: Premier League ama UEFA Champions League.

– Guuldarradii final-ka Carabao Cup ee ay ka qaaday Manchester City

Arteta, oo haatan galay xilli ciyaareedkiisii lixaad, wuxuu ilaa hadda la qaaday Gunners hal koob oo kaliya (FA Cup), taasoo ka dhigeysa in maamulka iyo taageerayaashu ay sugaan guul weyn.
Haddii Arsenal ay mar kale ku dhammaysato xilli ciyaareedka koob la’aan, waxaa si dhab ah suurtagal u noqon karta in Arteta xilka laga qaado.

headline: Pep Guardiola: “Guusha Kulanka Chelsea Ayaa Iga Xigta Premier League”
body:
Pep Guardiola ayaa si adag u sheegay in rajada Manchester City ee horyaalka Premier League ay si buuxda ugu xiran tahay kulanka ay la ciyaarayaan Chelsea.
Wuxuu sheegay in haddii ay guuldarreystaan kulanka Stamford Bridge, tartanku uu si weyn u dhammaan karo, isagoo si toos ah u yiri; “haddii aanan badin, waxaa laga yaabaa in aanan xitaa u baahnayn inaan ka hadalno kulanka Arsenal, sababtoo ah wax walba way soo af-jarmayaan.”
Hadalkiisa wuxuu muujinayaa cadaadis weyn oo saaran City, maadaama ay hadda si dhow ula tartamayaan Arsenal oo weli hoggaanka haysa. Inkastoo Arsenal ay dhibco lumisay, haddana City weli waa inay si joogto ah u guuleysataa si ay ugu sii noolaato rajadeeda.
Guardiola wuxuu sidoo kale caddeeyay in ciyaartoyda, isaga iyo qof walba ay si buuxda uga warqabaan culayska kulankaas. Tani waxay ka dhigan tahay in City ay si weyn u weerari doonto Chelsea, maadaama aysan haysan fursad ay ku lumiyaan dhibco.
Ugu dambeyntii, kulanka Chelsea wuxuu noqday mid go’aamin kara jihada tartanka horyaalka, halka kulanka xiga ee City ay la ciyaari doonto Arsenal uu noqon karo mid si buuxda u qeexa natiijada xilli ciyaareedka.

headline: Bruno Fernandes Oo Hal Shuruud Ku Xiray Inuu Sii Joogo Manchester United
body:
Bruno Fernandes ayaa si cad u sheegay in mustaqbalkiisa Manchester United uu ku xiran yahay hal shay; in kooxda ay si dhab ah ugu tartanto koobabka waaweyn.
Kabtanka United wuxuu muujiyay in ciyaartoy kasta oo yimaada Old Trafford uu leeyahay hal himilo:
“Qof walba oo yimaada Man United wuxuu rabaa inuu ku guuleysto koob kasta. Qofna ma yimaado isagoo leh ‘waxaan u dagaallami doonaa hal ama labo koob 6 sano gudahood.’”
Si kastaba, Fernandes wuxuu cadeeyay in waxa ugu muhiimsan aysan ahayn kaliya koob qaadis, balse ay tahay tartanka laftiisa:
“Waxaan rabaa oo kaliya inaan tartamo. Haddii aan tartamo, waxaan u dhowaanayaa inaan guuleysto. Haddii aanan tartamin, fursad ma jirto.”
Hadalladiisa waxay fariin cad u dirayaan maamulka Manchester United; In kooxda ay tahay inay noqoto mid si joogto ah ugu tartanta Premier League iyo UEFA Champions League haddii ay rabaan inay sii haystaan ciyaartoyda ugu muhiimsan.
Fernandes ma dalbanayo mucjiso; wuxuu dalbanayaa hal shay oo aasaasi ah: Manchester United waa inay noqotaa koox tartanta, haddii kale mustaqbalkiisa ayaa su’aal gali kara.

headline: Alan Shearer Oo Digniin Culus U Diray Arsenal Kadib Guuldarradii Bournemouth
body:
Halyeyga Newcastle United, Alan Shearer, ayaa digniin culus u diray Arsenal kadib guuldarradii lama filaanka ahayd ee 2-1 ee ka soo gaartay Bournemouth.
Shearer ayaa si adag u dhaliilay kooxda uu hogaamiyo Mikel Arteta, isagoo sheegay in ay halis ugu jiraan inay lumiyaan horyaalka Premier League:
“Way lumin karaan horyaalka haddii ay sidan u ciyaaraan. Waxay ahaayeen kuwo liita dhinac kasta, tamar ma jirin, waxayna u muuqdeen kuwo aad u walwalsan.”
Inkasta oo Arsenal wali hoggaanka ku hayso 9 dhibcood, Shearer wuxuu xusay in cadaadis weyn uu hadda jiro, gaar ahaan iyadoo Manchester City ay haystaan kulamo dheeri ah.

headline: Lamine Yamal Oo Mar Kale Sameeyay Taariikh Kadib Kulankii Espanyol
body:

Guushan cusub ayaa sii xoojineysa sumcaddiisa, iyadoo uu noqday mid ka mid ah ciyaartoyda ugu muhiimsan Barcelona, isla markaana door weyn ku leh dadaalka kooxda ee ku aaddan hanashada La Liga.

headline: Bruno Fernandes Oo Shaaciyay Sababta Aysan United Ugu Tartami Karin Horyaalka Iyo waxyaabaha Hor Taagan
body:
Bruno Fernandes ayaa si daacad ah u sheegay in dhibaatada ugu weyn ee Manchester United ay tahay joogteyn la’aanta tan iyo markii uu ku biiray kooxda.
Kabtanka United wuxuu qirtay in inkastoo ay mararka qaar muujiyaan qaab ciyaareed wanaagsan, haddana aysan awoodin inay sidaas ku sii wadaan xilli ciyaareedka dhan. Wuxuu xusay in horyaalka Premier League uu u baahan yahay feejignaan joogto ah, maadaama dhibic kasta iyo faahfaahin kasta ay go’aan ka gaarto natiijada ugu dambeysa.
Fernandes ayaa sidoo kale tilmaamay in isbeddellada badan ee maamulka, gaar ahaan tababarayaasha, ay carqaladeeyeen horumarka kooxda. Sida uu sheegay, mar kasta oo ay bilaabaan inay wax dhisaan, waxaa yimaada isbeddel cusub oo dib u dhigaya geeddi-socodkaas.
Wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay in farqiga u dhexeeya kooxaha caadiga ah iyo kuwa horyaalka ku guuleysta uu yahay joogteyn. Inkastoo United ay mararka qaar u muuqato mid tartan geli karta, haddana taas kaliya kuma filna haddii aan la sii wadin heerkaas muddo dheer.
Ugu dambeyn, Fernandes wuxuu cadeeyay in kooxda ay weli ka fog tahay heerka ay rabaan, isla markaana ay u baahan yihiin inay hagaajiyaan joogteynta haddii ay doonayaan inay si dhab ah ugu tartamaan horyaalka.

headline: Liam Rosenior Oo Hanjabaad Hawada U Mariyay Man City Ka Hor Kulanka Caawa
body:
Tababaraha Chelsea, Liam Rosenior, ayaa si cad u sheegay in kooxdiisu dhiiga shubi doonto, inkastoo ay yihiin kuwa laga filayo inay guuldarreystaan marka ay la kulmaan Manchester City.
Rosenior wuxuu diiradda saaray muhiimadda 3-da dhibcood ee kulankan, isagoo yiri:
“Waxay noqon lahayd 3 dhibcood oo nagu dhoweynaysa hadafkeena; kaas oo hadda ah inaan u soo baxno UEFA Champions League.”
Wuxuu sidoo kale cadeeyay in Premier League kulan kasta uu adag yahay, iyadoon loo eegin haddii aad la ciyaarayso kooxaha hoose, kuwa dhexe ama kuwa horyaalka u tartamaya.
Inkasta oo Chelsea wajaheyso caqabado; gaar ahaan maqnaanshaha ciyaartoy muhiim ah, Rosenior wuxuu muujiyay kalsooni iyo dhiirigelin:
Chelsea waxay wali u dagaallameysaa boos Champions League
Manchester City waxay u baahan tahay guul si ay cadaadis ku saarto Arsenal
Kulankani wuxuu saameyn weyn ku yeelan karaa tartanka horyaalka
Kadib guuldarradii Arsenal kasoo gaartay Bournemouth, City waxay haysataa fursad dahabi ah oo ay ugu soo dhowaato hogaanka haddii ay garaacdo Chelsea.
Chelsea ma ahan koox is dhiibeysa, waxay u ciyaarayaan sharaf, Champions League, iyo inay saameeyaan tartanka horyaalka. Kulankani wuxuu noqon karaa mid si weyn u beddela jihada xilli ciyaareedka.

headline: Shaxda Ay Chelsea Kaga Hor Tagi Karto Manchester City
body:
Chelsea ayaa mar kale soo geleysa iyadoo aanan wadan Enzo Fernandez kulanka adag ee ay la ciyaarayaan Manchester City ee Premier League.
Xiddiga reer Argentina ayaa weli loo heystaa ganaax labo kulan ah, inkastoo uu raalli-gelin ka bixiyay hadallo uu ka sheegay mustaqbalkiisa. Tani waxay dhaawac ku tahay qorshaha tababare Liam Rosenior, maadaama Fernandez uu muhiim u yahay khadka dhexe.
Dhanka kale, Marc Cucurella ayaa ka badbaaday ganaax, waxaana la filayaa inuu kusoo laabto safka hore kadib markii kursiga keydka uu ka soo galay kulankii FA Cup ee Port Vale.
Chelsea ayaa soo afjartay guuldarrooyin xiriir ah kadib markii ay gaartay semi-finalka FA Cup, halkaas oo ay kula ciyaari doonaan Leeds United garoonka Wembley Stadium.
Si kastaba, kulanka Manchester City waa mid aad muhiim u ah, maadaama natiijo xun ay sii fogeyn karto rajadooda ka qaybgalka Champions League, gaar ahaan kadib guushii Liverpool.
Shaxda la filayo (4-2-3-1):
Sanchez; Gusto, Fofana, Tosin, Cucurella; Lavia, Moises Caicedo; Neto, Palmer, Garnacho, Joao Pedro
Kulankan wuxuu noqon karaa mid go’aan ka gaara mustaqbalka Chelsea ee xilli ciyaareedkan.

headline: Owen Hargreaves Oo Daaha Ka Rogay Dhibaatada Ugu Weyn Ee Arsenal Heysata Kadib Guuldarradii Bournemouth
body:
Ciyaaryahankii hore ee Bayern Munich iyo Manchester United, Owen Hargreaves, ayaa si adag u dhaliilay Arsenal kadib guuldarradii 2-1 ee ka soo gaartay Bournemouth.
Hargreaves ayaa sheegay in dhibaatada ugu weyn ee Arsenal ay tahay kalsooni la’aan iyo qaab ciyaareed liita, isagoo xusay in kaliya laba ciyaaryahan ay si fiican u ciyaareen:
Declan Rice iyo Gabriel Magalhaes.
“Arsenal ma aysan ciyaarin iyagoo kalsooni leh,” ayuu yiri. “Bilowgii taageerayaashu aad bay u firfircoonaayeen, laakiin dhamaadka way niyad jabeen.”
Wuxuu sidoo kale amaanay Bournemouth:
“Waxay ahaayeen kuwo cajiib ah, si joogto ah ayey u cadaadiyeen Arsenal.”
Hargreaves ayaa tilmaamay in Arsenal ay dhibaato weyn kala kulantay haynta kubadda, xitaa iyagoo marar badan kubadda dib ugu celinayay goolhayaha David Raya.
Intaa waxaa dheer, wuxuu sheegay in tani aysan ahayn hal kulan oo kaliya:
“Waxaa laga awood batay saddex ka mid ah afartii kulan ee ugu dambeysay.”
Inkasta oo Mikel Arteta uu wali hoggaaminayo horyaalka Premier League, haddana dhaliilaha ayaa sii kordhaya, gaar ahaan marka loo eego qaab ciyaareedka kooxda iyo awood la’aanta abuurista fursado cadcad.
Ugu dambeyn, Hargreaves wuxuu si cad u sheegay:
“Waxaa ka maqneyd geesinimo, kalsooni iyo go’aan qaadasho.”

headline: Pep Guardiola: Man City Kuma Guuleysaneyso Premier League, Haddii…..
body:
Tababaraha Manchester City, Pep Guardiola, ayaa sheegay in kooxdiisu aysan wax fursad ah u lahayn hanashada Premier League haddii aysan guulaysan dhammaan kulamada ka haray xilli ciyaareedka.
Pep ayaa yiri:
“Xaaladda aan ku jirno Premier League, waa inaan wada badinaa kulamada. Haddii kale fursad ma heli doono ilaa dhammaadka.”
Wuxuu qirtay in dhibaatada ugu weyn ay tahay joogteyn la’aan:
“Ma aanan ahayn kuwo joogto ah xilli ciyaareedkan, waxaan luminay dhibco aan heli karaynay. Taasi waa sababta aan hadda u joogno meel aanan wax kale samayn karin.”
Guardiola ayaa caddeeyay in hadafku yahay hal mid oo kaliya:
“Waa inaan badinaa kulamadeenna, hadda kulamo yar ayaa haray, sidaas darteed waa inaan mid kasta ku guuleysanaa.”
Manchester City ayaa wali haysata 8 kulan, labo ka badan hoggaamiyeyaasha Arsenal, kuwaas oo 9 dhibcood horreeya.
Si kastaba, iyadoo City ay leedahay kulan dheeri ah iyo weliba kulan toos ah oo ay la ciyaari doonaan Arsenal, tartanka horyaalka wali waa furan yahay, laakiin Pep wuxuu ogyahay in qalad dambe uusan jirin.

headline: Rio Ngumoha Oo Jebiyay Rikoodh Aad U Miisaan Badan Kadib Goolkiisii Anfield
body:
Xiddiga da’da yar ee Liverpool, Rio Ngumoha, ayaa taariikh cusub, kadib markii uu dhaliyay goolkiisii ugu horreeyay ee garoonka Anfield kulankii Premier League ee ay la ciyaareen Fulham.
Ngumoha, oo jira 17 sano iyo 225 maalmood, ayaa noqday ciyaaryahankii ugu da’da yaraa ee Liverpool gool u dhaliya Anfield kulan Premier League ah.
Wuxuu jabiyay rikoor uu hore u hayay Raheem Sterling, kaasoo goolkiisii ugu horreeyay ee Anfield dhaliyay isagoo jira 17 sano iyo 317 maalmood sanadkii 2012.
Liiska Saddexda ciyaaryahan ee ugu da’da yar ee Anfield gool ka dhaliya, waxaa soo xiraya Jamie Carragher, kaasoo gool dhaliyay isagoo jira 18 sano iyo 356 maalmood sanadkii 1997.
Guushan shaqsiga ah ee Ngumoha ayaa muujineysa hibadiisa weyn, waxayna noqon kartaa bilowga mustaqbal ifaya oo uu ku yeesho Liverpool.

headline: Victor Gyokeres Oo Mar-marsiyo La Yaab Leh U Sameeyay Guuldaradii Bournemouth
body:
Weeraryahanka Arsenal, Viktor Gyokeres, ayaa ka hadlay guuldarradii 2-1 ee ka soo gaartay Bournemouth kulankii Premier League.
Inkasta oo uu gool dhaliyay, Gyökeres ma uusan ka badbaadin karin kooxdiisa guuldarro, waxaana Bournemouth u kala dhaliyay goolasha Eli Junior Kroupi iyo Alex Scott.
Mar uu la hadlay BBC Sport kadib ciyaarta, Gyökeres ayaa sheegay in xaaladda garoonka ay saameyn ku yeelatay ciyaarta:
“Waxaan helnay fursado dhamaadka ciyaarta. Garoonku wuxuu ahaa mid qallalan, run ahaantii, taasna waxba nama caawin.”
Si kastaba, wuxuu qirtay in khaladku uu guud ahaan ka yimid kooxda:
“Laakiin sidaan iri, dhammaanteen waa inaan si ka fiican u ciyaarnaa oo aan ka faa’iideysannaa fursadaha.”
Hadda Arsenal waxay diiradda saaraysaa tartanka UEFA Champions League, iyagoo wajihi doona Sporting CP lugta labaad ee wareegga siddeed dhammaadka, kulanka ka dhici doona Emirates Stadium.

headline: Joao Neves Oo Magacaabay Xiddiga Ugu Fiican Horyaalka Sacuudiga; Ma Ahan Ronaldo
body:
Ciyaaryahanka khadka dhexe ee Paris Saint-Germain, Joao Neves, ayaa si lama filaan ah isaga indha tiray Cristiano Ronaldo markii la weydiiyay ciyaaryahanka ugu fiican Saudi Pro League.
Inkastoo Neves uu la ciyaaray Ronaldo 14 kulan oo xulka Portugal ah, haddana ma uusan dooran xiddiga Al-Nassr.
Bedelkeeda, Neves ayaa doortay Joao Felix, isagoo ku tilmaamay ciyaaryahan “saaxirka horyaalkaas” waqtigan.
“Saudi League? Aniga ahaan hadda, ciyaaryahanka saaxirka ah waa João Félix,” ayuu yiri Neves.
Doorashadan ayaa la yaab ku noqotay taageerayaal badan, maadaama Ronaldo uu wali si joogto ah u soo bandhigayo qaab ciyaareed heer sare ah tan iyo markii uu ku biiray Al-Nassr, isagoo kamid ah xiddigaha ugu magaca weyn horyaalka.

headline: Liverpool Oo Garaacday Fulham, Iyadoo Ngumoha Uu Xiray Gool Qurux Badan
body:
Kooxda Liverpool ayaa gaartay guul muhiim ah kadib markii ay 2-0 ku garaacday Fulham kulankii wareegga 32-aad ee Premier League ee ka dhacay Anfield.
Liverpool ayaa hoggaanka qabatay daqiiqaddii 36-aad, markii da’yarka Rio Ngumoha uu gool qurux badan dhaliyay kadib caawin uu ka helay Florian Wirtz.
Wax yar kadib, daqiiqaddii 41-aad, Mohamed Salah ayaa dhaliyay goolka labaad, kadib weerar si fiican loo dhisay oo ay ka qayb qaateen Ngumoha iyo Cody Gakpo.
Guushan ayaa kor u qaaday dhibcaha Liverpool ilaa 52, iyagoo galay kaalinta 5-aad ee kala sarreynta horyaalka. Dhanka kale, Fulham ayaa ku hakatay 44 dhibcood, iyagoo ku jira kaalinta 11-aad.
Natiijadan waxay Liverpool siinaysaa dhiirrigelin cusub, iyagoo isku dayaya inay soo gaaraan boosaska u qalma tartamada Yurub.

headline: Casemiro Oo Heshiis Labo Sano Ah Ka Helay Koox Weyn
body:
Ciyaaryahanka khadka dhexe ee Manchester United, Casemiro, ayaa helay dalab rasmi ah oo laba sano ah si uu ugu biiro kooxda Inter Miami.
Sida uu sheegay wariyaha suuqa kala iibsiga Nicolo Schira, kooxda ka ciyaarta Major League Soccer ayaa wadahadallo kula jirta xiddiga reer Brazil si ay u dhammeystiraan heshiis suurtagal ah xagaagan.
Inter Miami waxay dooneysaa inay Casemiro ku soo qaadato si xor ah laga bilaabo bisha July, kadib markii uu xaqiijiyay inuu ka tagayo Old Trafford dhammaadka xilli ciyaareedka.
Dalabka ay u bandhigeen ayaa ah qandaraas soconaya ilaa December 2028, balse ciyaaryahanka 34 jirka ah wali ma gaarin go’aan kama dambeys ah.
Xiddigii hore ee Real Madrid ayaa sidoo kale lala xiriirinayaa kooxo ka ciyaara Sacuudi Carabiya, taasoo ka dhigeysa mustaqbalkiisa mid wali furan.

headline: Michael Carrick Oo Ka Hadlay Fursadaha Uu Ku Noqon Karo Tababaraha Joogtada Ah Ee United
body:
Tababaraha ku-meelgaarka ah ee Manchester United, Michael Carrick, ayaa xaqiijiyay inuu door muhiim ah ku leeyahay qorshaha kooxda ee xilli ciyaareedka soo socda iyo suuqa kala iibsiga.
Carrick ayaa sheegay inuu qayb ka yahay go’aan qaadashada, maadaama uu haatan hayo xilka ku-meelgaarka ah ee United:
“Doorka aan joogo hadda, waxaa jira go’aamo la qaadanayo. Waxaan sheegay markii aan imid; qeyb ayaan ka ahay arrintaas, mustaqbalkana si kasta ha noqotee, waan ka mid ahay,” ayuu yiri.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray inuu si joogto ah uga shaqeynayo horumarinta kooxda:
“Waxaan isku dayayaa inaan wax hagaajiyo mar walba. Waxaa jira wada-hadallo dhinacyo kala duwan ah oo aan si buuxda uga qayb qaaanayo.”
Inkasta oo hadalladiisu muujinayaan saameynta uu ku leeyahay gudaha kooxda, haddana wali lama xaqiijin karo inuu si rasmi ah u noqonayo tababaraha joogtada ah ilaa dhammaadka xilli ciyaareedka.
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Carrick ayaa si tartiib tartiib ah isugu muujinaya musharax dhab ah oo qaban kara shaqada United ee mustaqbalka.

headline: Mikel Arteta Oo Si Aan Gabasho Lahayn Farta Ugu Fiiqay Cidda Iska Leh Mas’uuliyadda Guuldarradii Kooxdiisa Ka Soo Gaartay Bournemouth
body:
Tababaraha Arsenal, Mikel Arteta, ayaa si cad u qirtay in kooxdiisu aysan si fiican u ciyaarin kadib guuldarradii 2-1 ee ka soo gaartay Bournemouth kulankii Premier League.
Arteta ayaa sheegay in kooxdiisu ay ahayd “mid aan wax ku ool ahayn” isla markaana ay sameeyeen “waxyaabo yaab leh” intii uu socday kulanka.
“Waa niyad jab. Waa jug weyn oo wajiga naga haleeshay, hadda waxa muhiimka ah waa sida aan uga falcelinno,” ayuu yiri Arteta.
Wuxuu sidoo kale amaanay Bournemouth, isagoo tilmaamay sababta ay u ahaayeen koox adag:
“Waa koox aan laga badin 11 kulan, wax badan ayay soo saxeen”
Arteta ayaa si gaar ah u dhaliilay difaaca kooxdiisa, isagoo sheegay:
“Fursaddii ugu horreysay ee sanduuqeenna la soo galay, waxay noqotay gool – waxaa jiray leexasho iyo difaac xumo. Taasi waa wax aan u baahanahay inaan hagaajino.”
Inkasta oo Arsenal ay si weyn u maamulayeen qeybtii labaad, Arteta wuxuu qirtay in kooxdiisa ay lumisay nidaamka:
“Qeybta labaad waxaad filaysaa ciyaar ka duwan, laakiin maanta waxaan sameynay waxyaabo badan oo aan caadi ahayn.”
Ugu dambeyn, tababaraha ayaa xusay in tani ay ka mid tahay kubadda cagta:
“Waxaan ahaan jirnay kuwo joogto ah. Tani way dhici kartaa, waa kubad.”

headline: Bournemouth Oo Garaacday Arsenal, Hadiyad Qaali Ahna U Dirtay Manchester City
body:
Arsenal ayaa la kulantay guuldarro lama filaan ah kadib markii Bournemouth ay ku garaacday Emirates kulankii wareegga 32-aad ee Premier League.
Bournemouth ayaa si degdeg ah hoggaanka u qabatay daqiiqaddii 17-aad, markii Eli Junior Kroupi uu gool u dhaliyay kooxda martida ahayd. Arsenal ayaa dib ugu soo laabatay ciyaarta daqiiqaddii 35-aad, kadib markii Viktor Gyokeres uu dhaliyay gool rigoore ah.
Si kastaba, goolka guusha ee Bournemouth ayaa yimid daqiiqaddii 74-aad, kadib weerar degdeg ah oo uu bilaabay Evanilson, kaasoo caawiye u noqday Alex Scott oo si qurux badan kubadda u dhex dhigay shabaqa.
Natiijadan ayaa ka dhigan in Arsenal ay ku hakatay 70 dhibcood, iyadoo si ku-meel-gaar ah 9 dhibcood uga horeysa Manchester City, kuwaas oo laba kulan oo baaqi ah heysta. Dhanka kale, Bournemouth ayaa kor ugu kacday 45 dhibcood, iyagoo galay kaalinta 9-aad.
Kulanka xiga ee muhiimka ah ayaa noqon doona midka u dhexeeya Chelsea iyo Manchester City, kaas oo si weyn u saameyn kara tartanka horyaalka.

headline: Michael Carrick Oo Dalbaday In Man United Ay Qasnadaha U Jebiso Saxiixa Xiddig Laf-dhabar U Ah Aston Villa
body:
Tababaraha ku-meel-gaarka ah ee Manchester United, Michael Carrick, ayaa la sheegay inuu ku taliyay in kooxda ay xagaagan la soo saxiixato Morgan Rogers.
Carrick, oo si fiican u yaqaan Rogers intii ay wada joogeen Middlesbrough, ayaa u sheegay agaasimaha ciyaaraha Jason Wilcox in ciyaaryahankan 23-jirka ah uu si fiican ugu habboon yahay nidaamkiisa ciyaareed.
Si kastaba, Aston Villa ayaa la filayaa inay dalbato lacag ka badan £100 milyan haddii ay go’aansadaan inay iibiyaan Rogers; lacag u dhiganta tii ay ka heleen Jack Grealish markii uu ka tagay kooxda.
Rogers ayaa dhowaan saxiixay qandaraas waqti dheer ah, mana jiro qodob fasax, taasoo siineysa Villa awood buuxda oo ay ku go’aamiso mustaqbalkiisa.
Manchester United kaligood maaha kuwa xiiseynaya, iyadoo Chelsea ay si xoogan ugu riixeyso saxiixiisa si ay u dhisaan mashruuc ku wareegsan Cole Palmer, halka Arsenal ay sidoo kale sameysay baaritaanno hordhac ah oo ku saabsan ciyaaryahanka.
Arrintan ayaa ka dhigaysa Rogers mid ka mid ah ciyaartoyda loogu doonista badan yahay suuqa kala iibsiga xagaaga.

headline: Mikel Arteta Oo Sharaxay Maqnaanshaha Odegaard, Calafiori iyo Piero Hincapie Kulanka Bournemouth
body:
Tababaraha Arsenal, Mikel Arteta, ayaa sharaxay sababta ay uga maqan yihiin qaar ka mid ah ciyaartoydiisa muhiimka ah kulanka Premier League ee ay la ciyaarayaan Bournemouth.
Kabtanka kooxda, Martin Odegaard, ayaa seegay ciyaarta kadib dhaawac yar oo uu ka soo gaaray kulankii bartamaha usbuuca ee UEFA Champions League.
Arteta ayaa yiri:
“Waa ciyaaryahan aad muhiim noogu ah, laakiin wuxuu qabay dhaawac yar kulankii bartamaha usbuuca, sidaas darteed maanta diyaar muusan ahayn.”
Sidoo kale, wuxuu xaqiijiyay in daafacyada Riccardo Calafiori iyo Piero Hincapie aysan diyaar u ahayn kulanka.
“Richy maanta diyaar ma uusan ahayn. Piero wuxuu hadda ka soo laabtay dhaawac, si fiicanna wuu u shaqeeyay si uu isugu diyaariyo inuu ciyaaro,” ayuu Arteta ku daray.
Maqnaanshaha ciyaartoydan muhiimka ah ayaa caqabad ku noqotay Arsenal, inkastoo ay wali doonayaan inay sii xajistaan hoggaanka horyaalka.

headline: Arne Slot Oo Markii Ugu Horreysay Ka Hadlay Bixitaanka Mo Salah Iyo Robertson
body:
Tababaraha Liverpool, Arne Slot, ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in isaga iyo maamulka sare ee kooxda ay hore u ogaayeen in dhibaatooyin iman karaan xilligiisa hoggaamineed, xitaa kadib markii ay ku guuleysteen Premier League xilli ciyaareedkiisii ugu horreeyay.
Slot ayaa sheegay in bixitaanka soo socda ee Mohamed Salah iyo Andy Robertson ay tahay qayb ka mid ah dhammaadka wareeg guul leh oo kooxdu soo martay.
Wuxuu tilmaamay in guushii horyaalka ee xilli ciyaareedkii hore ay dib u dhigtay isbeddelkan dabiiciga ah.
“Mo iyo Robbo waxay shaaciyeen inay baxayaan, laakiin aad ayaan ugu faraxsanahay inay la shaqeeyeen ciyaartoydii cusbayd ee aan keenay xagaagii hore,” ayuu yiri Slot.
Sidoo kale, wuxuu xusay in ciyaartoyda cusub ay wax badan ka barteen dadaalka iyo anshaxa shaqo ee ciyaartoyda waaweyn, taasoo uu ku tilmaamay hab caadi ah oo ka dhaca kooxaha waaweyn marka ay marayaan marxalad cusub.
Ugu dambeyn, Slot ayaa yiri:
“Waxa ugu fiican ayaa ah inaan dib u dhignay wareeggaas xilli ciyaareedkii hore.”

headline: Ruud Gullit Oo Farta Ku Fiiqay Tababaraha Ku Habboon Shaqada Manchester United.
body:
Halyeeyga reer Netherlands Ruud Gullit ayaa taageeray in kabtankii hore ee Arsenal, Robin van Persie, uu mustaqbalka noqdo tababaraha Manchester United.
Gullit ayaa aaminsan in Van Persie uu leeyahay tayada iyo kartida uu ku hoggaamin karo koox weyn sida Manchester United, isagoo xusay inay fiicnaan lahayd haddii arrintaas ay dhab noqoto mustaqbalka.
Wuxuu yiri:
“Way fiicnaan lahayd haddii Robin van Persie uu mustaqbalka noqdo tababaraha Manchester United. Runtii waan rajeynayaa inay taasi dhacdo maalin uun.”
Dhanka kale, Manchester United ayaa wali raadinaysa tababare joogto ah kadib markii ay shaqada ka ceyrisay Ruben Amorim. Tababaraha ku meel gaarka ah, Michael Carrick ayaa si fiican u shaqeynaya, halka sidoo kale lala xiriirinayo magacyo waaweyn sida Thomas Tuchel iyo Carlo Ancelotti.
Gullit ayaa sidoo kale tilmaamay in Van Persie uu hadda wajahayo cadaadis sare oo ka jira Feyenoord, sababtoo ah sumcaddiisii ciyaaryahanimo, balse uu u baahan yahay waqti si uu isu caddeeyo inuu yahay tababare heer sare ah.

headline: Declan Rice Oo Sharaxay Sida Arteta Uga Caawiyay Inuu Si Fudud Kula Qabsado Arsenal
body:
Arsenal ayaa wajahaysa Bournemouth iyadoo ay kaliya ka harsan yihiin horyaalka toddobo kulan, iyagoo doonaya inay sii xoojiyaan hoggaanka horyaalka.
Sidoo kale, kooxda ayaa hal guul u jirta inay u gudubto wareegga semi-final-ka ee UEFA Champions League.
Xiddiga Khadka dhexe ee Arsenal, Declan Rice, ayaa ka hadlay horumarka weyn ee uu sameeyay tan iyo markii uu yimid kooxda, isagoo si gaar ah u ammaanay tababare Mikel Arteta.
Rice ayaa yiri:
“Tababaraha wuxuu iga dhigay khadka dhexe oo dhammaystiran. Ciyaaryahan sameyn kara wax kasta oo uu iga rabo, anigoo si cad u fahmaya waxa la iga doonayo marka kubadda aan haysto iyo marka aanan hayn.”
Wuxuu sidoo kale xusay in fahamkiisa ciyaarta uu si weyn u koray, xitaa marka uu ka baxsan yahay garoonka, taasoo ka caawisay inuu si kale u arko ciyaarta.
Ugu dambeyn, Rice wuxuu sheegay:
“Tan iyo markii aan halkaan imid, si weyn ayaan u horumaray. Tababaraha si weyn ayuu ii caawiyay, waana uga mahadcelinayaa.”

headline: Mikel Arteta: “Sanadkaan Waxaan Doonaynaa Inaan Awooddeenna Isugu Geyno Hanashada Koobab”
body:
Tababaraha Arsenal, Mikel Arteta ayaa ka hadlay hamiga weyn ee kooxda ee hanashada koobab, iyadoo ay weli ku jiraan tartanka Premier League iyo sidoo kale UEFA Champions League.
Arteta ayaa sheegay in dhiirrigelinta kooxda ay ka timaaddo taariikhda, gaar ahaan sugitaanka dheer ee horyaalka iyo xaqiiqda ah in Arsenal aysan waligeed ku guuleysan Champions League.
Wuxuu yiri:
“Waxaan doonayay Premier League sababtoo ah 22 sano ayaa laga joogaa markii ugu dambeysay ee Arsenal ay ku guuleysato, Champions League-na waligeed kuma guuleysan kooxda. Taasina waa inay ku siisaa tamar iyo dhiirrigelin. Waa inaad wax walba miiska saartaa, sababtoo ah waa waqtigii la sameyn lahaa.”
Arsenal waxay haatan ku jirtaa xaalad adag oo horyaalka ah, sidoo kale waxay sii wadaan safarkooda Yurub kadib guushii lugta hore ee ay ka gaareen Sporting CP.
Arteta sidoo kale wuxuu ka hadlay mustaqbalkiisa, isagoo sheegay inuu rabo in la xusuusto “jacaylka, dadaalka iyo maskaxda guusha” ee uu kooxda u keenay.

headline: Alan Shearer Oo Saadaaliyay Kulanka Weyn Ee Man City Iyo Chelsea
body:
Halyeyga Newcastle United, Alan Shearer, ayaa saadaaliyay in Manchester City ay ka adkaan doonto Chelsea kulanka Premier League ee dhammaadka usbuucan.
Chelsea waxay ku soo geli doontaa ciyaarta iyadoo niyad fiican ka heshay guul ay ka gaareen Port Vale, halka City ay ku naallooneyso guul muhiim ah oo ay ka gaartay Liverpool.
Shearer ayaa aaminsan in kooxda uu maamulo Pep Guardiola ay khasab ku tahay inay badiso dhammaan kulamada haray si ay u sii haysato rajada horyaalka.
“Man City waa inay guuleystaan kulan kasta hadda, gaar ahaan iyadoo ay jirto ciyaar weyn oo ay la leeyihiin Arsenal usbuuca dambe,” ayuu yiri Shearer.
Wuxuu sidoo kale ka digay in haddii City ay dhibco lumiso, halka Arsenal ay guuleysato, tartanka horyaalka uu si rasmi ah u dhammaan doono.
Saadaashan waxay sii muujineysaa cadaadiska weyn ee saaran Manchester City, halka Chelsea ay isku dayeyso inay carqaladeyso rajadooda horyaalka.

headline: 3 Kulan Oo Laga Filan Karo Natiijooyin Layaab Leh Horyaalka Premier League Usbuucaan
body:
Toddobaadkan Premier League ayaa dib u bilaabanaya kadib fasaxii ciyaaraha xulalka, waxaana jira kulamo dhowr ah oo laga yaabo in lagu arko natiijooyin lama filaan ah.
1. Arsenal vs Bournemouth
Kulankan ayaa dejin doona jihada usbuuca. Haddii kooxda Mikel Arteta ay badiso, waxay 12 dhibcood ka fogaan doonaan Manchester City.
Laakiin Bournemouth waa koox halis ah—xilli ciyaareedkii hore ayay guul ku gaareen Emirates, taas oo ka dhigaysa kulan aan la fududaysan karin.
2. Liverpool vs Fulham
Kooxda Arne Slot waxay ku jirtaa xaalad adag kadib guuldarradii Paris Saint-Germain.
Inkasta oo Liverpool ay rabto inay soo laabato, Fulham ayaa laga yaabaa inay ka faa’iideysato cadaadiska iyo hoos u dhaca qaab ciyaareedka, taas oo keeni karta lama filaan.
3. Manchester United vs Leeds United
United oo uu hoggaaminayo Michael Carrick ayaa si fiican uga ciyaarta Old Trafford, laakiin 24 maalmood oo aan la ciyaarin waxay keeni kartaa caajis.
Leeds, oo uu tababaro Daniel Farke, waxay ku jirtaa niyad sare kadib guulo FA Cup iyo iyadoo kulankani yahay derby, wax walba way dhici karaan.
Inkasta oo kulanka Chelsea vs Manchester City uu yahay kan ugu weyn, saddexdan kulan ayaa ah kuwa ugu badan ee laga yaabo inay keenaan natiijooyin lama filaan ah—kuwaas oo saameyn weyn ku yeelan kara tartanka horyaalka iyo boosaska Yurub.

headline: Shaxda Ay Arsenal Kaga Hor Tagi Karto Bournemouth
body:
Arsenal ayaa heli karta war fiican ka hor kulankooda Premier League ee ay la ciyaarayaan AFC Bournemouth, iyadoo dhowr ciyaaryahan muhiim ah laga yaabo inay soo laabtaan.
Xiddigaha ay suuragalka tahay inay diyaar noqdaan waxaa ka mid ah:
Bukayo Saka, Martin Ødegaard, Jurrien Timber iyo Eberechi Eze

Saka: dhaawac uu la tacaalayay tan iyo final-kii Carabao Cup
Ødegaard: dhaawac jilib ah, balse dib ayuu u soo laabtay kulankii Southampton
Timber: dhaawac gumaarka ah tan iyo kulankii Everton
Merino: wali dhaawac ayuu ku maqan yahay
Safka la filayo(4-2-3-1):
Raya; Mosquera, Saliba, Gabriel, Calafiori; Zubimendi, Rice; Madueke, Havertz, Martinelli; Gyökeres
Haddii Arsenal ay guul gaarto, waxay 12 dhibcood ka fogaan karaan Manchester City, taas oo cadaadis weyn tartanka ka abuuri karta.

Goobta: Emirates Stadium

headline: Joe Gomez: “Waxaan Aaminsanahay Inaan PSG Ku Xasuuqi Karno Anfield”
body:
Joe Gomez ayaa qirtay in Liverpool ay ka hoos mareen heerkii laga filayay kadib guuldarradii 2-0 ee ay kala kulmeen Paris Saint-Germain lugtii hore ee wareegga sideed dhammaadka UEFA Champions League.
Isagoo hadlaya maalmo kadib kulankii ka dhacay Paris, Gomez wuxuu muujiyay in ciyaartu ay ahayd mid adag, isla markaana PSG ay tahay koox ka mid ah kuwa ugu fiican adduunka waqtigan. Si kastaba, wuxuu adkeeyay in wali rajo jirto.
“Ma ahayn sida aan rabnay, laakiin wali wax walba waa furan yihiin marka aan ku laabanno Anfield,” ayuu yiri Gomez.
Wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda kalsoonida iyo taageerada:
“Wax walba waxay ka bilaabmaan aaminaadda ciyaartoyda, macallimiinta iyo taageerayaasha. Waxay u baahan doontaa habeen gaar ah, laakiin horay ayaan u sameynay habeenno gaar ah.”
Kulanka lugta labaad ee lagu ciyaari doono Anfield ayaa noqon doona mid go’aamin kara mustaqbalka Liverpool ee tartanka, iyadoo kooxda ay u baahan tahay inay soo celiso labo gool ama ka badan si ay ugu gudubto wareegga xiga.

headline: Qorshaha Hansi Flick Uu Ku Doonayo Inuu Atletico Ku Burburiyo Lugta Labaad Ee Tartanka Champions League Oo La Kashifay
body:
Hansi Flick ayaa si cad u fahamsan in aysan jiri karin wax qalad ah oo loo dulqaadan karo kadib markii Barcelona looga adkaaday 2-0 lugtii hore ee ay la ciyaareen Atletico Madrid ee UEFA Champions League.
Si ay u gudbaan, Barcelona waxay u baahan tahay inay ku badiso ugu yaraan saddex gool marka ay tagaan garoonka Metropolitano Stadium.
Iyadoo haysata hoggaan 7 dhibcood ah oo La Liga ah, Flick wuxuu qorsheynayaa inuu nasiyo ciyaartoyda muhiimka ah kulanka ay la ciyaarayaan Espanyol. Taasi waxay fursad siin doontaa ciyaartoyda aan inta badan la isticmaalin sida Roony Bardghji, Marc Casado, Alejandro Balde iyo Ferran Torres.
Ujeeddada ugu weyn ee Flick waa in kooxdu ay timaado Madrid iyadoo firfircoon oo diyaar u ah kulan laga yaabo inuu noqdo kan ugu muhiimsan xilli ciyaareedka.
Kooxdu waxay ka bixi doontaa Ciutat Esportiva Joan Gamper, kadibna waxay tababar ku qaadan doontaa Metropolitano si ay ula qabsato garoonka iyo shuruudaha UEFA.
Guud ahaan, Flick wuxuu diyaar u yahay inuu khatar geliyo kulanka Espanyol si uu u xaqiijiyo isku day soo laabasho (comeback) oo weyn oo ay ku sameeyaan Atletico Madrid Talaadada.

headline: Muxuu Arbeloa Ka Yiri In Real Madrid Ay Mar Kale Kufto Kulankii Girona?
body:
Alvaro Arbeloa ayaa qirtay in Real Madrid aysan soo bandhigin waxqabadkii laga filayay kadib barbaro 1-1 ah oo ay la galeen Girona.
Tababaraha ku-meel-gaarka ah ayaa si daacad ah u sheegay in kulankaasi uu ahaa mid ay qasab ku ahayd inay guuleystaan:
“Uma aanan ciyaarin si heer sare ah. Tani waxay ahayd ciyaar aan ku guuleysan lahayn… waxay ahayd inaan xirno goolal badan,” ayuu yiri Arbeloa.
Inkasta oo uu amaanay dadaalka ciyaartoyda, haddana wuxuu caddeeyay in heerkaas uusan ku filneyn koox doonaysa horyaalka La Liga.
Natiijadan ayaa ka dhigeysa Real Madrid inay 7 dhibcood ka dambeeyaan hoggaamiyeyaasha Barcelona, kuwaas oo fursad u haysta inay farqiga ka dhigaan 9 dhibcood haddii ay ka adkaadaan Espanyol.
Arrintan waxay cadaadis dheeraad ah saareysaa Real Madrid, iyadoo sidoo kale ay wajahayso kulan adag oo lugta labaad ah oo ka dhan ah Bayern Munich tartanka Champions League.
Guud ahaan, Arbeloa wuxuu diray fariin cad: Real Madrid waa inay si weyn isu horumariyaan haddii ay rabaan inay sii wadaan tartanka horyaalka iyo Champions League.

headline: Liam Rosenior Oo Magacaabay Burburiyaha Ugu Fiican Kubadda Cagta Waqti Xaadir Kaan
body:
Tababaraha Chelsea, Liam Rosenior, ayaa si weyn u amaanay xiddiga khadka dhexe ee Moises Caicedo, isagoo ku tilmaamay midka ugu fiican adduunka marka laga hadlayo booska burburiyaha.
Isagoo ka hadlayay kahor kulanka adag ee ay la leeyihiin Manchester City, Rosenior wuxuu sheegay in Caicedo uu leeyahay wax kasta oo looga baahan yahay ciyaaryahan heer sare ah.
“Aniga ahaan, waa mid ka mid ah kuwa ugu fiican, haddii uusan ahayn kan ugu fiican booska burburiyaha ee adduunka,” ayuu yiri Rosenior.
Wuxuu si gaar ah u xusay:
-Fahamka ciyaarta
-Awooddiisa jireed
-Tayadiisa farsamo
Rosenior ayaa sidoo kale tilmaamay in Caicedo uu door weyn ka ciyaari doono kulanka Axadda, maadaama uu yahay laf-dhabarta kooxda marka ay timaado difaacashada iyo xakamaynta ciyaarta.
Amaanta noocan ah waxay muujineysaa sida uu Caicedo uga mid noqday ciyaartoyda ugu muhiimsan ee Chelsea xilli ciyaareedkan.

headline: Gyökeres: Inaan Ku Guuleysanno Premier League, Waxaa Kaliya Innaga Xigta Inaan…….
body:
Viktor Gyökeres ayaa ka hadlay culayska maskaxeed ee la socda tartanka hanashada horyaalka, iyadoo Arsenal ay si xoog leh u hoggaamineyso Premier League.
Kooxda Gunners ayaa haatan leh hoggaan 9 dhibcood ah oo ay ka sarreeyaan Manchester City, iyadoo ay harsan yihiin 7 kulan oo go’aamin doona cidda ku guuleysaneysa horyaalka.
Gyökeres wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay in furaha guusha uu yahay:
-Diiradda joogtada ah kulan kasta
-In aan la dhayalsan wax kulan ah
-In la xakameeyo niyad-jabka marka natiijo xun timaado
Wuxuu yiri:
“Waa inaad si buuxda diiradda u saartaa kulan kasta, dhibco kasta oo aad heshaana ugu dambeyn waa muhiim.”
Sidoo kale, wuxuu ku booriyay ciyaartoyda inay ka fogaadaan cadaadiska xad-dhaafka ah ee natiijada ugu dambeysa, isla markaana ay diiradda saaraan ciyaarta lafteeda:
“Waxa ugu muhiimsan waa inaad ciyaarta ku raaxaysataa oo aadan aad uga fikirin waxa dhici kara dhamaadka.”
Hadalladiisa waxay muujinayaan in inkastoo Arsenal ay hoggaanka hayaan, haddana tartanka wali furan yahay, isla markaana ay muhiim tahay in kooxda ay sii wado feejignaan buuxda ilaa dhammaadka xilli ciyaareedka.

headline: Bruno Fernandes Oo Daaha Ka Rogay Sirta Ka Dambeysa Guulaha United Tan Iyo Markii La Magacaabay Carrick
body:
Kabtanka Manchester United, Bruno Fernandes, ayaa shaaca ka qaaday sirta ka dambeysa isbeddelka weyn ee kooxda tan iyo markii Michael Carrick uu la wareegay tababarenimada ku-meel-gaarka ah.
Fernandes ayaa sheegay in Carrick uu kooxda ka dhigay mid aad u nidaamsan, gaar ahaan dhanka difaaca:
“Waxaan bilownay inaan noqono kuwo isku dhow marka aan difaaceyno, isla markaana fahamno in mararka qaar ay tahay inaan dhibka u adkeysanno marka aanan ku jirin xaalad fiican,” ayuu yiri.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray in kooxda ay hadda heshay hab ay ku guuleysato, xitaa haddii ciyaartu aysan qurux badneyn:
“Waxaan helnay qaab aan ku badin karno ciyaaraha, qurux ha noqoto ama yaanay noqon.”
Tan iyo markii Carrick uu yimid, United waxay guuleysteen 7 ka mid ah 10-kii kulan, iyagoo kor ugu kacay kaalinta 3-aad ee Premier League, taasoo muujineysa saameynta degdegga ah ee tababaraha.
Fernandes ayaa sidoo kale ammaanay isbeddelada taatikada ee Carrick, kuwaas oo u oggolaaday inuu si xor ah uga ciyaaro meelaha hore, taasoo kordhisay hal-abuurkiisa iyo saameyntiisa weerarka.
Arrin xiiso leh, Fernandes wuxuu sheegay in haddii uu dooran lahaa hal halyeey oo uu jeclaan lahaa inuu la ciyaaro, uu dooran lahaa Carrick laftiisa, taasoo muujineysa sida uu u qadarinayo xirfaddiisa iyo fahamka ciyaarta.
Guud ahaan, Carrick wuxuu dib u soo nooleeyay rajada United, iyadoo kooxda ay hadda si dhab ah ugu jirto tartanka u soo bixitaanka Champions League.

headline: Mikel Arteta Oo Ka War Bixiyay Xaaladda Dhaawacyada Kooxdiisa Ka Hor Kulanka Bournemouth
body:
Tababaraha Arsenal, Mikel Arteta, ayaa bixiyay war cusub oo ku saabsan xaaladda dhaawacyada kooxdiisa ka hor kulanka AFC Bournemouth ee Premier League.
Arsenal ayaa rajeynaysa inay sii ballaariso hoggaanka ay ku hayso horyaalka, iyadoo doonaysa inay 12 dhibcood ka hor marto Manchester City haddii ay guul gaaraan.
Si kastaba, Arteta wuxuu xaqiijiyay in dhowr ciyaaryahan ay ka maqnaayeen tababarka, oo ay ku jiraan:
Odegaard
Bukayo Saka
Piero Hincapie
Riccardo Calafiori
Jurrien Timber
Markii wax laga weydiiyay xaaladdooda, Arteta si cad ugama jawaabin, isagoo yiri:
“Waxaa jiray isbedello tan iyo shalay… ma hubo qaar ka mid ah xaaladdooda.”
War wanaagsan oo Arsenal ah ayaa ah in Eberechi Eze uu diyaar yahay. Arteta ayaa sheegay in Eze uu si adag u soo kabtay:
“Wuxuu rabay inuu si dhaqso ah u soo laabto, laakiin ma suurtagelin. Habka uu u soo kabtay iyo dadaalka uu sameeyay waa mid aad u fiican.”
Xaaladda dhaawacyada ayaa weli ah walaac weyn oo Arsenal horyaalla, inkastoo ay weli ku jiraan tartanka horyaalka iyo Champions League.

headline: Liam Rosenior Oo Xaqiijiyay In Mid Kamid Ah Xiddigihiisa Ugu Muhiimsan Kooxda Uu Ganaax Ku Seegayo Kulanka Weyn Ee City
body:
Tababaraha Chelsea, Liam Rosenior, ayaa xaqiijiyay in Enzo Fernandez uusan ciyaari doonin kulanka adag ee ay la leeyihiin Manchester City.
Xiddiga reer Argentina ayaa ganaax gudaha ah la saaray kadib hadallo uu warbaahinta u jeediyay intii uu ku maqnaa fasaxa caalamiga ah. Inkastoo uu raaligelin ka bixiyay arrintaas, iyadoo sidoo kale wakiilkiisu hore u dhaliilay go’aanka; haddana kooxda ayaa go’aansatay in ganaaxu sii socdo.
Rosenior ayaa sheegay inuu dhowr jeer la hadlay Enzo, isagoo caddeeyay inuusan shaki gelinaynin dabeecaddiisa, balse ay muhiim tahay in tallaabo laga qaado khaladka dhacay:
“Wuu na raaligeliyay aniga iyo kooxda. Waxaan u arkaa inuu yahay qof wanaagsan, balse qalad kasta wuxuu leeyahay cawaaqib,” ayuu yiri tababaruhu.
Wuxuu sidoo kale xaqiijiyay:
“Ma ciyaari doono Axadda, laakiin waxaan rajeynayaa inuu mustaqbalka noqdo qayb muhiim ah oo kooxda ka mid ah.”
Kulanka Chelsea iyo Man City ayaa ah mid aad muhiim ugu ah dagaalka loogu jiro boosaska sare ee Premier League, iyadoo maqnaanshaha Enzo Fernandez ay saameyn ku yeelan karto khadka dhexe ee Blues.

headline: Real Madrid Oo Qasnadaha U Jebineysa Saxiixa Michael Olise
body:
Real Madrid ayaa si dhab ah u xiiseynaysa xiddiga Bayern Munich, Michael Olise, kadib xilli ciyaareed cajiib ah oo uu sameeyay.
Wararka ka imanaya Jarmalka, gaar ahaan wariye Christian Falk, ayaa sheegaya in madaxweynaha Real Madrid Florentino Perez uu si weyn u jecel yahay Olise, isla markaana kooxda ay ka fiirsaneyso dalab waali ah oo gaari kara €160–165 milyan.
Olise ayaa dhawaan si weyn uga dhex muuqday kulankii Champions League ee ka dhacay Santiago Bernabéu, halkaas oo uu door muhiim ah ka ciyaaray guushii 2-1 ee Bayern ka gaartay Real Madrid, isagoo caawiyay goolkii uu dhaliyay Harry Kane isla markaana dhib weyn ku hayay difaaca Madrid.
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Bayern Munich ma doonayaan inay si fudud u sii daayaan ciyaaryahanka. Agaasimaha guud ee kooxda, Jan-Christian Dreesen, ayaa caddeeyay in Olise uu yahay qayb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah qorshaha mustaqbalka, isagoo xusay inuu qandaraas kula jiro kooxda ilaa 2029 isla markaana uusan lahayn wax qodob fasax ah.
Haddii dalabkan uu dhab noqdo, wuxuu noqon karaa mid ka mid ah heshiisyada ugu waaweyn taariikhda kubadda cagta, laakiin Bayern ayaa u muuqata inay diyaar u tahay dagaal si ay u sii haysato xiddigooda.

headline: Hansi Flick Oo Si Toos Ah Uga Hadlay Weerarkii Uu Arbeloa Kabaha Kula Tuntay Barcelona
body:
Tababaraha Barcelona, Hansi Flick, ayaa si cad uga gaabsaday inuu ka jawaabo hadalladii Alvaro Arbeloa uu ku duray Barca, isagoo sheegay inuusan “waqti iyo tamar ku lumin doonin” arrintaas.
Flick ayaa yiri:
“Waxba kama jawaabayo. Kuma luminayo tamarteyda isaga iyo wuxuu ku andacooday. Waa aragtidiisa, aniguna waxaan diiradda saarayaa kooxdayda.”
Tababaraha Jarmalka ah ayaa sidoo kale carrabka ku adkeeyay in kooxdiisu aysan ku mashquulin waxyaabaha ka imanaya dibadda, gaar ahaan Real Madrid.
“Waxaan diiradda saareynaa nafteena. Kama fikirayno Real Madrid. Waxaa jira buuq badan, laakiin waxaan u sheegay ciyaartoyda inay diiradda saaraan shaqadooda.”
Hadallada Arbeloa ayaa ku saabsanaa tirakoobyo La Liga ah tan iyo sanadkii 2000, isagoo sheegay in Barcelona ay heshay kaarar cas oo ka yar kuwa Real Madrid, inkastoo Yurub ay tiradu isu dhowdahay.
Arbeloa ayaa dhankiisa sii adkeeyay mowqifkiisa, isagoo sheegay inuusan beddeli doonin aragtidiisa ku saabsan arrimaha garsoorka kubadda cagta Spain.
Arrintan ayaa muujineysa xiisad hadal ah oo u dhaxeysa labada dhinac, balse Flick wuxuu doorbiday inuu ka fogaado doodda oo uu xooga saaro natiijooyinka kooxdiisa.

headline: Arne Slot: “Isak Wuxuu Naga Caawin Doonaa Inaan Goolal Badan Dhalinno”
body:
Tababaraha Liverpool, Arne Slot, ayaa si weyn u soo dhaweeyay soo laabashada Alexander Isak, isagoo sheegay in joogitaankiisu uu yahay “mid aad muhiim u ah” xilli kooxda ay dhib ku qabto dhalinta goolasha.
Isak ayaa kasoo muuqday kursiga keydka, isagoo ciyaaray 15 daqiiqo markii ugu horreysay tan iyo dhaawicii soo gaaray. Slot ayaa yiri:
“Waxay ahayd 15 daqiiqo oo keliya, laakiin waa wax fiican inuu soo laabto. Waxaan rajeyneynaa inuu si degdeg ah ugu soo laabto qaab ciyaareedkiisii hore.”
Tababaraha ayaa sidoo kale qiray in ay qaadan karto waqti uu weeraryahanku si buuxda ugu soo laabto heerkiisa ugu sarreeya, balse wuxuu rajo ka muujiyay horumarka uu sameeyay intii uu ku jiray soo kabashada.
Dhanka kale, Slot wuxuu xaqiijiyay in goolhaye Alisson Becker uu weli ku jiro soo kabasho adag, isla markaana uu seegi doono kulanka toddobaadkan.
Soo laabashada Isak ayaa la filayaa inay xal u noqoto dhibaatada gool dhalinta ee Liverpool, gaar ahaan iyadoo kooxda ay wajahday natiijooyin aan fiicneyn kulamadii ugu dambeeyay.

headline: Lewandowski Oo Go’aan Lama Filaan Ah Ka Soo Saaray Mustaqbalkiisa Barcelona Kadib Kulankii Atletico
body:
Weeraryahanka reer Poland Robert Lewandowski ayaa la sheegay inuu isagu isu bandhigay kooxda AC Milan ka hor suuqa kala iibsiga xagaaga, iyadoo mustaqbalkiisa Barcelona uu noqday mid aan la hubin.
Warbixinta ayaa sheegaysa in wakiillada Lewandowski ay hore ula xiriireen maamulka Milan, si ay u fahmaan qorshaha ciyaareed iyo xaaladda dhaqaale ee kooxda.
Xiddiga 37 jirka ah ayaa la rumeysan yahay inuu doorbidayo ku biirista Milan, inkastoo ay jiraan dalabyo kale oo ka imanaya Chicago Fire FC iyo kooxo ka ciyaara Sacuudiga.
Qandaraaskiisa Barcelona ayaa ku eg dhammaadka xilli ciyaareedkan, iyadoo aan horumar laga sameynin heshiis cusub, taasoo ka dhigaysa inuu si xor ah ku bixi karo. Milan ayaa si gaar ah u xiiseyneysa inay si bilaash ah ku hesho weeraryahanka, si ay uga fogaato qarash badan oo wareegis ah inkastoo mushaharkiisu sareeyo.
Dhanka kale, Juventus ayaa sidoo kale la socota xaaladda, balse Milan ayaa hadda loo arkaa kooxda ugu dhow ee heli karta saxiixiisa.
Lewandowski ayaa doonaya inuu ka sii ciyaaro heerka ugu sarreeya Yurub, halkii uu u wareegi lahaa horyaallo kale oo uu ku dhameysto xirfaddiisa.

headline: Arne Slot Oo Markii Ugu Horreysay Ka Hadlay Mustaqbalkiisa Liverpool — Wuxuu Ka Dhawaajiyay Arrin Ay La Yaabeen Taageerayaasha Liverpool
body:
Tababaraha Liverpool, Arne Slot, ayaa sheegay inuu weli dareemayo taageero buuxda oo ka imanaysa maamulka sare iyo taageerayaasha kooxda, inkastoo natiijooyin adag ay jireen dhawaanahan.
Slot wuxuu xusay in milkiilayaasha kooxda iyo madaxda sida Richard Hughes iyo Michael Edwards ay si joogto ah u garab taagan yihiin.
“Marar badan ayaan sheegay inaan dareemayo taageero badan oo ka imanaysa milkiilayaasha iyo Richard iyo Michael sidoo kale. Xitaa haddii ay u ekaan karto wax lala yaabo, waxaan sidoo kale dareemayaa taageerada taageerayaasha,” ayuu yiri Slot.
Wuxuu xasuustay dhacdo taabaneysa oo ka dhacday Paris kahor kulankii Paris Saint-Germain:
“Markii aan socod ku mareynay Paris, inkastoo 4-0 ay nooga soo adkaatay Manchester City, taageerayaashu waxay bilaabeen inay ku heesaan ‘We love you Liverpool’.”
Xitaa kadib markii si weyn nooga adkaatay PSG, taageerayaashu wali way heesayeen oo garab istaagnaayeen kooxda.
Slot ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay in kooxda ay si buuxda u fahamsan tahay marxaladda ay ku jirto, isla markaana ay jirto kalsooni iyo taageero buuxda oo uu ka haysto dhammaan dhinacyada muhiimka ah.

headline: Bruno Fernandes Oo Caddeeyay Mowqifkiisa Ku Aaddan Mustaqbalkiisa Manchester United
body:
Kabtanka Manchester United, Bruno Fernandes, ayaa sheegay inuu si buuxda ugu qanacsan yahay noloshiisa Old Trafford, isla markaana uu aaminsan yahay in kooxda ay gaari karto guulo waaweyn mustaqbalka dhow.
Ciyaaryahanka reer Portugal, oo xilli ciyaareedkan sameeyay bandhig heer sare ah islamarkaana bixiyay 16 caawin gudaha Premier League, ayaa sheegay in qoyskiisu si fiican ula qabsadeen magaalada Manchester.
“Markaad meel muddo dheer joogto, waxaad dareemeysaa inaad ka mid tahay. Carruurteyda waxay dareemayaan inay gurigooda joogaan,” ayuu yiri Fernandes.
Wuxuu sidoo kale ka hadlay himilada kooxda:

headline: Graeme Souness Oo Si Aan Horay Loo Arag U Weeraray Ciyaartoyda Liverpool Kadib Guuldarradii PSG
body:
Halyeeygii hore ee Liverpool, Graeme Souness, ayaa si toos ah dusha uga saaray mas’uuliyadda hoos u dhaca Liverpool, halkii uu eedda saari lahaa Arne Slot.
Souness ayaa sheegay in dhibaatada ugu weyn ay tahay dadaal la’aan:
“Uma eedeynayo Slot si toos ah, laakiin waxaan ka bilaabayaa ciyaartoyda. Waxaa jirta tiro muujineysa inay mar walba wax ka yar dadaalaan kooxaha kale. Taasi waa meesha laga bilaabayo,” ayuu yiri.
Wuxuu xusay in tayada Liverpool aysan shaki ku jirin, balse ay muhiim tahay in marka hore la muujiyo shaqo adag:
“Haddii aad heysato ciyaartoy tayo leh, waxa ugu horreeya waa inaad la mid noqotaa dadaalka kooxaha kale; Liverpool taas si joogto ah uma sameyn.”
Souness ayaa sidoo kale tilmaamay in awoodda raacashada kooxda ay hoos u dhacday, sidoo kalena uu difaacooda nuglaaday.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray in mararka qaar kubadda cagta aan loo baahnayn in la adkeeyo:
“Mararka qaar way sahlan tahay inaad ku fashilan taan inaad gaartaan heerka dadaalka kooxaha kale.”
Liverpool ayaa ku jirta qaab ciyaareed liita, iyadoo labo guul oo kaliya ka heshay siddeedii kulan ee ugu dambeysay, islamarkaana looga badiyay lix gool labo kulan gudahood muddo afar maalmood ah.
Hadallada Souness ayaa muujinaya cadaadiska sii kordhaya ee saaran ciyaartoyda Liverpool xilli ciyaareedkan.
