headline: Gary Neville Oo Magacaabay Mid Kamid Ah Saxiixyadii Ugu Yaabka Badnaa Taariikhda Premier League
body:
Halyeeyga Manchester United, Gary Neville, ayaa shaaciyay in mid ka mid ah saxiixyadii ugu yaabka badnaa taariikhda Premier League uu ahaa midii Sol Campbell.
Neville ayaa tilmaamay in Campbell uu sameeyay “u wareegistii ugu shoogga badnayd” markii uu ka tagay Tottenham Hotspur kuna biiray Arsenal sanadkii 2001.
“Sol waa u wareegistii ugu weynayd ee aan arkay marka laga hadlayo shoog. Waxay ahayd mid aad u weyn,” ayuu yiri Neville isagoo ka hadlayay barnaamijka Stick to Football.
Campbell ayaa markaas ahaa kabtanka Tottenham, taasoo ka dhigtay inuu si toos ah ugu biiro kooxda ay aadka u xafiiltamaan ee Arsenal, arrin si weyn uga careysiisay taageerayaasha Spurs.
Difaacan reer England ayaa shan xilli ciyaareed ku qaatay Arsenal, isagoo ku guuleystay koobab waaweyn, ka hor inta uusan 2006 ku biirin Portsmouth. Wuxuu mar kale ku soo laabtay Arsenal 2010 muddo gaaban, ka hor inta uusan ku fariisan Newcastle United.
U Wareegistaas ayaa weli loo arkaa mid ka mid ah kuwa ugu muranka iyo yaabka badan taariikhda kubadda cagta Ingiriiska.

headline: “Waa Dammiin Laga Waalay”:- Roy Keane Oo Kabaha La Dul-maray Arnold Kadib Kulankii Bayern
body:
Halyeeyga Manchester United, Roy Keane, ayaa si kulul u dhaleeceeyay daafaca Real Madrid, Trent Alexander-Arnold, kadib guuldarradii 2-1 ee ay kala kulmeen Bayern Munich ee UEFA Champions League.
Keane ayaa sheegay in Alexander-Arnold uu sameeyay qalad “carruurnimo” ah, kadib markii uu si liidata u difaacay oo uu u oggolaaday Luis Diaz inuu si fudud uga gudbo oo gool u dhaliyo. Goolkaas ayaa ahaa kii ugu horreeyay ee Bayern, ka hor inta uusan Harry Kane labaad ku darin.
Inkasta oo uu caawiyay goolkii Kylian Mbappe, haddana Keane wuxuu sheegay in waxqabadkiisa difaac uu ahaa mid aad u liita.
“Waan ka daalay. Mar walba isla sheekadaa ayaa soo noqnoqota marka ay timaado kulamada waaweyn. Dadku waxay ka hadlaan baasaskiisa, laakiin difaacashada aasaasiga ah waa eber?” ayuu yiri Keane.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray:
“Heerkan Champions League, ma awoodid inaad sidaas u seexato. Waa qalad carruurnimo. In Luis Diaz uu si fudud kuu dhaafo, taasi lama aqbali karo.”
Hadalkan ayaa mar kale muujinaya su’aalaha laga qabo awoodda difaac ee Alexander-Arnold marka uu wajahayo kulamada waaweyn.

headline: Barcelona Oo Dacwad Ka Gudbisay Garsoorihii Kulankii Atletico; Sabab?
body:
Kooxda Barcelona ayaa si rasmi ah cabasho ugu gudbisay UEFA kadib guuldarradii 2-0 ee ka soo gaartay Atletico Madrid kulankii lugta hore ee quarter-final-ka UEFA Champions League.
Kooxda uu hoggaamiyo Hansi Flick ayaa si weyn uga cabanaysa go’aamo ay ku tilmaameen kuwo muran dhaliyay, gaar ahaan:
-Kaarkii casaa ee la siiyay Pau Cubarsi
-Go’aano la xiriira VAR oo ay Barcelona u aragto kuwo saameeyay natiijada
Dhacdada ugu weyn ee muranka dhalisay ayaa timid daqiiqaddii 54-aad, markii goolhayaha Atletico, Juan Musso uu kubad ugu dhiibay daafaca Marc Pubill gudaha diilinta ganaaxa, kadibna Pubill uu gacanta ku qabtay kubadda—iyadoo aan garsooruhu dhigin rigoore.
Barcelona waxay aaminsan tahay in go’aamadaas aysan waafaqsaneyn sharciga ciyaarta, islamarkaana ay si toos ah u saameeyeen natiijada kulanka.
Cabashadan ayaa imanaysa iyadoo Barcelona ay isku dayeyso inay cadaadis saarto UEFA kahor kulanka lugta labaad, halkaas oo ay u baahan doonaan inay soo celiyaan natiijada si ay ugu gudbaan semi-final-ka.

headline: Milkiilayaasha Liverpool Oo Go’aan Lama Filaan Ah Ka Soo Saaray Mustaqbalka Arne Slot
body:
Milkiilayaasha Liverpool, ee Fenway Sports Group (FSG), ayaa weli si buuxda u taageeraya tababare Arne Slot, inkastoo cadaadis xooggan uu saaran yahay.
Warbixin ka timid The Telegraph ayaa sheegaysa in maamulka kooxda aysan qorsheyneyneyn inay beddelaan Slot xilli ciyaareedka soo socda, xitaa haddii ay ka haraan UEFA Champions League kadib guuldarradii 2-0 ee ka soo gaartay Paris Saint-Germain.
FSG waxay aaminsan yihiin in Slot uu u baahan yahay waqti uu dib ugu dhiso kooxda, maadaama uu beddelay tababare halyeey ah sida Jurgen Klopp. Heshiiskiisa ayaa soconaya ilaa sanadka dambe, waxaana la qorsheynayaa inuu sii wado ilaa dhammaadka qandaraaskiisa.
Sababaha loo tixgeliyay taageeradan waxaa ka mid ah:
-Isbeddelka kooxda
-Hoos u dhaca qaab ciyaareedka ciyaartoy muhiim ah sida Mohamed Salah
-Dhibaatooyin kale oo ka baxsan garoonka, sida geerida Diogo Jota
Dhanka kale, Slot ayaa durba ku lug leh qorshaha suuqa kala iibsiga xagaaga, iyadoo Liverpool ay hore u xaqiijisay saxiixa daafaca Jeremy Jacquet oo ka imanaya Stade Rennais.
Tani waxay muujineysaa in maamulka Liverpool ay wali kalsooni ku qabaan mashruuca Slot, inkastoo natiijooyinka dhawaanahan aysan fiicneyn.

headline: Paul Merson Oo Shaaciyay Waqtiga Ay Arsenal Xaqiijin Karto Ku Guuleysiga Premier League
body:
Halyeeygii hore ee Arsenal, Paul Merson, ayaa saadaaliyay in tartanka Premier League uu ku dhow yahay inuu dhammaado usbuucan.
Merson wuxuu aaminsan yahay in Arsenal ay sii fogeysan doonto hoggaanka haddii natiijooyinku u dhacaan sida uu filayo:
“Waxaan u maleynayaa in tartanka horyaalka uu dhammaan doono usbuucan. Arsenal waxay 12 dhibcood ka hormari doontaa Manchester City,” ayuu yiri.
Arsenal ayaa hadda leh 9 dhibcood oo hoggaan ah, laakiin haddii Manchester City ay dhibco lumiso kulanka ay la ciyaarayaan Chelsea, halka Arsenal ay ka badiso AFC Bournemouth, farqiga ayaa noqon kara 12 dhibcood.
Merson wuxuu kalsooni ku qabaa kooxda Mikel Arteta:
“Ma aaminsani in Man City ay ka badin doonto Chelsea. Waxaan filayaa in Arsenal ay si raaxo leh uga badiso Bournemouth.”
Haddii saadaashiisu rumoowdo, Merson wuxuu qabaa in Arsenal ay si dhab ah u xaqiijin doonto horyaalka, taasoo noqon lahayd guul weyn oo ay sugayeen muddo dheer.

Inkasta oo maamulka Chelsea ay wali doonayaan inay taageeraan Rosenior, haddana warar cusub ayaa tilmaamaya in haddii kooxda ay ku guuldareysato inay u soo baxdo UEFA Champions League, ay taasi halis gelin karto shaqadiisa Stamford Bridge.
Chelsea ayaa wajahday hoos u dhac weyn kahor fasaxa caalamiga ah ee March, iyadoo laga badiyay afar kulan oo xiriir ah. Natiijooyinkaas ayaa:
-Ka saaray tartanka Champions League
-Hoos u dhigay rajadooda inay galaan kaalmaha sare ee Premier League
Haatan, Chelsea waxay hal dhibic ka dambeysaa Liverpool, iyadoo kooxo badan oo kale ay si dhow ugu soo dhow yihiin.
Tani waxay ka dhigan tahay in toddobaadyada soo socda ay go’aamin karaan mustaqbalka Rosenior, iyadoo u soo bixitaanka Champions League uu noqday shuruud muhiim ah oo lagu sii oggolaan karo shaqadiisa.

headline: UEFA Oo Soo Saartay Shaxda Todobaadka Ee Champions League
body:
UEFA ayaa shaacisay kooxda usbuuca ee UEFA Champions League kadib kulamadii lugta hore ee quarter-final-ka.
Kooxdan waxaa si weyn u hoggaaminaya ciyaartoy ka kala socda Paris Saint-Germain iyo Bayern Munich, kuwaas oo soo bandhigay qaab ciyaareed cajiib ah.
Kooxda usbuuca:
Goolhaye: Manuel Neuer (Bayern)
Difaac: Josip Stanisic (Bayern), Marquinhos (PSG), Robin Le Normand (Atletico Madrid), Maximiliano Araujo (Sporting CP)
Khadka dhexe: Joshua Kimmich (Bayern), Joao Neves (PSG), Lamine Yamal (Barcelona)
Weerarka: Kai Havertz (Arsenal), Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG), Julian Alvarez (Atletico)
Kooxdan ayaa ka tarjumeysa ciyaartoydii ugu saameynta badnaa lugta hore, iyadoo PSG iyo Bayern ay si gaar ah u muujiyeen awoodooda.
Lugta labaad ee quarter-final-ka ayaa la ciyaari doonaa usbuuca soo socda, halkaas oo afar kooxood ay u gudbi doonaan semi-final-ka tartanka.

headline: Liverpool Oo Xaqiijisay Bixitaanka Mid Kamid Ah Daafacyadeeda
body:
Kooxda Liverpool ayaa si rasmi ah u xaqiijisay in Andy Robertson uu ka tagi doono Anfield dhammaadka xilli ciyaareedkan, isagoo ku bixi doona si xor ah.
War-saxaafadeedka kooxda ayaa lagu sheegay in Robertson uu soo afjari doono safarkiisa Liverpool kadib 9 sano oo guulo badan leh, isagoo ka mid noqday halyeeyada kooxda.
Robertson, oo ka yimid Hull City sanadkii 2017, ayaa door weyn ka qaatay guulihii waaweynaa ee Liverpool, oo ay ka mid yihiin:
2 horyaal oo Premier League
UEFA Champions League
FA Cup
2 League Cup
FIFA Club World Cup iyo UEFA Super Cup
Guud ahaan, daafaca bidix ee reer Scotland ayaa ciyaaray 373 kulan, isagoo noqday mid ka mid ah tiirarka ugu muhiimsan kooxda sanadihii ugu dambeeyay.
Inkasta oo uu baxayo, Robertson ayaa diiradda saaraya inuu si fiican u dhameystiro xilli ciyaareedka 2025/26, isagoo rajeynaya inuu kooxda ku hoggaamiyo guulo kale ka hor inta uusan sagootin.
Taageerayaasha Liverpool ayaa durba u arka Robertson halyeey dhab ah oo raad weyn kaga tagay taariikhda kooxda.

headline: Van Dijk Oo Farriin Culus U Diray Ciyaartoyda Liverpool Kadib Guuldarradii PSG
body:
Kabtanka Liverpool, Virgil van Dijk, ayaa fariin dhiirrigelin ah u diray saaxiibadiisa kooxda kadib guuldarradii 2-0 ee ay kala kulmeen Paris Saint-Germain lugtii hore ee quarter-final-ka UEFA Champions League.
Van Dijk ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay in soo laabashada ay ku bilaabato kalsooni:
“Wax walba waxay ka bilaabmaan aaminaad; aaminaadda aad naftaada ku qabto, tan tababaraha kaa timaadda, iyo qorshaha saxda ah ee ciyaarta,” ayuu yiri.
Wuxuu sidoo kale xusay muhiimadda dagaalka iyo dadaalka:
“Waa inaan muujinnaa rabitaan, dagaal iyo dadaal, taas waa waxa ugu yar ee laga rabo ciyaaryahan Liverpool ah.”
Daafaca reer Netherlands ayaa qiray in PSG ay tahay koox aad u adag:
“Waxaan la ciyaareynaa koox heer sare ah dhinac walba, sidaas darteed wax walba waa inay si fiican u shaqeeyaan si aan u soo laabanno.”
Si kastaba, wuxuu ku booriyay kooxda inay xasuustaan aqoonsigooda:
“Laakiin sidoo kale waxay ku xiran tahay kalsoonideenna iyo qabkeenna. waxaan nahay Liverpool.”
Van Dijk ayaa muujiyay in guuldarradu si gaar ah u xanuujisay:
“Xilligan wuu i xanuujinayaa, waana inuu xanuujiyaa qof walba oo qolka labiska jooga.”
Liverpool ayaa hadda rajeynaysa inay mucjiso ka sameyso Anfield lugta labaad, inkastoo ay wajahayaan hawl adag oo ka dhan ah PSG oo qaab ciyaareed wanaagsan ku jirta.

headline: Arsenal Oo War Farxad Leh Ka Heshay Xaaladda Eze
body:
Kooxda Arsenal ayaa heshay war wanaagsan, kadib markii Eberechi Eze uu ku soo laabtay tababarka buuxa ee kooxda koowaad ka hor kulanka Premier League ee ay la ciyaarayaan AFC Bournemouth usbuucan.
Eze, oo 27 jir ah, ayaa maqnaa tan iyo dhammaadkii March kadib dhaawac muruqa lugta ah oo ku qasbay inuu ka baxo xulka England. Soo laabashadiisa ayaa ah dhiirrigelin weyn oo uu helayo tababare Mikel Arteta, kaas oo wajahaya dhaawacyo badan oo ay ka mid yihiin Bukayo Saka, Declan Rice iyo William Saliba.
Xilli ciyaareedkan, Eze ayaa sameeyay 43 kulan, isagoo dhaliyay 9 gool isla markaana bixiyay 6 caawin, taasoo muujineysa muhiimaddiisa weerarka.
Kartidiisa hal-abuurnimo iyo awoodda uu uga ciyaari karo labada garab ayaa noqon karta mid muhiim u ah Arsenal, iyadoo ay harsan yihiin toddobo kulan oo go’aamin doona tartanka horyaalka.

headline: Gravenberch Oo Dhaliil Culus U Jeediyay Arne Slot Kadib Guuldarradii PSG
body:

Gravenberch ayaa yiri:
“Waxaa laga yaabaa inaan rabnay inaan difaac ahaan u noqono kuwo adag. Waxaan ognahay in garbaha PSG ay aad u khatar badan yihiin, sidaas darteed waxaan u baahannay ilaalin dheeraad ah. Laakiin guud ahaan, xitaa markaan shan daafac ku ciyaarnay, way adkayd.”
Arne Slot ayaa adeegsaday qaab ciyaareed difaac ah, kaasoo inkastoo PSG ku xaddiday labo gool kaliya, inkastoo kooxda Faransiiska si buuxda u maamushay ciyaarta.
Hadda oo kulanka labaad lagu ciyaari doono Anfield, waxaa la filayaa in Liverpool ay beddesho qaabkeeda oo ay u ciyaarto si weerar badan, maadaama ay u baahan yihiin inay soo celiyaan 2-0 si ay ugu sii noolaadaan tartanka UEFA Champions League.

headline: Martin Zubimendi Oo Ugu Dambeyntii Bannaanka Keenay Hal Sir Oo Ka Caawisay Inay Sporting Garaacaan Kulankii Champion-ka
body:
Ciyaaryahanka khadka dhexe ee Arsenal, Martin Zubimendi, ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in Viktor Gyokeres uu si weyn u caawiyay Gunners kulankii ay la ciyaareen Sporting CP ee Champions League.
Gyokeres, oo hore ugu soo ciyaaray Sporting xilli ciyaareedkii hore, ayaa siiyay Arsenal warbixin dhameystiran oo ku saabsan kooxdiisii hore:
“Ka hor ciyaarta, Viktor wax walba ayuu noo sheegay,” ayuu yiri Zubimendi.
Wuxuu sii raaciyay:
“Wuxuu nooga warbixiyay cimilada, jawiga garoonka, iyo sida ay u ciyaaraan Sporting. Waxaan tababarnay annagoo leh qorshe cad oo aan ku jebin karno qaabkooda, waana ay shaqeysay.”
Zubimendi ayaa sidoo kale amaanay weeraryahanka Sweden:
“Waa weeraryahan aad u fiican, welina waxaa si weyn u jecel taageerayaasha iyo ciyaartoyda Sporting.”
Arsenal ayaa ku guuleysatay lugta hore 1-0, taasoo muujineysa in xogta iyo talooyinka Viktor Gyokeres ay door weyn ka ciyaareen guusha muhiimka ah ee ay ka gaareen kooxda Lisbon.

headline: ​”Waa Niyad-Jab, Laakiin…”: Marcus Rashford Oo Kashifay Dareenka Dhabta Ah Ee Qolka Labiska Barcelona.
body:

Rashford ayaa muujiyay kalsooni ah in kooxdiisu ay awood u leedahay inay soo laabato:
“Kooxdeenu mar walba fursado way abuureysaa. Waxaan leenahay tayo badan, inkastoo kubadda ay naga hiillisay. Ma aha inaan ku mashquulno arrintaas, sababtoo ah kulanka xiga wax wey isbedeli doonaan,” ayuu yiri.

Rashford ayaa ku adkaystay in Barcelona ay si fiican uga jawaabtay ciyaarta inkastoo ay 10 ciyaaryahan ahaayeen.
Ugu dambeyn, wuxuu qirtay niyad-jabka:
“Waa niyad jab, laakiin waa kubadda cagta.”
Barcelona ayaa hadda wajahaysa caqabad adag oo ay ku doonayaan inay kasoo laabtaan 2-0 lugta labaad ee ka dhici doonta Madrid.

headline: Steven Gerrard Oo Magacaabay Ciyaaryahanka Uu Jeclaan Lahaa In Liverpool Ay U Soo Qaadato Beddelka Salah
body:
Halyeeyga Liverpool, Steven Gerrard, ayaa sheegay inuu jeclaan lahaa inuu arko Michael Olise oo ku biira Liverpool, balse uusan filaynin inuu ka tagayo Bayern Munich.
Gerrard ayaa shaki ka muujiyay suurtagalnimada heshiiska:
“Su’aashu waa, maxaa ku qasbaya inuu ka tago Bayern? Waa koox weyn, waxay u tartamayaan koobab waaweyn, waana kooxdii Bayern ee ugu xoogganayd sanadihii ugu dambeeyay,” ayuu yiri.
Wuxuu sidoo kale tilmaamay in Olise uu u muuqdo mid ku faraxsan xaaladdiisa hadda:
“Wuxuu isu diyaarinayaa inuu si weyn uga dhex muuqdo FIFA World Cup xagaagan. Wuxuu u egyahay ciyaaryahan faraxsan oo deggan, sidaas darteed uma maleynayo inuu meel u socdo.”
Si kastaba, Gerrard wuxuu qiray rabitaankiisa:
“Laakiin haa, waxaan jeclaan lahaa inaan ku arko Liverpool.”
Wuxuu sidoo kale xusay Luis Diaz, isagoo sheegay inuu jeclaan lahaa inuu mar kale ku arko kooxda.
Olise ayaa xilli ciyaareedkan sameeyay tirooyin cajiib ah, isagoo dhaliyay 16 gool isla markaana bixiyay 29 caawin 41 kulan, taasoo muujineysa sababta uu u yahay mid si weyn loo doonayo.

headline: Pau Cubarsi Oo Raalli-gelin Ka Bixiyay Khaladkii Sababay In Barcelona Kufto Kulankii Atletico
body:
Daafaca Barcelona, Pau Cubarsi, ayaa raalli-gelin siiyay taageerayaasha kadib casaankii saameynta weyn yeeshay ee kulankii 2-0 looga adkaaday Barca, lugtii hore ee quarter-final-ka UEFA Champions League.
Dhacdada ayaa timid daqiiqaddii 41-aad markii Cubarsí uu qalad ku galay Giuliano Simeone, isagoo ka hor istaagay fursad gool oo cad. Garsooraha ayaa markii hore bixiyay kaar jaalle ah, balse kadib dib-u-eegis VAR ah ayaa loo beddelay casaan toos ah.
Cubarsí ayaa qoraal uu soo dhigay baraha bulshada ku qirtay qaladkiisa:
“Hal ficil ayaa go’aamin kara natiijada ciyaar iyo wareeg dhan. Tani waa kubadda cagta, anigana masuuliyadda si buuxda ayaan u qaadanayaa.”
Si kastaba, daafaca da’da yar ayaa muujiyay rajo iyo midnimo:
“Weli wax badan ayaa harsan. Waxaan nahay hal qoys, waligeen ma quusan doonno.”
Barcelona ayaa hadda wajahaysa caqabad adag, maadaama ay u baahan yihiin inay kasoo laabtaan 2-0 iyagoo aan haysan Cubarsí, kaas oo ganaax ku seegi doona lugta labaad ee ka dhici doonta Madrid 14-ka April.

headline: Manchester United Oo Palmer La Soo Wareegeysa, Haddii……
body:
Halyeeygii hore ee Manchester United, Teddy Sheringham, ayaa aaminsan in kooxda ay kaliya lacag badan ku bixin doonto Cole Palmer haddii ay iibiso kabtankeeda Bruno Fernandes.
Sheringham ayaa ku tilmaamay xiddiga Chelsea “world-class”, balse wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda joogteynta:
“Waxaan u maleynayaa in United ay kaliya jebin doonto bangiga si ay u hesho ciyaaryahan sida Palmer haddii ay iibiso Bruno Fernandes,” ayuu yiri.
Wuxuu sidoo kale sheegay in labada ciyaaryahan la wada safi karo haddii ay jiraan ciyaaryahanno khadka dhexe oo daafaca ka qeyb qaata:
“Waad wada ciyaarsiin kartaa labadooda haddii aad haysato khad dhexe oo adag oo gadaal taageera.”
Si kastaba, Sheringham ayaa muujiyay walaac ku saabsan dhaawacyada yar-yar ee Palmer:
“Markaad raadineyso ciyaaryahan heer sare ah oo Manchester United ah, waxaad rabtaa mid si joogto ah u ciyaara. Wuxuu la kulmay dhaawacyo yaryar sida suul iyo muruq, taasoo noqon karta dhibaato mustaqbalka.”
Palmer, oo 23 jir ah, ayaa si joogto ah loola xiriirinayay u wareegista Old Trafford, waxaana la sheegay inuu diyaar u yahay inuu ku biiro haddii fursaddu timaado.

headline: Chelsea Oo Qorshaynaysa Inay Hal Mar Wada Iibsato Daafacyada Ugu Fiican Premier League!
body:
Kooxda Chelsea ayaa bilaawday qorshe ay ku xoojinayso difaaceeda xagaaga soo socda, iyadoo diiradda saaraysa saxiixa daafacyo dhexe oo tayo leh.
Wararka ayaa sheegaya in bartilmaameedyada ugu waaweyn ay ka mid yihiin:
Murillo (Nottingham Forest)
Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton)
Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton & Hove Albion)
Murillo ayaa muddo lala xiriirinayay Chelsea, waxaana suuragal ah in heshiiskiisa fududaado haddii Nottingham Forest ay hoos ugu dhacdo heerka labaad. Dhanka kale, Van Hecke ayaa sidoo kale diiradda la saarayaa, inkastoo arrimo hore oo dhex maray isaga iyo Joao Pedro ay saameyn karaan suurtagalnimada heshiiska.
Jarrad Branthwaite ayaa isna loo arkaa daafac si fiican u xoojin kara kooxda, iyadoo Chelsea ay raadineyso ciyaartoy si degdeg ah ula qabsan kara qaab ciyaareedka kooxda.
Intaas waxaa dheer, Chelsea waxay sidoo kale tixgelinaysaa saxiixa Marcus Sensi oo xor noqonaya (free agent), inkastoo uu jiro xiiso ka imanaya Liverpool iyo kooxo Spain ah.
Kooxdu waxay sidoo kale doonaysaa inay sii haysato Josh Achimpong, iyadoo u aragta qayb ka mid ah mustaqbalka difaaceeda.
Qorshayaashan ayaa muujinaya in Chelsea ay si dhab ah u dooneyso inay dhisto difaac adag oo dheellitiran, si ay ugu tartanto koobabka gudaha iyo kuwa Yurub xilli ciyaareedka cusub.

headline: Man United Iyo City Oo Ku Loollamaya Saxiixa Elliot Anderson
body:
Loollan adag oo suuqa kala iibsiga ah ayaa u muuqda inuu ka dhex qarxi doono Manchester City iyo Manchester United, kuwaas oo labaduba doonaya saxiixa xiddiga Nottingham Forest, Elliot Anderson.
Wararka ayaa sheegaya in labada koox ay horey ula yeesheen wadahadallo dhinaca ciyaaryahanka, inkastoo aysan wali jirin dalab rasmi ah oo la gudbiyay.
Manchester City waxay u aragtaa Anderson inuu yahay xoojin muhiim ah xitaa haddii Rodri uu cusbooneysiiyo qandaraaskiisa, halka Manchester United ay ka dhigatay bartilmaameedkooda koowaad ee khadka dhexe, kana hormarisay ciyaartoyda sida Sandro Tonali iyo Adam Wharton.
Dhanka kale, milkiilaha Forest Evangelos Marinakis ayaa la filayaa inuusan ogolaan doonin iib inta lagu jiro xilli ciyaareedka, taasoo adkeyn karta heshiis kasta oo degdeg ah.
Qiimaha Anderson ayaa si weyn u kici kara, gaar ahaan haddii uu sameeyo waxqabad fiican oo uu ku soo bandhigo FIFA World Cup ee soo socda.
Sida ay xaaladdu tahay, labada koox ee Manchester ayaa u muuqda kuwo isku diyaarinaya dagaal weyn oo ku saabsan mid ka mid ah xiddigaha ugu soo jiidashada badan khadka dhexe ee Ingiriiska.

headline: Konate Oo Digniin U Diray PSG Ka Hor Kulanka Lugta Labaad Ee Anfield
body:
Daafaca dhexe ee Liverpool, Ibrahima Konate ayaa amaanay Paris Saint-Germain isagoo ku tilmaamay “mid ka mid ah kooxaha ugu wanaagsan adduunka” ka dib guuldarradii 2-0 ee kooxdiisa soo gaartay lugtii hore ee quarter-final-ka UEFA Champions League ee Parc des Princes. Inkastoo uu habeen adag soo maray, Konate weli wuxuu ku rajo weyn yahay soo laabasho lugta labaad ee Anfield.
“PSG mar kale waxay muujiyeen inay ka mid yihiin kooxaha ugu wanaagsan adduunka,” ayuu Konate yiri. “Way adkaatay inaan helno fursado aan ku dhalino gool ama aan ku difaacanno goolkeena. Tababaraha hadda waa inuu arkaa waxa aan ka horumarin karno oo aan ka beddeli karno ciyaarta guriga.”
Ciyaaryahanka 26-jirka ah, oo ku faraxsan inuu ku soo laabto Paris oo ah magaalada uu ka soo jeedo, ayaa intaa ku daray: “Mar kasta waan ku faraxsanahay inaan ku soo laabto Paris maxaa yeelay waa magaalada aan ka soo jeedo… Laakiin natiijada aawgeed, way cadahay inaanan faraxsanayn. Waan ogahay inaan ciyaar kale ku leenahay Anfield, gurigeena. Wax walba way dhici karaan halkaas.”
Konate sidoo kale wuxuu soo dhoweeyay go’aanka Ligue 1 ee dib-u-dhigista ciyaarta PSG ee usbuuca, isagoo sheegay inuu jeclaan lahaa in Premier League ay si la mid ah u taageerto kooxaha Champions League.
Liverpool ayaa hadda isku diyaarin doonta inay ka soo kabato khasaarihii lugta hore ee Anfield, iyagoo rajeynaya in guriga ay wax ka beddeli karto natiijada tartanka.

headline: Barcelona Oo Dardar-gelisay Wadada Ay Kusoo Qaadaneyso Julian Alvarez
body:
Warar kasoo baxay El Chiringuito TV ayaa sheegaya in Barcelona ay qorsheyneyso inay furto wadahadallo ay ku dooneyso weeraryahanka Atletico Madrid, Julian Alvarez, xagaagan.
Arrintan ayaa timid kadib markii Alvarez uu si weyn u soo jiitay indhaha Barcelona kulankii ay 2-0 kaga adkaadeen Atletico ee UEFA Champions League, halkaas oo uu dhaliyay gool cajiib ah.
Barcelona ayaa la rumeysan yahay inay dardargelisay xiisaha ay u qabto xiddiga reer Argentina, maadaama ay raadinayaan weeraryahan cusub oo heer sare ah.
Si kastaba, Atletico Madrid ayaan diyaar u ahayn inay si fudud ku fasaxdo ciyaaryahankeeda muhiimka ah, waxaana la filayaa inay dalbato lacag aad u badan haddii ay ogolaato iibkiisa.
Alvarez, oo 26 jir ah, ayaa xilli ciyaareedkan sameeyay waxqabad cajiib ah, isagoo dhaliyay 18 gool iyo 9 caawin tartamada oo dhan, halka uu UEFA Champions League ka dhaliyay 9 gool isla markaana bixiyay 4 caawin 12 kulan.
Haddii Barcelona ay si dhab ah u gasho tartanka saxiixiisa, waxay noqon kartaa mid ka mid ah heshiisyada ugu waaweyn suuqa kala iibsiga xagaaga.

headline: Hansi Flick Oo Sharaxay Sababtii Keentay Guuldaradii Kooxdiisa Ka Soo Gaadhay Atlético Madrid.
body:
Tababaraha Barcelona, Hansi Flick, ayaa sheegay in nasiib xumo ay sabab u ahayd guuldarradii 2-0 ee ay kala kulmeen Atletico Madrid lugtii hore ee quarter-final-ka UEFA Champions League.
Flick ayaa qiray in kooxdiisu khaladaad difaac sameysay, gaar ahaan goolka koowaad:
“Goolka koowaad, waxay ahayd inaan si ka wanaagsan u difaacannaa sidaas, kaarka casna wuxuu keenay laad xor ah oo gool noqday. Waxaan sameyn karney si ka fiican,” ayuu yiri.
Inkasta oo Barcelona ay 10 ciyaaryahan ku ciyaareysay qayb ka mid ah kulanka, Flick wuxuu ku adkaystay in kooxdiisu si fiican u ciyaartay:
“Waxaan si fiican u ciyaarnay qeybta hore iyo tan labaad, xitaa iyadoo ciyaaryahan naga maqan yahay. Waxaan bixinnay wax walba, laakiin nasiibkaa naga hiilliyay”
Si kastaba, tababaraha Jarmalka ah ayaa weli rajo ka qaba soo laabasho lugta labaad:
“Weli waxba ma dhammaan. Waan isku dayi doonnaa, waan dagaallami doonaa. Semi-final-ka wuxuu u muuqdaa mid fog hadda, laakiin waxaan isku dayi doonaa inaan gaarno.”
Hadalkan ayaa muujinaya in Barcelona aysan wali quusan, inkastoo ay xaalad adag wajahayaan ka hor kulanka labaad ee Metropolitano.

headline: Tartanka Gooldhalinta Champions League Oo Meel Xiiso Leh Maraya – Kumaa Hoggaaminaya?
body:
Tartanka gooldhalinta UEFA Champions League xilli ciyaareedkan ayaa sii kululaanaya, iyadoo Kylian Mbappe uu hogaaminayo liiska.
Xiddiga Real Madrid ayaa dhaliyay 14 gool 10 kulan, isagoo si weyn uga horeeya tartamayaasha kale.
Gooldhaliyeyaasha ugu sarreeya:
14 gool – Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid)
11 gool – Harry Kane (Bayern Munich)
10 gool – Anthony Gordon (Newcastle United)
9 gool – Julian Alvarez (Atletico Madrid)
8 gool – Erling Haaland (Manchester City)
8 gool – Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Paris Saint-Germain)
Mbappe ayaa hadda 3 gool ka horeeya Harry Kane, taasoo ka dhigeysa musharraxa ugu cadcad ee ku guuleysan kara kabta dahabka ah ee Champions League.
Si kastaba, iyadoo wareegyada ugu dambeeya ay harsan yihiin, tartanka wali waa furan yahay, hal kulan oo weyn ayaa wax walba beddeli kara.

headline: Jamie Carragher Oo Farta Ku Fiiqay Ciyaaryahanka Iska Leh Mas’uuliyadda Guuldarradii Liverpool Ka Soo Gaartay PSG
body:
Halyeeygii hore ee Liverpool, Jamie Carragher, ayaa si toos ah farta ugu fiiqay Ibrahima Konate kadib guuldarradii 2-0 ee ay kala kulmeen Paris Saint-Germain lugtii hore ee quarter-final-ka UEFA Champions League.
Carragher ayaa sheegay in Konate uu si weyn uga hooseeyay heerkii laga filayay, taasoo saameyn ku yeelatay ciyaarta difaaca Liverpool:
“Ciyaaryahanka ag jooga Virgil van Dijk wuxuu ahaa mid liita xilli ciyaareedkan oo dhan, caawana sidoo kale wuu liitay – Konate, qalad ayuu sameeyaa kulan kasta,” ayuu yiri.
Wuxuu sidoo kale dhaliilay nidaamka uu adeegsaday tababare Arne Slot, isagoo sheegay in qaabkii 5-ta daafac uu ka dhigay kooxda mid sii nugul:
“Waxay u muuqdeen kuwo si ka badan u furan marka ay ciyaarayeen 5-ta daafac marka loo eego 4-ta daafac.”
Carragher ayaa difaacay Van Dijk, isagoo sheegay in lagu qasbay inuu daboolo meel ballaaran sababo la xiriira khaladaadka ka imaanayay saaxiibkiisa difaaca:
“Van Dijk waxaa lagu qasbay inuu ordo meelahaas, taas oo aad ugu adkayd isaga.”
Si kastaba, wuxuu qiray in PSG ay ahayd koox heer sare ah habeenkaas:
“Waxay ahaayeen sida adigoo daawanay Barcelona-dii Pep – si dhab ah ayay cajiib u ahaayeen.”
Hadalka Carragher wuxuu muujinayaa in guuldarrada Liverpool aysan kaliya ahayn xeelad, balse sidoo kale ay sabab u tahay qaladaad shaqsiyeed oo ka dhacay difaaca.

headline: Szoboszlai: “Waxaan Aamin-sanahay Inaan Wacdaro Dhigi Karno Kulanka Lugta Labaad”
body:
Xiddiga Khadka dhexe ee Liverpool, Dominik Szoboszlai, ayaa sheegay in kooxdiisu wali aaminsan tahay inay rogi karto natiijada kulanka Paris Saint-Germain inkastoo looga badiyay 2-0 lugtii hore ee quarter-final-ka UEFA Champions League.
Szoboszlai ayaa muujiyay kalsooni buuxda oo ku aaddan soo laabashada:
“Waxaan wajahney koox aad u fiican, laakiin wali waxaa harsan 90 daqiiqo. Weli waan aaminsanahay; aniga oo ka hadlayo kooxda, tababaraha iyo taageerayaasha.”
Wuxuu intaas ku daray in waxqabadkooda uusan ku filneyn kulankii hore:
“Waxaan kulankii hore ku luminay 2-0, mana ahayn mid ku filan wixii aan sameynay. Waa inaan si fiican isu diyaarinnaa.”
Ciyaaryahanka Hungarian-ka ah ayaa sidoo kale tilmaamay muhiimada kulamada soo socda, isagoo sheegay in ay diiradda saarayaan marka hore kulanka Fulham ee horyaalka, ka hor inta aysan u jeesan kulanka go’aaminta ah ee Champions League.
Hadalka Szoboszlai wuxuu muujinayaa in Liverpool aysan wali quusan, iyadoo rajeyneysa inay sameyso soo laabasho weyn marka lagu ciyaarayo Anfield.

headline: Pau Cubarsi Oo Baal Madoow Ka Galay Taariikhda Champions League Kadib Casaankii Loo Taagay Kulankii Atletico
body:
Daafaca da’da yar ee Barcelona, Pau Cubarsi, ayaa sameeyay taariikh aan wanaagsanayn oo UEFA Champions League, kadib markii uu noqday ciyaaryahankii ugu horreeyay ee dhalinyaro ah ee laba jeer laga saaro tartankan.
Cubarsí, oo 19 jir ah, ayaa helay kaarkiisii labaad ee casaanka xilli ciyaareedkan kulankii ay la ciyaarayeen Atletico Madrid lugta hore ee quarter-final-ka. Horey ayuu sidoo kale casaan u qaatay kulankii Benfica.
Arrinta ayaa sii xumaatay markii Atletico ay si toos ah uga faa’iideysatay qaladkii, iyagoo gool ka dhaliyay laadkii xorta ahaa ee ka dhashay casaanka.
Casaankan ayaa ka dhigay Barcelona inay 10 ciyaaryahan ku sii ciyaarto xilli aad muhiim u ah, taasoo saameyn weyn ku yeelatay natiijada kulanka iyo qorshaha tababare Hansi Flick.
Inkastoo Cubarsí uu ka mid yahay ciyaartoyda ugu wanaagsan Barcelona xilli ciyaareedkan, labada kaar ee casaanka ah waxay muujinayaan inuu wali u baahan yahay inuu xakameeyo ciyaartiisa, gaar ahaan kulamada waaweyn ee Yurub.

headline: Maxay Tahay Taariikhda Weyn Ee Mbappe Uu Sameeyay Kulankii Bayern?

Xiddiga Faransiiska ayaa ku biiray liis gaar ah oo ay ku jiraan halyeeyo sida Cristiano Ronaldo iyo Lionel Messi, kadib markii uu gool dhaliyay kulankii 2-1 loogu awood sheegtay ee ka dhacay Santiago Bernabéu.
Inkasta oo Madrid laga adkaaday kulankaas, iyadoo goolasha ay ka yimaadeen Luis Diaz iyo Harry Kane, haddana Mbappe wuxuu gaaray rikoor shaqsiyeed oo weyn.
Mbappe ayaa hore u dhaliyay 13 gool wareega group-yada, wuxuuna hadda gaaray 14 guud ahaan tartanka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Ciyaartoyda kale ee taariikhda sameeyay rikoodhkan waxaa ka mid ah:
Jose Altafini
Ruud van Nistelrooy
Robert Lewandowski
Karim Benzema
Inkasta oo guuldarro timid, Mbappe wuxuu sii muujinayaa inuu yahay mid ka mid ah weeraryahanada ugu halista badan ee kubadda cagta casriga ah.

headline: Barcelona Oo Lagu Garaacay Gurigeeda Kadib Casaan Uu Waqti Hore Qaatay Cubarsi
body:
Kooxda Atletico Madrid ayaa guul weyn ka gaartay Barcelona, kadib markii ay 2-0 ku badisay lugta hore ee quarter-final-ka UEFA Champions League oo lagu ciyaaray Camp Nou.
Ciyaarta ayaa si weyn isu beddeshay daqiiqaddii 42aad markii daafaca Barcelona Pau Cubarsi la siiyay kaarka cas, taasoo ku qasabtay kooxda Catalan-ka inay 10 ciyaaryahan ku sii ciyaarto.
Atletico ayaa si degdeg ah uga faa’iideysatay xaaladdaas, iyadoo Julian Alvarez uu dhaliyay goolka koowaad daqiiqaddii 45aad si uu hogaanka ugu dhiibo kooxdiisa kahor nasashada.
Qeybtii labaad, Atletico ayaa sii xoojisay guushooda markii Alexander Sorloth uu dhaliyay goolka labaad daqiiqaddii 70aad, kadib baas fiican oo uu ka helay Rodrigo Riquelme.
Guushan ayaa siinaysa Atletico Madrid faa’iido weyn ka hor lugta labaad ee lagu ciyaari doono Metropolitano Stadium 14-ka April, halkaas oo lagu go’aamin doono kooxda u gudbeysa semi-final-ka.

headline: PSG Oo Si Xarago Leh U Garaacday Liverpool
body:
Kooxda Paris Saint-Germain ayaa qaaday tallaabo weyn oo ay ugu sii dhowaaneyso semi-final-ka UEFA Champions League, kadib markii ay 2-0 ku garaacday Liverpool lugta hore ee quarter-final-ka.
Kulanka oo ka dhacay Parc des Princes, PSG ayaa si xoog leh ku bilaabatay ciyaarta, iyadoo goolka koowaad uu ka yimid Desire Doue daqiiqaddii 11aad, kadib orod iyo xirfad uu kaga dhex baxay difaaca Liverpool, kuna dhameystiray kubad xoog leh oo shabaqa gashay.

headline: Paul Scholes Oo Magacaabay Kooxda Ugu Awoodda Badan Dunida Waqti Xaadir Kaan
body:
Halyeeyga Manchester United, Paul Scholes, ayaa ku tilmaamay Paris Saint-Germain inay tahay “kooxda ugu fiican adduunka” waqti xaadirkan.
Scholes ayaa si weyn u ammaanay kooxda ku guuleysatay UEFA Champions League sanadkii 2025, isagoo yiri:
“PSG waa cajiib. Weli waxaan filayaa inay ka gudbi doonaan Liverpool, inkastoo aysan iga yaabin doonin haddii Liverpool ay guuleysato, laakiin hadda ma arko taas.”
Wuxuu si cad u sheegay:
“Hadda, PSG waa kooxda ugu fiican adduunka.”
Si kastaba, tababaraha PSG, Luis Enrique, ayaa hoos u dhigay hadalkaas, isagoo sheegay in aysan jirin koox si cad uga sarreysa kuwa kale marxaladdan tartanka.
Kulanka u dhexeeya PSG iyo Liverpool ee quarter-final-ka ayaa noqon doona imtixaan dhab ah oo lagu qiimeeyo haddii PSG ay runtii tahay kooxda ugu awoodda badan waqtigan.

headline: Carragher Oo Shaaciyay Hal Caqabad Oo Arsenal Ka Hor Istaagi Karta Inay Koob Ku Guuleysato Xilli Ciyaareed Kaan
body:
Halyeeygii hore ee Liverpool, Jamie Carragher, ayaa qirtay inuu leeyahay “walaac weyn” oo ku saabsan Arsenal, xilli cadaadis sii kordhaya uu hareeyay kooxda.
Carragher wuxuu sheegay in cabsi dhab ah ay ka dhex jirto taageerayaasha Arsenal, taasoo laga yaabo inay gudaha kooxda lafteeda gaartay:
“Waxaa jirta cabsi dhab ah oo ay qabaan taageerayaasha Arsenal… waxay dareemayaan in wax walba ay burbur qarka u saaran yihiin” ayuu yiri.
Wuxuu xitaa bixiyay tusaale qosol leh oo muujinaya heerka walwalka:
“Subaxdii waxaan la hadlay qof bangi jooga, wuxuuna i weydiiyay su’aal, markiiba waan fahmay inuu taageere Arsenal yahay! Waxaan noqday sidii dhakhtar cilmu nafsi oo kale, waan dejiyay.”
Carragher ayaa ka digay in waxa ugu weyn ee laga walwalo uu yahay haddii cadaadiskaas uu gudaha kooxda ka jiro:
“Walaaca ugu weyn waa haddii dareenkaas uu ka jiro gudaha kooxda.”
Inkasta oo Mikel Arteta iyo kooxdiisu wali ku jiraan tartanka Premier League iyo UEFA Champions League, hadalka Carragher wuxuu muujinayaa in dhinaca maskaxda uu noqon karo caqabadda ugu weyn ee Arsenal ka hor inta aysan gaarin guulo waaweyn.

headline: Musiibo: 8 Xiddig Oo Liverpool Ah Oo Seegaya Kulanka PSG
body:
Kooxda Liverpool ayaa wajahaysa xaalad dhaawacyo culus ah ka hor kulanka adag ee ay la ciyaarayaan Paris Saint-Germain lugta hore ee quarter-final-ka UEFA Champions League.
Tababare Arne Slot ayaa xaqiijiyay in ilaa 8 ciyaaryahan ay halis ugu jiraan inay seegaan kulankan muhiimka ah.
War wanaagsan ayaa ah in Alexander Isak uu kusoo laabtay kooxda kadib 15 toddobaad oo uu ku maqnaa dhaawac lugta ah, balse lama filayo inuu ku soo bilowdo:
“Wuxuu sameeyay toddobaad tababar ah, wuu ciyaari karaa qayb, laakiin kuma bilaaban doono,” ayuu yiri Slot.
Si kastaba, Liverpool ayaa weyn doonta dhowr ciyaaryahan oo muhiim ah, oo ay ka mid yihiin:
Alisson Becker
Conor Bradley
Wataru Endo
Stefan Bajcetic
Giovanni Leoni
Dhinaca PSG, tababaraha Luis Enrique ayaa sidoo kale xaqiijiyay maqnaanshaha:
Bradley Barcola
Fabian Ruiz
Quentin Ndjantou
Enrique ayaa sheegay in Barcola wali uusan diyaar buuxa ahayn:
“Haddii uusan si fiican u dareemin, ma ciyaari doono. Wuxuu wali raadinayaa kalsooni.”
Kulankan ka dhacaya Parc des Princes ayaa noqon doona mid tijaabo u ah qoto-dheeraanta labada kooxood, iyadoo labada dhinac ay doonayaan inay gaaraan semi-final-ka Champions League.

headline: Saddex Xiddig Oo Liverpool Muhiim U Ah Oo Khatar Ugu Jira Inay Seegaan Kulanka Lugta Labaad Ee PSG
body:
Kooxda Liverpool ayaa wajahaysa xaalad adag ka hor kulanka ay la ciyaarayaan Paris Saint-Germain ee UEFA Champions League, iyadoo saddex ciyaaryahan oo muhiim ah ay hal kaar u jiraan ganaax.
Virgil van Dijk, Ryan Gravenberch, iyo Curtis Jones ayaa dhammaantood haysta labo kaar oo jaalle ah. Haddii ay helaan hal kale kulanka PSG, waxay seegi doonaan lugta labaad ee quarter-final-ka.
Kaararkaas waxay heleen wareegii 16-ka markaasoo ay la ciyaareen Galatasaray, taasoo ka dhigaysa xaaladdooda mid khatar ah xilli muhiim ah oo tartanka ah.
Sidoo kale, Conor Bradley isna wuxuu haystaa labo kaar, balse kama qeyb qaadan doono maadaama uu dhaawac ku seegayo inta ka dhiman xilli ciyaareedka.
Xeerarka UEFA ayaa dhigaya in ciyaaryahan kasta oo gaaro saddex kaar jaalle ah la ganaaxo hal kulan, iyadoo kaararka la tiro kaliya marka laga gudbo wareega quarter-final-ka.
Dhinaca PSG, iyaguna waxay leeyihiin walwal la mid ah, iyadoo Nuno Mendes iyo Khvicha Kvaratskhelia ay sidoo kale hal kaar u jiraan ganaax ka hor lugta labaad ee Anfield.
Arrintan waxay ka dhigeysaa kulanka mid xasaasi ah, maadaama ciyaartoy muhiim ah ay isku dayayaan inay ka fogaadaan qaladaad keeni kara inay seegaan kulanka go’aaminta ah.

headline: Chelsea Oo Go’aan Lama Filaan Ah Ka Soo Saartay Mustaqbalka Marc Cucurella
body:
Kooxda Chelsea ayaa qorsheyneysa isbeddel weyn oo ka dhaca booska daafaca bidix, iyadoo la filayo inay iibiso Marc Cucurella xagaagan.
Wararka ayaa sheegaya in Chelsea ay bartilmaameedsaneyso inay dib u soo ceshato ciyaaryahankeedii hore Lewis Hall, kaasoo hadda ka tirsan Newcastle United. Hall ayaa si weyn u soo jiitay indhaha kooxo badan kadib qaab ciyaareedkiisa wanaagsan xilli ciyaareedkan.
Chelsea ayaa la tartameysa Manchester City iyo Arsenal si ay u hesho saxiixa Hall, iyadoo loo arko xiddig da’yar oo awood u leh inuu xalliyo dhibaatooyinka ka jira dhinaca bidix ee kooxda.
Heshiiskan ayaa sidoo kale ujeedadiisu tahay:
-In la xasiliyo booska daafaca bidix
-In la yareeyo mushaharka kooxda (iyadoo la iibinayo Cucurella)
-In la dhiso mustaqbal leh ciyaartoy da’yar oo tayo leh
Si kastaba, Newcastle United ma fududeyn doonto bixitaanka Hall, maadaama ay heshiiskiisa cusbooneysiisay ilaa 2029, waxaana la filayaa inay dalbato ku dhawaad £70 milyan.
Chelsea waxay rajeyneysaa in soo laabashada Hall ay noqoto fariin muujinaysa hamiga kooxda iyo dhisidda aqoonsi cusub, iyadoo la helayo ciyaaryahan awood u leh inuu hoggaamiyo daafaca bidix sanadaha soo socda.

body:

Kooxda Inter Miami oo uu qayb ka yahay David Beckham iyo sidoo kale Napoli ayaa muujisay xiisaha ay u qabto daafacan.

headline: Max Dowman Oo Jebiyay Rikoodh Waalli Ah Oo Uu Yamal Horay Uga Dhigay Tartanka Champions League
body:
Da’yarka Arsenal, Max Dowman, ayaa habeenkii Talaadada dhigay rikoor cusub oo UEFA Champions League ah, kadib markii uu noqday ciyaaryahankii ugu da’da yaraa ee ka ciyaara wareegyada isreeb reebka.
Dowman, oo jira 16 sano iyo 97 maalmood, ayaa jabiyay rikoor uu hore u haystay Lamine Yamal oo ka tirsan Barcelona, kaasoo 16 sano iyo 223 maalmood jiray markii uu wajahayay Napoli sanadkii 2024.
Tababare Mikel Arteta ayaa kursiga keydka ka soo geliyay Dowman intii lagu jiray kulankii ay la yeesheen Sporting CP, iyadoo Arsenal ay raadineysay natiijo wanaagsan lugta hore ee quarter-final-ka.
Xilli ciyaareedkan, Dowman ayaa si joogto ah u jebinaya rikoorro. Bishii hore, wuxuu dhaliyay gool cajiib ah kulankii ay 2-0 kaga badiyeen Everton, isagoo noqday ciyaaryahankii ugu da’da yaraa ee abid gool ka dhaliya Premier League.
Tani waxay muujineysaa in Arsenal ay heshay xiddig mustaqbal weyn leh oo si degdeg ah uga soo baxaya safka koowaad.

headline: Thierry Henry Oo Magacaabay Kooxda Ugu Awoodda Badan Tartanka Champions League Sanad Kaan
body:
Halyeeygii hore ee Arsenal, Thierry Henry, ayaa ku tilmaamay kooxda Gunners “tan ugu adkaysiga badan” tartanka UEFA Champions League xilli ciyaareedkan.
Arsenal ayaa muujisay difaac adag, iyadoo kaliya 5 gool laga dhaliyay 11 kulan oo Champions League ah, halka horyaalka Premier League 22 gool oo keliya laga dhaliyay 31 kulan. Bandhigyada cajiibka ah ee goolhayaha David Raya ayaa door weyn ka ciyaaray arrintan.
Henry ayaa yiri:
“Aniga ahaan waa kooxda ugu adag Champions League.”
Si kastaba, wuxuu sidoo kale tilmaamay meelaha ay Arsenal ku xoog badan tahay, inkastoo ay horseedi karto dood; Wuxuu leeyahay Henry Arsenal waxay ku xoogan tahay kubadaha taagan (set-pieces).
“Dadku way ka cabanayaan, laakiin waa qayb ka mid ah ciyaarta, waana waa wax faa’iido weyn u ah Arsenal, sababtoo ah aad bay ugu fiican yihiin,” ayuu raaciyay.
Inkasta oo uu si cad u ammaanay difaaca iyo nidaamka kooxda uu hoggaamiyo Mikel Arteta, hadalka Henry wuxuu muujinayaa in Arsenal ay wali u baahan tahay dheelitirnaan si ay ugu guuleysato koobka.

headline: Patrice Evra: “Man City Kuma Guuleysan Lahayn Wax Koob Ah, Haddii…….”
body:
Daaficii hore ee Manchester United, Patrice Evra, ayaa aaminsan in Manchester City aysan waligeed noqon lahayn awood weyn haddii aysan la saxiixan Carlos Tevez sanadkii 2009.
U wareegista Tevez ee City ayaa ahayd mid si weyn u gilgishay kubadda cagta England, iyadoo Evra uu qirtay inay si weyn u dhaawacday United.
“Waxay ahayd mid xanuun badan… qalbi jab,” ayuu yiri Evra.
Tevez ayaa ka tagay United kadib guuldarradii final-ka UEFA Champions League ee ay kala kulmeen Barcelona, iyadoo khilaaf uu kala dhex-galay tababarihii waqtigaas Sir Alex Ferguson.
Evra xitaa wuxuu xusay inuu si caro leh ula xiriiray Tevez:
“Waan wacay, waxaanan ku iri waan ku dili doonaa, lugaha ayaan kaa jebin doonaa.”
Si kastaba, wuxuu aaminsan yahay in saxiixaas uu wax walba beddelay:
“Haddii Tevez uusan ku biiri lahayn City, uma maleynayo inay xitaa bilaabi lahaayeen inay ku guuleystaan horyaalka.”
Tevez ayaa si degdeg ah u muujiyay qiimihiisa, isagoo ka caawiyay City inay ku guuleystaan FA Cup 2011;  koobkoodii ugu horreeyay muddo 35 sano ah iyo sidoo kale horyaalkii Premier League ee 2012.
Hadalkan Evra wuxuu muujinayaa sida hal saxiix uu u beddeli karo taariikhda koox, isla markaana u dhisi karto xukun dheer oo guulo ah.

headline: Alvaro Arbeloa: “Meel Kasto Real Madrid Awood Wey Ku Sheegan Kartaa”
body:
Tababaraha Real Madrid, Alvaro Arbeloa, ayaa muujiyay kalsoonida uu ku qabo kooxdiisa ka dib guuldarradii 2-1 ee lugtii hore ka soo gaartay Bayern Munich.
“Waxaan halista qaadannay markii ay ahayd 1-2, sababtoo ah 1-3 waxay ka dhignaan lahayd in arrintu adkaan lahayd. Waxaan leenahay rajo: Real Madrid waxay ku guuleysan kartaa garoon kasta,” ayuu Arbeloa yiri.
Markii la weydiiyay hadal uu la yeeshay Vinicius Junior daqiiqadii 70aad, Arbeloa ayaa sheegay: “Haa, waxaan u sheegay in hal gool kaliya loo baahan yahay si aan u sii jirno, oo aanu lumin kalsoonida.”
Kooxda Real Madrid ayaa soo galaysa lugta labaad iyadoo hal gool u baahan si ay ugu qasbaan Bayern waqtiga dheeriga ah. Waxay u baahan doonaan labo gool si ay si toos ah ugu guuleystaan kulanka oo ay u soo baxaan.

headline: “Liverpool Waxa Ku Dhaca, Waqti Dheer Waa Laga sheekeyn Doonaa”
body:
Xiddigii hore ee France, Christophe Dugarry, ayaa saadaaliyay guul dhinac kaliya ah oo ay Paris Saint-Germain ka gaari doonto Liverpool kulanka UEFA Champions League ee wareega siddeed dhammaadka toddobaadkan.
Kooxda uu tababaro Arne Slot, Reds, ayaa dhawaan guuldarro weyn 4-0 ah kala kulantay Manchester City tartanka FA Cup-ka, iyadoo Mohamed Salah uu seegay fursad dahabi ah.
Dugarry, oo ku guuleystay Koobka Adduunka 1998, ayaa sheegay in ay Liverpool fursad yar ka haystaan la kulanka PSG oo hadda awood weyn leh.
“Miyaan arkin hab ciyaareedka Liverpool? Waa musiibo dhab ah! Waxba ma hayaan. Inkastoo ay heystaan ciyaartoy farsamo yaqaan ah oo aan kala dhicin, xawaarahoodu aad buu gaabis u yahay.
“Markaad aragto xamaasadda PSG maanta, adkaysiga maskaxeed, iyo waxa ay dib u dhiseen… labada koox la isma barbardhigi karo. Waxay noqon doontaa guul dhinac kaliya ah! Dhab ahaantii waa sida adigoo meyd garaacaya”
Kulamadii hore ee tartankan, Reds ayaa laga saaray wareega 16-ka, ka dib markii ay guul 1-0 ah ka gaareen PSG lugta hore, laakiin lugtii labaad ayay Liverpool gurigeeda ku lumisay, taasoo ugu dambeyn sababtay inay harto.

headline: Arsenal Oo Sameysay Taariikh Kadib Kulankii Sporting
body:
Arsenal ayaa rikoodh cusub dhigtay ka dib markii ay guul ka gaareen Sporting CP lugtii hore ee UEFA Champions League.
Kooxda hoggaamineysa Premier League ayaa Talaadadii guul 1-0 ah ka gaartay Sporting CP, iyadoo Kai Havertz uu gool xiray waqtigii dheeriga ahaa taasoo Gunners u horseeday faa’iido lugta hore ka hor kulanka lugta labaad.
Si kastaba, sida lagu xusay OptaJoe, guushii Arsenal ee Sporting; waxay iftiimisay rikoodh cusub: kooxda ayaa 38 gool iyo caawin ka sameeysay beddellada xilli ciyaareedkan tartamada oo dhan (24 gool, 14 caawin), taas oo ka badan koox kasta oo ka tirsan shanta horyaal ee waaweyn ee Yurub.
Sidoo kale, Arsenal waa kooxda kaliya ee aan wali laga badin Champions League xilli ciyaareedkan.
Kooxda uu tababaro Mikel Arteta ayaa hadda wajihi doonta Bournemouth kulanka Premier League ee soo socda xilli ciyaareedkan.

headline: Kai Havertz Oo Magacaabay Goolhayihii Ugu Fiicnaa Dunida Labadii Xilli Ciyaareed Ee Ugu Dambeysay
body:
Weeraryahanka Arsenal, Kai Havertz, ayaa si weyn u amaanay goolhayaha kooxdiisa, David Raya kadib guushii 1-0 ee ay ka gaareen Sporting CP, lugtii hore ee quarter-final-ka UEFA Champions League.
Havertz ayaa Raya ku tilmaamay mid heer sare ah, isagoo xusay in aan wali si buuxda loo qadarin:
“Waa wax aan la rumaysan karin. Weli si buuxda loogama qadariyo kubadda cagta adduunka, laakiin aniga ahaan labadii xilli ciyaareed ee ugu dambeeyay waa goolhayaha ugu fiican adduunka.”
Wuxuu intaas ku daray in Raya uu kooxda badbaadiyay marar badan:
“Waa ciyaaryahan cajiib ah, marar badan ayuu na badbaadiyay, aad ayaana ugu faraxsanahay inaan haysanno.”
Hadalka Havertz ayaa muujinaya doorka muhiimka ah ee Raya ku leeyahay guulaha Arsenal, gaar ahaan kulamada waaweyn ee Champions League.

headline: Nicky Butt Oo Saadaaliyay Cidda Noqoneysa Tababaraha Joogtada Ah Ee Manchester United
body:
Halyeeygii hore ee Manchester United, Nicky Butt, ayaa aaminsan in Michael Carrick uu yahay musharraxa ugu dhow ee loo magacaabi karo tababaraha joogtada ah ee kooxda.
Butt ayaa sheegay in Carrick uu yahay “doorashada ugu fudud”, maadaama uusan jirin tababare kale oo si cad uga horeeya tartanka xilkan.
Carrick ayaa kooxda ula wareegay si ku-meel-gaar ah kadib markii la ceyriyay Ruben Amorim, halka Darren Fletcher uu si kumeel-gaar ah u maamulayay laba kulan.
Markii uu yimid Carrick, United waxay ku jireen kaalinta 6-aad, balse si degdeg ah ayuu u beddelay xaaladda kooxda. Wuxuu ku hoggaamiyay guulo waaweyn oo ay ka gaareen Manchester City iyo Arsenal, taasoo keentay taxane 7 kulan ah oo aan laga badin.
Haatan, United waxay fadhiyaan kaalinta 3-aad, iyagoo haatan xaqiijiyay booskooda u soo bixitaanka UEFA Champions League.
Butt ayaa yiri:
“Haddii aan Michael la siin shaqada, yaa kale oo la siinayaa? Ma jiro qof si cad u muuqda. Wuxuu qabtay shaqo fiican, wuxuuna si fiican u yaqaanaa kooxda.”
Si kastaba, maamulka Manchester United wali ma aysan gaarin go’aan rasmi ah oo ku aadan mustaqbalka Carrick, iyadoo la filayo in doodda ku saabsan tababaraha cusub ay sii socoto maalmaha soo socda.

headline: Supercomputer Oo Saadaaliyay Kooxda Ku Guulaysan Doonta Champions League Xilli Ciyaareedkan.
body:

Inkasta oo Gunners-ku ay dhawaan ka hareen Carabao Cup iyo FA Cup, haddana Opta waxay siisay fursad dhan 27.7% inay ku guuleystaan Champions League, taasoo ka sarreysa Bayern Munich oo heysata fursad 20.9%.
Kooxda uu hoggaamiyo Mikel Arteta ayaa Sporting CP garaacday lugtii hore ee quarter-final-ka, iyadoo natiijada kulankan ay dhabbada u xaartay fursadaha Arsenal ee ku guuleysiga tartanka.
Dhanka kale, Barcelona oo uu tababaro Hansi Flick ayaa sidoo kale loo arkaa mid aad ugu dhow inay u gudubto semi-final-ka, iyadoo la siiyay 68% fursad ay kaga gudbi karto wareegan.
SuperComputer-ka ayaa xitaa saadaaliyay in Arsenal ay la ciyaari doonto Barcelona semi-final-ka, taasoo noqon karta mid ka mid ah kulamada ugu waaweyn tartanka haddii ay dhacdo.

headline: Joao Cancelo Oo Magacaabay Xiddiga Ugu Firfircoon Barcelona
body:
Daafaca Barcelona, Joao Cancelo, ayaa amaanay saaxiibkiis Gavi, isagoo ku tilmaamay “ruuxda kooxda”.
Cancelo ayaa hadalkan ka sheegay shir jaraa’id ka hor kulanka UEFA Champions League ee ay la ciyaarayaan Atletico Madrid.
Wuxuu yiri Gavi waa ciyaaryahan aad u firfircoon oo farxad badan, isla markaana saameyn weyn ku leh kooxda:
“Waa nin aad u farxad badan, wuxuuna keenaa tamar iyo dhiirigelin dheeraad ah oo gudaha kooxda.”
Gavi ayaa ka mid ah ciyaartoyda ugu muhiimsan Barcelona, isagoo kasoo baxay akadeemiyada kooxda kadib markii uu ka yimid Real Betis sanadkii 2015, waxaana loo dalacsiiyay kooxda koowaad sanadkii 2021.
Hadalka Cancelo ayaa muujinaya sida Gavi uu u yahay laf-dhabarta ruuxiga ah ee kooxda, gaar ahaan kulamada waaweyn ee u baahan tamar iyo dagaal badan.

headline: Luis Enrique Oo Saadaaliyay Kooxda Ku Guuleysaneysa Champions League Sanad Kaan
body:
Tababaraha Paris Saint-Germain, Luis Enrique, ayaa si cad u sheegay in aysan jirin koox si rasmi ah loogu tilmaami karo inay tahay tan ugu cadcad ku guuleysiga UEFA Champions League xilli ciyaareedkan.
Enrique ayaa hadalkan sheegay ka hor kulanka adag ee ay la leeyihiin Liverpool ee ka dhacaya Paris.
Wuxuu yiri:
“Sanadkii hore Liverpool ayaa loo arkayay kuwa ugu cadcad, yaase ku guuleystay? PSG. Ma jiraan kooxo la dhihi karo waa kuwa ugu cadcad marxaladdan.”
Wuxuu intaas ku daray:
“Annaguna kuwa ugu cadcad ma nihin.”
Hadalka Enrique ayaa muujinaya sida tartanka Champions League uu u yahay mid aan la saadaalin karin, gaar ahaan marka la gaaro wareegyada dambe, halkaas oo koox kasta ay leedahay fursad ay ku gaari karto guul.
Paris Saint-Germain ayaa ah kooxda difaacaneysa koobka, taasoo ka dhigaysa inay si gaar ah indhaha loogu hayo kulanka ay la ciyaarayaan Liverpool.

headline: Giggs Iyo Rio Oo Isku Raacay: Labada Xiddig Ee Loo Baahan Yahay Inay Beddelaan Casemiro Iyo Ugarte!
body:

Ferdinand ayaa aaminsan in Anderson uu si fiican ula jaanqaadi karo Kobbie Mainoo, isagoo yiri:
“Guimaraes iyo Tonali ma ahan xulashadayda koowaad. Waxaan doorbidayaa Elliot Anderson. Waa 23 jir, da’diisu waa muhiim, waxaan rabaa ciyaartoy da’yar oo gaajeysan.”

Tani waxay muujineysaa in Manchester United ay si weyn u qorsheyneyso dib-u-dhis khadka dhexe ah xagaagan.

headline: 5 Boos Oo Rasmi Ah! Premier League Oo Helay Warkii Ugu Weynaa Xilli Ciyaareedka.
body:
Premier League ayaa mar kale xaqiijiyay inuu heli doono shan boos oo UEFA Champions League ah xilli ciyaareedka soo socda.
Arrintan ayaa la xaqiijiyay kadib markii Arsenal ay 1-0 kaga badisay Sporting CP lugta hore ee wareega sideed dhammaadka.
Goolka guusha waxaa dhaliyay Kai Havertz, kadib markii uu si fiican u xakameeyay kubad uu ka helay Gabriel Martinelli.
Natiijadan waxay ka dhigan tahay in kooxda ku dhameysata kaalinta shanaad ee horyaalka England ay si toos ah ugu soo bixi doonto Champions League, taasoo ah sanadkii labaad oo xiriir ah oo EPL uu helo boos dheeri ah, maadaama ay hoggaamineyso qiimeynta waxqabadka Yurub.
Haatan, Liverpool ayaa ku jirta kaalinta shanaad, iyadoo hal dhibic oo keliya ka sarreysa Chelsea oo ku jirta kaalinta lixaad, taasoo ka dhigaysa tartanka booska Champions League mid aad u kulul.

headline: Champions League: Shaxda Ay Liverpool Kaga Hor Tagi Karto PSG
body:
Liverpool ayaa rajeynaysa inay dib u hesho weeraryahankeeda Alexander Isak kulanka adag ee ay la leeyihiin Paris Saint-Germain ee UEFA Champions League.
Isak ayaa maqnaa muddo dheer kadib dhaawac culus oo canqowga ah oo qaliin u baahday, kaasoo soo gaaray kulan ay liverpool wajahaysay Tottenham Hotspur bishii December.
Hadda, weeraryahanka Sweden ayaa dib ugu soo laabtay tababarka kooxda, inkastoo uu ka maqnaa kulankii 4-0 lagu xaaqay ee FA Cup-ka. Tababare Arne Slot ayaa sheegay in go’aanka lagu daahiyay soo laabashadiisa uu ahaa mid wadajir ah oo ay qaateen kooxda caafimaadka iyo ciyaaryahanka.
Slot ayaa yiri:
“Waxaan rajeynaynay inuu xitaa kursiga keydka joogo, laakiin waxaan dooranay inuu qaato tababarro dheeraad ah halkii uu si degdeg ah ugu ciyaari lahaa kulan culus.”
Safka la filayo ee Liverpool:
Mamardashvili; Gomez, Konate, Van Dijk, Kerkez; Mac Allister, Gravenberch; Mohamed Salah, Dominik Szoboszlai, Ekitike; Wirtz
Xaaladda ciyaartoyda:
Dhaawac: Bradley, Leoni, Endo, Alisson Becker
Shaki: Isak
Kulankan muhiimka ah ayaa la ciyaari doonaa Arbaco, 10:00 fiidnimo (EAT), iyadoo Liverpool ay rajeynayso inay natiijo wanaagsan ka keento Paris.

headline: Champions League: Shaxda Ay Barcelona Kaga Hor Tagi Karto Atletico Madrid
body:
Barcelona ayaa habeenka Arbacada ku soo dhoweyn doonta Atletico Madrid garoonka Camp Nou, kulan ka tirsan lugta hore ee wareega sideed dhammaadka UEFA Champions League.
Barcelona ayaa kalsooni badan kusoo galeysa kulankan kadib guushii 2-1 ee ay dhowaan ka gaareen Atletico Madrid, taasoo kor u qaadaysa niyadda kooxda.
Tababare Hansi Flick ayaa la filayaa inuu isticmaalo nidaamka 4-2-3-1, isagoo sameyn doona isbedello yar yar si uu u helo dheelitirnaan iyo tamar cusub.
Line-up-ka la filayo ee Barcelona (4-2-3-1):
Goolhaye: Joan Garcia
Difaac: Cancelo, Martin, Cubarsi,Kounde
Khadka dhexe: Eric Garcia, Pedri
Weerarka dhexe: Rashford, Fermin, Yamal
Afka hore: Robert Lewandowski
Lewandowski ayaa hoggaamin doona weerarka, halka ciyaartoyda da’da yar sida Yamal iyo Pedri ay keeni doonaan xawaare iyo firfircooni.
Kulankan ayaa muhiim u ah labada kooxood, iyadoo Barcelona ay doonayso inay faa’iido ka hesho garoonkeeda ka hor lugta labaad.

headline: Manchester United Oo Dalabkeedii Ugu Horreeyay Ka Gudbisay Xiddig Ay Liverpool U Calaamadsatay Beddelka Salah
body:
Manchester United ayaa la sheegay inay gudbisay dalabkeedii ugu horreeyay si ay u soo qaadato xiddiga da’da yar ee RB Leipzig, Yan Diomande.
Weeraryahankan 19-jirka ah ayaa si weyn u soo jiitay indhaha kooxaha Yurub kadib qaab ciyaareed cajiib ah oo uu ka sameeyay Bundesliga, isagoo dhaliyay 11 gool isla markaana sameeyay 8 caawin 30 kulan oo uu ciyaaray.
Kooxo waaweyn sida Arsenal, Barcelona, Bayern Munich, iyo Liverpool ayaa dhammaantood xiiseynaya ciyaaryahanka, iyadoo Liverpool ay u aragto beddelka Mohamed Salah.
United ayaa si gaar ah u doonaysa garab bidix oo dabiici ah, maadaama tababaraha ku meel gaarka ah Michael Carrick uu ka tagay nidaamkii hore ee 3-4-3, isla markaana doonayo inuu xoojiyo weerarka.
Si kastaba, Leipzig ayaa doonaysa inay sii haysato Diomande, iyagoo u bandhigay qandaraas cusub oo mushahar kordhin leh, si ay uga hortagaan kooxaha doonaya. Qiimaha lagu qiimeynayo ciyaaryahanka ayaa gaaraya €80m ilaa €100m, taasoo ka dhigaysa mid ka mid ah bartilmaameedyada ugu qaalisan suuqa xagaagan.

headline: Vinicius Junior Oo Ugu Dambeyntii Daboolka Ka Rogay Sababta Uusan U Macsalaameyn Xabi Alonso
body:
Xiddiga Real Madrid, Vinicius Junior, ayaa shaaciyay sababta uusan u macsalaameyn tababarihii hore Xabi Alonso kadib bixitaankiisa kooxda.
Vinicius ayaa si toos ah u muujiyay in xiriirkooda uusan fiicneyn, isagoo yiri:“Tababare kasta wuxuu leeyahay qaabkiisa, waxaana laga yaabaa inaanan si fiican isu fahmin.”
Wuxuu sidoo kale qirtay in waqtigii Alonso uu ahaa mid adag:“Wuxuu ahaa waqti adag, sababtoo ah waxaan helayay daqiiqado yar. Laakiin wax badan ayaan bartay, waan ka fikiray, hadda waan ka fiicanahay.”
Hadalladan ayaa muujinaya in ay jireen dhibaatooyin gudaha ah oo u dhexeeyay ciyaaryahanka iyo tababaraha, taasoo laga yaabo inay saameysay waqti ciyaareedka Vinicius.
Xabi Alonso ayaa xilka laga qaaday kadib muddo kooban oo uu joogay Bernabeu, iyadoo la sheegay in uu la tacaalayay maareynta ciyaartoyda waaweyn ee kooxda.

headline: Alvaro Arbeloa Oo Magacaabay Kooxda Ugu Joogteynta Fiican Horyaallada Waaweyn Ee Europe
body:
Tababaraha Real Madrid, Alvaro Arbeloa, ayaa ku tilmaamay Bayern Munich kooxda ugu joogtada badan Yurub xilli ciyaareedkan.
Arbeloa ayaa hadalkan sheegay ka hor kulanka adag ee UEFA Champions League ee ay la ciyaarayaan Bayern Munich, isagoo muujiyay ixtiraam weyn uu u hayo kooxda Jarmalka.
Wuxuu yiri:
“Bayern waa kooxda ugu joogtada badan Yurub xilli ciyaareedkan. Waan ognahay khatarta ay leeyihiin, taariikhda naga dhaxaysa waa mid gaar ah.”
Wuxuu sidoo kale ka hadlay jawiga Santiago Bernabeu:
“Bernabéu wuxuu diyaar u yahay habeen kale oo weyn oo Champions League ah; sida kii aan la ciyaarnay Manchester City. Waxaan rajeynayaa inaan aragno sixirkaas mar kale.”
Real Madrid ayaa kulankan soo galaysa iyadoo kalsooni qabta kadib markii ay ka soo gudbeen Manchester City wareegii hore, balse waxay wajahayaan imtixaan adag oo ka dhan ah Bayern Munich oo qaab ciyaareed fiican ku jirta.

headline: ​”Keena Weeraryahan!”: Lamine Yamal Oo Fariin Naxdin Leh U Diray Maamulka Barcelona – Yaa Imaanaya?
body:
Xiddiga da’da yar ee Barcelona, Lamine Yamal, ayaa la sheegay inuu si cad uga codsaday maamulka kooxda inay keenaan weeraryahan heer sare ah xagaagan.
Wararka ayaa tilmaamaya in Yamal uu aaminsan yahay in booska weerarka dhexe uu yahay dhibaatada ugu weyn ee kooxda, isla markaana uu doonayo xal degdeg ah.
Haatan, Robert Lewandowski ayaa weli ah weeraryahanka koowaad ee uu ku tiirsan yahay tababare Hansi Flick, balse mustaqbalkiisa ayaa shaki ku jira iyadoo laga yaabo inuu tago marka qandaraaskiisu dhamaado.
Barcelona ayaa durba la xiriirtay weeraryahanno dhowr ah sida Julian Alvarez, Serhou Guirassy, Dusan Vlahovic, iyo Fisnik Asllani.
Sidoo kale, bixitaanka suurtagalka ah ee Ferran Torres ayaa sii kordhinaya baahida loo qabo weeraryahan cusub.
Inkasta oo ay jiraan dhibaatooyin dhaqaale, Barcelona ayaa la filayaa inay mudnaanta siiso saxiixa weeraryahan cusub, iyadoo codsiga Yamal uu sii kordhiyay cadaadiska lagu doonayo in xal looga gaaro arrintan.

headline: “Liverpool Waa La Ceebeyn Doonaa Kulanka PSG”
body:
Halyeeygii hore ee Faransiiska, Christophe Dugarry, ayaa si adag u dhaleeceeyay Liverpool, isagoo sheegay in Paris Saint-Germain ay si fudud uga badin doonto kulanka UEFA Champions League.
Dugarry ayaa xitaa ku tilmaamay Liverpool “musiibo,” isagoo sheegay in farqiga u dhexeeya labada koox uu aad u weyn yahay.
Wuxuu yiri:
“Si daacad ah, waxay noqon doontaa ciyaar aad u fudud. Liverpool waxaa heysta musiibo… farqiga tayada aad buu u weyn yahay, PSG-na waxay go’aamin doontaa isreeb-reebka kulanka hore.”
Wuxuu sidoo kale dhaliilay qaabka ciyaarta Liverpool:
“Ma aragteen sida ay u ciyaaraan? Tamar ma leh, xawaare ma leh… inkasta oo ay leeyihiin ciyaartoy tayo leh, haddana si aad gaabis u ah ayay u ciyaaraan.”
Dhanka kale, wuxuu si weyn u ammaanay PSG:
“Markaad aragto firfircoonida iyo kalsoonida ay PSG ku ciyaarayso hadda, tartan ma jiri doono. Waxay noqon doontaa hal dhinac.”
Hadalladan ayaa imanaya kadib markii Liverpool lagu xaaqay 4-0 kulankii FA Cup, taasoo sii kordhisay cadaadiska saaran kooxda Arne Slot kahor safarkooda Paris.

headline: Ciyaartoyda Chelsea Oo Go’aan Lama Filaan Ah Ka Soo Saaray Ganaaxa Enzo Fernandez Ka Hor Kulanka City
body:
Ciyaartoyda Chelsea ayaa la sheegay inay cadaadis saareen tababare Liam Rosenior si uu uga qaado ganaaxa Enzo Fernandez ka hor kulanka adag ee ay la leeyihiin Manchester City.
Fernandez ayaa laga reebay kulankii FA Cup ee ay Chelsea 7-0 ku garaacday Port Vale, iyo sidoo kale kulanka soo socda ee horyaalka, kadib hadallo uu bixiyay oo muujinayay xiisaha uu u qabo Real Madrid, taasoo Rosenior ku tilmaamay inuu “xad gudbay.”
Si kastaba, wararka ayaa sheegaya in saaxiibadiisa kooxda ay u arkaan mid muhiim ah kulanka Manchester City, isla markaana ay doonayaan inuu dib ugu soo laabto safka.
Dhanka kale, ilo ku dhow ciyaaryahanka ayaa sheegaya in mudnaantiisa koowaad ay tahay inuu sii joogo Chelsea, haddii kooxda ay ka xaajoon karto shuruudaha qandaraaskiisa cusub.
Xaaladda Fernandez ayaa weli ah mid aan degganayn, iyadoo kooxo waaweyn oo Yurub ah ay si dhow ula socdaan, taasoo cadaadis kale saaraysa Chelsea ka hor kulamada muhiimka ah ee soo socda.

headline: Rio Ferdinand Oo Shaaca Ka Qaaday Hal Kulan Oo Burburin Kara Rajada Arsenal Ee Ku Guuleysiga Premier League Sanadkan
body:
Halyeeygii hore ee Manchester United, Rio Ferdinand, ayaa ka digay in tartanka horyaalka uu halis gali karo Arsenal haddii ay ku fashilmaan kulankooda soo socda.
Ferdinand wuxuu tilmaamay in kulanka ay la ciyaarayaan Bournemouth uu noqon karo mid go’aan ka gaara rajada Arsenal ee hanashada Premier League.
Wuxuu yiri:
“Haddii aadan badinin kulankaas… waa dhibaato weyn. Kadibna waxaad la ciyaareysaan Manchester City oo qaab ciyaareed fiican ku jirta, wuxuu noqon karaa habeen ka farxiya City”
Arsenal ayaa durba laga reebay labo tartan muddo gaaban gudaheed, kadib guuldarrooyin ka soo gaaray Manchester City (Carabao Cup final) iyo Southampton (FA Cup).
Si kastaba, kooxda Mikel Arteta ayaa weli haysata fursad weyn oo ay ku qaadi karto horyaalka, iyadoo 9 dhibcood ka sareysa Manchester City.
Hase yeeshee, sida Ferdinand sheegay, hal guuldarro ayaa wax walba beddeli karta; gaar ahaan iyadoo jadwal adag uu soo socda.

headline: William Gallas Oo Arsenal Ugu Baaqay Inay Ceyriso Labadan Xiddig, Haddii La Doonayo In Gyokeres Uu Goolal Badan Dhaliyo
body:
Halyeeygii hore ee Arsenal, William Gallas, ayaa kula taliyay kooxdiisii hore inay qadka ka saarto labo kamid ah ciyaartoydeeda si ay uga faa’iideysato Viktor Gyokeres.
Gallas ayaa aaminsan in Arsenal ay u baahan tahay garbo heer sare ah oo si fiican u caawin kara Gyokeres, isagoo si gaar ah u liiday Gabriel Martinelli iyo Leandro Trossard.
Wuxuu yiri:
“Gyokeres wuu dhaliyaa goolal, laakiin waa inuu gaaro ugu yaraan 20 gool xilli ciyaareedka dambe. Way adkaan doontaa haddii ay sidaan u sii ciyaaraan Martinelli iyo Trossard.”
Gallas ayaa sidoo kale shaki geliyay heerka Martinelli:
“Ma garanayo waxa ku dhacay Martinelli—ma aha sidii hore. Trossard-na  wuxuu u baahan yahay wax ka duwan qaab ciyaareedkan.”
Aragtidiisa ayaa ah in haddii aad haysato weeraryahan sida Gyokeres, ay muhiim tahay in la helo ciyaartoy si joogto ah u siiya fursado uu ku dhaliyo goolal.
Gyokeres ayaa ilaa hadda dhaliyay 17 gool tartamada oo dhan tan iyo markii uu kaga yimid Gunners kooxda Sporting CP xagaagii hore, balse wali waxaa laga sugayaa wax badan xilli ciyaareedka dambe.

headline: Rio Ferdinand Oo Magacaabay Saxiixa Ay Ku Qasban Tahay United Iney Sameyso Suuqa Xagaaga; Ma Ahan Tonali
body:
Halyeeyga Manchester United, Rio Ferdinand, ayaa doortay bartilmaameedkiisa koowaad ee suuqa kala iibsiga xagaagan; wuxuuna si cad u taageeray Elliot Anderson.
Ferdinand ayaa aaminsan in xiddiga khadka dhexe ee Nottingham Forest uu si fiican ula jaanqaadi karo Kobbie Mainoo, kaasoo loo arko mustaqbalka United.
Wuxuu yiri:
“Waa Elliot Anderson. Wuxuu jiraa 23 sano… waxaan rabaa ciyaartoy da’yar oo gaajeysan.”
Ferdinand ayaa sharaxay sababta uu u doorbiday Anderson marka loo eego Bruno Guimaraes iyo Sandro Tonali, isagoo tilmaamay da’da iyo tamarta.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray:
“Wuxuu si fiican u dhammaystirayaa Mainoo. Anderson wuxuu leeyahay tamar, dagaal badan, wuxuuna ku fiican yahay soo qaadidda kubadda.”
Xiddigan 23-jirka ah ayaa sidoo kale lagu ammaanay qaab ciyaareedkiisa adag, isagoo xilli ciyaareedkan ku guuleystay tiro badan oo kubado lasoo qaaday.
Iyadoo Casemiro la filayo inuu ka tago Old Trafford, isla markaana mustaqbalka Manuel Ugarte uu shaki ku jiro, United ayaa la filayaa inay si weyn u xoojiso khadka dhexe xagaaga. Anderson-na wuxuu u muuqdaa inuu noqday doorashada ugu sareysa ee Ferdinand.

Fernandez ayaa laga reebay kulamada ay Chelsea la ciyaareyso Port Vale iyo Manchester City, kadib wareysi u muuqday mid albaabka u furaya Real Madrid.
Inkasta oo qaar ay taageereen ganaaxa maadaama uu yahay kabtan ku-xigeenka kooxda, Shearer ayaa aaminsan in Rosenior uu dejiyay “tusaale halis ah.”
Wuxuu yiri:
“Wuxuu isku dayayaa inuu fariin u diro kooxda, laakiin waxaa jira siyaabo kale oo loo sameeyo.”
Shearer ayaa sidoo kale tilmaamay in ganaaxyada lacagta aysan hadda saameyn weyn ku lahayn ciyaartoyda mushaharka sare qaata, balse dhibaatada dhabta ah ay tahay:
“Marka ciyaaryahan kale sidaas sameeyo, waa inuu mar kale ganaaxaa, taas ayaana dhib noqon karta.”
Arrintan ayaa sii hurisay doodda ku saabsan sida loo maareeyo ciyaartoyda waaweyn, iyadoo xaaladda Fernandez ay weli tahay mid aan degganayn kahor kulanka muhiimka ah ee Manchester City.

headline: Liverpool Oo Ceyrineysa Arne Slot, Haddii…..
body:
Wariye The Athletic ee arrimaha Liverpool, James Pearce, ayaa bixiyay digniin culus oo ku saabsan mustaqbalka Arne Slot.
Pearce ayaa sheegay in milkiilayaasha kooxda, Fenway Sports Group (FSG), ay wali doonayaan inay siiyaan Slot waqti uu wax ku hagaajiyo xilli ciyaareedka dambe. Si kastaba, xaaladdaas ayaa noqon karta mid “aan la sii wadi karin” haddii natiijooyinka liita ay sii socdaan.
Guuldarradii cusleyd ee 4-0 ahayd ee ay kala kulmeen Manchester City ee FA Cup ayaa kordhisay cadaadiska, iyadoo taageerayaashu ay sii kordhiyeen dhaliisha tababaraha.
Pearce wuxuu si gaar ah u tilmaamay dhibaatooyin farsamo:
“Waqtigii kadib nasashada ayaa ahaa midka ugu walaaca badan… Liverpool halkii ay ka fiicnaan lahayd way ka sii dartay, sidoo kale beddelada ayuu ka gaabiyay.”
Ugu dambeyn, wuxuu xaaladda ku soo koobay:
“Champions League khallalan oo aan tartan koob kale ku jirin.”
Tani waxay ka dhigan tahay in kulamada ay la leeyihiin Paris Saint-Germain ee UEFA Champions League ay go’aamin karaan mustaqbalka Slot iyo xilli ciyaareedka Liverpool guud ahaan.

headline: Garsooraha Dhex-dhexaadin Doona Kulanka PSG Iyo Liverpool Oo La Shaaciyay
body:
Kulanka weyn ee UEFA Champions League ee dhex mari doona Paris Saint-Germain iyo Liverpool Arbacada ayaa si rasmi ah loo shaaciyay garsoorayaashiisa.
Garsooraha rasmiga ee ciyaarta waxaa noqon doona Jose Maria Sanchez. Waxaa caawin doona laba kaaliye oo kale oo reer Spain ah, Raul Cabanero iyo Inigo Prieto.
Sidoo kale, Juan Martinez Munuera ayaa noqon doona garsooraha afaraad, halka VAR ay maamuli doonaan Carlos del Cerro Grande iyo Guillermo Cuadra Fernandez.
Tani waxay noqon doontaa markii labaad ee Sanchez uu dhex dhexaadiyo kulan ay ciyaarayaan PSG, iyadoo markii ugu horeysay uu garsoore ka ahaa kulankoodii ay la yeesheen Aston Villa xilli ciyaareedkii hore—kulankaas oo ku dhamaaday guuldarro 3-2 ah oo PSG soo gaartay.
Kulankan lugta hore ee quarter-final-ka ayaa ah mid aad muhiim u ah, iyadoo labada kooxood ay doonayaan inay helaan natiijo wanaagsan ka hor lugta labaad.

headline: Arsenal Oo War Farxad Leh Ka Heshay Xaaladda Rice, Gabriel Iyo Trossard Ka Hor Kulanka Sporting
body:
Arsenal ayaa heshay war wanaagsan kahor kulanka adag ee UEFA Champions League ay la ciyaarayaan Sporting CP, kadib markii saddex ciyaaryahan muhiim ah ay dib ugu soo laabteen tababarka.
Declan Rice, Gabriel Magalhaes, iyo Leandro Trossard ayaa dhammaantood lagu arkay tababarka Isniintii, taasoo kor u qaadaysa rajada ah inay diyaar u noqon doonaan kulanka ka dhacaya Lisbon.
Rice ayaa ka maqnaa kulamadii ugu dambeeyay sababo la xiriira dhaawac, halka Gabriel uu tababarka ku soo laabtay inkasta oo uu xanuun jilibka ah dareemay kulankii Southampton. Trossard isna wuxuu kasoo kabanayaa dhaawac sinta ah.
Si kastaba, xaaladda dhaawacyada weli way adag tahay. Bukayo Saka iyo Eberechi Eze ayaan kasoo muuqan tababarka, halka Piero Hincapie iyo Jurrien Timber ay wali dhaawac yihiin.
Kabtan Martin Odegaard ayaa sidoo kale tababarka ku soo laabtay, taasoo ah war kale oo dhiirrigelin leh.
Arsenal ayaa u safri doonta Portugal iyadoo diiradda la saarayo halista ugu weyn ee Viktor Gyokeres, kaasoo wajahaya kooxdiisii hore kulankan muhiimka ah ee ka dhici doona garoonka Estadio Jose Alvalade.

headline: Vinicius Junior Oo Go’aan Culus Ka Soo Saaray Mustaqbalkiisa Real Madrid
body:
Xiddiga Real Madrid, Vinicius Junior, ayaa ka hadlay mustaqbalkiisa kooxda, isagoo muujiyay rabitaan cad oo uu ku sii joogayo Santiago Bernabéu muddo dheer.
“Cusbooneysiinta heshiiska? Waxaan rajeynayaa inaan halkan sii joogo waqti dheer,” ayuu yiri Vinicius.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray:
“Hal sano ayaa ii harsan, laakiin waan degganahay. Waxaan haystaa kalsoonida madaxweynaha. Waqtiga saxda ah ayaan cusbooneysiin doonaa heshiiskeyga, waxaana halkan sii joogi doonaa muddo dheer, sababtoo ah waa kooxda riyadeyda.”
Garabka reer Brazil ayaa cadeeyay daacadnimadiisa, isagoo diiday hadal haynta la xiriirta xiisaha kooxaha kale ee Yurub.
Vinicius ayaa weli ah laf-dhabarta weerarka Real Madrid, wuxuuna diiradda saarayaa inuu kooxda ka caawiyo guulo La Liga iyo UEFA Champions League, isagoo doonaya inuu dhiso taariikh weyn oo uu ku yeesho kooxda.

headline: Gary Lineker Oo Si Weyn U Difaacay Arsenal Kadib Guuldarrooyinkii City Iyo Southampton!
body:
Halyeeygii hore ee xulka England, Gary Lineker, ayaa weli aaminsan in Arsenal ay ku guuleysan doonto Premier League xilli ciyaareedkan, inkasta oo ay ka hareen laba tartan oo waaweyn.
Gunners ayaa rajeynaysay inay qaaddo afar koob, balse waxaa laga qaaday Carabao Cup kadib guuldarro 2-0 ah oo ay kala kulantay Manchester City, halka sidoo kale ay ka hartay FA Cup kadib markii ay 2-1 uga adkaatay Southampton.
Natiijooyinkan ayaa keenay walaac ku saabsan in xilli ciyaareedka Arsenal uu burburo, balse Lineker ayaa ku tilmaamay kaliya “Khalkhal yar.”
Wuxuu yiri:
“Labadii toddobaad ee ugu dambeysay waxay ahaayeen kuwo adag. Dadku waxay is weydiinayaan haddii ay jiraan dhibaato, laakiin waa kaliya hoos u dhac yar.”
Inkasta oo cadaadis uu jiro, Arsenal ayaa wali sagaal dhibcood ka horeysa City horyaalka, waxayna sidoo kale wajahaysaa Sporting CP ee UEFA Champions League.
Lineker ayaa ku kalsoon:
“Waxaan u maleynayaa inay hagaagi doonaan oo ay horyaalka qaadi doonaan—taas ayaa ah tan ugu muhiimsan. Champions League-na waxay noqon doontaa gunno weyn.”

Garabka reer Brazil ayaa la siiyay fasax kadib dhaawac muruqa bowdada ah oo soo gaaray kulan saaxiibtinimo oo ay 2-1 kaga adkaatay France.

Raphinha, oo ka mid ah kabtanada kooxda, ayaa sidoo kale la filayaa inuu door muhiim ah ka ciyaaro kulamada UEFA Champions League ee ay la leeyihiin Atletico Madrid iyo derby-ga La Liga ee ay la ciyaarayaan Espanyol.
Soo laabashadiisa ayaa si weyn u xoojin doonta Barcelona xilli ay kooxda ku jirto marxalad go’aan qaadasho ah oo xilli ciyaareedka ah.

Kulanka ayaa ka dhici doona garoonka Santiago Bernabeu.Real waxay rajaneysaa inay guuldarradii Malorca ku illowdo kulankan.
Arbeloa ayaa sidoo kale wajahaya cadaadis ku saabsan mustaqbalkiisa, iyadoo lagu xiray inuu ku guuleysto koob weyn si uu u sii haysto shaqada Real xagaaga ka dib.

headline: £130 Milyan Ama Iska Ilawa! Chelsea Oo Qiime Naxdin Leh Dul Dhigtay Enzo Fernandez.
body:
Chelsea ayaa si cad u dejisay qiimaha Enzo Fernandez, iyadoo sheegtay inaysan ku iibin doonin wax ka yar £130 milyan xagaagan.
Kooxda ayaa weli dooneysa inay cusbooneysiiso heshiiska xiddiga reer Argentina, balse wadahadallada ayaa hakad galay, iyadoo xiisaha ka imaanaya kooxo waaweyn oo Yurub ah, gaar ahaan Real Madrid uu sii kordhayo.
Chelsea waxay ku adkeysaneysaa qiimahan sare maadaama ay bixisay £106.8 milyan markii ay ka soo qaadaneysay xiddiga kooxda Benfica sanadkii 2023, isla markaana Fernandez uu qandaraas kula jiro ilaa 2032, taasoo siinaysa awood weyn oo gorgortan.
Inkasta oo kooxda aysan si firfircoon u rabin inay iibiso, haddana haddii ciyaaryahanku dalbado inuu baxo, waxaa la filayaa in Chelsea ay dalbato lacag ka badan tii ay ku soo iibsatay.
Wararka ayaa sidoo kale sheegaya in Fernandez uu xiiseynayo nolosha Madrid, taasoo sii hurisay hadal haynta ku saabsan mustaqbalkiisa.
Dhanka kale, khabiirka suuqa kala iibsiga, Fabrizio Romano ayaa xaqiijiyay in wali aysan jirin wadahadallo rasmi ah oo ku saabsan heshiis cusub.
Xilli ciyaareedkan, Fernandez ayaa soo bandhigay qaab ciyaareed wanaagsan, isagoo dhaliyay 12 gool isla markaana bixiyay 6 caawin 46 kulan oo uu u saftay Chelsea dhammaan tartamada.

headline: Joe Hart Oo Bannaanka Keenay Dhibaatada Ugu Weyn Ee Salah Heysata Xilli Ciyaareed Kaan Kadib Kulankii City
body:
Goolhayihii hore ee Manchester City, Joe Hart, ayaa sheegay in Mohamed Salah uu muujiyay kalsooni darro kulankii ay City 4-0 kaga adkaatay Liverpool FA Cup-kii.
Hart ayaa tilmaamay in Salah, oo caadi ahaan lagu yaqaan kalsooni sare, uu kulankan ahaa mid hoos u dhacay.
“Waxaan arki jirnay Salah oo ciyaaryahan kalsooni badan ah, laakiin kulankan wuu dhibtooday, kalsooni la’aan ayuu u muuqday,” ayuu yiri.
Wuxuu sidoo kale xusay in Salah uu u muuqday mid niyad jabsan markii uu kusoo laabtay qeybta labaad ee ciyaarta.
Weeraryahanka reer Masar ayaa seegay fursado muhiim ah, oo ay ku jirto rigoore uu qasaariyay daqiiqaddii 64-aad, xilli ay ciyaartu goor sii horreysay ahayd 4-0.
Arrintan ayaa sii kordhisay walaaca ku saabsan qaab ciyaareedka Salah, gaar ahaan xilli uu wajahayo cadaadis iyo hadal hayn ku saabsan mustaqbalkiisa kooxda.

headline: Manchester City Oo Xaqiijisay Inuu Ka Tagayo Mid Kamid Ah Xiddigaheeda Ugu Saameynta Badan
body:
Manchester City ayaa si rasmi ah u xaqiijisay in kabtankeeda Bernardo Silva uu ka tagi doono kooxda xagaagan.
Kaaliyaha tababaraha City, Pep Lijnders, ayaa sheegay in bixitaanka Silva uu yahay mid lama huraan ah inkasta oo uu yahay ciyaaryahan gaar ah oo muhiim u ahaa kooxda.
Wuxuu yiri:
“Bernardo Silva waa ciyaaryahan gaar ah. Xaalkeennu ma sahlana marka uusan ciyaarin, hal kulan oo keliya ayaad dareemaysaa maqnaanshihiisa, ka warran xilli ciyaareed dhan.”
Lijnders ayaa sidoo kale xusay in waqtiga Silva ee Etihad uu dhamaanayo, isagoo rajeynaya inuu si sharaf leh uga tago kooxda lixda toddobaad ee soo socota.
Silva, oo 31 jir ah, ayaa laga yaabaa inuu dib ugu laabto Benfica, halka sidoo kale ay xiiseynayaan Juventus iyo kooxo ka tirsan Major League Soccer.
Bixitaankiisa ayaa calaamad u noqonaya dhammaadka xilli muhiim ah oo uu ku qaatay Manchester City, halkaas oo uu ka ahaa mid ka mid ah xiddigaha ugu saameynta badan kooxda.

headline: Ryan Giggs Oo Magacaabay Xiddig Ay United Ku Qasban Tahay Inay Soo Qaadato Suuqa Xagaaga
body:
Halyeeyga Manchester United, Ryan Giggs, ayaa ku booriyay tababare Michael Carrick inuu xagaagan la soo saxiixdo Adam Wharton.
Giggs ayaa aaminsan in xiddiga Crystal Palace uu durba leeyahay astaamaha ciyaaryahan Manchester United ah, isagoo ku qiimeeyay £70 milyan.
Wuxuu sidoo kale carrabka ku adkeeyay in United ay u baahan tahay inay si weyn u xoojiso khadka dhexe, gaar ahaan iyadoo Casemiro la filayo inuu baxo dhammaadka xilli ciyaareedka.
Giggs ayaa yiri:
“Waxaan u baahan-nahay laba ciyaaryahan oo khadka dhexe ah. Mudnaanta koowaad waa halkaas.”
Wuxuu sidoo kale soo jeediyay in Elliot Anderson oo ka tirsan Nottingham Forest uu noqon karo xulasho kale oo muhiim ah.
Giggs ayaa si gaar ah u amaanay Wharton, isagoo sheegay:
“Wuxuu u egyahay ciyaaryahan Man United, wuxuu xamili karaa kubadda, hore wuu u jiidaa kubadda, wuxuuna leeyahay khibrad Premier League.”
Talooyinkan ayaa imanaya xilli Manchester United ay qorsheyneyso dib-u-dhis weyn oo xagaaga ah, iyadoo la filayo isbeddelo muhiim ah oo ka dhaca khadka dhexe.

headline: ​”Kuma Filna Guul Kaliya”: Arsenal Oo Loo Sheegay Xaqiiqo Qadhaadh Oo Ku Saabsan Premier League.
body:
Arsenal ayaa loo sheegay inay u baahan karaan caawinta Chelsea si ay ugu guuleystaan Premier League xilli ciyaareedkan.
Falanqeeye iyo weeraryahan hore oo Chelsea ah, Tony Cascarino, ayaa sheegay in Gunners aysan kaliya ku filnaan doonin guulaha ay gaaraan, balse ay u baahan yihiin kooxo kale inay dhibco ka qaataan Manchester City.
Cascarino ayaa yiri:
“Haddii Arsenal ay tagto Etihad oo ay u baahato guul, waxaan u maleynayaa in City ay adkaan doonto. tobankiiba siddeed, City ayaa garaaci karta Arsenal.”
Wuxuu si gaar ah u xusay kulanka soo socda ee Chelsea ay la ciyaari doonto Manchester City, isagoo sheegay:
“Aad bay muhiim u tahay in Chelsea ay natiijo ka hesho kulankaas si ay u caawiso Arsenal.”
Sidoo kale wuxuu tilmaamay in Arsenal aysan u badneyn inay guuleysato dhammaan kulamada harsan, taasoo ka dhigeysa in natiijooyinka kooxaha kale ay door weyn ka ciyaari doonaan tartanka horyaalka.

headline: Real Madrid Oo Go’aan Lama Filaan Ah Ka Soo Saartay Mustaqbalka Eduardo Camavinga
body:
Mustaqbalka Eduardo Camavinga ee Real Madrid ayaa noqday mid aan la hubin kadib xilli ciyaareed adag oo uu ku dhibtooday xiddiga khadka dhexe.
Sida ay sheegtay Marca, Camavinga mar dambe looma arki doono ciyaaryahan “lama taabtaan ah”, iyadoo doorkiisa mustaqbalka ee kooxda hadda dib loo eegayo.
Ciyaaryahanka reer France ayaa dhawaan ku bilowday kulankii ay Madrid guuldarro kala kulantay Mallorca, balse qaab ciyaareedkiisa ayaa la dhaliilay, gaar ahaan goolkii uu dhaliyay Manu Morlanes.
Warbixinta ayaa sheegaysa in Camavinga uusan weli gaarin heerkii laga filayay kadib bixitaankii halyeeyada Toni Kroos iyo Luka Modric.
Taasi waxay keentay inuu hadda ka fiirsado mustaqbalkiisa xagaaga, iyadoo kooxo ka tirsan Premier League ay si dhow ula socdaan xaaladdiisa.
Si kastaba, Real Madrid ma riixeyso iibkiisa, waxaana go’aanka ugu dambeeya si weyn ugu xirnaan doona rabitaanka Camavinga; haddii uu doonayo inuu sii joogo oo u dagaallamo booskiisa ama uu doorto inuu tago.

headline: Chelsea Oo Xaqiijisay Saxiixeedii Ugu Horeeyay Ee Suuqa Xagaaga
body:
Chelsea ayaa heshiis la gaartay difaaca Valentin Barco, sida uu xaqiijiyay khabiirka suuqa kala iibsiga Fabrizio Romano.
Barco ayaa ogolaaday inuu ku biiro Chelsea, iyadoo shuruudaha shaqsiga ah horey la isula meel dhigay ka hor u wareegis la filayay xagaagan.
Da’yarka 21-jirka ah ayaa ugu biiray Strasbourg xagaagii hore heshiis joogto ah oo ku kacayay £8.7 milyan kadib markii uu markii hore amaah kaga yimid Brighton & Hove Albion.
Barco ayaa si degdeg ah ula qabsaday nolosha Faransiiska, isagoo u saftay 37 kulan isla markaana dhaliyay laba gool, taasoo sare u qaaday sumcaddiisa inuu yahay mid ka mid ah hibada ugu wanaagsan Argentina.
Si kastaba, waqtigiisii Brighton ma uusan noqon mid guul leh, isagoo kaliya ciyaaray todobo kulan oo Premier League ah.
Heshiiskan ayaa muujinaya in Chelsea ay sii waddo istiraatiijiyaddeeda ku aaddan saxiixa ciyaartoyda da’da yar ee leh mustaqbal ifaya.

headline: Rasmi: Isku Aadka Semi-finalka FA Cup-ka Oo La Soo Saaray
body:
Waxaa si rasmi ah loo shaaciyay kulamada semi-final-ka ee FA Cup kadib isku aad la sameeyay Axaddii.
Kulanka koowaad, Chelsea ayaa la ciyaari doonta Leeds United si ay u gaaraan final-ka. Chelsea ayaa si xooggan ugu gudubtay wareegan kadib markii ay 7-0 ku xasuuqday Port Vale, halka Leeds ay rigooreyaal kaga adkaatay West Ham United.
Kulanka labaad, Manchester City ayaa la balansan Southampton, kulan ka dhici doona garoonka Wembley Stadium. City ayaa si sahlan 4-0 uga adkaatay Liverpool, halka Southampton ay reebtay Arsenal.
Labada kulan ee semi-final-ka ayaa la ciyaari doonaa 25-ka iyo 26-ka bisha April, iyadoo kooxahan ay ku loolami doonaan inay gaaraan final-ka koobka.

headline: Jamie Carragher Oo Magacaabay Tababaraha Kaliya Ee Carrick Ku Ciriirin Kara Shaqada Joogtada Ah Ee Manchester United
body:
Jamie Carragher ayaa sheegay in Luis Enrique uu yahay ikhtiyaarka kaliya ee suurtagalka ah haddii Manchester United aysan sii haysan Michael Carrick xilli ciyaareedka soo socda.
Carragher oo ka hadlay barnaamijka The Overlap Fan Debate ayaa tilmaamay in doorashada tababare cusub ay keeni karto isbeddel weyn oo burburin kara horumarka hadda jira.
Wuxuu yiri:
“Waxaan dareemayaa inay hadda noqotay laba doorasho; Luis Enrique ama Michael Carrick.”
Hadalkiisa ayaa muujinaya in Carrick uu kasbaday kalsooni weyn kadib shaqadiisii ku meel gaarka ahayd ee uu ka qabtay United.
Dhanka kale, Roberto De Zerbi ayaa la sheegay inuu xiiseynayay shaqada Manchester United, balse lagu wargeliyay inuusan ku jirin liiska musharixiinta.
Arrintan ayaa muujineysa in Manchester United ay si weyn u soo koobtay liiska tababarayaasha ay tixgelinayso, iyadoo Carrick uu noqday musharax xooggan kadib waxqabadkiisa wanaagsan.

headline: Robbie Fowler Oo Farta Ku Fiiqay Ciyaaryahanka Ugu Liitay Liverpool Kulankii City
body:
Halyeeyga Liverpool, Robbie Fowler, ayaa si kulul u dhaliilay Ibrahima Konate, kadib qaab ciyaareedkiisii kulankii ay 4-0 kaga adkaatay Manchester City.
Fowler ayaa si gaar ah uga hadlay goolka afaraad ee City, isagoo ku eedeeyay Konate inuu muujiyay dabeecad “is-dhiibid” ah oo aan ku habboonayn ciyaaryahan heer sare ah.
Wuxuu yiri:
“Fiiri falcelinta Konate; waa mid muujinaysa qof is dhiibaya. Waxaan rabaa inaan isbeddel badan ku arko dhanka difaaca.”
Inkasta oo uu qiray in goolku uu ahaa mid fiican oo si wanaagsan loo dhaliyay, haddana wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay in Konate uu si fudud u ogolaaday weerarka inuu dhaafo.
“Waxaan aragnay arrintan dhowr jeer xilli ciyaareedkan; kubadda markay dhaafto, si fudud ayuu uga harayaa,” ayuu raaciyay.
Qaab ciyaareedka Konate ayaa noqday mid si weyn loo dhaliilayo xilli ciyaareedkan, gaar ahaan iyadoo qandaraaskiisu ku dhow yahay inuu dhamaado. Si kastaba, Liverpool ayaa weli diyaar u ah inay heshiis cusub u bandhigto daafaca reer France.
