headline: Van Dijk: “Slot Qeyb Ayuu Ka Yahay Guuldarradii Cusleyd Ee City Naga Soo Gaartay”
body:
Virgil van Dijk ayaa sheegay in mas’uuliyadda guuldarradii Liverpool ee ay kala kulmeen Manchester City aysan ku koobnayn ciyaartoyda oo keliya, balse uu sidoo kale qeyb ka yahay tababare Arne Slot.
Kabtanka Liverpool ayaa yiri:
“Waa arrin annagoo dhan aan ku lug leennahay, sax? Dabcan tababaraha waa mas’uul, laakiin annaga ayaa garoonka ku jirna oo waa inaan wax qabanaa.”
Van Dijk ayaa sidoo kale diiradda saaray kulanka adag ee soo socda ee UEFA Champions League, halkaas oo ay la ciyaari doonaan Paris Saint-Germain.
“PSG way na sugayaan. Wax yar ayaan daawaday, waxay noqon doontaa mid aad u adag. Waa inaan si maskax ahaan ah u diyaar garownaa sida ugu dhaqsaha badan,” ayuu yiri.
Difaaca reer Holland ayaa qiray in kooxda ay lumisay isku duubnidii hore:
“Waxa ugu muhiimsan mar walba waa wadajirka iyo isku-duubnida. Hadda waxaan ku jirnaa isbeddel, waa inaan mar kale helnaa.”
Dhanka kale, cadaadis ayaa ku sii kordhaya dusha sare ee Slot, iyadoo natiijooyinka aan joogtada ahayn ay halis gelin karaan mustaqbalkiisa, gaar ahaan haddii Liverpool ay ku guuldareysato inay gaarto UEFA Champions League xilli ciyaareedka soo socda.

headline: “Adiga Dartaa Ayuu Salah Uga Tagayaa Liverpool”
body:
Mohamed Aboutrika ayaa shaaca ka qaaday sabab muhiim ah oo ka dambeysa go’aanka Mohamed Salah ee uu uga tagayo Liverpool, isagoo farta ku fiiqay khilaafka kala dhexeeya tababare Arne Slot.
Halyeeyga Masar, oo saaxiib dhow la ah Salah, ayaa sheegay in dhibaatooyinkii dhawaan ka jiray kooxda ay saameyn weyn ku yeesheen fikirka weeraryahanka.
Aboutrika ayaa yiri:
“Mid ka mid ah sababaha Mohamed Salah uga tagayo Liverpool waa joogitaanka Arne Slot, sababtoo ah waxaan aragnay dhibaatooyin dhawaanahan.”
Wuxuu si toos ah ugu eedeeyay tababaraha:

headline: Hansi Flick Oo Saadaal Waalli Ah Ka Bixiyay Kulanka Champions League-ga Ay Kooxdiisa Kaga Hor Tagi Doonto Atletico Madrid
body:
Tababaraha Barcelona, Hansi Flick, ayaa saadaaliyay kulan xamaasad badan, marka ay la ciyaarayaan Atletico Madrid lugta koowaad ee quarter-final-ka UEFA Champions League.

Tababaraha reer Germany ayaa qiray in kulanka soo socda uu noqon doono mid aad u adag, isagoo yiri:
“Arbacada mar kale ayaan la ciyaareynaa, wuxuuna kulanka noqon doonta mid aad u adag.”
Wuxuu intaas ku daray in kooxdiisu ay u baahan tahay inay ciyaarto qaabkeeda caadiga ah oo ay bixiso wax walba si ay u gaarto natiijo wanaagsan.
Kulanka ayaa ka dhici doona Camp Nou, iyadoo la filayo inuu noqdo mid xiiso badan maadaama labada koox ay si fiican isu garanayaan kadib kulankoodii horyaalka.

headline: Alan Shearer Oo Shaaciyay Hal Sabab Oo Ay Arsenal Ugu Adkaan Doonto Inay Ku Guuleysato Premier League, Kadib Fashilkii FA Cup-ka
body:
Halyeeyga Newcastle United, Alan Shearer, ayaa sheegay inay aad ugu adkaan doonto Arsenal inay ku guuleysato Premier League, kadib guuldarradii lama filaanka ahayd ee FA Cup.
Southampton ayaa garaacday Arsenal, iyadoo goolasha ka heshay Ross Stewart, Viktor Gyokeres iyo Shea Charles oo dhaliyay goolka guusha daqiiqadii 85aad.
Inkasta oo Gunners ay weli ku jiraan laba tartan; Premier League iyo UEFA Champions League, haddana Shearer wuxuu shaki geliyay saameynta maskaxeed ee guuldarradan.
Arsenal ayaa horyaalka ku hoggaamineysa 9 dhibcood, iyadoo 7 kulan ay harsan yihiin horyaalka, balse Shearer wuxuu aaminsan yahay in jabkan uu dhaawici karo rajadooda.
Wuxuu yiri:
“Kadib markii Arsenal laga reebay FA Cup, waxay noqon doontaa mid aad u adag dhanka maskaxda inay gaaraan waxa ay doonayaan inay gaaraan.”

headline: Van Dijk: “Waan Ceebeysan-nahay, Ma Garanayo Meesha Uu Xalka Naga Jiro”
body:
Virgil van Dijk ayaa bixiyay qiimeyn aad u adag oo ku saabsan qaab ciyaareedka Liverpool kadib guuldarradii cusleyd ee 4-0 ay kala kulmeen Manchester City, quarter-final-kii FA Cup-ka.
Kabtanka Liverpool ayaa raaligelin siiyay taageerayaashii u soo safray kulanka, isagoo qiray in kooxda aysan soo bandhigin xooggii, dagaalkii iyo isku duubnidii loo baahnaa.
Van Dijk ayaa yiri:
“Qeybtii labaad ma la jaan qaadi karin xooggooda, tartamada kuma guuleysan, waxay ahayd mid adag. Inaad 4-0 ku lumiso ciyaar waa wax aad u xun.”
Wuxuu sidoo kale muujiyay daal maskaxeed oo ka jira kooxda:
“Waan ka daalay inaan hadalkan ku celceliyo? 100%. Waan fahamsanahay cadhada taageerayaasha.”
Difaaca reer Holland ayaa tilmaamay in dhibaatada ugu weyn ay tahay mid maskaxeed iyo isku duubni la’aan, isagoo sheegay in kooxda ay ku jirto marxalad isbeddel ah kadib imaanshaha Arne Slot.
“Waxaan luminay wadajirka. Taasi waxay adkeyneysaa inaad si joogto ah u ciyaarto saddexdii maalmoodba mar,” ayuu raaciyay.
Hadalladan ayaa muujinaya xaaladda adag ee Liverpool ku jirto, iyadoo ay weli u baahan yihiin inay si degdeg ah isu helaan ka hor kulamada waaweyn ee soo socda.

headline: Chelsea Oo Beddeshay Mowqif-keeda Mustaqbalka Enzo Fernandez
body:
Chelsea ayaa wali qorsheyneysa inay heshiis cusub oo la hagaajiyay u bandhigto Enzo Fernandez, inkastoo wadahadalladii hore ay hakad galeen.
Wadahadallada u dhexeeya kooxda iyo wakiillada Enzo ayaa istaagay kadib khilaaf ku saabsan mushaharka, iyadoo wakiillada dhinaca ciyaaryahanka ay aaminsan yihiin in 25-jirka uu qaato lacag ka yar inta uu mudan yahay.
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Chelsea waxay weli u aragtaa Enzo inuu yahay qayb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah qorshahooda mustaqbalka, waxayna doonayaan inay xaliyaan arrintan ka hor inta aysan ka fikirin iibkiisa xagaaga.
Haddii uu baxo, kooxda ayaa dalban doonta lacag aad u badan oo ka badan £100 milyan, iyadoo xiiso laga helayo kooxo waaweyn sida Real Madrid iyo Paris Saint-Germain.
Xaaladda Enzo ayaa weli furan, balse Chelsea waxay si cad u muujisay inay rabto inay sii haysato xiddiga khadka dhexe.

headline: Haaland Oo Jebiyay Rikoodh Waalli Ah Oo Uu Ku Faani Jiray Harry Kane
body:
Haaland ayaa jebiyay rikoor uu lahaa Harry Kane kadib saddexleydii uu u dhaliyay Man City.
Weeraryahanka Manchester City, Erling Haaland, ayaa Sabtidii dhaafay rikoor uu lahaa Harry Kane kadib markii uu dhaliyay saddexley kulankii FA Cup.
Haaland ayaa saddex gool ka dhaliyay Liverpool quarter-final-kii lagu ciyaaray Etihad Stadium, iyadoo ciyaarta ku dhammaatay 4-0 oo ay ku badisay City.
Sida ay sheegtay OptaJoe, tan iyo markii Haaland uu ku biiray Manchester City bishii July 2022, xiddiga reer Norway wuxuu dhaliyay 12 saddexley dhammaan tartamada.
Taas ayaa ka dhigaysa inuu noqdo ciyaaryahanka ugu badan ee saddexley ka dhaliya shanta horyaal ee ugu waa weyn Yurub, isagoo hal ka sare maray Harry Kane oo leh 11.
Haaland ayaa rajeynaya inuu sii wato qaab ciyaareedkiisa cajiibka ah marka Manchester City ay wajahdo Chelsea kulanka Premier League usbuuca soo socda.

Wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay in kooxda ay u baahan tahay inay ka faa’iideysato waqtiga harsan si ay u horumariso waxqabadkeeda, isla markaana aysan isku qaldin guulihii hore.
“Mararka qaar waa inaad istaagtaa xitaa markaad guuleysanayso, si aadan ugu maleyn inaad ka fiican tahay sida aad dhab ahaantii tahay,” ayuu raaciyay.
Arsenal ayaa hadda u jeesan doonta kulanka UEFA Champions League ee ay la leeyihiin Sporting CP, ka hor inta aysan dib ugu laaban Premier League oo ay la ciyaari doonaan AFC Bournemouth.

headline: Szoboszlai: “Waxaan Ku Qasban Nahay Inaan PSG Garaacno, Haddii Kale….”
body:
Liverpool ayaa wajahaysa imtixaan adag iyadoo ay isu diyaarinayaan kulanka lugta koowaad ee quarter-final-ka UEFA Champions League oo ay booqanayaan Paris Saint-Germain Arbacada, taasoo ah fursaddooda ugu dambeysa ee ay kaga badbaadi karaan xilli ciyaareed niyad-jab leh.
Xiddiga khadka dhexe Dominik Szoboszlai ayaa fariin adag u diray asxaabtiisa kadib guuldarradii 4-0 ee ay kala kulmeen Manchester City ee FA Cup.
Szoboszlai ayaa si cad u yiri:
“Waa inaan is uruurinaa, sababtoo ah haddii aan sidaan u ciyaarno, si degdeg ah ayaan u ilaawi karnaa Champions League iyo xitaa ka qeybgalkiisa sanadka dambe.”
Wuxuu ku tilmaamay xilli ciyaareedka Liverpool mid “musiibo ah”, isagoo ku booriyay kooxda inay si dhab ah isu eegaan oo ay raadiyaan xal ay ku badalaan xaaladda.
Cadaadis weyn ayaa saaran Liverpool kahor kulanka PSG, iyadoo Champions League uu yahay rajada kaliya ee ay koob ku hanan karaan xilli ciyaareedkan. Haddii ay sii wadaan qaab ciyaareedka liita, khatarta guuldarro kale ayaa aad u sarreysa.

headline: Gabriel Jesus Oo Shaaciyay Cidda Iska Leh Mas’uuliyadda Guuldarradii Lama Filaanka Ahayd Ee Arsenal Ka Soo Gaartay Southampton.
body:
Gabriel Jesus ayaa ugu baaqay ciyaartoyda Arsenal inay qaataan masuuliyad dheeraad ah kadib qaab ciyaareedkoodii liitay ee kulankii FA-ga.
Hadalkiisa ayaa yimid kadib guuldarradii 2-1 ee ay kala kulmeen Southampton, taasoo sii kordhisay cadaadiska saaran kooxda.
Jesus ayaa yiri:
“Ciyaartoydu waa inay hadlaan wax badan, oo ay qaataan masuuliyad. Tababare Arteta wuxuu na siiyaa qorshaha ciyaarta, laakiin gudaha garoonka annaga ayaa joogna, waa inaan fursadaha ka faa’iideysanaa.”
Wuxuu si cad u muujiyay in dhibaatada aysan ahayn mid tababaraha ku kooban, balse ay si weyn ugu xiran tahay ciyaartoyda laftooda:
“Waxaan u maleynayaa inay ka badan tahay ciyaartoyda marka loo eego tababaraha.”
Hadalladan ayaa muujinaya in Arsenal ay u baahan tahay hoggaan xooggan oo gudaha garoonka ah, si ay u hagaajiso natiijooyinka—haddii kale, taageerayaasha ayaa sii kordhin doona cadhadooda iyo niyad-jabkooda.

headline: Bruno Fernandes Oo Wakiil Uga Noqonaya United Soo Xero-gelinta Xiddig Mucjiso Ah
body:
Kabtanka Manchester United, Bruno Fernandes, ayaa la sheegay inuu door muhiim ah ka qaadan karo qorshaha mustaqbalka khadka dhexe ee kooxda, isagoo indhaha ku haya Mateus Fernandes.
Ciyaaryahanka 21-jirka ah ee West Ham United ayaa si weyn u soo jiitay indhaha, inkastoo kooxdiisu aysan xilli ciyaareedkan si fiican u socon. Waxa uu noqday bartilmaameed labaad oo ay United ka fiirsanayso, iyadoo ay jiraan xiddigo kale oo magac weyn leh oo lala xiriirinayo United.
Manchester United ayaa qorsheynaysa inay si weyn u maalgeliso suuqa kala iibsiga xagaagan, gaar ahaan iyadoo Casemiro la filayo inuu ka tago kooxda.
Mateus Fernandes ayaa dhawaan helay wicitaankiisii ugu horreeyay ee xulka qaranka Portugal, halkaas oo uu waqti kula qaatay Bruno Fernandes; ciyaaryahan uu horey u sheegay inuu yahay qof uu ku daydo.
Arrintan ayaa muujinaysa in Bruno uu saameyn ku leeyahay jiilka cusub, isla markaana laga yaabo inuu door ka ciyaaro xulashada ciyaartoyda mustaqbalka ee kooxda.

headline: Hansi Flick Oo Sharaxay Waxa Sababay Cadhadii Yamal Ee Kulankii Atletico
body:
Lamine Yamal ayaa caro muujiyay kadib guushii Barcelona ka gaartay Atletico Madrid, sababtuna waxay ahayd hal arrin oo fudud; inuusan gool dhalin.
Tababaraha Barcelona, Hansi Flick, ayaa sharaxay in xiddiga da’da yar uu si weyn isugu dayay inuu saameyn ku yeesho ciyaarta, balse wuxuu nasiib u yeelan waayay inuu shabaqa soo taabto.
Flick wuxuu yiri Yamal “wuxuu isku dayay wax walba,” taasoo muujineysa dadaalka iyo rabitaanka uu u qabo inuu goolal dhaliyo oo kooxda caawiyo.
Carada Yamal ma ahayn mid khatar ah, balse waxay ka timid dareen tartan iyo rabitaan guul; arrin caadi ka ah ciyaartoyda heerka sare, gaar ahaan kuwa da’da yar ee doonaya inay mar walba muujiyaan waxqabad sare.
Ugu dambeyn, Flick wuxuu xaqiijiyay in Yamal uu degay markii uu galay qolka labiska, wax walbana ay caadi noqdeen.

headline: Giggs Oo Farta Ku Fiiqay Labo Khad-dhexe Ay Qasab Tahay Inay United Soo Qaadato Suuqa Xagaaga
body:
Halyeeyga Manchester United, Ryan Giggs, ayaa ku booriyay kooxda inay xagaagan la soo saxiixato labo khad dhexe oo cusub si loo buuxiyo boosaska banaan.
Giggs wuxuu aaminsan yahay in Casemiro iyo Manuel Ugarte ay ka tagi doonaan kooxda dhammaadka xilli ciyaareedka, taasoo abuuri karta dalool weyn oo khadka dhexe ah.
Wuxuu si gaar ah u magacaabay Adam Wharton oo ka tirsan Crystal Palace iyo Elliot Anderson oo u ciyaara Nottingham Forest.
Giggs ayaa yiri:
“Mainoo wuxuu u muuqdaa inuu sii joogi doono, laakiin Casemiro iyo Ugarte way tagayaan, sidaas darteed waa inaan si degdeg ah u xoojinaa khadka dhexe.”
Wuxuu ku amaanay Wharton inuu leeyahay astaamo ciyaaryahan Manchester United ah, maadaama uu bidixle yahay, halka Anderson uu ku tilmaamay ciyaaryahan joogto ah oo heer fiican ku ciyaara kulamada oo dhan.
Giggs wuxuu soo jeediyay isku-dhafyo kala duwan sida Wharton iyo Kobbie Mainoo ama Anderson iyo Wharton, isagoo caddeeyay in United ay u baahan tahay ugu yaraan laba ciyaaryahan oo cusub oo khadka dhexe ah si ay u dhisto mustaqbal adag.

headline: FA Cup: Chelsea Oo Taariikh Sameysay Kadib Guushii Por Vale
body:
Chelsea ayaa Sabtidii taariikh dhigtay kadib markii ay Port Vale ku garaaceen 7-0 ciyaarta quarter-final-ka FA Cup.
Xusuusnow in goolasha Jorrel Hato, João Pedro, Jordan Lawrence-Gabriel (own-goal), Tosin Adarabioyo, Andrey Santos, iyo Estêvão ay hubiyeen in Chelsea ay u gudubto semi-final-ka FA Cup.
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, sida ay sheegeen OptaJoe, Chelsea waa kooxda ugu horeysay tan iyo 2005-06 ee goolal ka badan 7 ka dhalisa quarter-final-ka FA Cup, markii Liverpool ay 7-0 ku garaacday Birmingham City.
Sidoo kale, natiijada ciyaartan waxay ka dhigan tahay in Chelsea ay shan jeer xilli ciyaareedkan dhaliyeen 3 gool ama ka badan qeybta hore ee ciyaarta dhammaan tartamada, taasoo ka badan koox kasta oo Premier League ah.
Blues hadda waxay wajahayaan Manchester City Premier League Axadda soo socota.

headline: Jamie Carragher Oo Daaha Ka Rogay Khaladkii Ugu Weynaa Ee Salah Ku Dhaco, Kadib Markii Uu Klopp Ka Tagay Liverpool
body:
Halyeeyga Liverpool, Jamie Carragher, ayaa sheegay in qaladkii ugu weynaa ee Mohamed Salah uu ahaa inuu sii joogo kooxda kadib bixitaankii Jurgen Klopp.
Carragher ayaa xusay in Salah iyo Klopp ay si wadajir ah u gaareen guulo waaweyn sida Premier League iyo Champions League, balse xaaladdu ay is bedeshay markii Arne Slot uu la wareegay kooxda.
Xilli ciyaareedkan, xiriirka u dhexeeya Salah iyo Slot ayaa xumaaday, taasoo ugu dambeyn keentay in xiddiga Masaarida ah uu shaaciyo inuu ka tagayo kooxda Anfield.
Carragher ayaa yiri:
“Salah qaladkiisa ugu weyn wuxuu noqon karaa inuu sii joogay kadib markii Klopp tagay. Waxa uu sameeyay wax walba oo uu Liverpool u baahneyd, balse tani waa sagootin adag.”
Wuxuu sidoo kale barbar dhigay xaaladda Salah mid la mid ah tii Cristiano Ronaldo, isagoo tilmaamay in khilaafka tababare uu si weyn u burburin karo kalsoonida ciyaaryahanka.
Ugu dambeyn, Carragher ayaa muujiyay in ay tahay wax laga xumaado sida uu xiriirkaasi ku dhammaaday, iyadoo Salah uu ka tagayo kooxda isagoo xaalad adag ku jira halkii uu ku sagootin lahaa si sharaf leh.

body:

Manchester City ayaa si awood leh u soo baxday, kadib markii ay 4-0 ku garaaceen Liverpool. Weeraryahanka Erling Haaland ayaa hoggaamiyay bandhiggaas isagoo dhaliyay saddexley.
Dhanka kale, Chelsea ayaa si xun u xasuuqday Port Vale, iyagoo ku garaacay 7-0 kulan ka dhacay Stamford Bridge, taasoo muujisay awoodooda weerar.
Southampton ayaa iyaguna noqday yaabka wareeggan, kadib markii ay 2-1 ku reebeen Arsenal, taasoo ka dhigtay Gunners inay laba tartan ka haraan muddo kooban gudahood.

headline: Robbie Fowler Oo Bannaanka Keenay Dhibaatada Ugu Weyn Ay Liverpool La Daalaa-dhaceyso Xilli Ciyaareed Kaan Kadib Guuldarradii City
body:
Halyeeygii hore ee Liverpool, Robbie Fowler, ayaa si kulul u dhaliilay qaab ciyaareedka kooxda kadib guuldarradii 4-0 ee ay kala kulmeen Manchester City ee FA Cup.
Fowler ayaa tilmaamay in dhibaatada ugu weyn ay tahay kalsooni darro:
“Waligay ma arag Liverpool oo sidaan kalsooni u la’ kadib markii ay ciyaarta si fiican u bilaabeen,” ayuu yiri.
Wuxuu sharaxay in kooxda ay si wanaagsan u bilaabatay kulanka, balse si lama filaan ah ay u lumiyeen kalsoonidii, taasoo si cad uga muuqatay ciyaartoyda sida Mohamed Salah oo seegay fursado, iyo Hugo Ekitike oo u muuqday mid gaabis ah.
Fowler ayaa intaas ku daray in ay tahay waajibka tababaraha inuu dib u dhiso kalsoonida ciyaartoyda, maadaama ay sugayaan kulan aad u weyn oo ka dhan ah Paris Saint-Germain.
Wuxuu ka digay in haddii Liverpool ay u ciyaarto sida qeybtii labaad ee kulankii Man City, aysan wax fursad ah ka heli doonin PSG, taasoo cadaadis weyn saareysa kooxda kahor kulanka muhiimka ah ee soo socda.

headline: Muxuu Arteta Ka Yiri Guuldarradii Kooxdiisa Looga Reebay FA Cup-ka?
body:
Mikel Arteta ayaa si cad u sharaxay sababta Arsenal looga reebay FA Cup kadib guuldarro 2-1 ah oo ay kala kulmeen Southampton.
Arteta ayaa sheegay in dhibaatadu aysan ahayn weerarka, balse ay ahayd khaladaadka difaaca ee fudud:
“Waxaa sababay guuldarradan natiijada iyo gaar ahaan sida aan u ogolaanay labada gool,” ayuu yiri.
Tababaraha ayaa xusay in Arsenal ay si buuxda u maamuleysay ciyaarta, isla markaana ay gaareen meelaha halista ah ee goolka agtiisa, laakiin aysan ka faa’iideysan fursadahooda waaweyn. Dhanka kale, Southampton ayaa si fiican uga faa’iideysatay khaladaadka yar ee difaaca.
Goolasha laga dhaliyay Arsenal ayuu ku tilmaamay kuwo “aan caadi ahayn”, midkii koowaad iyo kii labaadba oo ka yimid kubbado toos ah, taasoo mar kale muujisay dhibaato ay horey u sheegtay kooxda ee kubbadaha dhaadheer.
Arteta ayaa qirtay in haddii aad sameyso khaladaadkaas, ay aad u adag tahay inaad gaarto semi-final-ka, isagoo intaas ku daray in kooxdu ay haysatay fursad weyn oo ay ku gaari lahayd Wembley balse ay ka faa’iideysan weyday.
Guuldarradan ayaa noqoneysa laba jab oo xiriir ah oo Arsenal soo gaara, kadib markii ay horay u lumiyeen final-kii Carabao Cup ee ay kaga adkaatay Manchester City.

headline: Virgil van Dijk Oo Farta Ku Fiiqay Ciyaaryahanka Iska Leh Mas’uuliyadda Xasuuqii Man City
body:
Kabtanka Liverpool, Virgil van Dijk, ayaa si daacad ah u qirtay mas’uuliyadda kadib guuldarradii cusleyd ee 4-0 ee ka soo gaartay Manchester City kulankii FA Cup.
Van Dijk ayaa sheegay in natiijada ay ahayd mid “aad u adag in la aqbalo”, isagoo si gaar ah uga hadlay niyad-jabka taageerayaasha:
“Waa maalin aad u adag, waanan ka xumahay taageerayaasha,” ayuu yiri.
Daafaca reer Netherlands ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay in ciyaartoyda ay qaadaan dhammaan eedda, maadaama ay ku fashilmeen inay si fiican uga ciyaaraan garoonka. Wuxuu sidoo kale fahmay sababta ay taageerayaal qaar uga baxeen ciyaarta ka hor dhammaadka, gaar ahaan markii xaaladdu noqotay mid aan la soo celin karin.
Ciyaarta ayaa si xun isu rogtay Liverpool kadib markii Van Dijk uu qalad ku galay Nico O’Reilly, taasoo keentay rigoore uu si qabow u dhaliyay Erling Haaland.
Intii lagu jiray qeybta labaad, kooxda ayaa gebi ahaanba burburtay, iyadoo afar gool laga dhaliyay 60 daqiiqo gudahood.
Van Dijk ayaa ugu dambeyn ku baaqay midnimo: inkastoo ay xaaladdu adag tahay, Liverpool waa inay isku duubnaadaan si ay uga gudbaan marxaladdan adag ee xilli ciyaareedka.

headline: Kylian Mbappe Oo Shaaciyay Booska Uu Aaminsan Yahay Inuu Yahay Kan Ugu Fudud Kubadda Cagta
body:
Kylian Mbappe ayaa si kaftan leh u shaaciyay booska uu u arko kan ugu fudud kubadda cagta.
Xiddiga Faransiiska ayaa sheegay in booska daafaca dhexe uu yahay kan ugu sahlan, isagoo ku dooday in ciyaartoyda halkaas ka ciyaara ay leeyihiin dabool dhinac walba ah, isla markaana ay helaan waqti badan oo ay kubadda ku maamulaan.
Mbappe wuxuu sidoo kale tilmaamay in daafacyadu aysan sameyn orod badan sida weeraryahannada, kuwaas oo mar walba ku tiirsan xawaare iyo dhaqdhaqaaq joogto ah si ay fursado u abuuraan.
Wuxuu xitaa xusay in ciyaartoy badan oo daafac ah ay heer sare ka ciyaari karaan ilaa da’da 40 jir, halka weeraryahannadu ay inta badan hoos u dhacaan marka ay gaaraan da’daas.
Hadalkan Mbappe wuxuu u muuqdaa mid kaftan iyo run iskugu jira, maadaama boos kasta oo garoonka ah uu leeyahay culays iyo caqabado u gaar ah, balse uu si fudud u muujinayo aragtidiisa ku aaddan farqiga u dhexeeya difaaca iyo weerarka.

headline: Chelsea Oo Xasuuqday Port Vale
body:
Chelsea ayaa si buuxda u burburisay Port Vale kadib markii ay 7-0 ku garaacday kulankii wareegga siddeed dhammaadka FA Cup, iyagoo iska xaadiriyay semi-final-ka Wembley.
Blues ayaa si degdeg ah ciyaarta u xakameeysay, iyadoo Jorrel Hato uu hoggaanka u dhiibay kaliya 64 ilbiriqsi kadib markii uu ka faa’iideystay koorne xilli hore ah.
Kadib, Joao Pedro ayaa dhaliyay goolka labaad, halka kabtan Cole Palmer uu si qurux badan u dhameystiray weerar kooxeed oo heer sare ah, taasoo Chelsea siisay hoggaan raaxo leh qeybtii hore.
Qeybtii labaad, Chelsea ma joojin weerarka, iyadoo Tosin Adarabioyo iyo Andrey Santos ay labaduba madax ku dhaliyeen goolal ka yimid koornooyin.
Estevao Willian ayaa sidoo kale gool dhaliyay kadib go’aan VAR ah, halka Alejandro Garnacho uu rigoore ku dhaliyay goolka toddobaad dhammaadkii ciyaarta.
Guushan weyn ayaa ka dhigan in Chelsea ay si xoog leh ugu sii socoto hanashada FA Cup, iyadoo hadda hal tallaabo u jirsatay final-ka Wembley.

headline: Manchester United Oo Shaacisay Waqtiga Ay Heshiiska U Kordhineyso Maguire Iyo Mainoo
body:
Kooxda Manchester United ayaa si degdeg ah u doonaysa inay heeshiisyo cusub ka saxiixato Harry Maguire iyo Kobbie Mainoo ka hor Koobka Adduunka, sida uu sheegay Fabrizio Romano.
Romano ayaa sheegay in maamulka United ay hadda dardar gelinayaan wada-hadallada si loo soo gabagabeeyo heshiisyada labada ciyaaryahan marka ay kasoo laabtaan waajibaadka xulalka qarankooda.
Difaaca khibradda leh ee Maguire ayaa la filayaa inuu saxiixo heshiis hal sano ah, oo ay ku jirto fursad hal sano oo dheeri ah. Dhanka kale, Mainoo oo ah xiddig da’yar oo si weyn u soo ifbaxay, ayaa la filayaa inuu heshiis la gaaro kooxda ilaa bisha June 2030, iyadoo sidoo kale lagu dari doono ikhtiyaar kordhin hal sano ah.
Arrintan ayaa muujinaysa sida ay United uga go’an tahay inay u sii haysato khibradda Maguire iyo mustaqbalka ifaya ee Mainoo, gaar ahaan iyadoo kooxda ay isku dayayso inay xoojiso xasiloonida safkeeda ka hor tartamada waaweyn ee soo socda.

headline: Arne Slot Oo Ka Dhawaajiyay 4 Arrimood Oo Sababay Guuldarradii Cusleyd Ay Liverpool Kala Kulantay Man City
body:
Tababaraha Liverpool, Arne Slot, ayaa qirtay in kooxdiisu ay muujisay daciifnimo dhanka ruuxda dagaalka ah kulankii ay 4-0 kaga adkaadeen Manchester City, balse wuxuu cadeeyay in dhibaatadu ay saameysay waqti gaar ah oo ciyaarta.
Slot wuxuu sheegay in dhibaatadu si gaar ah u muuqatay bilowgii qeybta labaad, halkaas oo ciyaartoyda Liverpool ay lumiyeen rabitaankii ay ugu guuleysan lahaayeen kubbadaha iyo iska horimaadyada. Wuxuu tilmaamay in muddadaas 10 ilaa 15 daqiiqo ah ay ahayd meesha ciyaarta laga lumiyay.
Sidoo kale, wuxuu si adag u dhaliilay qaabka difaaca, isagoo sheegay in goolasha laga dhaliyay ay ka imaadeen qaladaad cad sida orodyo aan la raacin, karoosyo aan la xirin, iyo iska hor imaadyo hawada ah oo lagu lumiyay gudaha diilinta. Waxa uu xusay in laba ka mid ah goolasha ay ka yimaadeen qaladaad la mid ah kuwii horey uga dhacay xilli ciyaareedka.
Inkasta oo Dominik Szoboszlai uu hore u sheegay in kooxda aysan lahayn “Dardar dagaal”, Slot wuxuu u arkaa in dhibaatadu ahayd waqti kooban balse saameyn weyn yeelatay.
Ugu dambeyn, Slot wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay in kooxdu ay si degdeg ah u saxdo khaladaadkan, gaar ahaan iyadoo wali ay rajadoodu ku xiran tahay UEFA Champions League.

headline: Mohamed Salah Oo Sameeyay Taariikh Xun Kadib Rigooradii Uu Khasaariyay Kulankii City
body:
Arrinta ku saabsan Mohamed Salah iyo rigoorooyinka ayaa hadda noqotay mid si dhab ah looga walaacsan yahay gudaha Liverpool.
Weeraryahanka reer Masar ayaa hadda seegay laba rigoore oo isku xigta, iyadoo tani noqoneyso rigooradii 5-aad ee uu khasaariyo tan iyo 2024, taasoo aan caadi u ahayn ciyaaryahan heerkiisa ah.
Guuldarradii ka dhacday kulankii FA Cup ee ay 4-0 kaga adkaatay Manchester City, Salah wuxuu helay fursad uu ciyaarta dib ugu soo celin karo, balse rigooradiisa waa la badbaadiyay, taasoo sii xoojisay cadaadiska.
Maxaa Sababay Walaaca?
Kalsoonida: Rigooreyaal la seego si joogto ah waxay dhaawacaan kalsoonida ciyaaryahanka
Saameynta ciyaareed: Fursadaha noocaas ah badanaa waa kuwa go’aamiya kulamada waaweyn
Xulashada qaataha: Liverpool waxay haystaan ciyaartoy kale oo leh rikoor fiican
Maxaa Xigi Kara?
Waxaa suuragal ah in Liverpool dib uga fiirsato cidda qaadata rigoorayaasha:
Xiddigo sida Dominik Szoboszlai ama ciyaartoy kale oo leh bartilmaameed sare ayaa fursad heli kara
Ama Salah la siiyo waqti uu kalsoonidiisa dib ugu helo
Si kastaba, inkastoo arrintan ay dhacday, Salah weli waa mid ka mid ah xiddigaha ugu muhiimsan Liverpool, laakiin xaaladdan waxay u baahan tahay xal degdeg ah, gaar ahaan iyadoo kooxda ay hadda rajadeeda koob ku xiran tahay UEFA Champions League.

headline: Muxuu Szoboszlai Ka Yiri Guuldarradii Cusleyd Ee Liverpool Ka Soo Gaartay Man City?
body:
Xiddiga Khadka dhexe ee Liverpool, Dominik Szoboszlai, ayaa si cad u muujiyay niyad-jabkiisa kadib guuldarradii cusleyd ee 4-0 ay kala kulmeen Manchester City ee FA Cup.
Szoboszlai ayaa sheegay in waxqabadkooda uusan wax macno ah lahayn haddii aysan natiijo la imaanin:
“Marka aad wax sameyso oo aan natiijo jirin, wax macno ah ma leh,” ayuu yiri.
Wuxuu qirtay in Liverpool ay heshay fursado balse aysan ka faa’iideysan, isla markaana ay si fudud u ogolaadeen goolal, taasoo keentay guuldarro culus.
Sidoo kale wuxuu si gaar ah u dhaliilay dhinaca maskaxda iyo dagaalka kooxda:
“Ruuxdii dagaalka ma jirin, maskaxdii guusha ma jirin. Midkeenna ma joogin heerkii la rabay,” ayuu raaciyay.
Xiddiga reer Hungary ayaa tilmaamay in marka ay 2-0 noqotay ciyaarta ay adkaatay soo laabashadu, halka goolka saddexaad uu gebi ahaanba dilay rajadii Liverpool.
Guuldarradan ayaa ka dhigan in Liverpool ay ka hartay FA Cup, waxaana rajadooda koob ku koobantahay hadda UEFA Champions League, halkaas oo ay la ciyaari doonaan Paris Saint-Germain.

headline: Manchester City Oo Xasuuqday Liverpool, Una Gudubtay Semi-finalka FA Cup
body:
Kooxda Manchester City ayaa si awood leh ugu gudubtay wareegga semi-finalka FA Cup, kadib markii ay 4-0 ku xasuuqeen Liverpool kulan ka dhacay Etihad Stadium.
Xiddiga reer Norway Erling Haaland ayaa ahaa geesiga ciyaarta, isagoo laba gool dhaliyay qeybtii hore. Haaland ayaa marka hore rigoore u saxiixay City daqiiqaddii 39aad, ka hor inta uusan markale shabaqa soo taaban daqiiqaddii 45+2, isagoo caawin ka helay Antoine Semenyo.
Qeybtii labaad, Semenyo ayaa isna gool dhaliyay daqiiqaddii 50aad kadib caawin uu ka helay Rayan Cherki, halka Haaland uu dhameystiray saddexleydiisa daqiiqaddii 57aad isagoo caawin ka helay O’Reilly.
Dhanka kale, Mohamed Salah ayaa fursad dahabi ah lumiyay markii rigoore uu tuuray la badbaadiyay daqiiqaddii 64aad.
Guushan weyn ayaa muujisay awoodda Manchester City, iyagoo si cad u diray fariin ah inay si dhab ah ugu tartamayaan koobkan.

headline: ​”Ha Fududaysanina!”: Liam Rosenior Oo Soo Saaray Digniin Culus Ka Hor Kulanka Port Vale.
body:
Tababaraha Chelsea, Liam Rosenior, ayaa aaminsan in dhibaatada ay kooxdiisu wajahday ay ugu dambeyn faa’iido u yeelan doonto mustaqbalka fog ee kooxda.
Chelsea ayaa wajahaysa Port Vale kulan muhiim ah oo ka tirsan FA Cup, iyadoo boos semi-final ah uu miiska saaran yahay, taasoo noqon karta markii ugu horreysay ee ay heerkan gaaraan tan iyo markii ay koobka ku guuleysteen 2018.
Rosenior ayaa sheegay in guuldarrooyinkii xiriirka ahaa ee dhawaan soo gaaray ay yihiin cashar muhiim ah: “Waa inaan ka gudubnaa xanuunkan. Wax badan ayaad ka baranaysaa koox ahaan marka aad wajahdo waqtiyo adag.”
Inkasta oo cadaadis jiro, wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay in himilada kooxda aysan is bedelin; guul iyo koobab: “Waxaan diiradda saareynaa inaan gaarno semi-final-ka FA Cup iyo sidoo kale inaan u soo baxno Champions League.”
Wuxuu sidoo kale ka digay in aan la fududeysan Port Vale, inkasta oo ay ku jiraan kaalinta ugu hooseysa League One, isagoo filaya kulan adag.

headline: Pep Guardiola Oo Durba Cabsi Ka Muujiyay Slot Ka Hor Kulanka FA Cup-ka
body:
Tababaraha Manchester City, Pep Guardiola, ayaa si weyn u ammaanay shaqada uu qabtay macallinka Liverpool, Arne Slot, xilli ciyaareedkiisii ugu horreeyay ee Anfield.
Guardiola ayaa qiray in Slot uu sameeyay wax cajiib ah, isagoo yiri: “Xilli ciyaareedkiisii ugu horreeyay, wuxuu ku guuleystay Premier League, wuu na burburiyay dhammaanteen…”
Hadalkan ayaa muujinaya sida ay u adag tahay guusha uu Slot gaaray, gaar ahaan marka la eego inuu ka hormaray kooxaha waaweyn sida Manchester City.
Labada koox ayaa markale isku wajahaya kulan ka tirsan FA Cup, taasoo sii kordhinaysa xiisaha tartanka u dhexeeya labada macallin.
Inkasta oo uu Guardiola ganaax ku maqanyahay oo uusan taagnaan doonin khadka tababaraha, haddana wuxuu si cad u muujiyay ixtiraamka uu u hayo Slot iyo shaqadiisa cajiibka ah ee Liverpool.

headline: ​”Isagaa Ah Kan Ugu Fiican”: Ronaldinho Oo Dunida U Sheegay Xiddiga Ka Yaabsan Doona Taageerayaasha Koobka Adduunka!
body:
Ronaldinho ayaa mar kale ammaanay saaxiibkiisii hore ee Barcelona, isagoo ku adkaystay in Lionel Messi uu weli yahay ciyaaryahanka ugu fiican adduunka, inkastoo uu ku dhow yahay dhammaadka xirfaddiisa.
Ronaldinho ayaa yiri: “Weli waa kan ugu fiican dunida, waxaana rajeynayaa inuu gaaro Koobka Adduunka isagoo qaab ciyaareed sare ku jira oo uu sameeyo waxyaabo cajiib ah.”
Messi, oo hadda u ciyaara Inter Miami, ayaa weli sii wada inuu saameyn weyn ku yeesho kubadda cagta, xitaa isagoo ka ciyaaraya Major League Soccer, taas oo Ronaldinho sheegay inay si weyn u korayso sanadba sanadka ka dambeeya.
Xiddigii hore ee Barcelona ayaa sidoo kale xusay xiriirka gaarka ah ee ka dhexeeya isaga iyo Messi, isagoo sheegay in kulamadooda mar walba yihiin kuwo farxad leh. Labadan halyeey ayaa taariikh weyn ku leh Barcelona, halkaas oo Ronaldinho uu door weyn ka ciyaaray koritaanka Messi, xitaa isaga oo u dhiibay lambarka caanka ah ee No.10.
Marka laga hadlayo FIFA World Cup 2026, Ronaldinho ayaa sheegay in Brazil ay tahay musharrax xooggan, balse uu tartanku noqon doono mid aad u adag maadaama kooxo badan ay awood leeyihiin.

headline: Liverpool Oo Ceyrineysa Arne Slot, Haddii…..
body:
Milkiilayaasha Liverpool ayaa weli taageere u muujinaya tababaraha kooxda Arne Slot, iyadoo taageerada ugu weyn ay ka imanayso gudaha kooxda lafteeda.
Gudaha Anfield waxaa si cad loo aqoonsan yahay in Slot uu la kulmay caqabado waaweyn xilli ciyaareedkan oo ay ka mid yihiin isbeddel badan oo ciyaartoy ah iyo dhaawacyo ku yimid xiddigaha muhiimka ah, kuwaas oo si weyn u saameeyay joogtaynta natiijooyinka.
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, dulqaadka maamulka ma sii jiri doono weligiis. Haddii qaab ciyaareedkii liitay ee ka horreeyay fasaxii caalamiga ahaa uu soo laabto, kalsoonida uu hadda haysto ayaa si degdeg ah u yaraan doontaa.
Ujeeddada ugu weyn ee kooxda ayaa ah inay ku dhammaysato afarta sare si ay ugu soo baxdo UEFA Champions League. Haddii taas la waayo, mustaqbalka Slot; gaar ahaan iyadoo qandaraaskiisu galayo sannadkii ugu dambeeyay bisha June, wuxuu si dhab ah u geli karaa khatar.

headline: Maxaa Ka Jira In Guardiola Uu Keydka Dhigi Doono Rodri Kadib Hadalladii Uu Ku Taageeray Real Madrid?
body:
Tababaraha Manchester City, Pep Guardiola, ayaa cadeeyay inuusan hor istaagi doonin Rodri haddii uu doonayo inuu ku biiro Real Madrid, isla markaana uusan raaci doonin tallaabadii ay qaaday Chelsea ee ganaaxa Enzo.
Guardiola ayaa si cad u yiri: “Ma jiro ciyaaryahan diidi doona fursadda uu ugu ciyaari karo Real Madrid.” Wuxuu intaas ku daray in xaaladda Chelsea ay tahay arrin iyaga u gaar ah, isaga oo tilmaamaya ganaaxii lagu soo rogay Enzo Fernandez kadib hadalladiisii ku saabsanaa mustaqbalkiisa.
Tababaraha reer Spain ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay in farxadda ciyaaryahanka ay ka muhiimsan tahay wax kasta: “Haddii ciyaaryahan uusan faraxsanayn, waa inuu baxaa.”
Inkasta oo uu jeclaan lahaa in Rodri sii joogo Etihad muddo dheer, Guardiola wuxuu qiray inuusan si buuxda u hubin go’aanka ugu dambeeya ee ciyaaryahanka, xilli ay kooxda diiradda saareyso heshiis cusub oo ay kusii heysaneyso xiddiga khadka dhexe.

headline: Marc Cucurella Oo Magacaabay Daafaca Bidix Ee Ugu Fiican Dunida Waqti Xaadir Kaan
body:
Daafaca bidix ee Chelsea, Marc Cucurella ayaa u magacaabay Nuno Mendes oo ka tirsan Paris Saint-Germain, daafaca bidix ee ugu fiican kubadda cagta caalamka xilligan, inkasta oo uu isagu sameeyay xilli ciyaareed heer sare ah.
Cucurella, oo loo aqoonsan yahay mid ka mid ah daafacyada bidix ee ugu fiican kubadda cagta hadda, ayaa noqday mid is-hoosaysiiyay markii la weydiiyay doorka garabka bidix intii uu wareysi kula jiray RNE.
“Midka aan ugu jecelahay xilligan waa Nuno Mendes,” ayuu yiri Cucurella, isagoo tilmaamaya xiddiga PSG kaasoo ku guuleystay UEFA Champions League.

headline: Arne Slot: “Kama Qoomameynayo Sidii Aan Ula Dhaqmay Salah”
body:
Tababaraha Liverpool, Arne Slot ayaa ka jawaabay dhaleeceynta ka dhalatay go’aanka Mohamed Salah uu kaga tagayo kooxda, isaga oo sheegay: “Kama qabo wax qoomamo ah sida aan xaaladda u maareeyay.”
Slot ayaa cadeeyay in go’aanka Salah uu ahaa mid shaqsi ah, wuxuuna si aan gabasho lahayn u yiri: “Wuu idiin sharraxay sababta uu u rabay inuu u baxo.”
Xiddiga reer Masar ayaa hore u muujiyay niyad-jabka uu ka qabo kaalintiisa kooxda, isagoo dareemay in aanu “la qiimeyn” isla markaana tilmaamay burbur ku yimid xiriirkiisa Slot xilli ciyaareedkan. Waxaa xitaa xaaladda sii xumaatay markii mararka qaarkood la dhigay keydka.
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Slot wuxuu ku adkeystay in kooxda ay si sax ah u dhaqantay intii uu socday xiriirka.
Bixidda Salah ayaa calaamad u ah dhammaadka waayihii cajiibka ahaa ee uu ku qaatay Liverpool, iyadoo mustaqbalka kooxda uu hadda yahay mid aan la hubin.

headline: Shaxda Ay Chelsea Kaga Hor Tagi Karto Port Vale Kulanka FA Cup-ka
body:
Kooxda Chelsea ayaa wajihi doonta Port Vale kulanka FA Cup-ka, balse waxaa war weyn ah, maqnaanshaha Enzo Fernandez.
Xiddiga reer Argentina ayaa ganaax labo kulan ah ku muteystay go’aan uu gaaray tababare Liam Rosenior, kadib hadallo uu dhawaan bixiyay oo shaki geliyay mustaqbalkiisa kooxda isla markaana la xiriiray xiisaha Real Madrid.
Rosenior ayaa la filayaa inuu soo saaro shax “tijaabo ah”, isagoo laga yaabo inuu nasiyo qaar ka mid ah xiddigaha waaweyn sida Cole Palmer, Moises Caicedo iyo Marc Cucurella.
Fursad ayaa u furmi karta ciyaartoyda aan inta badan ciyaarin sida Josh Acheampong, Benoit Badiashile iyo Liam Delap. Sidoo kale, khadka dhexe waxaa ku tartamaya Romeo Lavia, Dario Essugo iyo Andrey Santos.
Dhanka dhaawacyada, Chelsea waxaa ka maqan Reece James iyo Trevoh Chalobah, halka Levi Colwill uu weli ku jiro soo kabasho.
Shaxda la filayo (4-2-3-1):
Goolhaye: Sanchez
Difaac: Acheampong, Fofana, Badiashile, Hato
Khadka dhexe: Lavia, Essugo
Weerar: Estevao, Santos, Garnacho
Afka hore: Delap
Waqtiga: 7:15 PM (EAT), Sabti 4 April 2026
Garoonka: Stamford Bridge
Kulankan ayaa muhiim u ah Chelsea, iyagoo doonaya inay gaaraan semi-final-ka FA Cup inkastoo ay jiraan khilaafaad gudaha ah.

headline: Shaxda Ay Arsenal Kaga Hor Tagi Karto Southampton Kulanka FA Cup-ka
body:
Kooxda Arsenal ayaa heleysa war wanaagsan ka hor kulanka FA Cup-ka ay la ciyaarayaan Southampton, iyadoo kabtan Martin Odegaard la filayo inuu dib ugu soo laabto kooxda.
Odegaard ayaa ku maqnaa tan iyo bishii February dhaawac jilibka ah, balse hadda wuu soo kabtay waxaana la filayaa inuu qeyb ka noqdo kulanka ka dhacaya St Mary’s Stadium.
Mikel Arteta ayaa sidoo kale xaqiijiyay in Jurrien Timber uu ku dhow yahay inuu soo laabto kadib dhaawac gumaarka ah.
Dhanka kale, Noni Madueke ayaa seegi doona kulanka kadib dhaawac uu ka soo gaaray xulka England, inkastoo uusan halis weyn ahayn.
Indhaha ayaa si gaar ah loogu hayaa da’yarka 16-jirka ah Max Dowman, kaasoo laga yaabo inuu kusoo bilowdo garabka midig kadib qaab ciyaareedkii cajiibka ahaa ee uu sameeyay kulankii Everton.
Shaxda la filayo ee Arsenal:
Goolhaye: Kepa Arrizabalaga
Difaac: White, Mosquera, Gabriel, Lewis-Skelly
Khadka dhexe: Norgaard, Odegaard, Havertz
Weerar: Dowman, Jesus, Martinelli

Garoonka: St Mary’s Stadium
Kulankan ayaa muhiim u ah Arsenal, maadaama ay raadinayaan inay gaaraan semi-final-ka FA Cup isla markaana ay iska xaadiriyaan Wembley.

headline: Shaxda Ay Liverpool Kaga Hor Tagi Karto Man City Kulanka Wayn Ee FA Cup-ka
body:
Liverpool ayaa war fiican heshay Kulanka weyn ee FA Cup-ka ee ay la ciyaari doonto Manchester City, iyadoo Mohamed Salah dib ugu soo laabanayo safka kooxda Reds.
Salah ayaa maqnaa kulankii Brighton sababo la xiriira dhaawac muruq ah, balse hadda waa diyaar, taasoo si weyn u xoojinaysa weerarka Liverpool ka hor safarka Etihad.
Sidoo kale, tababare Arne Slot ayaa helay war wanaagsan oo ku saabsan Alexander Isak, kaasoo ku soo laabtay tababarka kadib dhaawac culus oo lugta ah. Inkastoo uusan weli diyaar u ahayn inuu kusoo bilowdo, waxaa suuragal ah inuu keydka kasoo galo.
Dhanka maqnaanshaha, Liverpool waxaa weli ka maqan Alisson Becker, halka sidoo kale ay dhaawac ay ku seegayaan kulanka Wataru Endo, Conor Bradley iyo Giovanni Leoni.
Shaxda la filayo (4-2-3-1):
Goolhaye: Mamardashvili
Difaac: Frimpong, Konate, Van Dijk, Kerkez
Khadka dhexe: Gravenberch, Mac Allister
Weerar: Salah, Szoboszlai, Wirtz
Afka hore: Ekitike
Garoonka: Etihad Stadium

headline: Pep Guardiola Oo Rodri Furka Ku Tuuray Kadib Markii Uu Shaaciyay Inuu Real Madrid Ku Riyoodo
body:
Tababaraha Manchester City, Pep Guardiola, ayaa sheegay inuusan hor istaagi doonin Rodri haddii uu doonayo inuu ka tago kooxda.
Hadalka Guardiola ayaa yimid kadib markii Rodri uu intii lagu jiray fasaxii kulamada caalamiga ahaa sheegay inuu mustaqbalka jeclaan lahaa inuu u ciyaaro Real Madrid.
Guardiola wuxuu cadeeyay in ciyaaryahan kasta oo aan ku faraxsanayn joogitaanka Etihad loo oggolaan doono inuu baxo.
“Haddii ciyaaryahan uusan ku faraxsanayn halkan, waa inuu baxaa,” ayuu yiri Guardiola. “Waxaan rajeynayaa inuu faraxsan yahay, laakiin haddii uusan ahayn, wuxuu garaaci karaa albaabka agaasimaha ciyaaraha, waxaana markaas la eegi doonaa dalab ku habboon tayadiisa weyn.”
Hadaladan ayaa muujinaya in City aysan ku qasbi doonin ciyaaryahan kasta inuu sii joogo haddii uu doonayo inuu baxo, inkastoo Rodri uu weli yahay mid ka mid ah ciyaartoyda ugu muhiimsan kooxda.

headline: Fariin Ka Timid Talyaaniga: Cesc Fabregas Ma Noqon Doonaa Tababaraha Cusub Ee Manchester United?
body:
Daaficii hore ee Talyaaniga, Marco Materazzi, ayaa aaminsan in Cesc Fabregas uu tixgelin doono fursad uu ku noqdo tababaraha Manchester United haddii loo soo bandhigo xagaagan.
Materazzi ayaa sheegay in inkastoo Fabregas uu xiriir adag la leeyahay kooxaha Arsenal iyo Chelsea, haddana uusan ka waaban doonin inuu ka fiirsado shaqo weyn sida United.
Waqti xaadirkan, Fabregas wuxuu shaqo fiican ka qabtaa kooxda Como, halkaas oo uu ka dhisay mashruuc xooggan. Si kastaba, Materazzi wuxuu tilmaamay in tababaraha reer Spain laga yaabo inuu sii joogo hal xilli ciyaareed oo kale si uu kooxda ugu hoggaamiyo Champions League ama xitaa ugu tartamo horyaalka Talyaaniga.
“Kooxo waaweyn sida Arsenal, Chelsea, Liverpool iyo Manchester United waa kuwo aad u waaweyn, laakiin Como sidoo kale waa koox dhaqaale leh,” ayuu yiri Materazzi.
Hadalkan ayaa muujinaya in mustaqbalka Fabregas uu noqon karo mid xiiso leh, iyadoo laga yaabo inuu kala doorto inuu sii horumariyo mashruuca Como ama uu qaado tallaabo weyn oo uu ugu wareegayo koox weyn oo Yurub ah.

headline: Hal Caqabad Oo Mo Salah Ka Hortaagan Inuu Ku Biiro Inter Miami Oo La Shaaciyay
body:
Kooxda Mareykanka ee Inter Miami ayaa si weyn u doonaysa saxiixa xiddiga Masar Mohamed Salah xagaagan, iyadoo ka faa’iideysanaysa bixitaankiisa la filayo ee Liverpool dhammaadka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Si kastaba, wararka ayaa sheegaya in caqabadda ugu weyn ee hortaagan heshiiska ay tahay mushaharka sare ee uu dalbanayo Salah. Inter Miami waa inay ama ka dhaadhicisaa inuu hoos u dhigo dalabkiisa ama ay si buuxda u bixiso si ay u dhammeystiraan heshiiska.
Dhanka kale, kooxaha ka ciyaara horyaalka Sacuudiga ayaa sidoo kale si xooggan u xiiseynaya Salah, iyagoo diyaar u ah inay bixiyaan mushaharka uu doonayo, taasoo sii adkeynaysa tartanka loogu jiro saxiixiisa.
Haddii uu heshiiskan dhaco, Salah wuxuu noqon karaa mid ka mid ah xiddigaha ugu waaweyn ee ku biira MLS, isagoo saameyn weyn ku yeelan kara kooxda sida ciyaartoy kale oo waaweyn ay horey uga sameeyeen horyaalka Mareykanka.

headline: Moises Caicedo Oo Magacaabay Saddexda Khad-dhexe Ee Uu Ku Daydo
body:
Xiddiga khadka dhexe ee Chelsea, Moises Caicedo, ayaa shaaca ka qaaday saddex ciyaaryahan oo uu u arko tusaale uu ku daydo.
Caicedo wuxuu magacaabay halyeeyada khadka dhexe ee kala ah N’Golo Kante, Claude Makelele iyo Paul Pogba inay yihiin kuwa ugu saameynta badan xirfaddiisa.
Wuxuu sheegay inuu si dhow u daraaseeyay qaab ciyaareedkooda si uu u horumariyo tayadiisa:
“Heerka ay gaareen wuxuu ka dhigay qaar ka mid ah kuwa ugu fiican dunida,” ayuu yiri Caicedo.
Ciyaaryahanka reer Ecuador ayaa sidoo kale xusay in uu doonayo inuu raaco waddadii ay mareen halyeeyadan, isagoo ku dadaalaya inuu noqdo mid ka mid ah ciyaartoyda ugu fiican khadka dhexe mustaqbalka.
Hadalka Caicedo wuxuu muujinayaa himiladiisa sare iyo rabitaankiisa ah inuu gaaro heerka ay gaareen ciyaartoydaas caanka ah, marka loo eego taariikhda kubadda cagta.

headline: Enzo: “Waan Baxayaa!” – Paul Merson Oo Qarxiyay Sirtii Ugu Weynayd Ee Chelsea.
body:
Halyeeygii hore ee Arsenal, Paul Merson, ayaa sheegay in Enzo Fernandez uu durba u sheegay tababaraha Chelsea, Liam Rosenior, inuu doonayo inuu ka tago kooxda xagaagan.
Merson wuxuu aaminsan yahay in waxyaabo badan ay ka socdaan gudaha kooxda, kana weyn hadalladii Enzo ee muranka dhaliyay, kuwaas oo uu ku sheegay inuu “aad u jeclaan lahaa” inuu ku noolaado Madrid.
“Waxaan u maleynayaa in wax badan ay dhaceen. Enzo wuu la fadhiistay Rosenior oo wuxuu ku yiri, ‘waxaan rabaa inaan baxo,’” ayuu yiri Merson.
Sidoo kale, Merson wuxuu dhaliilay go’aanka Rosenior ee ah in Enzo la ganaaxo labada kulan ee soo socda ee ay la ciyaarayaan Port Vale iyo Manchester City, isagoo sheegay in taasi ay dhaawici karto kooxda.
“Tababare ahaan waa inaadan naftaada waxyeelleyn. Taageerayaasha ha ka falceliyaan arrintaas, adiga ha sameyn,” ayuu yiri.
Wuxuu ku adkeystay in Enzo uu yahay mid ka mid ah ciyaartoyda ugu muhiimsan Chelsea, isla markaana ka maqnaanshihiisu uu faa’iido u yahay Manchester City, taasoo muujinaysa sida ay xaaladda Enzo murugo uga dhalisay Stamford Bridge.

headline: Jurgen Klopp Oo Ku Soo Laabanaya Liverpool
body:
Halyeeygii hore ee Liverpool, Vladimir Smicer, ayaa aaminsan in Jurgen Klopp uu mar uun dib ugu soo laaban doono kooxda.
Smicer ayaa sheegay in xiriirka gaarka ah ee Klopp la leeyahay taageerayaasha Liverpool iyo magaalada uu yahay mid aan la jebin karin, taasoo ka dhigaysa soo laabasho mustaqbalka mid aad suurtagal u ah.
“Markii aan ku arkay Klopp mar kale Anfield waxay ahayd wax cajiib ah. Waa qof aad u soo jiidasho leh, taageerayaashuna si weyn ayay u jecel yihiin,” ayuu yiri Smicer.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray:
“Haddii aad qof kasta oo Liverpool ah weydiiso inuu Klopp dib u soo laabto, dhammaantood ‘haa’ ayay dhihi doonaan. Wuxuu leeyahay wax gaar ah oo u dhexeeya isaga, kooxda iyo taageerayaasha.”
Klopp, oo ka tagay Liverpool sanadkii 2024 kadib sagaal sano oo guulo badan uu gaaray, ayaa hadda door ka haya nidaamka Red Bull. Si kastaba, iyadoo cadaadis uu saaran yahay tababaraha hadda ee Arne Slot, hadalka ku saabsan soo laabashada Klopp ayaa mar kale xoogeysanaya.
Smicer wuxuu aaminsan yahay in haddii Klopp go’aansado inuu soo laabto, ay “ku dhowaad noqon karin macquul in la diido” , taasoo muujinaysa sida uu weli u yahay halyey aan laga ilaawi karin Anfield.

Dhanka kale, Rosenior wuxuu cadeeyay in Cucurella ay si buuxda uga go’an tahay sii joogista kooxda kadib kulan ay yeesheen, taas oo muujinaysa in Chelsea ay isku dayayso inay xasiliso xaaladda gudaha kooxda ka hor dhammaadka xilli ciyaareedka.

headline: Caicedo Oo Wadnaha Jaray Taageerayaasha Chelsea, Isagoo Caddeeyay Kooxda Uu Daneynayo Inuu Ku Biiro.
body:
Xiddiga Khadka dhexe ee Chelsea, Moises Caicedo, ayaa si cad u muujiyay inuusan gebi ahaanba xirayn albaabka uu mustaqbalka ugu wareegi karo Real Madrid.
Caicedo oo ka hadlayay suurtagalnimada inuu ka ciyaaro garoonka Bernabéu, ayaa yiri:
“Kubadda cagta wax walba waad ku arki kartaa… waligaa ma ogid.”
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, xiddiga reer Ecuador wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay inuu hadda diiradda saarayo Chelsea:
“Waxaan qandaraas kula jiraa Chelsea, run ahaantiina wali kama fikirin inaan ka tago London.”
Wuxuu sidoo kale xusay inuu doonayo inuu ku raaxaysto ciyaarta isla markaana uu sii wato ciyaarista inta uu awoodo, isagoo mustaqbalka u daayay waxa dhici doona.
Inkasta oo uu sheegay inuu rabo inuu noqdo halyeey ka tirsan Chelsea, hadalladiisa ayaa muujinaya in haddii fursad weyn timaado mustaqbalka; gaar ahaan koox sida Real Madrid, uusan gabi ahaanba iska diidi doonin.

headline: “Klopp Oo Kale Ma Heli Kartaan” :- Jamie Carragher Oo Liverpool Uga Digay Ceydhinta Arne Slot
body:
Halyeeyga Liverpool, Jamie Carragher, ayaa taageerayaasha Reds uga digay inay si degdeg ah u dalbadaan in la eryo tababare Arne Slot, isagoo sidoo kale ka digay in Xabi Alonso loo arko xal toos ah.
Carragher ayaa qirtay in dhaliilaha Slot ay sii kordheen kadib natiijooyin liita, balse wuxuu sheegay in aan lagu degdegin go’aan:
“Dareenkeyga dabiiciga ah waa inaan taageero Slot, sababtoo ah wuxuu waqti dhow ku guuleystay horyaalka,” ayuu yiri.
Wuxuu si gaar ah uga digay in Liverpool ku dhacdo khaladkii ay sameysay Manchester United kadib bixitaankii Sir Alex Ferguson, markaas oo ay si joogto ah u beddeleen tababarayaal iyagoo raadinaya mid “cusub oo la mid ah.”
“Ma jiro Klopp oo kale. Wuxuu ahaa qof gaar ah,” ayuu Carragher xusay, isagoo tixraacaya saameyntii Jurgen Klopp ku lahaa Liverpool.
Ugu dambeyn, Carragher wuxuu rumeysan yahay in Slot wali yahay tababare da’yar oo horumar sameyn kara, isla markaana guulo uu ka gaaro FA Cup-ka iyo Champions League ay si degdeg ah u beddeli karaan aragtida taageerayaasha.

headline: “Muusan Af-lagaadeyn Kooxda, Khalad Ayaa Lagu Heystaa” :- Wakiilka Enzo Fernandez Oo Calaacal Afka Furtay
body:
Wakiilka Enzo Fernandez, Javier Pastore, ayaa si adag u difaacay ciyaaryahanka Chelsea kadib markii kooxda ay go’aansatay inay ciqaab ku soo rogto.
Pastore ayaa sheegay inuu farriin ka helay Chelsea xilli Enzo uu kusoo laabanayay London, iyagoo doonayay inay kala hadlaan wareysiga muranka dhaliyay. Wuxuu caddeeyay inuusan arkin wax ixtiraam darro ah oo ku jiray hadallada ciyaaryahanka.
“Wax dhibaato ah kuma arkin wareysiga. Ma uusan aflagaadeyn kooxda, saaxiibadiis, taageerayaasha ama cid kale,” ayuu yiri Pastore.
Wuxuu sidoo kale beeniyay wararka sheegaya in Enzo uu doonayo inuu ka tago Chelsea ama uu doorbidayo inuu ku noolaado Madrid, isagoo ku tilmaamay arrintaas mid ay warbaahintu si khaldan u fasirtay.
Pastore ayaa intaas ku daray in Enzo diyaar u yahay inuu raalli gelin bixiyo haddii ay jiraan taageerayaal dareemay in la xumeeyay, balse wuxuu ku adkeystay in ciyaaryahanku uusan waligiis si toos ah u muujin rabitaan uu uga tagayo kooxda.
Dhinaca kale, Pastore wuxuu sheegay in Chelsea ay u muuqato inay horey u gaartay go’aanka ciqaabta ka hor inta aysan jawaab  helin, taasoo sii kordhisay muranka ku hareeraysan xaaladda Enzo Fernandez.

headline: Gabriel Jesus Oo Ka Hadlay Fursadaha Arsenal Ee Ku Guuleysiga Premier League Xilli Ciyaareed Kaan

headline: Maxaa Ka Jira Wararka Sheegaya In Szoboszlai Uu Liverpool Ka Tagayo Xagaaga?
body:
Xiddiga khadka dhexe ee Liverpool, Dominik Szoboszlai, ayaa si cad u beeniyay wararka sheegaya inuu ka tagayo kooxda xagaagan.
Ciyaaryahanka reer Hungary ayaa sheegay inuu si weyn ugu faraxsan yahay nolosha iyo jawiga Anfield, isagoo yiri: “Waxaan jecelahay inaan halkan joogo. Qoyskeyga waa faraxsan yahay, waxaan jecelahay kooxda, taageerayaasha, iyo inaan u ciyaaro kooxdaan.”
Szoboszlai ayaa door muhiim ah ka qaatay Liverpool tan iyo markii uu yimid, isagoo goolal iyo caawino muhiim ah ku biiriyay kulamo waaweyn. Inkastoo uu jiray xiiso uga imaanayay kooxo waaweyn oo Yurub ah, hadalladiisa ayaa muujinaya inay si buuxda uga go’an tahay sii joogista kooxda.
Arrintan waxay war wanaagsan u tahay taageerayaasha Liverpool, gaar ahaan xilli ay jiraan isbedello badan oo la filayo xagaaga.

headline: Maamulka Sare Ee Liverpool Oo Go’aan Lama Filaan Ah Ka Soo Saaray Mustaqbalka Arne Slot
body:
Kooxda Liverpool ayaa si cad u muujisay taageerada ay u hayso tababare Arne Slot, iyadoo milkiilayaasha kooxda, Fenway Sports Group, ay si rasmi ah uga fogaadeen wararka sheegaya in mustaqbalkiisa shaqo uu ku xiran yahay natiijooyinka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Warbixinta ayaa tilmaameysa in aysan jirin hadaf gaar ah oo Slot looga baahan yahay si uu shaqadiisa ugu sii nagaado xagaaga, inkastoo Liverpool ay ku jirto kaalinta shanaad ee horyaalka isla markaana ay guuldarrooyin badan soo gaareen xilli ciyaareedkan.
Go’aankan ayaa muujinaya in maamulka sare aysan qorsheyneyn isbedel weyn oo dhanka tababarka ah, isla markaana aysan ku saleyn doonin mustaqbalka Slot natiijooyinka dhamaadka xilli ciyaareedka oo keliya.
Sidoo kale, tallaabadan waxay meesha ka saaraysaa wararka kooxda la xiriirinaya Xabi Alonso, iyadoo maamulka Liverpool ay u arkaan wararkaasi kuwo aan sal lahayn.
Gudaha kooxda, waxaa la rumeysan yahay in Slot oo ku guuleystay horyaalka Premier League xilli ciyaareedkiisii ugu horreeyay uu mudan yahay waqti dheeri ah iyo taageero dhinaca suuqa kala iibsiga ah si uu kooxda ugu soo celiyo heerkeedii sare.
Si kastaba, toddobaadyada soo socda ayaa noqon doona kuwo aad u muhiim ah, iyadoo Liverpool ay wajaheyso kulamo isdaba-joog ah oo ka tirsan FA Cup, Champions League iyo Premier League.

headline: Liverpool Oo War Xun Ka Heshay Xaaladda Alisson Becker Ka Hor Kulanka PSG
body:
Tababaraha Liverpool, Arne Slot, ayaa xaqiijiyay in goolhayaha reer Brazil Alisson Becker uusan ka qeyb geli doonin kulanka ay la ciyaarayaan Paris Saint-Germain.
Slot ayaa sheegay in Alisson uu si wanaagsan u soo kabanayo, balse aan la doonayn in halis la geliyo. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in la filayo inuu si buuxda u soo laabto dhammaadka xilli ciyaareedka.
Dhanka kale, tababaraha reer Netherlands ayaa ka hadlay xaaladda Jeremie Frimpong, isagoo xaqiijiyay in daafaca midig uu tababar la qaatay kooxda isla markaana uu u muuqdo mid xaalad fiican ku sugan. Si kastaba, wuxuu qirtay in ciyaarista jadwal adag oo saddexdii maalmoodba mar ah ay wali caqabad ku tahay.
Slot ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in tani ay keeni karto go’aan adag oo ku saabsan waqti ciyaareedka Frimpong, balse uu rajeynayo inuu xal u helo, maadaama xulashooyinka daafaca midig ay xaddidan yihiin.

headline: Mikel Arteta Oo Ku Guuleystay Abaalmarinta Tababaraha Bisha Ee Premier League
body:
Tababaraha Arsenal, Mikel Arteta, ayaa loo magacaabay Tababaraha Bisha Maarso ee Premier League kadib markii uu kooxdiisa ku hoggaamiyay guulo buuxa.
Arsenal ayaa badisay dhammaan saddexdii kulan ee ay ciyaartay bishaas, iyagoo ka adkaaday Chelsea (2-1), Brighton & Hove Albion (1-0) iyo Everton (2-0). Goolka guusha ee Brighton waxaa dhaliyay Bukayo Saka, halka ciyaartii Everton ay goolal ka kala yimaadeen Viktor Gyökeres iyo Max Dowman.
Natiijooyinkan ayaa u suurageliyay Arsenal inay sagaal dhibcood ka sareyso Manchester City oo kaalinta labaad ku jirta.
Abaalmarintan ayaa ah tii siddeedaad ee Arteta tan iyo markii uu qabtay shaqada bishii December 2019, waana tii ugu horreysay tan iyo Febraayo 2024. Wuxuu kaga adkaaday tartanka tababarayaal ay ka mid yihiin Eddie Howe, David Moyes, Régis Le Bris iyo Fabian Hürzeler.
Guushan ayaa sii muujineysa shaqada weyn ee Arteta ka wado Arsenal iyo sida ay ugu dhowdahay hanashada horyaalka.

headline: Saadaasha Alan Shearer Ee Kulamada FA Cup Ee Usbuucaan
body:
Halyeeyga Newcastle United, Alan Shearer, ayaa bixiyay saadaashiisa kulamada wareega sideed dhammaadka FA Cup.
Shearer ayaa aaminsan in Manchester City ay ka adkaan doonto Liverpool, isagoo sheegay in City ay ku jirto xaalad fiican kadib guushii EFL Cup.
Kulanka kale, wuxuu saadaaliyay in Chelsea ay si fudud uga badin doonto Port Vale, halka Arsenal ay guul ka gaari doonto Southampton oo ay marti u tahay.
Sidoo kale, Shearer ayaa rumeysan in West Ham United ay ka adkaan doonto Leeds United.
Saadaashan ayaa muujineysa kalsoonida uu ku qabo kooxaha waaweyn, iyadoo tartanka FA Cup uu marayo marxalad aad u xasaasi ah oo go’aamin doonta kooxaha u gudbaya afar dhammaadka.

headline: Ciyaartoyda Ugu Qiimaha Badan Koox Kasta Oo Premier League Ka Dhisan
body:
Qiimeyntii ugu dambeysay ee Transfermarkt ayaa shaaca ka qaaday ciyaartoyda ugu qiimaha badan ee koox kasta oo ka tirsan Premier League xilli ciyaareedkan.
Xiddiga ugu sarreeya waa Erling Haaland oo ka tirsan Manchester City, isagoo lagu qiimeeyay €200 milyan. Waxaa ku xiga Bukayo Saka (€120m) oo u ciyaara Arsenal, halka Cole Palmer (€110m) uu yahay kan ugu qaalisan Chelsea.
Florian Wirtz (€110m) ayaa hogaaminaya Liverpool, halka Bryan Mbeumo (€80m) uu yahay kan ugu qiimaha badan Manchester United.
Ciyaartoyda kale ee liiska ku jira waxaa ka mid ah Sandro Tonali (Newcastle), Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa), iyo Micky van de Ven (Tottenham).
Dhinaca hoose, ciyaartoyda ugu qiimaha yar liiska waxaa ka mid ah Ethan Ampadu oo ka tirsan Leeds United iyo Lesley Ugochukwu oo ka tirsan Burnley, kuwaas oo lagu qiimeeyay €25 milyan.
Qiimeyntan ayaa muujineysa farqiga weyn ee u dhexeeya xiddigaha ugu sarreeya iyo kuwa kale, iyadoo sidoo kale tilmaamaysa ciyaartoyda saameynta weyn ku leh kooxahooda xilli ciyaareedkan.

headline: Gabriel Jesus Oo Magacaabay Xiddiga Laf-dhabarta U Ah Arsenal Iyo Waxqabadkiisa
body:
Weeraryahanka Arsenal, Gabriel Jesus, ayaa amaanay saaxiibkiis Declan Rice, isagoo ku tilmaamay inuu yahay ciyaaryahan wax walba ka qaban kara garoonka dhexdiisa.
Jesus oo ka hadlayay kanaalka YouTube ee Rio Ferdinand, ayaa tilmaamay in Rice uu leeyahay awood dhameystiran oo ay wehliso difaacasho, abuurista fursado iyo gool dhalin.
Wuxuu sheegay in markii Rice uu ka yimid West Ham United, uu si gaar ah u codsaday inuu mar kasta toogto goolka marka uu helo fursad. Jesus ayaa aaminsan in toogashada Rice ay go’aan ka gaari karto kulamada waaweyn.
“Waa ciyaaryahan sameyn kara wax walba; wuu difaaci karaa, wuxuu abuuri karaa fursado, wuxuuna dhalin karaa goolal,” ayuu yiri Jesus, isagoo ku tilmaamay Rice mid ka mid ah xiddigaha ugu muhiimsan kooxda.
Hadalkan ayaa muujinaya sida weyn ee Rice u noqday tiir-dhexaadka Arsenal tan iyo markii uu ku soo biiray kooxda.

headline: Barcelona Oo Iibineysa Ferran Torres, Haddii…..
body:
Kooxda Barcelona ayaa diyaar u ah inay ka fiirsato iibinta weeraryahankeeda Ferran Torres xagaaga, balse kaliya haddii ay helaan dalab lacageed oo weyn.
Sida uu sheegay khabiirka suuqa kala iibsiga Fabrizio Romano, Barcelona si firfircoon uguma riixeyso Torres inuu baxo, mana raadineyso kooxo iibsada waqtigan.
Torres, oo qandaraaskiisu dhacayo sanadka dambe, ayaa doonaya inuu sii joogo Camp Nou, laakiin mustaqbalkiisa wuxuu ku xirnaan doonaa qorshaha kooxda ee weerarka.
Barcelona ayaa dooneysa inay la soo saxiixato Julian Alvarez oo ka tirsan Atletico Madrid, isla markaana ay kordhiso heshiiska Robert Lewandowski iyadoo mushaharkiisa la dhimayo. Tani waxay cadaadis saari kartaa booska Torres.
Inkasta oo uu hoos u dhac ku yimid gooldhalintiisa, tababaraha Hansi Flick ayaa weli aaminsan inuu dib u heli karo qaab ciyaareedkiisii fiicnaa.

headline: Liverpool Oo Iska Diraysa 5 Xiddig Suuqa Xagaaga
body:
Kooxda Liverpool ayaa wajahaysa isbeddel weyn oo ku yimaada ciyaartoydeeda xagaagan, iyadoo warbixinadu sheegayaan in dhowr xiddig oo muhiim ah la iibin karo.
Ciyaartoyda sida Cody Gakpo, Alexis Mac Allister, Federico Chiesa iyo Joe Gomez ayaa la sheegay in la heli karo, halka Andy Robertson uu qorsheynayo inuu baxo kadib Koobka Adduunka.
Sidoo kale, mustaqbalka Ibrahima Konate ayaa shaki ku jira iyadoo heshiiskiisu gabaabsi yahay, halka bixitaanka Mohamed Salah horey loo xaqiijiyay. Curtis Jones isna wali lama hubo inuu sii joogi doono.
Dhanka kale, cadaadis ayaa saaran tababare Arne Slot, iyadoo warar sheegayaan in Xabi Alonso loo arko beddelkiisa suurtagalka ah.
Liverpool ayaa sidoo kale raadineysa xiddigo cusub, iyadoo magacyada sida Carlos Baleba, Adam Wharton, Elliot Anderson iyo Eduardo Camavinga lala xiriirinayo.
Isbeddelkan ballaaran wuxuu muujinayaa in Liverpool ay diyaar u tahay dib-u-dhis weyn, si ay mar kale ugu tartanto horyaalka iyo koobabka Yurub.

headline: Thierry Henry:- “Arsenal Waa Inay Awood Muujisaa Kulamada Ka Harsan Horyaalka”
body:
Halyeeyga Arsenal, Thierry Henry, ayaa ugu baaqay kooxda inay si degdeg ah uga gudbaan guuldarradii final-ka EFL Cup ee ay kala kulmeen Manchester City.
Henry ayaa sheegay in City ay muujiyeen jawaab adag inkastoo qaab ciyaareedkooda horyaalka uu ahaa mid aan degganeyn, balse Arsenal ay tahay inay diiradda saarto hadafka ugu weyn ee ah ku guuleysiga horyaalka.
Wuxuu tilmaamay in ciyaartoydu ay muujiyeen niyad-jab kadib kulanka, balse ay muhiim tahay inay taas u beddelaan dhiirigelin. “Mar walba way adag tahay inaad final guuldarro ka qaadato, laakiin waa inaad sii socotaa,” ayuu yiri.
Henry ayaa sidoo kale ku booriyay Arsenal inay ka faa’iideystaan fursadaha harsan, gaar ahaan marka ay mar kale kula kulmaan City garoonka Etihad, si ay uga aar-gutaan natiijadaas.
Ugu dambeyn, wuxuu caddeeyay in inkastoo guuldarradaasi saameyn ku yeelan tartanka horyaalka, haddana Arsenal ay tahay inay si xooggan uga jawaabto, iyadoo awooddeeda ku muujineysa dhammaan tartamada ay ku jirto.

headline: “Waa Nacas Aan U Qalmin Calaamadda Kabtan-nimada”:- Obi Mikel Oo Mar Kale Kabaha La Dul-maray Enzo Fernandez
body:
Halyeeygii hore ee Chelsea, John Obi Mikel, ayaa si adag u dhaliilay Enzo Fernandez kadib hadallo dhayalsi ah oo uu kaga hadlay kooxda iyo mustaqbalkiisa.
Mikel ayaa ku eedeeyay Enzo inuu muujiyay hoggaan xumo, gaar ahaan kadib markii uu ka hadlay guuldarradii ay kala kulmeen Paris Saint-Germain ee Champions League, isagoo sidoo kale shaki geliyay mustaqbalkiisa Chelsea iyo xitaa muujiyay inuu jecel yahay inuu ku noolaado Madrid.
Isagoo ka hadlayay Podcast-kiisa, Mikel wuxuu sheegay in ciyaaryahan hoggaan leh uusan si fagaare ah uga hadlin arrimaha noocaas ah, gaar ahaan marka uu xiranyahay calaamadda kabtannimada.
“Taasi ma aha hoggaamiye-nimo. Ma sameyn kartid hadalladaas kadib marka aad si xun uga hartaan Champions League. Waa inaad ixtiraamtaa kooxda, calaamadda iyo taageerayaasha,” ayuu yiri Mikel.
Wuxuu sidoo kale xusay inaysan jirin ciyaaryahan ka weyn kooxda, isagoo Enzo ugu baaqay inuu ixtiraamo Chelsea, maadaama taageerayaashu ay door weyn ku leeyihiin guusha iyo mushaharkiisa.

headline: Emmanuel Petit Oo Shaaciyay Saddex Xiddig Uu Aaminsan Yahay Inay Isaga Tagayaan Chelsea Suuqa Xagaaga

headline: Pep Guardiola Oo U Sheegay City Waqtiga Uu Go’aan Ka Gaarayo Mustaqbalkiisa Kooxda
body:
Tababaraha Manchester City, Pep Guardiola, ayaa shaaciyay inuu go’aankiisa mustaqbalka kooxda shaacin doono dhammaadka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Guardiola, oo qandaraas kula jira City ilaa 2027, ayaa wajahaya warar isa soo taraya oo sheegaya inuu ka tagi karo kooxda, inkastoo aan wali wax go’aan rasmi ah la gaarin.
Wararka ayaa tilmaamaya in tababaraha reer Spain uu doonayo inuu qiimeeyo halka ay kooxdu marayso marka xilli ciyaareedku dhamaado bisha May, kahor inta uusan go’aan ka gaarin inuu sii joogo iyo in kale.
Arrintan ayaa muhiim u ah mustaqbalka kooxda, maadaama City ay horey u qorsheynayso beddelkiisa, iyadoo magacyada sida Enzo Maresca loo saadaalinayo musharraxa ugu horreeya.
Inkasta oo xilli ciyaareedkii hore ay ku dhammeeysteen koob la’aan, City ayaa horey u qaaday EFL Cup xilli ciyaareedkan kadib markii ay ka adkaadeen Arsenal final-ka, taasoo muujineysa in kooxda wali tartan adag ku jirto.

headline: Casemiro Oo Magacaabay Cidda Hoggaamin Doonta Khadka Dhexe Ee United 10-ka Sano Ee Soo Socota
body:
Xiddiga khadka dhexe ee Manchester United, Casemiro, ayaa si weyn u amaanay saaxiibkiisa kooxda Kobbie Mainoo, isagoo aaminsan inuu noqon karo mid ka mid ah khad dhexe-yaasha ugu fiican adduunka muddo dheer.
Casemiro ayaa sheegay in Mainoo uu yahay “hadda iyo mustaqbalka” kooxda, isla markaana uu leeyahay tayada iyo maskaxda ciyaareed ee ka dhigi karta mid heer sare sii ahaada 10 ilaa 12 sano ee soo socota.
“Kobbie waa ciyaaryahan aan aad u jeclahay. Mar walba wuxuu ku raaxeystaa kubadda, wuxuuna muujiyaa inuusan waligiis lumin doonin diiradda,” ayuu yiri Casemiro.
Mainoo ayaa mar kale noqday laf-dhabarta khadka dhexe ee United tan iyo markii uu yimid tababare Michael Carrick, isagoo door muhiim ah ka ciyaaray guulo waaweyn oo ay ka gaareen kooxo sida Manchester City iyo Tottenham.
Inkasta oo Casemiro la filayo inuu ka tago Old Trafford dhammaadka xilli ciyaareedka, hadalkiisa ayaa caddeynaya in Manchester United ay weli haysato mustaqbal ifaya oo uu hoggaaminayo Mainoo.

headline: Shaxda Ugu Fiican Premier League Oo La Soo Saaray.
body:
Halyeyga kubadda cagta Ingiriiska Alan Shearer ayaa soo saaray shaxdiisa ugu fiican ee Premier League xilli ciyaareedkan, iyadoo lagu jiro marxaladda ugu dambeysa ee tartanka.
Shearer ayaa qiimeeyay ciyaartoydii ugu saameynta badnaa tan iyo bilowga xilli ciyaareedka, isagoo doortay xiddigihii ugu fiicnaa ee ka caawiyay kooxahooda inay meel sare ka gaaraan kala sarreynta.
Kooxda Arsenal ayaa heshay saamiga ugu badan ee shaxda, iyadoo ay ugu jiraan afar ciyaaryahan, taasoo muujineysa xilli ciyaareedkooda cajiibka ah.
Waxaa ku xigta Manchester City ooshaxda ku leh saddex ciyaaryahan, halka kooxaha kale sida Manchester United, Brentford, Chelsea iyo Fulham ay mid walba ku leedahay hal ciyaaryahan.
Xulashadan ayaa muujineysa sida ay kooxaha waaweyn iyo kuwa dhexdhexaadka ahba u soo bandhigeen ciyaartoy heer sare ah xilli ciyaareedkan, iyadoo tartanka horyaalka uu weli si adag u socdo.

headline: Chelsea Oo Caddeysay Mowqif Keeda Mustaqbalka Enxo Fernandez
body:
Kooxda Chelsea ayaa la sheegay inay ka niyad jabsan tahay qaab ciyaareedka iyo doorka Enzo Fernandez, iyadoo warbixino ay tilmaamayaan in bixitaankiisu uusan noqon doonin musiibo weyn oo kooxda ku habsata.
Inkasta oo Fernandez uu heshiis kula jiro Chelsea ilaa 2032, haddana waxaa jira shaki ku saabsan inuu si buuxda ugu habboon yahay qorshaha fog ee kooxda. Qaar ka mid ah maamulka ayaa aaminsan in haddii uu baxo, aysan dhib weyn noqon doonin – gaar ahaan haddii lagu helo iibin tiisa lacag badan.
Waxaa sidoo kale jirta xiiseyn ka imaaneysa Real Madrid, balse wararka ayaa sheegaya in kooxda reer Spain aysan diyaar u ahayn inay bixiso lacag ka badan €100 milyan, taasoo caqabad ku noqotay suurtagalnimada heshiiska.
Chelsea ayaa hore u gelisay lacag badan saxiixa Fernandez, waxayna weli ku tiirsan tahay heshiisyo dhaadheer si ay u ilaaliso qiimaha ciyaartoydeeda iyo istaraatiijiyadda dhaqaale ee kooxda.

headline: Gabriel Jesus Oo Daaha Ka Rogay Cidda Ka Dambeysa Guulaha Arsenal Sanadihii Dambe
body:
Weeraryahanka Arsenal, Gabriel Jesus, ayaa si weyn u amaanay tababaraha kooxdiisa, Mikel Arteta, isagoo ku tilmaamay ninka beddelay wax walba oo kooxda ah.
Jesus ayaa sheegay in Arteta uu yimid xilli adag oo ay kooxda dhibtooneysay, balse uu si tartiib tartiib ah u beddelay maskaxda ciyaartoyda iyo qaabka ay u ciyaaraan. Wuxuu xusay in horumarka hadda muuqda uu yahay mid cad, islamarkaana Arsenal ay noqotay koox si dhab ah ugu tartami karta koobabka waaweyn.
“Wuxuu beddelay wax walba. Wuxuu yimid xilli adag, laakiin hadda marka aad aragto sida aan u ciyaareyno iyo meesha aan joogno, waxaan nahay koox ka mid ah kuwa ugu fiican dunida,” ayuu yiri Jesus.
Hadalka Jesus ayaa muujinaya saameynta weyn ee Arteta ku yeeshay Arsenal, isagoo ka dhigay koox mar kale u tartami karta horyaalada iyo koobabka waaweyn.

headline: Manchester City Oo Qaaday Tallaabo Ay Rodri Kaga Hor Istaageyso Inuu Ku Biiro Real Madrid
body:
Kooxda Manchester City ayaa u gudbisay heshiis cusub xiddigeeda khadka dhexe Rodri, iyadoo la siiyay dalab mushahar sare leh si loo xaqiijiyo mustaqbalkiisa fog ee kooxda.
Wararka uu bixiyay Fabrizio Romano ayaa sheegaya in go’aanka hadda uu ku xiran yahay Rodri, kaasoo kala dooran doona inuu sii joogo Etihad ama uu tixgeliyo fursad kale oo cusub.
Xiisaha Real Madrid ayaa sii huriyay wararka ku saabsan mustaqbalkiisa, inkastoo aysan jirin dalab rasmi ah ama wada-hadal toos ah oo u dhexeeya labada kooxood ilaa hadda.

headline: Liverpool Oo Heshiis Cusub U Soo Bandhigtay Ibrahima Konate
body:
Kooxda Liverpool ayaa sii wada dadaallada ay ku doonayso inay ku cusboonaysiiso qandaraaska daafaceeda Ibrahima Konate, iyadoo durba loo gudbiyay heshiis cusub oo muddo dheer ah, sida uu sheegay Florian Plettenberg.
Qandaraaska hadda ee Konaté ayaa galay marxaladdii ugu dambeysay, waxaana weli la gaarin heshiis rasmi ah, balse Liverpool ayaa weli rajo weyn ka qabta inay sii haysato xiddigan inkastoo ay jirto xiiseyn xooggan oo uga imaaneysa kooxo waa weyn sida Real Madrid.
Inkasta oo wada-hadalladu socdaan, Konaté wuxuu sii ahaanayaa tiir muhiim ah oo ka tirsan kooxda uu hoggaamiyo Arne Slot, isagoo noqday xubin joogto ah oo safka hore ah xilli ciyaareedkan.
Daafaca reer France ayaa saftay 41 kulan dhammaan tartamada, isagoo sidoo kale dhaliyay laba gool, taasoo muujineysa doorkiisa weyn ee kooxda.
Liverpool waxay doonaysaa inay si degdeg ah u xalliso mustaqbalkiisa si ay uga hortagto xiisaha sii kordhaya ee kooxaha kale.

headline: Bruno Fernandes Oo Ku Guuleystay Abaalmarinta Xiddiga Bisha Ee Premier League
body:
Kabtanka Manchester United, Bruno Fernandes, ayaa sameeyay qaab ciyaareed cajiib ah, isagoo ku guuleystay abaal-marinta Premier League Player of the Month ee bisha March 2026.
Xiddiga reer Portugal ayaa door weyn ka qaatay natiijooyinka wanaagsan ee kooxda, isagoo bishii la soo dhaafay dhaliyay 2 gool isla markaana bixiyay 4 caawin, taasoo ka caawisay United inay sii xajistaan kaalinta 3-aad ee horyaalka iyo rajada u soo bixista UEFA Champions League xilli ciyaareedka soo socda.
1-dii Maarso, Fernandes ayaa si weyn uga dhex muuqday kulankii ay ka badiyeen Crystal Palace, isagoo dhaliyay gool islamarkaana caawiye u noqday goolka uu dhaliyay Benjamin Sesko.
Inkasta oo United ay guuldarro kala kulmeen Newcastle United maalmo kadib, haddana Fernandes ayaa markale door muuqda qaatay, isagoo kubbad u soo qaaday Casemiro gool loo rogay.
Guusha abaal-marintan ayaa muujineysa hoggaamintiisa iyo saameynta weyn ee uu ku leeyahay kooxda xilli ciyaareedkan.

headline: DEG-DEG: Bernardo Silva Oo Shaaciyay Inuu Ka Tagayo Man City
body:
Xiddiga khadka dhexe ee Manchester City, Bernardo Silva, ayaa la xaqiijiyay inuu ka tagayo City xagaagan, iyadoo bixitaankiisa lagu sheegay “100% go’aan la gaaray” sida uu sheegay Fabrizio Romano.
Qandaraaska Silva ayaa dhacaya bisha June, wuxuuna bilaabi doonaa inuu qiimeeyo dalabyada uga imaanaya kooxaha kala duwan toddobaadyada soo socda, si uu u doorto halka uu u wareegayo.
Silva ayaa tan iyo markii uu kaga yimid AS Monaco sanadkii 2017 noqday mid ka mid ah ciyaartoyda ugu muhiimsan City, isagoo door weyn ka qaatay guulihii waaweynaa ee kooxda.
Mudadii uu joogay Etihad, wuxuu saftay in ka badan 400 kulan, wuxuuna ku guuleystay koobab badan oo ay ka mid yihiin Premier League (6 jeer), FA Cup, EFL Cup (5 jeer) iyo UEFA Champions League.
Hadda, Silva ayaa diyaar u ah inuu soo afjaro 9 sano oo uu ku qaatay Manchester City, isagoo bilaabaya cutub cusub oo xirfaddiisa ah.

body:

Gerrard ayaa sheegay in Slot uu la wareegay koox uu dhisay Jurgen Klopp, isla markaana dhaqankii iyo qaabkii hore ee kooxda ay weli saameyn ku leeyihiin ciyaarta Liverpool. Wuxuu xusay in Slot uu keenay fikrado cusub iyo neecaw cusub, balse dhibaatooyinka hadda jira ay soo bilaabmeen dhammaadkii xilli ciyaareedkii hore.
Wuxuu si gaar ah u amaanay daacadnimada Slot, qaabkiisa tababarka iyo faahfaahinta uu ku shaqeeyo, inkastoo uu sheegay inuu mararka qaar si aad ah u daacad yahay marka uu warbaahinta la hadlayo.
Gerrard ayaa sidoo kale carrabka ku adkeeyay in ku guuleysiga horyaalka Premier League ay tahay arrin aad u adag, isla markaana Slot uu mudan yahay waqti dheeri ah.
“Qof horyaal ku guuleystay xilli ciyaareedkiisii ugu horreeyay waa in la siiyo ugu yaraan hal xilli ciyaareed oo buuxa si uu uga baxo dhibaatooyinka,” ayuu yiri Gerrard, isagoo intaas ku daray in taageerayaasha Liverpool ay mararka qaar adag tahay in dib loo kasbado marka ay niyad jabaan.

headline: William Gallas Oo Saadaaliyay In Arsenal Hal Koob Kaliya Ku Guuleysan Doonto Haddii…..
body:
Halyeeygii hore ee Chelsea, William Gallas, ayaa saadaaliyay in Arsenal ay ku guuleysan doonto hal koob oo keliya xilli ciyaareedkan.
Gallas ayaa aaminsan in kooxda uu hoggaamiyo Mikel Arteta ay ku guuleysan doonto Premier League, balse aysan qaadi doonin UEFA Champions League ama FA Cup.
Wuxuu yiri: “Arsenal hal koob ayay qaadi doontaa, waana Premier League. Waa inay taxaddar muujiyaan, laakiin booska ay ku jiraan hadda, waa inay ku guuleystaan.”
Marka laga hadlayo Champions League, Gallas wuxuu si cad u sheegay inuusan u arkin Arsenal inay gaari karto guusha tartankaas. Dhanka FA Cup-ka, wuxuu tilmaamay in natiijada kulanka u dhexeeya Liverpool iyo Manchester City ay door weyn ka ciyaari doonto cidda koobka qaadaysa.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray in haddii final-ka ay gaaraan City, ay u badan tahay inay ku guuleystaan, balse haddii ay noqoto Arsenal iyo Liverpool, uu aaminsan yahay in Arsenal ay markaas fursad fiican heli doonto.

headline: Manchester City Oo Go’aansatay Macallinka Ay Ku Beddeleyso Guardiola
body:
Kooxda Manchester City ayaa go’aansatay tababaraha ay doonayso inuu beddelo Pep Guardiola, haddii uu ka tago kooxda mustaqbalka dhow.
Wararka uu shaaciyay khabiirka suuqa kala iibsiga Fabrizio Romano ayaa sheegaya in Enzo Maresca uu yahay musharraxa koowaad ee City u aragto inuu la wareego shaqada.
Kooxda ayaa la sheegay inay si buuxda u ixtiraamayso go’aanka Guardiola, isla markaana aysan ku qasbi doonin inuu baxo, iyadoo mustaqbalkiisa uu gacantiisa ku jiro.
Inkasta oo magacyo kale sida Vincent Kompany lala xiriiriyay xilka, haddana Manchester City waxay si gaar ah u qiimeyneysaa Maresca, oo ay u aragto inuu yahay qof si fiican u fahamsan falsafadda kooxda.
Haddii Guardiola go’aansado inuu baxo, Maresca ayaa hadda u muuqda doorashada ugu dhow ee lagu aamini karo hoggaanka Etihad.

headline: Gabriel Jesus Oo Magacaabay Ciyaaryahanka Ugu Fiican Arsenal Xilli Ciyaareed Kaan
body:
Weeraryahanka Arsenal, Gabriel Jesus, ayaa doortay ciyaaryahanka uu u arko kan ugu fiican kooxda xilligan, isagoo tilmaamay saaxiibkiis Gabriel Martinelli.
Jesus ayaa sheegay in Martinelli uu ahaa ciyaaryahan gaar ah tan iyo markii uu yaraa, isagoo xusuustay markii ugu horreysay ee uu arko, xilli ay isku diyaarinayeen Copa America 2019.
Wuxuu yiri: “Waxaa jira ciyaartoy badan oo fiican, laakiin waxaan dooranayaa Martinelli. Markii ugu horreysay ee aan arkay, waxaan iri, ‘waa wiil aad u fiican.’”
Martinelli, oo ku biiray Arsenal sanadkii 2019, isagoo ka yimid Ituano FC, ayaa si tartiib tartiib ah u noqday mid ka mid ah xiddigaha ugu muhiimsan kooxda, isagoo caan ku noqday xawaarihiisa, farsamadiisa iyo goolasha muhiimka ah.
Hadalka Jesus ayaa muujinaya kalsoonida weyn ee uu ku qabo Martinelli, gaar ahaan xilli ay Arsenal u dagaallameyso hanashada koobab muhiim ah.

headline: Saadaasha Paul Merson Ee Kulamada FA Cup Ee Usbuucaan
body:
Halyeeygii hore ee Arsenal, Paul Merson, ayaa saadaaliyay kulamada wareegga siddeed dhammaadka FA Cup ee toddobaadkan.
Merson ayaa aaminsan in Manchester City ay 2-1 ku garaaci doonto Liverpool kulanka ka dhacaya Etihad Stadium.
Sidoo kale, wuxuu saadaaliyay in Chelsea ay si fudud 3-0 ugu awood sheegan doonto Port Vale.
Kulanka kale, wuxuu sheegay in Arsenal ay 2-1 uga badin doonto Southampton.
Ugu dambeyn, Merson ayaa saadaaliyay in West Ham United iyo Leeds United ay 1-1 ay ku kala bixi doonaan, balse West Ham ay ku badin doonto rigoorayaal.
Saadaashadiisa ayaa muujineysa inuu aaminsan yahay in kooxaha waaweyn ay inta badan gaari doonaan wareegga xiga, inkastoo FA Cup mar walba laga filan karo lama filaan.

headline: Steven Gerrard Oo Shaaciyay Halka Uu Mo Salah Aadi Doono Kadib Marka Uu Ka Tago Liverpool
body:
Halyeeyga Liverpool, Steven Gerrard, ayaa saadaaliyay halka uu ku dambeyn doono xiddiga reer Masar Mohamed Salah marka uu ka tago Liverpool xagaagan.
Gerrard ayaa sheegay inuusan u maleynayn in Salah uu ku biirayo koox kale oo ka tirsan Premier League sida Chelsea ama Arsenal, isagoo ka jawaabayay aragti uu soo jeediyay Gary Neville.
Wuxuu yiri: “Uma maleynayo inuu sidaas sameyn doono. Wuxuu tegi karaa koox weyn oo meel kale ah, laakiin ma aaminsani inuu ku biirayo koox kale oo Ingiriis ah.”
Gerrard ayaa si cad u tilmaamay in meesha ugu macquulsan ay tahay Saudi Pro League, isagoo xusay sida weyn ee Salah looga qadariyo dalka Sacuudiga, maadaama uu isagu halkaas ka soo shaqeeyay.
Hadaladan ayaa imanaya kadib markii Salah si rasmi ah u xaqiijiyay inuu ka tagayo Liverpool dhammaadka xilli ciyaareedkan, taasoo sii kordhisay xiisaha ku saabsan halka uu mustaqbalkiisa kusoo af-meeri doono.

headline: Federico Valverde Oo Ugu Dambeyn Bannaanka Keenay Cidda Ka Dambeysa Guulihiisa Real Madrid
body:
Xiddiga khadka dhexe ee Real Madrid, Federico Valverde, ayaa si weyn u ammaanay tababarihiisii hore ee Carlo Ancelotti, isagoo ku tilmaamay macallinka ugu dhameystiran ee uu abid la shaqeeyo.
Valverde ayaa sheegay in Ancelotti uu door weyn ka qaatay horumarkiisa, isla markaana uu ku beeray kalsooni: “Ancelotti wuxuu iga dhigay inaan naftayda aamino. Wuxuu ii yahay sida qoys, waan jeclahay, waxaana rajeynayaa inaan mar kale la kulmo.”
Wuxuu sidoo kale xusay sida tababaruhu uu kooxda ugu abuuri jiray rabitaan joogto ah oo guul ah, taasoo ka caawisay ciyaartoyda inay horumar sameeyaan.
Tan iyo markii uu la shaqeeyay Ancelotti, Valverde wuxuu noqday tiir muhiim ah oo ka tirsan Real Madrid, isagoo sidoo kale ka mid noqday khad dhexe-yada ugu fiican dunida. Xilli ciyaareedkan, xiddiga reer Uruguay ayaa si weyn u iftiimay, isagoo dhaliyay 8 gool islamarkaana bixiyay 12 caawin.

headline: Maxaa Ka Jira Wararka Sheegaya In Konate Oggolaaday Inuu Sii Joogo Liverpool?
body:
Kooxda Liverpool ayaa weli dooneysa inay sii haysato daafaceeda Ibrahima Konate, balse kaliya haddii heshiiska cusub uu ku yimaado shuruudo u wanaagsan kooxda.
Wararka ka imanaya The Athletic ayaa sheegaya in wada-hadallada qandaraaska aysan wali gaarin horumar muuqda, taasoo keentay in mustaqbalka Konate uu noqdo mid aan weli caddeyn.
Inkasta oo bilo ka hor la rumeysnaa inuu bixitaan u dhow yahay, haddana xaaladda hadda way ka duwan tahay sidii hore. Ilo ku dhow kooxda iyo ciyaaryahanka ayaa xaqiijiyay in aysan jirin wax heshiis ah oo dhow, balse sidoo kale ma jirto go’aan cad oo ku saabsan inuu baxayo.
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, ilo ku dhow qolka labiska Liverpool ayaa aaminsan in fursadda uu Konate ku sii nagaan karo Anfield ay hadda ka badan tahay tan uu ku bixi karo xagaaga.
Arrintan ayaa ka dhigaysa xaaladdiisa mid furan, iyadoo la sugayo haddii labada dhinac ay gaari doonaan heshiis ama ay kooxo kale ka faa’iideysan doonaan xaaladda.

headline: Sidee Ayuu Champions League U Saamayn Doonaa Helitaanka Liverpool Ee Badalka Salah?
body:
Kooxda Liverpool ayaa sii waddo qorshaheeda ay ku doonayso inay hesho beddel muddo dheer ah oo loogu talagalay inuu buuxiyo booska xiddigeeda reer Masar, Mohamed Salah, kaasoo la filayo inuu ka tago kooxda dhammaadka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Saxafiga The Athletic, James Pearce, ayaa sheegay in inkastoo Liverpool lala xiriirinayo Michael Olise oo ka tirsan Bayern Munich, haddana uusan u arkin ikhtiyaar macquul ah. Wuxuu xusay in ay aad u adag tahay in Bayern laga qaato xiddig muhiim u ah, haddii aan la bixin lacag aad u badan.
Dhanka kale, Pearce ayaa tilmaamay in Yan Diomande oo ka tirsan RB Leipzig uu yahay doorasho ka macquulsan, isla markaana si fiican ugu habboon nooca ciyaaryahan ee Liverpool raadineyso. Si kastaba, qiimaha lagu qiyaasayo Diomande ayaa gaaraya €100 milyan, inkastoo uu da’ yar yahay.
Ugu dambeyn, Pearce ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay in qorshaha Liverpool uu si weyn ugu xirnaan doono inay u soo baxaan UEFA Champions League xilli ciyaareedka soo socda, maadaama tartankaasi uu saameyn weyn ku leeyahay awoodda dhaqaale ee kooxda iyo go’aamada suuqa kala iibsiga.

headline: Pep Guardiola Oo Loo Dhiibayo Xul Caan Ah
body:
Kadib guuldarradii kasoo gaartay Bosnia and Herzegovina kulankii play-off-ka ee isreeb-reebka FIFA World Cup 2026, xulka Italy ayaa bilaabay raadinta tababare cusub.
Sida ay qortay La Gazzetta dello Sport, musharrixiinta ugu cadcad waxaa ka mid ah Antonio Conte iyo Roberto Mancini. Mancini ayaa hore ugu guuleystay UEFA Euro 2020 isagoo hoggaaminaya xulka Talyaaniga, balse wuxuu ka tagay xilka kadib khilaaf uu la yeeshay xiriirka kubadda cagta Talyaaniga.
Magac kale oo si lama filaan ah ugu soo baxay liiska waa Pep Guardiola, iyadoo la sheegay in haddii uu ka tago Manchester City dhammaadka xilli ciyaareedka 2025/26, Talyaanigu isku dayi doono inuu soo jiito.
Sidoo kale, Massimiliano Allegri ayaa liiska ku jira, inkastoo ay adag tahay in laga soo qaato kooxdiisa, halka tababarayaal kale sida Luciano Spalletti iyo Gian Piero Gasperini aan hadda loo arkin doorashooyin ku habboon xaaladda.
Talyaaniga ayaa hadda xitaa ka fiirsanaya inuu keeno tababare ajnabi ah, taasoo ka dhigaysa Guardiola mid ka mid ah xulashooyinka ugu xiisaha badan ee suurtagalka ah.

headline: Joe Cole Oo Saadaaliyay Kooxda Uu Aaminsan Yahay Inay Ku Guuleysaneyso Tartanka FA Cup-ka Sanadkan
body:
Halyeeygii hore ee England, Joe Cole, ayaa sheegay inuu dareen qarsoon ka qabo in Manchester City ay ku guuleysan doonto FA Cup xilli ciyaareedkan.
Cole ayaa tilmaamay in kooxda uu hoggaamiyo Pep Guardiola ay horey u muujisay awooddeeda, gaar ahaan kadib markii ay ku guuleysteen Carabao Cup iyagoo ka adkaaday Arsenal finalka.
Manchester City ayaa wajahaysa kulan adag oo ay la ciyaarayso Liverpool wareegga siddeed dhammaadka FA Cup, kulan si weyn loo sugayo.
Dhanka kale, Arsenal ayaa u safreysa Southampton, halka Chelsea ay martigelinayso Port Vale, iyadoo West Ham United ay la ciyaari doonto Leeds United.
Hadalka Joe Cole ayaa muujinaya kalsoonida uu ku qabo Manchester City, inkastoo tartanka uu weli furan yahay oo ay jiraan kooxo badan oo awood leh.

headline: Obi Mikel Oo Shaaciyay Afar Xiddig Oo Muhiim Ah Oo Chelsea Ka Tagi Kara Suuqa Xagaaga
body:
Halyeeygii hore ee Nigeria iyo Chelsea, John Obi Mikel, ayaa ka digay in kooxda laga yaabo inay lumiso ilaa afar xiddig oo muhiim ah xagaagan.
Mikel ayaa sheegay in ciyaartoyda sida Enzo Fernandez, Cole Palmer, Marc Cucurella iyo Moises Caicedo ay heli karaan dalabyo waaweyn oo ka imaan kara kooxo kale, gaar ahaan Real Madrid.
Wuxuu si gaar ah u xusay madaxweynaha Madrid, Florentino Perez, isagoo ku tilmaamay inuu yahay qof aad ugu xeel dheer soo jiidashada ciyaartoyda ugu fiican.
Mikel ayaa sidoo kale su’aal ka keenay siyaasadda suuqa kala iibsiga ee Chelsea, isagoo shaki geliyay in qorshaha hadda jira uu keeni karo guulo waaweyn. Wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay in hadafka ugu weyn ee kooxda uu yahay ku guuleysiga koobab, balse arrintaas ay u baahan tahay xasillooni iyo haysashada ciyaartoyda ugu muhiimsan kooxda.

headline: 5-ta Xiddig Ee Ugu Mushahaarka Badan Horyaalka Premier League Oo La Shaaciyay
body:
Wargeyska Faransiiska ee L’Équipe ayaa shaaciyay liiska ciyaartoyda ugu mushaharka badan horyaalka Premier League xilli ciyaareedkan, iyadoo magacyo waaweyn ay hoggaaminayaan.
Xiddiga Manchester City, Erling Haaland, ayaa kaalinta koowaad galay, isagoo qaata €2.63 milyan bishii, taasoo ka dhigaysa ciyaaryahanka ugu mushaharka badan horyaalka.
Kaalinta labaad waxaa galay Mohamed Salah oo ka tirsan Liverpool, isagoo qaata €2 milyan bishii.
Kaalinta saddexaad waxaa wadaagay Casemiro oo ka tirsan Manchester United iyo Virgil van Dijk, oo labaduba qaata €1.75 milyan bishii.
Kaalinta shanaad waxaa isla wadaagay Bruno Fernandes iyo Bukayo Saka, kuwaas oo min €1.5 milyan bishii qaata.
Liiskan ayaa muujinaya sida ay kooxaha waaweyn ee England u bixiyaan mushahar aad u sarreeya si ay u sii haystaan ciyaartoydooda ugu muhiimsan.
