headline: Ciyaartoyda Ugu Mushahaarka Badan Horyaalka La liga Oo La Soo Saaray
body:
Wargeyska Faransiiska ee L’Équipe ayaa soo bandhigay liiska ciyaartoyda ugu mushahaarka badan horyaalka La Liga, iyadoo ay si weyn u hoggaaminayaan xiddigaha Real Madrid iyo Barcelona.
Kaalinta koowaad waxaa wadaagay Kylian Mbappé iyo saaxiibkiis Vinícius Júnior, kuwaas oo min €2.67 milyan bishii qaata.
Kaalinta saddexaad waxaa galay David Alaba oo isna ka tirsan Real Madrid, isagoo qaata €1.88 milyan bishii.
Weeraryahanka Barcelona, Robert Lewandowski, ayaa galay kaalinta afaraad, isagoo qaata €1.73 milyan bishii.
Kaalinta shanaad waxaa wadaagay Jude Bellingham oo ka tirsan Real Madrid iyo goolhayaha Atlético Madrid, Jan Oblak, kuwaas oo min €1.67 milyan bishii qaata.
Liiskan ayaa muujinaya awoodda dhaqaale ee kooxaha waaweyn ee Spain iyo sida ay u haystaan qaar ka mid ah xiddigaha ugu fiican dunida.

headline: Vinícius Júnior Oo Sameeyay Fal Ay Ku Farxeen Taageerayaasha Muslimiinta Kadib Takoor Diimeedkii Lagula Kacay Yamal
body:
Xiddiga reer Brazil, Vinícius Júnior, ayaa u muujiyay taageero da’yarka Barcelona, Lamine Yamal, kadib dhacdadii muranka dhalisay ee la xiriirtay heesaha cunsuriyadda iyo takoor diimeedka.
Vinícius ayaa si fudud u muujiyay garab istaaggiisa isagoo “like” gareeyay fariin uu Yamal ku daabacay baraha bulshada, taasoo uu kaga hadlayay sida uu uga xumaaday heesihii la qaaday kulankii u dhexeeyay Spain  iyo Egypt ee ka dhacay RCDE Stadium.
Yamal ayaa fariintiisa ku caddeeyay inuu yahay Muslim, isla markaana uu maqlay heeso lagu aflagaadeynayo dadka Muslimiinta ah, isagoo sheegay in inkasta oo aan si gaar ah isaga loola jeedin, haddana ay tahay arrin aan la aqbali karin oo muujinaysa jahli iyo takoor.
Wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay in kubadda cagtu ay tahay meel lagu raaxeysto oo lagu dhiirrigeliyo bulshooyinka kala duwan, balse aysan ahayn meel lagu caayo dadka diintooda ama aqoonsigooda.
Taageerada Vinícius iyo shaqsiyaad kale oo badan ayaa muujinaysa sida ay dunida kubadda cagtu u cambaareyneyso falalka noocan ah, iyadoo la dalbanayo in la joojiyo cunsuriyadda iyo takoor kasta oo ka dhaca garoomada.

headline: Beddelka Salah Oo La Helay! Liverpool Oo U Weecatay Xiddig €100 Milyan Ah.
body:
Baadi-goobka ay Liverpool ugu jirto beddelka mustaqbalka ee Mohamed Salah ayaa galay marxalad cusub, iyadoo magacyo cusub oo waaweyn si dhab ah loo tixgelinayo.
Sida uu sheegay wariyaha The Athletic James Pearce, Liverpool uma aragto Michael Olise mid si sahlan lagu heli karo, gaar ahaan maadaama uu ka tirsan yahay Bayern Munich, oo ay adag tahay in laga soo qaato xiddigahooda ugu muhiimsan.
Taa beddelkeeda, kooxda ayaa si dhab ah u eegaysa Yan Diomande oo ka ciyaara RB Leipzig, iyadoo loo arko mid ku habboon qaabka ay Liverpool raadinayso. Si kastaba, qiimaha lagu qiimeeyay da’yarkan oo ah €100 milyan ayaa weli keenaya su’aalo badan, maadaama uu weli yahay ciyaaryahan aan si buuxda u bislaan.
Go’aanka kama dambaysta ah ee Liverpool ayaa si weyn ugu xirnaan doona haddii ay u soo baxaan UEFA Champions League xilli ciyaareedka soo socda, maadaama arrintaas ay saameyn ku yeelan doonto miisaaniyadda suuqa kala iibsiga.

Wuxuu sheegay in hadalladiisu u muuqdaan kuwo uu ku muujinayo xakameyn, balse dhab ahaantii aysan jirin awood buuxda oo uu ku leeyahay kooxda.

Wuxuu sidoo kale dareemay in ciyaartoydu aysan si dhab ah u dhageysanayn ama u raacin tilmaamaha Rosenior.
Hadaladan ayaa sii kordhinaya cadaadiska saaran Rosenior, iyadoo mustaqbalkiisa kooxda uu sii noqonayo mid shaki ku jiro.

headline: Barcelona Oo Waji-gabax Kala Kulantay Kulantay Saxiixa Rashford
body:
Kooxda Barcelona ayaa isku dayaysa inay dib u qaabeyso heshiiska Marcus Rashford, halkii ay si toos ah u bixin lahayd €30 milyan oo ah lacagta ku xusan qodobkiisa iibsiga.
Sida uu sheegay Fabrizio Romano, Barca waxay doorbideysaa inay hal sano oo amaah ah ku kordhiso heshiiska Rashford, si ay u hesho dabacsanaan dhaqaale oo dheeraad ah iyadoo weli ka faa’iideysanaysa ciyaaryahanka.
Si kastaba, Manchester United ayaa si cad u diiday qorshahaas, iyagoo doonaya kaliya in la bixiyo lacagta €30 milyan, isla markaana aan dan ka lahayn amaah kale. Tani waxay abuurtay kala fogaansho u dhexeeya labada kooxood.
Inkasta oo xaaladdu sidaas tahay, Rashford ayaa lagu soo waramayaa inuu ku faraxsan yahay Barcelona, halka tababare Hansi Flick uu si weyn u qadariyo dabacsanaantiisa iyo anshaxa shaqadiisa. Xiddiga reer England ayaa xilli ciyaareedkan dhaliyay 10 gool, halka uu caawiyay 11 kale, isagoo door muhiim ah ka ciyaaray garabka bidix, gaar ahaan kadib maqnaanshaha Raphinha.

headline: Harry Maguire Oo Lagu Soo Oogay Dacwad Aflagaaddo Ah.
body:
Daafaca Manchester United, Harry Maguire, ayaa lagu soo oogay dacwad la xiriirta anshax xumo kadib kulankii ay la ciyaareen  Bournemouth.
Maguire ayaa casaan qaatay daqiiqaddii 78-aad ee ciyaartaas, waxaana lagu eedeeyay inuu si aan habboonayn ula dhaqmay garsooraha afraad, isagoo adeegsaday hadallo ama dhaqan aflagaado ah kadib markii garoonka laga saaray.
War rasmi ah ayaa lagu sheegay in falka difaaca uu ahaa mid “aan habboonayn” isla markaana uu ku lug lahaa erayo ama ficillo aflagaado ah oo ku wajahan garsooraha afraad.
Maguire ayaa la siiyay ilaa 2-da April inuu ka jawaabo eedeymaha loo soo jeediyay, iyadoo la filayo in go’aan laga gaaro haddii lagu helo dambigaas, iyadoo ciqaab halis ah ay ka dhalan karto.

headline: Fabrizio Romano Oo Shaaciyay Tababaraha Ay City U Calaamad-satay Beddelka Guardiola
body:
Kooxda Manchester City ayaa si cad u calaamad satay tababaraha ay rabto inuu beddelo Pep Guardiola mustaqbalka, iyadoo Enzo Maresca loo arko musharraxa ugu habboon.
Sida uu sheegay wariyaha caanka ah Fabrizio Romano, Manchester City waxay muddo bilo ah si joogto ah u aaminsanayd in Maresca yahay qofka ugu fiican ee sii wadi kara falsafadda kooxda marka Guardiola tago.
Inkasta oo Guardiola ay weli hal sano uga harsan tahay heshiiskiisa, isla markaana uusan jirin cadaadis lagu saarayo inuu baxo, haddana go’aanka mustaqbalkiisa wuxuu ku xiran yahay isaga laftiisa.
City ayaa la sheegay in haddii Guardiola uu go’aansado inuu baxo xagaagan ama mustaqbalka dhow, ay si toos ah ula xaajoon karaan Maresca si uu xilka ula wareego. Tani waxay muujinaysaa kalsoonida weyn ee ay maamulka kooxda ku qabaan tababaraha reer Talyaani, oo hore uga tirsanaa shaqaalaha tababarka kooxda.

headline: Casemiro Oo Magacaabay Labada Xiddig Ee Mustaqbalka Hoggaamin Doonta Manchester United
body:
Xiddiga Khadka dhexe ee Manchester United, Casemiro, ayaa si weyn u ammaanay labada xiddig ee da’da yar Kobbie Mainoo iyo Matheus Cunha, isagoo ku tilmaamay laf-dhabarta mustaqbalka kooxda.
Casemiro ayaa sheegay in Mainoo uu yahay “hadda iyo mustaqbalka” kooxda, isagoo ku ammaanay kalsoonidiisa iyo sida uu mar walba u maareeyo kubbadaha. Wuxuu xusay in Mainoo uu hore ugu muujiyay tayadiisa kulamo waaweyn, isla markaana uu noqon karo mid ka mid ah ciyaartoyda ugu fiican booskiisa sanadaha soo socda.
Dhanka kale, Casemiro ayaa sidoo kale si gaar ah u bogaadiyay Cunha, oo uu sheegay inuu xiriir wanaagsan la leeyahay. Wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay in weeraryahanka reer Brazil uu door weyn ka ciyaari doono qorshaha mustaqbalka ee United.
Cunha laftiisa ayaa dib u amaanay Casemiro, isagoo sheegay inuu wax badan ka barto khibraddiisa iyo sida uu ugu guuleystay koobab badan, taasoo ka caawinaysa inuu si joogto ah u horumaro.

headline: Liverpool Oo War Farxad Leh Ka Heshay Xaaladda Alexander Isak
body:
Weeraryahanka Liverpool, Alexander Isak, ayaa qaaday tallaabo muhiim ah oo ku saabsan soo kabashadiisa kadib dhaawac culus oo canqowga ah.
Isak ayaa maqnaa tan iyo bishii December, kaddib markii qalliin looga sameeyay dhaawac soo gaaray xilli uu gool dhalinayay kulan ay la ciyaareen Tottenham Hotspur.
Tababaraha kooxda, Arne Slot, ayaa sheegay in xiddiga reer Sweden uu hadda ku jiro xaalad wanaagsan, isla markaana uu dib ugu laabanayo tababarka kooxda markii ugu horreysay. Wuxuu sidoo kale xusay in soo bixitaanka xulka Sweden ee FIFA World Cup 2026 ay sii kordhisay dhiirranaanta ciyaaryahanka.
Slot ayaa tilmaamay in kadib saddex ilaa afar bilood oo uu ku jiray soo kabasho adag, ku soo laabashada tababarka kooxda ay tahay tallaabo weyn oo muujinaysa horumar wanaagsan, taasoo farxad u ah ciyaaryahanka iyo kooxda labadaba.

headline: William Gallas Oo Magacaabay Tababaraha Kaliya Ee Guulo Ku Hoggaamin Kara Chelsea, Haddii Ay Ceyriso Liam Rosenior
body:
Daaficii hore ee Chelsea, William Gallas, ayaa soo jeediyay tababaraha ay tahay in kooxda la keeno haddii Blues ay go’aansato inay fasaxdo Liam Rosenior dhammaadka xilli ciyaareedka.
Rosenior ayaa cadaadis wajahaya kadib markii kooxdiisu ay guuldarrooyin xiriir ah kala kulantay tartamada kala duwan, taasoo keentay in mustaqbalkiisa Stamford Bridge la is weydiiyo.
Gallas ayaa aaminsan in Cesc Fàbregas uu yahay doorasho wanaagsan oo mustaqbalka fog ah, isagoo sheegay in tababaraha reer Spain uu si fiican uga shaqeynayo kooxdiisa haatan, isla markaana uu leeyahay awood uu kula shaqeeyo ciyaartoyda da’da yar.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray in Fabregas uu keeni karo xasillooni iyo horumar joogto ah, taasoo ka caawin karta Chelsea inay dib ugu laabato heerkii sare ee ay taageerayaashu ka filayeen.

headline: Wayne Rooney Oo Daboolka Ka Rogay Waxa Ka Dambeeya Hoos U Dhaca Saka Ee Xilli Ciyaareed Kaan
body:
Halyeeyga Manchester United, Wayne Rooney, ayaa sharaxay sababaha ka dambeeya hoos u dhaca qaab ciyaareedka Bukayo Saka xilli ciyaareedkan, iyadoo Arsenal ay ku jirto tartan adag oo ay ugu jirto hanashada horyaalka Premier League.
Rooney wuxuu tilmaamay in cadaadis weyn uu saaran yahay Saka, gaar ahaan maadaama uu door hoggaamineed qaatay intii uu maqnaa kabtanka kooxda Martin Ødegaard oo dhaawac qabay. Cadaadiskaas, oo ay weheliso rajada sare ee laga qabo Arsenal inay koobab ku guuleysato, ayaa saameyn ku yeeshay waxqabadkiisa.
Wuxuu sidoo kale xusay in Saka uu ciyaaray kulamo badan tan iyo bilowgii xirfaddiisa, taasoo keeni karta daal jireed iyo maskaxeed. Inkastoo uu qirtay in xiddiga uu la kulmay hoos u dhac, Rooney wuxuu adkeeyay in Saka uu yahay ciyaaryahan heer sare ah oo wali leh wax badan oo uu bixin karo.

body:
Manchester United ayaa qorsheynaysa isbeddel weyn xagaagan, iyadoo la filayo inay helaan in ka badan £100 milyan oo ka yimaada iibka ciyaartoyda iyo heshiisyada dhamaanaya.
Kooxda ayaa hadda ku jirta kaalinta saddexaad ee Premier League, taasoo ka dhigan inay u dhowdahay inay dib ugu laabato UEFA Champions League, arrin dhaqaale ahaan muhiim u noqon doonta.
Ciyaartoyda la filayo inay si rasmi ah u baxaan waxaa ka mid ah Marcus Rashford, Rasmus Højlund, Manuel Ugarte, Joshua Zirkzee, iyo André Onana. Halka Casemiro, Jadon Sancho, iyo Tyrell Malacia ay bixi doonaan marka heshiisyadoodu dhamaadaan.
Rashford, oo amaah ku jooga Barcelona, ayaa leh qiime £26m ah, halka Højlund laga yaabo inuu £38m ugu biiro Napoli haddii shuruudo qaar la buuxiyo. United sidoo kale waxay rajeynayaan inay lacag ka helaan iibka Ugarte, Zirkzee iyo Onana, iyadoo mushaharooyin badan laga yareyn doono.
Kooxdu waxay mudnaanta siin doontaa khadka dhexe, iyadoo lala xiriirinayo ciyaartoy sida Carlos Baleba, Elliot Anderson, João Gomes, iyo Adam Wharton. Waxaa sidoo kale la eegayaa xoojinta garabka bidix, iyadoo magacyo ay ka mid yihiin Yan Diomande, Iliman Ndiaye, iyo Lewis Hall la tixgelinayo.
Isku darka tagista xiddigo badan iyo suurtagalnimada ka qaybgalka Champions League ayaa ka dhigaya suuqa xagaagan mid ka mid ah kuwii ugu muhiimsanaa ee Manchester United sanadihii ugu dambeeyay.

headline: 10-ka Xul Ee Ugu Caansan Ee Ku Fashilmay Inay U Soo Baxaan Koobka Adduunka 2026 Oo La Shaaciyay
body:
Ugu yaraan 10 xul oo hore uga soo qayb galay Koobka Adduunka ayaa seegi doona FIFA World Cup 2026, kaddib markii ay ku guuldareysteen kulamadii isreeb-reebka.
Qaaradda Afrika, waxaa si weyn looga dareemi doonaa maqnaanshaha xulalka Cameroon iyo Nigeria, kuwaas oo labaduba looga adkaaday play-off-yada Afrika ee ay ku soo baxday DR Congo.
Yurub, xulalka waa weyn sida Italy, Denmark, iyo Poland ayaa ka mid ah kuwa maqnaan doona, kaddib markii ay ku guuldareysteen final-kii play-off-yada. Boosaskooda waxaa ku soo baxay Bosnia and Herzegovina, Czech Republic, iyo Sweden.
Koonfurta Ameerika, saddex xul oo caan ah Chile, Peru, iyo Bolivia ayaa daawan doona tartanka iyagoo gurigooda jooga. Bolivia ayaa ugu dhowayd inay soo baxdo, balse waxaa 2-1 kaga adkaaday Iraq play-off-ka caalamiga ah.
Sidoo kale, China iyo Costa Rica ayaa ka mid ah xulalka kale ee aan ka soo muuqan doonin tartanka.
Arrintan waxay muujinaysaa sida tartanku u noqday mid aad u adag, iyadoo xulal taariikh leh ay ka hareen, halka kuwo cusub ay fursad heleen.

headline: 10-Ka Xiddig Ee Ugu Qaalisan Adduunka Balse Aan Nasiibka U Yeelan Inay Ka Qeyb Galaan World Cup-Ka.
body:
Xiddigo badan oo heer caalami ah ayaa weli aan ka qayb gelin FIFA World Cup, inkastoo ay ka mid yihiin kuwa ugu qiimaha sarreeya kubadda cagta maanta.
Hoggaanka liiskan waxaa haya weeraryahanka Manchester City, Erling Haaland, kaasoo lagu qiimeeyay €200 milyan; waana kan ugu qiimaha sarreeya dhammaan ciyaartoyda aan wali ciyaarin Koobka Adduunka.
Waxaa ku xiga Victor Osimhen, halka Alexander Isak iyo Florian Wirtz lagu qiimeeyay €140 milyan. Martin Ødegaard ayaa isna dhammaystiraya shanta ugu sarreysa.
Liiska 10-ka sare waxaa sidoo kale ku jira:
Dominik Szoboszlai (€100m)
Jan Oblak (€100m)
Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (€90m)
Marc-André ter Stegen (€90m)
Luis Díaz (€85m)
Arrintan waxay muujinaysaa in xitaa ciyaartoyda ugu qaalisan adduunka aysan mararka qaar helin fursad ay kaga qeyb galaan Koobka Adduunka, taas oo ku xiran awoodda xulalkooda qaranka ee isreeb-reebka.

headline: Guti Oo Magacaabay Cidda Ku Guuleysaneysa Champions League Xilli Ciyaareed Kaan; Ma Ahan Real Madrid
body:
Halyeeyga Real Madrid, Guti, ayaa sheegay in aysan jirin koox si cad ugu cadcad hanashada horyaalka La Liga xilli ciyaareedkan, isagoo tilmaamay in tartanku uu u dhexeeyo laba koox oo waaweyn.
Guti wuxuu xusay in Barcelona iyo Real Madrid labaduba ay wajahayaan waqtiyo adag, isla markaana aysan wali helin joogteyn guulo ah oo ka dhigta kuwo si cad ugu cadcad horyaalka.
Sidoo kale, Guti ayaa si cad u sheegay inuusan aaminsaneyn in kooxaha Spain ay ku guuleysan doonaan UEFA Champions League sanadkan. Wuxuu tilmaamay in koobka ay u badan tahay inuu aado koox ka socota France, Germany, ama England, isagoo hoos u dhigay rajada kooxaha sida Atletico Madrid, Barcelona iyo Real Madrid.
Inkasta oo uu rajeynayo in Real Madrid ay ku guuleysato La Liga, haddana Guti wuxuu qirtay in tartanku uu yahay mid aad u adag oo aan lahayn koox si buuxda uga sarreysa kuwa kale.

headline: Dhammaadka Xilligii Goolasha Tirada Badan: Sharciga Cusub Ee Ballon d’Or Oo Lagu Ciqaabayo Ciyaartoyda Qaar!
body:
Wararka ka soo baxaya wargeys yada Spain ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in sannadka 2026 la hirgelin doono shuruudo cusub oo lagu qiimeynayo Ballon d’Or, iyadoo xoogga la saari doono waxqabadka ciyaartoyga ee kulamada waaweyn.
Sida ay sheegtay idaacadda COPE, qiimeynta xilli ciyaareedka soo socda waxaa diiradda lagu saari doonaa saamaynta ciyaartoydu ku leeyihiin kulamada go’aaminta leh, ha ahaato heerka tartamada qaaradda ama kulamada kooxaha waaweyn ee muhiimka ah.
Dhanka kale, waxqabadka ciyaartoyga ka dhanka ah kooxaha heerka hooseeya ma yeelan doono miisaan la mid ah kan hore, taas oo ujeeddadeedu tahay in la muujiyo ciyaartoyda awoodda u leh inay farqi ka sameeyaan daqiiqadaha iyo kulamada waaweyn.
France Football, oo ah hay’adda abaabusha abaalmarintan, ayaa sheegtay in guuleystaha Ballon d’Or la doorto iyadoo la eegayo shuruudo ay ka mid yihiin waxqabadka ciyaartoyga ee koox iyo mid shaqsiyeed, tirada koobabka uu kula guuleystay kooxda, akhlaaqda ciyaareed, iyo guud ahaan taariikhdiisa ciyaareed.

headline: ​£280M! Chelsea Oo Go’aan Lama Filaan Ah Ka Gaartay Mustaqbalka Enzo Iyo Palmer.
body:
Wararka ka soo baxaya wargeys yada Ingiriiska ayaa sheegaya in Chelsea ay sare u qaaday qiimaha lagu heli karo xiddigaha ay ka mid yihiin Enzo Fernandez iyo Cole Palmer, iyadoo u sheegtay kooxaha xiisaynaya inaysan oggolaan doonin wax ka hooseeya £280 milyan.
Enzo Fernandez waxaa lala xiriirinayaa kooxaha Real Madrid iyo Paris Saint-Germain, halka Cole Palmer uu soo jiitay xiisaha kooxo waaweyn sida Manchester United, Bayern Munich, iyo Real Madrid.
Chelsea ayaa tallaabadan qaaday si ay u ilaaliso xiddigaha muhiimka u ah kooxda, gaar ahaan ka dib waxqabadkooda cajiibka ah ee xilli ciyaareedyadii u dambeeyay. Qiimahan sare wuxuu sidoo kale u muuqdaa in lagu adkeeyo wadahadalka, iyadoo koox kasta oo doonaysa xiddigahan ay tahay inay diyaar u noqoto bixinta lacagtaas.
Wararkan waxay muujinayaan sida Chelsea uga go’an tahay inay u sii haysato xiddigaha muhiimka u ah qorshayaasha mustaqbalka kooxda.

headline: Zico Oo Magacaabay Xiddiga Kaliya Ee Ka Hibada Badan Ronaldo & Messi
body:
Halyeygii hore ee Brazil, Zico ayaa si yaab leh u sheegay in Neymar uu ka hibbo badan yahay labada xiddig ee waaweyn Lionel Messi iyo Cristiano Ronaldo.
Zico ayaa qirtay in Neymar uu leeyahay hibbo dabiici ah oo aad u sareysa, balse uu ka hooseeyo Messi iyo Ronaldo marka loo eego dhinaca dadaalka iyo xirfadda.
“Ilaahay wuxuu Neymar siiyay hibbo uu siiyay dad aad u yar. Saddexda ugu hibbada badan kubadda cagta waa Messi, Ronaldo, iyo Neymar… laakiin labada kale waa xirfadlayaal cajiib ah,” ayuu yiri Zico.
Zico wuxuu si cad u sheegay in dhibaatada Neymar aysan ahayn tayo, balse ay tahay sida uu uga faa’iideysto:
Messi iyo Ronaldo → shaqo adag + joogteyn
Neymar → hibbo weyn, laakiin aan si buuxda loo isticmaalin
Wuxuu xusay in kubadda cagtu ay Neymar siisay wax walba, taasoo laga yaabo inay saameysay sida uu u maareeyo xirfaddiisa.
Zico ayaa sidoo kale tilmaamay in dhaawacyadu ay si weyn u saameeyeen Neymar sanadihii ugu dambeeyay, taasoo ka hor istaagtay inuu joogto noqdo.
Tan iyo dhaawacii cuslaa ee jilibka (ACL) ee 2023, Neymar ma helin waqti uu si joogto ah ugu ciyaaro, taasoo hoos u dhigtay heerkiisii.
Inkastoo doodda “yaa ugu fiican?” ay wali taagan tahay, hadalka Zico wuxuu iftiiminayaa xaqiiqo muhiim ah:
-Neymar waxaa laga yaabaa inuu yahay ciyaaryahanka ugu hibada badan, laakiin Messi iyo Ronaldo ayaa ah kuwa ugu guulaha badan, sababo la xiriira dadaalkooda iyo joogteyntooda.

headline: Ronaldo Oo Qaaday Tallaabo Uu Casemiro Kaga Hor Istaagayo Inuu Ku Biiro Inter Miami-da Messi
body:
Kabtanka Al-Nassr, Cristiano Ronaldo, ayaa la sheegay inuu isku dayayo inuu ka dhaadhiciyo saaxiibkiisii hore Casemiro inuusan ku biirin Inter Miami xagaagan.
Casemiro, oo ka tagaya Manchester United dhammaadka xilli ciyaareedkan kadib markii aan heshiiskiisa la kordhin, ayaa la filayaa inuu noqdo mid ka mid ah ciyaartoyda ugu xiisaha badan suuqa.
Kooxda Inter Miami ayaa doonaysa inay keento Casemiro si uu ula ciyaaro Lionel Messi, taasoo dib u kicin karta iska horimaadkii caanka ahaa ee Messi iyo Ronaldo, inkastoo markan ay ka dhici doonto Mareykanka.
Laakiin Ronaldo ayaa doonaya inuu arrintaas ka hortago, isagoo ku riixaya Casemiro inuu u wareego Sacuudiga, si uu ugu biiro Al-Nassr oo doonaysa inay xoojiso khadkeeda dhexe.
Sababta Ronaldo u doonayo Casemiro
-Khibrad sare oo Champions League ah
-Xiriir hore oo ay ku lahaayeen Real Madrid
-Hoggaan iyo difaac adag oo kooxda ka caawin kara koobab
Go’aanka Casemiro ayaa noqon doona mid xiiso leh:
Miyuu aadi doonaa Messi, Mise wuxuu dooran doonaa inuu la midoobo Ronaldo mar kale?
Hal arrin ayaa cad; xagaagan waxaa dhici kara mid ka mid ah saxiixyada ugu xiisaha badan suuqa kala iibsiga.

headline: Ashley Cole Oo Magacaabay Hal Daafac Oo Chelsea Ah Oo Ka Fiican Nuno Mendes
body:
Daaficii hore ee Chelsea, Ashley Cole, ayaa si cad u sheegay in kabtanka Blues, Reece James, uu ka difaacasho fiican yahay daafaca Paris Saint-Germain, Nuno Mendes.
Isagoo ka hadlayay barnaamijka The Overlap, Cole wuxuu yiri:
“Haddii aan ka fikiro waxa aan ka doonayo daafac dambeed, waxaan dooranayaa Reece James.”
James ayaa xilli ciyaareedkan si fiican uga dhex muuqday Chelsea, isagoo ka ciyaaray labadaba daafaca midig iyo khadka dhexe, inkastoo uu hadda dhaawac muruqa ah ku maqan yahay.
Maqnaanshihiisa ayaa si weyn loo dareemay, gaar ahaan xilli adag oo kooxda ay ku jirto, oo ay ka mid tahay guuldarro culus oo ka soo gaartay Paris Saint-Germain tartanka Yurub, iyo sidoo kale natiijooyin liita oo horyaalka ah.
Hadalka Cole wuxuu muujinayaa kalsoonida weyn ee lagu qabo tayada James, inkastoo tartanka uu ka dhexeeyo daafacyada ugu fiican Yurub uu sii xoogeysanayo.

headline: Konaté Oo Farriin Culus U Diray Taageerayaasha Liverpool
body:
Daafaca Liverpool, Ibrahima Konate, ayaa fariin dhiirrigelin ah u diray taageerayaasha kooxda xilli ay ku jiraan marxalad adag.
Konaté ayaa ka codsaday taageerayaasha inay muujiyaan dulqaad iyo midnimo, isagoo rumeysan in kooxda ay dib ugu soo laaban doonto guulihii lagu yaqiinay, mustaqbalka dhow.
“Waxaan keennay ciyaartoy cusub, waan is baran doonaa, ugu dambeynna waan ku guuleysan doonaa koob,” ayuu yiri.
Wuxuu sidoo kale xusay in guushii ay ku qaadeen Premier League xilli ciyaareedkii hore ay caddeyneyso in kooxda ay weli leedahay awood ay ku guuleysan karto mar kale.
“Markaan mar kale ku guuleysanno horyaalka ama UEFA Champions League, dadku way illoobi doonaan xilli ciyaareedyada adag,” ayuu intaas ku daray.
Liverpool ayaa hadda ku jirta xaalad adag, iyadoo natiijooyinkii ugu dambeeyay hoos u dhaceen, isla markaana ay jiraan walaacyo dhaawacyo oo ku saabsan xiddigo muhiim ah sida Mohamed Salah iyo Alisson Becker.
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, hadalka Konaté wuxuu muujinayaa in kooxda ay weli aaminsan tahay inay ka gudbi karto caqabadaha oo ay dib ugu laaban karto heerkii ugu sarreeyay.

Si kastaba ha ahaatee, hadalka Konaté wuxuu muujinayaa in kooxda ay weli aaminsan tahay inay ka gudbi karto caqabadaha oo ay dib ugu laaban karto heerkii ugu sarreeyay.

headline: Liverpool Oo Qorshe Cusub U Dejisay Bedelka Salah
body:
Kooxda Liverpool ayaa durba bilaawday qorshaha ay ku buuxinayso booska uu ka tagayo halyeeyga Mohamed Salah, kaasoo la xaqiijiyay inuu tagayo dhammaadka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Salah, oo in ka badan 250 gool u dhaliyay kooxda tan iyo 2017, ayaa ka mid noqday ciyaartoyda ugu waaweyn taariikhda Liverpool, taasoo ka dhigeysa bedelkiisa mid aad u adag.
Wararka ayaa sheegaya in Liverpool aysan raadin doonin ciyaaryahan hal qof ah oo si toos ah u bedela Salah, maadaama arrintaas loo arko “ku dhowaad mid aan suurtagal ahayn.”
Waxaa lala xiriiriyay magacyo ay ka mid yihiin:
Michael Olise
Yan Diomande
Francisco Conceicao
Si kastaba, fursadaha qaar ayaa adag, gaar ahaan Olise oo ay Bayern Munich diidan tahay inay iibiso.
Liverpool waxay si weyn u eegaysaa xal gudaha ah, iyadoo la isku dayayo in si fiican loo mideeyo weerarka kooxda ka hoos ciyaarta tababare Arne Slot.
Ciyaartoyda sida:
Alexander Isak
Florian Wirtz
Hugo Ekitike
ayaa loo arkaa inay si wadajir ah u buuxin karaan booska Salah, halkii hal ciyaaryahan lagu tiirsanaan lahaa.
Isbeddelka qaabka ciyaarta
Waxaa sidoo kale la filayaa in Liverpool ay wax ka beddesho qaabka weerarkeeda, iyadoo laga yaabo inay raadiso garab leh astaamo ka duwan Salah, si uu ula jaanqaado qaabka ciyaareed ee Isak iyo weeraryahanada kale.
Guud ahaan, Liverpool waxay u muuqataa inay qaadaneyso istaraatiijiyad kooxeed halkii ay ka raadin lahayd “Salah cusub”,  taasoo noqon karta go’aan caqli badan ama halis leh xilli ciyaareedka soo socda.

headline: Manchester United Oo Shaacisay Qorshaheeda Suuqa Ee Xagaaga
body:
Kooxda Manchester United ayaa wajahaysa suuq kala iibsi oo aad muhiim u ah, iyadoo qorshahooda si weyn ugu xirnaan doono ciyaartoyda ka tagaya kooxda.
Warbixinta ayaa tilmaamaysa in United ay ku jirto xaalad dhaqaale oo deggan marka loo eego sharciyada cusub ee Premier League, balse si ay si buuxda uga faa’iideystaan, waa inay lacag ka helaan iibka ciyaartoyda.
Magacyada ugu waaweyn ee laga yaabo inay saameeyaan qorshaha waxaa ka mid ah:
Andre Onana
Joshua Zirkzee
Marcus Rashford
Rasmus Hojlund
Haddii dhowr ka mid ah ciyaartoydan ay baxaan, United waxay heli kartaa awood dhaqaale oo ay ku keensato ugu yaraan laba ciyaaryahan oo khadka dhexe ah.
Kooxdu waxay sii wadaysaa siyaasaddeeda ah inay diiradda saarto ciyaartoyda da’da yar ee aan weli gaarin heerka ugu sarreeya, halkii ay ka keeni lahayd ciyaartoy waayeel ah oo xal degdeg ah keena.
Tani waxay muujinaysaa in United ay rabto inay dhisto mustaqbal fog oo joogto ah, halkii ay ka qaadan lahayd go’aanno degdeg ah oo ku meel gaar ah.
Maxaa la filan karaa?
Haddii iibka ciyaartoyda uu si fiican u dhaco, Manchester United waxay geli kartaa suuq aad u firfircoon, gaar ahaan xoojinta khadka dhexe, taasoo noqon karta furaha guusha ee xilli ciyaareedka dambe.

headline: Maxaa Ka Hor Taagan Manchester United Inay Sameyso Saxiixa Tonali?
body:
Kooxda Manchester United ayaa la sheegay inay si taxaddar leh u wajahday xiisaha ay u qabto xiddiga Newcastle United, Sandro Tonali, xagaagan.
Sida uu xaqiijiyay weriyaha caanka ah Fabrizio Romano, United waxay hore ula xiriirtay wakiillada Tonali toddobaadyadii la soo dhaafay, balse ma doonayaan inay bixiyaan lacag xad dhaaf ah.
Newcastle ayaa la filayaa inay dalbato lacag ka badan €60 milyan oo ay ku soo iibsadeen ciyaaryahanka 2023, taasoo caqabad weyn ku noqon karta Red Devils.
United ayaa hadda eegaysa dhowr xulasho oo khadka dhexe ah, iyadoo aysan Tonali u arkin bartilmaameed keliya. Kooxdu waxay qiimeyneysaa arrimo ay ka mid yihiin qiimaha, tayada, iyo mustaqbalka fog kahor inta aysan go’aan gaarin.
Sidoo kale, tartan adag ayaa ka iman kara Manchester City, kuwaas oo sidoo kale la socda xaaladda Tonali iyo ciyaaryahanka kale ee Elliot Anderson.
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, labada kooxood ee Manchester ayaa u muuqda inay sugayaan caddeyn ku saabsan jihada maamulka iyo qorshahooda mustaqbalka kahor inta aysan si buuxda ugu dhaqaaqin ciyaaryahanka.

headline: Obi Mikel Oo Kabaha La Dul-maray Enzo Fernandez Kadib Markii Uu Ku Dhawaaqay Inuu Ku Biirayo Real Madrid
body:
Xiddigii hore ee Chelsea, John Obi Mikel, ayaa si adag uga falceliyay hadalkii dhawaan kasoo yeeray ciyaaryahanka kooxda ee hadda, Enzo Fernandez, kaasoo sheegay inuu jeclaan lahaa inuu ku noolaado Madrid.
Mikel ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay daacadnimada iyo u naf-huridda kooxda Stamford Bridge.
“Chelsea ma ahan meel loo sii maro si aad ugu gudubto koox kale. Haddii qalbigaagu rabo Madrid, waa inaadan xiran funaanadda buluugga ah,” ayuu yiri.
Wuxuu intaas ku daray in xilligoodii ay u ciyaari jireen kooxda iyo taageerayaasha, halkii ay ka fikiri lahaayeen mustaqbalka ama wareegyo kale.
Hadalka Mikel ayaa muujinaya cadaadiska saaran ciyaartoyda Chelsea, si ay muujiyaan daacadnimo buuxda, gaar ahaan xilli warar badan ay ka jiraan mustaqbalka Enzo, kaasoo lala xiriirinayo kooxo waaweyn sida Real Madrid.
Arrintan ayaa sii kordhineysa doodda ku saabsan mustaqbalka Enzo iyo sida ay Chelsea u maareyn doonto xiddigeeda muhiimka ah.
